SAFE : S creen the customer/transaction; A sk the customer questions; F ind out if the transaction matches expectations; E valuate whether it is truly suspicious. 💬 JFIU 係「收件中心」而唔係「偵查機關」——佢收集 STR，再轉介畀執法部門。考試問「JFIU investigates…」多數係陷阱選項。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence money laundering 洗黑錢——將犯罪得嚟嘅錢「洗」到好似合法收入咁 Money laundering is the process by which criminals change the identity of money or property so that it appears to be derived from a legitimate source. predicate offence 上游罪行——產生黑錢嗰單原始罪行 Under Oei Hengky Wiryo v HKSAR (No. 2) (2007), the prosecution need not prove the predicate offence that generated the proceeds. reasonable grounds to believe 有合理理由相信——客觀跡象 + 被告知悉，兩者齊備 The Seng Yuet Fong test requires both objective grounds and the defendant's subjective knowledge of those grounds. tipping off 通水——已有人舉報後向當事人洩露風聲，妨礙調查 Warning a client that a suspicious transaction report has been filed may constitute tipping off under s.25A(5) of the OSCO. suspicious transaction report (STR) 可疑交易報告——向 JFIU 舉報可疑資金 The practice must file an STR with the JFIU as soon as reasonably practicable once suspicion is formed. customer due diligence (CDD) 盡職審查——開戶/接客前核實客戶身份、資金來源 Under Schedule 2 to the AMLO, accountants must perform CDD before carrying out specified transactions for clients. politically exposed person (PEP) 政治人物——高官及其家人、密切聯繫人，屬高風險客戶 Enhanced due diligence is required where a client or its beneficial owner is a PEP. advantage (POBO s.2) 利益——禮物、貸款、佣金、服務等都算，但請食飯唔算 An interest free loan from a supplier is an 'advantage' under s.2 of the POBO, whereas a dinner invitation is mere entertainment.

title: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Section 25(1) of the Organized and Ser…
text: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Section 25(1) of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455) ('OSCO') makes it an offence to deal with property, knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe that the property, in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, represents any person's proceeds of an indictable offence . On conviction upon indictment, the maximum penalty under s.25(3) OSCO is 14 years' imprisonment and a fine of HK$5 million. 解題思路（繁中）: 題眼係「indictable offence」——呢個係 OSCO 嘅關鍵字。 A 錯：s.25(1) DTROPO 條文措辭幾乎一樣，但只涵蓋 proceeds of drug trafficking ，唔係一般 indictable offences。 C 錯：s.5 AMLO 處理嘅係 金融機構明知或意圖欺詐監管機構而違反指定條文 嘅刑事責任，唔係處理黑錢罪。 D 錯：s.7 UNATMO 係 提供或收集財產用於恐怖活動 ，屬反恐範疇。 考試伏位：DTROPO 同 OSCO 嘅 s.25/s.25A 係「孿生條文」，見到毒品 → Cap. 405；見到 fraud/theft/tax evasion 等其他可公訴罪行 → Cap. 455。 Rule Check: Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455) s.25(1), s.25(3); cf. Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance (Cap. 405) s.25(1) Common Trap（繁中）: 見「s.25(1)」就亂揀——兩條條例嘅 section number 相同，分別只在於上游罪行類型（drug trafficking vs indictable offence）。答題時一定要連埋 Cap. number 寫。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Records must be retained for at least five years after the transaction or the cessation of the business relationship. The records must be sufficient to identify and verify the beneficial owner, keep a clear and complete audit trail, and be available to relevant authorities (e.g. the HKMA, the SFC or the Insurance Authority) on a timely basis. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係純記憶題，但係 AML 合規嘅核心數字。 A（3 年）、C（7 年）、D（10 年）都係 plausible distractors——3 年係 tipping off/failure to disclose 嘅最高監禁年期（s.25A(8)），容易記混；7 年係 POBO 一般罪行最高監禁（s.12）；10 年係 POBO ss.5/6 最高監禁。呢啲數字成日喺同一章出現，考官最鍾意用嚟做干擾項。 Rule Check: Anti Money Laundering and Counter Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615) Schedule 2, Part 3; HKICPA Guidelines on AML/CTF for Professional Accountants (2018), Section 660 Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好將「5 年保存期」同其他章節嘅時限（例如 TCSP 牌照有效期 3 年——s.53O AMLO）撈亂。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Under Oei Hengky Wiryo v HKSAR (No. 2) (2007) 10 HKCFAR 98 , the prosecution does not have to prove that the property dealt with was in fact the proceeds of a predicate offence; it is sufficient to establish that the defendant had reasonable grounds to believe the property represented the proceeds of an indictable offence. Applying the Seng Yuet Fong v HKSAR (1999) KCQ3 formulation (endorsed in HKSAR v Yeung Ka Sing Carson (FACC Nos. 5 and 6 of 2015) ), a reasonable person looking objectively at Derek's grounds — an unexplained HK$8 million round sum in and out transfer via a friend's account with a HK$50,000 "handling fee" — would believe (the test in HKSAR v Pang Hung Fai (FACC 8 of 2013) ) the money represented criminal proceeds, and Derek knew those grounds. Derek can therefore be convicted under s.25(1) OSCO. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考案例原則應用，唔係背書。 A 錯：正好係 Oei Hengky Wiryo 推翻咗嘅講法——控方 唔使 證明啲錢真係犯罪得益，都唔使指出邊單上游罪行（HKSAR v Yang Sigai (2016) 進一步確認連海外行為都唔使識別具體罪行）。 C 錯：「只係幫朋友過一筆數」唔係抗辯；mens rea 可以靠「reasonable grounds to believe」成立，唔使實際知悉。Pang Hung Fai 雖然顯示被告個人信任可作考慮，但 Derek 自己都「 suspected illegal gambling 」，主客觀元素齊。 D 錯：DTROPO 只限毒品得益；唔涉及毒品唔等於無罪——OSCO 正正涵蓋非法賭博呢類 indictable offence 嘅得益。 考試伏位：呢類「轉帳過戶」情境（friend's account + round sum + handling fee）係 LP Apply and Analyse 1（Caleb 案例）嘅標準 pattern——見到即諗 s.25(1) OSCO + Oei Hengky Wiryo。 Rule Check: Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455) s.25(1); Oei Hengky Wiryo v HKSAR (No. 2) (2007) 10 HKCFAR 98; Seng Yuet Fong v HKSAR (1999) KCQ3, FAMC No. 26 of 1998; HKSAR v Pang Hung Fai (FACC 8 of 2013); HKSAR v Yeung Ka Sing Carson (FACC Nos. 5 and 6 of 2015) Common Trap（繁中）: 考生最常犯嘅錯係以為「證唔到上游罪行 = 甩身」。記住：s.25(1) OSCO 嘅 mens rea 係 belief based，唔係 fact based。 Q4 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C is correct. Marco is an agent of Homer Living Ltd (s.2 POBO — any person employed by or acting for another). The HK$200,000 interest free loan is an advantage (s.2 expressly includes "a gift, loan , fee, reward or commission"; the fact that it was paid into his wife's account does not change this — Marco is the ultimate beneficiary). It was accepted as an inducement connected with awarding the supply contract, i.e. an act in relation to his principal's affairs , and was without lawful authority or reasonable excuse — Board approval was required and never obtained (s.9(5) would require permission applied for and given as soon as reasonably possible). All four elements of s.9(1) POBO are satisfied. Forest Way Ltd's responsible officers would correspondingly be liable under s.9(2) as offerors. 解題思路（繁中）: IRAC：Issue（私營機構僱員收受利益）→ Rule（s.2 advantage/agent；s.9(1) 四元素）→ Application（loan = advantage；存入老婆戶口唔改變受益人性質；無 Board 批准；判 contract 係 principal's affairs）→ Conclusion（s.9(1) 罪成）。 A 錯： loan 明確列明喺 s.2 advantage 定義入面 ——呢個係最常見嘅誤解，以為「借錢唔係送錢」就冇事。 B 錯：s.9(3) 係用 虛假或錯誤嘅 receipt/account/document 呃僱主 （如假單據、假申請）——呢度冇假文件。 D 錯：s.4 只適用於 public servants （公職人員）；Marco 係私營公司僱員，屬 s.9 嘅私營條文。 考試伏位：Jun 2026 panel report 有考生將 anti corruption 誤判為 money laundering——呢度 Marco 嘅行為係 bribery（POBO），唔係 laundering（OSCO），因為焦點係收受利益而非處理犯罪得益。 Rule Check: Prevention of Bribery Ordinance (Cap. 201) ss.2, 9(1), 9(2), 9(5); cf. HKSAR v Leung Yat Ming & Another (1999) 2 HKLRD 402 (s.9(3) contrast) Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 以為 loan 唔算 advantage；(2) 以為錢入親屬戶口就切斷咗同 agent 嘅關係；(3) 見「private company」仲揀 s.4——記住 ss.3–5 係公營、s.9 係私營。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Under s.12(1) of the UNATMO (Cap. 575) , a person who knows or suspects that any property is terrorist property must disclose that knowledge or suspicion to an authorised officer as soon as practicable; failure to do so is an offence punishable under s.14(5) with a maximum of 3 months' imprisonment and a fine . Peggy suspected the remitted funds were terrorist property and made no report — the offence is complete. Tipping off under s.12(5) UNATMO does not arise : that offence requires the person to know or suspect that a disclosure has been made , and then to disclose to another person a matter likely to prejudice an investigation. Since no STR or disclosure had been made by anyone, this precondition is absent, and her WhatsApp warning — however improper — cannot constitute tipping off on these facts. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 hard item，關鍵係認清 tipping off 嘅 前提條件 。 A 錯：佢嘅確警告咗客戶，行為似 tipping off，但 s.12(5) 嘅其中一個元素係「knowing or suspecting that a disclosure has been made 」——題目明確話 冇任何人報過案 ，所以 tipping off 唔成立。呢個係成條題嘅伏位所在。 C 錯：UNATMO 嘅舉報責任由 suspicion 觸發——「suspicion is more than speculation but less than proof or knowledge」，唔使確定先要報。以「可能係人道用途」為由唔報，正正係 s.12(1) 要懲罰嘅不作為。 D 錯：s.7 懲罰嘅係 提供或收集財產 意圖/明知/有合理理由相信會用於恐怖活動嘅人——Peggy 拒絕咗 處理最新匯款，佢自己冇提供或收集任何財產；用嘅係客戶嘅錢，唔係佢提供。 Conclusion：Peggy 唯一成立嘅罪名係 s.12(1) 知情不報，最高罰則 s.14(5)——3 個月監禁 + 罰款（比 OSCO/DTROPO s.25A(8) 嘅 3 年 + HK$500,000 輕，記住呢個差異）。 Rule Check: United Nations (Anti Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575) ss.12(1), 12(5), 14(5), 14(6); cf. s.7 UNATMO; Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455) s.25A(8) Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「警告客戶」三個字就即揀 tipping off——永遠先問： 已經有人作出 disclosure 未？ 冇 disclosure 就冇 tipping off，只剩 failure to disclose。另外記住 UNATMO 知情不報嘅罰則（3 個月）遠輕於 DTROPO/OSCO（3 年 + HK$500,000），數字題常考。

title: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實…
text: M10 Chapter 6: Money Laundering, Bribery and Corruption — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Under which provision does a person commit an offence if he or she deals with property, knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe that the property, in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, represents the proceeds of an indictable offence ? A. Section 25(1) of the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance (Cap. 405) B. Section 25(1) of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455) C. Section 5 of the Anti Money Laundering and Counter Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615) D. Section 7 of the United Nations (Anti Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575) Q2. Under the record keeping requirements applicable to accounting practices (Part 3 of Schedule 2 to the AMLO; Section 660 of the HKICPA AML/CTF Guidelines), client and transaction records must be retained for at least how long after the transaction or the cessation of the business relationship? A. 3 years B. 5 years C. 7 years D. 10 years Q3. Derek, the sole proprietor of a Hong Kong trading firm, agreed at the request of an old classmate to receive HK$8 million into his company's bank account and to remit the same amount the following day to an offshore account, keeping HK$50,000 as a "handling fee". Derek found the arrangement strange and suspected the money might be connected with illegal gambling, but he asked no questions and carried out the transfers. At trial, the prosecution is unable to trace or prove the actual origin of the HK$8 million. Which of the following statements best reflects the law? A. Derek cannot be convicted of money laundering because the prosecution must prove that the HK$8 million was in fact the proceeds of an identified predicate offence. B. Derek can be convicted under s.25(1) of the OSCO (Cap. 455) if he had reasonable grounds to believe that the money represented the proceeds of an indictable offence; the prosecution need not prove that the money was in fact such proceeds. C. Derek cannot be convicted because a person who merely processes one single transfer at a friend's request lacks the necessary mens rea. D. Derek can only be prosecuted under s.25(1) of the DTROPO (Cap. 405), and since no drugs are involved, no money laundering offence is available. Q4. Marco is the purchasing manager of a private furniture retailer, Homer Living Ltd. A timber supplier, Forest Way Ltd, transfers an interest free "loan" of HK$200,000, repayable "when convenient", into the bank account of Marco's wife. Two weeks later, Marco awards Forest Way Ltd a one year supply contract. Marco has never disclosed the loan to Homer Living Ltd, whose internal policy requires prior written approval from the Board for any benefit from suppliers. Which of the following best analyses Marco's position under the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance (Cap. 201)? A. No offence — a loan is a commercial arrangement and does not amount to an "advantage" under s.2 of the POBO. B. An offence under s.9(3) of the POBO — Marco deceived his principal by means of a false receipt, account or other document. C. An offence under s.9(1) of the POBO — Marco, as an agent, accepted an advantage without lawful authority or reasonable excuse as an inducement for an act in relation to his principal's affairs. D. An offence under s.4 of the POBO — Marco solicited or accepted an advantage as a public servant. Q5. Peggy is the compliance manager of a money service operator in Hong Kong. During a routine review, she discovers that a long standing customer has been making monthly remittances to an overseas organisation which was added last week to the list of designated terrorists under the United Nations (Anti Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575) ('UNATMO'). Peggy now suspects that the remitted funds are terrorist property. Afraid of losing the customer, she refuses to process the latest remittance, but sends the customer a WhatsApp message saying: "Your beneficiary is now a listed terrorist group — you'd better route future transfers under a different name." She makes no report to any authority, and no suspicious transaction report has been filed by anyone in respect of these remittances. Which of the following best analyses Peggy's criminal exposure? A. Peggy has committed tipping off under s.12(5) of the UNATMO by warning the customer, and this is the only offence she faces. B. Peggy has committed the offence of failing to disclose her knowledge or suspicion of terrorist property to an authorised officer as soon as practicable, contrary to s.12(1) of the UNATMO (maximum penalty under s.14(5): 3 months' imprisonment and a fine); tipping off under s.12(5) does not arise because it requires knowledge or suspicion that a disclosure has already been made, and none has been made. C. Peggy has committed no offence, because the remittances might have had legitimate humanitarian purposes and suspicion alone never creates any duty. D. Peggy has committed the offence under s.7 of the UNATMO of providing property for terrorist acts, because her employer's remittance channel was used by the customer. End of quiz. Do not open the answers file until you have submitted your answers.

title: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Relevant Ordinances（Cap. + section numbers，以 LP 所引為準）
C. IRAC Application Points（常見 scenario 落點）
excerpt: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Identify the sources of employment law …
text: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Identify the sources of employment law in Hong Kong and determine the scope of application of the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57). 2. Apply the control test, organisation test and multifactor test to distinguish an employee (contract of service) from an independent contractor (contract for service). 3. Analyse the express and implied terms of an employment contract, including the implied duties of employers and employees at common law. 4. Calculate and apply statutory entitlements on wages, MPF, rest days, holidays, leave, severance payment and long service payment under the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) and related legislation. 5. Apply the rules on termination (notice, summary dismissal, constructive dismissal, unlawful dismissal and remedies) and the four anti discrimination ordinances to scenario facts using the IRAC approach. 必背考點 A. Relevant Ordinances（Cap. + section numbers，以 LP 所引為準） 1. Sources of law & scope of the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) ('EO') Three sources: (1) international law — ICCPR & ICESCR, implemented via Articles 39 and 153 of the Basic Law ; (2) common law (formation, status, implied duties, vicarious liability); (3) domestic legislation. Key domestic statutes: EO (Cap. 57) ; Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance (Cap. 509); Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance (Cap. 59); Employees' Compensation Ordinance (Cap. 282); Minimum Wage Ordinance (Cap. 608) ('MWO'); Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Ordinance (Cap. 485) ('MPFSO'); Labour Tribunal Ordinance (Cap. 25). EO s.4(2) : EO applies to ALL employees regardless of nature of work, EXCEPT: (i) a family member employed by and living in the same dwelling as the employer; (ii) an overseas contract worker; (iii) a person serving under a crew agreement within the Merchant Shipping (Seafarers) Ordinance (Cap. 478) or on a ship not registered in HK; (iv) an apprentice under the Apprenticeship Ordinance (Cap. 47) (per EO s.2A ); (v) a civil servant. EO s.70 : any express contractual clause that extinguishes or reduces EO rights/benefits/protection is void . 2. Who is employable Age of Majority (Related Provisions) Ordinance (Cap. 410) s.2(1) : age of majority = 18. Employment of Children Regulations (Cap. 57B) ('ECR') s.4(1) : employment of a child under 13 generally prohibited; s.5 : child aged 13–15 may be employed only if completed Form III AND parent consents in writing. Employment of Young Persons (Industry) Regulation (Cap. 57C): governs employment of young persons aged 15–18. Immigration Ordinance (Cap. 115) s.17I : offence to employ anyone not lawfully employable (no valid HK Permanent Resident Identity Card or valid working visa). 3. Contract of employment — key EO provisions EO s.5(1) : absent express agreement, every continuous contract is deemed a contract for one month renewable from month to month ; onus on employer to prove otherwise. A fixed term contract ends automatically at term expiry without notice. EO s.6(3) (probation): within the first month of probation, either party may terminate without notice or payment in lieu ; after the first month, notice of not less than 7 days (or as agreed). EO s.6 : termination by notice or payment in lieu; if contract silent, not less than one month's notice or one month's wages in lieu. Parties may not contract out but may waive at the time. EO s.17 : employee under continuous contract entitled to not less than one rest day in every seven days ; substitute rest day within 30 days if worked in emergency; if rest day coincides with statutory holiday, an additional rest day must be given. 4. Remuneration and benefits Continuous employment (' 4–18 requirement ', First Schedule EO): at least 18 hours per week for 4 consecutive weeks ; EO s.3(2) : onus on the employer to disprove continuity. EO s.2(1) : 'wages' = all remuneration, earnings, allowances (incl. travelling/attendance), attendance bonus, commission, overtime pay, tips and service charges capable of being expressed in money — subject to 11 exclusions (e.g. value of accommodation/food/medical care; employer's retirement scheme contributions; gratuitous or purely discretionary commission/bonus; non recurrent travelling allowance; end of year payment under Part IIA; gratuity on completion/termination; gratuitous annual bonus). EO s.23 : wages due at expiry of wage period; payable as soon as practicable and no later than 7 days after the end of the wage period. EO s.22 : wage period presumed to be one month. EO s.25(2) : on termination, all termination payments (wages up to termination, payment in lieu of notice, unused annual leave pay, severance/long service payment, etc.) due within 7 days. EO s.32 lawful wage deductions (10 categories) — key caps: deduction for damage/loss directly attributable to employee's neglect or default capped at the value of damage/loss or HK$300, whichever is less , per case; total deductions in one wage period ≤ one quarter of wages . Absence deductions must be proportionate to time absent. EO s.25(3) : if employee quits without proper notice, employer may deduct wages in lieu of outstanding notice. MWO (Cap. 608) s.8(2) : minimum wage = total hours worked × minimum hourly rate; rate since 1 May 2019 = HK$37.5/hour (per LP). EO s.43C : principal contractor/superior subcontractor liable for subcontractor employees' unpaid wages (site related work); employee must serve written notice within 60 days after wages due; principal contractor pays within 30 days of notice. EO s.49A : keep wage/employment records covering preceding 12 months , retained 6 months after employment ceases. MPFSO (Cap. 485) s.7(1A) : employer must ensure 'relevant employees' (aged 18–65 , continuous employment ≥ 60 days ) join a registered MPF scheme. Exempt: domestic employees; self employed hawkers; persons under statutory pension schemes (e.g. civil servants, subsidised school teachers); overseas persons working <13 months or covered by overseas schemes; EU Office employees. MPF contributions: 5% employer + 5% employee of relevant income; monthly income < HK$7,100 → employee pays nothing (employer still 5%); HK$30,000 → capped at HK$1,500 each . 'Relevant income' (MPFSO s.2) excludes severance payments and long service payments . 5. Rest days, holidays and leave EO s.39 : 12 statutory holidays for every employee regardless of length of service; if required to work, a substituted holiday within 60 days before/after; payment in lieu of holiday is forbidden . General Holidays Ordinance (Cap. 149): 17 general holidays (12 overlap); binds banks, educational establishments, public offices and government departments only. EO s.41AA paid annual leave (continuous employment ≥ 12 months): 7 days (years 1–2), 8 (yr 3), 9 (yr 4), 10 (yr 5), 11 (yr 6), 12 (yr 7), 13 (yr 8), 14 (yr 9+). Unbroken period unless employee consents: ≤10 days → up to 3 days separately; 10 days → at least 7 consecutive; payment in lieu allowed only for the part exceeding 10 days. Daily rate = average daily wages over preceding 12 months. Sick leave (sickness allowance): continuous contract ≥ 1 month; sick leave ≥ 4 consecutive days (pregnancy check up/post confinement/miscarriage excepted); medical certificate; sufficient accumulated paid sick days. Rate = four fifths of average daily wages (12 month average). Accrual: 2 days/month in first 12 months , 4 days/month thereafter , capped at 120 days . Maternity leave: 14 weeks (Employment (Amendment) Ordinance 2020, effective 11 Dec 2020); paid if continuous contract ≥ 40 weeks before scheduled leave + notice + medical certificate; pay = four fifths of average daily wages; additional 4 week pay capped at HK$80,000 (government reimburses employers). <40 weeks → 14 weeks unpaid leave still available with notice + certificate. Paternity leave: 5 days per confinement (notice ≥ 3 months before expected confinement, else ≥ 5 days before leave). 6. Termination of employment Valid reasons for dismissal ( EO s.32K ): (a) misconduct; (b) incapability or disqualification; (c) redundancy or genuine operational requirements; (d) continued employment would contravene the law; (e) any other sufficient cause. Employee with ≥ 24 months continuous employment dismissed without valid reason → presumed dismissal to extinguish/reduce EO rights → unreasonable dismissal (consider all circumstances, EO s.32L(2) ). Note: employer is NOT obliged to give a reason at the time of termination. Summary dismissal ( EO s.9(1)(a) ): very serious misconduct or failure to improve after repeated warnings — (1) wilful disobedience of a lawful and reasonable order; (2) misconduct inconsistent with due and faithful discharge of duties; (3) fraud or dishonesty; (4) habitual neglect of duties. S.9(1)(b) : any other common law ground justifying termination without notice. Summary dismissal = last resort / drastic measure . Dismissal for taking part in a strike is prohibited. Statutory restrictions: unlawful to dismiss (i) a pregnant employee; (ii) an employee on paid sick leave; (iii) an employee who is a witness in court against the employer; (iv) a trade union member actively seeking to improve working conditions; (v) an injured employee before compensation settlement — UNLESS summary dismissal criteria are independently satisfied. Remedies for unlawful/unreasonable dismissal ( EO ss.32N & 33M ): (1) reinstatement (same position, rights, seniority, pension — considered first); (2) re engagement (comparable terms, by employer/successor/associated company); (3) terminal payments as just and appropriate ( EO s.32O ). Since the Employment (Amendment) (No. 2) Ordinance 2018, the Labour Tribunal may order reinstatement/re engagement without employer's consent ; non compliance → additional award of 3 × average monthly salary, capped at HK$72,000 , and possible criminal liability. Constructive dismissal ( EO s.10 ): employee may terminate without notice/payment if — (a) reasonable fear of physical danger by violence or disease not contemplated by the contract; (aa) ≥5 years' employment + certified permanently unfit for the particular type of work by a registered medical/Chinese medicine practitioner while engaged in that work; (b) ill treatment by the employer; (c) any common law ground (employer's repudiatory/fundamental breach ). Recognised grounds include: failure to provide sufficient work; failure to pay statutory remuneration/benefits; transfer without consent; failure to provide a safe and decent work environment; unlawful discriminatory conduct. Severance payment ( EO s.31B(1) ): continuous contract ≥ 24 months + dismissed by reason of redundancy or laid off ; voluntary resignation excluded. Redundancy ( s.31B(2) ): (1) employer closes/intends to close the business; (2) ceases business at the place where employee worked; (3) requirement for work of a particular kind ceases/diminishes. Lay off: no work/no wages half of normal working days in any 4 consecutive weeks, or one third in any 26 consecutive weeks. Long service payment: continuous contract ≥ 5 years , dismissed (not summarily for serious misconduct, not for redundancy) and — (1) employee dies; (2) employee terminates due to illness; (3) employee retires at age 65 or above. Formula (both payments): monthly paid → 2/3 × last month's wages × reckonable years of service ; daily/piece rated → any 18 days' wages chosen out of last 30 normal working days × reckonable years. Cap: HK$390,000 . Labour Tribunal (Labour Tribunal Ordinance, Cap. 25): exclusive jurisdiction over claims arising from non compliance with the EO, MWO or Apprenticeship Ordinance (Cap. 47); NO jurisdiction over tort claims, bankruptcy/winding up matters, or claims under the Minor Employment Claims Adjudication Board Ordinance (Cap. 453). 7. Anti discrimination ordinances Four ordinances: SDO (Cap. 480) ; DDO (Cap. 487) ; FSDO (Cap. 527) ; RDO (Cap. 602) . Equal Opportunities Commission (EOC) issues codes of practice. Direct discrimination: less favourable treatment on the ground of sex/marital status/pregnancy, disability, family status or race. Test: objective ' but for ' test — intention/motive irrelevant to liability (relevant only to remedies); claimant bears burden on balance of probabilities; where reason unclear, apply the two part test (comparator question + causation question) per M v Secretary for Justice . Indirect discrimination: a seemingly neutral requirement/condition which a considerably smaller proportion of the protected group can comply with, causing detriment, and not justifiable. Group based comparison (correct comparator pool: University of Manchester v Jones ). Justification = 3 step test: (1) legitimate aim; (2) rational connection; (3) necessity ( EOC v Director of Education ). Harassment: unwelcome conduct a reasonable person would anticipate would offend, humiliate or intimidate. Sexual harassment: 'quid pro quo' + 'hostile environment' types; subjective unwelcomeness + objective reasonable person assessment ( Chen v Tamara Rus ). Victimisation = a form of direct discrimination ('but for' test applies: Chang Ying Kwan v Wyeth (HK) Ltd ). SDO (Cap. 480): sex, marital status, pregnancy; sexual harassment; victimisation. Religion exception: s.22(1) SDO . DDO (Cap. 487): covers disability of the person or their associates ; harassment: s.3(6) DDO . Exception — s.12(2) DDO : not discrimination if the person, because of disability, cannot carry out the inherent requirements of the job, or would impose unjustifiable hardship (factors in s.4 DDO ). FSDO (Cap. 527): 'family status' = responsibility for care of an immediate family member (blood, marriage, adoption, affinity). Direct discrimination: s.5(a) ; indirect: s.5(b) ; unlawful to dismiss by reason of family status: s.8(2)(c) . RDO (Cap. 602): race discrimination, harassment ( s.7(1) , hostile environment s.7(2) ), and vilification (public activity inciting hatred/serious contempt/severe ridicule). Religion exception: s.23 RDO . Genuine occupational qualification (GOQ) exception: SDO/DDO/RDO, narrow; onus on employer. Remedies ( s.76(3A) SDO; s.72(4) DDO; s.54(3) FSDO; s.70(4) RDO ): declaration; order to redress; employ/re employ; promote; damages; punitive/exemplary damages; declare contract void. Court has wide discretion, global approach, but will not force an apology ( Ma Bik Yung v Ko Chuen ). Discrimination Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Ordinance 2020: workplace participant harassment ( s.23A SDO; s.22A DDO; s.24A RDO — covers interns, volunteers, contract workers); RDO 'near relative' replaced by ' associate ' ( s.5 RDO ); damages available for indirect discrimination on sex/family status/race without proof of intention . Sex Discrimination (Amendment) Ordinance 2021 (effective 19 June 2021): breastfeeding protection — direct discrimination ( s.8A(1)(a) SDO ), indirect discrimination ( s.8A(1)(b) ), harassment ( s.2A(1)–(2) ), victimisation; child need not be biological; no time limit. B. Leading Cases（full citation） Ready Mixed Concrete (South East) Ltd v Minister of Pensions and National Insurance (1968) 2 QB 497 — Mackenna J's three conditions for a contract of service: (1) servant provides work/skill for remuneration; (2) sufficient degree of control; (3) other provisions consistent with a contract of service. Owner drivers held to be independent contractors. Stevenson, Jordan and Harrison Ltd v Macdonald and Evans (1952) 1 TLR 101 — Lord Denning: under a contract of service the work is an integral part of the business; under a contract for services it is only accessory to it (organisation/integration test). Market Investigations Ltd v Minister of Social Security (1969) 2 QB 173 — Cooke J's flexible multifactor approach. Lee Ting Sang v Chung Chi Keung (1990) 1 HKLR 764 (PC) — Privy Council endorsed the multifactor approach; control no longer sole determinant; no exhaustive list of factors. Poon Chau Nam v Yim Siu Cheung (2007) 1 HKLRD 951 (CFA) — modern approach: 'a nuanced and not a mechanical approach: painting a picture from the accumulation of detail'; factors include control, own equipment, own helpers, financial risk, investment/management responsibility, opportunity to profit. Casual workers: umbrella contract vs specific engagement contract. Kao Lee & Yip v Koo Hoi Yan (2003) 3 HKLRD 296 — employee's fiduciary duty; merely informing a client of departure is not solicitation; going along with a client's proposal to move business without employer's consent is breach. Kuoni Travel (China) Ltd v Kelly Frances Richards, HCA 1265/2006 (unreported) — four factors for confidentiality: nature of employment; nature of information; whether employer impressed confidentiality; whether information easily isolated. Deacons v White & Case Ltd Liability Partnership (2003) 3 HKLRD 670 — after termination, confidentiality protection is restricted to trade secrets only . Thomas Vincent v South China Morning Post Publishers (2005) 4 HKLRD 258 (CFA) — misconduct under s.32K EO must be factual, real and relevant; ordinarily a first offender should not be instantly dismissed without warning or a further chance; dismissal without any formal disciplinary process was unreasonable. Ying Kee Safes and Furniture Limited v Wong Yam Tak, HCLA 105/1995 (unreported) — lateness is unauthorised absence and misconduct; isolated lateness insufficient, but persistent and repeated lateness after warnings justifies summary dismissal. Secretary for Justice v Chan Wah and Others (2000) 3 HKLRD 641 (CFA) — adopted the objective ' but for ' test (from R v Birmingham City Council, ex parte Equal Opportunities Commission (1989) 1 AC 1155 ) for direct discrimination; motive irrelevant to liability. M v Secretary for Justice (2009) 2 HKLRD 298 (CA) — two part test: (1) comparator question (same or not materially different circumstances); (2) causation question; employer's actual knowledge of disability irrelevant — knowledge of the manifestation of disability = knowledge of disability. Shamoon v Chief Constable of Royal Ulster Constabulary (2003) ICR 337 — where comparator identification is problematic, focus on the factual enquiry of the reason for the treatment (applied in Sit Ka Yin Priscilla v Equal Opportunities Commission (2010) HKEC 208 ). Equal Opportunities Commission v Director of Education (2001) 2 HKLRD 690 — three step justification test for indirect discrimination: legitimate aim; rational connection; necessity. University of Manchester v Jones (1993) ICR 474 (CA) — correct comparator pool = all men and women with the necessary qualifications/experience, not a distorted subgroup. Chang Ying Kwan v Wyeth (HK) Ltd (2001) 2 HKC 129 — pregnancy discrimination + victimisation after EOC complaint; 'but for' test applies to victimisation. Chen v Tamara Rus (2001) 3 HKLRD 541 (CA) — 'unwelcome' is subjective to the victim; then objective assessment of anticipated offence/humiliation/intimidation. B v King of the King Group Limited, DCEO 9/2010 — employer vicariously liable for co worker's sexual harassment for failing to take reasonable preventive steps; HK$80,000 damages for emotional distress. Ma Bik Yung v Ko Chuen (2002) 2 HKLRD 1 (CFA) — wide discretion on remedies, global approach; court will not force an unwilling respondent to apologise. C. IRAC Application Points（常見 scenario 落點） Issue : status dispute → Rule : three tests (control → organisation → multifactor, Poon Chau Nam ) → Application : run through control/ownership of tools/delegation/financial risk on facts; label is not conclusive → Conclusion : employee vs independent contractor; only employees get EO/ECO protection. Issue : dismissal without notice → distinguish summary dismissal (s.9 EO — employer initiated, last resort) from constructive dismissal (s.10 EO — employee initiated, employer's repudiatory breach) ; check warnings given ( Thomas Vincent ; Ying Kee ). Issue : dismissal reason → if ≥24 months continuous service, employer must justify under s.32K EO , else unreasonable dismissal (s.32L(2)); remedies ss.32N/33M/32O (reinstatement first). Issue : redundancy → s.31B(1)–(2) EO; watch for refusal of suitable alternative employment and whether requirement for the work truly 'ceased or diminished' (mere cost saving regrade ≠ redundancy). Issue : discrimination → identify protected ground and ordinance; choose direct ('but for') vs indirect (neutral condition + disparate impact + 3 step justification) ; check exceptions (GOQ; DDO s.12(2) inherent requirements); remedies under the relevant ordinance; victimisation if complaint triggered retaliation. 易混淆概念對比 Table 1 — Employee vs Independent Contractor 比較點 Employee (Contract of Service) Independent Contractor (Contract for Service) Tools / Equipment Provided by the employer Self provided Pay / Remuneration Not affected by how work is done; bears no financial risk Prospect of profit and bears financial risk Mode / Method of Work Determined by the employer Self determined Subcontract work to others No Yes Discipline by the company Yes No Statutory protection EO, ECO, MPF (as employee) etc. Not under EO; only MPF as self employed person 點樣分辨：睇「實質關係」唔睇合約標籤——就算合約寫明 "self employed"，法庭仍會用 multifactor test（ Poon Chau Nam ）從整體印象判斷。考試伏位：(1) 自備工具 唔係 決定性因素（高技術工人常客自備工具）；(2) 有權請幫手 ≠ 一定是僱主（supervisor/foreman 都可以請下屬）；(3) 答 status 題要逐個 factor 落 facts，最後俾 overall impression，唔好得個「control test」就收工。 Table 2 — Severance Payment vs Long Service Payment 比較點 Severance Payment (EO s.31B) Long Service Payment Minimum continuous service ≥ 24 months ≥ 5 years Trigger Dismissal by reason of redundancy or lay off Dismissal (not summary dismissal for serious misconduct, not redundancy) + death / resignation due to illness / retirement at ≥ 65 Voluntary resignation Not entitled Only if due to illness (or retirement ≥65) Formula 2/3 × last month's wages × reckonable years (monthly paid) Same formula Cap HK$390,000 HK$390,000 點樣分辨：兩者 互斥 ——同一次離職唔可以兩样都攞。考試伏位：(1) redundancy 定義係「職位需求消失/減少」，純粹慳錢降職降薪但工作量不減 ≠ redundancy（見 LP Flora 例），但可以構成 constructive dismissal（EO s.10(c) repudiatory breach）；(2) 自動辭職一般乜都冇，除非符合 illness/retirement 條件；(3) 記得檢查 24 months / 5 years 門檻先至計數。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: What are the three sources of employment law in Hong Kong, and which Basic Law articles implement the international covenants? Back: (1) International law — ICCPR and ICESCR (2) Common law — contract formation, employee status, implied duties, vicarious liability (3) Domestic legislation — EO (Cap. 57), ECO (Cap. 282), OSHO (Cap. 509), etc. Implemented via Articles 39 and 153 of the Basic Law 💬 白話解釋：記「國際、普通法、本地法例」三層。國際公約（ICCPR/ICESCR）靠 Basic Law 第 39 同 153 條落地香港。考試問 sources 就咁答三點已經攞分。 Card 2 Front: Under s.4(2) of the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57), which five categories of persons are excluded from the EO's application? Back: (1) A family member employed by and living in the same dwelling as the employer (2) An overseas contract worker (3) A person serving under a crew agreement (Merchant Shipping (Seafarers) Ordinance, Cap. 478) or on a non HK registered ship (4) An apprentice under the Apprenticeship Ordinance (Cap. 47) (EO s.2A) (5) A civil servant Also note EO s.70: clauses reducing EO rights are void 💬 白話解釋：口訣「同住家人、海外合約工、船員、學徒、公務員」。留意學徒係經 s.2A 排除。合約條款想「contract out」EO 權益？s.70 話直接無效。 Card 3 Front: State Mackenna J's three conditions for a contract of service in Ready Mixed Concrete (South East) Ltd v Minister of Pensions and National Insurance (1968) 2 QB 497. Back: (1) The servant agrees to provide his own work and skill in consideration of a wage or other remuneration (2) He agrees, expressly or impliedly, to be subject to a sufficient degree of control by the other party (a 'master') (3) The other provisions of the contract are consistent with its being a contract of service Held on facts: owner drivers were independent contractors 💬 白話解釋：三個條件記「俾工資、受控制、條款相符」。呢單案嘅司機要自己買車、可以請替工，所以係 independent contractor——即係話 control 重要但唔係全部。 Card 4 Front: According to Poon Chau Nam v Yim Siu Cheung (2007) 1 HKLRD 951 (CFA), how does a court determine employment status under the multifactor test? Back: 'A nuanced and not a mechanical approach: painting a picture from the accumulation of detail' — examine ALL features and form an overall impression Factors: degree of control; ownership of equipment; whether he hires his own helpers; degree of financial risk; responsibility for investment and management; opportunity to profit from sound management For casual workers: distinguish (1) umbrella/global contract (mutual obligation to offer and accept work relevant) from (2) contract for each specific engagement (mutual obligation irrelevant) Not a checklist exercise 💬 白話解釋：CFA 話唔好逐格剔 checklist，要「睇成幅畫」。散工都可以每次 engagement 都係僱員——mutual obligation 只係睇 umbrella contract 先關鍵。考試答 status 題必引此案。 Card 5 Front: What are the six implied duties of an employee at common law? Back: (1) To carry out lawful and reasonable orders of the employer (2) To perform work with reasonable care and skill (3) To serve the employer with fidelity and good faith (fiduciary duty — no conflict of interest, no solicitation of clients: Kao Lee & Yip v Koo Hoi Yan (2003) 3 HKLRD 296) (4) Not to disclose trade secrets or confidential information (post termination: trade secrets only — Deacons v White & Case (2003) 3 HKLRD 670) (5) To account for property and secret profits obtained in the course of employment (6) To indemnify the employer for tortious liability caused by the employee's negligence 💬 白話解釋：記「聽命令、有手藝、忠誠、保密、交數、賠償」。伏位：話俾客知「我會離職」唔算 solicitation，但順住客人提議把生意帶走就係 breach——matter of degree。 Card 6 Front: What are the MPF contribution rules under the MPFSO (Cap. 485) for employees? Back: 'Relevant employee': aged 18–65, continuous employment ≥ 60 days (s.7(1A) MPFSO) Employer + employee each contribute 5% of relevant income Monthly relevant income < HK$7,100: employee contributes nil; employer still 5% HK$7,100–30,000: each pays 5% HK$30,000: each pays HK$1,500 (capped) 'Relevant income' excludes severance payments and long service payments (s.2 MPFSO) Exempt: domestic employees, self employed hawkers, statutory pension scheme members, short term (<13 months) overseas workers, EU Office employees 💬 白話解釋：記兩條界線 7,100 同 30,000，同封頂 1,500。Domestic helper 係豁免 MPF 但 唔係 豁免 EO——呢個係經典伏位。 Card 7 Front: When may an employer lawfully summarily dismiss an employee under s.9 of the EO, and what limits did the CFA set in Thomas Vincent v SCMPP (2005) 4 HKLRD 258? Back: S.9(1)(a) EO grounds: (1) wilful disobedience of a lawful and reasonable order; (2) misconduct inconsistent with due and faithful discharge of duties; (3) fraud or dishonesty; (4) habitual neglect of duties — i.e. very serious misconduct or failure to improve after repeated warnings S.9(1)(b): any other common law ground justifying termination without notice Summary dismissal is a drastic measure / last resort Thomas Vincent: misconduct must be factual, real and relevant; a first offender should ordinarily not be instantly dismissed without warning or a further chance Dismissal for taking part in a strike is prohibited 💬 白話解釋：即炒係「最後手段」。單次 minor misconduct（例如第一次遲到）唔夠，要有 warning 同重複犯（Ying Kee 案：持續遲到 + 警告後再犯先算）。考試見「第一次犯錯即炒」通常係 unreasonable/wrongful。 Card 8 Front: Distinguish direct discrimination from indirect discrimination, naming the key tests and authorities. Back: Direct: less favourable treatment on a prohibited ground; objective 'but for' test (Secretary for Justice v Chan Wah (2000) 3 HKLRD 641, adopting R v Birmingham City Council, ex parte EOC (1989) 1 AC 1155); motive irrelevant to liability; two part test (comparator + causation) per M v Secretary for Justice (2009) 2 HKLRD 298 Indirect: facially neutral requirement/condition; considerably smaller proportion of the protected group can comply; detriment; not justifiable — 3 step justification: legitimate aim, rational connection, necessity (EOC v Director of Education (2001) 2 HKLRD 690); correct comparator pool (University of Manchester v Jones (1993) ICR 474) Victimisation is a form of direct discrimination (Chang Ying Kwan v Wyeth (HK) Ltd (2001) 2 HKC 129) 💬 白話解釋：Direct = 因為你個身份直接差別對待；indirect = 條件表面中性但實際排斥某群體（例如身高要求排斥女性）。答 indirect 一定要行埋三步 justification test，同埋講岩 comparator pool。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Contract of service / contract for services 僱傭合約／獨立承辦合約，前者係僱員、後者係自僱 "A contract of service governs the employer–employee relationship, whereas a contract for services governs an independent contractor." Continuous contract (4–18 requirement) 連續合約：連續 4 星期、每星期至少 18 小時 "Under the First Schedule to the EO, an employee who works at least 18 hours per week for four consecutive weeks is employed under a continuous contract." Payment in lieu of notice 代通知金，即刻終止合約嘅替代做法 "The employer may terminate the contract immediately by paying wages in lieu of the notice period under s.6 of the EO." Summary dismissal 即時解僱，唔使通知期，只適用於極嚴重過失 "Summary dismissal under s.9 of the EO is a drastic measure and should be treated as a last resort." Constructive dismissal 推定解僱：僱主根本違約，僱員主動辭職並索償 "The employee resigned and claimed constructive dismissal under s.10 of the EO because the employer's conduct amounted to a repudiatory breach." Severance payment / long service payment 遣散費（redundancy，≥24 個月）／長期服務金（≥5 年，非嚴重過失被炒） "An employee dismissed by reason of redundancy after at least 24 months' continuous service is entitled to a severance payment under s.31B of the EO." 'But for' test 「若非」測試：若非因為受保障特徵，會唔會受到較差對待 "Applying the 'but for' test in Secretary for Justice v Chan Wah, the claimant must show she would not have been dismissed but for her family status." Genuine occupational qualification (GOQ) 真正職業資格：極窄嘅歧視豁免，舉證責任喺僱主 "The employer bears the onus of proving that the genuine occupational qualification exception applies to the position in question."

title: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Answers

excerpt: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Under s.4(2) of the Employment Ordi…
text: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Under s.4(2) of the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57), the EO applies to all employees in Hong Kong regardless of the nature of their work, except: (1) a family member employed by and living in the same dwelling as the employer; (2) an overseas contract worker; (3) a person serving under a crew agreement within the meaning of the Merchant Shipping (Seafarers) Ordinance (Cap. 478) or on board a ship not registered in Hong Kong; (4) an apprentice under the Apprenticeship Ordinance (Cap. 47) (per s.2A of the EO); and (5) a civil servant. A registered apprentice therefore falls outside the EO. Options A, C and D describe ordinary employees covered by the EO (a foreign domestic helper is covered by the EO — her exemption is from the MPF scheme, not the EO). 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 s.4(2) 嘅五類豁免。選項 B 嘅學徒係經 EO s.2A 豁免，直接命中條文。A 係兼職但符合 4–18 連續合約要求，一樣受 EO 保障；C 係經典伏位——外傭豁免嘅係 MPF （MPFSO 下 domestic employees 豁免），唔係 EO；D 口頭合約唔影響 EO 適用（僱傭合約可以係 oral）。考試伏位：唔好將 MPF 豁免同 EO 適用範圍撈亂。 Rule Check: Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) s.4(2) and s.2A; Apprenticeship Ordinance (Cap. 47) Common Trap（繁中）: 以為「外傭唔受 EO 管」——錯，外傭受 EO 全面保障，只係唔使供 MPF。仲有以為合約冇書面就唔受保障，其實 EO 適用於 oral contracts。 Q2 — Answer: HK$112,000 Model Answer (EN): Eligibility: Marco has been employed under a continuous contract for not less than 24 months (8 years) and was dismissed by reason of redundancy (closure of the employer's business in Hong Kong falls within s.31B(2) EO: the employer has ceased, or intends to cease, the business in the place where the employee was employed). He did not refuse suitable alternative employment, so he qualifies under s.31B(1) EO. Formula for a monthly paid employee: 2/3 of the last month's wages × reckonable years of service. Working: 2/3 × HK$21,000 = HK$14,000 per year of service; HK$14,000 × 8 years = HK$112,000 . The statutory maximum of HK$390,000 does not apply, as HK$112,000 is below the cap. 解題思路（繁中）: 兩步驗證：第一步 eligibility——連續合約 ≥24 個月 + redundancy（僱主結束香港廠房業務，正正係 s.31B(2) 嘅「ceased business in the place」情況）。第二步代入公式：月薪僱員用「2/3 × 最後一個月工資 × 服務年資」。2/3 × 21,000 = 14,000；14,000 × 8 = 112,000。最後一定要檢查 HK$390,000 上限——呢個案例未觸頂，所以要明確講句「cap 唔適用」先算完整。考試伏位：唔好用錯 daily rated 公式（18 日工資），同埋遣散費係 last month's wages 唔係平均工資。 Rule Check: Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) s.31B(1) and s.31B(2); statutory maximum HK$390,000 Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 忘記檢查 24 個月連續服務門檻；(2) 用「平均月薪」代替「last month's wages」；(3) 忘記陳述 HK$390,000 上限是否適用——計算題要主動交代。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C is correct. Under the multifactor test endorsed by the CFA in Poon Chau Nam v Yim Siu Cheung (2007) 1 HKLRD 951 (following Market Investigations Ltd v Minister of Social Security (1969) 2 QB 173 and Lee Ting Sang v Chung Chi Keung (1990) 1 HKLR 764 ), the court examines all features of the relationship and forms an overall impression — 'a nuanced and not a mechanical approach'. Here, Bright exercises substantial control (fixed days and hours, internal manual, Financial Controller's instructions), supplies the equipment, pays fixed monthly remuneration with no financial risk to Fiona, and Fiona cannot delegate the work — all pointing to a contract of service. Labelling a person a 'freelance consultant' does not conclude the question of status (A is wrong), and self registration with an MPF scheme is only one factor and not determinative (B is wrong). The control test is no longer the sole determinative factor (D is wrong). 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 multifactor test 嘅應用。逐個 factor 落 facts：控制（固定返工時間、要跟 manual、聽上司指示）→ 指向僱員；工具（用公司電腦軟件）→ 指向僱員；唔可以請替工 → 指向僱員；固定月薪、無財務風險 → 指向僱員。整體印象 = contract of service。A 錯因為 label 唔係 conclusive（LP 明講 "Labeling someone as an employee or independent contractor does not conclude the status"）；B 錯因為自己供 MPF 只係其中一個因素（ Poon Chau Nam 嘅 P 都係自己供 MPF，CFA 都判佢係僱員）；D 錯因為 control test 早已唔係唯一測試。考試伏位：status 題一定要行晒幾個 factor 先落 conclusion，唔好淨係靠合約點寫。 Rule Check: Poon Chau Nam v Yim Siu Cheung (2007) 1 HKLRD 951 (CFA) ; Market Investigations Ltd v Minister of Social Security (1969) 2 QB 173 ; Lee Ting Sang v Chung Chi Keung (1990) 1 HKLR 764 (PC) Common Trap（繁中）: 最大伏位係俾合約標籤誤導——法庭睇實質關係。第二個伏位係以為高技術/部分自主 = 一定是 contractor；要問工作是否「part and parcel」of the employer's organisation（organisation test）。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Summary dismissal under s.9(1)(a) of the EO is available only where the employee has committed very serious misconduct or fails to improve after repeated warnings (wilful disobedience of a lawful and reasonable order; misconduct inconsistent with the due and faithful discharge of duties; fraud or dishonesty; habitual neglect). It is a drastic measure and a last resort. In Thomas Vincent v South China Morning Post Publishers (2005) 4 HKLRD 258 , the CFA held that the misconduct relied upon must be factual, real and relevant, and that ordinarily a first offender should not be instantly dismissed without any warning or a further chance. A single isolated error by an employee with a clean record, with no evidence of dishonest intent and no prior warning, does not meet the s.9 threshold; the dismissal is likely wrongful/unreasonable. A is wrong: the 'fraud or dishonesty' ground requires actual dishonest conduct, not an innocent mistake. C is wrong: while an employer need not give a reason at the time of termination, that does not dispense with the need for s.9 grounds to justify dismissal without notice. D is wrong: no prior Labour Tribunal approval is required for summary dismissal. 解題思路（繁中）: 題眼係「第一次犯 + 無警告 + 無證據有 dishonest intent」。S.9 嘅 dishonesty ground 要真有欺詐/不誠實，找錯錢嘅 innocent mistake 唔算；而且 CFA 喺 Thomas Vincent 話即時解僱初犯者（無警告、無第二次機會）通常 unreasonable。A 係 distractor 專攻「見 fraud or dishonesty 四個字就衝」嘅同學；C 係 hybrid 陷阱——「解僱時唔使講理由」係真嘅（LP 有講），但唔代表即炒唔使有 s.9 理由；D 無中生有，勞審處唔使事先批准。考試伏位：summary dismissal = last resort；有警告 + 持續重犯（如 Ying Kee 嘅持續遲到）先企得穩。 Rule Check: Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) s.9(1)(a); Thomas Vincent v South China Morning Post Publishers (2005) 4 HKLRD 258 (CFA) ; cf. Ying Kee Safes and Furniture Limited v Wong Yam Tak, HCLA 105/1995 Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 將「找錯錢」自動當 dishonesty——intent 係關鍵；(2) 將「僱主解僱時無責任講理由」同「即炒無需理由」撈亂；(3) 以為要勞審處事先批准先炒得人——無呢回事。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C is correct. Indirect discrimination occurs where an apparently neutral requirement or condition is applied equally to everyone, but the proportion of one sex who can comply with it is considerably smaller, the requirement causes detriment to the complainant, and it is not justifiable. A minimum height requirement is the LP's classic example of a condition favourable to male applicants that discriminates against female applicants. Wing suffered detriment (rejection solely for height). SecureGuard can escape liability only by justifying the requirement under the three step test affirmed in Equal Opportunities Commission v Director of Education (2001) 2 HKLRD 690 : (1) the requirement pursues a legitimate aim; (2) it is rationally connected to that aim; and (3) it is necessary to accomplish that aim — objectively balancing the discriminatory effect against the employer's reasonable needs. A is wrong: equal application of a neutral condition is precisely the hallmark of indirect discrimination, not a defence. B is wrong: Wing was treated the same as male applicants on its face, so this is not direct discrimination under the 'but for' test ( Secretary for Justice v Chan Wah (2000) 3 HKLRD 641 ). D is wrong: the genuine occupational qualification exception applies only in very limited circumstances and the onus is on the employer to prove it — it does not apply automatically. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題分層好清楚：表面中性條件（身高 170cm）+ 對兩性一視同仁 → 排除 direct discrimination，lock 入 indirect。之後三步 justification test 係僱主唯一出路：legitimate aim → rational connection → necessity，客觀平衡。A 係最常見錯誤——「人人都一樣要求所以冇歧視」正正係 indirect discrimination 嘅定義場景；B 錯因為 direct 係「因為你係女性所以唔請你」，呢度條件係中性；D 錯因為 GOQ 係極窄豁免、舉證責任喺僱主，而且身高要求一般唔係 GOQ。考試伏位：記住 LP 本身就用身高要求做 indirect discrimination 嘅經典例子；仲有 comparator pool 要揀啱（ University of Manchester v Jones ）。 Rule Check: Sex Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 480); Equal Opportunities Commission v Director of Education (2001) 2 HKLRD 690 ; Secretary for Justice v Chan Wah and Others (2000) 3 HKLRD 641 (CFA) ; University of Manchester v Jones (1993) ICR 474 Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 見到「一視同仁」就以為安全——neutral condition 正係 indirect discrimination 嘅核心；(2) 漏咗三步 justification test，只答「有歧視」唔答僱主可以點 justify；(3) GOQ 唔係自動適用，僱主要舉證而且適用範圍極窄。
