text: M10 Chapter 7: Introduction to Employment Law in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) Which of the following persons is excluded from the application of the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) under s.4(2) of the Ordinance? A. A shop assistant working 18 hours per week under a continuous contract with a retail chain B. A young person whose contract of apprenticeship is registered under the Apprenticeship Ordinance (Cap. 47) C. A foreign domestic helper employed under a standard two year employment contract D. A waiter engaged by a restaurant on a monthly paid oral contract Question 2 (Calculation / Short Answer) Marco has been employed by Harbour Textiles Ltd under a continuous contract for 8 reckonable years . He is monthly paid and his last month's wages were HK$21,000 . Harbour Textiles Ltd has closed its Hong Kong factory and dismissed Marco by reason of redundancy. Marco did not refuse any offer of suitable alternative employment. Calculate the amount of severance payment payable to Marco under the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57), and state whether the statutory maximum affects your answer. Show your workings. Question 3 (MCQ — Scenario) Fiona has provided bookkeeping services to Bright Logistics Ltd ('Bright') continuously for two years. Her written agreement states that she is a 'freelance consultant and not an employee'. In practice: Fiona must work at Bright's office every Tuesday and Thursday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.; she uses Bright's computer and accounting software; she must follow Bright's internal accounting manual and the instructions of Bright's Financial Controller; she is paid a fixed fee of HK$12,000 per month regardless of the volume of transactions; and she is not permitted to send anyone else to do the work in her place. Fiona has registered herself with an MPF scheme as a self employed person. Applying the approach endorsed by the Court of Final Appeal in Poon Chau Nam v Yim Siu Cheung (2007) 1 HKLRD 951 , which of the following statements is most accurate ? A. Fiona is an independent contractor because the written agreement expressly labels her as a freelance consultant B. Fiona is an independent contractor because she has registered with an MPF scheme as a self employed person C. Fiona is likely an employee because, looking at all the features of the relationship as a whole — the degree of control, use of Bright's equipment, no right to delegate, fixed monthly remuneration and no financial risk — the overall impression points to a contract of service, and the label is not conclusive D. Fiona's status cannot be determined because the control test is the sole determinative test and Bright does not supervise every entry she makes Question 4 (MCQ — Scenario) Kelvin has worked as a cashier at Daily Fresh Supermarket for three years with a clean disciplinary record. One morning, he mistakenly gave a customer HK$200 less in change. The store manager discovered the error that afternoon and immediately dismissed Kelvin without notice or payment in lieu of notice, citing 'dishonesty'. Kelvin had never received any warning before, and there was no evidence that he intended to keep the money. Which of the following statements is most accurate under the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57)? A. The summary dismissal is lawful because s.9(1)(a) of the EO covers fraud and dishonesty, and Kelvin's error falls within that ground B. The summary dismissal is likely unjustified because s.9(1)(a) EO requires very serious misconduct or failure to improve after repeated warnings; a single isolated error by a first offender with no prior warning does not ordinarily justify summary dismissal, which is a measure of last resort C. The summary dismissal is lawful because an employer is under no duty to give a reason for dismissal at the time of termination D. The summary dismissal is automatically void because an employer may never dismiss an employee without first obtaining the Labour Tribunal's approval Question 5 (MCQ — Scenario) SecureGuard Ltd advertises for security guards, stating that all applicants must be at least 170 cm tall . Wing, a 160 cm tall woman with ten years of security experience and excellent references, applies and is rejected solely because she does not meet the height requirement. The same requirement is applied to male and female applicants alike. Which of the following is the best analysis of Wing's position under the Sex Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 480)? A. Wing has no claim because the height requirement is applied equally to all applicants, so there is no discrimination B. Wing has a claim for direct sex discrimination because she was treated less favourably than the male applicants C. Wing has a claim for indirect sex discrimination because the apparently neutral height requirement is one with which a considerably smaller proportion of women can comply and it causes her detriment; SecureGuard Ltd can escape liability only if it justifies the requirement under the three step test (legitimate aim, rational connection and necessity) in Equal Opportunities Commission v Director of Education (2001) 2 HKLRD 690 D. Wing has no claim because the height requirement automatically falls within the genuine occupational qualification exception

title: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Relevant Ordinances（Cap. number + section numbers）
C. IRAC Application Points（答題框架）
excerpt: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Apply the doctrine of separate legal personality ( Salom…
text: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Apply the doctrine of separate legal personality ( Salomon v A. Salomon and Co Ltd ) and the concept of limited liability to scenario facts. 2. Analyse the differences between companies, sole traders, partnerships and joint ventures in formation, legal status, management and liability. 3. Identify the five types of companies that may be formed under s.66 of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) and the s.11 requirements of a private company. 4. Illustrate and apply the incorporation procedure under ss.67–73 CO, including the incorporation form, articles of association and certificate of incorporation. 5. Apply the rules on the articles as a statutory contract (s.86), alteration of articles (s.88), objects clauses and the reformed ultra vires doctrine (ss.115–116). 必背考點 以下按 Ordinances → Leading Cases → IRAC Application Points 組織。考試為 open book，但 panelists 多次指出：背晒啲條文而唔識 apply 落 scenario = 低分。記住「邊條 section 管邊件事」先係重點。 A. Relevant Ordinances（Cap. number + section numbers） 1. 核心概念：Separate Legal Entity & Limited Liability s.2 CO (Cap. 622) ：company 定義 —— formed and registered under the Companies Ordinance。 s.115 CO ：A company has the capacity, rights, powers and privileges of a natural person of full age ；s.115(2) 明確公司可 acquire, hold and dispose of land。公司可以同自己股東訂立合約（Salomon 賣生意俾自己公司）。 s.66 CO ：五種可成立公司 —— (1) public company limited by shares; (2) private company limited by shares; (3) public unlimited company with share capital; (4) private unlimited company with share capital; (5) company limited by guarantee without share capital。 s.8 CO ：company limited by shares —— members' liability limited by the articles to any amount unpaid on the shares held （已繳足 = 零額外責任）。 s.9 CO ：company limited by guarantee —— no share capital + liability limited to the amount members undertake to contribute on winding up （慈善/非牟利常用； 不屬 private 或 public ，見 ss.11(1)(b)、12(b)）。 s.10 CO ：unlimited company —— no limit on members' liability；注意成員係 severally liable （各自為自己份額負責），同 partnership 嘅 joint / joint and several liability 唔同。 s.73 CO ：由 certificate of incorporation 日期起，公司可行使 incorporated company 職能，並有 perpetual succession （s.73(2)）；founder members 於該日成為 members。 ⚠️ Incorporation ≠ limited liability ：limited liability 取決於公司類型（s.66），唔係成立就自動有。 2. Private vs Public Companies s.11(1)(a) CO ：private company 三個條件（ 全部寫喺 articles 度 ，缺一不可）： (i) restrict a member's right to transfer shares ； (ii) limit the number of members to 50 ； (iii) prohibit any invitation to the public to subscribe for shares or debentures。 （s.11(1)(b)：唔可以係 company limited by guarantee。） s.12 CO ：public company = not a private company + not a company limited by guarantee。Articles 達唔到 s.11(1)(a) 任何一項 = public。 只有 public company 可先可以上市（ Listing Rule 8.03 ）。 Private company 監管較鬆：s.359 reporting exemption + s.380(7) 豁免部分財務報表要求。 3. 成立程序（Formation） s.67(1) CO ：any one or more persons 可成立公司 —— (a) sign the articles + (b) deliver to the Registrar (i) an incorporation form in specified form + (ii) a copy of the articles。 s.67(2) ：只可為 lawful purpose 成立。 s.68 + Schedule 2 CO ：incorporation form 內容 —— 公司名、registered office 地址、limited/unlimited、private/public、founder members 姓名地址、directors 資料（自然人須 18 歲以上並 consent）、company secretary 資料、股份及股本細節（Sch. 2 ss.1–5, 7–8）。 s.71(1) CO ：Registrar 發出 certificate of incorporation 。 s.72 CO ：certificate 係 conclusive evidence 已符合註冊要求。 代替方案： shelf company （已註冊但未營運嘅空殼公司，買入後轉股、換董事及秘書、改名同 registered office）。 4. Articles of Association（公司憲制文件） s.75 CO ：公司 必須有 articles；memorandum of association 已喺新 CO 下 廢除 ，articles 係唯一 constitutional document。 ss.76–77 ：articles 須以英文或中文印刷、分條連續編號。 ss.81–85 ：articles 必載 —— s.81 公司名；s.83(1)/(2) limited/unlimited liability 聲明；s.84 limited by shares 須述明 liability limited to unpaid amount（limited by guarantee 須述明成員承諾出資額）；s.85 有股本公司須載 Sch. 2 s.8 資料； s.82(2) objects clause 屬 optional （例外：s.82(1) 依 s.103 申請刪除「Limited」字樣嘅公司必須載明 objects）。 ss.78–79 ：model articles 由 Financial Secretary 訂明（ Companies (Model Articles) Notice (Cap. 622H) ，Sch. 1 public / Sch. 2 private / Sch. 3 guarantee），公司可採用或修改。 s.86 CO ：articles 一經註冊，have effect as a contract under seal (i) between the company and each member 及 (ii) between a member and each other member；s.86(2) —— enforceable by the company against each member / by a member against the company / by a member against each other member。 ⚠️ Directors 唔可以 憑 s.86(2) 強制執行 articles（除非以 member 身份）；third parties 亦無權 —— s.3(2)(g) Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Ordinance (Cap. 623) 明確排除。 Alteration ： s.87(1) 可修改； s.88(2) 須 special resolution （≥75% 多數，s.564(1)）；例外： s.88(3) 修改最高發行股數只須 ordinary resolution（simple majority，s.563(1)）； s.88(5) 修改後 15 日內 向 Registrar 交付通知 + 經 officer 核證嘅修改後 articles，違反屬罪行（s.88(6)，Level 3 fine HK$10,000 + 每日 HK$300）； s.88(4) articles 自己加嘅額外修改條件無效； s.92(1) 不得藉修改強迫現有成員認購更多股份或增加其出資責任（除非書面同意）。 Objects / Ultra Vires 改革 ： s.115 賦予自然人能力 → 公司 capacity 不再受 objects 限制； s.116(1) 如 articles 載有 objects，公司不得做未獲授權嘅 act； s.116(3) members 可入稟 restrain 公司違反 s.116(1)； s.116(4) 不得針對履行因違反而產生嘅法律義務嘅行為提出（即已簽約就 too late）； s.116(5) 單純違反 s.116(1) 唔會令行為無效 。違反後果 = 追董事責任（breach of directors' duties）。 5. 其他成立及持續要求 Company name ： s.100(1) 不得同已註冊名稱相同 / 構成罪行 / 冒犯或違反公眾利益； s.100(2) 不得令人以為同中央人民政府或特區政府有關連； s.101 + Companies (Words and Expressions in Company Names) Order (Cap. 622A) （如 "trust"、"savings"、"chamber of commerce"）； s.102 limited company 英文名最後一字必須係 " Limited "、中文名最後四字必須係「有限公司」； s.103 Registrar 可特許刪除「Limited」（慈善類公司）。公司名須 全英文或全中文 ，不得中英混合（CR Guideline para. 3）。 Registered office ： s.658(1) 必須喺香港設 registered office； s.827 文件送達 registered office 即視為送達公司（ 即使公司已搬走或不知情 —— Ho Kwok Wah）；無 registered office 屬罪行（s.658(5)，Level 5 fine HK$50,000 + 每日 HK$1,000）。 Business registration ： s.5 BRO (Cap. 310) 開業後 1 個月內 向稅局登記； s.5A BRO 可同 incorporation 一併辦理（deemed application）。商業登記證須喺營業地點當眼處展示。 Common seal ：新 CO 下 唔再必需 ；如有，須為金屬印並清晰刻有公司名（s.124，違反 Level 3 fine）。 Registers ： s.627 register of members（2 個月內登記、成員離開後保存 10 年）； s.641 register of directors； ss.648/650 register of company secretaries；須存放於 registered office，15 日內通知 Registrar（ss.628, 641(3)–(5), 648(3)–(5)）；違反 = Level 4 fine HK$25,000 + 每日 HK$700；members 免費查閱（ss.631, 642, 649）。 Register of Significant Controllers (SCR) ： Part 12 Division 2A（ss.653A–653ZK）+ Schedules 5A–5C ，2018 年 3 月 1 日生效（Companies (Amendment) Ordinance 2018，回應 FATF 反洗錢建議）。 Significant control = 直接或間接持有 25% 已發行股份 / 投票權；或委任/罷免 過半數董事 嘅權利；或對公司有 significant influence or control ；或對符合上述條件嘅信託/商號有控制（Sch. 5A）。 即使無 significant controller 都要備存 register ；詳情確認後 7 日內 登記（s.653J(1)–(2)）；存放於 registered office（s.653M(1)）；只供 register 上人士及 law enforcement officers （警察、CR、海關、金管局、稅局、ICAC、SFC 等）查閱 —— 唔係公開查閱 。 須委任至少一名 designated representative （s.653Z）：香港居民 + 董事/僱員/成員，或會計/法律專業人士或 TCSP 持牌人。 Listed companies 豁免 （由 SFO 披露制度涵蓋）；經上市公司持有嘅人亦排除於 registrable person 之外。 違反 = Level 4 fine + 每日 HK$700（ss.653H(4), 653I(3), 653J(3)）。實際檢控案例： HKSAR v Best Time Holdings Limited （罰 HK$8,000）、 HKSAR v Haihua Shipping Service Co., Limited （罰 HK$10,000）。 Members ：s.67(1) 一人即可成立（one person company）；s.629(1) 單一成員公司須喺 register 註明。 Directors ：private company 至少 1 名 （s.454(1)）；public company 及 company limited by guarantee 至少 2 名 （s.453(2)）；自然人董事須 18 歲以上 （Sch. 2 s.4）。 Company Secretary ： s.474(1) 必須有； s.474(4) 自然人須 通常居於香港 ，法人團體須喺香港有 registered office/place of business； s.475(1) 董事可兼任， 但 s.475(2) 只有一名董事嘅 private company 唔可以 由該唯一董事兼任； s.475(3) 亦不得委任以該唯一董事為唯一董事嘅法人團體； s.479(1) 凡規定由「董事 + 公司秘書」做嘅事， 唔可以由同一人以雙重身份完成 （例如 s.127(3)(b) 簽立文件）；辭職： s.477 + s.652(2) ，15 日內交 Form ND4，違反 Level 4 fine；若秘書有理由相信公司唔會交通知，秘書自己須交（s.474(3)）。上市公司秘書須具學術/專業資格（ Listing Rule 3.28 ：HKICS 會員、律師、大律師或 CPA）。 Dormant companies ： s.5 CO —— 通過 special resolution 宣佈 dormant 並交付 Registrar；豁免 financial statements、directors' reports、AGM、annual returns、核數師委任（ss.477, 661, 663）；進行任何 accounting transaction （s.5(5)(b)，即 s.373 須入帳嘅交易，法定費用除外）即 自動失去 dormant 狀態，知情嘅 member/director 就該交易嘅債項負 個人責任 ；自願恢復：special resolution 表明有意進行 accounting transaction 並交付 Registrar（s.5(5)(a)）； public company 及 s.5(7) 所列受規管機構 （銀行、保險、SFC 持牌法團、強積金受託人及其控股公司、過去 5 年曾屬該類別者） 不得 dormant。 De registration ： s.750(1) 六個條件 —— (1) all members agree；(2) 未開業或申請前 3 個月 無營業；(3) 無未清償債務；(4) 非任何法律程序一方；(5) 無位於香港嘅不動產；(6) 如為控股公司，子公司亦無香港不動產。 Non Hong Kong companies ： s.2 定義 = 在外地成立但在香港 establish a place of business ； s.774 place of business 包括 share transfer office / share registration office ； s.776 設立營業地點後 1 個月內 向 Registrar 註冊；Part 16 只適用於 已註冊 嘅非香港公司，但 Part 14（unfair prejudice remedies）經 s.722 適用於註冊及未註冊非香港公司（法院是否行使管轄權視乎同香港有否 sufficient connection）； Cap. 622M 要求非香港公司展示名稱、註冊地及有限責任狀況（違反 level 3 fine）。 監管機構 ： Registrar of Companies / Companies Registry （s.27 保存紀錄、接受註冊、可剔除公司、可就 filing offences 檢控，但 無調查權 ）； Official Receiver （s.75 Bankruptcy Ordinance (Cap. 6) 委任；s.194 CWUMPO 無私人清盤人時出任清盤人；s.204 CWUMPO 監督私人清盤人）。 其他相關法例 ： CWUMPO (Cap. 32) —— 舊 CO 保留條文：winding up/insolvency、directors disqualification (Part IVA)、prospectuses (Part II)； BRO (Cap. 310) ； Transfer of Businesses (Protection of Creditors) Ordinance (Cap. 49) —— s.3 買方承擔賣方業務全部債務、s.4 + s.5(3) 以 Gazette + 兩份中文 + 一份英文報章刊登轉讓通知可免責（轉讓日前 1–4 個月刊登，通知於刊登後 1 個月屆滿時完成）； Partnership Ordinance (Cap. 38) —— s.3(1) partnership 定義、s.7 partner binds the firm、s.11/12 joint liability、s.13/14 joint and several liability、s.26 權利平等、s.30 full disclosure、s.31(1) duty to account、s.32 duty not to compete、ss.34–37 dissolution； Limited Partnerships Ordinance (Cap. 37) —— general partner 無限責任、limited partner 以出資額為限但 不得參與管理 ； Limited Partnership Fund Ordinance (Cap. 637) —— 2020 08 31 生效，投資基金工具，limited partner 無 fiduciary duty（s.26(2)）、無法律人格（s.15(b)）； SFO (Cap. 571) 及 Listing Rules （非成文法）。 B. Leading Cases（full citation） Case Principle（一句記住） Salomon v A. Salomon and Co Ltd (1897) AC 22 (HL) 公司一經註冊即係 separate legal person ，即使實際由一人操控亦然；Mr Salomon 毋須為公司債務負責。Separate legal entity 嘅基石案例。 Farrar v Farrars Limited (1888) 40 Ch. D. 395 股東將物業賣俾自己做股東嘅公司， 唔係 「賣俾自己」—— 交易不可僅因此撤銷。印證公司同股東係兩個人。 Ashbury Railway Carriage and Iron Co Ltd v Riche (1875) LR 7 HL 653 舊 ultra vires 原則：超出 objects clause 嘅合約 void （貸款起鐵路超出「造賣火車卡」嘅 objects）。⚠️ 已被 ss.115–116 改革，考試用嚟對比新舊制度。 Ng Kin Kenneth v HK Football Association Ltd (1994) 1 HKC 734 Articles 係 statutory contract，但 條款寫法決定可強制執行嘅範圍 —— 涉案仲裁條款只涵蓋 members 之間嘅爭議，唔涵蓋 company vs member。 Eley v Positive Government Security Life Assurance Co Ltd (1875) 1 Ex D 88 （LP footnote 2 引用） 股東只可以 member 身份 按 articles 起訴，唔可以以第三方/其他身份起訴。 Kam Leung Sui Kwan v Kam Kwan Lai and Others (2015) 18 HKCFAR 501 (CFA) 「Place of business」= 公司 經營或有意經營業務嘅地點 ；holding company 純行政職能、喺香港開 board meetings 唔足以 構成香港 place of business（但資產全在香港可構成 winding up 管轄嘅 sufficient connection）。 Ho Kwok Wah v Group Jewellery Arts Ltd and Others (2000) 3 HKC 595 (CA) 傳票送達公司 registered office 即屬有效送達， 即使公司其實已搬走 —— 判決非不當取得。Registered office 嘅法律後果唔可以hea。 HKSAR v Best Time Holdings Limited ； HKSAR v Haihua Shipping Service Co., Limited SCR（s.653M(1)）及各 registers 存放要求嘅實際刑事檢控案例，罰款 HK$8,000 / HK$10,000。 （Partnership 相關） Law v Law (1905) Partner 出售權益時未 full disclosure → 對方可終止交易（s.30 PO）。 Bentley v Craven (1853) Partner 低買高賣俾自己 firm → 須 account for 全部利潤（s.31(1) PO duty to account）。 C. IRAC Application Points（答題框架） 1. Separate legal entity 題 ： Issue ：X 是否要為公司債務/行為負責？ Rule ：Salomon + s.115 CO；公司同 members/officers 係不同法律主體。 Application ：分清「以個人身份簽」定「以公司身份簽」—— 若 X 親自 做合約一方（即使係股東/董事），X 個人負責；若只有公司係合約一方，members 唔使負責（limited by shares 最多賠 unpaid amount，s.8(1)）。 Conclusion ：明確寫邊個負責、邊個唔使負責。 2. Private vs public 題 ：逐項對照 s.11(1)(a)(i)–(iii) 三個 articles 要求 —— 缺一即 public （s.12(a)）。注意「限制 100 名成員」≠ private（上限係 50 ）。 3. Objects clause / ultra vires 題 ： 有 objects clause → s.116(1) 公司 不應 做未授權行為； 但 s.115 畀咗 capacity + s.116(5) 行為 唔會無效 （唔再係 Ashbury 嘅 void）； members 可依 s.116(3) 申請禁制， 但 s.116(4) —— 已簽約要履行嘅話 too late； 補救方向：告違約董事 breach of directors' duties。 4. Non HK company 註冊題 ：問三件事 —— (1) 有冇 place of business（Kam Leung Sui Kwan：純開 board meetings 唔夠）？(2) 有冇 share transfer/registration office（s.774 自動中招）？(3) 有 → s.776 一個月內註冊。 5. SCR 題 ：逐步 trace 持股鏈 —— 直接持股 25% 嘅 entity（且係 member）= registrable legal entity；透過 majority stake chain 間接持股嘅自然人 = registrable person；中間層唔係下層公司嘅 member 就唔係 registrable legal entity。 6. Company secretary 題 ：檢查 (1) 係咪 one director private company（s.475(2) 禁兼任）；(2) 有冇同一個人以 director + secretary 雙重身份做嘢（s.479(1) 禁止）；(3) 自然人係咪通常居港（s.474(4)）。 易混淆概念對比 表一：Private Company vs Public Company（CO ss.11–12） 比較點 Private Company (s.11) Public Company (s.12) 點樣分辨／考試伏位（繁中） Share transfer Articles 必須 restrict 轉讓（通常 directors 可拒絕登記，Model Articles Sch. 2 Art. 2 + Art. 64，或 pre emption 條款） 無限制要求 伏位：articles 唔寫限制 = public，唔使問股東人數 Number of members Articles 上限 50 無上限 伏位：「上限 100 人」唔符合 s.11(1)(a)(ii) —— 必須 ≤50 先算 private Public subscription Articles 必須 prohibit 邀請公眾認購 shares/debentures 可以邀請公眾 伏位：喺港鐵站公開招股嘅公司一定係 public Company limited by guarantee 排除（s.11(1)(b)） 排除（s.12(b)） Guarantee company 唔係 private 亦唔係 public —— 獨立類別 監管負擔 較輕（s.359 reporting exemption、s.380(7) 豁免） 較重；上市須為 public（ LR 8.03 ） 考試鍾意問「點解大部分香港公司係 private」 最少董事人數 1 （s.454(1)） 2 （s.453(2)） 同 guarantee company 一齊記：public/guarantee = 2 表二：Limited by Shares vs Limited by Guarantee vs Unlimited（CO ss.8–10） 比較點 Limited by Shares (s.8) Limited by Guarantee (s.9) Unlimited (s.10) Share capital 有 無 有 成員責任上限 持股 unpaid amount （繳足 = 零） Articles 訂明嘅 guarantee 金額 ，清盤時先要掏 無上限 （清盤時全數負責） 責任性質 Limited Limited（winding up 先觸發） 各成員 severally liable （⚠️ 唔係 joint and several，呢點同 partnership 唔同） 典型用途 一般商業營運 慈善、非牟利組織（無需集資） 罕見（責任太大） 考試伏位（繁中） 記住 Illustrative Example：繳咗一半錢 = 清盤時最多補返未繳嗰半 「冇股本」→ 唔可以發股集資；唔屬 private/public 伏位：成員係 several 而唔係 joint and several；同 partnership 對比題常考 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: What is the doctrine of separate legal entity, and which case established it? Back: A company at law is a different person from its founders/members, even if effectively operated by one person. Established by the House of Lords in Salomon v A. Salomon and Co Ltd (1897) AC 22 . Consequences: the company incurs its own obligations/liabilities; members are not liable for company debts; the company can contract even with its own members. Statutory basis: s.115 CO — capacity, rights, powers and privileges of a natural person of full age. 💬 白話解釋：公司一註冊就係一個「獨立嘅人」，老闆欠嘅唔係公司欠嘅，公司欠嘅亦唔關股東事。Salomon 個案入面就算成間公司實質得佢一個人搞，法庭都照樣認公司係獨立法人。 Card 2 Front: State the five types of companies that may be formed under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) and the relevant section. Back: (s.66 CO) 1. Public companies limited by shares 2. Private companies limited by shares 3. Public unlimited companies with share capital 4. Private unlimited companies with share capital 5. Companies limited by guarantee without share capital 💬 白話解釋：記法 = 兩條軸交叉 —— 第一條軸「private 定 public」，第二條軸「limited by shares 定 unlimited」，再加一個獨立嘅「guarantee（冇股本）」。揀邊種就睇你想唔想限責任、想唔想向公眾集資。 Card 3 Front: What are the three article requirements for a company to qualify as a private company under s.11(1)(a) CO? Back: 1. Articles restrict a member's right to transfer shares ; 2. Articles limit the number of members to 50 ; 3. Articles prohibit any invitation to the public to subscribe for shares or debentures. Failing any one → the company is a public company under s.12(a). A company limited by guarantee can be neither (ss.11(1)(b), 12(b)). 💬 白話解釋：三個條件全部要寫入 articles，缺一不可。考試伏位：上限寫「100 人」唔合格（要 ≤50）；寫咗可以公開招股都唔合格。達唔到任何一條自動變 public。 Card 4 Front: Describe the incorporation procedure and the legal effect of the certificate of incorporation (ss.67–73 CO). Back: s.67(1) : one or more persons (a) sign the articles and (b) deliver to the Registrar an incorporation form + a copy of the articles; s.67(2): lawful purpose only. Incorporation form contents: s.68 + Schedule 2 (name, registered office, company type, founder members, directors, company secretary, share capital details). s.71(1) : Registrar issues a certificate of incorporation . s.72 : certificate is conclusive evidence that registration requirements are complied with. s.73 : from the date of incorporation, the company can exercise its functions and has perpetual succession ; founder members become members. 💬 白話解釋：成立公司 = 簽 articles + 交 incorporation form 俾公司註冊處。張證書一出就係「鐵證」，冇人可推翻註冊係有效嘅；由證書日期起公司就有「永久延續」—— 股東換人都唔會影響公司存在。 Card 5 Front: What is the legal effect of a company's articles under s.86 CO, and who may enforce them? Back: Once registered, articles have effect as a contract under seal : (i) between the company and each member ; and (ii) between a member and each other member (s.86(1)). Enforceable: by the company against each member; by a member against the company; by a member against each other member (s.86(2)). Directors cannot enforce the articles as directors (only in capacity as members); third parties are excluded — s.3(2)(g) Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Ordinance (Cap. 623) . Cases: Ng Kin Kenneth v HK Football Association Ltd (1994) 1 HKC 734 (drafting limits scope of enforceability); Eley v Positive Government Security Life Assurance Co Ltd (1875) 1 Ex D 88 (sue only in member capacity). 💬 白話解釋：Articles 係一份「法定合約」，但唔係乜人都告得入 —— 公司告股東得、股東告公司得、股東告股東得；董事同外人就冇份。仲要睇條款點寫，寫得窄就只涵蓋部分爭議（Ng Kin Kenneth）。 Card 6 Front: How may a company alter its articles, and what statutory restrictions apply? (ss.87–92 CO) Back: s.88(2) : alteration only by special resolution (≥75% majority, s.564(1)); exception — s.88(3) : altering the maximum number of shares the company may issue needs only an ordinary resolution (s.563(1)). s.88(5) : deliver notice of alteration + certified copy of altered articles to the Registrar within 15 days ; offence otherwise (s.88(6): Level 3 fine HK$10,000 + HK$300/day). s.88(4) : extra conditions written into the articles themselves are invalid . s.92(1) : cannot alter articles to bind an existing member to take more shares or increase his liability to pay money to the company (without consent). 💬 白話解釋：改 articles 一定要 special resolution（75%），改完 15 日內要報註冊處。兩個伏位：(1) 公司唔可以自己喺 articles 加難度（例如要 90%）；(2) 唔可以藉改章程逼現有股東加碼出錢。 Card 7 Front: How has the ultra vires doctrine been reformed in Hong Kong? (ss.115–116 CO) Back: Old law: acts outside the objects clause were ultra vires and void — Ashbury Railway Carriage and Iron Co Ltd v Riche (1875) LR 7 HL 653 . Now: memorandum abolished; objects clause optional (s.82(2)); s.115 gives the company capacity of a natural person. s.116(1) : if objects are stated, the company must not do unauthorised acts — but s.116(5) : the act is not invalid merely because it breaches s.116(1). s.116(3) : members may bring proceedings to restrain the company; s.116(4) : no restraint against acts fulfilling legal obligations already arising from the breach. Real consequence: liability of the director who caused the breach (directors' duties). 💬 白話解釋：舊制超經營範圍 = 合約無效，好辣。新制下合約照樣有效（保護交易對手），但公司「唔應該做」，股東可以喺公司做之前申請禁制；一做咗就追唔返，只可以追究簽約董事嘅責任。 Card 8 Front: What are the rules on appointing a company secretary, and the prohibition on dual capacity? (ss.474–479 CO) Back: s.474(1) : every company must have a company secretary; s.474(4) : a natural person secretary must ordinarily reside in Hong Kong ; a body corporate must have its registered office/place of business in Hong Kong. s.475(1) : a director may also be company secretary — but s.475(2) : a private company with only one director cannot have that sole director as secretary; s.475(3) : nor a body corporate whose sole director is that director. s.479(1) : where something must be done by both a director and the company secretary , it is not satisfied by the same person acting in both capacities (e.g. execution of documents under s.127(3)(b)). Resignation: company must notify Registrar within 15 days (Form ND4, s.652(2)); if the company will not, the resigning secretary must deliver the notice himself (s.474(3)). Listed companies: secretary must have specified qualifications — Listing Rule 3.28 . 💬 白話解釋：一人公司嘅唯一董事唔可以自己做埋秘書 —— 因為好多法定動作要「一個董事 + 一個秘書」兩個人做，用嚟互相制衡。Bruce 想一人分飾兩角簽約？s.479 話唔得。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Separate legal entity 公司係獨立「法人」，同股東係兩個人 Under Salomon v A. Salomon and Co Ltd (1897) AC 22 , a company is a separate legal person distinct from its members. Limited liability 股東最多蝕晒啲股款，唔使掏腰包幫公司還債 In a company limited by shares, a member's liability is limited to any amount unpaid on his shares (s.8 CO). Perpetual succession 公司「長命」，股東死咗換人都唔影響公司存在 From the date of incorporation, the company has perpetual succession (s.73(2) CO). Statutory contract Articles 變成公司同股東之間嘅法定合約 Under s.86 CO, the articles have effect as a contract under seal between the company and each member. Ultra vires 超出公司經營範圍（舊制下 = 無效；新制下 = 唔會無效） Under s.116(5) CO, an act is not invalid merely because it breaches the company's stated objects. Shelf company 現成空殼公司，買返嚟即用 The client acquired a shelf company and replaced its directors and company secretary. Significant controller 實際控制公司嘅人（ 25% 持股/投票權等），要入 SCR A person holding more than 25% of the issued shares is a significant controller whose particulars must be entered in the significant controllers register. Dormant company 「冬眠」公司，通過特別決議後可豁免多項申報 By passing and delivering a special resolution under s.5 CO, the company declared itself dormant and was exempted from filing annual returns.

title: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Answers
Q2 — Answer: 見 Model Answer 六個條件
excerpt: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Issue: Whether Oscar, as sole shareholder and director, is persona…
text: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Issue: Whether Oscar, as sole shareholder and director, is personally liable for the debts of Oasis Trading Limited on its winding up. Rule: Under the doctrine of separate legal entity established in Salomon v A. Salomon and Co Ltd (1897) AC 22 , a company at law is a different person from its members, even if it is effectively operated by one person. Under s.115 of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), the company has the capacity, rights, powers and privileges of a natural person and incurs obligations and liabilities of its own. As the company is limited by shares, Oscar's liability as a member is limited to any amount unpaid on his shares (s.8(1) CO) — here nil, as his shares are fully paid. Application: The debts were incurred by the company, a separate legal person. Neither Oscar's status as sole shareholder nor as sole director makes him liable for the company's obligations; directors and employees are not generally personally liable for company debts. Conclusion: Oscar is not personally liable. The creditor's claim against Oscar must fail. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 Salomon 原則嘅直接應用。A 錯 —— 「一人操控」唔會令股東負責，Salomon 正正係一人實際控制嘅案例，House of Lords 都判佢唔使負責。B 錯 —— 董事管理公司唔等於個人承擔公司債務；董事/僱員一般以合約/代理關係為本，唔會為公司債務負責。D 錯 —— joint and several liability 係 partnership（s.13/s.14 PO）嘅概念，唔適用於股東同公司。C 啱 —— 公司係獨立法人，Oscar 已繳足股款，連 s.8(1) 嘅 unpaid amount 都冇，責任為零。 Rule Check: Salomon v A. Salomon and Co Ltd (1897) AC 22 ; Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) ss.115, 8(1) Common Trap（繁中）: 考生一見「sole shareholder + sole director」就以為可以 lift the veil 或「其實係同一個人」。記住：lifting the corporate veil 係例外（Chapter 10 先詳講），本章預設答案係 Salomon —— 冇特別事實（如 fraud、sham）就唔好亂掀面紗。 Q2 — Answer: 見 Model Answer 六個條件 Model Answer (EN): Under s.750(1) of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), an application for deregistration by the company, or a director or member of the company, may only be made if ALL of the following conditions are satisfied: 1. All members of the company agree to the deregistration; 2. The company has not commenced operation or business, or has not been in operation or carried on business during the 3 months immediately before the application; 3. The company has no outstanding liabilities; 4. The company is not a party to any legal proceedings; 5. The company's assets do not consist of any immovable property situated in Hong Kong; and 6. If the company is a holding company, none of its subsidiary's assets consist of any immovable property situated in Hong Kong. 解題思路（繁中）: 純 recall 題，考 s.750(1) 六個條件。記憶框架：「人（全體同意）、業（3 個月無營業）、債（無負債）、訟（無官司）、樓（自己冇香港物業）、仔（子公司都冇香港物業）」。伏位：(1) 唔係「6 個月」係「3 個月」；(2) immovable property 限於「situated in Hong Kong」；(3) 第 6 條只係控股公司先適用。呢啲係 open book 都應該即刻搵到嘅基本盤。 Rule Check: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) s.750(1) Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好同 dormant company（s.5） 撈亂 —— dormant 係「冬眠」保留公司，deregistration 係「解散除名」；亦唔好同 striking off / liquidation 搞混（panelists 喺 J24 Q5(c) 就批評考生將 deregistration 誤答成 liquidation）。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Issue: Whether the yacht chartering contract is void for being outside the company's objects, and whether the members can restrain its performance. Rule: Under s.115 of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), a company has the capacity of a natural person of full age, so its capacity is not restricted by its stated objects. Under s.116(1), where objects are stated in the articles, the company must not do any act it is not authorised to do; under s.116(3), members may bring proceedings to restrain such an act. However, s.116(4) provides that no such proceedings may be brought in respect of an act done in fulfilment of a legal obligation arising from the breach, and s.116(5) provides that an act is not invalid merely because it breaches s.116(1). Application: Operating a yacht chartering service is outside the stated object of retail sale of marine equipment, so the company should not have entered the contract (s.116(1)). But the contract has already been signed: restraining performance would prevent fulfilment of a legal obligation arising from the breach, which s.116(4) prohibits, and s.116(5) saves the contract from invalidity. Conclusion: The contract is valid and binding. The members' remedy lies against Derek personally for breach of his duties as a director in causing the company to act beyond its objects. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係新舊 ultra vires 制度嘅對比應用。A 錯 —— Ashbury 嘅「void」舊原則已被新 CO 改革，s.116(5) 明確行為唔會單因違反 objects 而無效。B 錯 —— s.116(3) 禁制令只適用於「未做嘅行為」；合約已簽，履行係因違反而產生嘅法律義務，s.116(4) 禁止針對呢類行為提出禁制（「too late」情況）。D 錯 —— 前半啱（合約有效），但後半錯，理由同 B。C 全對 —— 仲要記得補一句追究 Derek 嘅董事責任，呢個先係完整 exam style 答案。答呢類題要用 IRAC 四步，唔好齋背條文。 Rule Check: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) ss.115, 116(1), 116(3), 116(4), 116(5); cf. Ashbury Railway Carriage and Iron Co Ltd v Riche (1875) LR 7 HL 653 (old law) Common Trap（繁中）: 最大陷阱係背咗 Ashbury 就直接答「void」—— 新 CO 下 objects clause 違反 唔會 令交易無效。第二個陷阱係以為 members 隨時都可以禁制 —— 記住 s.116(4) 嘅「too late」規則：已簽約要履行就禁唔到。 Q4 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Arrangement (1) — Not permissible. Under s.475(2) of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), a private company having only one director must not have as its company secretary that sole director. Arrangement (2) — Not permissible. Under s.475(3), such a company also must not appoint as company secretary a body corporate whose sole director is that same director. Arrangement (3) — Permissible. A natural person may be appointed company secretary provided he/she ordinarily resides in Hong Kong (s.474(4)); Gary satisfies this requirement. (Note: s.475(1) allows a director to be company secretary only where the company has more than one director — not applicable here, but Gary is an independent appointee.) Arrangement (4) — Not permissible. A body corporate appointed as company secretary must have its registered office or place of business in Hong Kong (s.474(4)); Global Admin Inc. has neither. Therefore only arrangement (3) is permissible. 解題思路（繁中）: 逐個 arrangement 對條文就唔會錯。(1) 撞正 s.475(2) —— 一人董事嘅 private company，唯一董事唔可以兼任秘書，因為好多法定動作要「董事 + 秘書」兩個人互相制衡（s.479(1) 嘅精神）。(2) 係 (1) 嘅「迂迴版」，s.475(3) 專登封住呢個漏洞 —— 用間自己全資、自己做唯一董事嘅公司做秘書都唔得。(4) 考 s.474(4)：法人秘書嘅 registered office 或 place of business 必須喺香港，New York 公司冇香港據點 = 唔得。只有 (3) Gary 符合「自然人 + 通常居港」。 Rule Check: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) ss.474(1), 474(4), 475(1), 475(2), 475(3), 479(1) Common Trap（繁中）: 考生成日只記得 s.475(1)「董事可以兼任秘書」就揀 A —— 必須記住但書： only one director 嘅 private company 例外 。另一伏位係 (2)：以為搵間公司做秘書就繞過限制，其實 s.475(3) 已經封死。 Q5 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Beta Limited must be entered as a registrable legal entity : it is a member of Coral Limited and directly holds 30% of its shares (more than the 25% threshold), giving it significant control (Part 1, Schedule 5A CO). Alpha Limited must not be entered: although it has significant control over Coral Limited through the chain, it is not a member of Coral Limited, and a registrable legal entity must be a member of the applicable company. Ms Ho must be entered as a registrable person : she holds a majority stake in Alpha Limited, which holds a majority stake in Beta Limited, which in turn holds the shares in Coral Limited. She therefore holds 30% of Coral Limited's shares indirectly through a chain of majority stakes, exceeding the 25% threshold (Schedule 5A CO). Therefore the register must contain Ms Ho and Beta Limited. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 LP Apply and Analyse 5 嘅同款持股鏈分析。三步走：(1) 直接層 —— Beta 直接持 30% 25%，又係 Coral 嘅 member → registrable legal entity。(2) 中間層 —— Alpha 雖然透過控制 Beta 而有 significant control，但佢 唔係 Coral 嘅股東 ，做唔成 registrable legal entity（記住：entity 必須係 member）。(3) 自然人層 —— Ms Ho 透過「majority stake chain」（70% → 60% → 30%）間接持有 Coral 30%，超過 25% → registrable person。A 錯在漏咗 Ms Ho；B 錯在漏咗 Beta；C 錯在將 Alpha 當成 registrable entity。 Rule Check: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) Part 12, Division 2A (ss.653A–653ZK); Schedule 5A (significant control, majority stake chain); cf. LP Apply and Analyse 5 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個伏位：(1) 以為成條鏈嘅公司都要入 register —— 其實中間層唔係目標公司嘅 member 就唔入得；(2) 以為自然人要「直接」持股先算 —— Schedule 5A 嘅 majority stake chain 令間接持股都計，而且 nominee 持股會當係 beneficiary 持有。記住 register 唔係公開畀公眾查，只有 register 上人士同執法機關可查（唔好答「公眾可查閱」）。

excerpt: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 (MCQ) Os…
text: M10 Chapter 8: Incorporation in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 (MCQ) Oscar is the sole shareholder and sole director of Oasis Trading Limited, a private company limited by shares that he incorporated in Hong Kong. All of his shares are fully paid. The company has just been wound up with substantial unpaid debts owed to unsecured creditors. One creditor demands that Oscar personally repay the company's debts, arguing that "the company is just Oscar in another name". Which statement is correct? A. Oscar is personally liable for the company's unpaid debts because he is the sole shareholder and controller of the company. B. Oscar is personally liable for the company's unpaid debts because, as sole director, he managed the business that incurred them. C. Oscar is not personally liable for the company's debts, because the company is a separate legal person distinct from him. D. Oscar is jointly and severally liable together with the company for the unpaid debts. Q2 (Short answer) Golden Years Limited, a private company limited by shares, wishes to apply to the Registrar of Companies for deregistration. State ALL of the conditions that must be satisfied before such an application can be made, and cite the relevant section of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622). Q3 (MCQ — scenario) The articles of association of Marine Supplies Limited state its object as "to carry on the business of retail sale of marine equipment". Derek, a director, signs a contract on behalf of the company with Harbour Tours Limited under which Marine Supplies Limited will operate a yacht chartering service. The other members of Marine Supplies Limited discover the contract only after it has been signed. They want (i) to stop the company from performing the yacht chartering contract, and (ii) to have the contract declared void as beyond the company's objects. Which statement best states the legal position under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622)? A. The contract is void as ultra vires, following the doctrine in Ashbury Railway Carriage and Iron Co Ltd v Riche. B. The members may obtain a court order restraining the company from performing the contract, because performance would breach s.116(1). C. The contract is not invalid merely because it breaches the objects clause, and proceedings to restrain the company cannot be brought because performance would fulfil a legal obligation arising from the breach; the members should instead pursue Derek for breach of his duties as a director. D. The contract is valid, and the members may additionally obtain a court order restraining the company from performing it at any time before full performance. Q4 (MCQ — scenario) Fiona is the sole shareholder and sole director of Fable Design Limited, a private company limited by shares incorporated in Hong Kong. She is considering the following arrangements for the office of company secretary: (1) Appoint herself as company secretary in addition to being sole director; (2) Appoint Fiona Corporate Services Limited, a Hong Kong body corporate wholly owned by her and of which she is the sole director; (3) Appoint her friend Gary, a natural person who ordinarily resides in Hong Kong; (4) Appoint Global Admin Inc., a body corporate whose registered office is in New York and which has no place of business in Hong Kong. Which arrangement(s) is/are permissible under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622)? A. (1) only B. (2) only C. (3) only D. (1) and (4) only Q5 (MCQ — scenario) Ms Ho holds 70% of the shares in Alpha Limited. Alpha Limited holds 60% of the shares in Beta Limited. Beta Limited holds 30% of the shares in Coral Limited. None of Alpha Limited, Beta Limited or Coral Limited is listed, and no other person holds more than 25% of the shares or voting rights in Coral Limited. Coral Limited is an applicable company required to keep a significant controllers register under Part 12, Division 2A of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622). Who must be entered in Coral Limited's significant controllers register? A. Beta Limited only. B. Ms Ho only. C. Alpha Limited and Beta Limited. D. Ms Ho and Beta Limited.
