excerpt: M10 Chapter 13: Receivership, Liquidation and Winding up — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Distinguish compulsory winding up, member…
text: M10 Chapter 13: Receivership, Liquidation and Winding up — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Distinguish compulsory winding up, members' voluntary winding up and creditors' voluntary winding up, and apply the correct procedure for each. 2. Analyse the appointment, powers, duties, liabilities and removal of liquidators and receivers. 3. Apply the avoidance powers of a liquidator: void dispositions (s.182), unfair preferences (ss.266/266A/266B), invalid floating charges (s.267), fraudulent trading (s.275) and misfeasance (s.276). 4. Determine the provability of debts and the statutory order of priority of payments in a winding up. 5. Advise on receivership as a corporate rescue / debt enforcement device and the grounds for compulsory winding up under s.177 CWUMPO. 除非另註明，本章 s.177 起的條文均屬 Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap.32) ('CWUMPO') ；重組／收購條文（如 ss.670–721）屬 Companies Ordinance (Cap.622) ('CO') 。 必背考點 A. Relevant Ordinances & Sections (以 LP 所引為準) Receivership (LP s.13.3) CWUMPO ss.297A & 168D(1)(c) : receiver/manager 必須係 natural person；undischarged bankrupt 或受 disqualification order 者唔做得。 CWUMPO s.300A : floating charge 下委任嘅 receiver 須 forthwith 通知公司；公司 14 日內交 statement of affairs；receiver 收咗後 2 個月內將副本送 Registrar、court、trustees/debenture holders。 CWUMPO s.298A(1) : receiver 可向 court 尋求指示； s.298A(2) : receiver 對履行職能中訂立嘅合約負 personal liability，但有 statutory right of indemnity 從公司資產彌償。 Conveyancing and Property Ordinance (Cap.219), Fourth Schedule : receiver 對 mortgaged land 嘅 implied powers（insure、possess、lease、sell 等 9 項）。 High Court Ordinance (Cap.4) s.21L / CWUMPO s.725 / inherent jurisdiction：CFI 委任 receiver 嘅三個來源。 Compulsory winding up (LP s.13.4.2) s.177 : 六個 grounds — (1) special resolution to wind up by court; (2) 無開業一年／停業一年; (3) no members; (4) unable to pay its debts; (5) articles 指定事件發生; (6) just and equitable。 s.178(1) : deemed inability to pay debts — (a) statutory demand ≥ HK$10,000 未喺 21 日 內清償（但 debt 有 genuine dispute on substantial grounds 可拒絕）; (b) execution unsatisfied; (c) court 信納無力償債（cash flow test + balance sheet test）。 s.179 : petition 呈請方式；standing 包括 company、creditors、contributory、trustee in bankruptcy、official receiver、Financial Secretary、Registrar、SFC (s.212 SFO Cap.571)。 s.184(2) : winding up deemed commenced at presentation of petition（relation back）。 s.182 : commencement 後 disposition of property void，除非 court sanction → 公司通常要申請 validating order （如出糧、日常營運開支）。 s.186 : winding up order 後未經 court leave 不得開始或繼續針對公司嘅訴訟。 s.190 : directors 交 statement of affairs 及接受 interview； ss.221–222 : private / public examination。 s.197 : liquidator 接管全部資產； s.199(1)/(2)(a) : carry on business（beneficial winding up）、出售資產； s.268 : compromises + disclaimer of onerous property 。 ss.266, 266A, 266B : unfair preference — 破產前 6 個月 內（associate = 2 年 ）；要素：put creditor in better position + desire to prefer + insolvent at the time（借 Bankruptcy Ordinance (Cap.6) ss.50(3)/(4), 51(1)/(2)）。 s.267 : winding up 前 12 個月 內批出嘅某些 floating charges 可被推翻。 s.275(1) : fraudulent trading — intent to defraud creditors / fraudulent purpose + knowingly a party；civil（個人負全部債務）+ criminal（最高 5 年監禁）。 s.264B : extortionate credit transaction — winding up order / special resolution 前 3 年 內，grossly exorbitant payments 或 grossly contravenes fair dealing，court 可 set aside / vary。 s.276 : misfeasance summary procedure — 針對 officer、liquidator、receiver、promoter；official receiver / liquidator / creditor / contributory 可申請； 不創建新訴因 。 s.265(1) : preferential creditors — 僱員工資/遣散費/長服金 (EO Cap.57)、僱員補償 (Cap.282)、ORSO (Cap.426)、MPFA (Cap.485 s.17(7))、government statutory debts (12 個月內到期, s.265(1)(d))、銀行存戶 (≤HK$500,000, s.265(1)(db))、保險索償 (s.265(1)(e))。 s.265(3B)/(4) : preferential creditors rank above floating chargee；liquidator's costs 先於一般分派。 s.263 + s.34 BO : proof of debts； s.264A : statutory interest； ss.265(5)/(5A) : 三個月內 distrained goods 嘅 landlord。 s.227F : 資產 < HK$200,000 → summary procedure，official receiver 做 liquidator。 ss.271–275 : 刑事罪行（concealment/falsification s.271–272、fraudulent conduct s.273、無 proper books s.274、fraudulent trading s.275）。 Voluntary winding up (LP s.13.4.3) s.228(1)(a)/(b), s.228A, s.228(1)(d) : 開始方式 — articles 期限屆滿（ordinary resolution）、special resolution、directors' resolution (liabilities)、s.228A winding up statement。 s.233 : certificate of solvency — directors 認為公司可喺 commencement 後 12 個月 內全數還債；證明須喺 resolution 前 5 星期 內發出； s.117(1) : certificate + resolution 15 日內交 Registrar → 有 = members' voluntary winding up ；無 = creditors' voluntary winding up (s.233(4))。 s.241(1)/(2) : creditors' meeting 須喺公司會議後 14 日 內舉行；notice 同時發出 + Gazette + 中英文報章各一次；違反可致 liquidation invalid。 s.242 : creditors 提名 liquidator 優先於 members' nominee（7 日內可向法院申請裁定）。 s.235(1) : members' voluntary — liquidator 由 members ordinary resolution 委任； s.237A(1) : liquidator 認為還唔切債 → summon creditors' meeting。 s.229(1) : resolution 14 日內 Gazette 公告； s.230 : voluntary winding up commenced at passing of resolution； s.231 : 停業（beneficial winding up 除外）； s.253 : liquidator 21 日內公告委任； s.255A : 帳目須審計。 s.227 : court order dissolution； s.226A : 註冊證明書後 2 年自動解散； s.752 : 剩餘資產 bona vacantia 歸政府。 Liquidator 移除 : ss.196(1) & 252（court, on cause shown）；voluntary 另可 s.235A(1) special resolution / s.235A(2) court；resignation s.194(1) + CWUR (Cap.32H) Rules 154–155。 B. Leading Cases (full citations 以 LP 為準) Case Principle Ebrahimi v Westbourne Galleries Ltd (1973) AC 360 Just & equitable winding up：quasi partnership 小公司，股東被踢出管理層、合理期望受挫 → 清盤令；legal rights 受制於 equitable considerations Re ePlaza Ltd (unreported) HCCW 1122/2002 Statutory demand 下 debt 有 genuine dispute → petition dismissed；deemed insolvency 可被推翻 Re Wah Nam Group Ltd (unreported, 26 July 2000) HCCW 166/2000 Cash flow test + balance sheet test 雙軌判斷 unable to pay debts Yeung Siu Ming v Man Lung Textiles Ltd (2018) HKCA 521 Registered shareholder 即有 standing 呈請；實益擁有與否無關 Golden Gate International Kindergarten and Nursery Ltd (2018) HKCFI 641 股東貸款以「公司盈利」為還款條件 → 永遠唔會 provable → petitioner 非 contingent creditor，無 standing Forsyth v Blundell (1973) 129 CLR 477 Mortgagee/receiver duty of good faith：已知有人肯出高價仍私下低價賣 = breach Tse Kwong Lam v Wong Chit Sen (1983) 3 All ER 54 (PC) 賣俾自己有利益嘅公司非絕對禁止，但須證明 good faith + reasonable precautions 取得 best price（應取 expert advice on method of sale & reserve price） Downsview Nominees Ltd v First City Corp Ltd (1993) AC 295 (PC) Receiver 接受委任目的係阻撓另一 chargee 執行 → breach of good faith & proper purpose Super Master Holdings Ltd v Chung Nam Securities Ltd (unreported, 26 March 2004) HCA 4573/2003 Mortgagee（同理 receiver）可為自身利益行使 power of sale，唔係 trustee；但須 good faith + reasonable care 取得 true market value Re Tyler (1907) 1 KB 865 Court appointed receiver 係 officer of the court，須 act lawfully + fairly + honourably（high mindedness） Macau First Universal International Ltd v Ding Xiaohong (No 2) (2012) 2 HKLRD 494 Court 唔會輕易撤換自己嘅 officer；honestly done his best 而任務 onerous → slow to remove Achieve Goal Holdings Ltd v Zhong Xin Ore Material Holding Co Ltd (2018) HKCFI 2718 Court receiver 對各方 impartial；unfitness/forfeit of confidence 先撤換；申請人負舉證責任 Liquidator of Almond Ltd v Cheong Chan Kao (2019) HKCFI 634 Unfair preference：提前還有董事擔保嘅銀行貸款 → inferred desire to prefer（objective test + subjective desire） Aktieselskabet Dansk Skibsfinansiering v Brothers (2000) 3 HKCFAR 70, (2000) 1 HKC 511 Fraudulent trading 須 actual dishonesty；honest belief 母公司會打救 → 唔算 fraud，即使客觀上存活機會低 Advance Housing Pty Ltd (in liq) v Newcastle Classic Development Pty Ltd (1994) 14 ACSR 230 Liquidator 係 fiduciary：自己 firm 收過公司錢又要查 unfair preference = inherent conflict Re Rainbow Gate Ltd (unreported, 20 December 2007) HCCW 593/1998 / Re Action Industrial (Intl) Ltd (unreported, 2 December 2009) HCCW 35/2007 Liquidator 違 statutory duties（唔交帳、唔將款項存入 companies liquidation account、拖唔做）→ removed Re Carrian Holdings Ltd (in liq) (No 2) (1984) 1 HKC 598 Disclaimer of onerous property 可被拒絕（如有 indemnity 令第三方嚴重受損） C. IRAC Application Points（答題骨架） Issue spotting : 分清 scenario 係 receivership（secured creditor 自救，公司未死）、provisional liquidation（petition 後 interim 保護）、定 winding up（公司終局）。考官伏位：deregistration ≠ liquidation；receivership ≠ liquidation。 Rule selection : 先問 (1) 邊條 route — compulsory (s.177) / members' voluntary (s.233 COS) / creditors' voluntary (s.233(4))；(2) 涉事條文 pinpoint 到 subsection。 Application : 時間線最緊要 — 計返 commencement date（compulsory = petition presentation, s.184(2)；voluntary = resolution, s.230），再數 6 個月 / 2 年（unfair preference）、12 個月（floating charge s.267）、3 年（extortionate credit s.264B）。 Conclusion : 要果斷 — 「the floating charge is liable to be set aside」「the liquidator should be removed」；引用 case 做 analogy（考評報告多次批評漏引 case law）。 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Compulsory Winding up vs Members' Voluntary vs Creditors' Voluntary 項目 Compulsory (s.177) Members' Voluntary Creditors' Voluntary 發動者 Court order on petition（creditor/contributory/company/SFC 等） Members（special resolution） Members 發動，creditors 主導 公司狀態 通常 insolvent Solvent （directors 簽 s.233 certificate of solvency，12 個月內還清） Insolvent / 無 COS (s.233(4)) Liquidator 委任 Court；OR 先做 provisional liquidator (s.194(1)(a)) Members ordinary resolution (s.235(1)) Creditors 提名優先 (s.242) Commencement Petition presentation (s.184(2)) — relation back Passing of resolution (s.230) Passing of resolution (s.230) 自動 stay / void dispositions 有 (ss.182, 186) 無 無 點樣分辨 睇 scenario：有冇 petition/court order？有冇 certificate of solvency？無 COS 嘅 voluntary 一定係 creditors' 考試伏位 「Solvent 公司股東想結束」→ members' voluntary，唔係 deregistration/just & equitable；CVWU 漏發 creditors' meeting notice → liquidation invalid (s.241) Table 2: Privately Appointed Receiver vs Court appointed Receiver vs Liquidator 項目 Private Receiver Court appointed Receiver Liquidator 委任來源 Debenture/appointment instrument Court order（HCO s.21L / CWUMPO s.725 / inherent） Court / creditors / members 身份 Agent of debtor company（「only non fiduciary agent」），唔係 court officer Officer of the court Fiduciary of the company 首要職責對象 Appointor debenture holder 嘅利益（good faith + proper purpose） All interested parties ，lawfully + fairly + honourably (Re Tyler) 公司 + 全體 creditors/contributories，impartial 目的 執行抵押、收返 secured assets（公司仍可生存） 保護/保存資產 pending proceedings 變賣全部資產、分派、解散公司 終止 目的達成 / appointor 隨時撤換 / resignation 只可由 court discharge（除非 order 有期限）；court 唔輕易撤換 (Macau First) ss.196(1)/252 court remove on cause shown；s.235A 點樣分辨 睇邊個委任 + 目的係咪「保債權人收返抵押品」定「結束公司」 考試伏位 Receiver 唔使為公司整體利益行事（Downsview 唯一紅線：good faith/proper purpose）；但 court receiver 標準高好多，唔好混淆兩套 duty Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: What are the six grounds for compulsory winding up under s.177 CWUMPO? Back: Special resolution resolving to be wound up by the court No commencement of business within 1 year of incorporation, or suspension for a whole year (plus no intention to recommence) Company has no members Company is unable to pay its debts (s.178(1): statutory demand ≥HK$10,000 unpaid for 21 days; unsatisfied execution; proof to court) Event specified in articles for dissolution occurs Just and equitable (Ebrahimi v Westbourne Galleries Ltd (1973) AC 360) 💬 記「六大死因」：自己話要死、冇開過工、冇股東、還唔到錢、章程話到期、法庭覺得唔公道。考試最常考 (4) 同 (6)。 Card 2 Front: How do members' voluntary winding up and creditors' voluntary winding up differ? Back: Dividing line = solvency: directors sign a certificate of solvency (s.233) → members'; no COS (s.233(4)) → creditors' COS: full enquiry; opinion debts payable in full within 12 months ; issued within 5 weeks before the members' resolution; filed with Registrar within 15 days (s.117(1)) Creditors' VWU: creditors' meeting within 14 days of the company meeting; notice simultaneous + Gazette + one English & one Chinese newspaper (s.241); creditors' nominee for liquidator prevails (s.242) Members' VWU: liquidator appointed by ordinary resolution (s.235(1)) 💬 分界線就係嗰張「償債證明書」：有 = 股東話事；冇 = 債權人話事。記住 12 個月、5 星期、14 日三個數字。 Card 3 Front: What are the elements of an unfair preference liable to be invalidated under ss.266/266B CWUMPO? Back: Given to a creditor / surety / guarantor, putting them in a better position on winding up (s.50(3) BO) Within 6 months before commencement of winding up — 2 years if an associate (ss.266(1), 266B(1)(b); s.51(1) BO) Company influenced by a desire to prefer (s.266(4); s.50(4) BO) Company insolvent at the time or made insolvent by it (s.266B(2); s.51(2) BO) Examples: repaying unsecured creditor; granting security for pre existing debt; undervalued transaction with existing creditor (Liquidator of Almond Ltd v Cheong Chan Kao (2019) HKCFI 634) NOT preferences: security for a new loan/creditor; paying secured creditor up to security value 💬 口訣「更好位置 + 有心偏幫 + 已經資不抵債 + 六個月內（自己人兩年）」。新貸款嘅抵押唔算，因為公司攞到對價。 Card 4 Front: What must be proved for fraudulent trading liability under s.275(1) CWUMPO, and what are the consequences? Back: Elements: (1) business carried on; (2) with intent to defraud creditors or for a fraudulent purpose; (3) defendant knowingly a party Actual dishonesty required — continuing to trade with no reasonable prospect of paying creditors is NOT enough by itself (Aktieselskabet Dansk Skibsfinansiering v Brothers (2000) 3 HKCFAR 70) Dishonesty = defendant knows the conduct is dishonest by standards of reasonable/honest people Civil: personally liable for all/any debts as court directs (no limit); Criminal: up to 5 years' imprisonment + fine 💬 考試伏位：「明知冇希望仲繼續做生意」本身唔等於 fraudulent trading，一定要證到主觀不誠實。Dansk 案董事真心信母公司會救 → 甩身。 Card 5 Front: State the order of distribution of free assets in a winding up. Back: 1. Costs & expenses of liquidation incl. liquidator's remuneration (s.265(4)) 2. Preferential creditors (s.265(1)) — employees' wages/severance/long service, MPF/ORSO, government debts, bank depositors (≤HK$500,000), insurance claims 3. Landlords who distrained goods within 3 months before the order (ss.265(5)/(5A)) 4. Ordinary unsecured creditors pari passu (provable debts, s.263) 5. Statutory interest (s.264A) 6. Non provable debts 7. Contributories: return of share capital, then surplus 💬 記住 fixed charge 資產完全唔入 pool；floating charge 資產要 先畀 preferential creditors 先輪到 floating chargee (s.265(3B))。呢個係最常考嘅 priority 陷阱。 Card 6 Front: What are a privately appointed receiver's duties and to whom are they owed? Back: Primary duty: realise charged assets for the benefit of the appointor debenture holder (contractual, per appointment instrument) Equitable duty of good faith & proper purpose — no wilful/reckless sacrifice of the security holder's interests (Forsyth v Blundell (1973) 129 CLR 477; Downsview Nominees v First City Corp (1993) AC 295 (PC)) Duty of reasonable care — obtain proper price; take professional advice on method of sale & reserve (Tse Kwong Lam v Wong Chit Sen (1983) 3 All ER 54); higher price obtainable ≠ automatic breach Duty to provide information: common law 'need to know' + s.300A CWUMPO Not a trustee of the power of sale; may prefer own/appointor's interest if acting in good faith (Super Master Holdings v Chung Nam Securities, HCA 4573/2003) 💬 Private receiver 係「唯一唔使對公司盡 fiduciary duty 嘅 agent」，佢嘅老闆係抵押權人；但唔可以為整垮公司而做嘢。 Card 7 Front: On what bases may a liquidator be removed, and under which sections? Back: Court may remove in compulsory AND voluntary winding up: ss.196(1) & 252 — "on cause shown" Causes: misconduct; personal unfitness; breach of statutory/fiduciary/other duties; lack of vigour; failure to proceed with reasonable expedition (Re Kaypak Homecare Ltd (1987) BCLC 409; Re Rainbow Gate Ltd HCCW 593/1998; Re Action Industrial (Intl) Ltd HCCW 35/2007) Voluntary only: special resolution of members (s.235A(1)) or court on creditor/contributory application (s.235A(2)) Resignation: s.194(1) + CWUR Rules 154–155 (creditors'/contributories' meetings, then court if refused) Serious cases: damages under s.276 💬 撤換 liquidator 門檻係 "cause shown"；違法定職責（唔入帳、唔交報告）+ 利益衝突 + 拖足幾年唔做 = 必炒，Apply and Analyse 3 就係咁。 Card 8 Front: What is the effect of a winding up petition/order on dispositions and proceedings, and how can a company continue trading? Back: Winding up deemed to commence at presentation of petition (s.184(2)) Any disposition of property after commencement is void unless the court orders otherwise (s.182) — covers sale, lease, charge, gift, loan, liens On the winding up order, no action commenced/continued against the company without leave of court (s.186); provisional liquidator appointment also triggers a stay Directors' powers cease upon appointment of provisional liquidator/liquidator Company should apply for a validating order for payments in the ordinary course (e.g. salaries); refused if insolvent and trading would deplete assets further Title to assets stays with the company (no real trust; vesting order possible under s.198) 💬 關鍵係 relation back：order 3 月先做，但 commencement 計返 12 月入紙嗰日。s.182 先係點解 petition 一出公司戶口即凍結、要攞 validating order 出糧。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Provisional liquidator 正式清盤令前暫時接管公司、防止資產被掏空嘅人 The court appointed a provisional liquidator to safeguard ITL's assets pending the hearing of the winding up petition. Certificate of solvency 董事簽嘅聲明，話公司 12 個月內還得晒啲債 The directors issued a certificate of solvency under s.233, so the winding up proceeded as a members' voluntary winding up. Unfair preference 清盤前偏幫某個債權人，令佢著數過其他人 The repayment to the director's wife two months before the petition was set aside as an unfair preference under ss.266 and 266B. Fraudulent trading 存心呃債權人咁繼續做生意，個人要孭返啲債 The director was held personally liable for fraudulent trading under s.275(1) because he knowingly carried on business to defraud creditors. Validation order 法庭批嘅命令，令 petition 後嘅正常付款唔會被推翻 The company obtained a validation order so that employees' salaries could continue to be paid after the petition was presented. Preferential creditors 法定排頭位攞錢嘅債權人（員工、政府、存戶等） Employees' unpaid wages rank as preferential debts under s.265(1), ahead of the floating chargee. Disclaimer of onerous property 清盤官放棄啲蝕本資產／合約嘅權力 The liquidator disclaimed the loss making joint venture agreement as onerous property under s.268. Pari passu 同級債權人按比例平分 Ordinary unsecured creditors are paid pari passu from the remaining free assets.

title: M10 Chapter 13: Receivership, Liquidation and Winding-up — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M10 Chapter 13: Receivership, Liquidation and Winding-up — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M10 Chapter 13: Receivership, Liquidation and Winding up — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under s.177 of the Companies (Winding Up and Miscel…
text: M10 Chapter 13: Receivership, Liquidation and Winding up — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under s.177 of the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap.32), the six grounds on which the court may make a winding up order are: (1) the company has by special resolution resolved to be wound up by the court; (2) the company has not commenced business within a year of incorporation or has suspended business for a whole year (with no intention of recommencing); (3) the company has no members; (4) the company is unable to pay its debts; (5) an event specified in the articles for dissolution has occurred; and (6) it is just and equitable to wind up the company (Ebrahimi v Westbourne Galleries Ltd (1973) AC 360). A "net liability position for two consecutive financial years" is not a statutory ground. It may, however, be evidence supporting ground (4) under the balance sheet test (Re Wah Nam Group Ltd (unreported, 26 July 2000) HCCW 166/2000), but it is not itself a free standing ground. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係純 recall，考你背唔背到 s.177 六大 grounds。Distractor 設計：D 係最常見伏位 — 學生會將「balance sheet test 下資不抵債」同「s.177 法定 ground」混淆。資產負債表連續兩年淨負債只係證明 unable to pay debts 嘅 證據方法 ，唔係獨立 ground。A、B、C 都係 s.177 明寫嘅 ground（B 記住仲要證明無意復業）。考試伏位：默寫 grounds 時唔好漏咗 ground (5)（articles 指定事件），亦要分清 s.177（grounds）同 s.178(1)（deemed inability to pay debts 嘅三種情況）。 Rule Check: Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap.32) s.177; s.178(1); Re Wah Nam Group Ltd (unreported, 26 July 2000) HCCW 166/2000; Ebrahimi v Westbourne Galleries Ltd (1973) AC 360 Common Trap（繁中）: 將 insolvency tests（cash flow / balance sheet）當成獨立清盤 ground — 佢哋只係證明 ground (4) 嘅工具；答案字眼要精準："unable to pay its debts" 先係 ground。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A members' voluntary winding up is only available where the company is solvent. The directors must issue a certificate of solvency under s.233 of the CWUMPO, having made full enquiry into the company's affairs, stating their opinion that the company will be able to pay its debts in full within 12 months of the commencement of the winding up. The certificate must be issued within the five weeks preceding the members' resolution for winding up, and the certificate and resolution must be filed with the Registrar within 15 days after the resolution (s.117(1)). Option A is wrong: the 14 day creditors' meeting requirement (s.241(1)) applies to a creditors' voluntary winding up. Option C is wrong: in a members' voluntary winding up the liquidator is appointed by the members by ordinary resolution (s.235(1)); the creditors' nomination priority (s.242) applies only to creditors' voluntary winding up. Option D misstates both the solvency period (12, not 24 months) and the timing of the certificate (before, not after, the resolution). 解題思路（繁中）: 分界線係 solvency：有 certificate of solvency (s.233) = members' VWU；冇 (s.233(4)) = creditors' VWU。三個必背數字：12 個月還債期、resolution 前 5 星期內發證明、15 日內交 Registrar。A 同 C 都係 creditors' VWU 嘅程序（s.241 十四日內開債權人會議、s.242 債權人提名優先），故意搬過嚟做 distractor — 考試最鍾意考「邊條程序屬邊種清盤」。D 玩數字+時間方向（after vs preceding）。 Rule Check: Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap.32) ss.233, 233(4), 235(1), 241(1), 242; filing per s.117(1) as cited in the LP Common Trap（繁中）: 以為 voluntary winding up 一定使開 creditors' meeting — 只有 creditors' VWU 先要；members' VWU 只有當 liquidator 認為還唔切債時先要召開 (s.237A(1))，屆時更可轉軚做 compulsory。 Q3 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Issue: Whether transactions (i) and (ii) are liable to be invalidated as unfair preferences. Rule: Under ss.266 and 266B of the CWUMPO (importing ss.50(3)/(4) and 51(1)/(2) of the Bankruptcy Ordinance (Cap.6)), a transaction is voidable as an unfair preference if: (1) it puts a creditor/surety/guarantor in a better position than on a winding up; (2) it was made within six months before the commencement of the winding up, or two years if the person preferred is an associate (ss.265B–265C); (3) the company was influenced by a desire to prefer; and (4) the company was insolvent at the time or made insolvent by it. The winding up is deemed to commence at the presentation of the petition, i.e. 1 June (s.184(2)). Application: Transaction (ii) (1 April) falls within six months of 1 June; granting security for a pre existing unsecured debt is a classic unfair preference, and the desire to prefer is evident from the company's response to the bank's pressure (cf. Liquidator of Almond Ltd v Cheong Chan Kao (2019) HKCFI 634). Transaction (i) (1 March) is more than six months before commencement, but the managing director's wife is an associate, so the two year period applies; early repayment of a not yet due unsecured loan to an associate puts her in a better position, and a desire to prefer is readily inferred. Conclusion: Both transactions can be challenged by the liquidator. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考三個嘢疊埋一齊：(1) relation back — commencement 計 petition presentation (1 June)，唔係 order 日 (15 Aug) (s.184(2))，A 就係中咗呢個伏；(2) 6 個月 vs 2 年 — associate（董事配偶，ss.265B–265C）用兩年窗口，所以 3 月嘅還款都捉得返；B 錯喺以為 (ii) 過期（4 月 → 1 June 得兩個月，明明喺六個月內）；(3) granting security for pre existing debt 係 LP 明寫嘅 unfair preference 例子，而 security for new loan 先唔算 — C 搞錯方向。答題要逐個 element 對返事實：better position + desire + insolvency + timing。 Rule Check: CWUMPO (Cap.32) ss.184(2), 266, 266A, 266B, 265B–265C; Bankruptcy Ordinance (Cap.6) ss.50(3)–(4), 51(1)–(2); Liquidator of Almond Ltd v Cheong Chan Kao (2019) HKCFI 634 Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 用 winding up order 日期計時限；(2) 唔記得 associate 窗口係兩年；(3) 以為「還錢俾自己人」係正常還債 — 未到期就還 + associate + insolvent = 近乎必中 unfair preference。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Issue: Whether Raymond, a privately appointed receiver, breached his duties in selling the charged building. Rule: A privately appointed receiver acts as agent of the debtor company but is "the only non fiduciary agent" — his primary duty is owed to the appointor debenture holder, and he is not a trustee of the power of sale (Super Master Holdings Ltd v Chung Nam Securities Ltd (unreported, 26 March 2004) HCA 4573/2003). However, he owes an equitable duty of good faith and a duty to take reasonable care to obtain the best price reasonably obtainable. A sale to a party in which the mortgagee/appointor is interested is not absolutely prohibited, but the seller must show good faith and that reasonable precautions were taken, including taking expert advice on the method of sale and the reserve price (Tse Kwong Lam v Wong Chit Sen (1983) 3 All ER 54). Ignoring a known higher bidder is a breach of good faith (Forsyth v Blundell (1973) 129 CLR 477). Application: Raymond sold without any valuation or advertisement, to a party connected with his appointor, for HK$5–6 million below market, while ignoring the indicated HK$26 million bidder. He cannot discharge his burden of showing good faith and reasonable precautions. Conclusion: Raymond is likely in breach of his duties; Jade Properties Ltd may challenge the sale. 解題思路（繁中）: 本題核心係 private receiver duty 嘅精確定位。A 係最常見錯誤 — receiver 雖然首要向 appointor 負責，但唔係冇底線：good faith + reasonable care 係硬要求。C 係觀念錯：private receiver 係公司 agent 但 唔係 fiduciary （LP 原話 "the only non fiduciary agent"），佢可以喺利益衝突時優先 appointor，所以用 fiduciary duty 分析係揀錯 rule。D 搬咗 fraudulent trading 嘅 actual dishonesty 標準過嚟 — receiver duty breach 唔使證不誠實，Tse Kwong Lam 案都冇 dishonesty，只係低於 reasonable care 標準。記住口訣：可以賣俾自己人，但要證明 good faith + reasonable precautions（expert advice on method & reserve）。 Rule Check: Tse Kwong Lam v Wong Chit Sen (1983) 3 All ER 54; Forsyth v Blundell (1973) 129 CLR 477; Super Master Holdings Ltd v Chung Nam Securities Ltd (unreported, 26 March 2004) HCA 4573/2003; CWUMPO (Cap.32) s.298A Common Trap（繁中）: 誤以為 receiver 對公司負 full fiduciary duties（C 選項）；又或者以為「幫債權人收返錢」就免責（A 選項）。另一伏位：receiver 對第三方合同負 personal liability 但有 statutory indemnity (s.298A(2)) — 唔好同 breach of duty 嘅責任撈埋。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Issue: Whether Daniel is liable for fraudulent trading under s.275(1) of the CWUMPO. Rule: Fraudulent trading requires: (1) the carrying on of the company's business; (2) with intent to defraud creditors or for a fraudulent purpose; and (3) the defendant being knowingly a party. Actual dishonesty must be established: a person is dishonest if he acts in a way he knows to be dishonest by the standards of reasonable and honest people. Crucially, continuing to trade where there is no reasonable prospect of creditors being paid is not by itself fraudulent; something more — e.g. misrepresentation to creditors or dishonest intent for personal advantage — is needed (Aktieselskabet Dansk Skibsfinansiering v Brothers (2000) 3 HKCFAR 70, (2000) 1 HKC 511). Application: Daniel honestly relied on a signed letter of intent after weeks of negotiation; the injection failed only because the fund withdrew, an event outside his control. His honest belief that the company could trade through is inconsistent with fraud, even if objectively the prospect of survival was low. Conclusion: Daniel is not liable for fraudulent trading. (Had the elements been made out, he would face personal liability for the company's debts without limit and criminal liability of up to five years' imprisonment.) 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 hard tier，直擊考評報告批評嘅弱點 — 學生見「資不抵債仲繼續落單」就即刻答 fraudulent trading。A 係呢個錯誤嘅化身：Dansk v Brothers 明講 "no reasonable prospect" 本身 唔等於 fraud，客觀上存活率極低都唔否定 honest belief。B 錯在將 s.275(1) 講成 strict liability — 佢係要主觀欺詐意圖嘅嚴重指控（所以有刑事後果，最高監禁 5 年）。D 係無中生有 — creditor protection / chain of causation 喺 s.275 完全唔係 defence。正確答法係行足 IRAC：先講三個 element + dishonesty test，再 apply honest belief（letter of intent = 合理依據），conclusion 斬釘截鐵話唔成立。 Rule Check: Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap.32) s.275(1); Aktieselskabet Dansk Skibsfinansiering v Brothers (2000) 3 HKCFAR 70, (2000) 1 HKC 511 Common Trap（繁中）: 「繼續交易 + 冇合理還款希望 = fraud」係錯嘅推論 — 仲要有 misrepresentation、dishonest personal gain 等加碼事實先會推論到 fraud。答題時記住 civil + criminal 雙重後果，conclusion 先至有說服力。

text: M10 Chapter 13: Receivership, Liquidation and Winding up — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Which of the following is NOT a statutory ground on which the court may order the compulsory winding up of a company under s.177 of the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap.32)? A. The company has, by special resolution, resolved that it be wound up by the court. B. The company has suspended its business for a whole year and has no intention of recommencing. C. The company is unable to pay its debts. D. The company's audited financial statements show a net liability position for two consecutive financial years. Q2. Harvest Trading Ltd is solvent. Its directors wish to close the company down by a members' voluntary winding up. Which of the following statements about the required procedure is correct ? A. The directors must convene a meeting of creditors within 14 days after the members' meeting at which the winding up resolution is proposed. B. The directors must issue a certificate of solvency, stating their opinion that the company can pay its debts in full within 12 months of the commencement of the winding up, issued within the five weeks preceding the members' resolution. C. The liquidator must be nominated by the creditors, whose choice prevails over the members' nominee. D. The certificate of solvency must state that the company can pay its debts in full within 24 months of the commencement of the winding up, and must be issued within five weeks after the members' resolution. Q3. Marble Design Ltd was wound up by the court. The winding up petition was presented on 1 June, and the winding up order was made on 15 August. The liquidator discovers the following transactions, both entered into while Marble Design Ltd was already insolvent: (i) On 1 March, the company repaid in full an unsecured loan of HK$400,000 owed to the wife of its managing director, although the loan was not yet due; (ii) On 1 April, the company granted its bank a floating charge over all its assets as security for a pre existing, previously unsecured overdraft, in response to the bank's threat to demand immediate repayment. No new money was advanced. Which of the following is the best analysis of the liquidator's position? A. Neither transaction can be challenged, because both were entered into more than 21 days before the winding up order was made. B. Only transaction (i) can be challenged as an unfair preference, because the two year look back period applies to associates, whereas the six month period for transaction (ii) has expired. C. Only transaction (ii) can be challenged, because repayment of a loan to a director's spouse is a legitimate discharge of the company's liability and cannot be a preference. D. Both transactions can potentially be challenged as unfair preferences: the winding up is deemed to have commenced on 1 June (presentation of the petition), transaction (ii) falls within the six month period, and transaction (i) falls within the extended two year period because the managing director's wife is an associate. Q4. Jade Properties Ltd granted Bank K a debenture secured by a charge over its office building. On default, Bank K privately appointed Raymond, an accountant, as receiver. Raymond promptly sold the building by private treaty to a company owned by Bank K's holding company for HK$20 million, without obtaining any independent valuation, without advertising the sale, and despite a neighbouring owner having earlier indicated to Raymond that he was prepared to bid HK$26 million. The building's market value was approximately HK$25 million. Jade Properties Ltd now complains. Which of the following is the best analysis of Raymond's position? A. Raymond is not in breach of any duty, because a privately appointed receiver owes duties only to his appointor, Bank K, and the sale discharged the secured debt. B. Raymond is likely in breach of his duties: although he may sell to a party connected with the appointor, he must act in good faith and take reasonable precautions to obtain the best price reasonably obtainable, including taking expert advice on the method of sale — which he failed to do by ignoring the indicated higher bidder. C. Raymond is in breach of his fiduciary duty to Jade Properties Ltd, because a receiver, as the company's agent, owes full fiduciary duties to the company and must subordinate the appointor's interests to the company's interests. D. Raymond is in breach of duty only if Jade Properties Ltd can prove that he acted with actual dishonesty or fraudulent intent. Q5. Golden Wok Holdings Ltd operated a chain of restaurants. In September, it was in severe cash flow difficulty and owed several suppliers substantial sums. Its director, Daniel, signed a letter of intent with a private equity fund which, after weeks of negotiation, indicated it would inject HK$30 million. Genuinely relying on the imminent injection, Daniel caused the company to accept further supplies on credit in October. The fund then abruptly withdrew from the deal for its own commercial reasons, the injection never materialised, and the company was wound up in December, unable to pay the suppliers. The liquidator commences fraudulent trading proceedings against Daniel under s.275(1) of the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap.32). Which of the following is the best analysis of Daniel's liability? A. Daniel is liable for fraudulent trading, because he continued to incur credit when there was no reasonable prospect of the suppliers ever being paid. B. Daniel is liable for fraudulent trading, because s.275(1) imposes strict liability on directors who cause an insolvent company to incur further debts. C. Daniel is not liable for fraudulent trading, because liability requires actual dishonesty measured against the standards of reasonable and honest people; his honest belief that the fund injection would materialise is inconsistent with fraud, even if the objective likelihood of survival was low. D. Daniel is not liable for fraudulent trading because the suppliers could have protected themselves by demanding cash on delivery; their failure to do so breaks the chain of liability.

excerpt: M6 Chapter 1: Financial Reporting Framework — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the objective of general purpose financial rep…
text: M6 Chapter 1: Financial Reporting Framework — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the objective of general purpose financial reporting and the qualitative characteristics of useful financial information under the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting (2018). 2. Define the elements of financial statements (assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses) and apply the recognition and derecognition criteria of the Conceptual Framework. 3. Distinguish between the measurement bases (historical cost, current cost, fair value, value in use / fulfilment value) and the two concepts of capital maintenance. 4. Describe the financial reporting framework in Hong Kong, including the regulatory bodies, the HKFRS standard setting due process, and the hierarchy of mandatory vs non mandatory pronouncements. 5. Identify the eligibility conditions for adopting the HK SME FRF / HK SME FRS and the HKFRS for Private Entities. 必背考點 A. Objective & Qualitative Characteristics（概念框架嘅根基） Objective of general purpose financial reporting (HKFRS CF 1.2–1.11) Provide useful financial information about the entity to primary users (existing and potential investors, lenders and other creditors) for decisions relating to providing resources to the entity (buying/selling/holding instruments, providing or settling loans, voting on management's actions). 用戶需要評估：(1) prospects for future net cash inflows；(2) management's stewardship of the entity's economic resources。 Qualitative characteristics Characteristic 內容 Reference Relevance (fundamental) Capable of making a difference in decisions; has predictive value , confirmatory value , or both; materiality is an entity specific aspect of relevance HKFRS CF 2.6–2.11 Faithful representation (fundamental) Complete + Neutral + Free from error ; substance over form; measurement uncertainty does not undermine usefulness if estimates are clearly described and explained HKFRS CF 2.12–2.22 Comparability (enhancing) The goal ; consistency (same methods period to period) helps achieve it; comparability ≠ uniformity HKFRS CF 2.24–2.29 Verifiability (enhancing) Different knowledgeable and independent observers reach the same/similar conclusion; direct (count cash) or indirect (recalculate inputs) HKFRS CF 2.30–2.32 Timeliness (enhancing) Available in time to influence decisions HKFRS CF 2.33 Understandability (enhancing) Clear and concise classification/presentation; users assumed to have reasonable business knowledge HKFRS CF 2.34–2.36 Cost constraint Benefits of reporting information must justify the costs of providing and using it HKFRS CF 2.39–2.43 💬 記住：enhancing characteristics 唔可以 將 irrelevant 或唔 faithful 嘅資訊變成 useful —— 兩個 fundamental characteristics 係必要條件。Prudence = exercise of caution under uncertainty， 唔准 overstate 亦唔准 understate assets/income/liabilities/expenses（考試伏位！）。 B. Recognition（要素定義 + 確認/終止確認準則） Elements — definitions (HKFRS CF 4.3–4.25; 4.68–4.69) Element Definition 三大測試 / 關鍵點 Asset A present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events (1) Right；(2) Potential to produce economic benefits（唔需要 certain 甚至唔需要 likely）；(3) Control = present ability to direct the use and obtain the benefits。員工服務 唔係 asset，因為冇 control（員工可以隨時走） Liability A present obligation of the entity to transfer an economic resource as a result of past events (1) Obligation = no practical ability to avoid；(2) Obligation to transfer an economic resource；(3) Present obligation exists as a result of a past event Equity Residual interest in assets after deducting all liabilities Claims that do not meet the definition of a liability（例如 ordinary shares） Income Increases in assets or decreases in liabilities resulting in increases in equity, other than contributions from holders of equity claims HKFRS CF 4.68 Expenses Decreases in assets or increases in liabilities resulting in decreases in equity, other than distributions to holders of equity HKFRS CF 4.69。Dividend 係 distribution → 直接扣 equity， 唔係 expense（常見伏位） Executory contract (HKFRS CF 4.56–4.58) A contract that is equally unperformed : neither party has performed, or both have partially performed to an equal extent 。 一旦只有一方履行咗，合約就唔再係 executory —— 先履行嗰方產生 asset（e.g. trade receivable）；另一方產生 liability（e.g. contract liability）。 Recognition criteria (HKFRS CF 5.6–5.23) Recognition = capturing an item that meets the definition of an element, in words and by a monetary amount, in the statement of financial position or statement(s) of financial performance。 An asset or liability is recognised only if recognition provides: (i) relevant information ；AND (ii) a faithful representation 。 Relevance 受 existence uncertainty （e.g. 權利存在與否有爭議）同 low probability of inflow/outflow 影響；faithful representation 受 measurement uncertainty （e.g. cash flow based techniques with exceptionally wide range of outcomes）影響。 Cost constraint 同樣適用：cost of recognising 唔可以大過 benefits。 Derecognition = mirror image of recognition：當 item 唔再符合 asset/liability 定義時，從 statement of financial position 移除。 💬 呢一章冇 journal entries；考試重心係 definition → recognition 嘅兩層分析：先問「符唔符合 element 定義？」，再問「recognition 會唔會提供 relevant + faithfully represented 嘅資訊？」兩關都過先 confirm 落賬。 Going concern assumption (HKFRS CF 3.2–3.3) 唯一 underlying assumption：entity 會喺 foreseeable future（實務上 12 個月）繼續經營，冇意圖亦冇需要 liquidate 或 cease trading。唔成立 → 可能要用另一個 basis 編製（e.g. 唔係 accrual basis）。 Reporting entity (HKFRS CF 3.9–3.14) Boundary 可以是：a single entity / a portion of an entity (e.g. a division) / more than one entity。 多於一個 entity → consolidated （parent + subsidiaries）/ unconsolidated （parent alone）/ combined （非 parent subsidiary 關係嘅組合）。 C. Measurement（計量基礎） Two categories of measurement basis (HKFRS CF Chapter 6) Basis 定義要點 Entry / Exit value Transaction costs Reference Historical cost Asset：取得時付出嘅代價（consideration paid + transaction costs）；Liability：收到嘅代價 − transaction costs Entry value Included HKFRS CF 6.4–6.9 Current cost 於 measurement date 購入同等 item 要付嘅金額 Entry value Included HKFRS CF 6.21–6.22 Fair value Price received to sell an asset (paid to transfer a liability) in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date Exit value — market participants' perspective Not adjusted HKFRS CF 6.12–6.16 Value in use (asset) / Fulfilment value (liability) Entity specific discounted cash flows expected from using/disposing the asset（或履行 liability 要 transfer 嘅貼現現金流） Exit value — entity specific assumptions Not adjusted HKFRS CF 6.17–6.20 選擇 measurement basis 由 relevance + faithful representation 驅動；historical cost 常用因為 objective and verifiable；fair value 可能更 relevant 但無 active market quote 時較 subjective。 Concepts of capital (HKFRS CF 8.3) Financial concept of capital Physical concept of capital Capital = Net assets (equity) of the entity Productive capacity (e.g. units of output per day) Profit earned if Money amount of net assets increased during the period Physical productive capacity increased during the period 共同點 都要 exclude distributions to and contributions from owners 同上 D. Presentation and Disclosure（表達與披露原則） Three communication principles (HKFRS CF 7.4–7.6, 7.7–7.19, 7.20–7.22) 1. Focus on presentation and disclosure objectives and principles rather than rules — 避免 boilerplate（標準化罐頭描述）同 duplication。 2. Classify information：group similar items, separate dissimilar items，按 nature / role or function / measurement basis 分類。 3. Aggregate appropriately：唔可以因 unnecessary detail 或 excessive aggregation 而 obscure 資訊。 E. Hong Kong Framework & Regulatory Bodies HKFRS 由 HKICPA 發佈，modelled after IFRS，自 2005 年起 fully converged（有少量例外）；HKFRS = HKFRS + HKAS + Interpretations（HK(IFRIC) Int, HK Int, HK(SIC) Int），全部 mandatory on HKICPA members。 IFRS 係 principles based （要 professional judgement）；U.S. GAAP 係 rules based。 Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) ：Part 9 'Accounts and Audits' 及 Schedule 4 規定財務報表編製；香港註冊公司必須按 HKICPA 頒佈嘅 accounting standards（即 HKFRS）編製財務報表 (Preface para 25A)；s.359 規定 SME reporting exemption 條件；s.383 規定 directors' remuneration 披露（AB 3 提供指引）。 上市公司 （HKEX）可用 HKFRS、IFRS 或 CASBE（限內地企業）編製。Main Board：interim + annual reports；GEM：quarterly + interim + annual。 監管機構 ：Companies Registry（執行 Cap. 622，true and fair view + directors' report business review）；HKEX（listing rules）；HKICPA（唯一法定 CPA 註冊及執業證書簽發機構，依 Professional Accountants Ordinance 運作）；SFC（證券期貨市場、takeovers and mergers，Securities and Futures Ordinance）；AFRC（依 Financial Reporting Council Ordinance 成立嘅獨立法定機構，監察上市實體財務匯報質素、調查核數師違規）。 Standard setting due process (Preface para 27–28) ：FRSC 負責制訂、ROB 提供策略建議；新準則前要發 exposure draft（附 basis for conclusions）公開諮詢，有 comment period —— IFRS 唔會 自動成為 HKFRS。 AGs（Preface para 14） ：guidance statements、best practice，非強制但 normally should be followed，須 Council 批准（e.g. AG 1 Incomplete Records）。 ABs（Preface para 34–36） ：FRSC 發佈嘅 topical 刊物，非強制， 唔需要 Council 批准（e.g. AB 3 Directors' Remuneration, AB 5 Business Review under Cap. 622）。 F. HK SME FRF / HK SME FRS（Cap. 622 s.359） 公司類型（HK SME FRF para. 22–26） ：只限 private company （成員 ≤ 50、股份轉讓受限、禁止公開招股）或 company limited by guarantee （無股本）。 Ineligible businesses（HK SME FRF para. 27） ：持牌進行 SFO Part V 受規管業務；接受附息或溢價償還嘅貸款（放債）；banking business；insurance business。 Size tests（HK SME FRF para. 28–43） Type Size test Shareholders' approval Small guarantee company Total annual revenue ≤ HK$25 million Not required Small private company 三項中 唔超過任何兩項 ：revenue ≤ HK$100m；total assets ≤ HK$100m；employees ≤ 100 Not required Larger 'eligible' private company 三項中唔超過任何兩項：revenue ≤ HK$200m；total assets ≤ HK$200m；employees ≤ 100 ≥75% of all members 通過決議 AND 其餘 voting rights 無人反對 Private company（無 subsidiaries，亦唔係別人嘅 subsidiary） No limit 100% shareholders agree（每年） Two year rule ：連續兩年符合 size tests 先合資格；連續兩年唔符合先失去資格。 Benefits（HK SME FRF） ：simpler and briefer；less disclosure（ 唔使 cash flow statement）； 豁免 true and fair view （只需 comply with SME FRF/FRS）；directors' report 唔使 business review。 HK SME FRS 要點 ：accrual basis，但 唔准用 fair value （靠 historical cost，para. 20）；PPE 只有 cost model（Section 3）；investment property 當 PPE 處理（Section 4）；intangibles 可反駁推定 useful life ≤ 10 年（Section 9）； deferred tax 唔確認 （Section 14）。 G. HKFRS for Private Entities（HKFRS for PEs） 適用於 do not have public accountability AND publish general purpose financial statements for external users 嘅 entity（Section 1.1–1.4）。 Public accountability （Section 1.6–1.7）：(i) debt/equity instruments 喺公開市場交易；(ii) 正在發行工具準備公開交易（e.g. IPO 申請中）；(iii) 以受託身份為廣大 outsiders 持有資產作為主要業務（banks, insurance companies, securities brokers）。 冇 size tests，冇 shareholders' approval 要求 —— 即使 HK$10 billion assets 都可以合資格。 Group context：parent 用 full HKFRS，subsidiary 自己冇 public accountability 仍可喺 own FS 用 HKFRS for PEs；parent 評估自己 separate FS 資格時唔使理會集團整體。 約 250 頁；measurement 承認 historical cost 和 fair value（Section 2.34）；有 'undue cost or effort' exemption （Section 21.4A/B）。 與 SME FRF 差異（Exhibit 1.15）：cash flow statement required 、statement of changes in equity required；investment property 可用 fair value（如可靠計量）；R&D 全部 expensed；goodwill 無法可靠估計 useful life 時上限 10 年；deferred tax 處理類似 HKAS 12。 易混淆概念對比 對比一：Relevance vs Faithful Representation（兩大 fundamental characteristics） Relevance Faithful Representation 核心問題 資訊會唔會 make a difference 喺用戶決策？ 資訊係咪 如實反映 佢聲稱代表嘅現象？ 組成 Predictive value + Confirmatory value + Materiality（entity specific） Complete + Neutral + Free from error 關鍵子概念 Materiality：omitting/misstating/obscuring 會影響 primary users 決策 Substance over form；prudence 支持 neutrality（唔准兩個方向嘅 bias）；free from error ≠ perfectly accurate Recognition 關卡 Existence uncertainty、low probability of economic benefits → 可能唔 relevant High measurement uncertainty → 可能唔 faithful 點樣分辨／考試伏位 見到「預測將來 / 確認過去估計」= relevance。考生常誤將 completeness、neutral 當 relevance —— 佢哋屬於 faithful representation 「Free from error」唔等於 perfectly accurate（合理估計照樣可以 faithful）；prudence 雙向 ——understate assets 一樣唔准 對比二：HK SME FRF/FRS vs HKFRS for Private Entities HK SME FRF / SME FRS HKFRS for PEs 淵源 HKICPA home grown 本地研製 Modelled after IFRS for SMEs （"SMEs" 改名做 "Private Entities"） Qualifying entities Private / guarantee company + size tests （Cap. 622 s.359）+ 股東批准 （大 eligible 要 ≥75% 且無人反對；非集團私人公司免 size test 要 100%） No public accountability + publish general purpose FS for external users； 冇 size test、冇股東批准 True and fair view 豁免 要公平呈列（依 PEs 準則） Cash flow statement Optional（唔使） Required Measurement Historical cost only， 禁用 fair value Historical cost + fair value 都承認；有 undue cost or effort exemption Deferred tax 不確認 類似 HKAS 12，要確認 Goodwill Useful life ≤ 5 年（更長須每年檢討） 無法可靠估計時上限 10 年 點樣分辨／考試伏位 見到 HK$100m/HK$200m 門檻、75%/100% approval ＝ SME FRF。記住 small private company 係「三選二」而 唔係 三項全過 見到 public accountability 三測試（公開交易 / 發行中 / fiduciary 持有資產）＝ PEs。公司 規模完全無關 ——巨型私人公司都可以合資格 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: What is the objective of general purpose financial reporting under the Conceptual Framework, and who are the primary users? Back: To provide useful financial information about the entity to users for making decisions relating to providing resources to the entity (HKFRS CF 1.2–1.11). Primary users: existing and potential investors, lenders and other creditors . Users assess: (i) prospects for future net cash inflows; (ii) management's stewardship of the entity's economic resources. 💬 白話：財務報告唔係寫俾所有人嘅——首要服務對象係「出錢嗰班人」（股東、潛在投資者、銀行債權人），幫佢哋決定買賣持有、借唔借錢、點投票。記住 stewardship（管理層睇住啲資產睇得幾好）呢個字，written question 成日要提。 Card 2 Front: List the two fundamental and four enhancing qualitative characteristics of useful financial information, with one line meanings. Back: Fundamental: Relevance (predictive/confirmatory value; materiality); Faithful representation (complete, neutral, free from error). Enhancing: Comparability (the goal; consistency helps), Verifiability (independent observers reach same conclusion), Timeliness (available in time), Understandability (clear and concise). Enhancing characteristics cannot make irrelevant or unfaithful information useful. 💬 白話：口訣「相關＋如實」係入場券，另外四個（比較、驗證、及時、易懂）係加分項。試場伏位：completeness / neutrality 屬於 faithful representation，唔係 relevance；comparability ≠ uniformity。 Card 3 Front: Define 'asset' under the Conceptual Framework and state the three elements of the definition. Why is the right to receive employee services NOT an asset? Back: Asset = a present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events ; an economic resource is a right that has the potential to produce economic benefits (HKFRS CF 4.3–4.25). Three elements: (1) Right ; (2) Potential to produce economic benefits (need not be certain or even likely); (3) Control (present ability to direct the use and obtain the benefits). Employee services fail the control test — employees can leave at any time. 💬 白話：三關——「有權、有潛力生財、控制得到」。員工會辭職，公司控制唔到佢，所以請人本身唔產生 asset。注意「唔使肯定甚至唔使很可能有利益流入」——probability 唔係定義嘅一部分，係 recognition 層面先考慮。 Card 4 Front: Define 'liability' under the Conceptual Framework and state the three criteria. Is an executory contract a liability? Back: Liability = a present obligation of the entity to transfer an economic resource as a result of past events (HKFRS CF 4.3–4.25). Three criteria: (1) the entity has an obligation (no practical ability to avoid); (2) the obligation is to transfer an economic resource ; (3) it is a present obligation existing as a result of a past event . An executory contract is equally unperformed — rights and obligations to exchange economic resources only; once one party performs first, the other party's obligation becomes a liability (e.g. contract liability). 💬 白話：liability 三大件＝「有責任、要俾嘢出去、過去事件造成嘅現時責任」。Executory contract 即「大家都未做嘢」嘅合約——雙方未履行或履行程度相等，一般未產生 element；一方先做咗（例如先收錢），另一方先至有 liability。 Card 5 Front: State the recognition criteria for an asset or liability under the Conceptual Framework, and the factors that may cause recognition to fail each criterion. Back: Recognise only if recognition provides: (i) relevant information ; and (ii) a faithful representation of the asset or liability (HKFRS CF 5.6–5.23). Relevance may fail due to: existence uncertainty ; low probability of an inflow/outflow of economic benefits. Faithful representation may fail due to high measurement uncertainty (e.g. exceptionally wide range of possible outcomes). Cost constraint also applies. Derecognition = removal from the statement of financial position when the item no longer meets the definition of an asset or liability. 💬 白話：定義過咗關唔代表可以入賬——仲要過「relevant＋faithful」雙關。記住配對：existence uncertainty 同 low probability 影響 relevance ；measurement uncertainty 影響 faithful representation 。呢個 matching 係 MCQ 常客。 Card 6 Front: Compare the four measurement bases in the Conceptual Framework: which are entry values and which are exit values? Which reflect entity specific assumptions? Back: Entry values : Historical cost (consideration paid + transaction costs); Current cost (cost of acquiring an equivalent item at the measurement date) — transaction costs included. Exit values : Fair value (orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date); Value in use / fulfilment value (discounted entity specific cash flows) — transaction costs NOT adjusted. Value in use reflects entity specific assumptions; fair value reflects the market participants' perspective. 💬 白話：Entry＝「買入價邏輯」（歷史成本、現行成本，計 transaction costs）；Exit＝「賣出價邏輯」（fair value、value in use，唔計 transaction costs）。Fair value 跟市場參與者角度，value in use 跟自己公司角度——呢個對照必考。 Card 7 Front: A private company wants to adopt the HK SME FRF. What types of companies qualify, which businesses are ineligible, and what are the size tests and approval requirements? Back: Qualifying types: private companies (≤50 members, transfer restrictions, no public subscription) and companies limited by guarantee (Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) s.359). Ineligible: SFO Part V licensed business; accepting loans at interest/premium; banking ; insurance . Size tests: small guarantee co. — revenue ≤ HK$25m (no approval); small private co. — 2 of 3 : revenue ≤ HK$100m / assets ≤ HK$100m / ≤100 employees (no approval); larger 'eligible' private co. — 2 of 3 at HK$200m thresholds + ≥75% members approve and none of the rest vote against ; standalone private co. (no subsidiary, not a subsidiary) — no size limit but 100% approval . Two consecutive years meeting/failing the tests to gain/lose status. 💬 白話：背門檻口訣「25 / 100 / 200」，「三選二」唔係全過。批准規則：小型唔使批；大型要 75%＋剩返嗰啲冇人反對；非集團私人公司免 size test 就要全體 100%。考試最鍾意將 75% 同 100%、small 同 large eligible 調亂。 Card 8 Front: What is 'public accountability' under the HKFRS for Private Entities, and what are the eligibility conditions for adopting it? Back: An entity has public accountability if: (i) its debt or equity instruments are traded in a public market ; (ii) it is in the process of issuing such instruments for public trading; or (iii) it holds assets in a fiduciary capacity for a broad group of outsiders as one of its primary businesses (e.g. banks, insurers, securities brokers) (HKFRS for PEs Section 1.1–1.4, 1.6–1.7). Eligibility: no public accountability AND publishes general purpose financial statements for external users . No size tests and no shareholders' approval required. 💬 白話：三條問題——「上市未？準備上市未？係咪幫人託管資產做本業？」三條都答「唔係」，加上有出 general purpose FS 俾外部用戶（例如稅局），就合資格。規模幾大都冇所謂——呢點同 SME FRF 嘅 size tests 完全相反，係經典對比考點。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Faithful representation 如實反映——資料要完整、中立、無錯誤地描繪佢聲稱代表嘅嘢 "To be a faithful representation, information must be complete, neutral and free from error." Executory contract 「大家都未做嘢」嘅合約——雙方未履行或履行程度相等 "An executory contract is one that is equally unperformed by both parties." Going concern 持續經營假設——預期公司喺可見將來（實務上 12 個月）唔會倒閉或停業 "The going concern assumption presumes the entity will remain in operation for the foreseeable future." Public accountability 公眾責任——股份公開交易、準備上市、或以受託身份為外人持有資產 "An entity whose shares are traded in a public market has public accountability and cannot adopt the HKFRS for PEs." Entry value / Exit value 買入價邏輯 vs 賣出價邏輯嘅計量基礎 "Historical cost and current cost are entry values, while fair value and value in use are exit values." Reporting entity 報告實體——可以係單一公司、公司一部分（如分部）、或多於一間公司（集團） "The boundary of a reporting entity may be a single entity, a portion of an entity, or more than one entity." Cost constraint 成本制約——披露資訊嘅好處要大過收集同提供嘅成本 "The cost constraint requires that the benefits of reporting information justify the costs of providing it." Derecognition 終止確認——當項目唔再符合 asset/liability 定義時從財務狀況表移除 "Derecognition occurs when an item no longer meets the definition of an asset or a liability."

title: M6 Chapter 1: Financial Reporting Framework — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 1: Financial Reporting Framework — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 1: Financial Reporting Framework — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Comparability is the goal: information is more useful if it can …
text: M6 Chapter 1: Financial Reporting Framework — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Comparability is the goal: information is more useful if it can be compared with similar information about other entities and about the same entity for another period or date. Consistency — the use of the same methods for the same items from period to period — is related to, but different from, comparability; it helps achieve the goal of comparability. Both comparability and consistency relate to the enhancing qualitative characteristics, not the fundamental ones. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 goal vs means 嘅層次關係：Conceptual Framework 明確講 comparability 係 goal，consistency 係幫手達成 goal 嘅工具 （例如同一折舊方法年年用，數字先可比較）。 Option A 掉轉咗主客關係——將 consistency 當 goal，係典型 reversal trap。 Option B 係 uniformity trap：comparability ≠ uniformity，「like things look alike, unlike things look different」，強迫所有公司用一模一樣方法反而降低可比性。 Option D 錯喺分類：comparability 同 consistency 都唔係 fundamental qualitative characteristics（fundamental 只得 relevance 同 faithful representation），而且 enhancing characteristics 唔可以單獨令資訊 useful。 考試伏位：見到「uniformity」「一致方法令報表完全一樣」呢類字眼，即刻諗起 comparability ≠ uniformity。 Rule Check: HKFRS CF 2.24–2.29 Common Trap（繁中）: 考生常將 consistency 誤當成 comparability 嘅同義詞或者上位概念。記住：consistency 係同一間公司跨期用同一方法；comparability 仲包括跨公司比較。MCQ 好鍾意將兩者角色對調做 distractor。 Q2 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): An asset is a present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events, where an economic resource is a right that has the potential to produce economic benefits. Option A: the signed lease gives Verdant Limited a right to use the machine; the machine has the potential to produce economic benefits (used in juice production); and Verdant Limited has control (the present ability to direct how and when the machine is used and to obtain the benefits) — all three elements are met, so it is an asset (a right of use type resource), even without legal ownership. 解題思路（繁中）: Asset 定義三大件： right + potential to produce economic benefits + control ，仲要係 past event 產生嘅 present resource。A 全中：簽咗租約（past event）→ 有使用權（right）→ 機器可以榨汁生財（potential benefits）→ 公司決定點用（control）。冇 legal ownership 唔緊要，使用權本身就係 asset。 Option B：員工服務 fail control test——baristas 可以隨時辭職，公司控制唔到，所以唔係 asset（LP 原文例子）。 Option C：呢個係 executory contract （雙方都未履行），只係交換經濟資源嘅權利義務組合，未產生 asset/liability。 Option D：customer loyalty 唔係公司可以 control 嘅 right——顧客嚟唔嚟幫襯由佢哋決定，所以唔符合定義。 考試伏位：唔好以為「有所有權先係 asset」；亦唔好以為「預期帶來利益」就夠——必須係 controlled right 。 Rule Check: HKFRS CF 4.3–4.25（asset definition; executory contracts: HKFRS CF 4.56–4.58） Common Trap（繁中）: 最大陷阱係 B 同 D——「好有價值嘅嘢」唔等於 asset，關鍵永遠係 control 。記住 LP 金句：right to receive employee services is not an asset because the entity lacks control（員工可以隨時走）。 Q3 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Value in use is the discounted cash flows an entity expects to receive from using and disposing of an asset. It is an exit value (like fair value) but is based on entity specific assumptions , whereas fair value reflects the perspective of market participants . Historical cost and current cost are entry values (prices in the market in which the entity acquires the asset or incurs the liability). 解題思路（繁中）: 題目有兩個篩選條件：(1) exit value；(2) entity specific 而非 market participants 角度。兩個條件同時符合嘅只有 value in use 。 Option A historical cost：entry value（取得時嘅交易價），出局。 Option B current cost：都係 entry value（measurement date 買同等資產嘅價），出局。 Option C fair value：係 exit value 冇錯（"price received to sell…in an orderly transaction"），但佢反映 market participants 角度，唔係 entity specific，所以唔係最佳答案——呢個係本题核心陷阱。 Option D value in use：exit value + entity specific discounted cash flows，全中。 順帶背埋：entry values 計 transaction costs；fair value 同 value in use 唔計 transaction costs。 Rule Check: HKFRS CF 6.17–6.20（value in use）；HKFRS CF 6.12–6.16（fair value）；HKFRS CF 6.4–6.9、6.21–6.22（entry values） Common Trap（繁中）: 考生成日記住「fair value＝exit value」就秒選 C，忽略咗題目第二個條件「entity specific」。雙條件題要兩個都 check 先好揀。另一常見混淆：以為 value in use 係 entry value 或者要加 transaction costs——兩樣都錯。 Q4 — Answer: HK$500,000 Model Answer (EN): Under the financial concept of capital, capital is regarded as the net assets (equity) of the entity, and profit is earned if the financial (money) amount of net assets has increased during the period, excluding any distributions to and contributions from the owners . Workings: HK$ Net assets at 31 December 20X8 5,600,000 Less: Net assets at 1 January 20X8 (4,800,000) Increase in net assets 800,000 Less: Contributions from owners (share issue) (500,000) Add: Distributions to owners (dividends paid) 200,000 Profit for the year 500,000 解題思路（繁中）: Financial capital maintenance 下，profit = 期末 net assets − 期初 net assets，再 剔除同業主之間嘅往來 （注資要扣返、派息要加返）。 計算：5,600,000 − 4,800,000 = 800,000（淨資產升幅）；發新股係 contribution，唔係 income → 減 500,000；派息係 distribution，唔係 expense → 加返 200,000。Profit = 800,000 − 500,000 + 200,000 = HK$500,000 。 常見錯法對應：(i) 直接答 800,000（完全唔剔除股東往來）；(ii) 答 300,000（加咗股息當 expense 扣，方向掉轉）；(iii) 答 1,100,000（將發股當收入加埋）。 呢題同時暗考 income/expense 定義：equity holders 嘅 contributions 同 distributions 唔係 income/expense，係直接喺 equity 出入。 Rule Check: HKFRS CF 8.3（concepts of capital and capital maintenance）；HKFRS CF 4.68–4.69（income/expenses exclude contributions from and distributions to holders of equity claims） Common Trap（繁中）: 最大伏位係 dividend 嘅方向——股息令資產（cash）減少，但佢 唔係 expense （定義明確剔除 distributions to equity holders），所以計 profit 時要 加返 。記住口訣：「注資扣、派息加」。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) s.359 and the HK SME FRF size tests, a small private company must not exceed any two of: (i) total annual revenue of HK$100 million; (ii) total assets of HK$100 million; (iii) 100 employees. Harbour View Limited met the revenue test (HK$96m / HK$98m ≤ HK$100m) and the employee test (92 / 95 ≤ 100) in both 20X7 and 20X8 — i.e. two of the three tests for two consecutive years . No shareholders' approval is required for a small private company, so it may adopt the simplified reporting exemption for the year ended 31 December 20X9. 解題思路（繁中）: 逐步分析：先查公司類型（private company ✓）→ 查 ineligible business（冇 banking/insurance/SFO Part V ✓）→ 查 size test。 三年數據：revenue ≤ HK$100m（✓ ✓）；total assets ≤ HK$100m（✗ ✗，兩年都超）；employees ≤ 100（✓ ✓）→ 三項中符合 兩項 ，達到 small private company 嘅「唔超過任何兩項」要求，且 連續兩年 符合（two year rule），20X9 可用 SME FRF。 Small private company 唔需要 shareholders' approval——題目話冇攞任何 resolution，唔影響資格。 Option A 錯：佢用 HK$200m 嘅 larger 'eligible' 門檻嚟套，但公司已經符合更細嘅 small private company 門檻；而且 larger eligible 先要 75% approval，呢度唔適用。 Option C 錯：呢個係「三項全過」嘅常見誤解——規則係 2 of 3 ，assets 超標唔會一票否決。 Option D 錯：將 larger 'eligible' private company 嘅 approval 要求（≥75% + 無人反對）錯套落 small private company 度。 Rule Check: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) s.359；HK SME FRF para. 28–43（size tests and shareholders' approval） Common Trap（繁中）: 三大伏位：(1) 以為三項 size tests 要全過（其實 2 of 3）；(2) 將 small private company 同 larger 'eligible' private company 嘅股東批准要求調亂（細嘅唔使批、大嘅要 75%＋其餘無人反對）；(3) 唔記得 two consecutive years 先可以首次採用。呢啲 boundary/threshold 題係 QP MCQ 常客，數字要逐項對照門檻表。 End of Answers

text: M6 Chapter 1: Financial Reporting Framework — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 In accordance with the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting, which of the following statements best describes the relationship between comparability and consistency? A. Consistency is the goal of useful financial information, and comparability is one of the means that helps an entity achieve that goal. B. Comparability requires all entities to adopt uniform accounting methods for similar transactions so that their financial statements look alike in all respects. C. Comparability is the goal, and consistency — the use of the same methods for the same items from period to period — helps achieve that goal. D. Comparability and consistency are both fundamental qualitative characteristics, and either one alone is sufficient to make financial information useful. Question 2 Verdant Limited operates a chain of juice bars in Hong Kong. In accordance with the definition of an asset in the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting, which of the following items gives rise to an asset of Verdant Limited? A. The right to use a commercial juicing machine under a signed three year lease agreement, under which Verdant Limited can decide how and when the machine is operated. B. The services to be rendered by its team of baristas, who are highly skilled but may resign from the company at any time. C. A purchase contract signed with a fruit supplier for delivery next month, under which neither Verdant Limited nor the supplier has performed any obligation. D. The strong loyalty of its regular customers, which is expected to generate repeat purchases in the coming year. Question 3 In accordance with the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting, which of the following measurement bases is an exit value that reflects entity specific assumptions rather than the perspective of market participants? A. Historical cost B. Current cost C. Fair value D. Value in use Question 4 Falcon Limited had net assets of HK$4,800,000 at 1 January 20X8 and net assets of HK$5,600,000 at 31 December 20X8. During the year ended 31 December 20X8, Falcon Limited issued new ordinary shares for cash of HK$500,000 and declared and paid dividends of HK$200,000 to its shareholders. In accordance with the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting, calculate Falcon Limited's profit for the year ended 31 December 20X8 under the financial concept of capital maintenance. Show your workings. Question 5 Harbour View Limited is a private company incorporated under the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622). It has no subsidiaries and is not a subsidiary of another company. It does not carry on any banking business, insurance business, or any business licensed under Part V of the Securities and Futures Ordinance. Its financial data are as follows: Year ended 31 Dec 20X7 Year ended 31 Dec 20X8 Total annual revenue HK$96 million HK$98 million Total assets at year end HK$112 million HK$118 million Average number of employees 92 95 Harbour View Limited has not obtained any resolution from its members regarding reporting exemptions. In accordance with the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) and the HK SME FRF, which of the following statements is correct regarding Harbour View Limited's eligibility to adopt the simplified reporting exemption for the year ended 31 December 20X9? A. Harbour View Limited qualifies as a larger 'eligible' private company because it meets two of the three size tests measured against the HK$200 million thresholds, provided that at least 75% of all its members pass a resolution approving the adoption. B. Harbour View Limited qualifies as a small private company because it has met two of the three size tests (total annual revenue not exceeding HK$100 million and not more than 100 employees) for two consecutive years, and no shareholders' approval is required. C. Harbour View Limited does not qualify for the simplified reporting exemption because its total assets exceed HK$100 million at the end of both reporting periods. D. Harbour View Limited qualifies as a small private company only if at least 75% of all its members pass a resolution approving the adoption and none of the remaining members vote against it. End of Quiz — 提交格式： 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. …

excerpt: M6 Chapter 2: Fair Value Measurement — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define fair value and explain the exit price, market based me…
text: M6 Chapter 2: Fair Value Measurement — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define fair value and explain the exit price, market based measurement principle in accordance with HKFRS 13. 2. Determine the principal (or most advantageous) market and apply the correct treatment of transaction costs and transport costs in fair value measurement. 3. Select appropriate valuation techniques (market / cost / income approach) and classify the inputs within the three level fair value hierarchy. 4. Apply the highest and best use valuation premise to non financial assets. 5. Identify the recurring and non recurring fair value disclosure requirements of HKFRS 13. 必背考點 A. Recognition — 呢章其實唔講 recognition！ HKFRS 13 只講 "how to measure"，唔講 "when to measure" ：其他 HKFRSs（如 HKFRS 9、HKAS 16、HKAS 40）先決定邊啲資產/負債要按 fair value 計量；HKFRS 13 提供統一嘅計量框架（LP §2.1 引言）。考試問「邊個準則決定要唔要用 fair value」→ 唔係 HKFRS 13。 Fair value 定義（HKFRS 13.9） ："the price that would be received to sell an asset (or paid to transfer a liability) in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date"。 兩大核心原則： Exit price （賣出價），唔係 entry price（買入價）。 Market based measurement ，唔係 entity specific measurement — 用 market participants 嘅假設，唔用自己公司嘅假設（無例外）。 Unit of account 由其他準則決定，HKFRS 13 唔指定（stand alone item vs group of assets/liabilities）。 B. Measurement rules（HKFRS 13 核心） 1. Orderly transaction（HKFRS 13.A） ：假設交易前有一段時間曝光於市場做 marketing activities； forced liquidation / distress sale 唔算 。 2. Principal (or most advantageous) market（HKFRS 13.17–18, 13.19） ： Entity 必須能夠 access 該市場 → 所以呢個判斷係 entity specific （唔同公司對同一 item 可以有唔同 principal market）。 Principal market = greatest volume and level of activity 嘅市場（用 market based volume，唔係 entity 自己嘅銷量）。 有 principal market → 直接用嗰個市場嘅價； 只有冇 principal market 先 用 most advantageous market （扣除 transaction costs + transport costs 後 net proceeds 最高嘅市場）。 3. Transaction costs vs Transport costs（考試必考伏位） ： Transaction costs ： 唔扣 — 唔係資產特性，係交易特性（只喺揀 most advantageous market 時先考慮）。 Transport costs ： 要扣 — location 係資產特性（如 commodity）。 4. Market participants 特徵（HKFRS 13.A） ：independent of each other / knowledgeable / able to enter into a transaction / willing (motivated but not forced)。 5. Highest and best use（HKFRS 13.27–29） ：只適用於 non financial assets ；從 market participants' perspective 判斷，可以唔同於 entity 嘅 current use（LP 例子：工業地 HK$3m vs 住宅地 HK$3.6m → FV = HK$3.6m）。 6. Valuation techniques（HKFRS 13.61–62） ： Market approach （HKFRS 13.B5–B7）：comparables、market multiples（e.g. P/E ratio）；適用於 quoted shares、real estates。 Cost approach （HKFRS 13.B8–B10）：current replacement cost；適用於自用廠房設備（唔獨立產生現金流）； 唔適用於 financial assets （金融資產唔可以「複製」）。 Income approach （HKFRS 13.B10–B30）：折現未來現金流（present value techniques）；適用於 unlisted equity、derivatives、investment properties、intangibles；multi period excess earnings method 屬於 income approach。 Choice（HKFRS 13.63） ：HKFRS 13 冇 為估值技術設 hierarchy，亦唔指定用邊一種；複雜情況可以用多於一種。原則： maximise observable inputs, minimise unobservable inputs （HKFRS 13.61）。 7. Fair value hierarchy（HKFRS 13.72–90, B35–B36） ： Level 1 ：unadjusted quoted prices in active markets for identical assets/liabilities（ 唔准調整 ）。 Level 2 ：observable inputs other than Level 1（similar assets in active market、identical in inactive market、interest rates/yield curves）。 Level 3 ：unobservable inputs（e.g. entity's own cash flow projections）。 分級規則 ：成個 measurement 按 lowest level of input that is significant to the entire measurement 分類 — 用咗 Level 2 + 重大 Level 3 inputs → 成個歸 Level 3 in entirety ；若 unobservable adjustment 唔重大 → 仍可歸 Level 2。 8. Present value technique 元素（Exhibit 2.5） ：estimate future cash flows → expectations about variations in amount and timing → time value of money (risk free rate) → price for bearing uncertainty (risk premium)。LP 例：expected cash flows HK$10,400 ÷ (1 + 2.5% + 1.5%) = HK$10,000 。 Key journal entries（注意：HKFRS 13 本身唔產生 journal entries；以下係其他準則要求按 FV 計量後嘅後續調整） 情境 Dr Cr 依據 FVTPL 股票投資 FV 升 HK$200,000 Dr Financial asset at FVTPL 200,000 Cr Gain on fair value change (P&L) 200,000 HKFRS 9 Investment property FV 升 HK$500,000（fair value model） Dr Investment property 500,000 Cr Gain on fair value change (P&L) 500,000 HKAS 40 Investment property FV 跌 HK$300,000 Dr Loss on fair value change (P&L) 300,000 Cr Investment property 300,000 HKAS 40 （每條 Dr = Cr，已平衡。FV 金額本身由 HKFRS 13 框架計量。） C. Disclosure requirements（HKFRS 13.93） 區分 recurring （每個報告日都要計 FV）vs non recurring （特定情況先觸發）fair value measurement。 兩者都要披露：period end FV、所屬 hierarchy level、（Level 2 & 3）valuation techniques 及 inputs 描述、Level 3 quantitative information about significant unobservable inputs、Level 3 valuation processes description、non financial asset highest and best use 同實際用途唔同嘅原因。 只有 recurring 先額外要：Level 3 reconciliation of opening to closing balances 、（Level 3 financial assets/liabilities only）quantitative effect of changes in unobservable inputs。 原則：Level 3 披露要求最重 — 愈靠 unobservable inputs，披露愈多。 易混淆概念對比 對比一：Principal market vs Most advantageous market Principal market Most advantageous market 定義（EN） Market with the greatest volume and level of activity for the asset/liability Market that maximises the amount received to sell (net of transaction costs AND transport costs) 幾時用 只要存在就一定要用（priority） 只有 absence of principal market 先用 考慮 transaction costs? 搵市場時唔使 搵市場時要扣 點樣分辨（繁中） 睇「邊個市場最旺」（market based volume，唔係自己銷量） 睇「邊個市場落袋最多」（net proceeds） 考試伏位 題目俾咗交易量 → 一定有 principal market，即使另一市場價錢更好都唔准轉；計 FV 時記住 price − transport costs（唔扣 transaction costs） 同學成日直接用淨價最高市場嘅 net proceeds 做 FV — 錯！揀市場先扣 transaction costs，計 FV 嗰陣唔扣 對比二：Fair Value Hierarchy — Level 1 vs Level 2 vs Level 3 Level 1 Level 2 Level 3 Inputs（EN） Unadjusted quoted prices in active markets for identical items Observable inputs other than Level 1 (similar items / inactive markets / interest rates, yield curves) Unobservable inputs (entity's own data, cash flow projections) 可否調整 No adjustment allowed 可以調整（condition/location），但若調整基於重大 unobservable input → 降做 Level 3 N/A 典型例子 HKEX 上市股票報價 同區類似物業每平方呎價、唔活躍市場嘅 identical item 報價 Multi period excess earnings method 嘅 forecast income 及 asset specific discount rate 披露要求 最輕 中（techniques + inputs） 最重（reconciliation、quantitative info、valuation processes） 考試伏位 Real estate 幾乎永遠唔係 Level 1（冇 identical property）；「in entirety」規則 — 混用 inputs 時成個 measurement 歸最低而重大嘅 level，唔准拆開 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Define fair value in accordance with HKFRS 13, and state the two key principles derived from the definition. Back: "The price that would be received to sell an asset (or paid to transfer a liability) in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date" (HKFRS 13.9) Principle 1: fair value is an exit price , not an entry price Principle 2: fair value is a market based measurement, not an entity specific measurement 💬 白話解釋：Fair value = 「賣出去收到幾多錢」，唔係「買入嚟俾咗幾多」；而且要用市場參與者嘅諗法，唔可以用自己公司一廂情願嘅假設。 Card 2 Front: What is an "orderly transaction" under HKFRS 13, and which transactions fail this test? Back: A transaction that assumes exposure to the market for a period before the measurement date to allow for marketing activities (HKFRS 13.A) Fails: forced liquidation; distress sale (e.g. seller near bankruptcy); forced sale to meet regulatory requirements; outlier transaction prices 💬 白話解釋：「Orderly」即係有足夠時間慢慢搵買家；急住賤賣（near bankruptcy、被監管機構逼住賣）就唔係 fair value。 Card 3 Front: How does an entity determine which market's price to use for fair value measurement? Back: Step 1: consider only markets the entity can access at the measurement date (HKFRS 13.19) — entity specific Step 2: identify the principal market = greatest volume and level of activity (market based volume, not the entity's own volume) (HKFRS 13.17) Step 3: only if no principal market exists , use the most advantageous market = highest net proceeds after transaction costs and transport costs (HKFRS 13.18) Fair value = price in the selected market 💬 白話解釋：先問「我入到邊啲市場」，再問「邊個最旺」；最旺嗰個就係答案，就算隔籬市場價錢更靚都唔可以貪心轉場。 Card 4 Front: How are transaction costs and transport costs treated in (a) identifying the most advantageous market and (b) measuring fair value? Back: Transaction costs (e.g. brokerage fees): considered when identifying the most advantageous market, but NOT adjusted in measuring fair value — not a characteristic of the asset; transaction specific Transport costs : considered in both — adjusted in measuring fair value because location is a characteristic of the asset 💬 白話解釋：口訣 —「運輸扣得，佣金唔扣得」。佣金係你點樣做交易嘅成本，同資產本身無關；搬運費就同資產喺邊度有關，所以要扣。 Card 5 Front: What is the "highest and best use" premise, and to which assets does it apply? Back: Applies to non financial assets only (HKFRS 13.27) Fair value reflects a market participant's ability to generate economic benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use (or selling it to another market participant who would) Determined from market participants' perspective — may differ from the entity's current use (HKFRS 13.29) E.g. land used as factory worth HK$3m; worth HK$3.6m as residential site → FV = HK$3.6m 💬 白話解釋：塊地而家攞嚟起廠唔緊要，市場參與者覺得起樓最值錢，就按起樓嘅價值計 — 「物盡其用」嘅市場版。 Card 6 Front: Name the three valuation approaches in HKFRS 13 and one typical application of each. Back: Market approach — prices/multiples from transactions of identical or comparable items (e.g. quoted shares; P/E multiple for private company) (HKFRS 13.B5–B7) Cost approach — current replacement cost of service capacity (e.g. own use plant and equipment); not applicable to financial assets (HKFRS 13.B8–B10) Income approach — convert future cash flows/income to a single current amount (e.g. present value of rental income for investment property) (HKFRS 13.B10–B30) HKFRS 13 sets no hierarchy of techniques ; more than one technique may be used (HKFRS 13.63) 💬 白話解釋：三招 —「人哋賣幾錢」（market）、「重造要幾錢」（cost）、「將來賺幾錢折返今」（income）。準則唔逼你用邊招，但要盡用 observable inputs。 Card 7 Front: Explain the three levels of the fair value hierarchy and the "in entirety" classification rule. Back: Level 1 : unadjusted quoted prices in active markets for identical items (no adjustment allowed) Level 2 : observable inputs other than Level 1 (similar assets in active markets; identical items in inactive markets; interest rates, yield curves) Level 3 : unobservable inputs (own cash flow projections) In entirety rule : if a measurement uses both Level 2 and significant Level 3 inputs → classify the whole measurement as Level 3 ; if the unobservable adjustment is insignificant → Level 2 (HKFRS 13.72–90) Priority: maximise observable inputs, minimise unobservable inputs (HKFRS 13.61) 💬 白話解釋：好似污染咁 — 一啲重大嘅 Level 3 不確定因素，足以令成個估值「降級」做 Level 3，唔可以話「一半 Level 2 一半 Level 3」。 Card 8 Front: Distinguish recurring vs non recurring fair value measurement disclosures under HKFRS 13.93. Back: Recurring = FV measurement required at each reporting date ; non recurring = triggered only in particular circumstances Both: period end FV; hierarchy level; valuation techniques/inputs (Levels 2–3); quantitative info on significant unobservable inputs (Level 3); valuation processes (Level 3); reasons if highest and best use differs from actual use Recurring only : Level 3 reconciliation of opening to closing balances ; quantitative effect of changes in unobservable inputs (Level 3 financial assets/liabilities) More disclosure required for Level 3 measurements 💬 白話解釋：「次次都要計」嘅 FV 要多啲交代（特別係 Level 3 嘅期初對期末 reconciliation）；「偶然先計一次」嘅可以少啲。越靠估（Level 3），披露越多。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Fair value 賣出價／有序交易下市場參與者之間嘅價 Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date. Exit price 「離場價」（賣出收幾多），相對 entry price（買入俾幾多） Fair value is an exit price, not the price paid to acquire the asset. Orderly transaction 有充足時間做市場推廣嘅正常交易，唔係割價求售 A distress sale is not an orderly transaction and therefore does not reflect fair value. Principal market 成交量同活躍度最高嘅市場 The principal market is the market with the greatest volume and level of activity for the asset. Most advantageous market 扣除交易及運輸成本後淨收入最高嘅市場（冇 principal market 先用） In the absence of a principal market, fair value is measured using the price in the most advantageous market. Highest and best use 從市場參與者角度最有價值嘅用途（只限非金融資產） The highest and best use of the land is residential development, which differs from its current industrial use. Observable inputs 有市場數據支持嘅輸入（Level 1–2） Quoted prices for similar properties in an active market are observable inputs. Unobservable inputs 冇市場數據、靠自己內部估計嘅輸入（Level 3） The entity's own cash flow projections are unobservable inputs classified within Level 3.
