text: M6 Chapter 5: Property, Plant and Equipment — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C (HK$509,000) Model Answer (EN): Workings — capitalise only the purchase price and directly attributable costs (HKAS 16.16–16.17): Purchase price: HK$500,000 − trade discount HK$25,000 = HK$475,000 Import duty (non refundable tax): HK$8,000 Delivery and installation: HK$20,000 Testing costs: HK$6,000 Cost of machine = HK$475,000 + 8,000 + 20,000 + 6,000 = HK$509,000 Excluded: refundable VAT HK$12,000 (recoverable, not a cost); staff training HK$9,000 and opening ceremony HK$4,000 (HKAS 16.19–20: costs of conducting business with a new class of operation and opening a new facility are expensed). 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵係逐項問「係咪令部機 ready for intended use 所必需」。 Option A（HK$521,000）錯誤加咗可退還 VAT — VAT 係 refundable tax，收回得返，唔係資產成本。 Option B（HK$534,000）= 正確數 509,000 + VAT 12,000 + training 9,000 + ceremony 4,000，全部錯誤資本化。 Option D（HK$530,000）= 509,000 + VAT 12,000 + training 9,000，同樣錯。 Trade discount 一定要扣（HKAS 16.16(a)）；import duty 係 non refundable → 資本化；testing 同 delivery/installation 係典型 directly attributable costs。 Rule Check: HKAS 16 para. 15–17; HKAS 16 para. 19–20 (excluded costs) Common Trap（繁中）: 見到稅項就諗清楚：VAT refundable → expense/ receivable；stamp duty、import duty non refundable → capitalise。Training 同 opening ceremony 無論點包裝都係費用。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 16.55, depreciation of an asset begins when it is available for use , i.e. when it is in the location and condition necessary for it to be capable of operating in the manner intended by management — here, 1 October 20X4. Depreciation does not cease while an asset is idle; an idle but ready for use asset continues to be depreciated (under a usage method the charge may be zero, but Otter's idleness arises from low seasonal demand, not from a usage method outcome). 解題思路（繁中）: 考點係「ready for use 即刻開始折舊」，唔係「開始用」先折。10月1日已達到 location and condition necessary → 當日開始折。 Option A 錯：延到實際使用日（1月1日）先折，違反 16.55。 Option C 錯：idle 唔等於停止折舊；折舊只喺 earlier of held for sale（HKFRS 5）或 derecognition 時先停。 Option D 錯：無「閒置一個月自動停止折舊」呢回事——徹底虛構嘅規則。 考試伏位：題目畀兩個日期（ready 日 vs 使用日）就係引你揀遲嗰個。 Rule Check: HKAS 16 para. 55 (commencement and cessation of depreciation) Common Trap（繁中）: 同學常將「開始折舊」同「開始使用」混淆。記住：depreciation reflects consumption of service potential, and an idle asset still deteriorates。 Q3 — Answer: A (HK$52,500) Model Answer (EN): Workings: Depreciable amount = HK$480,000 − HK$60,000 = HK$420,000 Annual depreciation (straight line) = HK$420,000 ÷ 6 = HK$70,000 Depreciation commences 1 April 20X4 (asset acquired and ready for use); 9 months to 31 December 20X4 Depreciation expense 20X4 = HK$70,000 × 9/12 = HK$52,500 解題思路（繁中）: 兩個計算步驟：先扣 residual value 計 depreciable amount，再按月 pro rate。 Option B（HK$70,000）：計咗全年，忽略咗 4月1日先買入（題目明講 monthly depreciation）。 Option C（HK$60,000）：忽略 residual value（480,000 ÷ 6 = 80,000 × 9/12 = 60,000）。 Option D（HK$80,000）：既忽略 residual value 又計全年 — 雙重錯誤。 Straight line 一定要扣 residual value；只有 diminishing balance 先唔扣（residual value 只作下限）。 Rule Check: HKAS 16 para. 50 (depreciable amount); HKAS 16 para. 55 (depreciation commences when ready for use) Common Trap（繁中）: Mid year acquisition + monthly depreciation 係 M6 官方常見出法。唔記得 pro rate 或唔扣 residual value 都會中伏。 Q4 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under the net method (HKAS 16.35(b)), accumulated depreciation is first eliminated against the gross carrying amount, then the carrying amount is adjusted to fair value: Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Accumulated depreciation 100,000 Equipment 100,000 (eliminate accumulated depreciation) Equipment 60,000 Revaluation surplus (OCI) 60,000 (uplift carrying amount HK$300,000 → FV HK$360,000; first revaluation, so increase to OCI) 解題思路（繁中）: Revaluation increase = FV 360,000 − carrying amount 300,000 = 60,000；首次重估 → 全數 credit OCI (revaluation surplus) （HKAS 16.39），唔係 P&L。 Option A 錯：冇 eliminate accumulated depreciation — 違反題目講明嘅 net method policy（panelist report 常批評考生 ignore stated policy）。 Option B 錯：elimination 步驟啱，但 increase 入咗 P&L（gain on revaluation）— 只有逆轉先前同一資產嘅 P&L 減值先入 P&L，呢度係首次重估。 Option C 錯：HK$40,000 係將 FV 360,000 同 gross carrying amount 400,000 比較得出嘅錯誤結果（360,000 − 400,000 = −40,000），仲當埋佢係減值入 P&L — 正確比較基準係 carrying amount 300,000（net of accumulated depreciation），實際係 上升 60,000，唔係下跌。 考試伏位：revaluation 永遠攞 carrying amount（net of depreciation） 同 FV 比。 Rule Check: HKAS 16 para. 35(b) (elimination of accumulated depreciation); HKAS 16 para. 39 (revaluation increase to OCI) Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 忘記按 stated policy 消除累計折舊；(2) 將 revaluation increase 錯入 P&L。記住「升 → OCI，除非係逆轉舊 P&L 減值」。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Revaluation decrease = carrying amount HK$4,200,000 − fair value HK$3,700,000 = HK$500,000 . Under HKAS 16.40, a revaluation decrease is recognised in profit or loss, except to the extent of any existing credit balance in the revaluation surplus in respect of the same asset — that portion is debited to OCI: Debit Revaluation surplus (OCI): HK$300,000 (exhausts the surplus for this building; balance becomes nil) Recognise Revaluation loss in profit or loss: HK$200,000 (the excess) Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Revaluation surplus (OCI) 300,000 Revaluation loss (P&L) 200,000 Building 500,000 解題思路（繁中）: 口訣：「跌 → 先食盡同一資產嘅 surplus（行 OCI），多出嚟先入 P&L」。500,000 跌 − surplus 得 300,000 → 300,000 行 OCI、200,000 行 P&L。 Option A 錯：全數 500,000 入 P&L，忽略咗有 300,000 surplus 可以先行 OCI 抵銷。 Option B 錯：全數行 OCI — surplus 只有 300,000 credit，唔可以將 surplus 推落 debit balance；超出部分必須入 P&L。 Option D 錯：OCI/P&L 調轉咗（200,000 OCI / 300,000 P&L），違反「先用盡 surplus」嘅次序。 Surplus 係 asset by asset 計（唔可以用其他資產嘅 surplus 嚟抵）。 Rule Check: HKAS 16 para. 40 (revaluation decrease: OCI to extent of surplus, excess to P&L) Common Trap（繁中）: 最常見錯誤係全數入 P&L 或全數扣 surplus。記住 surplus 用完即零， 永遠唔會因減值而出現 debit balance 。呢條 rule 同 impairment of revalued assets（當 revaluation decrease 處理）係考官最愛。

excerpt: M6 Chapter 5: Property, Plant and Equipment — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 Heron …
text: M6 Chapter 5: Property, Plant and Equipment — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 Heron Manufacturing Limited purchased a machine for its Kwun Tong factory and incurred the following costs: Item HK$ List price of machine (before trade discount) 500,000 Trade discount (5% of list price) (25,000) Import duty (non refundable) 8,000 Value Added Tax on purchase (fully refundable) 12,000 Delivery and installation 20,000 Testing whether the machine functions properly 6,000 Staff training on operating the machine 9,000 Costs of the ceremony to celebrate the machine's commissioning 4,000 In accordance with HKAS 16, what is the cost of the machine on initial recognition? A. HK$521,000 B. HK$534,000 C. HK$509,000 D. HK$530,000 Q2 Otter Logistics Limited has just finished assembling a new sorting machine at its depot. The machine was in the location and condition necessary for it to be capable of operating in the manner intended by management on 1 October 20X4, but management decided not to start using it until 1 January 20X5 because demand was seasonally low. Identify which one of the following statements is correct under HKAS 16. A. Depreciation of the machine commences on 1 January 20X5, the date the machine is first used in operations. B. Depreciation of the machine commences on 1 October 20X4, even though the machine has not yet been used. C. Depreciation of the machine is not required because the machine is temporarily idle, and resumes only when it is used at full capacity. D. Depreciation of the machine ceases automatically whenever the machine is idle for more than one month. Q3 On 1 April 20X4, Falcon Freight Limited acquired a delivery truck for HK$480,000. The truck has an estimated residual value of HK$60,000 and an estimated useful life of six years. The entity applies the straight line method of depreciation, charges depreciation on a monthly basis, and has a 31 December year end. Calculate the depreciation expense for the truck for the year ended 31 December 20X4. A. HK$52,500 B. HK$70,000 C. HK$60,000 D. HK$80,000 Q4 Pelican Engineering Limited carries its equipment under the revaluation model and eliminates accumulated depreciation against the gross carrying amount when an asset is revalued (the net method). At 31 December 20X4, an item of equipment has a gross carrying amount of HK$400,000, accumulated depreciation of HK$100,000 (i.e. carrying amount of HK$300,000), and a fair value of HK$360,000. The equipment has never been revalued before. In accordance with HKAS 16, which set of journal entries correctly records the revaluation at 31 December 20X4? A. Dr Equipment HK$60,000; Cr Revaluation surplus (OCI) HK$60,000. B. Dr Accumulated depreciation HK$100,000; Cr Equipment HK$100,000; then Dr Equipment HK$60,000; Cr Gain on revaluation (profit or loss) HK$60,000. C. Dr Revaluation loss (profit or loss) HK$40,000; Cr Equipment HK$40,000. D. Dr Accumulated depreciation HK$100,000; Cr Equipment HK$100,000; then Dr Equipment HK$60,000; Cr Revaluation surplus (OCI) HK$60,000. Q5 Seahorse Properties Limited carries its office buildings under the revaluation model. A particular office building has a carrying amount of HK$4,200,000 at 31 December 20X4, immediately before a revaluation. The revaluation surplus in equity includes a credit balance of HK$300,000 arising from a previous revaluation increase of this same building. An independent valuer has determined the building's fair value at 31 December 20X4 to be HK$3,700,000. In accordance with HKAS 16, how should the revaluation of HK$500,000 be accounted for? A. Recognise the entire HK$500,000 as a loss in profit or loss. B. Debit HK$500,000 to the revaluation surplus through other comprehensive income. C. Debit HK$300,000 to the revaluation surplus through other comprehensive income and recognise HK$200,000 as a loss in profit or loss. D. Recognise HK$300,000 as a loss in profit or loss and debit HK$200,000 to the revaluation surplus through other comprehensive income. End of quiz. 完成後先好揭答案檔。

title: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
D. Key Journal Entries（Dr/Cr 必背）
excerpt: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define investment property and distinguish it from owner occupie…
text: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define investment property and distinguish it from owner occupied property and inventory under HKAS 40. 2. Apply the recognition criteria and determine the elements of cost for owned investment property (HKAS 40.16–40.23). 3. Account for investment property after initial recognition under the cost model and the fair value model (HKAS 40.30–40.35). 4. Account for transfers between investment property and other asset categories upon a change in use (HKAS 40.57–40.64). 5. Prepare the disclosures required by HKAS 40 for investment property (HKAS 40.75–40.79). 必背考點 A. Recognition（確認） 考點 規定 出處 Definition of investment property Property (land or a building – or part of a building – or both) held (by the owner or by the lessee as a right of use asset) to earn rentals or for capital appreciation or both, rather than for (a) use in production/supply of goods or services or for administrative purposes; or (b) sale in the ordinary course of business. Generates cash flows largely independently of other assets. HKAS 40.5（定義）；例子見 HKAS 40.8 Examples of investment property (a) land held for long term capital appreciation; (b) land held for a currently undetermined future use (regarded as held for capital appreciation); (c) a building leased out under one or more operating leases; (d) a vacant building held to be leased out under operating leases; (e) property being constructed or developed for future use as investment property HKAS 40.8(a)–(e) NOT investment property Owner occupied property (incl. property occupied by employees even if they pay market rent; property held for future use as owner occupied property; owner occupied property awaiting disposal) → HKAS 16 / HKFRS 16；Property held for sale in the ordinary course of business or in construction/development for such sale → HKAS 2 Inventories HKAS 40.9(a),(c) Recognition criteria (owned IP) Recognised as an asset when, and only when: (1) it is probable that future economic benefits will flow to the entity; AND (2) cost can be measured reliably. Same criteria as HKAS 16 PPE; apply to both initial and subsequent costs. HKAS 40.16–40.17 Subsequent costs — component approach Costs to replace a component (e.g. lifts, fittings) are capitalised if the recognition criteria are met; the carrying amount of the replaced part is derecognised. Unit of account = the part, regardless of the life of the whole property. HKAS 40.19 Day to day servicing Repairs and maintenance costs are expensed when incurred — never capitalised. HKAS 40（與 HKAS 16 一致） Leased IP (right of use asset) Recognition and initial measurement follow HKFRS 16 Leases (not the HKAS 40.16 criteria); subsequent measurement follows the entity's HKAS 40 model. If leased out under a finance lease → HKFRS 16 (interest = lease receivable). Exhibit 6.1 B. Measurement（計量） Initial measurement (owned IP) — at cost (HKAS 40.18, 40.20–40.21) Include: purchase price + directly attributable expenditure (transaction costs such as legal fees, property transfer taxes; e.g. architect's fees, construction costs, cost of removing derelict buildings on site, regulatory approval costs). Exclude (HKAS 40.23): start up costs (unless necessary to bring the property to intended operating condition, e.g. advertising newly built rental accommodation); operating losses incurred before planned occupancy level; abnormal amounts of wasted material, labour and other resources (HKAS 40.23(c) — e.g. typhoon damage repairs during construction → expense to profit or loss). Subsequent measurement — one model chosen for ALL investment properties (HKAS 40.30, 40.33) Cost model Fair value model Carrying amount Cost − accumulated depreciation − accumulated impairment losses (HKAS 16 cost model; impairment per HKAS 36) Fair value at each reporting date per HKFRS 13; no depreciation Remeasurement gains/losses n/a (impairment only) ALL fair value changes → profit or loss in the period of change (never OCI) Reference HKAS 40.30；HKAS 16.30 HKAS 40.33, 40.35 Extra rules — Continue measuring at FV even if comparable market transactions become less frequent (HKAS 40.40); FV estimate must reflect rental income from current leases and market participant assumptions (HKAS 40.55) Change of policy Cost → fair value: permitted if justified under HKAS 8 Fair value → cost: highly unlikely to be permitted (HKAS 40.31) Transfers（轉撥）— only on change in use (HKAS 40.57–40.64) Transfer to/from IP when, and only when : (1) there is evidence of a change in use ; AND (2) the change causes the property to meet, or cease to meet, the IP definition. A change in management's intentions alone is NOT evidence (HKAS 40.58). Evidence of change in use (HKAS 40.57): end of owner occupation (→ IP); inception of an operating lease to another party (inventory → IP); commencement of owner occupation or development with a view to owner occupation (→ owner occupied); commencement of development with a view to sale (→ inventories). Deciding to dispose of an IP without development: keep as IP until derecognition — do NOT reclassify as inventory (HKAS 40.58). Direction Treatment 出處 Owner occupied (cost model) → IP (fair value model) (1) Update depreciation/impairment to date of change in use under HKAS 16; (2) revalue to fair value at that date — difference treated under HKAS 16 revaluation rules (increase → revaluation surplus in OCI, unless reversing a prior P&L decrease) HKAS 40.61–62 Owner occupied (cost) → IP (cost) Carrying amount unchanged HKAS 40.59 Inventory → IP (fair value model) Remeasure to fair value at date of change in use; difference → profit or loss (consistent with a sale of inventory) HKAS 40.63–64 Inventory → IP (cost) Carrying amount unchanged HKAS 40.59 IP (fair value) → owner occupied (cost) or inventory Fair value at date of change in use = deemed cost for subsequent accounting under HKAS 16 / HKFRS 16 / HKAS 2. Remeasure to FV first (gain/loss → P&L while still IP); do NOT reverse cumulative FV gains/losses HKAS 40.60 IP (cost) → owner occupied / inventory (cost) Carrying amount unchanged HKAS 40.59 Derecognition / disposal ：dispose of or permanently withdraw from use with no future benefits expected → derecognise; gain/loss on derecognition → profit or loss.（HKAS 40 mind map） HKFRS 5 互動 ：fair value model 下嘅 IP 即使符合 held for sale 分類條件，HKFRS 5 嘅 measurement provisions 唔適用 — 繼續按 HKAS 40 以 fair value 計量（唔好用 lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell）。 C. Disclosure（披露）— HKAS 40.75–40.79 適用範圍 必須披露 出處 Both models Whether the fair value model or the cost model is applied HKAS 40.75(a) Both models Reconciliation of carrying amount at beginning and end of period: additions; assets classified as held for sale under HKFRS 5; transfers to/from inventories and owner occupied properties; other changes HKAS 40.76, 40.79(d) Both models Whether valued by an independent qualified valuer with recent relevant experience (and extent of reliance); rental income from IP; direct operating expenses (including repairs and maintenance) — indirect operating expenses NOT required HKAS 40.75 Fair value model only Net gains/losses from fair value adjustments in the reconciliation; reconciliation between an external valuation and the valuation in the FS where significantly adjusted; plus HKFRS 13 disclosures (valuation techniques, inputs, FV hierarchy level) HKAS 40.76(d) Cost model only Depreciation methods; useful lives or depreciation rates; gross carrying amount and accumulated depreciation (aggregated with impairment losses) at beginning and end; depreciation and impairment losses/reversals in the reconciliation; the fair value of the investment properties HKAS 40.79(a)–(d), 40.79(d)(iv)–(v) D. Key Journal Entries（Dr/Cr 必背） 1. Initial recognition (owned IP) 2. Fair value model — remeasurement at reporting date (HKAS 40.35) 3. Cost model — annual depreciation (HKAS 40.30) 4. Owner occupied (cost) → IP (fair value) (HKAS 40.61–62) 5. IP (fair value) → inventory / owner occupied (HKAS 40.60) 6. Inventory → IP (fair value) (HKAS 40.63–64) 7. Subsequent expenditure (capitalised component replacement) 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Fair Value Model (HKAS 40) vs Revaluation Model (HKAS 16) IP — Fair Value Model (HKAS 40) PPE — Revaluation Model (HKAS 16) Increase in value CR Fair value gain in profit or loss （全數） CR Revaluation surplus in OCI ；只有當 reversal of 同一資產之前喺 P&L 認過嘅 decrease，先至可以計入 P&L Decrease in value DR Fair value loss in profit or loss （全數） 先扣同一資產嘅 revaluation surplus（DR OCI），超出部分先 DR loss in P&L Depreciation 唔使折舊 照計折舊（按 revalued amount） 考試伏位 見到 IP fair value change 千祈唔好放入 OCI / revaluation surplus — 呢個係最常見失分位；相反 PPE revaluation surplus 唔可以直入 P&L Table 2: Investment Property vs Owner Occupied Property vs Inventory（分類判斷） Investment Property (HKAS 40) Owner Occupied Property (HKAS 16 / HKFRS 16) Inventory (HKAS 2) 持有目的 Earn rentals / capital appreciation / both Use in production/supply of goods or services, or administrative purposes Sale in the ordinary course of business（或建造中準備出售） Cash flows Largely independent of other assets Generated jointly with other assets 出售套現 典型例子 Land for undetermined use; vacant building held to lease out; building leased out under operating lease; property under construction for future IP use Head office; property occupied by employees（即使收 market rent！）; held for future owner occupation Developed/resold property; land acquired for development and resale 考試伏位 「Vacant」≠ owner occupied — 空置樓持有作出租係 IP；員工宿舍即使收市值租金都係 owner occupied（HKAS 40.9(c)）；打算出售但未有 development 嘅 IP 繼續係 IP，唔會變 inventory Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Define "investment property" under HKAS 40 and list three examples. Back: Property (land or a building – or part of a building – or both) held (by the owner or by the lessee as a right of use asset) to earn rentals or for capital appreciation or both NOT for use in production/supply of goods or services or administrative purposes, and NOT for sale in the ordinary course of business Examples (HKAS 40.8): land held for long term capital appreciation; land held for currently undetermined future use; building leased out under operating lease(s); vacant building held to be leased out; property being constructed for future use as IP 💬 白話：核心係「收租或者等升值」，而且 cash flows 係獨立於公司其他資產。記住兩個「唔係」：唔係自用、唔係存貨出售。特別陷阱係「未決定用途嘅土地」都當 IP（視為等升值）。 Card 2 Front: What are the recognition criteria for an owned investment property under HKAS 40.16, and how are subsequent replacement costs treated? Back: Recognised when, and only when: (1) probable future economic benefits will flow to the entity; (2) cost can be measured reliably Same criteria apply to initial AND subsequent costs (HKAS 40.17) Component approach (HKAS 40.19): replacement of parts (e.g. lifts) capitalised if criteria met; carrying amount of replaced part derecognised Day to day servicing / repairs and maintenance → expense as incurred 💬 白話：同 HKAS 16 嘅確認條件一模一樣。換升降機呢類「換零件」可以資本化，但要同時 derecognise 舊件嘅賬面值；日常維修就直出 P&L，冇得資本化。 Card 3 Front: Which costs are included in, and excluded from, the initial cost of an owned investment property? Back: Include (HKAS 40.20–21): purchase price + directly attributable expenditure — transaction costs such as legal fees and property transfer taxes; architect's fees; construction costs; site clearance; regulatory approval costs Exclude (HKAS 40.23): start up costs (e.g. advertising rental accommodation); operating losses before planned occupancy; abnormal wasted material/labour (e.g. typhoon damage repairs) → expense to profit or loss 💬 白話：記住「直接應佔先計得入」。考試最鍾意混入「abnormal waste」同「廣告費」呃你資本化 — 呢兩樣係費用。注意：IP 嘅 transaction costs（如律師費、印花稅）係要計入成本嘅，唔好似金融工具咁即刻出費用。 Card 4 Front: Compare the cost model and fair value model for subsequent measurement of investment property (HKAS 40.30–40.35). Back: Policy choice applies to ALL investment properties Cost model (HKAS 40.30): cost − accumulated depreciation − accumulated impairment losses (HKAS 16 cost model; HKAS 36 impairment) Fair value model (HKAS 40.33, 40.35): fair value at each reporting date per HKFRS 13; no depreciation; ALL gains/losses → profit or loss (never OCI) FV → cost model change: highly unlikely to be permitted (HKAS 40.31); cost → FV possible under HKAS 8 💬 白話：揀咗一個 model 就要全部 IP 一齊用。Fair value model 最大特點：唔折舊 + 升跌全部入 P&L。一旦用咗 fair value model 基本上冇得返轉頭用 cost model。 Card 5 Front: When can a property be transferred into or out of investment property under HKAS 40.57–40.58? Back: Only when: (1) evidence of a change in use; AND (2) the change causes the property to meet / cease to meet the IP definition Evidence examples: end of owner occupation; inception of operating lease to another party; commencement of owner occupation; commencement of development with a view to sale Change in management's intentions ALONE is NOT evidence Decision to sell IP without development → stays as IP until derecognition (not reclassified to inventory) 💬 白話：「講」唔算數，要有實際行動（vacate 咗、租約開始、動工起嚟賣）。管理層得個諗字 / 開會決定咗，係唔構成 transfer 嘅 — 考試必考呢個伏位。 Card 6 Front: An owner occupied property under the HKAS 16 cost model is transferred to investment property under the fair value model. What is the accounting treatment? (HKAS 40.61–62) Back: (1) Update depreciation and any impairment losses up to the date of change in use (HKAS 16) (2) Revalue to fair value at that date; the increase/decrease follows HKAS 16 revaluation rules → increase to revaluation surplus in OCI (unless reversing a prior P&L decrease) (3) Reclassify the revalued amount as investment property Thereafter: fair value changes → profit or loss (HKAS 40.35) 💬 白話：轉嗰下嘅升值係跟 HKAS 16 遊戲規則（入 OCI revaluation surplus），唔係即刻入 P&L！但轉完之後就係 IP，之後嘅 fair value 升跌先入 P&L。呢個「分界點」係經典考點。 Card 7 Front: What is "deemed cost" on a transfer from fair value model investment property to owner occupied property or inventory? (HKAS 40.60) Back: First remeasure the IP to fair value at the date of change in use; gain/loss → profit or loss (still an IP at that moment) Fair value at date of change in use = deemed cost for subsequent accounting under HKAS 16 / HKFRS 16 / HKAS 2 Do NOT reverse cumulative fair value gains/losses to restate to original cost After transfer to inventory: measure at lower of deemed cost and NRV — subsequent fair value is irrelevant 💬 白話：轉出嗰日嘅 fair value 就係「新成本」，之後當 inventory 就 lower of cost and NRV，年結個 fair value 再高都唔關你事。千祈唔好諗住「還原」返最初成本。 Card 8 Front: List the key HKAS 40 disclosures for investment property under (a) both models, (b) fair value model only, (c) cost model only. Back: (a) Both: measurement model chosen (HKAS 40.75(a)); reconciliation of opening/closing carrying amounts (additions, held for sale, transfers, other changes) (HKAS 40.76, 79(d)); independent valuer details; rental income; direct operating expenses (b) Fair value model: net FV gains/losses in the reconciliation (HKAS 40.76(d)); external vs book valuation reconciliation; HKFRS 13 disclosures (techniques, inputs, hierarchy level) (c) Cost model: depreciation methods; useful lives/rates; gross carrying amount + accumulated depreciation; depreciation and impairment in reconciliation; fair value of the IP (HKAS 40.79) 💬 白話：無論邊個 model 都要披露 rental income 同 direct operating expenses（indirect 唔使）。用 cost model 反而要額外披露 fair value — 呢個係反向伏位，好多人以為 cost model 唔使理 fair value。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Investment property 持有嚟收租或等升值嘅物業（土地/樓宇/部分樓宇） The vacant office tower held to be leased out under operating leases is classified as investment property under HKAS 40.8(d). Owner occupied property 自己公司用嘅物業（生產、供應貨品服務或行政用途） The head office building is owner occupied property within the scope of HKAS 16 rather than HKAS 40. Fair value model 每個報告日按公允價值計量，升跌全入損益 Under the fair value model, all changes in fair value are recognised in profit or loss in the period of change (HKAS 40.35). Cost model 成本減累計折舊同累計減值虧損 Under the cost model, the investment property is carried at cost less accumulated depreciation and accumulated impairment losses (HKAS 40.30). Change in use 用途改變（要有實質證據，管理層意圖唔算） The end of owner occupation provides evidence of a change in use, triggering a transfer to investment property (HKAS 40.57). Deemed cost 轉撥當日嘅 fair value，當作之後嘅成本 For a transfer from investment property carried at fair value to inventories, the fair value at the date of change in use is the deemed cost (HKAS 40.60). Revaluation surplus 重估盈餘（入 OCI，唔入 P&L） On transfer to investment property, the uplift of the owner occupied property to fair value is credited to revaluation surplus in other comprehensive income under HKAS 16. Directly attributable expenditure 直接應佔開支（律師費、物業轉讓稅等，計入成本） Property transfer taxes are directly attributable expenditure included in the cost of an owned investment property (HKAS 40.21).

title: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A vacant building held to be leased out by the entity as a lessor under on…
text: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A vacant building held to be leased out by the entity as a lessor under one or more operating leases is specifically identified as an example of investment property (HKAS 40.8(d)). Property occupied by employees is owner occupied property even if employees pay rent at market rates (HKAS 40.9(c)) — option A. Property held for sale in the ordinary course of business is inventory within HKAS 2 (HKAS 40.9(a)) — option C. A building used as the entity's administrative head office is owner occupied property within HKAS 16 — option D. 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵係睇「持有目的」同「cash flows 係咪獨立」。A 係經典伏位：員工宿舍即使收市值租金都係 owner occupied property，因為佢嘅 cash flows 係同公司營運一齊產生。C 係「短期內出售」→ inventory（HKAS 2）。D 係自用行政樓 → HKAS 16。只有 B 係「空置但持有作出租」— vacant 唔代表自用，HKAS 40.8(d) 明確列為 IP。 Rule Check: HKAS 40.8(d); HKAS 40.9(a), (c) Common Trap（繁中）: 以為「收租 = IP」就會揀 A — 但對象係員工，仍然係 owner occupied。另外唔好以為空置樓冇用途就唔係 IP；相反，「用途未定嘅土地」反而係 IP（HKAS 40.8(b)）。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Purchase price 80,000 + legal fees 1,200 + property transfer taxes 3,400 = HK$84,600,000 Legal fees and property transfer taxes are transaction costs — directly attributable expenditure included in cost (HKAS 40.20–21). Advertising to attract tenants is a start up cost — expensed (HKAS 40.23). Abnormal wasted materials from the typhoon interruption — expensed, not capitalised (HKAS 40.23(c)). 解題思路（繁中）: A (HK$85.1m) 錯在將廣告費資本化 — advertising 係 start up cost，HKAS 40.23 明確排除。B (HK$86.6m) 錯在將 abnormal waste（颱風造成嘅異常浪費）計入成本 — 呢類支出要即刻出 P&L。D (HK$81.2m) 錯在漏咗 property transfer taxes — 印花稅／轉讓稅係 transaction costs，必須計入 IP 成本（唔同 HKFRS 9 下 FVTPL 金融資產嘅處理）。 Rule Check: HKAS 40.20–21 (elements of cost); HKAS 40.23(a),(c) (exclusions) Common Trap（繁中）: 記住 IP 嘅 transaction costs 係「加」入成本；考試成日混埋「abnormal waste」同埋「達到預計入住率前嘅經營虧損」嚟呃你 — 三樣排除項要背熟。 Q3 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Under the fair value model, the investment property is remeasured to fair value at each reporting date with the change recognised in profit or loss (HKAS 40.33, 40.35). The fair value movement during 20X1 is measured from the previous reporting date's fair value: HK$52m − HK$48m = HK$4m decrease → Dr Fair value loss (profit or loss) HK$4m / Cr Investment property HK$4m. No depreciation is charged under the fair value model. 解題思路（繁中）: B (Dr IP 3 / Cr gain 3) 係用咗「由買入價 HK$45m 到而家 HK$48m」嘅累計升值 — 錯，因為上年嘅 HK$7m gain 已經喺 20X0 年認咗，本年只認「由上年年結 fair value 起計」嘅變動。C 錯在將 fair value loss 放入 OCI — IP 嘅 fair value 升跌永遠入 P&L，唔入 OCI（呢點同 HKAS 16 revaluation model 相反）。D 錯在 fair value model 下根本唔折舊，而且題目已講明唔計折舊。 Rule Check: HKAS 40.33; HKAS 40.35 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大伏位：(1) 用累計變動（成本對比最新 FV）而唔係年度變動；(2) 將 IP fair value 變動當成 PPE revaluation 咁擺入 OCI / revaluation surplus — 記住 fair value model = 全數入 profit or loss。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Workings: Annual depreciation = (HK$90m − HK$6m) ÷ 40 = HK$2.1m Carrying amount at 1 January 20X5 = 90 − (2.1 × 12) = HK$64.8m Depreciation for 4 months to 30 April 20X5 (date of change in use) = 2.1 × 4/12 = HK$0.7m Carrying amount at 30 April 20X5 = 64.8 − 0.7 = HK$64.1m Revaluation increase to fair value = 70 − 64.1 = HK$5.9m , recognised in revaluation surplus through OCI under the HKAS 16 revaluation rules (no prior P&L revaluation decrease exists). Per HKAS 40.61–62: depreciation is updated to the date of change in use; the uplift on transfer to fair value model investment property is treated as an HKAS 16 revaluation (→ OCI), not as an HKAS 40 fair value gain. 解題思路（繁中）: A (HK$5.2m) 係漏咗計 20X5 年頭 4 個月折舊（70 − 64.8）— 轉撥前要將折舊計到 change in use 嗰日。C (HK$0) 係錯用「cost model → cost model 賬面值不變」嘅規則 — 但呢度轉入嘅係 fair value model IP，必須重估。D (HK$7.75m) 係計折舊時漏咗扣 residual value（90 ÷ 40 × 12⅓ 年 = 27.75；CA = 62.25；升值 7.75）— depreciable amount = cost − residual value。仲有個隱藏伏位：轉撥當日嘅升值係入 OCI（HKAS 16 規則），唔係入 P&L；轉咗做 IP 之後嘅 fair value 變動先至入 P&L。 Rule Check: HKAS 40.61–62; HKAS 16 (revaluation rules); HKAS 40.57 (end of owner occupation as evidence of change in use) Common Trap（繁中）: 三個常見錯：(1) 唔計轉撥前嗰段期間嘅折舊；(2) 唔記得扣 residual value；(3) 將轉撥升值直接入 P&L — 分界點係「轉嗰刻跟 HKAS 16，轉完之後跟 HKAS 40」。 Q5 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Commencement of development with a view to sale is evidence of a change in use, triggering a transfer from investment property to inventories on 1 September 20X1 (HKAS 40.57(d)). The June 20X1 management decision alone is not evidence of a change in use (HKAS 40.58). On transfer: (i) remeasure the IP to fair value at the date of change in use — gain of HK$47m − HK$40m = HK$7m recognised in profit or loss (HKAS 40.35, 40.60); (ii) the fair value of HK$47m becomes the deemed cost of the inventory under HKAS 2 (HKAS 40.60). At 31 December 20X1 the property is measured at the lower of deemed cost (HK$47m) and NRV; since NRV exceeds cost, it is carried at HK$47m. The subsequent fair value of HK$70m is irrelevant. 解題思路（繁中）: A 錯在年結時用返 fair value HK$70m — 轉咗做 inventory 之後就係 HKAS 2 嘅天下（lower of cost and NRV），之後嘅 fair value 唔關事。B 錯在當咗成個年度升值（70 − 40 = 30）都係 gain — 得轉撥前嗰 HK$7m 先入 P&L，而且存貨唔會以高於成本列賬。C 錯在冇喺轉撥日重估 — IP（fair value model）轉出前必須先 remeasure 到當日 fair value，唔可以按舊賬面值 HK$40m 直接過戶。仲要留意：6 月管理層「決定」出售唔算 change in use，9 月 1 日「動工起嚟賣」先算 — intention alone 唔係證據。 Rule Check: HKAS 40.57; HKAS 40.58; HKAS 40.60; HKAS 40.35; HKAS 2 (lower of cost and NRV) Common Trap（繁中）: 記住「deemed cost = 轉撥日 fair value」，之後唔准 reverse 累計 fair value gains/losses 去還原成本；亦唔好被年結嘅高 fair value 引誘去重估存貨 — inventory 上限係 NRV，唔係 fair value。

text: M6 Chapter 6: Investment Property — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Kestrel Holdings Limited (Kestrel), a Hong Kong property company, holds the following four properties. In accordance with HKAS 40, which one of the following properties qualifies as an investment property? A. A residential block leased by Kestrel as a lessor to its own employees under operating leases at market rates of rent. B. A vacant retail podium currently held by Kestrel to be leased out to tenants under one or more operating leases. C. An office building held by Kestrel with a view to disposal in the near future in the ordinary course of its business. D. A building occupied by Kestrel as its administrative head office. Question 2 Marina Vista Properties Limited (Marina Vista) purchased a completed office building on 1 March 20X1 to earn rental income under operating leases. In accordance with HKAS 40, Marina Vista classifies the building as an owned investment property. The following amounts were incurred: Item HK$’000 Purchase price 80,000 Legal fees on the purchase 1,200 Property transfer taxes 3,400 Advertising campaign to attract tenants 500 Abnormal wasted materials caused by a typhoon interrupting renovation 2,000 At what amount should Marina Vista initially measure the investment property? A. HK$85,100,000 B. HK$86,600,000 C. HK$84,600,000 D. HK$81,200,000 Question 3 Trident Land Limited (Trident) adopts the fair value model under HKAS 40 for all its investment properties. An investment property was purchased for HK$45 million on 1 January 20X0. Its fair value was HK$52 million at 31 December 20X0 and HK$48 million at 31 December 20X1. Depreciation is not charged under Trident's chosen model. Which accounting entry should Trident record for the year ended 31 December 20X1? A. Debit HK$m Credit HK$m Fair value loss (profit or loss) 4 Investment property 4 B. Debit HK$m Credit HK$m Investment property 3 Fair value gain (profit or loss) 3 C. Debit HK$m Credit HK$m Fair value loss (other comprehensive income) 4 Investment property 4 D. Debit HK$m Credit HK$m Depreciation expense 4 Accumulated depreciation – investment property 4 Question 4 Beacon Hill Properties Limited (Beacon Hill) occupied an office building as its head office until 30 April 20X5, when the company vacated the building and began holding it to earn rentals under operating leases. The building had a cost of HK$90 million, a residual value of HK$6 million and a useful life of 40 years, depreciated on a straight line basis under the HKAS 16 cost model. At 1 January 20X5, the building had been used for exactly 12 years. Beacon Hill measures its investment properties under the fair value model. The building's fair value on 30 April 20X5 was HK$70 million. The building had never previously been revalued. In accordance with HKAS 40 and HKAS 16, what amount should be recognised in other comprehensive income on 30 April 20X5 in respect of the transfer from owner occupied property to investment property? A. HK$5,200,000 B. HK$5,900,000 C. HK$0 D. HK$7,750,000 Question 5 Coral Bay Development Limited (Coral Bay) adopts the fair value model for its investment properties. It holds a parcel of land carried at HK$40 million at 31 December 20X0. On 1 September 20X1, Coral Bay commenced development of the land with a view to sale in the ordinary course of business. The land's fair value was HK$47 million on 1 September 20X1. At 31 December 20X1, the fair value of the property under development was HK$70 million, and its net realisable value exceeded its cost. Coral Bay's management had already decided in June 20X1 to sell the land, but no development or other action occurred before 1 September 20X1. In accordance with HKAS 40 and HKAS 2, which of the following correctly states (i) the gain recognised in profit or loss and (ii) the carrying amount of the property in the statement of financial position at 31 December 20X1? A. (i) Gain of HK$7 million; (ii) HK$70 million B. (i) Gain of HK$30 million; (ii) HK$70 million C. (i) No gain; (ii) HK$47 million D. (i) Gain of HK$7 million; (ii) HK$47 million

title: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
G. Key Journal Entries（全部平衡；數字取自 LP 例題，可作 template）
excerpt: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Determine whether a contract is, or contains, a lease in accordance…
text: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Determine whether a contract is, or contains, a lease in accordance with HKFRS 16 Leases . 2. Measure right of use assets and lease liabilities from the lessee's perspective, at initial recognition and subsequently. 3. Apply the lessee recognition exemptions for short term leases and leases of low value assets. 4. Classify leases as finance leases or operating leases from the lessor's perspective and account for each type. 5. Identify the presentation and disclosure requirements for lessees and lessors under HKFRS 16. 必背考點 A. Identifying a lease（Recognition gateway） HKFRS 16.9 : A contract is, or contains, a lease if it conveys the right to control the use of an identified asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration , assessed at the inception date （inception date = earlier of the date of the lease agreement and the date of commitment to the principal terms and conditions）。Recognition/initial measurement 要等到 commencement date （lessor makes the underlying asset available for use）。 Identified asset (HKFRS 16.B13) : usually explicitly specified in the contract; no identified asset if the supplier has a substantive substitution right , which requires BOTH (HKFRS 16.B14): 1. the supplier has the practical ability to substitute alternative assets throughout the period of use; AND 2. the supplier would benefit economically from substitution (benefits costs). Substitution only upon fault/damage/technical upgrade → not substantive → identified asset 仍然存在。 Right to control use (HKFRS 16.B9) requires BOTH: 1. right to obtain substantially all of the economic benefits from use (directly or indirectly, incl. subleasing) (HKFRS 16.B21); AND 2. right to direct the use (how and for what purpose — type/when/where/whether & quantity of output) (HKFRS 16.B24–B26), or such decisions are predetermined. Protective rights (e.g. limits on use to protect the supplier's asset/personnel) do not prevent the customer having the right to direct use (HKFRS 16.B28/B30 area）。 Components of a contract (HKFRS 16.12–14, B32–B33) : separate lease components (asset useable on its own + not highly dependent/interrelated with other assets) from non lease components; allocate consideration on relative stand alone prices . Lessee may use a practical expedient to aggregate non lease components (elect by class of underlying asset); the lessor has NO such expedient and must always separate. B. Lessee — Recognition & initial measurement Single lessee model : recognise a right of use (ROU) asset and a lease liability at the commencement date for ALL leases unless a recognition exemption applies (HKFRS 16.22). Lease term (HKFRS 16.18) = non cancellable period + periods covered by an extension option (only if lessee is reasonably certain to exercise ) + periods covered by a termination option (only if lessee is reasonably certain NOT to exercise ). Assessed at commencement considering economic incentives (below market option rentals, significant leasehold improvements, termination penalties, importance of asset, past practice) (HKFRS 16.B37–B40). Reassess if significant events/changes within the lessee's control occur (HKFRS 16.20). Lease liability — initial measurement (HKFRS 16.26–27) : present value of future lease payments (i.e. excluding payments made at/before commencement), comprising: 1. fixed payments less any lease incentives receivable ; 2. variable payments that depend on an index or a rate (e.g. CPI, benchmark interest rate, market rental rates) — initially measured using the index/rate at the commencement date (HKFRS 16.28); 3. amounts expected to be payable under residual value guarantees (expected payment, NOT the full guaranteed amount); 4. exercise price of a purchase option — only if reasonably certain to be exercised; 5. penalties for terminating — only if the lease term reflects the lessee exercising the termination option. ❌ Variable payments linked to performance or usage (e.g. % of lessee's sales) are EXCLUDED — expensed as incurred — to prevent manipulation of the liability. Discount rate (HKFRS 16.26, App A) : interest rate implicit in the lease (the rate making PV of lease payments + PV of unguaranteed residual value = fair value of the underlying asset + lessor's initial direct costs); if not readily determinable → lessee's incremental borrowing rate . ROU asset — initial measurement at cost (HKFRS 16.23–24) : Component Treatment Initial measurement of the lease liability + Lease payments made at or before commencement, less lease incentives received + / − Initial direct costs of the lessee (incremental, e.g. commissions, legal fees) + Estimated dismantling/removal/restoration costs when the obligation arises (HKAS 37 provision) + The lessee recognises the ROU asset , NOT the underlying asset itself. Recognition exemptions (HKFRS 16.5–6, 8) — lessee may ELECT not to recognise ROU asset/lease liability; payments expensed straight line (or another systematic basis): 1. Short term lease : lease term ≤ 12 months at commencement AND no purchase option ; election made by class of underlying asset . 2. Low value asset : assessed on the value of the asset when new , on an absolute basis (not materiality); IASB had in mind ≈ US$5,000 (≈ HK$40,000) or less — e.g. tablets, personal computers, small office furniture, telephones (IFRS 16.BC100; HKFRS 16.B3–B8). C. Lessee — Subsequent measurement Lease liability (HKFRS 16.36) : carrying amount is increased by interest (effective interest method at the rate used at commencement), reduced by lease payments made, and remeasured for reassessments or lease modifications. Changes (HKFRS 16.40, 42) : e.g. change in an index/rate used to determine variable payments → remeasure the lease liability using the original (unchanged) discount rate ; corresponding adjustment to the ROU asset ; if the ROU asset is reduced to zero , any remaining reduction goes to profit or loss (HKFRS 16.39). ROU asset (HKFRS 16.29–30) : cost model → cost less accumulated depreciation less accumulated impairment losses, adjusted for remeasurements of the lease liability. Depreciation (HKFRS 16.31–32, per HKAS 16) : If ownership transfers at end of lease term, or a purchase option is reasonably certain to be exercised → depreciate from commencement date to the end of the useful life of the underlying asset. Otherwise → depreciate from commencement date to the earlier of the end of the useful life of the ROU asset and the end of the lease term . Impairment : HKAS 36 applies to ROU assets (HKFRS 16.33). Revaluation model (HKAS 16) or fair value model (HKAS 40) permitted where applicable. D. Lessor — Classification（Recognition） Dual lessor model : at the inception date , classify each lease as a finance lease or an operating lease based on whether the lease transfers substantially all the risks and rewards incidental to ownership of the underlying asset (HKFRS 16.61–62). Substance over form. Finance lease criteria (HKFRS 16.63) — normally a finance lease if ANY of: 1. ownership transfers to the lessee by the end of the lease term; 2. purchase option at a price sufficiently lower than fair value that exercise is reasonably certain at inception; 3. lease term covers the major part of the asset's economic life (even if title does not transfer); 4. at inception, PV of lease payments ≈ substantially all of the fair value of the underlying asset; 5. the asset is so specialised that only the lessee can use it without major modifications. Additional indicators (HKFRS 16.64) : lessee bears lessor's cancellation losses; gains/losses on residual value fluctuation accrue to the lessee; lessee can continue for a secondary period at rent substantially below market. E. Lessor — Measurement Finance lease (HKFRS 16.67–70) : derecognise the underlying asset; recognise a receivable = net investment in the lease = PV of (lease payments receivable incl. fixed, index/rate based variable, RVGs from any party , purchase option price if reasonably certain, termination penalties if applicable) + PV of any unguaranteed residual value . Discount at the interest rate implicit in the lease . Two key differences vs the lessee's lease liability: (1) includes unguaranteed residual value ; (2) includes RVG guaranteed by any party (not just the lessee). Subsequent (HKFRS 16.75–77) : recognise finance income at a constant periodic rate of return on the net investment; each receipt splits into finance income + principal repayment. Apply HKFRS 9 derecognition and impairment to the net investment; review unguaranteed residual values regularly. Manufacturer or dealer lessor (HKFRS 16.71–74) : treat as an outright sale at commencement: Revenue = LOWER of fair value of the underlying asset and PV of lease payments discounted at a market rate of interest (anti abuse: prevents revenue inflation via inflated FV or artificially low interest rate); Cost of goods sold = cost (or carrying amount) of the underlying asset; Selling profit/loss = revenue − COGS, accounted for per HKFRS 15 ; Costs of obtaining the lease are expensed at commencement (NOT added to net investment). Operating lease (HKFRS 16.81–85) : lessor keeps the underlying asset in its SFP, depreciates it per HKAS 16/HKAS 38 ; lease income recognised straight line (or another systematic basis); initial direct costs added to the carrying amount of the underlying asset and expensed over the lease term on the same basis as lease income; impairment per HKAS 36 . F. Presentation & Disclosure Lessee — SFP (HKFRS 16.47–48) : ROU assets (non investment property) presented separately from other assets OR within the same line item as owned equivalents with disclosure of which line items include them; lease liabilities separately or with other liabilities with disclosure. ROU assets meeting investment property definition → presented as investment property. Lessee — P&L (HKFRS 16.49) : interest expense on the lease liability (a component of finance costs ) and depreciation on the ROU asset presented separately . Lessee — Statement of cash flows (HKFRS 16.50) : principal portion of lease payments → financing activities ; interest portion → per the lessee's HKAS 7 policy for interest paid; payments for short term / low value / variable not in liability leases → operating activities . Lessee disclosures (HKFRS 16.52–54) — single note/section, tabular format: depreciation charge for ROU assets by class of underlying asset ; interest expense on lease liabilities; short term lease expense; low value asset lease expense; expense for variable lease payments not included in the lease liability; income from subleasing ROU assets; total cash outflow for leases; additions to ROU assets; carrying amount of ROU assets at period end by class of underlying asset . Lessor disclosures : finance leases (HKFRS 16.90) — selling profit/loss, finance income on the net investment, variable payment income; operating leases (HKFRS 16.92) — lease income, separately disclosing variable lease payments not depending on an index/rate; plus qualitative and quantitative information on leasing activities and risk management of retained rights (HKFRS 16.91, 95–96). G. Key Journal Entries（全部平衡；數字取自 LP 例題，可作 template） JE1 — Lessee, initial recognition at commencement date （Apply & Analyse 2: office lease, 6 years, 4%, HK$250,000 paid at commencement, legal fees HK$20,000 unpaid, dismantling provision HK$50,000, PV of future payments HK$1,112,956） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Right of use asset 1,432,956 — Lease liability 1,112,956 — Cash 250,000 — Legal fees payable 20,000 — Provision for dismantling costs 50,000 JE2 — Lessee, interest accretion at year end （HK$1,112,956 × 4%） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Interest expense 44,518 — Lease liability 44,518 JE3 — Lessee, depreciation of ROU asset （HK$1,432,956 / 6 years, straight line） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Depreciation expense — Right of use asset 238,826 — Accumulated depreciation — Right of use asset 238,826 JE4 — Lessee, lease payment made in advance （1 Jan 20Y0 payment） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Lease liability 250,000 — Cash 250,000 JE5 — Lessee, lease payment made in arrears (payment + interest split) （Knowledge Check Q4: HK$25,000 payment; interest HK$74,561 × 5% = HK$3,728） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Lease liability 21,272 Interest expense 3,728 — Cash 25,000 JE6 — Lessee, remeasurement from change in index/rate （Illustrative Example 6: CPI linked payments; remeasured liability exceeds carrying amount by HK$4,715; original discount rate retained） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Right of use asset 4,715 — Lease liability 4,715 JE7 — Lessor (financier), finance lease commencement （Apply & Analyse 5: derecognise truck at fair value = net investment HK$373,028） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Lease receivables 373,028 — Vehicles 373,028 JE8 — Lessor (financier), receipt of lease payment + finance income （HK$150,000 received; finance income HK$373,028 × 10% = HK$37,303） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Cash 150,000 — Lease receivables 112,697 — Finance income 37,303 JE9 — Manufacturer/dealer lessor, finance lease commencement （Apply & Analyse 6: revenue = lower of PV HK$190,000 vs FV HK$200,000; COGS = carrying amount HK$170,000） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Lease receivables 190,000 Cost of Goods Sold 170,000 — Vehicles 170,000 — Revenues 190,000 JE10 — Lessor, operating lease (income + depreciation) （Apply & Analyse 7: monthly income HK$500; computer HK$20,000 + legal costs HK$3,000 capitalised, depreciated over 6 year economic life） Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Cash 500 — Lease income 500 Depreciation expense — Computer (HK$23,000/6) 3,833 — Accumulated depreciation — Computer 3,833 易混淆概念對比 Table 1 — Lessor: Finance lease vs Operating lease Finance lease Operating lease Classification trigger (HKFRS 16.61–63) Transfers substantially all risks and rewards incidental to ownership to lessee Risks and rewards retained by lessor Underlying asset in lessor's SFP Derecognised ; replaced by lease receivable (net investment in the lease) Remains in SFP (PPE/investment property); depreciated per HKAS 16/38 Income recognised Finance income at constant periodic rate of return on net investment Lease income straight line (or systematic basis) over lease term Initial direct costs Included in measuring net investment (financier); expensed at commencement (manufacturer/dealer lessor) Added to carrying amount of the underlying asset and expensed over lease term 💬 點樣分辨 考試伏位：見到 purchase option「平過市價好多」、lease term 佔 economic life「major part」、PV of payments ≈ FV 嘅「substantially all」——任何一項已足夠指向 finance lease；相反呢啲全部唔符合先係 operating lease。另一伏位： lessee 冇呢個分類 （single model），題目問 lessee 時唔好分 finance/operating。 Table 2 — Lessee's lease liability vs Lessor's net investment in the lease Lease liability (lessee) Net investment in the lease (lessor) Measurement basis (HKFRS 16.26 / 16.67–70) PV of future lease payments (payments at/before commencement excluded) PV of lease payments receivable + unguaranteed residual value Residual value guarantee Only amounts expected to be payable under RVG made by the lessee RVG from any party (lessee, related party, or third party) + unguaranteed residual value Variable payments Only those depending on an index or rate ; performance/usage based excluded Same rule for inclusion Subsequent movement + interest expense; − lease payments made; remeasurements (HKFRS 16.36) + finance income; − lease payments received; HKFRS 9 impairment (HKFRS 16.75–77) 💬 點樣分辨 考試伏位（Jun 2024 實錄）：gross vs net investment 混淆；記住 lessor 一定多咗 unguaranteed residual value ，所以即使同一租約，lessor 嘅 receivable ≠ lessee 嘅 liability。Lessee 計 RVG 用「expected to be payable」（唔係 guaranteed amount 全數）。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Under HKFRS 16.9, when does a contract contain a lease? Name the three elements and the assessment date. Back: The contract conveys the right to control the use of an identified asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration Elements: (1) an identified asset (no substantive substitution right); (2) right to obtain substantially all economic benefits from use; (3) right to direct the use (how and for what purpose) Assessed at the inception date of the contract 💬 白話解釋：三條件齊先算 lease——有指定資產、你袋走絕大部分經濟利益、你話事點用。留意判斷時點係 inception date，但入帳要等到 commencement date（資產真正可用嗰日）。 Card 2 Front: When does a supplier have a "substantive substitution right" that prevents an asset from being an identified asset? (HKFRS 16.B14) Back: BOTH conditions required: (1) supplier has the practical ability to substitute alternative assets throughout the period of use ; AND (2) supplier would benefit economically from substitution (economic benefits costs of substitution) Substitution only upon fault/damage/technical upgrade → NOT substantive Substitution possible only after a future date/event → NOT substantive at inception 💬 白話解釋：supplier 要「換得到」兼「換著數」先算 substantive。考試常見陷阱：合約寫明可以維修時替換（如壞船換船）——呢種唔算 substantive substitution right，identified asset 仍然存在，合約仍然係 lease。 Card 3 Front: How is the lease term determined under HKFRS 16.18? When must it be reassessed? Back: Lease term = non cancellable period + periods covered by an extension option (if reasonably certain to exercise ) + periods covered by a termination option (if reasonably certain NOT to exercise ) Assessed at commencement date , considering economic incentives (below market option rentals, significant leasehold improvements, termination penalties, importance of asset, past practice) (HKFRS 16.B37–B40) Reassess upon significant events/changes within the lessee's control (HKFRS 16.20) 💬 白話解釋：重點係「reasonably certain」加「economic incentive」——例如租客自己出錢做咗大額裝修，就會變成 reasonably certain 會續租，lease term 要拉長（LP 例子：6 年變 9 年）。 Card 4 Front: List the five components of lease payments included in the initial measurement of the lease liability (HKFRS 16.27). What variable payments are excluded? Back: Included: (1) fixed payments less lease incentives receivable; (2) variable payments depending on an index or rate (measured at the commencement date index/rate); (3) amounts expected to be payable under residual value guarantees ; (4) purchase option exercise price if reasonably certain to be exercised; (5) termination penalties if the lease term reflects termination Excluded: variable payments linked to performance or usage (e.g. % of sales) → expensed as incurred; also payments already made at/before commencement 💬 白話解釋：口訣「fixed、index、RVG、option、penalty」。考試伏位：RVG 計「預期要賠嘅數」唔係擔保額全數；銷售額掛鈎嘅 variable payment 因為租客可以自己操控，所以剔出 liability。 Card 5 Front: What does the cost of a right of use asset comprise at initial measurement? (HKFRS 16.23–24) Back: (1) Initial measurement of the lease liability ; PLUS (2) lease payments made at or before commencement , less lease incentives received ; PLUS (3) initial direct costs of the lessee (incremental costs of obtaining the lease, e.g. commissions, legal fees); PLUS (4) estimated dismantling, removal and restoration costs (obligation recognised per HKAS 37) 💬 白話解釋：ROU asset = liability + 開頭已付嘅租金（減 incentives）+ 直接成本 + 拆遷還原撥備。伏位：commencement date 當日付嘅第一期租金 唔計入 lease liability（唔係 future payment），但要 計入 ROU asset。 Card 6 Front: State the two lessee recognition exemptions under HKFRS 16.5–6 and their key conditions. Back: Short term lease : lease term ≤ 12 months at commencement AND no purchase option ; election by class of underlying asset Low value asset lease : assessed on the value of the asset when new , on an absolute basis (≈ US$5,000 / HK$40,000 or less; e.g. tablets, PCs, small office furniture, telephones) If elected: lease payments expensed straight line (or another systematic basis) over the lease term — no ROU asset, no lease liability 💬 白話解釋：兩個豁免都係 optional election。伏位：short term 豁免一旦合約有 purchase option 就用唔到；low value 係按「全新時值幾錢」判斷，租二手平價車但新車價高 → 唔合資格。 Card 7 Front: Over what period does a lessee depreciate a right of use asset? (HKFRS 16.31–32) Back: If ownership transfers at end of lease term, or a purchase option is reasonably certain to be exercised → depreciate from commencement date to the end of the useful life of the underlying asset Otherwise → depreciate from commencement date to the earlier of the end of the useful life of the ROU asset and the end of the lease term Depreciation method per HKAS 16 (pattern of consumption of benefits); impairment per HKAS 36 💬 白話解釋：買得晒（或肯定會買）→ 用 useful life 折舊；否則用 shorter of useful life / lease term。呢個係 past paper 實錄弱項（purchase option 對折舊期嘅影響）。 Card 8 Front: How does a manufacturer or dealer lessor account for a finance lease at the commencement date? (HKFRS 16.71–74) Back: Recognise revenue = LOWER of the fair value of the underlying asset and the PV of lease payments discounted at a market rate of interest Recognise COGS = cost (or carrying amount) of the underlying asset; derecognise the asset Selling profit/loss = revenue − COGS, per HKFRS 15 ; also recognise the net investment in the lease as a receivable Costs of obtaining the lease are expensed at commencement (they relate to earning the selling profit, not included in net investment) 💬 白話解釋：製造商/經銷商出租等於「賣咗件貨 + 做埋融資」，所以同日認 revenue 同 COGS 賺 selling profit，之後再收 finance income。兩個 anti abuse 位：revenue 取 FV 同 PV 嘅 較低者 、貼現用 market rate （唔俾你用超低利率谷大 upfront revenue）。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Right of use asset 使用權資產——你租返嚟嘅「使用權」，唔係資產本身 The lessee recognises a right of use asset at the commencement date, measured at cost under HKFRS 16.23. Lease liability 租賃負債——未來租金嘅現值 The lease liability is initially measured at the present value of the lease payments that are not paid at the commencement date. Interest rate implicit in the lease 租賃隱含利率——令租金現值＋無擔保餘值現值＝資產公允價值＋出租人直接成本嘅利率 The interest rate implicit in the lease causes the present value of lease payments and the unguaranteed residual value to equal the fair value of the underlying asset plus the lessor's initial direct costs. Lessee's incremental borrowing rate 承租人增量借款利率——隱含利率搵唔到時嘅後備利率 If the interest rate implicit in the lease cannot be readily determined, the lessee uses its incremental borrowing rate to discount the lease payments. Net investment in the lease 租賃淨投資——出租人 finance lease 嘅應收款，等於租金現值加無擔保餘值現值 At the commencement date, the lessor derecognises the underlying asset and recognises a receivable equal to its net investment in the lease. Residual value guarantee 餘值擔保——租約完結時資產價值低過擔保額，承租人要補差價 The lessee includes in the lease liability only the amount it expects to be payable under the residual value guarantee. Lease incentives 租賃優惠——業主氹你簽約嘅甜頭（如現金回贈、代付搬遷費），要扣減 ROU asset Lease incentives received are deducted from the cost of the right of use asset at initial measurement. Short term lease 短期租賃——租期 12 個月或以內且無購買選擇權，可豁免上表 A short term lease has a lease term of 12 months or less at the commencement date and does not contain a purchase option.

title: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): The contract does not contain a lease because there is no identified asset . …
text: M6 Chapter 7: Lease Accounting — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): The contract does not contain a lease because there is no identified asset . Under HKFRS 16.B13–B14, an asset explicitly specified in a contract is still not an identified asset if the supplier has a substantive substitution right . Victoria's substitution right is substantive because both conditions are met: (1) Victoria has the practical ability to substitute alternative units throughout the period of use (other comparable units in the same complex, goods on movable pallets, minimal relocation cost); and (2) Victoria would benefit economically from substitution (it can lease the premium unit to others at significantly higher rentals). Without an identified asset, the contract cannot be, or contain, a lease (HKFRS 16.9); it is a service arrangement. 解題思路（繁中）: 本題考 identified asset 嘅 substantive substitution right，兩個條件必須 同時 成立：practical ability + economic benefit。題目刻意畀齊兩個事實（可以隨時搬、搬咗賺多啲租金），所以 substitution right 係 substantive → 冇 identified asset → 唔係 lease。Distractor A 係最常見錯誤：「合約白紙黑字寫明 Unit 8」就當有 identified asset——但 LP 明確講 "Despite an asset being specified, a customer does not have the right to use the asset if the supplier has the substantive right to substitute"。Distractor B 用 control 嘅第二元素嚟混淆，但三元素要有 identified asset 先講到 control。Distractor D 錯在原因：customer 唔需要自己 operate 資產都可以有 lease（supplier 負責操作唔影響），而且真正原因係 substitution right。 Rule Check: HKFRS 16.9; HKFRS 16.B13; HKFRS 16.B14 Common Trap（繁中）: 見「資產喺合約入面寫明咗」即刻答「有 lease」。記住：寫明 ≠ identified asset，仲要 supplier 冇 substantive substitution right。反方向伏位：維修／故障時先可以替換（如壞船換船） 唔算 substantive，嗰種情況反而係 lease。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under HKFRS 16.18, the lease term comprises the non cancellable period (four years) plus periods covered by an option to extend if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option . At the commencement date, Harbour Retail has strong economic incentives to extend: (1) the rental during the optional period is set at 30% below market rates ; and (2) it has undertaken significant leasehold improvements expected to generate benefits over seven years which can only be enjoyed through continued tenancy (HKFRS 16.B37–B40). It is therefore reasonably certain the extension option will be exercised, and the lease term is 4 + 2 = 6 years . 解題思路（繁中）: 考 lease term 嘅「reasonably certain + economic incentive」判斷。題目畀咗兩個典型經濟誘因：option period 租金平過市價 30%、自己做咗大額裝修要繼續住先享受到。所以 extension option 要計入 lease term → 6 年。Distractor A 係死背「non cancellable period」嘅半桶水答案——non cancellable period 只係起點，extension option 要按 reasonable certainty 加入。Distractor C 錯在等行使先計——assessment 係喺 commencement date 做（LP 原話：The assessment ... is made at the commencement date of the lease）。Distractor D 亂用裝修受益期 7 年——裝修期只係證據，唔係 lease term 本身。 Rule Check: HKFRS 16.18; HKFRS 16.B37–B40 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個方向都會考：有 economic incentive 唔續租 → termination option 期間 唔計入 （lease term 縮短）；有 incentive 續租 → extension period 計入 （lease term 拉長）。睇清楚題目係 extension 定 termination option，同埋 incentive 指向邊一邊。 Q3 — Answer: B (HK$281,169) Model Answer (EN): The lease liability is initially measured at the present value of the lease payments not paid at the commencement date (HKFRS 16.26–27): Fixed payments: HK$80,000 × 4 years, in arrears, discounted at 6%: 80,000/1.06 + 80,000/1.06² + 80,000/1.06³ + 80,000/1.06⁴ = 75,472 + 71,200 + 67,170 + 63,367 = HK$277,209 Expected payment under the residual value guarantee: 5,000/1.06⁴ = HK$3,960 Variable payments linked to Bamboo's sales (2% of annual sales): excluded — they depend on the lessee's performance, not on an index or rate. Lease liability = 277,209 + 3,960 = HK$281,169 解題思路（繁中）: 三個考點一次過：(1) RVG 只計 expected to be payable （HK$5,000），唔係擔保額全數 HK$20,000——錯用全數就會揀 A（HK$293,051 = 277,209 + 20,000/1.06⁴ = 277,209 + 15,842）；(2) 銷售掛鈎 variable payment 唔入 liability——錯誤加入 HK$10,000/年會揀 D（HK$315,820）；(3) 要折現——唔折現直接加總（80,000×4 + 5,000）會揀 C（HK$325,000）。留意 payments in arrears 用普通年金 t=1 至 4；如果係 in advance，第一期喺 commencement date 已付，根本唔入 liability（呢個係另一常見伏位）。 Rule Check: HKFRS 16.26; HKFRS 16.27; HKFRS 16.28 Common Trap（繁中）: 記住 RVG 口訣「計預期、唔計足額」；variable payment 只有掛鈎 index or rate （CPI、benchmark interest rate、market rental、匯率）先入 liability，掛鈎銷售/用量一律 expense as incurred。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under HKFRS 16.36, the lease liability is increased by interest (effective interest method) and reduced by lease payments made. Interest for the year = HK$500,000 × 5% = HK$25,000 . The HK$120,000 payment in arrears is therefore split between interest and principal repayment: Account Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Interest expense 25,000 Lease liability (120,000 − 25,000) 95,000 — Cash 120,000 After the payment, the lease liability = 500,000 + 25,000 − 120,000 = HK$405,000 . 解題思路（繁中）: 題目係 payment in arrears，所以年尾嗰 HK$120,000 入面已經包含咗全年利息，要拆開 interest 同 principal 兩份——呢個係 LP Knowledge Check Q4 嘅標準做法。Distractor A 全數減 liability，完全冇計 interest，違反 effective interest method。Distractor C 只入 interest accretion 嗰條（呢條分錄本身係啱嘅，但係 未記錄付款 ——題目問嘅係「in respect of the lease payment」嗰條 entry）。Distractor D 將 principal 部分 debit 落 ROU asset，大錯——付款只影響 lease liability 同 cash，ROU asset 只會因 depreciation／liability remeasurement 而變。 Rule Check: HKFRS 16.36; HKFRS 16.BC182 (effective interest method) Common Trap（繁中）: 分清楚兩種付款時點： in arrears → 一條 entry（Dr Lease liability + Dr Interest expense / Cr Cash）； in advance （年頭付款）→ 付款時已冇未到期利息，entry 係 Dr Lease liability / Cr Cash，利息係之前一年年尾已經 accrete 咗（Dr Interest expense / Cr Lease liability）。考試見到 1 Jan 付款就唔好再計當年利息入嗰條 payment entry。 Q5 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Dragon Motors is a manufacturer or dealer lessor , so the finance lease is accounted for as an outright sale of the underlying asset at commencement (HKFRS 16.71–74): Revenue = lower of the fair value of the underlying asset (HK$400,000) and the present value of the lease payments discounted at a market rate of interest (HK$380,000) → HK$380,000 Cost of goods sold = carrying amount of the van = HK$320,000 Selling profit = 380,000 − 320,000 = HK$60,000 Costs incurred in obtaining the finance lease (HK$8,000) are expensed at the commencement date — they relate mainly to earning the selling profit and are not included in the net investment in the lease. (Finance income on the net investment is subsequently recognised over the lease term at a constant periodic rate of return.) 解題思路（繁中）: Manufacturer/dealer lessor 兩個 anti abuse rule 要記死：(1) revenue 取 FV 同 PV（market rate 折現）嘅較低者 ——呢度 PV 380,000 低過 FV 400,000，所以 revenue 係 380,000，唔係 400,000；用 FV 就會揀 B 或 D。(2) 攞租約嘅成本 commencement date 即刻 expense ——錯誤咗加入 net investment 就會揀 B。Distractor C 係 financier lessor 嘅處理（只有 finance income，冇 selling profit）——題目講明 Dragon Motors 係 dealer，賣車賺差價係佢嘅 business model，所以一定要認 revenue + COGS。 Rule Check: HKFRS 16.71; HKFRS 16.72; HKFRS 16.73; HKFRS 16.74 Common Trap（繁中）: 「lower of」規則嘅立法原意係防止 lessor 谷大 selling price（虛高 FV）或用超低利率谷大 PV，從而喺 commencement date 認過多 revenue。另一伏位：financier lessor vs manufacturer/dealer lessor 嘅 initial direct costs 處理相反——前者入 net investment，後者即時 expense。考試見題先問自己：呢個 lessor 係賣貨嘅定係做融資嘅？
