excerpt: M6 Chapter 10: Financial Assets, Financial Liabilities and Equity Instruments — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The preference shares are fina…
text: M6 Chapter 10: Financial Assets, Financial Liabilities and Equity Instruments — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The preference shares are financial liabilities. Under HKAS 32, an instrument is a financial liability if the issuer has a contractual obligation to deliver cash or another financial asset to the holder. Crescent Bay Limited has an unconditional obligation to pay the 7% dividend (it cannot elect to withhold payment) and an obligation to redeem the shares at par for cash at a fixed date. Both features are contractual obligations to deliver cash, so the shares are classified as financial liabilities despite their legal form as "shares". Classification follows substance over legal form. 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵係睇實質唔睇名。強制派息（non discretionary）＋到期強制贖回 = 發行人有 contractual obligation to deliver cash，所以係 financial liability。A 錯：法律形式係「股」但經濟實質係債。C 錯：冇任何 equity 成分 — 股息同本金都係強制現金流出（compound instrument 分拆屬 module 範圍外，但呢度連部分權益都唔存在）。D 錯：由發行人角度，呢啲係 obligations，唔係 assets。考試伏位：discretionary dividend（可選擇唔派、唔累積）+ liquidation 時與普通股同級 → 先至係 equity。 Rule Check: HKAS 32.11 (definition of financial liability; equity instrument conditions) Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「preference shares」個「share」字就直覺揀 equity — 考試專登用呢啲名實不符嘅工具考你 substance over form。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The shares are equity instruments of another entity, so their cash flows are not solely payments of principal and interest; moreover they are held for trading. They must be measured at fair value through profit or loss (HKFRS 9.4.1.4). For FVTPL assets, initial measurement is at fair value excluding transaction costs, which are expensed immediately to profit or loss. Initial carrying amount = 20,000 × HK$12 = HK$240,000 ; the HK$3,000 brokerage fee is recognised in profit or loss. 解題思路（繁中）: 兩步：(1) 股票 cash flows 唔係 SPPI，兼且 held for trading → FVTPL；(2) FVTPL 嘅 transaction costs 唔可以資本化，要即時 expense。A 錯：將交易成本 扣除 （HK$240,000 − HK$3,000）— 方向錯，交易成本永遠唔會減少初始賬面值。C 錯：HK$243,000 係 amortised cost / FVOCI 嘅做法（fair value + transaction costs）— 呢個係最常見混淆。D 錯：HK$260,000（20,000 × HK$13）係用年結日公平值，但題目問 初始 確認，唔係後續計量。考試伏位：記住「FVTPL = 費用化；其餘兩類 = 資本化」。 Rule Check: HKFRS 9.5.1.1 (initial measurement at fair value); HKFRS 9.4.1.4 (FVTPL classification) Common Trap（繁中）: 睇漏「held for trading」/「actively trading」呢啲字眼，或者背錯邊類先加交易成本 — FVTPL 唔加，amortised cost 同 FVOCI 先加。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The bonds are measured at amortised cost (hold to collect business model + SPPI cash flows). Amortised cost roll forward using the effective interest method: Year Opening HK$ Interest revenue (EIR 6.5%) HK$ Coupon received (5% × 2,000,000) HK$ Closing HK$ 20X8 1,920,000 124,800 (100,000) 1,944,800 20X9 1,944,800 126,412 (100,000) 1,971,212 Workings: 20X8 interest = 1,920,000 × 6.5% = 124,800; closing = 1,920,000 + 124,800 − 100,000 = 1,944,800. 20X9 interest = 1,944,800 × 6.5% = 126,412; closing = 1,944,800 + 126,412 − 100,000 = 1,971,212 . The bonds were acquired at a discount, so the carrying amount accretes towards the HK$2,000,000 redemption value. 解題思路（繁中）: 貼士：折扣買入嘅債券，amortised cost 每年 上升 行向面值 — 可以即刻 sanity check 答案。A 錯：HK$1,944,800 只係第一年尾嘅結餘，做少咗一年。C 錯：HK$1,974,800 係用 EIR 乘 面值 （2,000,000 × 6.5% = 130,000；1,944,800 + 130,000 − 100,000）— EIR 要乘期初賬面值，唔係面值。D 錯：HK$2,044,800 係將成個 coupon 加落賬面值（1,944,800 + 100,000），冇分清「EIR 利息入 P&L」同「coupon 係現金收回」。考試伏位：coupon rate 決定現金流，EIR 決定 P&L — 兩個率唔好調亂。 Rule Check: HKFRS 9.4.1.2 (amortised cost criteria); HKFRS 9.App A (effective interest method definitions) Common Trap（繁中）: 用 coupon rate 計 interest revenue，或者忘記第二年要用第一年嘅 closing balance 做 opening — 呢類 roll forward 題一定要逐年推。 Q4 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): The transfer qualifies for derecognition: Maple Grove Limited has transferred its rights to the cash flows and the bank assumes the full risk of non collection with no recourse, so substantially all risks and rewards of ownership have been transferred (HKFRS 9.3.2.6(a)). On derecognition, the difference between the carrying amount and the consideration received is recognised in profit or loss (HKFRS 9.3.2.12): Dr Cash HK$760,000 Dr Loss on transfer (profit or loss) HK$40,000 Cr Trade receivables HK$800,000 (Dr total = Cr total = HK$800,000 — the entry balances.) 解題思路（繁中）: 無追索權（no recourse）= 銀行承受收唔到錢嘅風險 = risks and rewards 已轉移 = derecognise。B 錯：只留下 HK$40,000 應收喺賬上，冇反映成個轉讓，虧損冇入賬。C 錯：Dr Cash / Cr Loan 係「唔符合 derecognition」（例如有追索權、fixed price repurchase）嘅處理 — 保留資產兼另認負債；但呢個 case 係無追索權，所以唔啱用呢個方法，呢個係最危險嘅 distractor。D 錯：現金實收只有 HK$760,000，唔可能 Dr Cash 800,000。考試伏位：見「with recourse / 須償還墊款」→ 唔 derecognise；見「no recourse / 對方承受壞賬風險」→ derecognise 兼認 loss/gain。 Rule Check: HKFRS 9.3.2.3; HKFRS 9.3.2.6(a); HKFRS 9.3.2.12 (derecognition and P&L on transfer); HKFRS 9.3.2.6(b) (transfers not qualifying) Common Trap（繁中）: 混淆 qualifying 與 non qualifying transfer 嘅分錄 — non qualifying 係 Cr financial liability 兼唔准 offset；qualifying 係成個 Cr Trade receivables 走數，差額入 P&L。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Statement C is correct. In Stage 1 (no significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition), the loss allowance is measured at an amount equal to 12 month expected credit losses , and interest revenue is calculated by applying the effective interest rate to the gross carrying amount (before deducting the loss allowance). Statement A is wrong: Stage 2 requires lifetime ECL (not 12 month ECL) and interest is still on the gross carrying amount. Statement B is wrong: in Stage 3 interest revenue is calculated on the net carrying amount (gross less loss allowance). Statement D is wrong: the 30 days past due rule is only a rebuttable presumption of a significant increase in credit risk (Stage 2), not automatic credit impairment (Stage 3). 解題思路（繁中）: 用口訣「12 Gross / Life Gross / Life Net」可以秒殺呢類題：Stage 1 = 12 month ECL + gross basis；Stage 2 = lifetime ECL + gross basis；Stage 3 = lifetime ECL + net basis。A 將 Stage 2 嘅 allowance 同 interest basis 都講錯。B 係 Stage 3 嘅 allowance 啱但 interest basis 錯（net 先啱）。D 係典型伏位：30 日逾期只係 significant increase in credit risk 嘅 rebuttable presumption ，即預設入 Stage 2 而唔係 Stage 3；credit impaired 要有實際違約/破產等 detrimental events。記住 Stage 2 同 Stage 3 唯一分別係 interest revenue 嘅計算基礎。 Rule Check: HKFRS 9.5.5.3 (Stage 1: 12 month ECL); HKFRS 9.5.5.5 (Stage 2: lifetime ECL); HKFRS 9.B5.5.17 (30 days past due rebuttable presumption); HKFRS 9.5.5.11 / 9.5.4.1(b) (Stage 3: interest on net carrying amount) Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 以為 Stage 2 起 interest 就用 net basis — 其實 Stage 3 先轉 net；(2) 將 30 日逾期直接等同 credit impaired；(3) 忘記 Stage 1 即使有 lifetime ECL 估計都只確認 12 month ECL。

title: M6 Chapter 10: Financial Assets, Financial Liabilities and Equity Instruments — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 10: Financial Assets, Financial Liabilities and Equity Instruments — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 10: Financial Assets, Financial Liabilities and Equity Instruments — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. ……
text: M6 Chapter 10: Financial Assets, Financial Liabilities and Equity Instruments — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Crescent Bay Limited issued 200,000 preference shares with a par value of HK$10 each. The shares carry a mandatory dividend of 7% of par value per annum, which the company cannot elect to withhold, and the shares are redeemable at par at a fixed date five years after issue. In accordance with HKAS 32, how should Crescent Bay Limited classify the preference shares in its statement of financial position? A. As equity instruments, because they are issued in the legal form of shares B. As financial liabilities, because the company has a contractual obligation to deliver cash to the holders C. As compound instruments, with the dividend stream classified as a financial liability and the redemption amount classified as equity D. As financial assets, because the shares will generate future cash outflows Q2. On 1 October 20X8, Harbour Stone Limited acquired 20,000 listed ordinary shares in Brightfield Limited at HK$12 per share, paying brokerage fees of HK$3,000. Harbour Stone Limited acquired the shares with the intention of actively trading them for short term profits. In accordance with HKFRS 9, at what amount should the investment be initially measured on 1 October 20X8? A. HK$237,000 B. HK$240,000 C. HK$243,000 D. HK$260,000 Q3. On 1 January 20X8, Kettlewell Limited purchased bonds with a face value of HK$2,000,000 for HK$1,920,000 (inclusive of directly attributable transaction costs). The bonds pay a contractual coupon of 5% per annum on face value, in arrears on 31 December each year, and are redeemable at face value on 31 December 20Y0. Kettlewell Limited holds the bonds within a business model whose objective is to collect contractual cash flows, and the cash flows are solely payments of principal and interest. The effective interest rate of the bonds is 6.5%. In accordance with HKFRS 9, what is the carrying amount of the bonds in Kettlewell Limited's statement of financial position as at 31 December 20X9? A. HK$1,944,800 B. HK$1,971,212 C. HK$1,974,800 D. HK$2,044,800 Q4. Maple Grove Limited sells goods on 90 day credit terms. To improve its working capital, it enters into an agreement with a bank under which it transfers the contractual rights to the cash flows of a portfolio of trade receivables with a carrying amount of HK$800,000 to the bank for consideration of HK$760,000. The bank assumes the full risk of the receivables being uncollectible and has no recourse to Maple Grove Limited for any amounts not collected. Which set of journal entries correctly records this transaction in the books of Maple Grove Limited? A. Dr Cash HK$760,000; Dr Loss on transfer (profit or loss) HK$40,000; Cr Trade receivables HK$800,000 B. Dr Cash HK$760,000; Cr Trade receivables HK$760,000 C. Dr Cash HK$760,000; Cr Loan from bank HK$760,000 D. Dr Cash HK$800,000; Cr Trade receivables HK$800,000 Q5. In accordance with HKFRS 9's general approach to impairment (the expected credit loss model), which of the following statements is correct? A. In Stage 2, the loss allowance is measured at 12 month expected credit losses and interest revenue is calculated on the net carrying amount. B. In Stage 3, the loss allowance is measured at lifetime expected credit losses and interest revenue is calculated on the gross carrying amount. C. In Stage 1, the loss allowance is measured at 12 month expected credit losses and interest revenue is calculated on the gross carrying amount. D. A financial asset that is more than 30 days past due is always credit impaired and must be classified in Stage 3.

title: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
1. Recognition — 何時要做減值測試、減值點樣入賬
excerpt: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Identify common external and internal indicators of impairment…
text: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Identify common external and internal indicators of impairment and determine when an impairment test must be performed under HKAS 36. 2. Calculate the recoverable amount of an asset or CGU as the higher of fair value less costs of disposal (FVLCD) and value in use (VIU). 3. Account for impairment losses for individual assets (cost model and revaluation model) and allocate impairment losses within a cash generating unit (CGU), including goodwill. 4. Account for the reversal of impairment losses, applying the ceiling in HKAS 36.117, and explain why goodwill impairment losses are never reversed. 5. Prepare the disclosures required by HKAS 36 for impairment losses and reversals. 必背考點 1. Recognition — 何時要做減值測試、減值點樣入賬 Scope exclusions (HKAS 36.2): HKAS 36 唔涵蓋 inventories、deferred tax assets、investment property measured at fair value、biological assets within the scope of HKAS 41。考試見到呢啲資產，唔好用 HKAS 36。 Assessment each period (HKAS 36.9): At the end of each reporting period, assess whether there is any indication that an asset may be impaired. 一般資產只有喺有 indication 先要做 full impairment test。 Mandatory annual testing (HKAS 36.10) — 三類資產每年必測，無論有冇 indication: 1. Intangible assets with an indefinite useful life (HKAS 36.10(a)); 2. Intangible assets not yet available for use (HKAS 36.10(b)); 3. Goodwill acquired in a business combination (tested via the CGU to which it is allocated). Indications of impairment (HKAS 36.12): External: market capitalisation below carrying amount of net assets; adverse technological/market/economic/legal changes; new competitors; unfavourable FX movements; changes in legislation. Internal: obsolescence or physical damage; asset becoming idle or plans to discontinue/restructure/dispose early; reassessing useful life from indefinite to finite; declining sales/net profit; loss of significant customers; actual cash flows significantly worse than budgeted. 伏位：資產損耗比預期快（例如飛機喺嚴寒航線老化快啲） 唔係 impairment indicator — 呢個係要 review depreciation（LP Illustrative Example 1）。 Impairment exists when carrying amount recoverable amount (HKAS 36.59): the carrying amount is reduced to the recoverable amount; the reduction is the impairment loss. Recognition — cost model (HKAS 36.60): impairment loss recognised immediately in profit or loss . Recognition — revaluation model (HKAS 36.60–61): treated as a revaluation decrease — recognised in OCI against the revaluation surplus for that same asset, to the extent of the surplus; any excess goes to profit or loss . Cannot reduce below zero (HKAS 36.62): an asset is written down to nil at most, unless a liability is required to be recognised by another standard. Post impairment depreciation (HKAS 36.63): future depreciation/amortisation is adjusted to allocate the revised carrying amount (less residual value) over the remaining useful life. Reversal recognition (HKAS 36.119): reversal recognised immediately in profit or loss, unless the asset is carried at a revalued amount, in which case it is an increase in the revaluation surplus in OCI (any amount previously taken to P&L is reversed through P&L first). Goodwill reversal prohibited (HKAS 36.124): impairment losses recognised for goodwill cannot be reversed in subsequent periods (any increase is likely internally generated goodwill, which HKAS 38 prohibits recognising). 2. Measurement — Recoverable Amount 點計 Recoverable amount (HKAS 36.6) = the HIGHER of: Fair value less costs of disposal (FVLCD) — market based measure, fair value per HKFRS 13. Costs of disposal = incremental costs directly attributable to disposal, excluding finance costs and income tax expense (HKAS 36.6); e.g. legal costs, stamp duty, dismantling/removal costs. Value in use (VIU) — entity specific measure: the present value of future cash flows expected from continuing use and ultimate disposal. VIU 兩大步驟: (1) estimate future cash inflows/outflows from continuing use and ultimate disposal; (2) discount them to present value (HKAS 36.30–32). Cash flow projections must be based on reasonable and supportable assumptions (management's best estimate). Discount rate (HKAS 36.55–56): a pre tax rate reflecting current market assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the asset (e.g. WACC as surrogate). 考試伏位：唔好用 post tax rate 配 pre tax cash flows 之餘仲要記住 rate 係 pre tax。 Indefinite life intangible shortcut (HKAS 36.24): may use the most recent detailed recoverable amount calculation if (i) the CGU composition has not changed significantly, (ii) the last calculation exceeded carrying amount by a substantial margin, and (iii) the likelihood that current RA < CA is remote. CGU (HKAS 36.6, 36.66): the smallest identifiable group of assets that generates cash inflows largely independent of the cash inflows from other assets or groups of assets. Test individual asset first; only if its RA cannot be determined do you test the CGU. If an active market exists for the output of an asset, treat the asset's operation as a separate CGU and use market prices (not internal transfer prices) for VIU. CGU carrying amount consistency (HKAS 36.76–79): include only assets directly attributable or allocable on a reasonable and consistent basis; exclude recognised liabilities unless the CGU's RA cannot be determined without considering the liability (integrated, sold together). Allocation of CGU impairment loss (HKAS 36.104): 1. First, reduce the carrying amount of any goodwill allocated to the CGU; 2. Then, reduce the other assets pro rata to their carrying amounts; 3. Floor (HKAS 36.105): no asset is reduced below the highest of its FVLCD (if measurable), its VIU (if determinable), and zero . Any unallocated excess goes pro rata to the other assets. Corporate assets (HKAS 36.100–102(a)): e.g. head office building — do not generate independent cash inflows; if allocable on a reasonable and consistent basis, allocate a portion to each CGU and compare (CGU carrying amount + allocated portion) with RA. Goodwill (HKAS 36.81): on acquisition, allocate to each CGU (or group of CGUs) expected to benefit from the synergies. Testing: annually at the same time each year (different CGUs may test at different times) and whenever an indicator exists (HKAS 36.90, 36.96); CGUs receiving goodwill in the current period must be tested before the end of the current reporting period (HKAS 36.96); if an asset within the CGU is tested at the same time, test the asset first (HKAS 36.97). Reversal ceiling (HKAS 36.117): the increased carrying amount must not exceed the carrying amount that would have been determined (net of depreciation/amortisation) had no impairment loss been recognised in prior years. For a CGU, the reversal is allocated pro rata to assets other than goodwill , subject to the same per asset ceiling (HKAS 36.122–123). 3. Disclosure (HKAS 36.126, 36.130) By class of assets (HKAS 36.126): Impairment losses recognised in P&L and the line item(s) in which they are included; Impairment losses on revalued assets recognised in OCI; Same two disclosures for reversals . For each material impairment loss or reversal (HKAS 36.130): The amount; the events and circumstances that led to recognition/reversal; the nature of the asset or description of the CGU; The recoverable amount and whether it is FVLCD or VIU; If FVLCD: the level of the HKFRS 13 fair value hierarchy; if Level 2 or 3 — valuation technique(s), any change in technique and reasons, key assumptions, and discount rate(s) if a present value technique is used; If VIU: the discount rate(s) used in the current and previous estimate. 4. Key Journal Entries (all balanced) (a) Impairment — cost model (HKAS 36.60): Account Dr (HK$) Cr (HK$) Impairment loss (P&L) xxx Accumulated impairment losses xxx (b) Impairment — revaluation model (carrying amount 550; revaluation surplus 150; recoverable amount 375 → loss 175, per LP Illustrative Example 4): Account Dr (HK$m) Cr (HK$m) Accumulated depreciation 100 Airplane (eliminate accumulated depreciation) 100 Revaluation surplus (OCI) 150 Impairment loss (P&L) (excess over surplus) 25 Airplane (write down to recoverable amount) 175 Total 275 275 (c) CGU impairment (HKAS 36.104) — goodwill written off first, remainder pro rata (per LP Exam Practice Q3, May CGU, loss HK$1,284,000): Account Dr (HK$) Cr (HK$) Impairment loss (P&L) 1,284,000 Accumulated impairment — goodwill 276,000 Accumulated impairment — land 439,535 Accumulated impairment — plant 383,860 Accumulated impairment — patent 184,605 Total 1,284,000 1,284,000 (d) Reversal — cost model (HKAS 36.119): Account Dr (HK$) Cr (HK$) Accumulated impairment losses xxx Reversal of impairment loss (P&L) xxx 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Individual Asset Testing vs CGU Testing Individual Asset Cash Generating Unit (CGU) When used Default level — test the asset alone if its recoverable amount can be determined Only when the asset does not generate largely independent cash inflows and its RA cannot be determined individually (HKAS 36.66) Unit definition The single asset Smallest identifiable group of assets generating cash inflows largely independent of other assets (HKAS 36.6) Goodwill in test N/A Compare CA of CGU including allocated goodwill with RA (HKAS 36.90) Loss allocation Entire loss to that asset Goodwill first, then pro rata to other assets (HKAS 36.104) Per asset floor Written down to RA (not below zero, HKAS 36.62) No asset below highest of its own FVLCD / VIU / zero (HKAS 36.105) 點樣分辨 / 考試伏位 見到個別機器、車輛「generates cash flows largely independent」→ 個別測。注意：有 active market for the output → 要當獨立 CGU，VIU 用 market price 唔係 internal transfer price CGU 考題必伏位：(1) 攞錯 CA 基準（記住 cash/receivables/inventories 唔寫低，但計 CA 總數時要一致）；(2) 冇先撇 goodwill；(3) 用 cost 而唔係 carrying amount 做 pro rata；(4) 忘記 floor 限制 Table 2: Impairment & Reversal — Cost Model vs Revaluation Model Cost Model Revaluation Model Impairment loss recognised in Profit or loss, immediately (HKAS 36.60) OCI against revaluation surplus for the same asset; excess over surplus → P&L (HKAS 36.60–61) Reversal recognised in Profit or loss (HKAS 36.119) OCI as increase in revaluation surplus; but any amount previously expensed in P&L is reversed through P&L first (HKAS 36.119) Ceiling on reversal Increased CA ≤ CA that would have existed (net of depreciation) had no impairment occurred (HKAS 36.117) Same ceiling applies Goodwill Impairment never reversed (HKAS 36.124) N/A (goodwill is never revalued) 點樣分辨 / 考試伏位 題目講「carried at cost」→ 全部落 P&L，簡單 最大伏位： surplus 用晒之後嘅 excess 先落 P&L ，同埋 reversal 時要倒返轉頭——之前落咗 P&L 嘅部分要經 P&L 撥回，唔係全部入 OCI。另一伏位：reversal 唔可以衝過「無減值折舊後原值」條線 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: How is the "recoverable amount" of an asset determined under HKAS 36, and when does an impairment loss arise? Back: Recoverable amount = the higher of fair value less costs of disposal (FVLCD) and value in use (VIU) (HKAS 36.6). An impairment loss arises when the asset's carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount (HKAS 36.59); the asset is written down to recoverable amount. 💬 記住係「 higher of」唔係「lower of」——Jun 2023 考官報告特別點名考生攞錯做 lower。邏輯：企業會揀對自己最有利嘅出路（賣或用），所以取高者；賬面值高過呢個數先至要撇減。 Card 2 Front: Which three categories of assets must be tested for impairment annually, regardless of whether any indication of impairment exists? Back: (HKAS 36.10) Intangible assets with an indefinite useful life ; Intangible assets not yet available for use ; Goodwill acquired in a business combination (tested through its CGU). 💬 口訣：「無限期、未用得、商譽」三寶年年驗。有明確年期嘅資產（例如 20 year franchise）只係有 indication 先測——呢個係 MCQ 常見反向問法。 Card 3 Front: Give two external and two internal indicators of impairment under HKAS 36.12. Back: External: market capitalisation falls below the carrying amount of net assets; new competitors / adverse market, technological, economic or legal changes. Internal: evidence of obsolescence or physical damage; plans to discontinue/restructure/dispose of the asset early or asset becoming idle; actual cash flows significantly worse than budgeted. 💬 分辨技巧：external = 企業控制唔到嘅大環境（市場、法例、競爭對手、匯率）；internal = 公司內部營運嘅事（資產閒置、業績差過預算、提早出售計劃）。注意伏位：資產折舊快過預期 ≠ impairment indicator，係要 review depreciation。 Card 4 Front: What are the two steps in estimating value in use, and what type of discount rate must be used? Back: Step 1: estimate future cash inflows and outflows from continuing use and ultimate disposal (reasonable and supportable assumptions); Step 2: discount those cash flows to present value. The discount rate must be a pre tax rate reflecting current market assessments of the time value of money and risks specific to the asset (HKAS 36.55–56). 💬 VIU 係 entity specific（用自己 budget/forecast），FVLCD 係 market based（用 HKFRS 13）。考試俾你做 PV 計數時，discount rate 題目會俾；概念題就考你「pre tax」呢個字。 Card 5 Front: Define a cash generating unit (CGU) and state when impairment testing is performed at CGU level. Back: CGU = the smallest identifiable group of assets that generates cash inflows largely independent of the cash inflows from other assets or groups of assets (HKAS 36.6). Test at CGU level only when the recoverable amount of the individual asset cannot be determined (e.g. the asset does not generate independent cash inflows) (HKAS 36.66). If an active market exists for an asset's output, that operation is a separate CGU; use market prices (not internal transfer prices) in VIU. 💬 諗法：一架礦場專用鐵路自己賺唔到錢 → 要成個礦場當一個 CGU 測。判斷「largely independent」係 professional judgement 考點（HKAS 36.69：睇 management 點 monitor 營運）。 Card 6 Front: How is an impairment loss allocated among the assets of a CGU, and what is the per asset floor? Back: (HKAS 36.104–105) Step 1: reduce the carrying amount of goodwill allocated to the CGU first; Step 2: allocate the remainder to other assets pro rata to their carrying amounts; Floor: no asset is reduced below the highest of (a) its FVLCD (if measurable), (b) its VIU (if determinable), and (c) zero; unallocated excess is reallocated pro rata to the other assets. 💬 次序口訣：「商譽先死，其餘攤分，個個有底」。Floor 伏位：如果某資產 FVLCD ≥ 佢攤完之後嘅值，就要停喺 FVLCD，多咗嘅 loss 推俾其他資產（LP Apply and Analyse 4 個 vineyard 就係咁）。 Card 7 Front: State the ceiling that applies when reversing an impairment loss on an individual asset, and the rule for goodwill. Back: Individual asset (HKAS 36.117): the reversal must not increase the carrying amount above the amount that would have been determined ( net of depreciation/amortisation ) had no impairment loss been recognised in prior periods. Goodwill (HKAS 36.124): an impairment loss for goodwill is never reversed — any subsequent increase is treated as internally generated goodwill, which HKAS 38 prohibits recognising. 💬 兩條線記住：reversal 上限 = 「冇減值世界」嘅折舊後賬面值（唔係 recoverable amount！）；goodwill = 撇咗就永遠冇得返。Jun 2023 考官話考生完全唔知有 reversal ceiling 呢回事。 Card 8 Front: How is an impairment loss on a revalued asset recognised, and how is a subsequent reversal treated? Back: Impairment (HKAS 36.60–61): treated as a revaluation decrease — debit OCI against the revaluation surplus for that same asset up to its balance; any excess is recognised in profit or loss . Reversal (HKAS 36.119): recognised as an increase in the revaluation surplus in OCI — but any amount previously recognised in P&L is reversed through P&L first . 💬 鏡像規則：落去嘅時候「OCI 用晒先落 P&L」；上返嚟嘅時候「P&L 部分先經 P&L 撥返，多餘先入 OCI」。另外 LP 做法係先將 accumulated depreciation 對銷資產賬（Dr Accumulated depreciation / Cr Asset），再做撇減分錄。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Recoverable amount 資產「至少值幾多」嘅底線，取賣價淨額同使用價值兩者較高者 The recoverable amount is the higher of an asset's fair value less costs of disposal and its value in use (HKAS 36.6). Value in use (VIU) 繼續用呢件資產，未來現金流折現後值幾多（公司自己角度） Value in use is the present value of the future cash flows expected to be derived from an asset, discounted at a pre tax rate. Fair value less costs of disposal (FVLCD) 賣走件資產，扣埋律師費、印花稅等出售成本後袋幾多（市場角度） Costs of disposal are incremental costs directly attributable to the disposal, excluding finance costs and income tax expense (HKAS 36.6). Cash generating unit (CGU) 一組最細嘅、能獨立產生現金流入嘅資產組合 A CGU is the smallest identifiable group of assets that generates cash inflows largely independent of those from other assets. Corporate asset 總部大樓呢類自己賺唔到錢、要攤分落各 CGU 嘅集團資產 The carrying amount of the head office building was allocated to each CGU on a reasonable and consistent basis. Impairment loss 賬面值高過 recoverable amount 嘅差額，要即刻撇減 An impairment loss of HK$100 million was recognised immediately in profit or loss as the asset is measured under the cost model. Revaluation surplus 重估增值喺 OCI 儲起嘅儲備；重估資產減值時先衝呢度 The impairment loss was recognised in OCI to the extent of the revaluation surplus for that same asset, with the excess charged to profit or loss. Reversal ceiling 減值撥回唔可以衝過「假設從未減值」嘅折舊後賬面值 The reversal was capped at the carrying amount that would have existed, net of depreciation, had no impairment loss been recognised (HKAS 36.117).

title: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Goodwill acquired in a business combination must be tested for impairmen…
text: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Goodwill acquired in a business combination must be tested for impairment annually (through the CGU to which it is allocated), irrespective of whether any indication of impairment exists. The same annual requirement applies to intangible assets with an indefinite useful life and intangible assets not yet available for use. All other assets — including the delivery truck, the 15 year licence and the owner occupied building — are tested only when an indication of impairment exists (assessed at the end of each reporting period). 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 HKAS 36.10 三類「年年必測」資產：indefinite life intangibles、not yet available for use intangibles、goodwill。A、C、D 都係有明確年期嘅資產，只係有 impairment indication 先要測（HKAS 36.9）。記住 goodwill 唔可以單獨測，要經佢所屬 CGU 測。 Rule Check: HKAS 36.10; HKAS 36.9 Common Trap（繁中）: 見到 licence 就以為係 intangible 所以要年測——關鍵係 indefinite useful life ；15 year licence 係 finite life，要攤銷，唔使年年測。反向問法（"which does NOT require annual testing"）係真實考試常見包裝，睇清楚問題方向先好揀。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Workings: Fair value less costs of disposal = HK$300,000 − HK$15,000 = HK$285,000 Value in use = 120,000 × 0.926 + 110,000 × 0.857 + 100,000 × 0.794 = 111,120 + 94,270 + 79,400 = HK$284,790 Recoverable amount = higher of FVLCD and VIU = HK$285,000 Impairment loss = Carrying amount HK$350,000 − Recoverable amount HK$285,000 = HK$65,000 , recognised immediately in profit or loss (cost model). 解題思路（繁中）: 三步曲：(1) FVLCD 記得扣 costs of disposal（285,000）；(2) VIU 要折現（284,790）；(3) recoverable amount 取 高者 ——呢度 FVLCD 高少少，所以用 285,000。Distractor 解構：A（20,000）= 冇折現，直接用 330,000 總現金流當 VIU；B（50,000）= 忘記扣 disposal costs，用咗 fair value 300,000；D（65,210）= 用咗「lower of」攞咗 VIU 284,790，呢個係考官報告點名嘅真實錯誤。 Rule Check: HKAS 36.6; HKAS 36.59–60 Common Trap（繁中）: Recoverable amount 係 higher of ，唔係 lower of——Jun 2023 panelists' report 特別點名呢個錯。另外 FVLCD 一定要扣 costs of disposal，唔好用 fair value 直接比較。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): An impairment loss on a revalued asset is treated as a revaluation decrease: it is recognised in OCI against the revaluation surplus for that same asset to the extent of the surplus balance (HK$30,000), and the excess (HK$80,000 − HK$30,000 = HK$50,000) is recognised in profit or loss. Account Dr (HK$) Cr (HK$) Revaluation surplus (OCI) 30,000 Impairment loss (P&L) 50,000 Machine 80,000 Total 80,000 80,000 解題思路（繁中）: 重估模式資產減值 = downward revaluation：先衝同一資產嘅 revaluation surplus（上限係 surplus 餘額 30,000），多餘 50,000 先落 P&L。A 錯在全部落 P&L，無視咗 surplus；B 錯在全部落 OCI，surplus 唔夠 cover 嘅部分唔可以再扣其他儲備；D 嘅 Dr/Cr 方向完全倒轉，仲要虛增 surplus，係 nonsense。 Rule Check: HKAS 36.60–61 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個伏位：(1) 以為 revalued asset 減值全部入 OCI——surplus 係有上限嘅，excess 必須落 P&L；(2) 忘記 surplus 必須係 that same asset 嘅 surplus，唔可以挪用其他資產嘅 surplus 抵銷。 Q4 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Workings: Carrying amount of CGU = 200,000 + 500,000 + 300,000 = HK$1,000,000 Impairment loss = HK$1,000,000 − HK$700,000 = HK$300,000 Step 1: write off goodwill first → HK$200,000 (goodwill reduced to nil) Step 2: remaining HK$100,000 allocated pro rata to other assets by carrying amount: Bottling machine = 500,000 / (500,000 + 300,000) × 100,000 = HK$62,500 Factory building = 300,000 / 800,000 × 100,000 = HK$37,500 Floor check (HKAS 36.105): neither asset has a measurable FVLCD or VIU, so no floor constraint binds. 解題思路（繁中）: CGU 撇減次序係「goodwill 先死、其餘 pro rata」。Distractor 解構：B（50,000）= pro rata 嘅分母錯咗，用咗 1,000,000（連 goodwill）去攤剩餘嘅 100,000；C（150,000）= 完全冇先撇 goodwill，將成個 300,000 按 500/1,000 攤分；D（100,000）= 誤以為 goodwill 撇完之後嘅餘額全部落最大嗰件資產。LP Knowledge Check Q6/Q7 正正考呢兩個錯法。 Rule Check: HKAS 36.104; HKAS 36.105 Common Trap（繁中）: 最常見錯誤：冇將 goodwill 先撇到零就開始 pro rata。第二個伏位：pro rata 用 carrying amount 做權重，唔係 cost。第三：如果某資產有自己嘅 FVLCD/VIU，記住 floor 規則——唔可以撇低過 highest of FVLCD / VIU / zero，多咗嘅要再攤俾其他資產。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Workings: Original depreciation = HK$1,800,000 ÷ 9 = HK$200,000 per year Carrying amount at 31 December 20X4 = 1,800,000 − (4 × 200,000) = HK$1,000,000 Impairment loss 20X4 = 1,000,000 − 700,000 = HK$300,000; revised carrying amount = HK$700,000 Revised depreciation 20X5 = 700,000 ÷ 5 remaining years = HK$140,000 Carrying amount at 31 December 20X5 = 700,000 − 140,000 = HK$560,000 Carrying amount had NO impairment occurred = 1,800,000 − (5 × 200,000) = HK$800,000 (the ceiling) Recoverable amount HK$950,000 exceeds the ceiling; reversal capped at 800,000 − 560,000 = HK$240,000 , recognised in profit or loss (cost model). 解題思路（繁中）: Reversal 三條數要齊：(1) 而家賬面值（560,000）——記住減值後要用 新 折舊率 140,000；(2) recoverable amount（950,000）；(3) 上限 = 「冇減值世界」折舊後賬面值（800,000）。Reversal = min(RA, ceiling) − 現賬面值。Distractor 解構：A（100,000）= 忘記 20X5 要折舊，直接用 700,000 做賬面值；C（300,000）= 將當年嘅 impairment loss 全數撥返，衝穿咗上限；D（390,000）= 用 RA − CA（950,000 − 560,000），完全冇理會 ceiling。 Rule Check: HKAS 36.117; HKAS 36.119; HKAS 36.63 Common Trap（繁中）: Reversal 上限係「冇減值嘅折舊後賬面值」， 唔係 recoverable amount——RA 高過上限嘅部分永遠冇得入賬。另外減值之後一定要重計折舊（HKAS 36.63），再用重計後嘅賬面值去計 reversal。Jun 2023 考官明言考生「no awareness of the ceiling on impairment reversal」，呢題係必操題型。

title: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. In accordance…
text: M6 Chapter 11: Impairment of Assets — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. In accordance with HKAS 36, which of the following assets of Heron Retail Limited MUST be tested for impairment at least annually, irrespective of whether any indication of impairment exists? A. A delivery truck with a remaining useful life of six years, measured under the cost model B. Goodwill that arose on the acquisition of a subsidiary two years ago C. A 15 year operating licence that is being amortised on a straight line basis D. An owner occupied office building measured under the cost model Q2. Falcon Logistics Limited owns a cargo vehicle with a carrying amount of HK$350,000 at 31 December 20X8. Following a significant fall in freight rates, an impairment test was performed. The vehicle's fair value is estimated at HK$300,000 and estimated costs of disposal are HK$15,000. If the vehicle continues to be used, it is expected to generate net cash inflows of HK$120,000, HK$110,000 and HK$100,000 at the end of each of the next three years respectively, after which it will be scrapped for nil. The appropriate discount rate is 8%. (Present value factors at 8%: Year 1 = 0.926; Year 2 = 0.857; Year 3 = 0.794.) In accordance with HKAS 36, what is the impairment loss, if any, to be recognised? A. HK$20,000 B. HK$50,000 C. HK$65,000 D. HK$65,210 Q3. Marlin Manufacturing Limited carries a machine under the revaluation model in HKAS 16. At 30 June 20X9, the machine has a carrying amount of HK$800,000 and a revaluation surplus of HK$30,000 relating to this same machine is included in equity. An impairment test determined the machine's recoverable amount to be HK$720,000. In accordance with HKAS 36, which set of journal entries correctly records the impairment loss of HK$80,000 (ignore the elimination of accumulated depreciation)? A. Dr Impairment loss (P&L) HK$80,000 / Cr Machine HK$80,000 B. Dr Revaluation surplus (OCI) HK$80,000 / Cr Machine HK$80,000 C. Dr Revaluation surplus (OCI) HK$30,000; Dr Impairment loss (P&L) HK$50,000 / Cr Machine HK$80,000 D. Dr Impairment loss (P&L) HK$50,000; Dr Machine HK$30,000 / Cr Revaluation surplus (OCI) HK$80,000 Q4. Otter Beverages Limited has identified its juice division as a cash generating unit (CGU). At 31 March 20X9, the carrying amounts of the assets of the CGU are: goodwill HK$200,000; bottling machine HK$500,000; factory building HK$300,000. The recoverable amount of the CGU is HK$700,000. Neither the bottling machine's nor the factory building's individual fair value less costs of disposal or value in use is measurable. In accordance with HKAS 36, what amount of the impairment loss is allocated to the bottling machine? A. HK$62,500 B. HK$50,000 C. HK$150,000 D. HK$100,000 Q5. On 1 January 20X1, Pelican Freight Limited acquired a crane for HK$1,800,000 with a useful life of nine years and no residual value, depreciated on a straight line basis (cost model). On 31 December 20X4, an impairment test showed a recoverable amount of HK$700,000, and an impairment loss was recognised; the useful life was unchanged. On 31 December 20X5, indicators showed the impairment loss had decreased, and the recoverable amount was estimated at HK$950,000. In accordance with HKAS 36, what is the amount of the impairment loss reversal that Pelican Freight Limited should recognise on 31 December 20X5? A. HK$100,000 B. HK$240,000 C. HK$300,000 D. HK$390,000

title: M6 Chapter 12: Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 12: Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
C. Disclosure / Presentation 披露及列報
excerpt: M6 Chapter 12: Non current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Describe the classific…
text: M6 Chapter 12: Non current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Describe the classification criteria for a non current asset (or disposal group) to be classified as held for sale or held for distribution to owners under HKFRS 5. 2. Define a disposal group and distinguish assets within / outside the measurement scope of HKFRS 5. 3. Apply the measurement rules of HKFRS 5: measure at the lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell, cease depreciation, and allocate impairment losses / reversals correctly. 4. Define and identify a discontinued operation and explain why an abandoned asset is never classified as held for sale. 5. Present and disclose non current assets held for sale and discontinued operations in the statement of financial position and statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income. 必背考點 A. Recognition（Classification 分類準則） 考點 規則 出處 核心分類測試 A non current asset (or disposal group) is classified as held for sale if its carrying amount will be recovered principally through a sale transaction rather than through continuing use HKFRS 5 para. 6 兩大必須同時符合嘅條件 (1) available for immediate sale in its present condition subject only to terms that are usual and customary for sales of such assets; AND (2) the sale must be highly probable HKFRS 5 paras. 6–7 "Highly probable" 定義 Significantly more likely than probable ; "probable" = more likely than not HKFRS 5 App A（LP Section 12.1.1.1） "Highly probable" 六項準則 (i) appropriate level of management committed to a plan to sell ; (ii) active programme to locate a buyer initiated; (iii) asset actively marketed at a price reasonable in relation to current fair value ; (iv) sale expected to complete within one year from classification; (v) unlikely significant changes / withdrawal of the plan; (vi) shareholder approval (if required) likely to be obtained HKFRS 5 para. 8 超過一年唔使即刻除名 Extension beyond one year does not preclude continued HFS classification if the delay is caused by events/circumstances beyond the entity's control and there is sufficient evidence of continued commitment HKFRS 5 para. 9 分類日期 Classify as HFS on the date the criteria are first met（例：Board 批准並啟動賣盤程序當日，並非簽約日） HKFRS 5 para. 8（LP Illustrative Example 2） To be abandoned An asset to be abandoned is NOT classified as held for sale（carrying amount recovered through continuing use）；但若 disposal group 被 abandoned 且符合 discontinued operation 定義，於 the date it ceases to be used 列作 discontinued operation HKFRS 5 para. 13 Held for distribution to owners 處理方法 essentially the same as HFS；計量用 fair value less costs to distribute HKFRS 5（LP Section 12.1.1.2；詳見 M11 Ch15） B. Measurement 計量（initial + subsequent） 考點 規則 出處 基本計量 Measure at the lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell (FVLCS) HKFRS 5 para. 15 Fair value 定義 The price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date HKFRS 5 App A（引述 HKFRS 13） Costs to sell 定義 Incremental costs directly attributable to the disposal , excluding finance costs and income tax expense（例：due diligence costs、commissions） HKFRS 5 App A 停止折舊 No depreciation / amortisation while classified as HFS（或屬於 HFS disposal group）；但 disposal group 負債嘅 interest and other expenses 繼續 確認 HKFRS 5 para. 25 Measurement scope 豁免（ 唔 受 HKFRS 5 計量規定管） (1) financial assets within HKFRS 9（carried at FV through P&L）; (2) deferred tax assets （HKAS 12 — fair value 難以確定）; (3) investment property under fair value model of HKAS 40；另外 assets arising from insurance contracts（HKFRS 17）亦被排除 HKFRS 5 para. 5 Disposal group 三步法 Step 1: 先用各自準則 remeasure 唔屬 HKFRS 5 計量範圍嘅資產（如 HKAS 40 investment property 先重估至 FV）； Step 2: 加返入 disposal group 其他 HKFRS 5 範圍內資產嘅 carrying amount； Step 3: 比較 disposal group 總 CA vs FVLCS，CA FVLCS → 確認 impairment loss HKFRS 5 paras. 18–19（LP Section 12.2.2 三步法） Impairment 分配次序 先全數撇銷 disposal group 內 goodwill ；再按 pro rata 分配予其他屬 HKFRS 5 計量範圍嘅 non current assets； cash / trade receivables / FV model investment property 一律唔分 （與 HKAS 36 一致） HKFRS 5（allocation consistent with HKAS 36，LP Section 12.2.2） Reversal（回升上限） Subsequent increase in FVLCS → recognise a gain, capped at the cumulative impairment loss previously recognised（under HKFRS 5 or previously HKAS 36）； goodwill 永不 reversal （HKAS 36）；每項資產嘅 reversal 不得超過該資產累計 impairment HKFRS 5 paras. 21–22 Key journal entries（Dr/Cr 必須平衡） 例：Machine CA HK$1,000,000；分類為 HFS 時 FVLCS = HK$850,000（FV 900,000 − selling costs 50,000）。 C. Disclosure / Presentation 披露及列報 考點 規則 出處 SFP 單獨列示 HFS 資產（及 disposal group 資產）與其他資產 分開 列示；disposal group 負債與其他負債 分開 列示； assets and liabilities shall NOT be offset （唔可以 net off） HKFRS 5 para. 38 比較期間 初步分類為 HFS 時， 唔准 reclassify / re present prior period comparatives（無追溯重列） HKFRS 5 para. 40 OCI 累計項目 與 HFS 資產有關、曾於 OCI 確認嘅累計 income/expense（如 HKAS 16 revaluation surplus）須單獨列示 HKFRS 5 para. 38 Discontinued operations 於 P&L 單一金額（single amount）＝ post tax profit/loss of discontinued operations ＋ post tax gain/loss on measurement to FVLCS or disposal；與 continuing operations 分開列示 HKFRS 5 paras. 30, 33(a)(i)–(ii) 分析披露 Para. 33(a) 金額須分析為 revenue、expenses、pre tax profit/loss、FVLCS/disposal gain or loss、及各自 income tax（P&L 或 notes） HKFRS 5 para. 33(b) 現金流披露 Net cash flows attributable to operating / investing / financing activities of discontinued operations HKFRS 5 para. 33(c) 母公司擁有人應佔 Income from continuing operations and from discontinued operations attributable to owners of the parent HKFRS 5 para. 33(d) 唔屬 discontinued operation 嘅 HFS 撇減 Gain/loss on remeasurement 計入 profit or loss from continuing operations （唔好放入 discontinued operations） HKFRS 5 para. 37 額外 notes 披露（分類/出售當期） (1) description of the asset (or disposal group); (2) facts and circumstances of the sale, expected manner and timing; (3) impairment loss on write down to FVLCS or gain on subsequent increase HKFRS 5（LP Section 12.4.3） Discontinued operation 定義（必背） ：a component of an entity that has been disposed of or is classified as held for sale , AND: (a) represents a separate major line of business or geographical area of operations ; (b) is part of a single co ordinated plan to dispose of such a line/area; or (c) is a subsidiary acquired exclusively with a view to resale （HKFRS 5 para. 32）。Component = operations and cash flows clearly distinguishable；held for use 期間須曾為 CGU 或 group of CGUs（HKFRS 5 para. 31）。 注意 ：未出售都可以是 discontinued operation —— classified as held for sale 已足夠（HKFRS 5 para. 32；LP 明確指出 "discontinuing" 先啱但都叫 discontinued）。 易混淆概念對比 Table 1：Held for Sale vs Held for Distribution to Owners vs To Be Abandoned Held for Sale Held for Distribution to Owners To Be Abandoned Carrying amount 收回方式 Through a sale transaction Through distribution to owners Through continuing use（用到完/關閉唔賣） HFS classification? Yes 會計處理 essentially the same as HFS No — never classified as HFS 計量 Lower of CA and FVLCS FVLCS 對應版： fair value less costs to distribute 繼續按原準則（如 HKAS 16）折舊計量 折舊 Cease upon classification Cease Continue depreciating （一直用到 economic life 尾） Discontinued operation 可能性 符合 para. 32 即可 符合即可 只可以喺 ceases to be used 當日 先至列作 discontinued operation 點樣分辨：關鍵問「部資產嘅 carrying amount 點收回？」—— 賣 → HFS；送畀股東 → held for distribution；丟/閂 → abandoned， 永遠唔入 HFS 。考試伏位：見到 "close down / abandon / use until end of life" 就 唔好 分類 HFS，但如果係成個 disposal group 關閉，記住 abandoned group 都可能要喺停用日做 discontinued operation 披露（HKFRS 5 para. 13）。 Table 2：HKFRS 5 Measurement Scope — 適用 vs 豁免資產 屬於 HKFRS 5 計量範圍（用 lower of CA & FVLCS） 唔 屬於（先用自己嘅準則 remeasure） Property, plant and equipment（HKAS 16 cost model） Financial assets within HKFRS 9（cash、trade receivables、FVTPL investments） Intangible assets（HKAS 38，包括 goodwill 分配減值） Deferred tax assets（HKAS 12） Land、buildings、machinery、motor vehicles Investment property under HKAS 40 fair value model Assets arising from insurance contracts（HKFRS 17） 點樣分辨：口訣「 金融、稅、投資物業、保險 」四大豁免。考試伏位：做 disposal group 減值題時，豁免資產 第一步先按自己準則 remeasure （例：HKAS 40 investment property 先撇至 FV），然後先至比較成個 group 嘅 CA vs FVLCS；而 impairment 分配時 cash 同 receivables 永遠唔使分 ——呢個係 panelist 年年話弱嘅位（HKFRS 5 measurement 連續三年被點名）。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Under HKFRS 5, what are the two conditions that must BOTH be met for a non current asset to be classified as held for sale? Back: Available for immediate sale in its present condition, subject only to usual and customary terms (HKFRS 5 para. 7) The sale must be highly probable (HKFRS 5 para. 8) Overarching test: carrying amount recovered principally through sale, not continuing use (para. 6) 💬 白話解釋：兩個條件缺一不可——「而家即刻賣得」加「好大機會賣成」。淨係「probable」（過半機會）都未得，要 "highly probable"（significantly more likely than probable）。 Card 2 Front: List the six HKFRS 5 criteria for a sale to be considered "highly probable". Back: Appropriate level of management committed to a plan to sell Active programme to locate a buyer initiated Actively marketed at a price reasonable relative to current fair value Sale expected to complete within one year of classification Unlikely the plan will be significantly changed or withdrawn Shareholder approval (if required) likely to be obtained (HKFRS 5 para. 8) 💬 白話解釋：記憶口訣「Management 有心、搵客程序已啟動、開價貼市、一年內搞掂、計劃唔會縮沙、股東會過關」。考試鍾意抽一兩項問你仲未符合 highly probable。 Card 3 Front: Can a non current asset that management intends to ABANDON be classified as held for sale? Explain. Back: No — never classified as HFS, because the carrying amount is recovered through continuing use (HKFRS 5 para. 13) Includes assets used to the end of their economic life and assets closed rather than sold BUT: an abandoned disposal group meeting the definition is presented as a discontinued operation from the date it ceases to be used 💬 白話解釋：「唔賣就唔係 HFS」係鐵律。但留意個伏位：abandon 成個業務組合，停用當日一樣可能要當 discontinued operation 披露，兩件事唔好撈亂。 Card 4 Front: State the measurement rule for non current assets (or disposal groups) classified as held for sale, and the depreciation treatment. Back: Measure at the lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell (HKFRS 5 para. 15) Cease depreciation / amortisation from the date of HFS classification (para. 25) Interest and other expenses on liabilities of a HFS disposal group continue to be recognised 💬 白話解釋：由分類嗰刻起個資產「凍結」——唔再折舊，因為你唔係再用佢，係等緊賣佢。考試伏位：好多人忘記停折舊，繼續計全年 depreciation，即刻錯。 Card 5 Front: Which assets are EXCLUDED from the measurement requirements of HKFRS 5 (HKFRS 5 para. 5)? Back: Financial assets within the scope of HKFRS 9 (e.g. carried at FV through P&L) Deferred tax assets (HKAS 12) Non current assets under the fair value model of HKAS 40 Investment Property (Also assets arising from insurance contracts — HKFRS 17) Note: classification & presentation rules still apply; only the measurement rules are excluded 💬 白話解釋：口訣「金融、稅、投資物業、保險」。呢啲資產本身已經按 fair value 或專屬準則計量，再用 lower of 測試會衝突，所以 HKFRS 5 放手。 Card 6 Front: Describe the THREE steps to determine the impairment loss of a disposal group held for sale, and the allocation order of any write down. Back: Step 1: Remeasure disposal group assets outside HKFRS 5's measurement scope under their own standards Step 2: Add remeasured amounts to carrying amounts of in scope assets Step 3: Compare total CA vs FVLCS of the group; CA FVLCS → impairment loss Allocation: first to goodwill , then pro rata to other in scope non current assets (consistent with HKAS 36) Cash and trade receivables are never allocated any write down 💬 白話解釋：口訣「先執豁免貨、再埋單比較、goodwill 先孭鑊」。Pilot paper 出過 3 分題考呢個 allocation，cash/receivables 唔郁係最常見得分/失分位。 Card 7 Front: What is the ceiling on recognising a gain when the FVLCS of a held for sale asset subsequently increases? Back: Gain recognised only up to the cumulative impairment loss previously recognised (under HKFRS 5 or previously under HKAS 36) (HKFRS 5 paras. 21–22) Treated as a reversal of impairment No reversal ever allocated to goodwill (HKAS 36) Per asset cap: reversal on each asset cannot exceed that asset's own cumulative impairment 💬 白話解釋：「撇咗幾多，最多賺返幾多」。Goodwill 一撇永撇，永不回頭 —— 同 HKAS 36 impairment reversal 個 cap 概念一脈相承。 Card 8 Front: Define a "discontinued operation" under HKFRS 5 and state how its results are presented. Back: A component of an entity (CGU or group of CGUs; operations & cash flows clearly distinguishable) disposed of or classified as held for sale (para. 32) AND: separate major line of business / geographical area; part of a single co ordinated disposal plan; or a subsidiary acquired exclusively with a view to resale Presentation: single amount in SPLOCI = post tax profit/loss + post tax measurement/disposal gain/loss, separate from continuing operations (paras. 30, 33(a)) Non qualifying HFS remeasurement gains/losses stay in continuing operations (para. 37) 💬 白話解釋：「未賣得都可以係 discontinued」係最易錯位——classified as HFS 已經合格。但唔係個個 HFS 都係 discontinued：細微資產（如一層寫字樓）唔代表 major line of business，就留返喺 continuing operations。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Disposal group 一籃子一單過賣嘅資產（連埋直接相關負債） A disposal group is a group of assets to be disposed of together as a group in a single transaction, including directly associated liabilities. Highly probable 「非常有可能」，比 probable 再高一级 A sale is highly probable when it is significantly more likely than probable, which itself means more likely than not. Fair value less costs to sell (FVLCS) 公平價值減賣嘢成本，計量下限比較嘅一邊 The machine is measured at the lower of its carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell. Costs to sell 直接因出售而多咗嘅增量成本（唔包 finance costs 同稅） Broker commissions and legal fees are costs to sell, whereas finance costs are excluded. Component of an entity 營運同現金流可以清清楚楚同其他業務分開嘅部分 The retail division is a component of the entity because its operations and cash flows are clearly distinguishable. Discontinued operation 已出售或已分類 HFS 嘅主要業務線/地區 The disposal of the entire European division is presented as a discontinued operation. Cash generating unit (CGU) 最細嗰組自己產生獨立現金流嘅資產 While held for use, a component of an entity will have been a cash generating unit or a group of cash generating units. Reversal of impairment loss 減值回升，但最多賺返之前撇過嘅數 The gain on the increase in FVLCS is capped at the cumulative impairment loss previously recognised on that asset.

excerpt: M6 Chapter 12: Non current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Under HKFRS 5, a n…
text: M6 Chapter 12: Non current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. Under HKFRS 5, a non current asset is classified as held for sale only if it is available for immediate sale in its present condition (subject only to usual and customary terms) and the sale is highly probable (paras. 6–7). For the sale to be highly probable, HKFRS 5 para. 8 requires, inter alia, an active programme to locate a buyer to have been initiated and the asset to be actively marketed at a price reasonable in relation to its current fair value. Lantern fails both: no programme to locate a buyer exists, and the asking price (40% above fair value) is not reasonable. Therefore the warehouse cannot be classified as held for sale. 解題思路（繁中）: 兩大條件要 同時 符合：available for immediate sale（Lantern 過咗呢關）＋ sale highly probable（Lantern 過唔到）。 伏位一：board approval 只係 highly probable 六項準則之一（management committed to a plan）， 唔係充分條件 —— 所以 A 同 C 錯。 伏位二：開價高過 FV 四成即係 "not actively marketed at a price reasonable in relation to current fair value"，呢個係 HKFRS 5 para. 8 明文嘅準則，唔係常識題。 D 錯因為 HKFRS 5 從未要求已簽 binding sale agreement —— 分類基準係 criteria met 之日，唔係簽約日（LP Illustrative Example 2：Board 批准 + 啟動程序當日已分類）。 考試伏位：題目刻意畀晒「board 批准」「即刻賣得」呢啲糖衣，考你記唔記得 highly probable 係 六項準則全體 嘅測試。 Rule Check: HKFRS 5 paras. 6, 7, 8 Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「board 已批准＋可即時出售」就心急揀「must classify」；記住 "highly probable" 係 significantly more likely than probable，要逐項 para. 8 準則核對，尤其 pricing 同 active programme 兩項最常畀人抽走。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C is correct. The measurement requirements of HKFRS 5 do not apply to non current assets accounted for under the fair value model of HKAS 40 Investment Property (HKFRS 5 para. 5). In the three step approach for disposal groups, such assets must first be remeasured in accordance with their own standard (HKAS 40, i.e. to fair value) before the disposal group's total carrying amount is compared with its fair value less costs to sell. Goodwill, PPE and intangible assets are all within the measurement scope of HKFRS 5 and are therefore measured at the lower of carrying amount and FVLCS as part of the group test. 解題思路（繁中）: 口訣「 金融、稅、投資物業、保險 」：HKFRS 9 financial assets、HKAS 12 deferred tax assets、HKAS 40 fair value model investment property、HKFRS 17 insurance assets 全部豁免 HKFRS 5 計量。 A、B、D 全部屬於 HKFRS 5 measurement scope：goodwill 更加係 impairment 分配嘅 第一順位 ；PPE 同 intangibles 係 pro rata 分配對象。 留意題目問嘅唔係「邊個唔使減值」，而係「邊個要 先用自己準則 remeasure 」—— 即係 disposal group 三步法嘅 Step 1。豁免資產唔係唔郁，係要按 HKAS 40 先重估至 FV，之後先埋單比較。 考試伏位：如果 investment property 用 cost model 就唔豁免——題目明寫 fair value model 先係答案。 Rule Check: HKFRS 5 para. 5；HKFRS 5 disposal group three step approach（LP Section 12.2.2, paras. 18–19） Common Trap（繁中）: 以為「豁免 = 完全唔理」而跳過 remeasurement step；又或者見 goodwill 係特殊資產就以為佢豁免——goodwill 恰恰相反，係減值分配嘅頭號吸收者。HKFRS 5 measurement 連續多年被 panelist 點名為弱項，呢個 scope 分界位務必背熟。 Q3 — Answer: (a) HK$2,200,000; impairment loss HK$200,000 (b) see journal below (c) Nil Model Answer (EN): (a) On classification as held for sale, the machine is measured at the lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell (HKFRS 5 para. 15): Carrying amount: HK$2,400,000 Fair value less costs to sell: HK$2,300,000 − HK$100,000 = HK$2,200,000 Lower = HK$2,200,000 → impairment loss of HK$200,000 (HK$2,400,000 − HK$2,200,000) recognised in profit or loss. (b) Journal entry on 1 October 20X6: (Reclassification entry, if presented separately: Dr Non current asset held for sale 2,400,000 / Cr Property, plant and equipment 2,400,000, followed by the write down above.) (c) Nil. An entity shall not depreciate a non current asset while it is classified as held for sale (HKFRS 5 para. 25). Depreciation ceases from the classification date of 1 October 20X6, so no depreciation is charged for October–December 20X6. 解題思路（繁中）: (a) 留意 FVLCS 要 扣 costs to sell ：HK$2,300,000 − HK$100,000 = HK$2,200,000。好多人唔記得扣 HK$100,000，就會答 HK$2,300,000（無減值）—— 呢個係 panelist 年年鬧嘅 HKFRS 5 measurement 弱點。Costs to sell 只包 incremental costs directly attributable to disposal（legal fees、commissions）， 唔包 finance costs 同 income tax（HKFRS 5 App A）。 (b) Journal 要平衡：Dr impairment loss HK$200,000 / Cr machine HK$200,000。若題目要求先重列，再做多一組 reclassification entry（Dr NCA HFS / Cr PPE，各 HK$2.4m）。 (c) 分類日起 停止折舊 ：10–12 月三個月嘅 HK$20,000/月 一仙都唔計。題目畀 monthly depreciation 係誘你繼續計 HK$60,000 —— 錯。 考試伏位：「lower of」測試同「停折舊」係孖生兄弟，一觸發分類兩樣同時生效；唔好以為「賣唔出先停折舊」。 Rule Check: HKFRS 5 paras. 15, 25; HKFRS 5 App A (definitions of fair value and costs to sell) Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 忘記扣 costs to sell，用裸 fair value 比較；(2) 繼續計折舊至出售日；(3) 將 costs to sell 當 expense 入 P&L 而唔係扣 FVLCS —— 三個錯誤都係真實考生常犯。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. A discontinued operation is a component of an entity that has been disposed of or is classified as held for sale , and that represents a separate major line of business or geographical area of operations, is part of a single co ordinated plan to dispose of such a line/area, or is a subsidiary acquired exclusively with a view to resale (HKFRS 5 para. 32). Falcon's entire European operations constitute a component (a CGU with clearly distinguishable operations and cash flows) representing a separate major geographical area, and it has been classified as held for sale — both limbs are satisfied. 解題思路（繁中）: 兩層測試：(1) 係咪 component of an entity（operations & cash flows clearly distinguishable；held for use 時曾為 CGU）；(2) disposed of 或 classified as HFS，再加大三選一條件（major line/geographical area、co ordinated plan、subsidiary acquired for resale）。 A 錯：一間細分店唔代表 separate major line of business or geographical area —— 佢係 HFS，但 唔係 discontinued operation，佢嘅 remeasurement gain/loss 留喺 continuing operations（HKFRS 5 para. 37）。 C 錯：用到報廢 = to be abandoned，carrying amount 透過 continuing use 收回， 永不 分類 HFS（HKFRS 5 para. 13），自然唔係 discontinued operation。 D 錯：equity method associate 唔係 component 被出售或分類 HFS；「accounted for using the equity method」從來唔係 discontinued operation 嘅條件。 考試伏位：「未賣出」唔緊要 —— classified as held for sale 已經足夠（para. 32 明確）；但純粹 HFS ≠ 自動 discontinued，仲要過 major line/geographical 嗰關。 Rule Check: HKFRS 5 paras. 31, 32; HKFRS 5 paras. 13, 37 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個方向都會錯：(1) 以為一定要已經賣咗先係 discontinued operation；(2) 以為任何 held for sale 資產都係 discontinued operation。正確理解：HFS 係必要條件之一，但仲要係 separate major line of business / geographical area。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. HKFRS 5 paras. 21–22: an entity shall recognise a gain for any subsequent increase in fair value less costs to sell, but not in excess of the cumulative impairment loss previously recognised (under HKFRS 5 or previously under HKAS 36). Workings: 30 June 20X6: impairment loss recognised = HK$1,800,000 − HK$1,500,000 = HK$300,000 (carrying amount written down to HK$1,500,000) 31 December 20X6: increase in FVLCS = HK$1,950,000 − HK$1,500,000 = HK$450,000 Gain recognised = HK$300,000 (capped at the cumulative impairment loss); carrying amount restored to HK$1,800,000. The remaining HK$150,000 of the increase is NOT recognised. Journal entry: Dr Non current asset held for sale HK$300,000 / Cr Gain on reversal of impairment loss (profit or loss) HK$300,000. 解題思路（繁中）: Reversal 上限 = 累計 impairment loss（呢度 HK$300,000）。呢個 cap 概念同 HKAS 36 一脈相承，「撇咗幾多，最多賺返幾多」。 A (HK$450,000) 錯：呢個係 FVLCS 全數升幅，忽視咗 reversal ceiling —— 考試最常見錯誤。 C (HK$150,000) 錯：呢個係「新 FVLCS 減返原本 carrying amount」（1,950,000 − 1,800,000），即係 唔應該確認 嗰部分，調轉咗嚟答。 D (HK$0) 錯：HKFRS 5 明確容許 reversal（paras. 21–22），唔係一撇永撇；一撇永撇嘅係 goodwill （HKAS 36 下 goodwill impairment 永不 reversal），唔好撈亂。 考試伏位：題目個 FVLCS 升到高過原本 carrying amount（1,950,000 1,800,000）係刻意設計 —— 測你知唔知 cap 嘅存在。 Rule Check: HKFRS 5 paras. 21–22（reversal capped at cumulative impairment loss; no reversal to goodwill per HKAS 36） Common Trap（繁中）: 混淆兩個 cap：HKFRS 5 reversal cap = 累計 impairment（HK$300,000），唔係原本 carrying amount 以上嘅全部升幅，亦唔係零。另外記住 goodwill 永遠唔 reversal —— 如果 disposal group 有 goodwill，reversal 只分畀其他屬 HKFRS 5 範圍嘅資產。

title: M6 Chapter 12: Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 12: Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 3 Quiz

text: M6 Chapter 12: Non current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Lantern Lighting Limited ("Lantern") owns a warehouse in Kwai Chung. On 15 November 20X6, the board of directors approved a plan to sell the warehouse. The warehouse is empty and could be sold immediately. Management has set an asking price approximately 40% above the warehouse's current fair value because it hopes to "test the market", and no broker or active programme to locate a buyer has yet been appointed. According to HKFRS 5 Non current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations , which of the following statements is correct as at 15 November 20X6? A. The warehouse must be classified as held for sale because the board has approved a plan to sell it and it is available for immediate sale in its present condition. B. The warehouse cannot be classified as held for sale because the sale is not highly probable: the asset is not being actively marketed at a price that is reasonable in relation to its current fair value, and no active programme to locate a buyer has been initiated. C. The warehouse must be classified as held for sale because it is available for immediate sale in its present condition, and board approval alone makes the sale highly probable. D. The warehouse cannot be classified as held for sale because a non current asset can only be classified as held for sale once a binding sale agreement has been signed. Q2. Crane Logistics Limited has classified a disposal group as held for sale in accordance with HKFRS 5. The disposal group contains the following assets: goodwill; property, plant and equipment; an investment property carried under the fair value model of HKAS 40 Investment Property ; and intangible assets. Before the carrying amount of the disposal group is compared with its fair value less costs to sell, which of the following assets must FIRST be remeasured in accordance with its own specific standard rather than the measurement requirements of HKFRS 5? A. Goodwill B. Property, plant and equipment C. The investment property carried under the fair value model of HKAS 40 D. Intangible assets Q3. Heron Manufacturing Limited ("Heron") has a machine with a carrying amount of HK$2,400,000. On 1 October 20X6, the machine met all the criteria in HKFRS 5 to be classified as held for sale. On that date, the machine's fair value was HK$2,300,000 and the incremental costs directly attributable to its disposal (legal fees and broker commission) were estimated at HK$100,000. Heron depreciates the machine at HK$20,000 per month. In accordance with HKFRS 5: (a) At what amount should the machine be measured immediately upon classification as held for sale, and what impairment loss (if any) should be recognised? (b) State the journal entry (Dr/Cr) to record the write down on 1 October 20X6. (c) How much depreciation should Heron charge on the machine for the period from 1 October 20X6 to its year end of 31 December 20X6, assuming it remains classified as held for sale? Q4. Falcon Retail Group Limited ("Falcon") is considering the presentation of the following four components in its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X6. In accordance with HKFRS 5, which component should be presented as a discontinued operation ? A. A single small retail outlet in Mong Kok classified as held for sale; Falcon operates over 200 similar outlets across Hong Kong and this outlet does not represent a separate major line of business or geographical area. B. Falcon's entire European operations, a cash generating unit representing a separate major geographical area of operations, which has been classified as held for sale during the year. C. A delivery truck that management intends to use until the end of its economic life and then scrap. D. A 20% investment in an associate accounted for using the equity method, which Falcon plans to retain for the long term. Q5. Otter Marine Limited ("Otter") classified a boat engine as held for sale on 30 June 20X6. At that date the engine's carrying amount was HK$1,800,000 and its fair value less costs to sell was HK$1,500,000; an impairment loss was recognised accordingly. At Otter's year end of 31 December 20X6, the engine is still classified as held for sale and its fair value less costs to sell has increased to HK$1,950,000 as market conditions improved. In accordance with HKFRS 5, what gain (if any) should Otter recognise for the year ended 31 December 20X6 in respect of the subsequent increase in fair value less costs to sell? A. HK$450,000 B. HK$300,000 C. HK$150,000 D. HK$0 End of quiz. No answers are provided in this file.
