excerpt: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Distinguish provisions fro…
text: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Distinguish provisions from other liabilities (trade payables, accruals) and from contingent liabilities in accordance with HKAS 37. 2. Apply the recognition criteria in HKAS 37 para. 14 to determine whether a provision, a contingent liability, or no liability arises. 3. Measure provisions at the best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the obligation, applying the expected value method and discounting to present value where the time value of money is material. 4. Determine the accounting treatment for future operating losses, onerous contracts, restructuring costs, and decommissioning/restoration costs. 5. Prepare the note disclosures for provisions, contingent liabilities and contingent assets required by HKAS 37 paras. 84–86 and 89. 必背考點 A. Recognition（確認） Provision — HKAS 37.14：三個條件必須全部符合 1. Present obligation (legal or constructive) as a result of a past event — the obligating event (HKAS 37.17: the entity has no realistic alternative to settling the obligation) 2. Probable outflow of resources embodying economic benefits — "probable" = more likely than not ( 50%) (HKAS 37.23) 3. Reliable estimate of the amount of the obligation can be made Legal obligation （HKAS 37.15–16）：源自 contract、legislation 或 other operation of law（例：warranty agreement、legal requirement to clean up contaminated land） Constructive obligation （HKAS 37.15–16）：established pattern of past practice / published policies + valid expectation created in other parties（例：retail store published refund policy with no legal requirement） 罕有情況（lawsuit） （HKAS 37.15–16）：judgement at the end of the reporting period based on all available evidence (incl. expert opinions) — more likely than not a present obligation exists → condition 1 satisfied Board / management decision （HKAS 37.20）：只有在 communicated to those affected in a sufficiently specific manner 先至係 obligating event；未公佈前仍可撤回 → no provision Environmental damage, no legal requirement （HKAS 37.21）：即時無 obligation；除非 law enacted (retrospectively) 或 entity publicly accepts responsibility（→ constructive obligation） Proposed new law （HKAS 37.22）：present obligation 只喺 enactment is virtually certain 時出現 Intention to incur future expenditure （HKAS 37.19）：NOT a past event — entity can avoid it by future actions → no provision（例：regular overhaul policy） Probability thresholds — liabilities（HKAS 37.23, 27–28） Likelihood of outflow Treatment Probable ( 50%, more likely than not) + reliable estimate Recognise provision Probable but cannot be reliably measured Contingent liability — disclose (rare) Possible (not probable, but more than remote) Contingent liability — disclose in notes Remote Do nothing — no recognition, no disclosure Contingent liability（HKAS 37.10） = (a) possible obligation confirmed only by uncertain future events not wholly within entity's control; 或 (b) present obligation failing recognition because outflow not probable (10(b)(i)) 或 cannot be reliably measured (10(b)(ii))。永遠 not recognised （HKAS 37.27）；disclose unless remote（HKAS 37.28）。 Contingent asset（HKAS 37.10, 31–34） Likelihood of inflow Treatment Virtually certain Recognise asset （no longer contingent — HKAS 37.33） Probable (but not virtually certain) Disclose contingent asset in notes（HKAS 37.34） Not probable No recognition, no disclosure（HKAS 37.31） ⚠️ Threshold asymmetry ：liabilities 喺 probable 時已經要入賬；assets 要等到 virtually certain 先入賬。呢個係防範提前確認收入嘅 prudence 設計，考試必考。 Specific applications — Recognition Future operating losses （HKAS 37.63）： never recognise a provision — no obligating event, management has realistic alternatives. 但係可能係 impairment indicator → HKAS 36（HKAS 37.65） Onerous contracts （HKAS 37.66）：unavoidable costs of meeting obligations economic benefits expected → present obligation recognised as a provision Restructuring （HKAS 37.70, 72）：recognise only when BOTH (a) detailed formal plan (business concerned, locations, employees, expenditures, implementation timing — HKAS 37.72(a)) AND (b) valid expectation raised in those affected by starting implementation OR announcing main features (HKAS 37.72(b)–73). Board approval alone is NOT enough. Decommissioning / restoration （HKAS 37 + HKAS 16）：recognise provision at best estimate; PV included in the cost of PPE （not expensed） B. Measurement（計量） Best estimate （HKAS 37.36–37）：the amount the entity would rationally pay to settle the obligation at the end of the reporting period or to transfer it to a third party Large population of similar obligations （HKAS 37.39）： expected value method — weight all possible outcomes by probabilities; if each outcome equally likely, use the mid point Single obligation （HKAS 37.40）： most likely outcome may be best estimate, BUT must consider other possible outcomes — if other outcomes are mostly higher (lower), best estimate is a higher (lower) amount Discounting （HKAS 37.45–46）：where the effect of the time value of money is material , provision = present value of expected expenditures. LP 實務指引：settlement 12 months after reporting date → discount Unwinding of discount （HKAS 37.60）：increase in provision due to passage of time → interest expense （a borrowing cost），NOT added to PPE Onerous contract measurement （HKAS 37.68–68A）：unavoidable costs = lower of (i) cost of fulfilling the contract AND (ii) compensation/penalties from failure to fulfil。Cost of fulfilling = incremental costs (direct labour, materials) + allocation of other directly related costs (e.g. depreciation on PPE used) Restructuring measurement （HKAS 37.80–84）： Include : only direct expenditures necessarily entailed by the restructuring AND not associated with ongoing activities（e.g. redundancy payments, lease termination costs） Exclude : retraining/relocating continuing staff; marketing; investment in new systems and distribution networks; future operating losses (unless onerous contract); gains on expected disposal of assets C. Disclosure（披露） Provisions — for each class （HKAS 37.84–85）： Para Disclosure 84(a) Carrying amount at beginning and end of period 84(b) Additional provisions made, incl. increases to existing provisions 84(c) Amounts used (charged against the provision) during the period 84(d) Unused amounts reversed during the period 84(e) Increase in discounted amount from passage of time / change in discount rate 85(a) Brief description of nature of obligation + expected timing of outflows 85(b) Uncertainties about amount/timing; major assumptions on future events 85(c) Expected reimbursements + any asset recognised for them Comparative information not required for para. 84 items Contingent liabilities （HKAS 37.86, disclose unless remote）：brief description of nature + where practicable (a) estimate of financial effect, (b) uncertainties re amount/timing, (c) possibility of reimbursement Contingent assets （HKAS 37.89, disclose when probable）：brief description of nature + where practicable an estimate of financial effect 通用豁免 ：impracticable to disclose → disclose that fact (HKAS 37.91)；disclosure would seriously prejudice entity's position in a dispute → disclose general nature of dispute + fact and reason for non disclosure (HKAS 37.92) D. Key Journal Entries（全部 Dr = Cr 平衡） 1. Warranty / refund provision（initial recognition, e.g. expected value HK$700,000） Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Warranty expense (P&L) 700,000     Provision for warranties 700,000 2. Warranty claims incurred against provision（e.g. HK$280,000） Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Provision for warranties 280,000     Cash / Spare parts inventory 280,000 3. Provision for damages on lawsuit loss（e.g. HK$500,000） Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Damages expense (P&L) 500,000     Provision for damages (current liability) 500,000 4. Onerous contract（e.g. least net cost HK$120,000） Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Loss on onerous contract (P&L) 120,000     Provision for onerous contract 120,000 5. Decommissioning provision — initial recognition at PV（e.g. PV HK$3,384,000） Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Property, plant & equipment 3,384,000     Provision for decommissioning 3,384,000 6. Unwinding of discount on decommissioning provision（e.g. HK$169,200） Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Interest expense (P&L) 169,200     Provision for decommissioning 169,200 7. Restructuring provision（e.g. direct expenditures HK$1,200,000） Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Restructuring expense (P&L) 1,200,000     Provision for restructuring 1,200,000 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Provision vs Contingent Liability（probability thresholds） Provision Contingent Liability Nature of obligation Present obligation from past obligating event Possible obligation; 或 present obligation 但唔符合 recognition criteria Probability of outflow Probable (more likely than not, 50%) Not probable (但 more than remote)；或 outflow probable 但 cannot be reliably measured Recognised in SFP? Yes — recognised as liability No — never recognised (HKAS 37.27) Disclosure Full movement reconciliation per class (HKAS 37.84–85) Notes disclosure unless remote (HKAS 37.28, 86) 點樣分辨 問自己：係咪 present obligation + probable + reliable estimate？三個 YES 先入賬 任何一個 criteria fail（但仍 possible / more than remote）→ 只披露； remote → 咩都唔使做 考試伏位 Lawsuit 判斷：lawyers 話 likely to lose → provision； unlikely (but not remote) → contingent liability 披露； remote → 唔披露 唔好見到 "present obligation" 就入賬 — 仲要 check probable + reliable estimate！可靠估計做唔到都係 contingent liability Table 2: Contingent Liability vs Contingent Asset（threshold asymmetry） Contingent Liability Contingent Asset Definition (HKAS 37.10) Possible obligation from past events, confirmed by uncertain future events outside entity's control Possible asset from past events, confirmed by uncertain future events outside entity's control Recognised in SFP? Never Never — 除非 inflow 係 virtually certain → 變成真正的 asset 入賬 (HKAS 37.33) Disclosure threshold Disclose unless outflow is remote (HKAS 37.28) Disclose only when inflow is probable (HKAS 37.34) Recognition threshold 升到 probable + reliably measurable → 變 provision 入賬 (HKAS 37.30) 升到 virtually certain → 變 asset (receivable) 入賬 (HKAS 37.33) 點樣分辨 Liability 門檻低啲：more than remote 就要披露 Asset 門檻高好多：probable 只係披露；virtually certain 先入賬 — 防範確認可能永遠收唔到嘅 income 考試伏位 "Remote" 無定義，靠 professional judgement — 題目俾 lawyers' advice 字眼要捉實 最經典錯誤：probable inflow 就急住 recognise receivable — 錯！ probable ≠ virtually certain ，只可以披露 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Define a "provision" under HKAS 37 and explain how it differs from other liabilities such as trade payables and accruals. Back: A provision is a liability of uncertain timing or amount (HKAS 37.10/37.11) Trade payables: goods/services received and invoiced or formally agreed — low uncertainty Accruals: goods/services received but not yet invoiced/formally agreed — medium uncertainty Provisions: amount and/or timing of settlement is genuinely uncertain (e.g. warranty claims) — high uncertainty → presented separately from payables and accruals in the SFP 💬 白話解釋：三樣都係負債，分別只在於「唔確定性」有幾高。收咗貨等找數（trade payable）同埋未收單嘅 accrual 金額時間都好肯定；provision 係你知道遲早要俾錢，但唔知幾時俾、俾幾多，所以要獨立一欄披露。 Card 2 Front: State the THREE recognition criteria for a provision under HKAS 37.14. Must all of them be met? Back: (1) A present obligation (legal or constructive) as a result of a past event (obligating event) (2) It is probable (more likely than not, 50%) that an outflow of resources embodying economic benefits will be required to settle the obligation (HKAS 37.23) (3) A reliable estimate can be made of the amount of the obligation ALL THREE must be met ; if any fails → no provision (but a contingent liability may exist) 💬 白話解釋：記口訣「 obligation–probable–estimate」三環扣。少一個都唔可以入賬，最多做 contingent liability 喺 notes 披露。 Card 3 Front: Distinguish a legal obligation from a constructive obligation under HKAS 37, giving one example of each. Back: Legal obligation : arises from a contract, legislation, or other operation of law — e.g. warranty agreement issued at time of sale; legislative requirement to clean up contaminated land (HKAS 37.15–16) Constructive obligation : arises from an established pattern of past practice or published policies indicating the entity will accept certain responsibilities, AND the entity has created a valid expectation in other parties that it will discharge them — e.g. retail store with published refund policy despite no legal requirement 💬 白話解釋：Legal = 白紙黑字法律合約迫你做；constructive = 你一直以來嘅做法或公開承諾令到人哋合理預期你會做，你冇 realistic alternative 甩身。兩者都符合 provision 第一個條件。 Card 4 Front: What is a contingent liability under HKAS 37.10, and what is its accounting treatment (HKAS 37.27–28)? Back: Definition: (a) a possible obligation from past events, confirmed only by occurrence/non occurrence of uncertain future events not wholly within the entity's control; OR (b) a present obligation not recognised because outflow is not probable or amount cannot be reliably measured Treatment: never recognised in the financial statements (HKAS 37.27) Disclose in the notes unless the possibility of outflow is remote (HKAS 37.28); if remote → no disclosure at all 💬 白話解釋：Contingent liability 永遠唔上 SFP。問自己 outflow 係咪 remote：唔係 remote 就要喺 notes 講（nature、financial effect、uncertainties）；remote 就當冇事發生。 Card 5 Front: State the accounting treatment of a contingent asset at each likelihood level of inflow (HKAS 37.31–34). Back: Virtually certain → inflow is no longer contingent: recognise the asset (e.g. receivable) in the SFP (HKAS 37.33) Probable (but not virtually certain) → do not recognise ; disclose contingent asset in notes — brief description of nature + where practicable estimate of financial effect (HKAS 37.34, 89) Not probable → no recognition, no disclosure (HKAS 37.31) 💬 白話解釋：記住資產門檻高過負債：負債 probable 就入賬；資產要 virtually certain 先入賬，probable 只係披露。原因係避免確認可能永遠收唔到嘅 income。 Card 6 Front: How is the "best estimate" of a provision measured under HKAS 37.36–40 for (a) a large population of similar obligations and (b) a single obligation? Back: Best estimate = amount the entity would rationally pay to settle the obligation at the end of the reporting period or to transfer it to a third party (HKAS 37.36–37) (a) Large population (e.g. product warranties): expected value — weight all possible outcomes by probabilities; mid point if outcomes equally likely (HKAS 37.39) (b) Single obligation (e.g. rectifying a fault in one building): most likely outcome , but consider other possible outcomes — if they are mostly higher (lower), best estimate is a higher (lower) amount (HKAS 37.40) 💬 白話解釋：一大堆同類嘢（賣咗十萬件貨嘅 warranty）用期望值 probability weighted；單一事件（一幢樓維修）用最可能結果，但其他結果普遍偏高時要向上調。 Card 7 Front: When must a provision be discounted to present value, and how is the subsequent unwinding of the discount accounted for (HKAS 37.45–46, 60)? Back: Discount when the effect of the time value of money is material — provision = present value of expenditures expected to settle the obligation (HKAS 37.45–46). LP working guide: settlement more than 12 months after reporting date → discount The increase in the provision due to the passage of time (unwinding) is recognised as interest expense (a borrowing cost) in P&L (HKAS 37.60): Dr Interest expense / Cr Provision For decommissioning provisions, the initial PV is capitalised into the cost of PPE under HKAS 16 — but unwinding is never added to PPE 💬 白話解釋：十年後先使嘅 500 萬唔值今日嘅 500 萬，所以要折現。之後每年個 provision 會「滾大」返向面值，滾大嗰部分入 interest expense，唔係加落 PPE 成本。 Card 8 Front: State the recognition criteria (HKAS 37.72) and measurement rule (HKAS 37.80–84) for a restructuring provision. Back: Recognition — BOTH required: (a) a detailed formal plan (business/part concerned, principal locations, employees to be compensated, expenditures, implementation timing); AND (b) a valid expectation raised in those affected — by starting to implement the plan or announcing its main features (HKAS 37.72–73). Board approval alone is not sufficient Measurement — include only direct expenditures necessarily entailed by the restructuring and not associated with ongoing activities (e.g. redundancy payments, lease termination costs) Exclude : retraining/relocating continuing staff; marketing; new systems and distribution networks; future operating losses (unless onerous contract); gains on expected disposal of assets 💬 白話解釋：董事會齋拍板唔算數 — 要公佈咗俾受影響嘅人知，令佢哋有 valid expectation 先可以確認。計數只計「直接、必要、同持續經營無關」嘅開支；retraining、marketing、新系統呢啲係將來生意嘅嘢，全部唔計。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Provision 時间或金額唔確定嘅負債，符合條件要入賬 A provision is recognised only when a present obligation exists, an outflow is probable, and a reliable estimate can be made (HKAS 37.14). Contingent liability 未確認嘅可能負債，除非 remote 否則要披露 The lawsuit is disclosed as a contingent liability because the lawyers advised that an outflow is possible but not probable. Contingent asset 未確認嘅可能資產，probable 先披露、virtually certain 先入賬 As the compensation inflow was probable but not virtually certain, it was disclosed as a contingent asset rather than recognised. Constructive obligation 因過往做法或公開政策造成他人合理預期而產生嘅義務 The store's published refund policy created a constructive obligation even though no legal obligation existed. Obligating event 令企業冇 realistic alternative、必須履行義務嘅過去事件 The sale of goods under warranty is the obligating event that gives rise to the warranty provision. Onerous contract 履行成本（unavoidable costs）高過預期利益嘅虧損合約 Because the unavoidable costs of fulfilling the contract exceed the expected economic benefits, the contract is onerous and a provision is recognised (HKAS 37.66). Expected value 按概率加權嘅期望值，用嚟計量一大population 嘅同類義務 The warranty provision was measured using the expected value method, weighting each outcome by its probability (HKAS 37.39). Restructuring 由管理層策劃控制、重大改變業務範圍或經營方式嘅計劃 A restructuring provision is recognised only when a detailed formal plan exists and a valid expectation has been raised in those affected (HKAS 37.72).

title: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 37 para. 14, a provision …
text: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 37 para. 14, a provision is recognised only when ALL three of the following conditions are met: (a) the entity has a present obligation (legal or constructive) as a result of a past event; (b) it is probable (more likely than not) that an outflow of resources embodying economic benefits will be required to settle the obligation; and (c) a reliable estimate can be made of the amount of the obligation. Certainty of timing and amount is NOT required — indeed, a provision is by definition a liability of uncertain timing or amount (HKAS 37.10/37.11). If timing and amount were certain, the item would be a trade payable or accrual, not a provision. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 NOT question，考你 provision 嘅定義本質。Provision 嘅核心特徵就係 timing 或 amount 有 uncertainty — 所以 D 所講「time 同 amount 都確定」唔單止唔係確認條件，仲同 provision 定義相反。A、B、C 就係 HKAS 37.14 嘅三大條件，全部係真。考試伏位：睇漏 "NOT" 字就會揀 A/B/C。遇到 NOT/EXCEPT 題目，先圈起個關鍵字再答。 Rule Check: HKAS 37 para. 14; HKAS 37 para. 11 Common Trap（繁中）: 考生經常將「reliable estimate」同「certainty」混淆。HKAS 37 要求嘅係可以可靠估計（reliable estimate），而唔係金額確定 — 如果金額完全確定，根本就唔係 provision，而係 payable/accrual。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 37 para. 72, a constructive obligation for restructuring arises only when the entity (a) has a detailed formal plan for the restructuring AND (b) has raised a valid expectation in those affected that it will carry out the restructuring by starting to implement the plan or announcing its main features to those affected. At 31 December 20X5, Lantern had a detailed formal plan but had NOT communicated it to employees, customers or suppliers — a board decision alone is not an obligating event because it can still be altered or reversed (HKAS 37.20). Therefore no restructuring provision is recognised in the 20X5 financial statements. The public announcement on 8 January 20X6 is a non adjusting event after the reporting period which requires disclosure under HKAS 10 if material. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 restructuring 嘅經典考試伏位 — 正正係 Jun 2024 panelist report 點名批評嘅錯誤：考生以為董事會批准咗就要入賬。板斧：board approval ≠ constructive obligation；必須已經公佈俾受影響人士（或已開始實施），令佢哋產生 valid expectation 先算。Option A 錯在齋睇 formal plan 忽略 communication；Option C 錯在將 1 月 8 日嘅公佈當 adjusting event — 佢唔係為報告期末已存在嘅狀況提供證據，而係報告期後先產生 obligation；Option D 錯在分類：呢度唔係 possible obligation，而係根本未有 obligating event，所以連 contingent liability 都唔係，只係 HKAS 10 嘅 non adjusting event 披露。Redundancy HK$900,000 + lease termination HK$300,000 = HK$1,200,000 係將來（20X6 年公佈後）先確認嘅數字。 Rule Check: HKAS 37 paras. 20, 72; HKAS 10 Events after the Reporting Period (non adjusting event disclosure) Common Trap（繁中）: 「Board 已批准 + 有詳細計劃」只滿足 HKAS 37.72(a) 一半條件。記住兩個條件係 AND 關係：detailed formal plan AND valid expectation raised。缺第二個就乜都唔入賬。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Workings — expected value of warranty obligation at 31 December 20X5 (HKAS 37.39, large population of similar obligations): Likelihood Cost (HK$) Expected value (HK$) 70% no defects 0 0 20% minor defects 1,500,000 300,000 10% major defects 4,000,000 400,000 Total expected value 700,000 Less: repair costs already incurred during 20X5: (280,000) Provision for warranties at 31 December 20X5 = HK$700,000 − HK$280,000 = HK$420,000 解題思路（繁中）: 兩步計算：第一步用 expected value method（HKAS 37.39）— 因為係一大 population 嘅同類 warranty obligations，要 probability weighted，唔可以攞最可能結果（70% 無事 → nil）。第二步記住扣返年內已經使咗嘅維修費 HK$280,000，剩低嘅先係年結日 provision 餘額。Distractor 分析：A（HK$nil）= 錯用 most likely outcome 喺大 population 度；B（HK$700,000）= 計啱 expected value 但唔記得扣已付嘅 claims；D（HK$5,500,000）= 完全唔用概率，直接將 minor + major 成本相加。 Rule Check: HKAS 37 paras. 24, 36, 39 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個常見錯：(1) 見到 70% 機會無 defect 就以為唔使做 provision — 對成個 population 嚟講 probable outflow 係成立嘅；(2) 忘記 provision 係「年結日尚欠嘅責任」，已經賠咗嘅錢要扣走。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Step 1 — Is the contract onerous (HKAS 37.66)? Economic benefits expected (contract revenue) = 4,000 × HK$300 = HK$1,200,000. Cost of fulfilling the contract = 4,000 × HK$340 = HK$1,360,000. Since the unavoidable costs of meeting the obligations exceed the economic benefits expected, the contract is onerous and a provision must be recognised. Step 2 — Measure at the least net cost (HKAS 37.68): the lower of (a) the net cost of fulfilling the contract = HK$1,360,000 − HK$1,200,000 = HK$160,000 ; and (b) the penalty from failure to fulfil = HK$120,000 . Provision for onerous contract = lower of HK$160,000 and HK$120,000 = HK$120,000. Journal entry: Dr Loss on onerous contract (P&L) HK$120,000 / Cr Provision for onerous contract HK$120,000. 解題思路（繁中）: Onerous contract 兩步曲：第一步測試係咪 onerous — 成本 340/set 高過售價 300/set，履行就蝕，所以係 onerous。第二步計 provision 金額 — 記住係「least net cost」：履行嘅淨虧損 HK$160,000 同退出罰款 HK$120,000 取其 低 。Distractor 分析：A（nil）= 混淆咗「future operating losses 唔入賬」嘅規則 — onerous contract 係現存合約義務，必須入賬；C（HK$160,000）= 只睇履行成本，忘記同 penalty 比較取低；D（HK$1,360,000）= 錯用履行總成本，冇扣除合約收益 HK$1,200,000。注意 HKAS 37.68A：cost of fulfilling 包括 incremental costs（direct labour、materials）加分攤直接相關成本（如 machinery depreciation），題目已經包埋喺 HK$340 入面。 Rule Check: HKAS 37 paras. 66, 68, 68A Common Trap（繁中）: 最大陷阱係忘記「lower of」比較 — 履行定退出，邊個平計邊個。其次係唔記得將合約收益對銷履行成本（要用 net cost，唔係 gross cost）。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): The decommissioning obligation meets the HKAS 37 recognition criteria: a present (legal) obligation exists as a result of a past event (the construction of the solar farm), an outflow is probable, and a reliable estimate (HK$5,000,000) exists. Because settlement occurs 8 years after the reporting date, the time value of money is material and the provision must be measured at present value (HKAS 37.45–46): PV of decommissioning cost = HK$5,000,000 × 0.6768 = HK$3,384,000 Under HKAS 16, the initial estimate of dismantling/removal/restoration costs is included in the cost of the item of property, plant and equipment — it is NOT expensed. Journal entry on 1 January 20X4: Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Property, plant & equipment — solar farm 3,384,000     Provision for decommissioning 3,384,000 解題思路（繁中）: 考兩個規則疊埋一齊：(1) discounting — 8 年後先使嘅錢要折現（LP 指引：settlement 超過 12 個月就要折），用題目俾嘅 PV factor 0.6768；(2) HKAS 16 嘅資本化規則 — decommissioning 成本嘅現值要加落 PPE 成本，唔係當 expense。Distractor 分析：A 錯在唔折現，直接用面值 HK$5,000,000；B 折現啱但錯誤費用化（debit Decommissioning expense）— 初期估計永遠資本化入 PPE；D 係古惑混合體，將部分當 expense 部分入 PPE，仲要 Cr 面值，完全違規。留意：之後每年 unwinding of discount 先會出現 Dr Interest expense / Cr Provision（HKAS 37.60），嗰部分先入 P&L。 Rule Check: HKAS 37 paras. 45–46; HKAS 16 (initial estimate of dismantling/removal/restoration costs included in cost of PPE); unwinding — HKAS 37 para. 60 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大陷阱：(1) 見到 settlement 好耐之後先發生都唔折現，直接入面值；(2) 將 PV 當 expense 而唔係資本化。口訣：「初期入 PPE，滾息入 P&L」— initial PV capitalise under HKAS 16；unwinding 先係 interest expense。

title: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … …
text: M6 Chapter 15: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (1 mark) Beacon Lighting Limited (Beacon) is assessing whether it can recognise provisions for several obligations in its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X5. In accordance with HKAS 37, which of the following is NOT a condition that must be met before a provision is recognised? A. Beacon has a present obligation (legal or constructive) as a result of a past event B. It is probable that an outflow of resources embodying economic benefits will be required to settle the obligation C. A reliable estimate can be made of the amount of the obligation D. The timing and the amount of the future expenditure required in settlement are certain Question 2 (1 mark) Lantern Homeware Limited (Lantern), whose reporting date is 31 December 20X5, operates a lighting division that has been loss making. On 18 December 20X5, Lantern's Board of Directors unanimously approved a detailed formal plan to close the lighting division. The plan identifies the business concerned, the principal locations affected, the number of employees who will receive redundancy payments of HK$900,000, lease termination costs of HK$300,000, and the implementation date (1 March 20X6). As at 31 December 20X5, the decision had not been communicated to any of the employees, customers or suppliers affected. The plan was publicly announced to all affected parties on 8 January 20X6. In accordance with HKAS 37, how should Lantern account for the closure plan in its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X5? A. Recognise a restructuring provision of HK$1,200,000 because a detailed formal plan had been approved by the Board before the reporting date B. Recognise no restructuring provision; disclose the plan as a non adjusting event after the reporting period in accordance with HKAS 10 if it is material C. Recognise a restructuring provision of HK$1,200,000 and disclose the announcement on 8 January 20X6 as an adjusting event after the reporting period D. Disclose a contingent liability of HK$1,200,000 because the restructuring is only a possible obligation at the reporting date Question 3 (2 marks) Kowloon Kettle Limited (Kowloon Kettle) sells electric kettles with a six month warranty under which it repairs manufacturing defects free of charge. For kettles sold during the year ended 31 December 20X5, management estimates: 70% probability that the kettles sold will have no defects; 20% probability that the kettles sold will have minor defects, which would cost HK$1,500,000 to repair in total; and 10% probability that the kettles sold will have major defects, which would cost HK$4,000,000 to repair in total. During the year ended 31 December 20X5, repair costs of HK$280,000 had already been incurred in respect of kettles sold during that year. In accordance with HKAS 37, what amount should be recognised as a provision for warranties in Kowloon Kettle's statement of financial position at 31 December 20X5? A. HK$nil B. HK$700,000 C. HK$420,000 D. HK$5,500,000 Question 4 (2 marks) Harvest Kitchenware Limited (Harvest) entered into a non cancellable contract to supply 4,000 cookware sets to a customer at HK$300 per set, with delivery due in June 20X6. Due to a sharp rise in steel prices before production commenced, Harvest's incremental costs of direct labour and materials, plus the allocation of depreciation on machinery used to fulfil this and other contracts, now amount to HK$340 per set. If Harvest fails to fulfil the contract, it must pay the customer a penalty of HK$120,000. No inventory had been produced by Harvest's reporting date of 31 December 20X5. In accordance with HKAS 37, what amount, if any, should Harvest recognise as a provision in respect of this contract at 31 December 20X5? A. HK$nil — no provision is recognised because the production costs will only be incurred in the future B. HK$120,000 C. HK$160,000 D. HK$1,360,000 Question 5 (2 marks) On 1 January 20X4, SolarTech Energy Limited (SolarTech) completed the construction of a solar farm at a cost of HK$40,000,000. Under local law, SolarTech is legally required to dismantle the solar panels and restore the site at the end of their useful life of 8 years. SolarTech estimates the decommissioning work will cost HK$5,000,000. The relevant discount rate is 5% and the present value factor for 8 years at 5% is 0.6768. In accordance with HKAS 37 and HKAS 16, which journal entry should SolarTech record on 1 January 20X4 in respect of the decommissioning obligation? A. Dr Property, plant & equipment — solar farm HK$5,000,000; Cr Provision for decommissioning HK$5,000,000 B. Dr Decommissioning expense HK$3,384,000; Cr Provision for decommissioning HK$3,384,000 C. Dr Property, plant & equipment — solar farm HK$3,384,000; Cr Provision for decommissioning HK$3,384,000 D. Dr Property, plant & equipment — solar farm HK$3,384,000; Dr Decommissioning expense HK$1,616,000; Cr Provision for decommissioning HK$5,000,000 End of quiz. No answers are provided in this file.

title: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
C. Presentation & Journal Entries（本章 LP 以確認/計量為主，無獨立披露段落；以下為必考呈報同分錄）
excerpt: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives (3–5, English, action verbs) 1. Distinguish current tax from deferred tax…
text: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives (3–5, English, action verbs) 1. Distinguish current tax from deferred tax, and accounting profit from taxable income, under HKAS 12 Income Taxes . 2. Account for current tax liabilities and current tax assets, including converting accounting profit to taxable income via adjustments. 3. Compute the tax base of assets and liabilities and identify taxable and deductible temporary differences. 4. Calculate and recognise deferred tax liabilities and deferred tax assets, including the movement (opening → closing balance) and the related journal entries. 5. Apply the initial recognition exemption and the rule on measuring deferred tax at enacted or substantively enacted tax rates. 必背考點 A. Recognition（確認） A1. Current tax liabilities and current tax assets Recognise a current tax liability for any unpaid current tax from the current and prior periods (HKAS 12.12). 考試伏位：唔係淨係計今年，往年未找清嘅稅都要入。 If the amount already paid in respect of current and prior periods exceeds the amount due, the excess is recognised as a current tax asset (HKAS 12.13). A tax loss that can be carried back to recover current tax of a previous period is recognised as a current tax asset , because the benefit is probable and reliably measurable (HKAS 12.13–14). Journal entry (current tax): Dr Income tax expense ｜ Cr Income tax payable （以 taxable income × 現行稅率計） A2. Temporary differences — 定義（HKAS 12.5） Temporary difference = the difference between the carrying amount of an asset or liability in the statement of financial position and its tax base (HKAS 12.5). Arise from timing differences in recognising transactions/events under HKFRSs vs the Inland Revenue Ordinance (IRO); they reverse over time . Permanent differences（例如 dividend income not taxable under IRO、fines and penalties non deductible） never give rise to temporary differences — 考試年年考呢個分別。 A3. Deferred tax liabilities — recognition A deferred tax liability (DTL) is the income tax payable in respect of a taxable temporary difference (HKAS 12.5). An entity recognises a DTL for all taxable temporary differences（無 probability 條件 — 呢點同 DTA 唔同，常見伏位）。 Taxable temporary difference exists when（Exhibit 16.1）： Asset: Carrying amount Tax base ；或 Liability: Carrying amount < Tax base 。 A4. Deferred tax assets — recognition criteria（HKAS 12.24, 34） A deferred tax asset (DTA) is income tax recoverable in respect of a deductible temporary difference , the carryforward of unused tax losses , and the carryforward of unused tax credits (HKAS 12.5). DTA recognised only to the extent it is probable that sufficient future taxable income will be available to utilise the deductible temporary difference / unused tax loss / unused tax credit (HKAS 12.24, 34)。有 probable 測試 — 同 DTL 全面確認唔一樣。 Deductible temporary difference exists when（Exhibit 16.2/16.6）： Asset: Carrying amount < Tax base ；或 Liability: Carrying amount Tax base 。 A5. Initial recognition exemption（HKAS 12.15(b), 22(c), 24） No DTL or DTA is recognised on a temporary difference arising on initial recognition of an asset/liability where the transaction: 1. is not a business combination ; and 2. affects neither accounting profit nor assessable/taxable profits at the time of the transaction; and 3. does not give rise to equal taxable and deductible temporary differences . Rationale（LP）：recognising deferred tax would adjust the carrying amount of the asset/liability and make the financial statements less transparent ；禁止於 initial recognition 及其後任何時間確認。 經典例子：購入 land，無 capital allowance/depreciation deduction，tax base = Nil → TTD 存在但豁免適用（唔係 business combination、唔影響 accounting/taxable profit）。 B. Measurement（計量） B1. Accounting profit → Taxable income（轉換公式） Accounting profit Plus Non deductible expenses（會計已計、稅務唔准扣） Minus Deductible charges and allowances not recognised in accounting profit（稅務先扣，例如 capital allowance） Minus Non assessable income（會計已計、稅務唔使課稅，例如 dividend income） Plus Assessable income not recognised in accounting profit = Taxable income Current tax expense = Taxable income × tax rate （香港 profits tax 例子用 16.5%/15%，題目話事）。 B2. Tax base（HKAS 12.5 指引） Asset : Tax base = Carrying amount − future Taxable amounts + future Deductible amounts Liability : Tax base = Carrying amount − future Deductible amounts + future Taxable amounts 記法（LP 例子）： Machine：Tax base = Cost − accumulated capital allowance already deducted（例如 cost 100、已扣 30 → TB 70）。 Trade receivables（已課稅銷售）+ ECL provision 20 → TB = 100 − Nil + 20 = 120 （TB CA → DTD → DTA）。 Interest payable（paid 先可扣）→ TB = 100 − 100 = Nil 。 Accrued fines and penalties（永不可扣）→ TB = 100 − Nil = 100 （= CA → 無 temporary difference — permanent difference）。 B3. Deferred tax 計算 — 記住 closing balance vs movement DTL = Taxable temporary difference × tax rate （= CA of asset − TB of asset，或 TB of liability − CA of liability） DTA = Deductible temporary difference × tax rate （= TB of asset − CA of asset，或 CA of liability − TB of liability） 計出嚟嘅係 closing balance ；journal entry 記 movement = closing − opening ： DTL 增加 → deferred tax expense 增加；DTA 減少 → deferred tax expense 增加（相反方向就係 income）。 Income tax expense = current tax expense + deferred tax expense （兩者分開計）。 B4. Tax rate 選擇 Current tax：按 the end of the reporting period 已生效（in effect） 嘅稅率計量（HKAS 12.46）。 Deferred tax：按 預期資產變現／負債清償期間適用 、且於報告期末已 enacted or substantively enacted 嘅稅率計量（HKAS 12.47）。已立法但未來先生效嘅新稅率都要用（例如 15% → 10%，DTL 要重計：64,000 × 10%/15% = 42,667）。 C. Presentation & Journal Entries（本章 LP 以確認/計量為主，無獨立披露段落；以下為必考呈報同分錄） Income tax expense = current tax expense + deferred tax expense ，於 statement of profit or loss 呈報；current tax liability/asset 與 deferred tax liability/asset 於 statement of financial position 呈報。 Journal entries（全部 balance）： 情況 Dr Cr 記 current tax Income tax expense 140,250 Income tax payable 140,250 DTL 增加（例：movement 151,000） Income tax expense – deferred 151,000 Deferred tax liability 151,000 DTA 增加（例：movement 217,000） Deferred tax asset 217,000 Income tax expense – deferred 217,000 稅率下調，重計 DTL（例：21,333） Deferred tax liability 21,333 Income tax expense – deferred 21,333 稅率下調，重計 DTA Income tax expense – deferred Deferred tax asset 易混淆概念對比 對比一：Accounting profit vs Taxable income Accounting profit Taxable income 計算依據 HKFRSs（會計準則） Inland Revenue Ordinance（稅例） 報告去邊 Financial statements（畀 investors/creditors） Tax return（交畀 Inland Revenue Department） Dividend income Recognised when earned Not taxable under IRO → 永久差異， 不會 產生 temporary difference Warranty expense Accrual basis（估計即入賬） Deductible only when paid → timing 差異，產生 deductible temporary difference Depreciation vs capital allowance 按 useful life 折舊 按稅例 capital allowance → 差額屬 temporary difference，會 reverse 考試伏位（點樣分辨） 見到「never assessable / never deductible」= permanent ，無 deferred tax 見到「deductible when paid/incurred/written off」= temporary ，要計 DTA/DTL 對比二：Taxable temporary difference vs Deductible temporary difference Taxable temporary difference (TTD) Deductible temporary difference (DTD) 未來效果 未來 taxable income ↑ → 未來多交稅 未來 taxable income ↓ → 未來慳稅 Asset 情況 Carrying amount Tax base Carrying amount < Tax base Liability 情況 Carrying amount < Tax base Carrying amount Tax base 確認 Deferred tax liability （全數確認，無 probable 測試） Deferred tax asset （ only to the extent probable 有足夠 future taxable income 可用，HKAS 12.24, 34） 典型例子 Capitalised development costs（稅務已全扣，TB = Nil）；accelerated capital allowance depreciation ECL allowance、warranty provision、annual leave provision（paid/incurred 先可扣） 考試伏位 同學最易調亂 liability 方向：liability CA TB 其實係 DTA （唔係 DTL） 記住 JE 方向：DTL↑ 要 Cr DTL / Dr expense；DTA↑ 要 Dr DTA / Cr expense Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Under HKAS 12, when must an entity recognise a current tax liability, and when a current tax asset? Back: Current tax liability: for any unpaid current tax from the current and prior periods (HKAS 12.12). Current tax asset: when the amount paid exceeds the amount due for those periods (excess → current tax income); also for a tax loss carried back to recover current tax of a previous period (HKAS 12.13–14). 💬 白話：未找清嘅稅（唔單止今年，舊年欠嘅都計）就係 current tax liability；交多咗、或者 tax loss 可以 carry back 拎返舊稅，就係 current tax asset。 Card 2 Front: What is the formula for the tax base of an asset? Apply it to trade receivables of HK$100 with a general ECL provision of HK$20 (provision not yet tax deductible; revenue already taxed). Back: Tax base (asset) = Carrying amount − future taxable amounts + future deductible amounts. Trade receivables: HK$100 − Nil + HK$20 = HK$120 . CA (100) < TB (120) → deductible temporary difference → deferred tax asset. 💬 白話：資產嘅 tax base 即係「將來稅務上仲有幾多可以扣」。ECL 而家唔准扣、將來 write off 先扣，所以 TB 高過賬面值 20，係 DTA。 Card 3 Front: What is the formula for the tax base of a liability? Apply it to (i) interest payable of HK$100 deductible when paid, and (ii) accrued fines of HK$100 that are never deductible. Back: Tax base (liability) = Carrying amount − future deductible amounts + future taxable amounts. (i) Interest payable: 100 − 100 = Nil → CA TB → deductible temporary difference → DTA. (ii) Accrued fines: 100 − Nil = HK$100 → CA = TB → no temporary difference (permanent difference). 💬 白話：負債 tax base = 賬面值減將來可扣嘅數。罰款永遠唔准扣，所以 TB 照等於 100，無差異 — 呢個係 permanent difference，考試好鍾意用嚟做 distractor。 Card 4 Front: Complete the four identification rules: (a) asset CA TB; (b) asset CA < TB; (c) liability CA TB; (d) liability CA < TB. Back: (a) Asset CA TB → taxable temporary difference → DTL. (b) Asset CA < TB → deductible temporary difference → DTA. (c) Liability CA TB → deductible temporary difference → DTA. (d) Liability CA < TB → taxable temporary difference → DTL. 💬 白話：資產睇 CA 大細好直覺；負債要反轉諗 — liability 賬面值大過 tax base 其實代表你將來有得扣（例如 provision），所以係 DTA。呢格係 panel report 年年話弱嘅位。 Card 5 Front: What are the recognition criteria for a deferred tax asset under HKAS 12.24 and 12.34? How does this differ from a deferred tax liability? Back: DTA recognised for deductible temporary differences, carryforward of unused tax losses and unused tax credits — only to the extent it is probable that sufficient future taxable income will be available to utilise them. DTL: recognised for all taxable temporary differences — no probability condition. 💬 白話：DTA 係「有望先好認」— 要 probable 有未來應課稅利潤先用得著；DTL 就「凡有 TTD 必認」，唔使過 probable 關。 Card 6 Front: State the three conditions for the initial recognition exemption under HKAS 12.15(b), 22(c) and 24. Back: The transaction on initial recognition of the asset/liability: 1. is not a business combination ; 2. affects neither accounting profit nor assessable/taxable profits ; and 3. does not give rise to equal taxable and deductible temporary differences . → No DTL/DTA recognised, on initial recognition or subsequently. 💬 白話：三個條件齊中先豁免。經典考法：買 land 無得扣稅（TB = Nil），明明有 TTD，但因為唔影響會計/應課稅利潤又唔係 business combination，所以一世唔准認 DTL。 Card 7 Front: At what tax rates are current tax and deferred tax measured under HKAS 12.46 and 12.47? Back: Current tax: the rate in effect at the end of the reporting period (HKAS 12.46). Deferred tax: the rates expected to apply when the asset is realised / liability settled, based on rates enacted or substantively enacted by the end of the reporting period (HKAS 12.47). Rate change → restate deferred balances (e.g. DTL 64,000 at 15% → 64,000 × 10%/15% = 42,667 at 10%). 💬 白話：current tax 用「而家生效」嘅率；deferred tax 用「將來變現嗰陣」嘅率，但必須已經立法或實質立法。稅率變咗，舊嘅 DTA/DTL 要按比例重計。 Card 8 Front: Give the journal entries for (a) an increase in a deferred tax liability of HK$151,000 and (b) an increase in a deferred tax asset of HK$217,000. What amount does the entry record — balance or movement? Back: (a) Dr Income tax expense – deferred 151,000 ｜ Cr Deferred tax liability 151,000 (b) Dr Deferred tax asset 217,000 ｜ Cr Income tax expense – deferred 217,000 The entry records the movement (closing balance − opening balance), not the closing balance. 💬 白話：公式計出嚟係 closing balance，入賬記「變動」。方向口訣：DTL 升＝使多咗稅＝Dr expense；DTA 升＝慳咗稅＝Cr expense。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Current tax 今期實際要交嘅稅（按 taxable income 計） Current tax is the income tax payable on the taxable income for the current period. Deferred tax 因 timing 差異而產生嘅未來稅務後果 Deferred tax captures the future tax consequences of recovering assets or settling liabilities. Temporary difference 賬面值同 tax base 嘅差異，會隨時間 reverse A temporary difference is the difference between the carrying amount of an asset or liability and its tax base. Tax base 資產/負債喺稅務上嘅「賬面值」 The tax base of the machine is its cost less accumulated capital allowances deducted. Taxable temporary difference 將來會令你多交稅嘅差異 → DTL The excess of the carrying amount over the tax base of an asset is a taxable temporary difference. Deductible temporary difference 將來會令你慳稅嘅差異 → DTA A warranty provision gives rise to a deductible temporary difference because the deduction arises only when paid. Initial recognition exemption 初次確認時符合三條件就唔准認 DTA/DTL The initial recognition exemption prohibits recognising deferred tax on the acquisition of the land. Enacted or substantively enacted rate 已立法（或實質立法）嘅稅率 Deferred tax is measured at tax rates enacted or substantively enacted by the end of the reporting period.

title: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Tax base of a liability = Carrying amount − future deductible amounts + future t…
text: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Tax base of a liability = Carrying amount − future deductible amounts + future taxable amounts. Carrying amount = HK$360,000; future deductible amount = HK$360,000 (deductible only when paid); future taxable amount = Nil. Tax base = HK$360,000 − HK$360,000 + Nil = Nil . Consequently, carrying amount (360,000) tax base (Nil) gives a deductible temporary difference of HK$360,000, giving rise to a deferred tax asset. 解題思路（繁中）: 負債嘅 tax base 公式係「Carrying amount − 將來可扣 + 將來應課稅」。Warranty 將來付款先扣得，所以將來可扣 = 360,000，TB 變 Nil。A 係直接抄賬面值，冇扣將來可扣數 — 係最常見錯誤（panel report 話 tax base of a liability 年年弱就係呢度）。B 係將可扣數加埋落去（方向調轉）。C 係無啦啦除以二，無依據。 Rule Check: HKAS 12.5 (definition of tax base and temporary difference); LP §16.2.2.2 liability tax base formula. Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好以為 liability 嘅 tax base 永遠等於賬面值。口訣：「負債將來有得扣，tax base 即刻縮水」。同時留意：TB = Nil 代表成個 provision 都係 deductible temporary difference → DTA（唔係 DTL）。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Conversion of accounting profit to taxable income (HK$): HK$ Accounting profit before tax 4,200,000 Add: Fines and penalties (non deductible) 80,000 Add: Depreciation expense 250,000 Less: Capital allowance deduction (400,000) Less: Dividend income (non assessable) (60,000) Taxable income 4,070,000 Current tax expense = HK$4,070,000 × 16.5% = HK$671,550 . 解題思路（繁中）: 公式：Accounting profit + non deductible expenses − deductible allowances not in accounts − non assessable income = taxable income。Distractor 逐個拆： A (693,000) = 直接將 4,200,000 × 16.5%，完全冇做任何稅務調整。 B (681,450) = 4,130,000 × 16.5%，即係漏咗扣 non assessable 嘅 dividend income（dividend 喺香港唔使課稅，要扣走）。 D (803,550) = 4,870,000 × 16.5%，即係將 capital allowance 加返入去而唔係扣（方向錯）。 Rule Check: HKAS 12.12; LP §16.1.1.1 accounting profit to taxable income conversion formula. Common Trap（繁中）: 三件事最易亂：(1) depreciation 要 add back、capital allowance 要 deduct — 方向相反；(2) dividend income 喺香港 non assessable，係 permanent difference，但計 taxable income 時一樣要剔走；(3) 罰款 non deductible 要 add back。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Tax base of the interest receivable (asset) = Carrying amount − future taxable amounts + future deductible amounts = HK$120,000 − HK$120,000 + Nil = Nil (the interest will be taxed when received in the future). Carrying amount (120,000) tax base (Nil) → a taxable temporary difference of HK$120,000. Deferred tax liability = HK$120,000 × 16.5% = HK$19,800 . 解題思路（繁中）: Interest income 喺會計上 earned 即認，但稅務上收到現金先課稅 → 將來收錢嗰陣會多交稅，所以係 taxable temporary difference → DTL。Distractor 拆： A 將方向調轉：CA TB 對資產嚟講係 taxable（唔係 deductible），所以唔係 DTA。 C 混淆咗「已入賬」同「無差異」— 正正因為會計早過稅務確認，先會有 timing difference。 D 差異類型講啱但結果錯：taxable temporary difference 只會產生 DTL，唔會產生 DTA。 Rule Check: HKAS 12.5 (taxable temporary difference); LP §16.2.1 (interest income timing example) and §16.2.3.1–16.2.3.2 (Exhibit 16.1: asset CA TB → taxable temporary difference; DTL = TTD × tax rate). Common Trap（繁中）: 考試見到「taxable when received / deductible when paid」就要即刻諗 tax base：資產將來要被課稅 → TB 縮細 → CA TB → DTL。唔好一見「income」就以為係 DTA。 Q4 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Workings (HK$): Carrying amount at 31 March 20X9 = 2,000,000 − (2,000,000 ÷ 4) = 1,500,000 . Tax base at 31 March 20X9 = 2,000,000 − 1,000,000 (capital allowance) = 1,000,000 . Taxable temporary difference = 1,500,000 − 1,000,000 = 500,000 . Closing deferred tax liability = 500,000 × 16.5% = 82,500 . Opening DTL = Nil → movement = increase of 82,500. Journal entry: Dr Income tax expense – deferred 82,500 Cr Deferred tax liability 82,500 (An increase in a deferred tax liability gives rise to deferred tax expense.) 解題思路（繁中）: 三步曲：CA vs TB → TTD → DTL closing balance → 減 opening 得 movement → 先至寫 JE。Distractor 拆： B 方向反轉：DTL 增加要 Cr DTL、Dr expense；Dr DTL 係 DTL 減少先啱。 C 直接將 taxable temporary difference (500,000) 入賬，冇乘稅率 — 記住 JE 記嘅係 tax effect，唔係 temporary difference 本身。 D 用咗 15% 稅率（500,000 × 15% = 75,000）— 題目明明話 16.5%，考試要睇清楚。 Rule Check: HKAS 12.5; LP §16.2.2.1 (tax base of machine = cost − accumulated capital allowance); §16.2.3.2 (DTL = TTD × tax rate; movement entry: Dr Income tax expense – deferred / Cr Deferred tax liability). Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大伏位：(1) closing balance vs movement — 公式計出嚟係 closing balance，opening 為零先可以照入，否則一定要減 opening；(2) Dr/Cr 方向 — DTL 升＝未來多交稅＝ expense 增加（Dr expense）。 Q5 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Tax base workings (HK$): Item Carrying amount Tax base Temporary difference Trade receivables (net) 1,910,000 2,000,000 (gross; sales already taxed; ECL deductible on write off) DTD 90,000 Provision for warranties 140,000 Nil (deductible when incurred) DTD 140,000 Property, plant and equipment 3,000,000 2,400,000 (given) TTD 600,000 Total deductible temporary differences = 90,000 + 140,000 = 230,000 → Deferred tax asset = 230,000 × 15% = HK$34,500 (probable future taxable income available). Total taxable temporary difference = 600,000 → Deferred tax liability = 600,000 × 15% = HK$90,000 . 解題思路（繁中）: 逐項砌 tax base： Trade receivables：CA = 2,000,000 − 90,000 = 1,910,000；TB = 1,910,000 − Nil + 90,000 = 2,000,000（銷售已課稅，將來 taxable = Nil；ECL 將來 write off 可扣 90,000）→ CA < TB → DTD 90,000。 Warranty provision：TB = 140,000 − 140,000 = Nil → CA TB → DTD 140,000。 PPE：CA (3,000,000) TB (2,400,000) → TTD 600,000 → DTL。 Distractor 拆： B 冇乘 15% 稅率，直接報 temporary differences (230,000 / 600,000)。 C 將 DTA 同 DTL 嘅數調轉咗 — 記住 TTD → liability（大數 600,000 係 PPE，係 DTL）。 D 只計咗 ECL 嘅 DTA（90,000 × 15% = 13,500），漏咗 warranty provision 嘅 DTD。 Rule Check: HKAS 12.5; HKAS 12.24 (DTA recognised only to the extent probable future taxable income is available); LP §16.2.2 tax base formulas and §16.2.4.3 (DTA = DTD × tax rate; DTL = TTD × tax rate). Common Trap（繁中）: 多項目題要分開兩堆：DTA 一堆（receivables ECL + provisions）、DTL 一堆（PPE），唔好 net off，亦唔好漏項。記住 DTA 有 probable 條件 — 題目話明「probable sufficient future taxable income」先可以全數認。呢種「tax base of an asset/liability」題型係 panel report 連續三年點名嘅弱項，務必練熟。

title: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Harbour View L…
text: M6 Chapter 16: Income Taxes — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Harbour View Limited (Harbour View) recognised a warranty provision of HK$360,000 in its statement of financial position as at 31 March 20X9. Under the Inland Revenue Ordinance, warranty expenditure is deductible for tax purposes only when it is paid. Warranty payments are expected to be made in full in future periods. In accordance with HKAS 12 Income Taxes , what is the tax base of the warranty provision as at 31 March 20X9? A. HK$360,000 B. HK$720,000 C. HK$180,000 D. Nil Question 2 Kowloon Dynamics Limited (Kowloon Dynamics) reported an accounting profit before tax of HK$4,200,000 for the year ended 31 March 20X9. The profit was arrived at after including the following items: Fines and penalties expense of HK$80,000 (not deductible for tax purposes); Depreciation expense of HK$250,000; Dividend income of HK$60,000 (not taxable under the Inland Revenue Ordinance). A capital allowance deduction of HK$400,000 is available for tax purposes for the year. The profits tax rate is 16.5%. What is the current tax expense of Kowloon Dynamics for the year ended 31 March 20X9? A. HK$693,000 B. HK$681,450 C. HK$671,550 D. HK$803,550 Question 3 Beacon Trading Limited (Beacon) recognises interest income when it is earned under HKFRS. At 31 March 20X9, Beacon has an interest receivable of HK$120,000 recognised in its statement of financial position. For tax purposes, interest income is assessable only when the cash is received. The tax rate is 16.5%. In accordance with HKAS 12, which of the following correctly describes the temporary difference arising and its deferred tax consequence as at 31 March 20X9? A. A deductible temporary difference of HK$120,000, giving rise to a deferred tax asset of HK$19,800 B. A taxable temporary difference of HK$120,000, giving rise to a deferred tax liability of HK$19,800 C. No temporary difference arises because the interest income has already been accrued in the financial statements D. A taxable temporary difference of HK$120,000, giving rise to a deferred tax asset of HK$19,800 Question 4 On 1 April 20X8, Kestrel Engineering Limited (Kestrel) acquired a machine for HK$2,000,000. The machine has a useful life of four years and no residual value, and is depreciated on a straight line basis. For tax purposes, a capital allowance deduction of HK$1,000,000 is available for the year ended 31 March 20X9. The tax rate is 16.5%. The deferred tax liability account had a nil balance at 1 April 20X8, and the machine is Kestrel's only depreciable asset. Which of the following is the correct journal entry to record the deferred tax consequences of the machine for the year ended 31 March 20X9? Date Description Debit HK$ Credit HK$ A 31 March 20X9 Income tax expense – deferred 82,500     Deferred tax liability 82,500 B 31 March 20X9 Deferred tax liability 82,500     Income tax expense – deferred 82,500 C 31 March 20X9 Income tax expense – deferred 500,000     Deferred tax liability 500,000 D 31 March 20X9 Income tax expense – deferred 75,000     Deferred tax liability 75,000 Question 5 Meridian Supplies Limited (Meridian) has the following balances in its statement of financial position as at 31 March 20X9: Carrying amount HK$ Trade receivables (gross) 2,000,000 Allowance for expected credit losses (90,000) Property, plant and equipment 3,000,000 Provision for warranties 140,000 Additional information: 1. Credit losses are deductible for tax purposes only when the trade receivable is written off as credit impaired. The related sales revenue has already been taxed. 2. Warranty costs are deductible for tax purposes only when incurred. 3. The tax base of property, plant and equipment as at 31 March 20X9 is HK$2,400,000. 4. The tax rate is 15%. It is probable that sufficient future taxable income will be available to utilise all deductible temporary differences. In accordance with HKAS 12, what amounts should Meridian recognise as deferred tax asset and deferred tax liability as at 31 March 20X9? A. Deferred tax asset HK$34,500; Deferred tax liability HK$90,000 B. Deferred tax asset HK$230,000; Deferred tax liability HK$600,000 C. Deferred tax asset HK$90,000; Deferred tax liability HK$34,500 D. Deferred tax asset HK$13,500; Deferred tax liability HK$90,000

title: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Scope & "Recognition" of the EPS numbers（邊啲公司要計、用邊個盈利數字）
B. Measurement（Basic EPS 同 Diluted EPS 點計）
C. Presentation & Disclosure（擺邊、披露啲乜）
D. Limits of EPS as a Performance Measure
excerpt: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the scope of HKAS 33 Earnings per Share and identify the…
text: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the scope of HKAS 33 Earnings per Share and identify the entities required to present EPS. 2. Calculate basic EPS, including the determination of earnings and the weighted average number of ordinary shares (WANOS), incorporating bonus issues and rights issues with a bonus element. 3. Calculate diluted EPS by assessing whether potential ordinary shares (options, warrants, convertible instruments) are dilutive or anti dilutive, and sequence them from most to least dilutive. 4. Apply the presentation and disclosure requirements of HKAS 33 for basic and diluted EPS, including discontinued operations and restatement of comparatives. 5. Evaluate the limitations of EPS as a performance measure. 必背考點 A. Scope & "Recognition" of the EPS numbers（邊啲公司要計、用邊個盈利數字） 考點 內容 Reference Scope HKAS 33 applies to each entity whose ordinary shares or potential ordinary shares are traded in a public market (e.g. HKEX, foreign exchange, OTC markets), or that is in the process of arranging a public listing. HKAS 33.2 Ordinary share Equity instrument subordinate to all other classes of issued securities; participates in profit only after other classes (e.g. preference shares). HKAS 33.5 Potential ordinary share A financial instrument or other contract that may entitle its holder to ordinary shares — e.g. options, warrants, convertible notes, convertible preference shares. HKAS 33.5 Earnings (numerator) Profit or loss attributable to ordinary shareholders of the parent entity — excludes NCI; can be a loss (loss per share). HKAS 33.5, 33.31 Continuing vs discontinued Two separate earnings amounts → two separate basic EPS amounts (continuing operations / discontinued operations, per HKFRS 5). HKAS 33; HKFRS 5 Preference share returns Any non principal payments on preference shares — whether classified as liabilities or equity under HKAS 32 — are an expense like deduction from earnings, at the after tax amount. If classified as a liability, the cost (interest) is already in P&L → no further action. If equity: cumulative → deduct declared AND undeclared returns for the period; non cumulative → deduct only returns declared in the period. HKAS 33.12, 33.13 Mandatorily convertible instruments Adjustment to earnings may be needed where they carry a guaranteed return before conversion. HKAS 33.23 B. Measurement（Basic EPS 同 Diluted EPS 點計） B1. Basic EPS 考點 內容 Reference WANOS 時間加權 Shares issued/bought back during the period are time weighted (days or months) for the portion of the period they were on issue; weighting runs from the date consideration is due (normally issue/redemption date). HKAS 33.20, 33.21 Shares issued to acquire a business Included in WANOS from the date of acquisition (when the acquiree's earnings enter the group). HKAS 33.22 Issue at full market value No restatement of comparatives — resources and share numbers change proportionately; EPS comparable across periods. HKAS 33 Change in shares WITHOUT change in resources (bonus issue / share split / rights issue with bonus element) WANOS for the current period AND all comparative periods must be adjusted (restated) so EPS is comparable. HKAS 33.27, 33.28 Rights issue formulas Theoretical ex rights price per share = (Fair value of shares immediately prior to exercise of rights + Proceeds from exercise of rights) ÷ Number of shares outstanding after exercise of rights. Adjustment factor = Fair value per share prior to exercise of rights ÷ Theoretical ex rights price per share. Prior period EPS is restated by multiplying prior WANOS by the factor (equivalently, dividing prior EPS by the factor). HKAS 33.A2 B2. Diluted EPS 考點 內容 Reference Adjustment to earnings Add back the after tax effect of: (i) dividends/returns on dilutive potential ordinary shares already deducted; (ii) interest recognised in finance costs on dilutive potential ordinary shares; (iii) any other income/expense impacts of assumed conversion. HKAS 33.33 Adjustment to shares Assume conversion at the beginning of the period (or issue date of the potential ordinary shares, if later); determine dilution independently for each period ; instruments that lapsed during the period are included pro rata for the time outstanding. HKAS 33.36, 33.37, 33.38 Options & warrants Assume exercised. Assumed proceeds are treated as received from issuing shares at the average market price of the period. Only the shares issued for no consideration (shares issuable under the option − shares that the proceeds would buy at average market price) enter the denominator. Numerator is NOT adjusted. Shares deemed issued at average market price are neither dilutive nor anti dilutive — ignore them. HKAS 33.45, 33.46 Convertible instruments Dilutive only when total contractual return ÷ ordinary shares issuable on conversion < basic EPS (i.e. earnings per incremental share below basic EPS). Add back after tax return to numerator; add conversion shares to denominator. HKAS 33.50 Dilutive vs anti dilutive Dilutive = conversion would decrease EPS (or increase loss per share) from continuing operations → include. Anti dilutive = conversion would increase EPS (or decrease loss per share) → exclude from diluted EPS. Benchmark is profit or loss from continuing operations attributable to the parent. HKAS 33.41, 33.42, 33.43 Sequencing (multiple series) Each series considered separately , in order from most dilutive to least dilutive based on earnings per incremental share (options first — nil earnings effect). Stop when the next instrument would increase EPS. HKAS 33.44 Journal entries（本章特別提示）： HKAS 33 係計量同披露準則 — EPS 本身 唔會產生任何 journal entries 。考試相關嘅 "entries" 係調整分子（after tax add back of interest/preference returns）同分母（incremental shares）嘅 EPS workings ，唔係 double entry。股份發行本身嘅分錄（Dr Cash / Cr Share capital (+ Share premium)）屬於股東權益章節範圍，唔屬於 EPS 計算。考 M6 EPS 題時， show workings 就有 method marks ，唔好試圖寫 Dr/Cr。 C. Presentation & Disclosure（擺邊、披露啲乜） 考點 內容 Reference Face of SPLOCI Basic and diluted EPS from continuing operations must be presented on the face of the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income , with equal prominence , for all periods presented — applies equally to losses per share (negative EPS). HKAS 33.66, 33.67 Discontinued operations Separate basic and diluted EPS for discontinued operations — on the face or in the notes . HKAS 33.68 Numerator reconciliation Disclose the earnings used as numerators for basic and diluted EPS, reconciled to profit or loss attributable to the parent entity . HKAS 33.70 Denominator reconciliation Disclose the WANOS used as denominators, reconciled between basic and diluted EPS , showing the effect of each class of instruments. HKAS 33.70 Anti dilutive instruments Disclose instruments that could dilute basic EPS in the future but were excluded because anti dilutive in the period(s) presented. HKAS 33.70 Post reporting period share transactions Describe ordinary/potential ordinary share transactions after period end that would have significantly changed the share numbers (e.g. large share issue, large conversion). HKAS 33.70 D. Limits of EPS as a Performance Measure WANOS may be irrelevant when large issues/buy backs occur late in the period (period end share count differs materially; investors take a forward looking view). Weighting of lapsed shares is questioned (known at reporting date that they lapsed). Average market price used in diluted EPS may not reflect the recent price. EPS is not comparable across industries/geographies (growth phase biotech vs mature retailer); EPS is backward looking and only one metric — use with other measures. 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Basic EPS vs Diluted EPS Basic EPS Diluted EPS Purpose Actual interests of each ordinary share in the period's performance "Worst case" warning sign : EPS if all dilutive potential ordinary shares were converted/exercised Numerator Profit/loss attributable to ordinary shareholders of parent (less after tax preference returns) Same, plus after tax add back of interest/returns on dilutive potential ordinary shares (HKAS 33.33) Denominator WANOS actually on issue (HKAS 33.20) WANOS + dilutive potential ordinary shares deemed converted at start of period (HKAS 33.36) When required All entities in scope Only when potential ordinary shares exist (complex capital structure) 點樣分辨／考試伏位（繁中）： 見到 options/convertible bonds 唔代表一定要計 diluted — 先要過 dilution test 。Jun 2025 考官報告特別鬧考生以為 options 要 exercised 先計入 — 錯！只要 potentially dilutive 就要計。另外 options 唔會郁 numerator ，只有 convertible instruments 先 add back after tax interest/return。 Table 2: Dilutive vs Anti dilutive Potential Ordinary Shares Dilutive Anti dilutive Test (HKAS 33.43) Conversion decreases EPS or increases loss per share from continuing operations Conversion increases EPS or decreases loss per share Options/warrants quick test Exercise price < average market price → shares issued for no consideration exist Exercise price ≥ average market price → excluded Convertibles quick test Earnings per incremental share < basic EPS (HKAS 33.50) Earnings per incremental share ≥ basic EPS Treatment in diluted EPS Included (denominator, + numerator add back for convertibles) Excluded from calculation, but disclosed in notes as potentially dilutive in future (HKAS 33.70) 點樣分辨／考試伏位（繁中）： 多過一類 potential ordinary shares 時要 逐類獨立測試 ，由 earnings per incremental share 最細（最 dilutive，通常係 options，因為 numerator effect = nil）排到最大；一路加，加到某類令 EPS 回升 就停，嗰類之後全部 exclude（HKAS 33.44）。伏位：唔好將所有 instruments 一次過 合埋 測；anti dilutive 嘅嘢 diluted EPS 唔計，但 notes 要披露 。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: What is the formula for basic EPS under HKAS 33, and what exactly is the "earnings" figure? Back: Basic EPS = Profit or loss attributable to ordinary shareholders of the parent entity ÷ WANOS on issue (HKAS 33.31) Earnings excludes NCI interests; may be a loss (loss per share) Deduct the after tax amount of preference share returns (cumulative: declared + undeclared; non cumulative: declared only) (HKAS 33.12–13) 💬 繁中白話解釋：EPS 個分子係「屬於母公司普通股股東嘅除稅後損益」，NCI 同 preference shareholders 嘅份都要剔走。優先股股息無論喺 HKAS 32 下係負債定權益，計 EPS 時都當費用扣，仲要用 after tax 數。 Card 2 Front: How do cumulative and non cumulative preference shares differ in the basic EPS earnings adjustment? Back: Cumulative: entity must pay whether declared or not → deduct the after tax return for the period (declared AND undeclared) Non cumulative: no obligation if not declared → deduct only the after tax return declared in the period (HKAS 33.12–13 flowchart, Exhibit 17.1) If preference shares are classified as liabilities under HKAS 32: interest already expensed in P&L → no further adjustment 💬 繁中白話解釋：記法好簡單 — cumulative 係「欠住都當洗咗」，無論宣唔宣派都要扣；non cumulative 就「宣派先扣」。如果已經喺 P&L 度扣咗（負債類），就唔好扣兩次。 Card 3 Front: How is the weighted average number of ordinary shares (WANOS) determined when shares are issued or bought back mid period at full market price? Back: Time weight shares for the portion of the period on issue (days or months) (HKAS 33.20) Weighting runs from when consideration is due — normally the issue/redemption date (HKAS 33.21) Shares issued as consideration in a business acquisition : include from acquisition date (HKAS 33.22) Issue at full market price → no restatement of comparatives 💬 繁中白話解釋：年中發行新股，唔可以全年計晒 — 要按「喺市嘅時間」加權。West Plates 例子：4月1日發行 2m 股，weighting = 275/365 = 75.3%，即只加 1.506m 股。市價發行唔使重述舊年 EPS。 Card 4 Front: A rights issue is made at below market price. How are current and comparative EPS figures adjusted under HKAS 33? Back: Rights issue contains a bonus element → change in shares without corresponding change in resources Theoretical ex rights price = (FV of shares before exercise + proceeds from exercise) ÷ shares outstanding after exercise Adjustment factor = FV per share before rights ÷ theoretical ex rights price Apply factor to WANOS before the rights issue (current year pro rata) AND restate all comparative periods (HKAS 33.27, 33.28, 33.A2) 💬 繁中白話解釋：供股價低過市價 = 變相派紅股，股數多咗但資源唔係按比例多。所以舊年度 EPS 都要「加水」重述：舊 EPS ÷ adjustment factor。考試最常考就係計 TERP 同 factor，跟住 restate comparative。 Card 5 Front: How are options and warrants incorporated into diluted EPS? Back: Assume dilutive options/warrants are exercised Deemed proceeds (options × exercise price) treated as buying back shares at average market price of the period Only shares issued for no consideration = (shares under options) − (proceeds ÷ average market price) enter the denominator (HKAS 33.45, 33.46) No adjustment to the numerator Dilutive only when exercise price < average market price 💬 繁中白話解釋：諗住公司收到行使價錢會攞去市場買返啲股 — 買得返嗰部分就當冇發行過（fairly priced，唔 dilutive 唔 anti dilutive），淨係「免費送出」嗰部分股數先加入分母。記住：options 永遠唔郁分子 。 Card 6 Front: How do you test whether convertible bonds/preference shares are dilutive, and what adjustments follow? Back: Test: earnings per incremental share = after tax return on the instrument ÷ ordinary shares issuable on conversion; dilutive if < basic EPS (HKAS 33.50) If dilutive: numerator + after tax interest/dividend (HKAS 33.33); denominator + conversion shares (deemed converted at start of period or issue date if later, HKAS 33.36) If the recomputed EPS increases → anti dilutive → exclude (HKAS 33.41) 💬 繁中白話解釋：convertible 嘅 test 係「每股新增股份帶嚟幾多盈利」同 basic EPS 比。低過就 dilutive：分子加返 after tax interest（因為轉咗股就唔使付息），分母加轉換股數。West Plates 例子入面 CPS 轉換後 EPS 由 3.84 升到 4.02 → anti dilutive → 唔計。 Card 7 Front: When several series of potential ordinary shares exist, in what order are they included in diluted EPS? Back: Consider each series separately , not in aggregate (HKAS 33.44) Sequence from most dilutive to least dilutive based on earnings per incremental share Options/warrants usually first (earnings effect = nil → lowest incremental EPS) Stop including further series once the next one would increase EPS (that series and beyond are anti dilutive) 💬 繁中白話解釋：FuturePan 例子：options (incremental EPS = 0) → convertible bonds (HK$1.002) → convertible preference shares (HK$2.667)。加到 preference shares 時 EPS 由 2.50 升返 2.52 → 嗰度停，CPS exclude。記住「逐件加、一升即停」。 Card 8 Front: State the presentation and disclosure requirements for EPS under HKAS 33. Back: Basic + diluted EPS from continuing operations: face of SPLOCI, equal prominence, all periods presented , including loss per share (HKAS 33.66–67) Discontinued operations: separate basic + diluted EPS, face or notes (HKAS 33.68) Disclose: numerators reconciled to profit attributable to parent; denominators (WANOS) reconciled basic → diluted by instrument class (HKAS 33.70) Disclose anti dilutive instruments excluded that could dilute in future Describe post period end share transactions that would significantly change share numbers (HKAS 33.70) 💬 繁中白話解釋：記憶口訣「面上一樣搶眼、所有期間、虧損都照披露」；discontinued 可以落 notes。Notes 要 reconcile 分子分母、披露冇計入嘅 anti dilutive 工具、同年結後大額股份交易。呢啲 disclosure 題考生成日留白 — 係易攞分位。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Potential ordinary share 潛在普通股 — 將來可能變成普通股嘅工具（options、warrants、convertible bonds） A convertible bond is a potential ordinary share because it may entitle its holder to ordinary shares. Weighted average number of ordinary shares (WANOS) 加權平均普通股數 — 按期內「喺市時間」加權嘅股數 Shares issued on 1 April are included in WANOS at a weighting of 275/365 days. Theoretical ex rights price 理論除權價 — 供股後每股理論價值，用嚟計 adjustment factor The theoretical ex rights price per share is the fair value of shares before the rights issue plus the proceeds, divided by the shares outstanding after the issue. Bonus element 紅利成分 — 供股價低過市價嗰部分，等於免費派股 Because the exercise price was below fair value, the rights issue contained a bonus element requiring restatement of prior period EPS. Dilutive 攤薄性 — 轉換後 EPS 下降（或每股虧損上升） The options are dilutive because their exercise price is below the average market price of the shares. Anti dilutive 反攤薄 — 轉換後 EPS 反而上升，計 diluted EPS 時要剔除 The convertible preference shares were anti dilutive and therefore excluded from the diluted EPS calculation. Earnings per incremental share 每股新增股份盈利 — 用嚟排 dilutive 次序嘅 benchmark Options have nil earnings per incremental share and are therefore considered first in the diluted EPS sequence. Equal prominence 同等顯眼 — basic 同 diluted EPS 要喺損益表面一齊披露，唔可以一個大一個細 HKAS 33 requires basic and diluted EPS to be presented with equal prominence on the face of the statement of profit or loss and OCI.

title: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Earnings for basic EPS = profit attributable to ordinary shareholders of t…
text: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Earnings for basic EPS = profit attributable to ordinary shareholders of the parent entity, adjusted for the after tax amount of returns on preference shares classified as equity. For non cumulative preference shares, only the dividend declared in the period is deducted. Earnings = HK$8,000,000 − HK$500,000 × (1 − 16.5%) = HK$8,000,000 − HK$417,500 = HK$7,582,500 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵兩步：(1) non cumulative preference shares → 只扣 已宣派 嘅股息（undeclared 唔使扣）；(2) 因為股息由 retained earnings 支付、冇稅務扣減，要 調整稅務影響 ，當佢係可扣稅利息咁計 — 所以扣 after tax 嘅 HK$417,500 而唔係 HK$500,000。 A 錯：完全冇調整 preference dividend — EPS 係普通股股東角度，其他股東嘅分派要剔走。 C 錯：扣咗股息但 冇做稅務調整 — LP 明確講「return paid from retained earnings without tax deducted is adjusted for tax」。 D 錯：方向掉轉，變成 加返 after tax dividend。 Rule Check: HKAS 33.12, HKAS 33.13（after tax preference dividends deducted from earnings）; Exhibit 17.1 flowchart Common Trap（繁中）: 考生最常犯係記住「扣股息」但 唔記得稅務調整 。記住邏輯：如果得普通股，嗰筆錢會係可扣稅利息開支，所以扣嘅係 after tax 數。cumulative vs non cumulative 嘅分別（undeclared 扣唔扣）係另一常見考點。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): WANOS (monthly weighting): 1 Jan – 31 Dec: 8,000,000 × 12/12 = 8,000,000 Issued 1 Jul: 2,400,000 × 6/12 = 1,200,000 Bought back 1 Oct: (600,000) × 3/12 = (150,000) WANOS = 9,050,000 shares Basic EPS = HK$21,900,000 ÷ 9,050,000 = HK$2.42 解題思路（繁中）: 市價發行／回購只影響 WANOS 嘅 時間加權 ，唔使重述比較期間。發行由 1 July 起計 6 個月，回購由 1 October 起計扣 3 個月。 A 錯（HK$2.23）：用咗 年結日實際股數 9,800,000（8m + 2.4m − 0.6m）做分母，冇時間加權。 B 錯（HK$2.38）：加權咗新發行但 漏咗回購 （分母 9,200,000）。 D 錯（HK$2.74）：完全冇理會年中變動，用期初 8,000,000 股。 Rule Check: HKAS 33.20, HKAS 33.21（time weighting of shares issued/bought back during the period） Common Trap（繁中）: Jun 2025 考官報告特別鬧考生「weighted average shares for mid year issue poorly done」。伏位：(1) 用期末股數當 WANOS；(2) 記得加新股但唔記得扣回購。時間加權可以由發行日計到年結（6/12），buy back 係 減數 ，唔係加。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Theoretical ex rights price = (4,000,000 × HK$10 + 1,000,000 × HK$6) ÷ 5,000,000 = HK$46,000,000 ÷ 5,000,000 = HK$9.20 Adjustment factor = HK$10 ÷ HK$9.20 = 1.0869565 Restated 20X4 WANOS = 4,000,000 × 1.0869565 = 4,347,826 shares Restated 20X4 basic EPS = HK$3,600,000 ÷ 4,347,826 = HK$0.83 (equivalently HK$0.90 ÷ 1.0869565) 解題思路（繁中）: 供股價 HK$6 低過市價 HK$10 → 有 bonus element → 股數增加但資源唔按比例增加 → 所有比較期間 EPS 都要重述 （乘 adjustment factor 落分母，或者將舊 EPS 除以 factor）。 A 錯（HK$0.72）：直接用供股後 5,000,000 股做分母 — 舊年度根本唔存在嗰 1,000,000 股。 C 錯（HK$0.90）：冇重述 — 管理層聲稱「rights issue 對 comparative EPS 冇影響」係 錯 嘅（LP Exam Practice Q1 嘅 management assertion 都係 not true）。 D 錯（HK$0.98）：將舊 EPS 乘 factor（方向掉轉）— factor 係加喺 股數 度，EPS 要 除 。 Rule Check: HKAS 33.27, HKAS 33.28, HKAS 33.A2（theoretical ex rights price and adjustment factor; restatement of comparatives for the bonus element in a rights issue） Common Trap（繁中）: 三個伏位：(1) TERP 公式分子係「舊股公平值 + 供股所得款項 」，唔好漏咗 proceeds；(2) factor = 市價 ÷ TERP，唔好倒轉；(3) 重述係 舊 EPS ÷ factor ，唔係 ×。Bonus issue / share split 同樣要重述，但市價發行就唔使。 Q4 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): The exercise price (HK$15) is above the average market price for the period (HK$12). If exercised, the assumed proceeds (600,000 × HK$15 = HK$9,000,000) would repurchase 750,000 shares at the average market price — more than the 600,000 shares issuable — so no shares would be issued for no consideration. The options would increase EPS (or have no dilutive effect) and are therefore anti dilutive : excluded from diluted EPS (HKAS 33.41, 33.43, 33.45) but disclosed in the notes as instruments that could potentially dilute basic EPS in the future (HKAS 33.70). 解題思路（繁中）: Options 嘅 dilution test 好直接： exercise price < average market price → dilutive；exercise price ≥ average market price → anti dilutive → exclude 。呢度 HK$15 HK$12，holder 用 HK$15 買股仲貴過市價，冇「免費股份」產生。 B 錯：唔係所有 options 都要計入 — 必須先過 dilution test，而且就算 dilutive 都係只加 shares for no consideration ，唔係全部 600,000 股。 C 錯：600,000 × (HK$15 − HK$12) ÷ HK$12 = 150,000 係 亂套公式 — 分子分母調轉兼無視咗 exercise price 高過市價嘅事實，套出嚟嘅「free shares」根本唔存在。 D 錯： 「未行使所以唔計」係大錯 — Jun 2025 考官報告專登批評考生以為 options 要 exercised 先計入。diluted EPS 計嘅係 potential dilution；呢啲 options 唔計入係因為 anti dilutive ，唔係因為未行使。 Rule Check: HKAS 33.41（anti dilutive shares excluded）, HKAS 33.43（dilutive = decreases EPS from continuing operations）, HKAS 33.45–46（options assumed exercised; shares for no consideration）, HKAS 33.70（disclosure of excluded potentially dilutive instruments） Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大伏位都係考官報告點名嘅：(1) 以為 options 要行使咗先影響 diluted EPS；(2) 唔比較 exercise price 同 average market price 就亂加股數。仲有：anti dilutive 唔等於唔使理 — notes 要披露。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Step 1 — Dilution test: earnings per incremental share = after tax interest ÷ conversion shares = HK$167,000 ÷ 1,000,000 = HK$0.167 < basic EPS of HK$2.00 (HK$10,000,000 ÷ 5,000,000) → dilutive , include. Step 2 — Adjusted earnings: interest add back = 40,000 × HK$100 × 5% × (1 − 16.5%) = HK$200,000 × 0.835 = HK$167,000 → adjusted earnings = HK$10,000,000 + HK$167,000 = HK$10,167,000 Step 3 — Adjusted shares: 5,000,000 + (40,000 × 25) = 5,000,000 + 1,000,000 = 6,000,000 Diluted EPS = HK$10,167,000 ÷ 6,000,000 = HK$1.69 解題思路（繁中）: Convertible bonds 標準三步：test → add back after tax interest 落分子 → 加 conversion shares 落分母。轉換後 EPS 由 2.00 跌到 1.69 → 的確 dilutive，計法成立。 A 錯（HK$1.67）：分母加咗 1,000,000 股但 分子冇 add back interest （10,000,000 ÷ 6,000,000）— 轉咗股就唔使付息，分子分母要 一齊郁 。 C 錯（HK$1.70）：add back 咗 稅前 interest HK$200,000（10,200,000 ÷ 6,000,000）— 必須用 after tax，因為利息慳返嘅同時稅都會多交。 D 錯（HK$2.00）：即係 basic EPS，完全冇理會 convertible bonds（或者錯誤判斷為 anti dilutive）。 Rule Check: HKAS 33.33（after tax adjustment to earnings for interest on dilutive potential ordinary shares）, HKAS 33.36（conversion deemed at beginning of period）, HKAS 33.50（convertible instruments dilutive only if earnings per incremental share < basic EPS） Common Trap（繁中）: 三個經典錯：(1) 只做分母唔做分子；(2) 唔記得 interest add back 要 × (1 − tax rate) ；(3) 唔做 dilution test 就當 convertible 一定 dilutive（LP West Plates 例子入面 CPS 就係 anti dilutive）。記住 diluted EPS 係「worst case warning sign」— 計出嚟 一定唔可以高過 basic EPS；如果高過就係 anti dilutive 要 exclude。
