excerpt: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Alder Li…
text: M6 Chapter 17: Earnings per Share — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Alder Limited's profit attributable to shareholders of the parent entity for the year ended 31 December 20X3 was HK$8,000,000. Throughout the year, Alder Limited had non cumulative preference shares on issue, classified as equity in accordance with HKAS 32. During 20X3, Alder Limited declared and paid a dividend of HK$500,000 on these preference shares out of retained earnings. The applicable tax rate is 16.5%. In accordance with HKAS 33, what amount of earnings should be used as the numerator in calculating Alder Limited's basic EPS for 20X3? A. HK$8,000,000 B. HK$7,582,500 C. HK$7,500,000 D. HK$8,417,500 Question 2 Hibiscus Limited had 8,000,000 ordinary shares on issue as at 1 January 20X4. On 1 July 20X4, it issued 2,400,000 ordinary shares for cash at the prevailing market price. On 1 October 20X4, it bought back and cancelled 600,000 ordinary shares at the prevailing market price. Profit attributable to ordinary shareholders of the parent entity for the year ended 31 December 20X4 was HK$21,900,000. (Use monthly time weighting.) In accordance with HKAS 33, Hibiscus Limited's basic EPS for the year ended 31 December 20X4 is: A. HK$2.23 B. HK$2.38 C. HK$2.42 D. HK$2.74 Question 3 Falcon Limited had 4,000,000 ordinary shares on issue throughout 20X4. On 1 September 20X5, it made a rights issue of one new ordinary share for every four shares held at an exercise price of HK$6 per share. The fair value of each share immediately prior to the exercise of the rights was HK$10. All rights were taken up. Falcon Limited reported profit attributable to ordinary shareholders of HK$3,600,000 for the year ended 31 December 20X4 and had reported basic EPS of HK$0.90 in its 20X4 financial statements. In accordance with HKAS 33, the restated comparative basic EPS for 20X4 presented in Falcon Limited's 20X5 financial statements is (rounded to two decimal places): A. HK$0.72 B. HK$0.83 C. HK$0.90 D. HK$0.98 Question 4 Heron Limited had 600,000 options outstanding for the whole of the year ended 31 December 20X6. Each option entitles the holder to acquire one ordinary share at an exercise price of HK$15. The average market price of Heron Limited's ordinary shares during 20X6 was HK$12. In accordance with HKAS 33, how should these options be treated in the calculation of diluted EPS for 20X6? A. The options are excluded from the diluted EPS calculation because they are anti dilutive, but are disclosed in the notes as instruments that could potentially dilute basic EPS in the future. B. The options are included in the diluted EPS calculation because all outstanding options must be assumed to be exercised, adding 600,000 shares to the denominator. C. The options are included in the diluted EPS calculation by adding 150,000 shares issued for no consideration to the denominator. D. The options are excluded from the diluted EPS calculation because they have not yet been exercised by the holders. Question 5 Kestrel Limited's profit from continuing operations attributable to ordinary shareholders of the parent entity for the year ended 31 December 20X7 was HK$10,000,000. The weighted average number of ordinary shares on issue during 20X7 was 5,000,000. Throughout the year, Kestrel Limited had 40,000 convertible bonds on issue with a face value of HK$100 each, paying an annual coupon of 5% (which is tax deductible). Each bond is convertible into 25 ordinary shares. The applicable tax rate is 16.5%. In accordance with HKAS 33, Kestrel Limited's diluted EPS for the year ended 31 December 20X7 is (rounded to two decimal places): A. HK$1.67 B. HK$1.69 C. HK$1.70 D. HK$2.00

title: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Recognition — 基本概念與確認
D. Key Journal Entries（Dr/Cr，全部平衡）
excerpt: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define and distinguish functional curr…
text: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define and distinguish functional currency and presentation currency , and explain the factors in HKAS 21 used to determine an entity's functional currency. 2. Define and classify monetary items and non monetary items in accordance with HKAS 21. 3. Account for the initial recognition of foreign currency transactions using the spot exchange rate. 4. Apply the correct exchange rates to foreign currency monetary and non monetary items at subsequent reporting dates , and account for the resulting exchange differences. 5. Prepare journal entries for unsettled foreign currency balances and for settlement of foreign currency monetary items. 範圍提示：LP 明確指出 foreign operations 及 translation of financial statements into a presentation currency 不在 Module 6 範圍內 ；本章焦點係 foreign currency transactions 嘅 recognition 同 measurement。LP 本章亦無講述 HKAS 21 嘅 disclosure requirements，考試準備以 recognition / measurement 規則為主。 必背考點 A. Recognition — 基本概念與確認 1. Functional currency（HKAS 21.8） Definition: the currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates — normally the one in which it primarily generates and expends cash . 三個 primary factors（HKAS 21.9）: 1. The currency that mainly influences sales prices for goods and services (often the currency in which sales prices are denominated and settled); 2. The currency of the country whose competitive forces and regulations mainly determine sales prices; 3. The currency that mainly influences labour, material and other costs (often the currency in which costs are denominated and settled). Additional evidence（HKAS 21.10）: currency in which financing activities (debt/equity) are denominated; currency in which receipts from operating activities are usually retained . 如果 indicators mixed → management judgement（HKAS 21.12）， primary factors (HKAS 21.9) 優先 。 2. Presentation currency（HKAS 21.8） The currency in which the financial statements are presented . An entity may present its financial statements in any currency — 同 functional currency 可以唔同。 3. Foreign currency transaction（HKAS 21.20–21.21） A transaction denominated in or requiring settlement in a foreign currency (a currency other than the functional currency). Examples: purchases/sales priced in foreign currency; borrowing/lending denominated in foreign currency; acquisition/disposal of long term assets in foreign currency; incurrence/settlement of foreign currency liabilities. Initial recognition : record in the functional currency by applying the spot exchange rate at the date of the transaction . Spot rate = exchange rate for immediate delivery (HKAS 21.8). 4. Monetary vs non monetary items（HKAS 21.8, 21.16） Monetary items : units of currency held and assets/liabilities to be received or paid in a fixed or determinable number of units of currency . Examples: foreign currency cash holdings, trade and notes receivable/payable, accrued liabilities (interest payable, salaries payable), dividends payable, borrowings. Non monetary items : essential feature = absence of a right to receive (or obligation to deliver) a fixed or determinable number of units of currency. Examples: prepaid expenses (prepaid rent/insurance), goodwill, intangible assets, inventories, property, plant and equipment, share investments , unearned revenue （已收錢但欠人服務，唔係欠固定金額）。 B. Measurement — Subsequent reporting dates 1. Monetary items（HKAS 21.23(a), 21.28） Translate at the closing rate (spot rate at the end of the reporting period, HKAS 21.8). Exchange differences (arising on translation at reporting date or on settlement) → profit or loss in the period in which they arise. 無論 realised 定 unrealised 都入 P/L。 2. Non monetary items（HKAS 21.23） Measurement base Exchange rate used Historical cost Rate at the date of the transaction (initial recognition) — no exchange difference arises Fair value Rate at the date the fair value was measured (usually closing rate at year end) Carrying amount 要跟相關準則（如 HKAS 16 cost model vs revaluation model）決定，再套用上述匯率。 HKAS 21.30 : when a gain/loss on a non monetary item is recognised in OCI (e.g. revaluation surplus under HKAS 16), the foreign exchange component of that gain/loss is also recognised in OCI ; if the gain/loss goes to profit or loss , the exchange component goes to profit or loss too（跟住宿主走）. 3. Carrying amount determined by comparison（HKAS 21.25）— e.g. inventories under HKAS 2 (lower of cost and NRV) Compare: (1) cost/carrying amount translated at the rate when that amount was determined (usually acquisition date rate); vs (2) NRV/recoverable amount translated at the rate when that value was determined (usually closing rate ). 結果可能係：外幣角度無減值，但 functional currency 角度要減值（或反之）— 一定要兩個數都轉做 functional currency 先好比較。 C. Disclosure LP 本章 未涵蓋 HKAS 21 嘅 disclosure requirements（亦無提供 paragraph references），foreign operations translation 同樣 out of scope。考試溫書以 Section A/B 規則為主；如 quiz/exam 問到 disclosure，用「本章 LP 無要求」心態處理，唔好自行吹噓。 D. Key Journal Entries（Dr/Cr，全部平衡） Mini scenario: HK company（functional currency HKD）buys goods on credit for US$20,000 on 1 Nov 20X8 (spot HK$7.80 = US$1). Year end 31 Dec 20X8: HK$7.85 = US$1. Settled 15 Jan 20X9: HK$7.83 = US$1. (1) Initial recognition — 1 Nov 20X8 (spot rate, HKAS 21.21) Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Purchases / Inventories 156,000     Trade payable (US$) 156,000 (US$20,000 × 7.80) (2) Year end retranslation of monetary item — 31 Dec 20X8 (closing rate, HKAS 21.23(a), 21.28) Liability = US$20,000 × 7.85 = HK$157,000 → increase HK$1,000 = exchange loss. Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Loss on foreign exchange difference (P/L) 1,000     Trade payable (US$) 1,000 (3) Settlement — 15 Jan 20X9 (HKAS 21.28) Pay US$20,000 × 7.83 = HK$156,600; recorded liability HK$157,000 → gain HK$400. Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Trade payable (US$) 157,000     Cash 156,600     Gain on foreign exchange difference (P/L) 400 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Monetary items vs Non monetary items Monetary items Non monetary items Core feature Right to receive / obligation to deliver a fixed or determinable number of currency units Absence of such a right/obligation Examples Cash, trade receivables/payables, borrowings, interest payable, dividends payable Inventories, PPE, goodwill, intangibles, prepayments, share investments, unearned revenue Rate at reporting date Closing rate (HKAS 21.23(a)) Historical cost → transaction date rate; Fair value → FV measurement date rate (HKAS 21.23) Exchange difference Always to profit or loss (HKAS 21.28) Historical cost → none; FV → follows the gain/loss: OCI→OCI, P/L→P/L (HKAS 21.30) 點樣分辨 / 考試伏位 問自己：「到期收到／付出嘅係咪固定金額嘅錢？」是 → monetary。 伏位 ：unearned revenue 同 prepaid expenses 涉及現金已收付，但係欠貨/欠服務，屬 non monetary；share investments 都係 non monetary（唔係收固定現金嘅權利）。 Historical cost non monetary 年結 唔使重譯 — 好多同學誤用 closing rate 重譯存貨/機器，直接錯。 Table 2: Functional currency vs Presentation currency Functional currency Presentation currency Definition Currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates (HKAS 21.8) Currency in which the financial statements are presented (HKAS 21.8) How determined Judgement based on HKAS 21.9 primary factors (sales prices; competitive forces/regulations; costs) + HKAS 21.10 secondary factors (financing; retained receipts) Free choice — entity may present in any currency Can they differ? — Yes — presentation currency may differ from functional currency Role in this chapter Defines what counts as a "foreign currency"; all transactions translated into it (Translation into presentation currency is out of M6 scope) 點樣分辨 / 考試伏位 考試鍾意畀 mixed indicators，記住 HKAS 21.9 primary factors 優先 於 financing/retained receipts（HKAS 21.10, 21.12）。 伏位 ：唔好以為「註冊地貨幣」= functional currency；亦唔好以為股東要求用 USD 出報表就改變 functional currency — 嗰個只係 presentation currency 嘅選擇。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Define "functional currency" and "presentation currency" under HKAS 21.8. Back: Functional currency: the currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates (normally where it primarily generates and expends cash). Presentation currency: the currency in which the financial statements are presented ; the entity may choose any currency. 💬 白話：functional currency 係公司日常做生意「真正用緊」嘅錢；presentation currency 純粹係報表用咩錢嚟表達，可以揀，兩者可以唔同。 Card 2 Front: List the three primary factors in HKAS 21.9 for determining functional currency, and the two additional factors in HKAS 21.10. Back: Primary (HKAS 21.9): (1) currency mainly influencing sales prices ; (2) currency of the country whose competitive forces and regulations determine sales prices; (3) currency mainly influencing labour, material and other costs . Additional (HKAS 21.10): currency of financing activities ; currency in which operating receipts are retained . If mixed → judgement, primary factors given priority (HKAS 21.12). 💬 白話：記口訣「賣嘢收咩錢、邊度競爭規管、成本使咩錢」，三個主要因素唔一致就用 judgement，但主要因素優先；融資貨幣只係輔助證據。 Card 3 Front: How is a foreign currency transaction recorded on initial recognition (HKAS 21.21)? Back: Record in the functional currency ; Apply the spot exchange rate at the date of the transaction ; Spot rate = rate for immediate delivery (HKAS 21.8). 💬 白話：落簿嗰刻就用當日即期匯率折做 functional currency，唔好用年結率、唔好用平均率（M6 層面）。 Card 4 Front: Define monetary items (HKAS 21.8) and give four examples; give three examples of non monetary items. Back: Monetary: units of currency held + assets/liabilities receivable/payable in a fixed or determinable number of units of currency . Examples: cash in foreign currency, trade receivables/payables, borrowings, dividends payable. Non monetary: inventories, PPE, goodwill/intangibles, prepaid expenses, unearned revenue, share investments. 💬 白話：分水嶺係「係咪收/付固定金額嘅錢」。Unearned revenue 同 prepayment 雖然涉及現金，但將來交嘅係貨/服務，所以係 non monetary — 考試大伏。 Card 5 Front: State the accounting treatment of foreign currency monetary items at each reporting date (HKAS 21.23(a), 21.28). Back: Translate using the closing rate (spot rate at end of reporting period); Exchange differences → profit or loss in the period they arise; Same P/L treatment for differences arising on settlement . 💬 白話：monetary item 年結要「重估」做 closing rate，匯兌差額（包括未實現）直接入 P/L；到真正找數嗰日再計一次差額，一樣入 P/L。 Card 6 Front: Which exchange rates are used for non monetary items at subsequent reporting dates (HKAS 21.23)? Back: Carried at historical cost → rate at the date of the transaction (no exchange difference arises); Carried at fair value → rate at the date the fair value was measured (usually closing rate). 💬 白話：歷史成本項目「一鎚定音」，用買入日匯率，之後唔郁；fair value 項目就跟估值日匯率。考試最常考：cost model 嘅機器/存貨年結唔使重譯。 Card 7 Front: A revalued foreign currency building (HKAS 16 revaluation model) increases in value, partly due to exchange rate movement. Where does the exchange component go (HKAS 21.30)? Back: Revaluation gain/loss recognised in OCI → exchange component also in OCI ; Gain/loss recognised in profit or loss → exchange component also in profit or loss ; Exchange difference "follows" the recognition of the underlying gain/loss. 💬 白話：匯兌成分係「跟班」— 宿主（重估盈虧）去 OCI 佢就去 OCI，宿主去 P/L 佢就去 P/L，唔會自己獨立揀路。 Card 8 Front: Under HKAS 21.25, how is the carrying amount of foreign currency inventory (lower of cost and NRV, HKAS 2) determined? Back: Translate cost at the rate when that amount was determined (usually acquisition date rate); Translate NRV at the rate when that value was determined (usually closing rate ); Compare in functional currency → write down may arise even if NRV cost in foreign currency (or vice versa). 💬 白話：兩個數用唔同日嘅匯率各自折做 HKD 先好比較。外幣睇唔蝕唔代表 HKD 睇唔蝕 — 匯率跌可以「製造」一個減值，LP 嘅 EUR 存貨例就係咁。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Functional currency 公司主要經濟環境日常用嘅貨幣（收支以咩錢為主） The functional currency is the currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates (HKAS 21.8). Presentation currency 財務報表揀嚟表達嘅貨幣，可自由選擇 An entity may present its financial statements in any presentation currency. Spot exchange rate 即期匯率，即時交收嘅匯價 A foreign currency transaction is initially recorded using the spot exchange rate at the date of the transaction (HKAS 21.21). Closing rate 報告期末嘅即期匯率 Foreign currency monetary items are translated at the closing rate at the end of the reporting period (HKAS 21.23(a)). Monetary items 將來收/付固定或可確定金額貨幣嘅項目 Trade payables and borrowings are monetary items because they will be settled in a fixed number of currency units. Non monetary items 冇固定貨幣收付權利/義務嘅項目 Inventories and property, plant and equipment are non monetary items under HKAS 21. Exchange difference 因匯率變動產生嘅折算差額 Exchange differences on monetary items are recognised in profit or loss in the period in which they arise (HKAS 21.28). Foreign currency transaction 以功能貨幣以外貨幣計價或結算嘅交易 A foreign currency transaction is denominated in, or requires settlement in, a currency other than the entity's functional currency.

title: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Monetary items are units of currency held and as…
text: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Monetary items are units of currency held and assets and liabilities to be received or paid in a fixed or determinable number of units of currency (HKAS 21.8). Trade receivables and dividends payable both meet this definition. Inventories, prepaid insurance, goodwill and property, plant and equipment are non monetary items — their essential feature is the absence of a right to receive (or obligation to deliver) a fixed or determinable number of currency units (HKAS 21.16). 解題思路（繁中）: 判斷方法係問「到期收/付嘅係咪固定金額嘅錢」。A 嘅 inventories 同 prepaid insurance 將來交嘅係貨同服務保障，唔係錢 → 錯；C 嘅 goodwill 係 non monetary → 錯；D 嘅 PPE 係 non monetary → 錯；只有 B 兩項都係收/付固定金額貨幣。Borrowings 同 trade payables 本身係 monetary，可惜佢哋同 non monetary item 綁埋一齊，成個 option 就錯。 Rule Check: HKAS 21.8 (definition of monetary items); HKAS 21.16 (essential feature of non monetary items) Common Trap（繁中）: 見到 "payable" 就以為一定 monetary — prepaid expenses 同 unearned revenue 雖然有現金流過，但將來交嘅係貨/服務，係 non monetary。反向伏位：share investments 都唔係 monetary（冇收固定現金嘅權利）。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): The functional currency is the currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates (HKAS 21.8). HKAS 21.9 primary factors: (1) the currency that mainly influences sales prices — RMB (85% of sales denominated and settled in RMB); (2) the currency of the country whose competitive forces and regulations determine sales prices — Mainland China, i.e. RMB; (3) the currency that mainly influences labour, material and other costs — RMB. All three primary factors indicate RMB. The HKD bank borrowings are only an additional (secondary) factor under HKAS 21.10, and the place of incorporation is not determinative. 解題思路（繁中）: 三個 primary factors（售價、競爭/規管所在地、成本）全部指向 RMB，所以答案係 C。A 用咗次要因素（融資貨幣，HKAS 21.10）同註冊地嚟壓過主要因素 — 次序調轉咗；B 完全無事實支持；D 混淆咗 presentation currency（先可以自由揀）同 functional currency（必須按 HKAS 21.9 因素判斷）。 Rule Check: HKAS 21.8; HKAS 21.9 (primary factors); HKAS 21.10 (additional factors); HKAS 21.12 (judgement when indicators are mixed, primary factors given priority) Common Trap（繁中）: 「公司註冊喺香港 → functional currency 係 HKD」係典型錯覺；考試鍾意畀 mixed indicators 考你知唔知 primary factors 優先。 Q3 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): The trade payable is a foreign currency monetary item and must be translated at the closing rate at the reporting date (HKAS 21.23(a)). Initial recognition (1 Nov 20X8): US$40,000 × 7.82 = HK$312,800 Closing rate (31 Dec 20X8): US$40,000 × 7.78 = HK$311,200 Decrease in liability = HK$312,800 − HK$311,200 = HK$1,600 → exchange gain in profit or loss (HKAS 21.28). Journal entry: Dr Trade payable (US$) HK$1,600 / Cr Gain on foreign exchange difference (P/L) HK$1,600. 解題思路（繁中）: 負債嘅 HKD 價值由 312,800 跌到 311,200，即係將來使少咗錢找數 → gain 1,600。B 錯在方向調轉（畀 HKD 貶值先會係 loss）；C 係常見誤解，以為未找數就唔使計 — HKAS 21.28 明確規定 monetary item 嘅 exchange differences（包括 unrealised）喺產生期間入 P/L；D 用平均匯率 7.80 重譯（40,000 × 7.80 = 312,000，gain 800）— 年結必須用 closing rate，唔係平均率。 Rule Check: HKAS 21.23(a) (monetary items at closing rate); HKAS 21.28 (exchange differences to profit or loss) Common Trap（繁中）: 記住「負債升 = loss、負債跌 = gain」（應收款就反轉）。同埋 unrealised gain/loss 都要入賬，唔使等 settlement。 Q4 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): At 31 December 20X7 the trade receivable was retranslated at the closing rate: EUR50,000 × 8.60 = HK$430,000. On settlement (20 January 20X8), cash received = EUR50,000 × 8.55 = HK$427,500. The receivable settled exceeds cash received by HK$2,500 → exchange loss in profit or loss (HKAS 21.28). Correct entry: Dr Cash 427,500; Dr Loss on foreign exchange difference (P/L) 2,500; Cr Trade receivable (EUR) 430,000. 解題思路（繁中）: 做呢類題目三步走：(1) 年結已重譯 receivable = 430,000（用 closing rate 8.60）；(2) 找數日用當日 spot rate 計實收現金 = 427,500；(3) 差額 2,500 係 loss（收少咗）。A 完全忽略匯率由 8.60 跌到 8.55，當足額收 430,000 → 錯；B 用返最初交易日匯率 8.50 做基準（425,000）兼方向調轉 → 錯；D 現金金額用錯 8.50（425,000），仲要將 loss 寫成 gain → 錯。只有 C 金額、方向、科目全對。 Rule Check: HKAS 21.23(a) (closing rate at reporting date); HKAS 21.28 (exchange differences arising on settlement recognised in profit or loss) Common Trap（繁中）: Settlement 日嘅差額係同「年結重譯後嘅賬面值」比較，唔係同最初交易日金額比較 — 跨年交易一定要分段計。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 2, inventories are carried at the lower of cost and net realisable value. Under HKAS 21.25, each amount is translated at the exchange rate in effect at the date that amount was determined: Cost: MYR200,000 × 1.90 (rate when cost was determined) = HK$380,000 NRV: MYR210,000 × 1.75 (closing rate when NRV was determined) = HK$367,500 NRV < cost in HKD → write down = HK$380,000 − HK$367,500 = HK$12,500 . Journal entry: Dr Loss on inventory write down (P/L) HK$12,500 / Cr Inventories HK$12,500. 解題思路（繁中）: 雖然用 MYR 睇 NRV（210,000）高過成本（200,000），但 HKAS 21.25 要求兩個數各自用「該金額確定當日」嘅匯率折做 functional currency 先比較。折做 HKD 之後 NRV 反而低過成本，所以要減值 12,500。A 係最大伏位 — 只睇外幣層面就話唔使減值；C（30,000）係錯用 closing rate 重譯成本（200,000 × 1.75 = 350,000；380,000 − 350,000）— 歷史成本唔可以重譯；D（31,500）係亂用匯率差（210,000 × (1.90 − 1.75)），無視兩數分開翻譯嘅規則。 Rule Check: HKAS 21.25 (carrying amount determined by comparing two amounts — translate each at the rate at the date the amount was determined); HKAS 2 (lower of cost and NRV) Common Trap（繁中）: 「外幣冇減值 → functional currency 都冇減值」係錯嘅；匯率變動本身可以製造（或消除）減值。記住：cost 用 acquisition date rate，NRV 用 closing rate，兩個率通常唔同。

text: M6 Chapter 18: Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 According to HKAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates , which of the following combinations contains only monetary items ? A. Inventories and prepaid insurance B. Trade receivables and dividends payable C. Goodwill and trade payables D. Property, plant and equipment and borrowings Question 2 Lantau Electronics Limited is incorporated in Hong Kong. 85% of its sales are made to customers in Mainland China; these sales prices are denominated and settled in Renminbi (RMB), and are driven by competitive forces and regulations in the Mainland China market. Most of its labour and material costs are also denominated and settled in RMB, although the company's bank borrowings are denominated in HKD and it is incorporated in Hong Kong. In accordance with HKAS 21, what is the most likely functional currency of Lantau Electronics Limited? A. HKD, because the company is incorporated in Hong Kong and its borrowings are denominated in HKD B. USD, because it is a common currency for international trade C. RMB, because the primary factors in HKAS 21.9 (sales prices and costs) point to RMB D. Any currency of management's choice, because an entity can freely choose its functional currency Question 3 Kowloon Trading Limited (functional currency: HKD) purchased goods on credit from a US supplier for US$40,000 on 1 November 20X8, when the exchange rate was HK$7.82 = US$1.00. The amount was still unpaid at the financial year end of 31 December 20X8, when the exchange rate was HK$7.78 = US$1.00. In accordance with HKAS 21, what should Kowloon Trading Limited recognise in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X8 in respect of this trade payable? A. An exchange gain of HK$1,600 B. An exchange loss of HK$1,600 C. No exchange difference, because the payable has not yet been settled D. An exchange gain of HK$800 Question 4 Pearl River Limited (functional currency: HKD) sold goods on credit to a customer in France for EUR50,000 on 15 December 20X7, when the exchange rate was HK$8.50 = EUR1.00. The trade receivable was correctly retranslated at the closing rate of HK$8.60 = EUR1.00 at the year end of 31 December 20X7. The customer settled the invoice in full on 20 January 20X8, when the exchange rate was HK$8.55 = EUR1.00. Which journal entry correctly records the settlement on 20 January 20X8? A. Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Cash 430,000     Trade receivable (EUR) 430,000 B. Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Cash 427,500     Trade receivable (EUR) 425,000     Gain on foreign exchange difference (P/L) 2,500 C. Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Cash 427,500 Loss on foreign exchange difference (P/L) 2,500     Trade receivable (EUR) 430,000 D. Dr HK$ Cr HK$ Cash 425,000 Gain on foreign exchange difference (P/L) 2,500     Trade receivable (EUR) 427,500 Question 5 Harbourview Limited (functional currency: HKD) holds inventories in an offshore warehouse in Malaysia. The inventories cost MYR200,000 and were purchased when the exchange rate was HK$1.90 = MYR1.00. At the financial year end, the net realisable value of the inventories is MYR210,000, and the closing exchange rate is HK$1.75 = MYR1.00. In accordance with HKAS 2 Inventories and HKAS 21, what amount, if any, should Harbourview Limited recognise as a write down of inventories at the year end? A. No write down, because the net realisable value exceeds cost when both are measured in MYR B. A write down of HK$12,500 C. A write down of HK$30,000 D. A write down of HK$31,500

title: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Recognition / Identification — 邊個先係 Related Party？（核心考點）
B. Measurement — 本章無獨立計量規則
C. Disclosure — HKAS 24 (Revised) 具體要求
excerpt: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define and identify related parties of a reporting entity…
text: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define and identify related parties of a reporting entity in accordance with HKAS 24 (Revised) Related Party Disclosures . 2. Distinguish relationships that are related parties from those explicitly excluded by HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 11. 3. Explain the significance of sufficient disclosure of related party relationships, transactions and outstanding balances. 4. Describe and apply the disclosure requirements for related party relationships, related party transactions and key management personnel (KMP) compensation. ⚠️ 本章定位：HKAS 24 (Revised) 係一個 disclosure standard — 佢唔改變任何 transaction 嘅 recognition 或 measurement（嗰啲由其他準則處理，例如 HKFRS 16 處理 lease 本身嘅入賬）。所以本章冇專屬 journal entries；考試重點係 邊個係 related party 同 要披露啲乜 。相關披露會補充其他法規要求，例如 Section 383 of the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance （directors' emoluments）同 Chapter 14A of the Hong Kong Listing Rules （connected transactions）。 必背考點 A. Recognition / Identification — 邊個先係 Related Party？（核心考點） A1. Person (or a close member of that person's family) — HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 9(a) A person (or close family member) is related to the reporting entity if that person: 1. has control or joint control of the reporting entity — para. 9(a)(i); 2. has significant influence over the reporting entity — para. 9(a)(ii); 3. is a member of the key management personnel (KMP) of the reporting entity or of a parent of the reporting entity — para. 9(a)(iii). Key definitions (HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 9): Key management personnel (KMP) : those persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the entity, directly or indirectly, including any director (whether executive or otherwise) of that entity. Close members of the family of a person : family members who may be expected to influence, or be influenced by, that person in their dealings with the entity. Always includes : (i) the person's children and spouse or domestic partner; (ii) children of the person's spouse or domestic partner; (iii) dependants of that person or that person's spouse or domestic partner. Principles based — parents/grandparents could qualify depending on facts and circumstances. Related party transaction : a transfer of resources, services or obligations between a reporting entity and a related party, regardless of whether a price is charged （免費 transfer 都照計！）. A2. Entity — HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 9(b) An entity is related to the reporting entity if any of the following applies: 1. The entity and the reporting entity are members of the same group (each parent, subsidiary and fellow subsidiary is related to the others) — para. 9(b)(i); 2. One entity is an associate or joint venture of the other entity (or an associate or JV of a member of a group of which the other entity is a member) — para. 9(b)(ii); 3. Both entities are joint ventures of the same third party — para. 9(b)(iii); 4. One entity is a joint venture of a third entity and the other entity is an associate of the third entity — para. 9(b)(iv); 5. The entity is controlled or jointly controlled by a person identified in para. 9(a) — para. 9(b)(vi); 6. A person identified in para. 9(a)(i) (i.e. a person with control or joint control of the reporting entity) has significant influence over the entity or is a member of the KMP of the entity (or of a parent of the entity) — para. 9(b)(vii); 7. The entity, or any member of a group of which it is a part, provides KMP services to the reporting entity or to the parent of the reporting entity — para. 9(b)(viii). 💬 記憶法：集团内（same group）、有影响力（associate/JV 及延伸）、同一第三者嘅 JV、被关键人控制、提供 KMP 服务 — 一有任何一项就係 related party。LP 提醒：list 唔係 exhaustive，要睇 substance over legal form 。 A3. NOT related parties — HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 11（考試必考陷阱） The following are NOT related parties: Two entities simply because they have a director or other member of KMP in common , or because a member of KMP of one entity has significant influence over the other entity — para. 11(a); Two joint venturers simply because they share joint control of a joint venture — para. 11(b); A customer, supplier, franchisor, distributor or general agent with whom the entity transacts a significant volume of business, merely by virtue of the resulting economic dependence （經濟依賴 ≠ related party；但其他準則可能要求另行披露重大依賴）; Providers of finance / lenders in the ordinary course — financing arrangements alone do not constitute a related party relationship. A4. Timing point（Key Learning Point） : An entity's related parties may change from period to period — a person who was KMP for only part of the year is still a related party for that period（年中離任嘅 director 都照計）。 B. Measurement — 本章無獨立計量規則 HKAS 24 (Revised) 係 disclosure standard， 唔規定 related party transactions 點樣計量；交易本身按相關準則（HKFRS 15、HKFRS 16、HKAS 2 等）確認及計量。 因此本章 無指定 journal entries 。但記住：related party transactions 包括 arm's length 及 non arm's length 價格嘅交易 — 就算係市價交易， 一樣要披露 ；nil consideration 嘅 transfer（例如 parent 免費送 inventory 畀 subsidiary）都係 related party transaction。 相關披露責任疊加於：Section 383 of the HK Companies Ordinance（directors' emoluments）、HK Listing Rules Chapter 14A（connected transactions）、HKAS 1、HKFRS 12。 C. Disclosure — HKAS 24 (Revised) 具體要求 C1. Relationships — para. 13 & para. 16（無論有冇交易都要披露！） Disclose relationships between a parent and its subsidiaries irrespective of whether there have been transactions between them — para. 13. A subsidiary must disclose the name of its parent and, if different, the name of the ultimate controlling party — para. 13. If neither the parent nor the ultimate parent produces consolidated financial statements available for public use, disclose the name of the next most senior parent that does (the first parent above the immediate parent that produces publicly available consolidated FS) — para. 16. C2. Related party transactions — para. 18（有交易時） Disclose the nature of the related party relationship plus information about the transactions and outstanding balances (including commitments) necessary for users to understand the effect on the FS. At a minimum : the amount of the transactions ; the amount of outstanding balances, including commitments , and: their terms and conditions , including whether they are secured , and the nature of the consideration to be provided in settlement; and details of any guarantees given or received ; provisions for doubtful debts related to the amount of outstanding balances; and the expense recognised during the period in respect of bad or doubtful debts due from related parties. C3. Examples of related party transactions — para. 21 Purchases/sales of goods (finished or unfinished); purchases/sales of property and other assets; rendering or receiving of services; leases ; transfers of research and development; transfers under licence agreements; transfers under finance arrangements (including loans and equity contributions in cash or in kind); provision of guarantees or collateral ; commitments to do something if a particular event occurs or does not occur; settlement of liabilities on behalf of the entity (or by the entity on behalf of the related party). C4. KMP compensation — para. 17（必背五大類） Disclose KMP compensation in total and for each of the following categories: 1. Short term employee benefits (e.g. wages and salaries); 2. Post employment benefits (e.g. retirement benefits); 3. Other long term benefits (e.g. long term leave or sabbatical leave); 4. Termination benefits (e.g. severance payments); 5. Share based payment (e.g. share options and share appreciation rights). ⚠️ HKAS 24 (Revised) does NOT require disclosure of the compensation of each individual key management person — total + 五大類就夠（個別董事薪酬係 Companies Ordinance s.383 嘅要求，唔好混淆）。 易混淆概念對比 表 1：Related party vs NOT related party（HKAS 24 para. 9 vs para. 11） Situation Related party? 點樣分辨／考試伏位 Fellow subsidiary (same group) ✅ Yes — para. 9(b)(i) 同一集團內 automatically related，唔使有交易 Associate / joint venture of the reporting entity ✅ Yes — para. 9(b)(ii) Significant influence / joint control 就夠 Both entities are JVs of the same third party ✅ Yes — para. 9(b)(iii) 伏位：同下一条好易搞乱 Two venturers sharing joint control of the same JV ❌ No — para. 11(b) 淨係「一齊控制一個 JV」唔構成關係 — 經典陷阱 Entity controlled by a KMP member of the reporting entity ✅ Yes — para. 9(b)(vi) 人係 related → 佢控制嘅公司都係 related Two entities with merely a common director ❌ No — para. 11(a) 只有共同董事唔夠；除非該董事同時 control 其中一方 Major customer / supplier (economic dependence) ❌ No — para. 11 經濟依賴 ≠ related party，就算 100% 生意都係 Lender / provider of finance ❌ No — para. 11 層次 純融資安排唔構成 related party relationship 表 2：Control vs Joint control vs Significant influence vs KMP Concept 定義重點 Related party 後果 考試伏位 Control Power over the entity + exposure/rights to variable returns + ability to affect those returns through power Person/entity with control 係 related party（para. 9(a)(i), 9(b)(i)） 持股百分比本身唔等於 control（HKFRS 10 概念） Joint control Contractually agreed sharing of control; decisions require unanimous consent Joint control of reporting entity → related；同第三者 joint control 一個 JV，嗰個 JV 係 related，但 另一個 venturer 唔係 「JV 本身 related」vs「fellow venturer not related」係最常見失分位 Significant influence Power to participate in financial and operating policy decisions, but not control/joint control 產生 associate 關係 → related party（para. 9(a)(ii), 9(b)(ii)） 一般 20–50% 持股推定，但要睇實質 KMP Authority & responsibility for planning, directing, controlling activities; includes ALL directors (executive or otherwise) KMP + 其 close family + 其控制嘅 entity 全部 related（para. 9(a)(iii), 9(b)(vi)） Non executive / independent directors 都係 KMP；年中上任或離任都計（part period） Phase 2 閃卡（8 cards） Card 1 Front: According to HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 9, define a "related party" and a "related party transaction". Back: A related party is a person or entity that is related to the entity preparing its financial statements (the reporting entity). A related party transaction is a transfer of resources, services or obligations between a reporting entity and a related party, regardless of whether a price is charged . 💬 白話：related party 唔一定係公司，可以係人（director、佢屋企人）；交易唔使有價 — parent 免費送貨畀 subsidiary 都照樣要披露。 Card 2 Front: List the family members who are ALWAYS "close members of the family of a person" under HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 9. Back: 1. The person's children and spouse or domestic partner; 2. Children of the person's spouse or domestic partner; 3. Dependants of that person or that person's spouse or domestic partner. Parents / grandparents: not automatic — may qualify depending on facts and circumstances (principles based). 💬 白話：三類必中 — 仔女＋配偶、配偶嘅仔女、受養人。父母、祖父母唔係自動包，要睇情況判斷。 Card 3 Front: Define "key management personnel" (KMP) under HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 9. Back: Persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the entity, directly or indirectly; Including any director (whether executive or otherwise) of that entity. KMP of the parent of the reporting entity also counts. 💬 白話：所有董事都係 KMP — non executive、independent director 都計，唔好以為得 CEO/CFO。母公司嘅 KMP 都係子公司嘅 related party。 Card 4 Front: State the THREE exclusions in HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 11 — parties that are NOT related parties. Back: 1. Two entities simply because they have a director or KMP member in common (or KMP of one has significant influence over the other); 2. Two joint venturers simply because they share joint control of a joint venture; 3. A customer, supplier, franchisor, distributor or general agent with significant business volume, by virtue of economic dependence alone. 💬 白話：記住三個「唔係」— 共同董事、共同控制 JV 嘅拍檔、大客大供應商。考試 MCQ 十居其九會放一個 economic dependence distractor。 Card 5 Front: What parent subsidiary relationship disclosures does HKAS 24 (Revised) paras. 13 and 16 require, and do they depend on transactions occurring? Back: Disclose parent–subsidiary relationships irrespective of whether transactions have occurred . Disclose the name of the parent and, if different, the ultimate controlling party . If the parent / ultimate parent does not produce consolidated FS available for public use, disclose the next most senior parent that does. 💬 白話：呢個係「關係披露」，有冇交易都要寫。母公司唔係最終控制人就要連 ultimate controlling party 個名都披露；冇 public consolidated FS 就要搵上一層有嘅 parent。 Card 6 Front: List the MINIMUM disclosures required by HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 18 when related party transactions have occurred. Back: Nature of the related party relationship; Amount of the transactions; Amount of outstanding balances (including commitments), their terms and conditions (incl. whether secured, nature of consideration for settlement) and guarantees given or received ; Provisions for doubtful debts related to outstanding balances; Bad/doubtful debt expense recognised in the period re amounts due from related parties. 💬 白話：記「關係＋金額＋結餘條款＋擔保＋壞賬」五步。免息、無抵押呢啲「唔正常」條款正正係要披露嘅重點。 Card 7 Front: List the FIVE categories of KMP compensation disclosure required by HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 17. Is per individual disclosure required? Back: 1. Short term employee benefits; 2. Post employment benefits; 3. Other long term benefits; 4. Termination benefits; 5. Share based payment. Disclosed in total and by category — disclosure of compensation of each individual KMP is NOT required by HKAS 24 (Revised). 💬 白話：口訣「短、退、長、散、股」。個別董事薪酬係 Companies Ordinance s.383 嘅事，HKAS 24 只要總數分五類。 Card 8 Front: True or False: (i) Arm's length transactions between related parties need not be disclosed. (ii) A director who resigned mid year is not a related party for that year. Explain. Back: (i) False — all transactions between related parties must be disclosed, whether on arm's length or non arm's length terms. (ii) False — related parties may change from period to period; a person who was KMP for part of the period is still a related party for that period. 💬 白話：兩個經典伏位 — 市價交易一樣要披露；年中離任嘅 director 嗰年都仲係 related party。見到 "arm's length so no disclosure" 即刻知係陷阱。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Related party 關聯方／關連人士（個人或公司） A related party is a person or entity that is related to the reporting entity preparing its financial statements. Related party transaction 關聯方交易（唔使有作價） A related party transaction is a transfer of resources, services or obligations between related parties regardless of whether a price is charged. Key management personnel (KMP) 主要管理人員（包所有董事） Key management personnel include any director, whether executive or otherwise, of the entity. Close members of the family 密切家庭成員（配偶仔女受養人） The spouse of a director is a close member of the family and therefore a related party of the entity. Arm's length transaction 公平／獨立市價交易 Even transactions conducted on an arm's length basis must be disclosed if they occur between related parties. Ultimate controlling party 最終控制方 The subsidiary must disclose the name of its parent and, if different, the ultimate controlling party. Economic dependence 經濟依賴（≠ related party） A major customer is not a related party merely because of the entity's economic dependence on that customer. Outstanding balances (including commitments) 未結算餘額（包括承擔） The entity must disclose the amount of outstanding balances with related parties, their terms and conditions, and any guarantees given or received.

title: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C is correct. Under HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 11(a), two entities are…
text: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C is correct. Under HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 11(a), two entities are not related parties simply because they have a director or other member of key management personnel in common. The finance director of Falcon Limited serving as a non executive director of Merlin Limited is, on these facts alone, insufficient to create a related party relationship. A is incorrect: Kestrel Limited is a fellow subsidiary of Falcon Limited — members of the same group are related to each other (para. 9(b)(i)). B is incorrect: the spouse of the CEO is a close member of the family of a member of KMP (paras. 9(a)(iii) and 9 — close family always includes the spouse). D is incorrect: Osprey Limited is a joint venture of Falcon Limited — one entity being a joint venture of the other creates a related party relationship (para. 9(b)(ii)). 解題思路（繁中）: 題目問邊個「唔係」related party。A 係 fellow subsidiary — 同一集團內自動 related。B 係 CEO 配偶 — close member of the family of KMP，必定 related。D 係公司嘅 joint venture — para. 9(b)(ii) 涵蓋。C 只有一位共同董事（common director），para. 11(a) 明確排除。留意：如果題目話該董事同時 control Merlin，答案就會唔同（咁會落入 para. 9(b)(vi)）。 Rule Check: HKAS 24 (Revised) paras. 9(a)(iii), 9(b)(i), 9(b)(ii) and 11(a) Common Trap（繁中）: 學生常誤以為「共同董事 = related party」。HKAS 24 para. 11(a) 專登寫明淨係有共同 KMP 成員唔構成關係。另一個伏位：Osprey 嘅「另一個 joint venturer」先至唔係 related party — 但 JV 本身（Osprey）一定係。 Q2 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): A is correct. The wife of the chief financial officer is a close member of the family of a member of Marble Limited's key management personnel — close members of the family always include the person's spouse (HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 9), and the CFO is KMP (para. 9(a)(iii)). B is incorrect: a supplier with whom the entity transacts a significant volume of business is not a related party merely by virtue of the resulting economic dependence (para. 11). C is incorrect: a provider of finance acting in the ordinary course of business does not become a related party by reason of its lending arrangements alone. D is incorrect: the sales manager has no authority or responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the entity, so he is not KMP and therefore not a related party. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題測「person」層面嘅 related party 定義。B 同 C 係 para. 11 嘅經典排除 — 經濟依賴同純融資安排都唔構成關係。D 測 KMP 定義：sales manager 就算職位重要，只要冇 planning/directing/controlling 嘅權責就唔係 KMP（對比 LP 嘅 exam practice：sales staff 唔係 related parties）。A 係唯一符合 para. 9 嘅答案：CFO 係 KMP，配偶係 close family。 Rule Check: HKAS 24 (Revised) paras. 9, 9(a)(iii) and 11 Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「85% 供應量」、「主要客戶」、「主要銀行」呢類字眼，九成係 distractor — economic dependence 永遠唔係 related party 嘅理由。記住 KMP 係功能測試（authority and responsibility），唔係職銜測試。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B is correct. The related parties of Papaya Limited are: Mango Limited — Mango is the parent of Papaya; members of the same group are related (para. 9(b)(i)); Lychee Limited — Lychee is an associate of Papaya (significant influence) (para. 9(b)(ii)); Rambutan Limited — Rambutan is a joint venture of Mango Limited, which is a member of the group of which Papaya is a member (para. 9(b)(ii) — an associate or joint venture of a member of a group of which the other entity is a member). Durian Limited is NOT a related party of Papaya : Durian merely shares joint control of Rambutan with Mango — two joint venturers simply sharing joint control of a joint venture are not related parties (para. 11(b)), and there is no other relationship linking Durian to Papaya. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係多步驟 group structure 分析。第一步：Mango 係 parent（9(b)(i)）。第二步：Lychee 係 Papaya 嘅 associate（9(b)(ii)）。第三步係關鍵：Rambutan 雖然唔係 Papaya 直接持有，但佢係 Mango（Papaya 集團成員）嘅 JV — para. 9(b)(ii) 嘅延伸條款令佢成為 Papaya 嘅 related party。第四步：Durian 只係同 Mango 一齊控制 Rambutan — para. 11(b) 排除。A 漏咗 Rambutan；C 錯誤包括 Durian；D 漏晒 associate 同 JV。 Rule Check: HKAS 24 (Revised) paras. 9(b)(i), 9(b)(ii) and 11(b) Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個伏位：(1) 漏咗 para. 9(b)(ii) 嘅「JV of a member of the group」延伸 — parent 嘅 JV 都係 subsidiary 嘅 related party；(2) 誤將 fellow joint venturer（Durian）當 related party — 「共同控制一個 JV」本身唔構成關係。 Q4 — Answer: D (HK$3,750,000) Model Answer (EN): KMP compensation under HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 17 includes, in total and by category: Category Item HK$ Short term employee benefits Salaries 2,400,000 + bonuses 600,000 3,000,000 Post employment benefits Employer's pension contributions 180,000 Termination benefits Termination payment to retiring director 250,000 Share based payment Fair value of share options granted 320,000 Total KMP compensation 3,750,000 Salaries of sales staff (HK$1,900,000) are excluded — the sales staff are not KMP, so their remuneration is not KMP compensation. Dividends on directors' personal shareholdings (HK$90,000) are excluded — dividends are returns on share ownership, not compensation for KMP services. Distractor analysis: A (HK$3,430,000) omits the share based payment; B (HK$3,840,000) wrongly includes the dividends; C (HK$5,650,000) wrongly includes the sales staff salaries. 解題思路（繁中）: 計數前先分類：邊啲係 KMP compensation。董事薪酬、花紅（short term）、退休金供款（post employment）、遣散費（termination）、購股權（share based）全部計。Sales staff 唔係 KMP — 佢哋嘅人工與 KMP disclosure 無關。董事個人持股收到嘅股息係股東回報，唔係 compensation — 呢個係最巧妙嘅 distractor。加總：3,000,000 + 180,000 + 250,000 + 320,000 = 3,750,000。 Rule Check: HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 17 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大伏位：(1) 將非 KMP 員工薪酬計入；(2) 將股息當成董事報酬 — 股息係投資回報，唔屬於 para. 17 五大類。記住口訣「短、退、長、散、股」，逐項歸類再加總。 Q5 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): A is correct. HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 18 requires disclosure of the amount of outstanding balances (including commitments), their terms and conditions (including whether secured and the nature of the consideration to be provided in settlement), details of guarantees given or received, provisions for doubtful debts related to the outstanding balances, and the bad/doubtful debt expense recognised in the period. It does not require disclosure of a hypothetical arm's length price for the balance — the standard requires disclosure of the actual terms and effects of related party transactions, not a reconstruction of market equivalent pricing. B, C and D are all explicitly required by para. 18. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 NOT question，考 para. 18 嘅 minimum disclosure 清單。B（條款、有冇抵押、結算方式）、C（擔保）、D（壞賬撥備）全部係白紙黑字嘅要求。A 聽落好合理，但 HKAS 24 從來唔要求你披露「如果係市價會係幾多」— 準則只要求披露實際交易條款，等用家自己判斷影響。呢個設計係利用學生「related party 披露應該要話畀人知偏離市價幾多」嘅直覺做陷阱。 Rule Check: HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 18 Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好將「披露目的」（等用家知道交易可能唔係市價）同「披露要求」（披露實際條款）混為一談。考試見到 "arm's length equivalent price" / "fair value of the transaction" 呢類選項，通常唔係 HKAS 24 嘅披露要求。

title: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 I…
text: M6 Chapter 19: Related Party Disclosures — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 In accordance with HKAS 24 (Revised) Related Party Disclosures , which of the following parties is NOT a related party of Falcon Limited, a Hong Kong trading company? A. Kestrel Limited, a fellow subsidiary of Falcon Limited (both are wholly owned by the same parent company) B. Ms. Wong, the spouse of Falcon Limited's chief executive officer C. Merlin Limited, a company whose only connection with Falcon Limited is that the finance director of Falcon Limited also serves as a non executive director of Merlin Limited D. Osprey Limited, a joint venture of Falcon Limited over which Falcon Limited shares joint control with an unrelated investor Question 2 According to HKAS 24 (Revised), which of the following persons is a related party of Marble Limited, a Hong Kong property developer, in respect of its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X5? A. The wife of Marble Limited's chief financial officer B. Granite Supplies Co., a supplier that provides 85% of Marble Limited's raw materials, creating significant economic dependence C. Harbour Bank, which provides Marble Limited's mortgage financing in the ordinary course of its banking business D. A sales manager of Marble Limited who is responsible for negotiating property sales contracts but has no authority over the planning, directing or controlling of the entity's activities Question 3 Mango Limited owns 80% of the issued shares of Papaya Limited. Papaya Limited owns 30% of the issued shares of Lychee Limited and has significant influence over Lychee Limited. Mango Limited and Durian Limited each hold 50% of Rambutan Limited and share joint control of Rambutan Limited; Mango Limited and Durian Limited are otherwise unrelated. In accordance with HKAS 24 (Revised), which of the following sets correctly identifies the related parties of Papaya Limited ? A. Mango Limited and Lychee Limited only B. Mango Limited, Lychee Limited and Rambutan Limited C. Mango Limited, Lychee Limited, Rambutan Limited and Durian Limited D. Mango Limited only Question 4 The board of directors of Otter Limited comprises the only key management personnel of the company. For the year ended 31 December 20X6, the following amounts were paid or granted: Item HK$ Directors' salaries 2,400,000 Directors' performance bonuses 600,000 Employer's pension contributions for directors 180,000 Termination payment to a retiring director 250,000 Fair value of share options granted to directors 320,000 Salaries of sales staff (not key management personnel) 1,900,000 Dividends paid to directors on their personal shareholdings 90,000 In accordance with HKAS 24 (Revised), what is the total key management personnel compensation that Otter Limited must disclose for the year ended 31 December 20X6? A. HK$3,430,000 B. HK$3,840,000 C. HK$5,650,000 D. HK$3,750,000 Question 5 Beaver Limited has an outstanding loan balance due from its parent company at the year end. In accordance with HKAS 24 (Revised) para. 18, which of the following is NOT required to be disclosed in respect of this outstanding balance with a related party? A. The price that would have been charged for an equivalent loan had it been negotiated with an unrelated lender on an arm's length basis B. The terms and conditions of the balance, including whether it is secured and the nature of the consideration to be provided in settlement C. Details of any guarantees given or received in respect of the balance D. Provisions for doubtful debts related to the amount of the outstanding balance

text: M6 Chapter 20: Financial Statements Introduction — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives (3–5, English, action verbs) 1. Explain the basis of preparation and presentation of general purpose financial statements under HKAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements , including the eight general features (true and fair view, going concern, accrual basis, materiality, offsetting, frequency of reporting, comparative information, consistency of presentation). 2. Identify the components of a complete set of financial statements under HKAS 1 and state when a third statement of financial position is required. 3. Apply the current / non current classification rules for assets and liabilities, including operating cycle and refinancing considerations. 4. Prepare and present a statement of financial position , a statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (single or two statement approach; expenses by nature or by function) and a statement of changes in equity in accordance with HKAS 1. 5. Distinguish items reported in profit or loss , other comprehensive income (with/without subsequent reclassification), the statement of changes in equity and the notes . 必背考點 A. Recognition（元素何時入帳 — 與 Framework 連繫） Accrual basis (HKAS 1 para. 27) : FS 以 accrual basis 編製（cash flow information 除外）；income, expenses, assets, liabilities, equity 於滿足 Framework 中各元素的 definition 及 recognition criteria 時確認（詳見 Chapter 1）。 Going concern (HKAS 1) : FS 一般假設 entity 在 foreseeable future 持續經營（going concern assumption）。 All inclusive approach (HKAS 1 para. 88) : 期內所有 income 及 expense items 必須計入 profit or loss，除非另一 HKFRS 要求或准許計入 other comprehensive income (OCI) 。 Profit or loss (HKAS 1 para. 7) : total of income less expenses, excluding OCI items。 OCI (HKAS 1 para. 7) : items of income and expense (including reclassification adjustments) not recognised in profit or loss as required or permitted by other HKFRSs（例：revaluation surplus 變動 under HKAS 16 para. 39；fair value gains/losses on investments in equity instruments）。 Total comprehensive income (HKAS 1 para. 7) : profit or loss + OCI = change in equity during a period other than transactions with owners in their capacity as owners。 B. Measurement（計量基礎 — 本章以披露為主） HKAS 1 本身不訂立計量規則；recognition/measurement 由其他 HKFRSs 訂明（e.g. HKAS 16 PPE、HKAS 2 Inventories、HKAS 38 Intangible Assets）。 Notes 必須披露 measurement basis (or bases) used in preparing the FS（historical cost、current cost、fair value 等），因為這對用家分析有重大影響（HKAS 1 para. 117 相關；HKAS 16 亦要求披露 measurement bases）。 Judgements (HKAS 1 para. 122) : management 在應用會計政策時作出、對 FS 確認金額有最重大影響的 judgements 必須披露。 Offsetting (HKAS 1 paras. 32–35) : assets/liabilities、income/expenses 不得對銷 ，除非某 HKFRS 要求或准許（例：HKAS 32 在符合條件時准許 financial asset/liability 對銷）。 Measuring assets net of valuation allowances（如 trade receivables 減 provision for expected credit loss）不是 offsetting 。同一交易或同類交易的 gains/losses 可 net（如出售非流動資產的 gain/loss；外匯收益虧損；HKAS 37 provision 開支與第三方補償），但 material 的 gains/losses 必須分開列報。 C. Disclosure / Presentation requirements（本章核心） C1. Complete set of financial statements（HKAS 1 para. 10） statement of financial position as at the end of the period statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period statement of changes in equity for the period statement of cash flows for the period（HKAS 7 — 詳見 Chapter 21） notes, comprising material accounting policy information and other explanatory information comparative information in respect of the preceding period a third statement of financial position as at the beginning of the preceding period when there is retrospective application of an accounting policy / retrospective restatement / reclassification with a material effect on that SOFP (HKAS 1 paras. 40A–40C)； related notes for this third SOFP are not required 。例：year end 31 Dec 20X9 → 三份 SOFP 日期為 31 Dec 20X9、31 Dec 20X8、 1 Jan 20X8 。 C2. True and fair view / compliance（HKAS 1 paras. 15, 16, 23） 遵從 HKFRSs（必要時加 additional disclosures）即 presumed to give a true and fair view 。 遵從 HKFRSs 的 entity 須在 notes 作出 explicit and unreserved statement of compliance (para. 16)。 極罕有情況下遵從某 HKFRS 會誤導而監管框架又不准偏離：須披露 (i) 該 HKFRS 名稱、要求性質及管理層認為遵從會誤導的原因；(ii) 每期為達致 true and fair view 所需對各項目的調整 (para. 23)。 C3. Consistency (HKAS 1 paras. 45–46) Presentation/classification 須逐期一致，除非：(i) significant change in operations；(ii) 改變能提供更 relevant 資訊；或 (iii) 另一 HKFRS 要求。改變時 comparatives 須 reclassify。 C4. Materiality and aggregation (HKAS 1 paras. 29–31; Framework para. 2.11) 'Material' = information 若 omitted, misstated or obscured 可合理預期影響 primary users 的決定；以 FS as a whole 評估；HKICPA 不能 設定 uniform quantitative threshold。 每個 material class of similar items 須分開列報；dissimilar items 除非 immaterial 否則分開列報；immaterial 金額可 aggregate。 HKFRS 指定的 disclosure 若 resulting information not material ，可不作披露（但可自願加 additional disclosure）。 C5. Comparative information (HKAS 1 paras. 38, 38A, 38B, 41, 42) 最少列報 preceding period 的所有金額（即最少兩年）；narrative/descriptive comparatives 若 relevant 亦須提供（例：未解決官司的進展）。 改變 presentation/classification 時，comparatives 須 reclassify，並披露 reclassification 的 nature, amount and reason 。 HKAS 8 的 accounting policy 變更及 error 更正亦須調整 comparatives（Chapter 13）。 C6. Identification & reporting period (HKAS 1 paras. 49–51, 36–37) FS 須 clearly identified 並與同一文件內其他資料區分；prominently display：entity 名稱（及改名）、individual entity 或 group、reporting period 結算日/涵蓋期間、presentation currency（HKAS 21 定義）、level of rounding。 Complete set of FS at least annually ；可採用 52 week period。改變 year end 致期間長短於一年：須披露原因及 comparatives 不完全可比的事實。 C7. Statement of financial position（HKAS 1 paras. 54–58, 60–70, 77–79） HKAS 1 不指定 order or format （para. 57；Implementation Guidance 只提供一個可接受格式；可採 Assets = Equity + Liabilities 或 Assets − Liabilities = Equity）。 Minimum line items (para. 54)：PPE; investment property; intangible assets; financial assets; investments accounted for using the equity method; inventories; trade and other receivables; cash and cash equivalents; assets/disposal groups held for sale (HKFRS 5); trade and other payables; provisions; financial liabilities; current tax liabilities/assets (HKAS 12); deferred tax liabilities/assets; liabilities in disposal groups held for sale; non controlling interests (within equity); issued capital and reserves attributable to owners of the parent。 Additional items/headings/subtotals 當 relevant to understanding (para. 55)，按 nature and liquidity of assets、function of assets、amounts/nature/timing of liabilities 評估。 Current asset (para. 66) ：(a) 預期在 normal operating cycle 內變現/出售/消耗；(b) 主要持作 trading；(c) 預期於報告期後 12 個月內變現；(d) cash or cash equivalent（HKAS 7 定義）除非受限於報告期後至少 12 個月不得兌換或用於償債。其他全部 = non current。 Current liability (para. 69) ：(a) 預期在 normal operating cycle 內結清；(b) 主要持作 trading；(c) 於報告期後 12 個月內到期結清；(d) 於報告期末沒有權利 將結清遞延至報告期後至少 12 個月。其他全部 = non current。 Operating cycle (para. 68) ：由購入資產加工到變現為 cash/cash equivalents 的時間；通常 12 個月內但可更長。Operating cycle 12 個月時（如物業發展 18 個月），inventories/trade payables 仍可全數列 current，但須就每個 line item 額外披露預期 超過 12 個月 後收回/結清的金額 (para. 61)。 金融機構等無清晰 operating cycle 的 entity 可按 liquidity order 列報 (para. 63)。 Share capital 每類別須披露 (para. 79(a))：authorised 股數；issued（fully/partly paid）股數；par value per share 或無面值；期初至期末股數 reconciliation。另須描述每項 reserve 的 nature and purpose (para. 79(b))。Line items 須再作 subclassification（paras. 77–78），如 PPE 按 HKAS 16 para. 37 分類（land、machinery 等，通常於 notes 披露）。 C8. Statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income（HKAS 1 paras. 10A, 81A–82A, 85, 90–93, 97–105） Presentation choice (para. 10A) ：(i) single statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income（profit or loss section 直接接 OCI section）；或 (ii) two statements — separate statement of profit or loss 緊接 statement of comprehensive income（後者以 profit or loss 數字開始）。 Profit or loss section minimum line items (para. 82) ：revenue；gains/losses on derecognition of financial assets at amortised cost；finance costs；impairment losses (including reversals)；share of profit or loss of associates and JVs (equity method)；tax expense；a single amount for the total of discontinued operations。須另列 profit or loss、total OCI 及 comprehensive income for the period (para. 81A)，並分配 profit or loss 及 total comprehensive income 予 owners of the parent 及 non controlling interests (para. 81B)。 Material items (paras. 97–98) ：性質/金額重大的 income/expense 須單獨披露，例：write down of inventories to NRV 或 PPE to recoverable amount（及 reversals）；restructuring 及 provision reversals；disposals of PPE / investments；discontinued operations；litigation settlements。 Expense analysis (paras. 99, 102–103, 105) ：按 nature （depreciation、employee benefits、raw materials used 等；簡單，不用分攤）或 function / 'cost of sales' （cost of sales、distribution costs、administrative expenses；較 relevant 但需 arbitrary allocations）分類 — 選能提供 reliable and more relevant information 者。 OCI section (paras. 82A, 90–91) ：分開列示 (a) items that will not be reclassified subsequently to profit or loss；(b) items that may be reclassified subsequently when specific conditions are met；並單獨列示 share of OCI of associates/JVs。每項 OCI 的 income tax 須在 statement 或 notes 披露；OCI items 可 net of tax 或 before tax（連一個合計稅額） 列報。 Reclassification adjustments (paras. 92–93, 96) ：過往在 OCI 確認的 'unrealised' 金額其後 'recycled' 至本期 P&L，須在相關 OCI component 中扣除以避免 double counting。 Revaluation surplus 不產生 reclassification adjustments — 永不 recycle 至 P&L；資產 derecognised 時 surplus 可直接轉撥（transfer directly）於 equity 內。 C9. Statement of changes in equity（HKAS 1 paras. 106–110） 功能：reconcile 每個 equity component 期初至期末的 carrying amount。Total equity 須與 SOFP 的 total equity 相符。 必須包括 (para. 106)：(a) total comprehensive income for the period（分開 owners of the parent / NCI）；(b) 每個 component 按 HKAS 8 的 retrospective application/restatement 影響（調整 opening retained earnings，除非準則要求調整其他 component；policy changes 與 error corrections 分開披露）；(d) 每個 component 的 reconciliation，分開列示 profit or loss、OCI、transactions with owners（contributions by / distributions to owners；不導致 loss of control 的 subsidiary ownership 變動）。 Components of equity (para. 108)：each class of share capital、each class of OCI 的累計結餘（如 revaluation surplus）、retained earnings。 Dividends (para. 107) ：已確認分派予 owners 的股息及每股金額須在 SOCIE 或 notes 披露 — 不得 列入 SPLOCI（屬 owner transaction，非 expense）。 SOCIE 公式：Opening total equity + total comprehensive income −/+ transactions with shareholders（share issues、dividends）= Closing total equity。 D. Key Journal Entries（本章示例中出現、必須識做） 1. Upward revaluation of PPE（首次、未沖回減值）— gain to OCI （稅前）： Dr Property, plant and equipment (asset) 120,000 / Cr Revaluation surplus (OCI → equity) 120,000 2. Deferred tax on revaluation gain （HKAS 12，稅率 16.5% → 120,000 × 16.5% = 19,800）： Dr Revaluation surplus (equity) 19,800 / Cr Deferred tax liability 19,800 淨效應：revaluation surplus 增加 100,200（OCI net of tax）。 3. Dividend declared（owner transaction，唔係 expense） ： Dr Retained earnings 160,000 / Cr Dividend payable 160,000（ordinary；preference 同理） 4. Transfer to general reserve（equity 內部轉撥，total equity 不變） ： Dr Retained earnings 20,000 / Cr General reserve 20,000 5. Issue of shares for cash ： Dr Cash 200,000 / Cr Share capital 200,000 易混淆概念對比 Table 1 — Profit or Loss vs Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) Profit or Loss Other Comprehensive Income Definition (HKAS 1 para. 7) Income less expenses, excluding OCI items Income/expense items (incl. reclassification adjustments) NOT recognised in P&L as required/permitted by other HKFRSs Examples Revenue, cost of sales, finance costs, tax expense, impairment losses, share of profit of associates Changes in revaluation surplus (HKAS 16 para. 39); FV gains/losses on equity instruments Recycled to P&L later? N/A 視乎類別：'may be reclassified' vs 'will not be reclassified'（para. 82A）— revaluation surplus 永不 recycle （para. 96） 點樣分辨 / 考試伏位 HKAS 1 採 all inclusive approach（para. 88）：預設所有 income/expense 入 P&L 伏位：考生誤以為 revaluation gain 入 P&L，或誤將 revaluation surplus 於出售時 recycle 入 P&L（正確做法係直接喺 equity 內轉撥） Table 2 — Statement of Changes in Equity vs Notes to the Financial Statements Statement of Changes in Equity Notes 內容 (HKAS 1) TCI；每個 equity component 期初/期末 reconciliation；HKAS 8 retrospective adjustments；dividends；share issues；equity 內部轉撥 (paras. 106–108) Statement of compliance with HKFRSs；material accounting policy information (para. 117)；supporting information；other disclosures e.g. contingent liabilities (paras. 112–114) Dividends 放邊度 SOCIE 或 notes（para. 107）— 絕對唔係 SPLOCI 可作替代披露位置 Accumulated depreciation / PPE 分類 唔會出現（SOCIE 只顯示 equity components） PPE by class (HKAS 16 para. 37)、accumulated depreciation 等 subclassification 喺 notes (paras. 77–78) 點樣分辨 / 考試伏位 凡係 owner transaction 或 equity component 變動 → SOCIE；total equity 要對返 SOFP 伏位：考生將 dividends declared 放入 SPLOCI 當 expense；或將 prior period error 對 opening retained earnings 嘅調整遺漏喺 SOCIE Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: According to HKAS 1, what are the components of a complete set of financial statements? Back: Statement of financial position (end of period) Statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income Statement of changes in equity Statement of cash flows (HKAS 7) Notes (material accounting policy information + other explanatory information) Comparative information for the preceding period A third SOFP at the beginning of the preceding period (only when retrospective application / restatement / reclassification with material effect) 💬 記口訣「四表一註加比較」：SOFP、SPLOCI、SOCIE、SOCF 四張主表，加 notes、comparatives，特殊情況（追溯調整/重列/重新分類且有重大影響）要加多份期初 SOFP。Statement of cash flows 嘅詳細內容喺 Chapter 21。 Card 2 Front: Under HKAS 1, when must an entity present a third statement of financial position, and are related notes required? Back: Required when the entity (i) applies an accounting policy retrospectively; (ii) makes a retrospective restatement; or (iii) reclassifies items — AND there is a material effect on the SOFP at the beginning of the preceding period (HKAS 1 paras. 40A–40B) Present SOFPs at: end of current period; end of preceding period; beginning of preceding period Related notes for the third (opening) SOFP are NOT required (para. 40C) 💬 三個觸發點：追溯會計政策、追溯重列錯誤、重新分類，仲要有 material effect。例：20X9 年結 → 31/12/20X9、31/12/20X8、1/1/20X8 三份 SOFP，最早嗰份唔使附 notes。考試常問日期點計。 Card 3 Front: State the HKAS 1 criteria for classifying an asset as current. Back: An asset is current when (HKAS 1 para. 66): Expected to be realised / sold / consumed in the normal operating cycle; OR Held primarily for trading; OR Expected to be realised within 12 months after the reporting period; OR Cash or cash equivalent, unless restricted from being exchanged or used to settle a liability for at least 12 months after the reporting period All other assets → non current 💬 關鍵係 operating cycle 可以長過 12 個月（例如物業發展商 18 個月 cycle），咁樣 inventory 就算 15 個月後先賣出都係 current。但受限唔用得嘅 cash 超過 12 個月就變 non current — 呢個係常見伏位。 Card 4 Front: State the HKAS 1 criteria for classifying a liability as current. Back: A liability is current when (HKAS 1 para. 69): Expected to be settled in the normal operating cycle; OR Held primarily for trading; OR Due to be settled within 12 months after the reporting period; OR The entity does NOT have the right at the end of the reporting period to defer settlement for at least 12 months after the reporting period All other liabilities → non current 💬 同 asset 規則鏡像對稱。特別留意 (d)：判斷時點係「報告期末」有冇遞延權利。Trade payables 就算 12 個月後先找數，只要屬 normal operating cycle 一部分都照列 current (para. 70)。 Card 5 Front: What is the HKAS 1 rule on offsetting, and what is NOT regarded as offsetting? Back: Assets/liabilities and income/expenses shall NOT be offset unless required or permitted by an HKFRS (HKAS 1 para. 32; e.g. HKAS 32 permits offsetting financial assets/liabilities when conditions are met) NOT offsetting: measuring assets net of valuation allowances (e.g. trade receivables less provision for expected credit loss) Netting permitted for gains/losses from the same or similar transactions (e.g. disposal of non current assets; FX gains/losses) — but material gains/losses must be reported separately 💬 白話：「唔准玩對沖式隱藏」— 對銷會令用家睇唔到交易全貌同現金流。但「receivables 減 ECL provision」只係計量唔係對銷。記住：auditor/director 批准都唔構成對銷理由，一定要 HKFRS 准許。 Card 6 Front: Which items must be presented in the profit or loss section under HKAS 1 para. 82? Back: Revenue Gains/losses on derecognition of financial assets measured at amortised cost Finance costs Impairment losses (including reversals) Share of profit or loss of associates and joint ventures (equity method) Tax expense Single amount for the total of discontinued operations Plus: profit or loss, total OCI, total comprehensive income (para. 81A); allocation to owners of the parent / NCI (para. 81B) 💬 伏位：rent expense、audit fees、profit before tax 都 唔係 para. 82 指定嘅 mandatory line items（PBT 係常見但非強制）。記住「R F I A T D」主軸再加 discontinued operations 單一數字。 Card 7 Front: Distinguish the 'nature of expense' method from the 'function of expense' method under HKAS 1. Back: Nature of expense method: expenses aggregated by nature — e.g. depreciation, employee benefits, raw materials used, advertising; simple, no allocation needed (HKAS 1 paras. 99, 102) Function of expense ('cost of sales') method: expenses classified by function — e.g. cost of sales, distribution costs, administrative expenses; more relevant but requires arbitrary allocations and judgement (para. 103) Choose whichever provides reliable and more relevant information, based on historical/industry factors and nature of the entity (para. 105) 💬 分辨口訣：nature 問「洗咗喺乜嘢上面」（折舊、人工）；function 問「邊個部門洗」（銷售成本、行政費）。題目見到 'distribution costs / administrative expenses' = function；見到 'depreciation / employee benefits' 逐項列 = nature。 Card 8 Front: What must be included in a statement of changes in equity under HKAS 1 para. 106, and where are dividends disclosed? Back: Total comprehensive income for the period (split: owners of the parent / NCI) Effects of retrospective application / restatement per HKAS 8 for each component Reconciliation of each component of equity (share capital, each OCI reserve, retained earnings) between beginning and end of period, showing separately: profit or loss; OCI; transactions with owners (contributions, distributions, changes in ownership without loss of control) Dividends recognised as distributions to owners + amount per share: in SOCIE or in the notes (para. 107) — NEVER in SPLOCI Total equity must agree with the SOFP 💬 SOCIE 係「期初 → 期末」嘅對帳表：開頭結餘 + TCI +/− owner transactions（發股、派息）= 期末結餘。最大伏位：dividends declared 唔係 expense，唔准放入 profit or loss！ 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Complete set of financial statements 完整財務報表組合：四張主表 + notes + 比較資料（特殊情況加期初 SOFP） A complete set of financial statements comprises a statement of financial position, a statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, a statement of changes in equity, a statement of cash flows, notes and comparative information. Going concern 持續經營假設：預設公司 foreseeable future 繼續營運 Financial statements are normally prepared on the assumption that the entity is a going concern and will continue in operation for the foreseeable future. Materiality 重要性：資料若遺漏、錯報或被遮蔽會影響使用者決定；無統一百分比門檻 Information is material if omitting, misstating or obscuring it could reasonably be expected to influence decisions that the primary users of general purpose financial statements make. Offsetting 對銷：資產/負債、收入/費用唔准互相抵銷，除非 HKFRS 准許 Assets and liabilities shall not be offset unless required or permitted by an HKFRS. Operating cycle 營運週期：由入貨加工到收返現金嘅時間，通常 12 個月但可以更長 The operating cycle of an entity is the time between the acquisition of assets for processing and their realisation in cash or cash equivalents. Other comprehensive income (OCI) 其他全面收益：HKFRS 指定唔入損益嘅收入/費用項目，如重估盈餘變動 Other comprehensive income comprises items of income and expense that are not recognised in profit or loss as required or permitted by other HKFRSs. Reclassification adjustment 重新分類調整：以前喺 OCI 嘅金額「回收」返入本期損益，避免雙重計算 Reclassification adjustments are amounts reclassified to profit or loss in the current period that were recognised in other comprehensive income in the current or previous periods. Revaluation surplus 重估盈餘：資產重估增值喺 OCI 確認並累積於權益，永不 recycle 入損益 The revaluation surplus is recognised in other comprehensive income and is not reclassified to profit or loss in subsequent periods.
