excerpt: M6 Chapter 20: Financial Statements Introduction — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A complete set of financial statements under HKAS 1 compris…
text: M6 Chapter 20: Financial Statements Introduction — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A complete set of financial statements under HKAS 1 comprises: (i) a statement of financial position; (ii) a statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income; (iii) a statement of changes in equity; (iv) a statement of cash flows; (v) notes comprising material accounting policy information and other explanatory information; (vi) comparative information for the preceding period; and (vii) a statement of financial position at the beginning of the preceding period when there is retrospective application/restatement or reclassification. A statement of directors' remuneration is NOT a component — directors' remuneration disclosures, where required, appear in the notes, not as a separate primary statement. 解題思路（繁中）: 考「四表一註加比較」嘅完整組合。Option A（SOCIE）、C（notes）、D（comparative information）全部係 HKAS 1 明確列出嘅 components，所以唔係答案。Option B 係虛構嘅「董事薪酬表」— 董事薪酬資料只會喺 notes 披露，唔係一份 primary statement。呢類題目嘅伏位通常係將一個聽落合理嘅披露項目包裝成「statement」。 Rule Check: HKAS 1 para. 10 Common Trap（繁中）: 考生容易漏咗「comparative information」同「notes」都係 complete set 嘅正式組成部分，以為只有四張主表。另外記住第三份 SOFP 只喺追溯調整/重列/重新分類且有重大影響時先需要。 Q2 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 1 para. 66(d), cash or a cash equivalent is classified as current unless it is restricted from being exchanged or used to settle a liability for at least 12 months after the reporting period. The restricted cash deposit (restricted for 24 months) therefore fails all current asset criteria and is classified as NON CURRENT. Options A and B are current under para. 66(a) — assets expected to be realised/sold/consumed in the entity's normal operating cycle are current even if realisation is more than 12 months away (the operating cycle here is 15 months). Option C is current under para. 69(a)/70 — liabilities settled within the normal operating cycle are current even if settlement is due more than 12 months after the reporting period. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 operating cycle 12 個月嘅特殊情況。關鍵概念：current/non current 分界唔係單純「12 個月」，而係「normal operating cycle 或 12 個月，以適用者為準」。A、B、C 雖然都超過 12 個月先變現/結清，但因為喺 15 個月 operating cycle 之內，所以全部係 current。唯獨 D 嘅受限現金因為 24 個月內唔用得，直接唔符合 HKAS 1 para. 66(d) 嘅例外條件，所以要列 non current。 Rule Check: HKAS 1 paras. 66, 68, 69, 70 Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「15/14 個月 12 個月」就即刻判 non current 係最常見錯誤 — 一定要諗返 operating cycle。相反方向嘅伏位：受限現金（restricted cash）就算係「cash」，只要被限制使用超過 12 個月都唔可以列 current。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 1 paras. 40A–40B, when an entity makes a retrospective restatement that has a material effect on the information in the statement of financial position at the beginning of the preceding period, it must present three statements of financial position: at the end of the current period (31 December 20X9), at the end of the preceding period (31 December 20X8), and at the beginning of the preceding period (1 January 20X8). Under para. 40C, related notes are NOT required for the third statement of financial position (1 January 20X8). HKAS 8 disclosures about the correction of the error are additionally required. 解題思路（繁中）: 三步判斷：(1) 有冇觸發事件？有 — retrospective restatement of a material prior period error；(2) 對期初 SOFP 有冇 material effect？有（題目講明）；(3) 所以三份 SOFP 嘅日期 = 本期期末、上期期末、上期期初，即 31/12/20X9、31/12/20X8、1/1/20X8。Option A 錯喺「notes required for all three」— HKAS 1 para. 40C 明確話最早嗰份唔使附 notes。Option B 漏咗第三份 SOFP。Option D 日期組合亂嚟（1/1/20X9 唔係規定嘅日期）。 Rule Check: HKAS 1 paras. 40A, 40B, 40C Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大伏位：(i) 記錯日期 — 「beginning of the preceding period」= 上期期初（1 Jan 20X8），唔係本期期初；(ii) 以為三份 SOFP 全部要附 notes — 其實只有最早嗰份豁免。同埋要記住觸發條件必須有 material effect，冇重大影響就唔使出第三份。 Q4 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Total comprehensive income = profit or loss + other comprehensive income (net of tax). Profit for the year: HK$800,000 OCI — gain on revaluation of building (never reclassified to P&L): HK$200,000 gross; less deferred tax HK$200,000 × 16.5% = HK$33,000; net of tax = HK$167,000 Total comprehensive income = 800,000 + 167,000 = HK$967,000 Workings for the deferred tax (journal entry form): Dr Revaluation surplus (equity) 33,000 / Cr Deferred tax liability 33,000 Dividends declared (HK$120,000) and the share issue (HK$300,000) are transactions with owners in their capacity as owners — they are reported in the statement of changes in equity and are EXCLUDED from total comprehensive income. 解題思路（繁中）: Total comprehensive income 嘅定義係「期內 equity 嘅變動，撇除與擁有人（以其擁有人身份）嘅交易」。逐步拆：profit 800,000 照計；重估增值屬 OCI（will not be reclassified 類別），要扣 16.5% deferred tax → 200,000 × (1 − 0.165) = 167,000。Option A (1,000,000) 係唔記得扣稅；Option B (847,000) 係錯誤將股息 120,000 當 expense 扣減 — 股息係 distribution to owners，只入 SOCIE，唔入 SPLOCI；Option D (1,267,000) 係錯誤將發股 300,000 加埋入嚟 — 發股都係 owner transaction，唔影響 TCI。 Rule Check: HKAS 1 paras. 7, 81A, 106; HKAS 16 para. 39; HKAS 12 (deferred tax on revaluation) Common Trap（繁中）: 最大陷阱係將 dividends 同 share issues 混入 comprehensive income — 呢兩樣永遠屬於 SOCIE 嘅「transactions with owners」部分。其次係 OCI 嘅稅務影響：HKAS 1 para. 90 要求披露每項 OCI 相關所得稅，重估增值要 net of tax 先入到 TCI。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Statement B is NOT correct. Under HKAS 1 para. 96, reclassification adjustments do NOT arise on changes in a revaluation surplus. A revaluation increase on property, plant and equipment is recognised in OCI and accumulated in equity as a revaluation surplus (HKAS 16 para. 39); it is NOT reclassified (recycled) to profit or loss in subsequent periods. When the asset is derecognised, the surplus may be transferred directly within equity (e.g. to retained earnings), not through profit or loss. Statements A, C and D are correct: OCI items are grouped by whether they may be reclassified subsequently to profit or loss (para. 82A); income tax relating to each OCI item must be disclosed in the statement or in the notes (para. 90); and OCI items may be presented net of tax or before tax with a single aggregate tax amount (para. 91). 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 NOT question，要搵出邊句 唔啱 。B 句嘅錯誤核心係「recycled to profit or loss」— revaluation surplus 係教科書級嘅「永不 recycle」項目，資產出售時只可以喺 equity 內部直接轉撥（例如轉去 retained earnings），唔經 P&L。A 對應 HKAS 1 para. 82A 嘅兩大分組（will not be reclassified vs may be reclassified）；C 對應 para. 90 嘅稅項披露要求；D 對應 para. 91 嘅 net of tax 或 before tax 選擇。呢三句都係標準原文嘅正確表述。 Rule Check: HKAS 1 paras. 82A, 90, 91, 92, 96; HKAS 16 para. 39 Common Trap（繁中）: 考生最容易混淆「reclassification adjustments（recycling）」嘅適用範圍 — 記住口訣：「revaluation surplus 永不回收」。另外留意 double counting 概念：recycling 嘅目的係避免同一 gain 計兩次入 comprehensive income，而 revaluation surplus 因為根本唔入 P&L，所以唔存在呢個問題。

title: M6 Chapter 20: Financial Statements Introduction — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 20: Financial Statements Introduction — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 20: Financial Statements Introduction — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Ques…
text: M6 Chapter 20: Financial Statements Introduction — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Mantis Limited is preparing its first annual general purpose financial statements in accordance with HKFRSs for the year ended 31 December 20X9. According to HKAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, which of the following is NOT a component of a complete set of financial statements? A. A statement of changes in equity for the period B. A statement of directors' remuneration for the period C. Notes, comprising material accounting policy information and other explanatory information D. Comparative information in respect of the preceding period Question 2 Harbour View Limited is a property developer with a normal operating cycle of 15 months. Its reporting period ended on 31 December 20X9. In accordance with HKAS 1, which of the following items should be classified as NON CURRENT in its statement of financial position as at 31 December 20X9? A. Inventories of properties under development that are expected to be sold within the company's 15 month operating cycle B. Trade receivables expected to be realised within the company's 15 month operating cycle C. Trade payables due to be settled in 14 months as part of the company's normal operating cycle D. A cash deposit that is restricted from being exchanged or used to settle liabilities for 24 months after the reporting period Question 3 During 20X9, Falcon Limited discovered a material error: plant purchased in 20X7 had been incorrectly recorded as repairs expense. The error is corrected by retrospective restatement in its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X9, and the restatement has a material effect on the information in the statement of financial position at the beginning of the preceding period. In accordance with HKAS 1, which statements of financial position must Falcon Limited present in its 20X9 financial statements? A. 31 December 20X9, 31 December 20X8 and 1 January 20X8, with related notes required for all three statements B. 31 December 20X9 and 31 December 20X8 only, because the error relates to an earlier period C. 31 December 20X9, 31 December 20X8 and 1 January 20X8, with related notes not required for the statement as at 1 January 20X8 D. 31 December 20X9, 1 January 20X9 and 1 January 20X8, with related notes required for all three statements Question 4 Egret Limited reported a profit for the year ended 31 December 20X9 of HK$800,000. During the year, the company revalued a building upwards by HK$200,000 (the building had never been revalued before). The income tax rate is 16.5% and a deferred tax liability arises on the revaluation gain. The company also declared ordinary dividends of HK$120,000 and issued new shares for cash of HK$300,000 during the year. In accordance with HKAS 1, what is Egret Limited's TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE INCOME for the year ended 31 December 20X9? A. HK$1,000,000 B. HK$847,000 C. HK$967,000 D. HK$1,267,000 Question 5 In accordance with HKAS 1, which of the following statements about the presentation of other comprehensive income (OCI) is NOT correct? A. Items of OCI must be grouped into those that will not be reclassified subsequently to profit or loss and those that may be reclassified subsequently to profit or loss when specific conditions are met B. Reclassification adjustments arise on changes in the revaluation surplus of property, plant and equipment, so the surplus is recycled to profit or loss when the related asset is derecognised C. The amount of income tax relating to each item of OCI must be disclosed either in the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income or in the notes D. Items of OCI may be presented either net of related tax effects or before related tax effects with one aggregate amount shown for the related income tax

title: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Recognition / Scope — 點解要有 Statement of Cash Flows
B. Measurement / Computation rules（逐條公式背）
D. Key journal entries（Dr/Cr 必須平衡）
excerpt: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the difference between operating, investing and fin…
text: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the difference between operating, investing and financing activities in accordance with HKAS 7. 2. Describe the components of cash and cash equivalents and apply the definitions to classify items. 3. Calculate cash flows from operating activities under both the direct method and the indirect method. 4. Calculate cash flows relating to investing and financing activities (including disposals, acquisitions, borrowings and dividends). 5. Prepare a complete statement of cash flows for a single entity, including the required note disclosures for non cash transactions. 必背考點 A. Recognition / Scope — 點解要有 Statement of Cash Flows HKAS 1.10 : The statement of cash flows is a required component of a complete set of financial statements . 現金流量表係法定完整財報一部分，唔可以唔交。 HKAS 7 (objective) : requires information about the historical changes in cash and cash equivalents , classified into operating, investing and financing activities . 考試伏位：佢係用 cash basis ，其他財報用 accrual basis — accrual accounting choices (e.g. depreciation methods) 會 mask 咗賺錢能力，SCF 就係拆穿呢樣嘢。 HKAS 7.6 — definitions（必背原文） : Cash comprises cash on hand and demand deposits . Cash equivalents are short term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and subject to an insignificant risk of changes in value . 白話：要「隨時攞到」+「金額肯定」+「價值唔會大上大落」。Listed shares、gold bullion、high return money market fund 全部 唔係 （price volatility = significant risk of value change）；3 month government bond / treasury bills / commercial papers / deposits at call 先係。 HKAS 7.6 — three categories : Operating activities — the principal revenue producing activities of the entity and other activities that are not investing or financing. Investing activities — acquisition and disposal of long term assets and other investments not included in cash equivalents (examples: HKAS 7.16). Financing activities — activities that result in changes in the size and composition of the contributed equity and borrowings . 記憶法：Operating = 做生意本業；Investing = 長期資產/投資買賣；Financing = 股本+借貸變動（含 lease liability principal repayment）。 B. Measurement / Computation rules（逐條公式背） Direct method (HKAS 7.18–7.19) — disclose major classes of gross cash receipts and payments: Cash receipts from customers = Net sales + Opening AR − Closing AR (adjusted for bad debt write offs — add back write offs to closing AR) Cash payments to suppliers = Net purchases + Opening AP − Closing AP，其中 Net purchases = COGS + Closing inventory − Opening inventory Cash payments to employees = Wages expense + Opening wages payable − Closing wages payable HKAS 7.19: both methods permitted , but the direct method is encouraged （考試鍾意出「required / mandatory」做錯誤選項）。 Indirect method (HKAS 7.18) — start from profit before tax , adjust for: Add back non cash expenses (depreciation, amortisation) Add back losses / deduct gains from non operating activities (e.g. disposal of PPE — the cash proceeds go to investing, so the gain/loss must be stripped out of operating) Decrease in current operating assets → add; Increase → deduct （receivables, inventory, prepayments） Increase in current operating liabilities → add; Decrease → deduct （payables, wages payable） ⚠️ Interest payable and tax payable 唔計入 working capital 調整 — interest expense 同 interest paid、tax expense 同 tax paid 分開處理： Indirect method: profit before tax add back interest expense ，之後喺「Cash generated from operations」下面 separate line 扣 interest paid 同 income tax paid （LP Apply & Analyse 2 / 3 格式）。 Cash paid for interest = Interest expense + Opening interest payable − Closing interest payable Cash paid for income taxes = Income tax expense + Opening income tax payable − Closing income tax payable（有 deferred tax 時要先拆出 current tax portion，見 LP Illustrative Example 8） 兩個 method 計出嚟嘅 net operating cash flow 一定相同 （LP: HK$716,350 兩邊一樣）。 Investing (HKAS 7.16) : Cash receipts from disposal of NCAs = NBV of disposed NCAs +/− Gains/(Losses) on disposal + Opening related receivable − Closing related receivable Cash payments for acquisition of NCAs = Closing NCA − Opening NCA (net of cost of disposals) − NCA acquired through non cash transactions + Opening related payable − Closing related payable − Revaluation increases 伏位： revaluation increase 同 share for asset acquisition 係 non cash，要剔除 ；lessee 嘅 new lease（ROU asset）亦係 non cash。 Financing : Increase in share capital / borrowings accounts → cash inflow；decrease → repayment outflow； interest accretion 係 non cash （要喺 reconciliation 剔返出嚟）。 Cash paid for dividends = Opening RE +/− Net profit/(loss) − Closing RE + Opening dividends payable − Closing dividends payable − Non cash dividends (e.g. dividend reinvestment plan) Lessee: cash payments for the reduction of the outstanding lease liability = financing activities （LP Exam Practice Q2；唔係 free choice）。 C. Disclosure requirements HKAS 7.31 : Cash flows from interest and dividends received and paid shall each be disclosed separately , and classified consistently from period to period . HKAS 7.33–7.34 — classification flexibility（非金融機構） : Item Allowed classification Interest paid Operating or Financing Interest received Operating or Investing Dividends paid Operating or Financing Dividends received Operating or Investing （Financial institutions: interest paid/received & dividends received 通常全部歸 operating。） HKAS 7.35 : Income tax cash flows → operating activities , unless specifically identifiable with financing/investing activities; separately disclosed . HKAS 7.43 : Investing and financing transactions that do not require the use of cash (e.g. acquiring assets via a lease, acquiring an entity by issuing shares, debt to equity conversion) are excluded from the statement of cash flows , but relevant information must be disclosed elsewhere (notes) （HKAS 7.44 相關披露）。 D. Key journal entries（Dr/Cr 必須平衡） 1. Cash purchase of PPE (investing outflow) : Dr Property, Plant and Equipment 500,000 / Cr Cash 500,000 2. Disposal of equipment at a loss (cost 500,000; accumulated depreciation 320,000; cash proceeds 150,000 → loss 30,000): Dr Cash 150,000; Dr Accumulated Depreciation 320,000; Dr Loss on Disposal (P&L) 30,000 / Cr Equipment 500,000 SCF 影響：investing inflow = cash proceeds HK$150,000 （唔係 NBV 180,000）；indirect method 要 add back loss 30,000。 3. Dividend declared then paid : On declaration: Dr Retained Earnings 200,000 / Cr Dividends Payable 200,000（ no cash flow yet ） On payment: Dr Dividends Payable 200,000 / Cr Cash 200,000（financing 或 operating outflow，視乎 policy） 4. Issue of shares for cash (financing inflow) : Dr Cash 800,000 / Cr Share Capital 800,000 易混淆概念對比 Table 1 — Direct Method vs Indirect Method (HKAS 7.18–7.19) 項目 Direct method Indirect method Presentation Major classes of gross cash receipts and payments (e.g. receipts from customers, payments to suppliers) Starts from profit before tax , adjusted for non cash items, non operating gains/losses, working capital changes Information shown 逐條實收實付 Reconciliation between profit 同 operating cash flow HKAS 7 態度 Encouraged （HKAS 7.19，資訊更有用）but not mandatory Permitted alternative Net operating cash flow 結果 兩者 一定相同 兩者 一定相同 考試伏位 記得 AR 要 adjust for bad debt write offs；purchases 要由 COGS + Δinventory 推返 Interest/tax payable 唔係 working capital 調整；gain on disposal 係 deduct （唔係 add back）；FVTPL fair value changes 係 non cash（Jun 2025 panel 報告考生常錯） Table 2 — Cash and Cash Equivalents vs 似是而非項目 (HKAS 7.6) Item Cash / Cash equivalent? 點樣分辨（繁中） Cash on hand / demand deposits / deposits at call ✅ Cash 隨時攞得，無價值變動風險 3 month treasury bills / short term government bonds / commercial papers ✅ Cash equivalent Short term + highly liquid + insignificant risk of value change Listed equity shares ❌ 易賣 ≠ cash equivalent；股價波動 = significant risk of value change Gold bullion / high return money market fund ❌ 市場活躍但價格大幅波動 Trade receivables / long term bond investments ❌ 唔係 readily convertible to known amounts / 唔 short term 考試伏位 — 「Highly liquid」單獨一個條件 唔足夠 ；必須同時滿足 short term、convertible to known amounts、insignificant risk 三個條件 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: According to HKAS 7.6, how are "cash" and "cash equivalents" defined? Back: Cash = cash on hand + demand deposits Cash equivalents = short term, highly liquid investments, readily convertible to known amounts of cash, subject to an insignificant risk of changes in value 💬 白話解釋：Cash 就係手頭現金同活期存款；cash equivalents 係嗰啲短期、隨時變返已知金額、價值又唔會大上大落嘅投資，例如 3 個月國庫券。記住三個條件要 同時 成立。 Card 2 Front: How does HKAS 7.6 define the three categories of cash flows in a statement of cash flows? Back: Operating activities — principal revenue producing activities + anything not investing/financing Investing activities — acquisition/disposal of long term assets and other investments not included in cash equivalents Financing activities — changes in size and composition of contributed equity and borrowings 💬 白話解釋：做生意本業收付 = operating；買賣固定資產同投資 = investing；發股、借錢、還債 = financing。分類睇 來源 ，唔係淨睇流入定流出。 Card 3 Front: What is the difference between the direct method and the indirect method under HKAS 7.18–7.19, and which does the standard encourage? Back: Direct method: discloses major classes of gross cash receipts and payments (e.g. cash received from customers) Indirect method: adjusts profit or loss for non cash transactions, deferrals/accruals, and items of income/expense associated with investing or financing cash flows Both permitted; direct method is encouraged (HKAS 7.19); net operating cash flow is identical under both 💬 白話解釋：Direct 係「流水賬」逐條列實收實付；indirect 係由利潤「還原」返做現金。考試陷阱：encouraged ≠ required，兩個方法答案一樣。 Card 4 Front: Under the indirect method, what are the four types of adjustments made to profit before tax? Back: Add back non cash expenses (e.g. depreciation, amortisation) Add back losses / deduct gains from non operating activities (e.g. disposal of PPE) Decrease in current operating assets → add; increase → deduct Increase in current operating liabilities → add; decrease → deduct (Interest payable and tax payable are NOT working capital adjustments — dealt with separately) 💬 白話解釋：口訣「非現金開支加返、非經營盈虧反轉、資產同現金反向、負債同現金同向」。Interest payable 同 tax payable 留返喺後面 separate lines 處理。 Card 5 Front: How may interest paid, interest received, dividends paid and dividends received be classified under HKAS 7.31–7.34 (for non financial institutions)? Back: Interest paid: operating or financing Interest received: operating or investing Dividends paid: operating or financing Dividends received: operating or investing Each must be disclosed separately and classified consistently from period to period (HKAS 7.31) 💬 白話解釋：HKAS 7 喺利息同股息上有彈性，但兩大底線：分開披露、前後一致。Financial institutions 通常全部歸 operating。 Card 6 Front: How are income tax cash flows classified under HKAS 7.35, and how is cash paid for income taxes computed? Back: Classified as operating activities , separately disclosed, unless specifically identified with financing/investing activities Cash paid for income taxes = Income tax expense + Opening income tax payable − Closing income tax payable With deferred tax: strip deferred tax movement out of total tax expense first to get current tax 💬 白話解釋：稅預設歸 operating。有 deferred tax 嗰陣，total tax expense 入面嘅 deferred portion 係 non cash，要剔走先計到真係交咗幾多稅。 Card 7 Front: How are non cash investing and financing transactions treated under HKAS 7.43? Give three examples. Back: Excluded from the statement of cash flows Disclosed elsewhere in the financial statements (notes) Examples: acquisition of assets by entering into a lease; acquiring an entity/assets by issuing shares; conversion of debt to equity 💬 白話解釋：冇現金郁動就唔可以入 SCF，但係要喺 notes 話俾人知。考試常見：新租賃嘅 ROU asset、以股換資產，記住喺計 purchase of PPE 時要剔除。 Card 8 Front: State the formulas for (a) cash receipts from disposal of non current assets and (b) cash paid for dividends. Back: (a) Cash receipts from disposal = NBV of disposed NCAs +/− Gain/(Loss) on disposal + Opening related receivable − Closing related receivable (b) Cash paid for dividends = Opening retained earnings +/− Net profit/(loss) − Closing retained earnings + Opening dividends payable − Closing dividends payable − Non cash dividends 💬 白話解釋：賣資產收幾多錢 = 賬面值加減盈虧，再調整未收到嘅 receivable；派息要先由 retained earnings 推返「宣派咗幾多」，再扣未付嘅 payable 同以股代息。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Statement of cash flows 現金流量表：講解期內現金及現金等價物點樣變動 The statement of cash flows classifies cash flows during the period into operating, investing and financing activities. Cash equivalents 現金等價物：短期、高流動性、價值變動風險極低嘅投資 A three month treasury bill qualifies as a cash equivalent under HKAS 7.6. Operating activities 經營活動：公司本業嘅創收活動 Cash received from customers is classified as a cash flow from operating activities. Investing activities 投資活動：買賣長期資產同其他投資 Cash paid to purchase property, plant and equipment is an investing cash outflow. Financing activities 融資活動：改變股本同借貸規模嘅活動 Proceeds from the issue of shares are presented as cash flows from financing activities. Direct method 直接法：逐項列出大額現金收入同支出 Under the direct method, major classes of gross cash receipts and payments are disclosed. Indirect method 間接法：由稅前利潤調整返去經營現金流 Under the indirect method, depreciation is added back to profit before tax because it is a non cash expense. Non cash transactions 非現金交易：唔涉及現金，唔入 SCF 但要喺附註披露 Acquiring equipment by issuing shares is a non cash transaction excluded from the statement of cash flows under HKAS 7.43.

title: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 7.6, cash comprises cash on hand and demand deposits, and …
text: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 7.6, cash comprises cash on hand and demand deposits, and cash equivalents are short term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and which are subject to an insignificant risk of changes in value. Listed ordinary shares, even in a liquid market, are subject to price volatility amounting to a significant risk of changes in value, so they do NOT qualify. 解題思路（繁中）: A（petty cash）同 B（demand deposit）直接落入 "cash" 定義；C 嘅 3 個月 treasury bill 係 textbook cash equivalent（short term + highly liquid + insignificant risk）。D 嘅上市股票雖然好易賣，但股價波動代表 significant risk of value change — 「highly liquid」單一條件唔足夠。三個條件必須同時成立。 Rule Check: HKAS 7.6 Common Trap（繁中）: 以為「易變現 = cash equivalent」。LP Apply & Analyse 1 明確指出 listed shares 同 high return money market fund 都因為價格波動而 唔算 。考試揀 NOT 題時記得逐個選項用三條件測試。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Statement B is NOT correct. HKAS 7.18 permits BOTH the direct and indirect methods for presenting cash flows from operating activities; HKAS 7.19 merely encourages the direct method because it provides more useful information — it is not required. Statements A (HKAS 7.43: non cash transactions excluded but disclosed in notes), C (lessee's payments to reduce the lease liability are financing cash flows) and D (HKAS 7.31/7.33: interest paid may be operating or financing, separately disclosed and consistent) are all correct. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 NOT question，要搵出 錯 嗰句。B 嘅伏位係將 "encouraged" 偷換做 "required" — LP 原文：「both methods are permitted by HKAS 7... the use of the direct method is encouraged」。C 係 LP Exam Practice Q2 嘅考点：lessee 償還 lease liability 本金部分 冇得揀 ，係 financing。D 考 HKAS 7.31 嘅 separately disclosed + consistent 要求。 Rule Check: HKAS 7.18, 7.19, 7.31, 7.33, 7.43 Common Trap（繁中）: 見到 "encouraged" 字眼就當咗 mandatory；同埋以為 lessee 嘅租賃付款可以好似 interest paid 咁自由分類 — lease liability reduction 係指定 financing。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Net purchases = COGS + Closing inventory − Opening inventory = 640,000 + 120,000 − 96,000 = HK$664,000 Cash payments to suppliers = Net purchases + Opening accounts payable − Closing accounts payable = 664,000 + 58,000 − 46,000 = HK$676,000 解題思路（繁中）: 兩步計算：先由 COGS 同存貨變動推返 purchases（存貨升咗 24,000，代表買多咗貨，所以要加）；再用應付賬款變動推實付現金（AP 跌咗 12,000，代表找咗舊數，所以加多 12,000）。B (664,000) 係唔記得調整 AP；D (652,000) 係 AP 調相反轉（減 opening 加 closing）；A (616,000) 係存貨調相反轉（640,000 + 96,000 − 120,000）。 Rule Check: HKAS 7.18 (direct method); LP Section 21.3.1 computation rules Common Trap（繁中）: 方向感：存貨/應收等 資產 增加 = 現金流出（扣）；應付等 負債 減少 = 現金流出（加返 opening − closing 時已內置）。考試先寫低公式再代數。 Q4 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): HK$ Profit before tax 850,000 Add: Depreciation expense (non cash) 120,000 Add: Interest expense (accrual, presented separately) 34,000 Less: Gain on disposal of equipment (investing) (35,000) Less: Increase in trade receivables (48,000) Add: Decrease in inventory 22,000 Add: Increase in trade payables 15,000 Cash generated from operations 958,000 Less: Interest paid (30,000) Less: Income tax paid (95,000) Net cash flows from operating activities 833,000 解題思路（繁中）: 跟 LP Apply & Analyse 2/3 格式：interest expense 屬 accrual，先加返入 profit，然後喺 "Cash generated from operations" 下面用 實付 利息 (30,000) 同實付稅 (95,000) 做 separate lines。Gain on disposal 係 investing 項目，要 扣 走。A (863,000) 漏扣 interest paid (958,000 − 95,000)；B (903,000) 將 gain 加返而唔係扣（誤差 70,000）；C (799,000) 冇加返 interest expense（淨計實付利息，變相少加 34,000）。 Rule Check: HKAS 7.18, 7.31, 7.33, 7.35 Common Trap（繁中）: Jun 2025 panel 報告話考生喺呢啲位最弱：gain/loss on disposal 方向調錯、interest 加減錯。記住： expense → add back，cash paid → separate deduction ；兩個金額通常唔同（因為 interest payable 有變動）。 Q5 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Carrying amount of machine = 500,000 − 320,000 = HK$180,000 Cash proceeds HK$150,000 < carrying amount → Loss on disposal = 180,000 − 150,000 = HK$30,000 Journal entry: Dr Cash 150,000; Dr Accumulated Depreciation 320,000; Dr Loss on Disposal (P&L) 30,000; Cr Machine (cost) 500,000 (Dr total = Cr total = HK$500,000) SCF impact: investing cash inflow = HK$150,000 (actual cash proceeds); under the indirect method the HK$30,000 loss is added back to profit before tax. 解題思路（繁中）: 處置固定資產三步：沖銷成本、沖銷累計折舊、差額落 gain/loss。B 嘅錯係當 proceeds = carrying amount (180,000)，完全忽略咗 30,000 虧損；C 係亂谷 accumulated depreciation (350,000) 去迫平條數；D 係新派嘅「net off」寫法，冇 derecognise 成本同累計折舊，違反 HKAS 16 嘅 derecognition 處理。 Rule Check: HKAS 16 (derecognition of PPE); HKAS 7.16 (investing activities) Common Trap（繁中）: 考試見到 disposal 記住 SCF 入面 investing inflow 係 實收現金 150,000 ，唔係 NBV 180,000；而 P&L 嘅 loss 30,000 喺 indirect method 要 add back — 兩件事唔好撈亂。

text: M6 Chapter 21: Statement of Cash Flows — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Silver Crane Limited holds the following items at its year end. In accordance with HKAS 7, which of the following would NOT qualify as cash or a cash equivalent in the statement of cash flows? A. Coins and bank notes held in the company's petty cash box B. A deposit placed with a bank that is repayable on demand C. A three month treasury bill acquired two months before the year end D. Ordinary shares of a company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, held in a highly liquid market Question 2 Cedar Limited is preparing its statement of cash flows in accordance with HKAS 7. Which of the following statements is NOT correct? A. Acquiring a machine by issuing the company's own shares is a non cash transaction excluded from the statement of cash flows, but must be disclosed elsewhere in the financial statements. B. HKAS 7 requires all entities to use the direct method when presenting cash flows from operating activities. C. Cash payments by Cedar Limited, as a lessee, for the reduction of the outstanding liability relating to a lease are classified as cash flows from financing activities. D. Interest paid may be classified as either an operating or a financing cash flow, provided it is disclosed separately and classified consistently from period to period. Question 3 Harbour Textiles Limited provides the following information for the year ended 31 December 20X8: HK$ Cost of goods sold 640,000 Inventory — 1 January 20X8 96,000 Inventory — 31 December 20X8 120,000 Accounts payable — 1 January 20X8 58,000 Accounts payable — 31 December 20X8 46,000 Using the direct method, what is the amount of cash payments to suppliers for the year ended 31 December 20X8? A. HK$616,000 B. HK$664,000 C. HK$676,000 D. HK$652,000 Question 4 Jade Garden Limited uses the indirect method to present cash flows from operating activities and classifies interest paid as an operating cash flow. Information for the year ended 30 June 20X9: HK$ Profit before tax 850,000 Depreciation expense 120,000 Gain on disposal of equipment 35,000 Interest expense 34,000 Increase in trade receivables 48,000 Decrease in inventory 22,000 Increase in trade payables 15,000 Interest paid during the year 30,000 Income tax paid during the year 95,000 What is the net cash flows from operating activities for the year ended 30 June 20X9? A. HK$863,000 B. HK$903,000 C. HK$799,000 D. HK$833,000 Question 5 On 30 September 20X8, Maple Kitchenware Limited sold a machine with an original cost of HK$500,000 and accumulated depreciation of HK$320,000 for cash proceeds of HK$150,000. In accordance with HKAS 16, which journal entry correctly records this disposal? A. Dr Cash 150,000; Dr Accumulated Depreciation 320,000; Dr Loss on Disposal 30,000; Cr Machine (cost) 500,000 B. Dr Cash 180,000; Dr Accumulated Depreciation 320,000; Cr Machine (cost) 500,000 C. Dr Cash 150,000; Dr Accumulated Depreciation 350,000; Cr Machine (cost) 500,000 D. Dr Cash 150,000; Dr Loss on Disposal 30,000; Cr Machine (carrying amount) 180,000
