text: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define a business combination and explain the three components of control (power; exposure to variable returns; ability to use power to affect returns) in accordance with HKFRS 3 (Revised) and HKFRS 10. 2. Apply the acquisition method: identify the acquirer, determine the acquisition date, and measure the consideration transferred (including deferred and contingent consideration) at acquisition date fair value. 3. Account for acquisition related costs, distinguishing them from consideration transferred and from debt/equity issue costs under HKFRS 9 / HKAS 32. 4. Recognise and measure identifiable assets acquired, liabilities assumed (including contingent liabilities) and any non controlling interest (NCI), applying the recognition and measurement exceptions. 5. Calculate goodwill or gain from a bargain purchase under both the partial goodwill and full goodwill NCI measurement options. 必背考點 A. Recognition 認確認知 1. Is it a business combination at all?（判斷入口） Business combination = a transaction or other event in which an acquirer obtains control of one or more businesses — HKFRS 3(R) App A. 兩大條件缺一不可：(i) a business must be acquired; (ii) the acquirer must control the business after the acquisition. A business = an integrated set of activities and assets with at least an input and a substantive process that together significantly contribute to the ability to create outputs — HKFRS 3(R) App A, B7, B8, B12A. Outputs 並非必要（HKFRS 3(R).B9）。 Substantive process = not minor or ancillary; an organised workforce performing a critical function 係 indicator — HKFRS 3(R).B12D。Back office systems (accounting, billing, payroll) 一般唔算 substantive process（HKFRS 3(R).B11）。 Control 三要素（全部同時存在）— HKFRS 3(R).7, B13; HKFRS 10.6–7: 1. Power over the investee (existing rights giving the current ability to direct relevant activities ); 2. Exposure, or rights, to variable returns from involvement; 3. Ability to use power to affect the amount of returns. Rights 必須係 substantive （currently exercisable、能 benefit 持有人），唔係 merely protective — HKFRS 10.B22–B24。Deeply out of the money options 唔算 substantive（LP Knowledge Check Q3）。 De facto control ：持股 <50% 都可以有 power，如果其餘股權分散、唔會集結投票 — HKFRS 10.B38–B46。 2. Recognition principle at acquisition date — HKFRS 3(R).10, 12: Acquirer 須 separately from goodwill 確認：all identifiable assets acquired、liabilities assumed、any NCI。 條件：項目須 meet the definition of an asset/liability at acquisition date，且係 business combination 嘅一部分（唔係 separate transaction，例如報酬員工未來服務嘅安排 — HKFRS 3(R).52）。 收購後可能確認 acquiree 從未確認 嘅 intangible assets（如 internally developed brands、customer lists），只要 identifiable： Contractual legal criterion 或 separability criterion （capable of being separated and sold/transferred/licensed/rented/exchanged）— HKFRS 3(R).B31–B34; HKAS 38.12。 不考慮 acquirer 是否有意出售（intention irrelevant），只看是否 capable — HKFRS 3(R).B33。 Assembled workforce 永遠唔可以單獨確認 （無 control、無 contractual/legal right、唔 separable）→ 價值 subsumed into goodwill — HKFRS 3(R).B37–B38。 3. Recognition exceptions （LP 要求掌握嘅三個）— Exhibit 22.4: Exception HKFRS 3 (Revised) requirement Ref Contingent liabilities Acquiree 按 HKAS 37 唔確認，但 acquirer 須確認若屬 present obligation arising from past events 且 FV reliably measurable，以 acquisition date FV 計量（possible obligation 則不確認） HKFRS 3(R).22–23 Leases (acquiree as lessee) 按 HKFRS 16 確認 lease liability（= PV of remaining lease payments as if a new lease）及 right of use asset（同額，± favourable/unfavourable terms 調整） HKFRS 3(R).28A–28B NCA / disposal groups held for sale 按 HKFRS 5 計量 HKFRS 3(R).31 B. Measurement 計量 Acquisition method 五步驟 — HKFRS 3(R).5: 1. Identify the acquirer（付現/發股/促成合併、規模較大一方通常係 acquirer — HKFRS 3(R).6, B14–B17）； 2. Determine the acquisition date = date acquirer obtains control （一般係 closing date，可早可遲於 closing，睇 facts）— HKFRS 3(R).8–9； 3. Determine the consideration transferred ； 4. Recognise & measure identifiable assets/liabilities/NCI； 5. Recognise & measure goodwill or gain on bargain purchase 。 Consideration transferred — HKFRS 3(R).37（sum of acquisition date fair values of）: assets transferred by the acquirer; liabilities incurred by the acquirer to former owners; equity interests issued by the acquirer。 Share consideration ：以 acquisition date 嘅 fair value（上市股=當日報價），無論股份幾時發行 — HKFRS 3(R).37。若 acquirer 非上市而 acquiree 上市，可用 acquiree 股價計量（HKFRS 3(R).B14 方向，LP §22.3.3.1）。 Deferred consideration ：以 acquisition date FV（即折現值）計量； unwinding of discount = finance cost in P&L (HKFRS 9)，唔屬於 business combination 。 Contingent consideration （如 earn out）：以 acquisition date estimated fair value 計入 consideration — HKFRS 3(R).39。 日後 contingency 落實後，差額唔會回頭調整 goodwill （settlement difference 唔屬 business combination accounting）。 Acquisition related costs （finder's fees、due diligence、legal、valuation、internal acquisition department 成本）： expensed as incurred，唔入 consideration、唔入 goodwill、唔入 parent's separate FS 嘅 investment cost — HKFRS 3(R).59。例外： debt/equity issue costs 按 HKFRS 9 / HKAS 32 處理（share issue costs = deduction from equity，e.g. against share capital/share premium）。 Identifiable assets & liabilities ：以 acquisition date fair values 計量 — HKFRS 3(R).18（HKFRS 13 定 FV）。FV uplift on PPE、unrecognised intangibles、contingent liabilities 全部要計入 identifiable net assets。 NCI measurement options — HKFRS 3(R).19（ acquisition by acquisition basis 逐單選擇）: Fair value（full goodwill method） ；或 Proportionate share of the acquiree's identifiable net assets（partial goodwill method） 。 NCI at FV ≠ 股數 × 股價，亦 ≠ proportionate share of net assets（可能含 lack of control discount）— HKFRS 3(R).B44–B45。 Goodwill — HKFRS 3(R).32: Goodwill = residual asset，代表未單獨識別資產（synergies、assembled workforce、potential new contracts）嘅未來經濟利益 — HKFRS 3(R) App A。 Gain on bargain purchase — HKFRS 3(R).34–36: 當 identifiable net assets consideration + NCI 時， 先 reassess ：(1) 是否已識別晒所有 assets/liabilities；(2) 計量是否反映 acquisition date 所有可得資料； 確認無誤後， gain 即時計入 profit or loss（acquisition date），歸屬 acquirer 。 C. Disclosure / Reporting requirements 披露與報告 Business combination 以 equity instruments 達成 → 形成 parent–subsidiary group，parent 須編製 consolidated financial statements （assets/liabilities/equity/income/expenses/cash flows 以 single economic entity 呈列）— Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) s.379(2) ；HKFRS 10.4, App A。 以 net assets acquisition 達成 → 無 subsidiary，資產負債直接併入 acquirer 財報， 唔叫 consolidated FS 。 HKFRS 10 豁免：intermediate parent（符合條件）及 investment entity 可免編 consolidated FS（細節 out of scope）。 ⚠️ 本章 LP 未展開 HKFRS 3 嘅逐段 disclosure 清單（屬 Ch 23 consolidation 範圍），考試層面掌握上列「邊個要編 consolidated FS」即可。 D. Key Journal Entries（全部平衡） JE1 — Parent's separate books: acquisition of shares (cash + shares + contingent consideration) JE2 — Acquisition related costs（expensed） JE3 — Share issue costs（HKAS 32: deduction from equity） JE4 — Deferred consideration unwinding（HKFRS 9 finance cost） JE5 — Consolidation of identifiable net assets + goodwill（consolidation worksheet 概念） 如為 bargain purchase：唔借 goodwill，改為 Cr Gain on bargain purchase (P&L) 。 易混淆概念對比 表 1：Full goodwill method vs Partial goodwill method（HKFRS 3(R).19, 32） 項目 Full goodwill method Partial goodwill method NCI 計量 NCI at fair value NCI at proportionate share of identifiable net assets Goodwill 包含 Acquirer + NCI 雙方應佔 goodwill 只包含 acquirer 應佔 goodwill Goodwill 金額 較 高 較 低 （差額 = NCI 應佔 goodwill） 政策選擇 逐單收購選擇（acquisition by acquisition） 同左 點樣分辨（繁中） 題目畀「FV of NCI」或「NCI at fair value」就用呢招 題目講「proportionate share of net assets」就用呢招 考試伏位 用 NCI 股數 × 股價當 FV（錯：可能有 lack of control discount）；FV of NCI 唔係 net assets × NCI% 計 goodwill 時忘記加 NCI；或將 NCI% 用錯母公司持股比例（要用 100% − parent%） 表 2：Deferred consideration vs Contingent consideration 項目 Deferred consideration Contingent consideration 性質 金額 確定 ，只係 遲啲找數 金額 取決於未來事件 （earn out、業績目標） Acquisition date 計量 折現值 （PV at acquisition date） Estimated fair value （反映預期達成機率）— HKFRS 3(R).39 後續處理 Unwinding of discount → finance cost in P&L (HKFRS 9) ；唔影響 goodwill Contingency 落實後差額 唔調整 goodwill ；與 business combination 分開處理 點樣分辨（繁中） 題目寫「payable in 12/24 months」+ 畀 discount rate → deferred 題目寫「if revenue/earning target met…」+ 畀 fair value → contingent 考試伏位 用 face value 唔折現；或將 unwinding 當 acquisition cost 用最終實付金額取代 acquisition date FV 重計 goodwill（錯）；或將 FV 當成 expense Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Define "business combination" and state the two features a transaction must have to be one (HKFRS 3 (Revised)). Back: A transaction or other event in which an acquirer obtains control of one or more businesses (HKFRS 3(R) App A). Feature 1: a business must be acquired (at least an input + a substantive process capable of contributing to outputs). Feature 2: the acquirer must control the business after the acquisition. 💬 白話解釋：兩個條件要齊——買嘅嘢要係一盤「生意」（有 input + 實質 process），而且買完你要 控制 到佢。淨係買部機器或者買少少股份唔夠控制權，就唔係 business combination。 Card 2 Front: State the three components of control under HKFRS 10.6–7 / HKFRS 3(R).7. Back: 1. Power over the investee — existing rights giving the current ability to direct the relevant activities ; 2. Exposure, or rights, to variable returns from involvement with the investee; 3. The ability to use that power to affect the amount of the investor's returns. 💬 白話解釋：記「權、利、用權影響利」。三個要 同時 存在；仲要留意係 current ability，唔係 future；direct 嘅係 relevant activities ，唔係所有 operation。持股過半通常有 power，但唔係必要條件（de facto control）。 Card 3 Front: List the five steps of the acquisition method (HKFRS 3(R).5). Back: 1. Identify the acquirer ; 2. Determine the acquisition date (date control is obtained — HKFRS 3(R).8–9); 3. Determine the consideration transferred (acquisition date FV — HKFRS 3(R).37); 4. Recognise and measure identifiable assets acquired, liabilities assumed and any NCI (HKFRS 3(R).10, 18, 19); 5. Recognise and measure goodwill or a gain from a bargain purchase (HKFRS 3(R).32, 34–36). 💬 白話解釋：口訣「人、日、價、產、誉」——邊個買、幾時控制、畀幾多、執到咩資產負債同 NCI、最後計 goodwill 定 bargain purchase gain。每一步都有對應段數，答題時逐步引。 Card 4 Front: How is share consideration measured, and which date's share price is used (HKFRS 3(R).37)? Back: Shares issued by the acquirer are measured at fair value on the acquisition date , regardless of when the shares are actually issued. For listed shares, FV = quoted share price on the acquisition date (NOT the agreement/signing date, NOT the settlement date if control passed earlier/later). If the acquirer is unlisted but the acquiree is listed, use the acquisition date FV of the acquiree's shares. 💬 白話解釋：伏位之王！簽約日、交收日嘅股價都係陷阱， 唯有取得控制權嗰日 嘅股價先啱。記住 acquisition date = control passes 嘅日子。 Card 5 Front: How are acquisition related costs accounted for under HKFRS 3(R).59, and what is the exception? Back: Acquisition related costs (finder's fees, due diligence, legal, valuation, internal M&A department costs) are expensed in profit or loss as incurred . They are excluded from : consideration transferred, goodwill calculation, and the cost of investment in subsidiary in separate FS. Exception : costs of issuing debt or equity securities are dealt with under HKFRS 9 / HKAS 32 — share issue costs are a deduction from equity (e.g. against share premium). 💬 白話解釋：請律師、做 due diligence 嘅錢全部即時 expense，唔准加落收購成本度「扮大」goodwill。唯獨 發股/發債嘅發行費 例外——發股費用扣 equity，唔落 P&L，亦唔入 consideration。 Card 6 Front: State the two measurement options for non controlling interest at the acquisition date (HKFRS 3(R).19) and their effect on goodwill. Back: Option 1: Fair value → full goodwill method (goodwill includes NCI's share); Option 2: Proportionate share of the acquiree's identifiable net assets → partial goodwill method (only acquirer's goodwill recognised); Choice made on an acquisition by acquisition basis; FV of NCI may include a lack of control discount , so it need not equal share price × shares or NCI% × net assets (HKFRS 3(R).B44–B45). 💬 白話解釋：同一單收購，NCI 用 FV 計，goodwill 就大啲（full）；用 net assets 比例計，goodwill 就細啲（partial）。考試會指明用邊個，睇清楚先好落筆；題目冇講就唔好自己創第三個方法。 Card 7 Front: What must an acquirer do before recognising a gain on a bargain purchase, and where is the gain recognised (HKFRS 3(R).34–36)? Back: 1. Reassess whether all assets acquired and liabilities assumed have been correctly identified; 2. Review the measurement procedures to ensure amounts reflect all information available at the acquisition date; 3. Then recognise the resulting gain in profit or loss at the acquisition date , attributed to the acquirer. 💬 白話解釋：「執到平貨」唔可以即刻開心入賬——因為正常冇人會平賣，所以 HKFRS 3 強制你先 double check 有冇睇漏資產負債、估值有冇錯，確認真係平先可以將 gain 落 P&L。 永遠唔係 credit 去 equity 或者負 goodwill 。 Card 8 Front: Why can an assembled workforce never be recognised as a separate intangible asset in a business combination, and where does its value go? Back: Fails the definition of an asset: the acquirer usually has insufficient control over the future economic benefits (employees can leave); Fails the contractual legal criterion : the "workforce" as a unit does not arise from contractual or legal rights; Fails the separability criterion : it cannot be sold/transferred separately from the business; → Its value is subsumed into goodwill (HKFRS 3(R).B37–B38). 💬 白話解釋：員工會辭職，你控制唔實；「成個團隊」又唔係合約權利，亦拆唔散嚟賣。所以 workforce 永遠冇得單獨確認——佢嘅價值全部跌落 goodwill。對照：trademark、customer list 通常 separable，可以單獨確認。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Business combination 取得另一盤生意控制權嘅交易 "The acquisition is a business combination because the acquirer obtained control of a business." Substantive process 對產出成果關鍵、唔係閒角嘅流程 "The organised workforce performs a substantive process critical to creating outputs." Acquisition date 收購方取得控制權嗰一日 "The acquisition date is generally the closing date on which control passes to the acquirer." Consideration transferred 為換取被收購方而付出嘅總代價（收購日公允值） "The consideration transferred is measured at the sum of acquisition date fair values of cash, shares issued and contingent consideration." Contingent consideration 視乎未來條件先至要畀嘅額外代價 "The earn out is contingent consideration measured at its acquisition date fair value." Non controlling interest (NCI) 子公司入面唔屬於母公司嘅股權 "The NCI is measured either at fair value or at its proportionate share of the acquiree's identifiable net assets." Goodwill 畀多咗嗰浸溢價，代表協同效應等未單獨識別嘅價值 "Goodwill is the excess of consideration transferred plus NCI over the fair value of identifiable net assets acquired." Gain on bargain purchase 執平貨收益——淨資產公允值高過付出代價 "After reassessing the identification and measurement of net assets, the acquirer recognises the gain on bargain purchase in profit or loss."

title: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): A business combination requires that (i) a business is acquired and (ii…
text: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): A business combination requires that (i) a business is acquired and (ii) the acquirer obtains control of it. A business is an integrated set of activities and assets comprising at least an input and a substantive process that together significantly contribute to the ability to create outputs. In C, Heron acquires the bakery's net assets (inputs) together with a trained workforce performing production processes critical to creating outputs (a substantive process), and by acquiring all net assets it controls the business — this is a business combination effected by acquiring underlying net assets. 解題思路（繁中）: A 錯：一架貨車只係單一資產，唔係「integrated set of activities and assets」，屬資產購置（HKAS 16 範圍）。 B 錯：新註冊空殼公司冇 input、冇 process、冇 output，唔具備 substantive process，所以唔係 business（LP Knowledge Check Q2(d) 同款邏輯）。 D 錯：25% 持股只得 significant influence（HKAS 28 associate）， 冇 control ，所以唔係 business combination。 C 啱：inputs（設備、舖位）+ substantive process（熟練烘焙團隊嘅生產流程）+ 控制權，三樣齊。 考試伏位：「有 workforce」係 substantive process 嘅 indicator，但要睇佢係咪 critical to creating outputs ；back office 行政系統一般唔算。 Rule Check: HKFRS 3 (Revised) App A (definitions of "business combination" and "business"); HKFRS 3(R).B7, B8, B12A, B12D; HKFRS 3(R).7 (control requirement). Common Trap（繁中）: 以為「買公司 = 一定係 business combination」。其實要過兩關：買嘅係咪 business（空殼唔係），同埋有冇攞到 control（25% 冇）。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Legal fees (HK$90,000) are acquisition related costs expensed in profit or loss as incurred; share issue costs (HK$30,000) are a deduction from equity under HKAS 32. Neither forms part of the consideration transferred. 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵一： 股代價用 acquisition date（31 March，即 control passes 嗰日）股價 HK$16 ，唔係簽約日（1 March）嘅 HK$14。 關鍵二：contingent consideration 用 acquisition date fair value HK$350,000 ，唔係最高可能付嘅 HK$500,000。 關鍵三：legal fees 同 share issue costs 都係 acquisition related / issue costs ，一個落 P&L、一個扣 equity， 兩個都唔入 consideration 。 A 錯：用咗簽約日股價 HK$14（3,000,000 + 2,800,000 + 350,000）。 C 錯：將 legal fees 同 share issue costs 加埋入 consideration（6,550,000 + 90,000 + 30,000）。 D 錯：contingent consideration 用 full HK$500,000（3,000,000 + 3,200,000 + 500,000）。 Rule Check: HKFRS 3(R).37 (consideration at acquisition date fair values); HKFRS 3(R).39 (contingent consideration at acquisition date FV); HKFRS 3(R).59 (acquisition related costs expensed); HKAS 32 (share issue costs deducted from equity). Common Trap（繁中）: 三個日期（簽約、控制轉移、結算）擺埋一齊考你——鎖死「 control passes 嗰日 」嘅股價。另外見到「付咗啲 fees」就想加落代價，係最高頻失分位。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Although HKAS 37 prohibits the acquiree from recognising contingent liabilities, HKFRS 3 (Revised) contains a recognition exception : in a business combination, the acquirer must recognise a contingent liability assumed if it is a present obligation arising from past events and its fair value can be measured reliably , measured at its acquisition date fair value (HK$180,000). The fact that an outflow is not probable does not prevent recognition by the acquirer. 解題思路（繁中）: 核心考點：business combination 入面，acquirer 確認標準 闊過 HKAS 37 ——唔需要「probable outflow」，只要是 present obligation + FV reliably measurable。 A 錯：HKAS 37 嘅 prohibition 只約束 acquiree 自己嘅財報；HKFRS 3(R).22–23 明確係 exception。 B 錯：acquirer 要獨立評估確認條件，唔可以照抄 acquiree 嘅處理（LP Key Learning Point §22.3.4.1）。 D 錯：「等到 probable 先確認」係把 HKAS 37 邏輯錯誤搬入收購會計；確認時點係 acquisition date。 考試伏位：題目強調「not probable」係煙幕——呢個正正係 exception 存在嘅原因；但如果係 possible obligation （連存在都唔確定），就真係唔確認。 Rule Check: HKFRS 3(R).22–23 (contingent liabilities recognised at acquisition date FV if present obligation and FV reliably measurable); HKAS 37 (contingent liabilities not recognised by the acquiree). Common Trap（繁中）: 背咗 HKAS 37「contingent liability 唔確認」就直情套用，忘記 HKFRS 3 有 recognition exception。兩條準則嘅分工要分清：acquiree 自己財報 vs acquirer 收購會計。 Q4 — Answer: HK$3,600,000 Model Answer (EN): Step 1 — Fair value of identifiable net assets at acquisition date: Step 2 — Goodwill (full goodwill method, NCI at fair value): (For reference: under the partial goodwill method, NCI = 25% × HK$8,000,000 = HK$2,000,000 and goodwill = 9,000,000 + 2,000,000 − 8,000,000 = HK$3,000,000. The HK$600,000 difference is the goodwill attributable to the NCI.) 解題思路（繁中）: 先執 identifiable net assets： unrecognised trademark 要加 （separability/contractual legal criterion 通過就得，acquiree 冇確認唔緊要）； contingent liability 要減 （HKFRS 3(R).22–23 exception）。 NCI 題目講明 at fair value → full goodwill method ，直接用 HK$2,600,000，唔好用 25% × net assets。 常見錯：(1) 用 partial goodwill 計出 HK$3,000,000；(2) 忘記確認 contingent liability，net assets 計錯做 8,200,000 → goodwill 3,400,000；(3) 漏咗 trademark。 計 goodwill 公式要記實：consideration + NCI − FV of identifiable net assets。 Rule Check: HKFRS 3(R).32 (goodwill measured as a residual); HKFRS 3(R).19 (NCI at fair value option — full goodwill); HKFRS 3(R).10, 18 (recognition and FV measurement of identifiable net assets); HKFRS 3(R).22–23 (contingent liability); HKFRS 3(R).B31–B34 (identifiable intangible asset). Common Trap（繁中）: 題目同時畀「FV of NCI」同「NCI%」，係引你用錯方法。題目講明 NCI at fair value 就一定用 FV 嗰個數；只有講「proportionate share」先至用百分比乘 identifiable net assets。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Investment in subsidiary = consideration transferred = 4,000,000 + (100,000 × HK$25) + 300,000 = HK$6,800,000. Shares issued are credited at nominal value to share capital with the excess to share premium. Legal fees are acquisition related costs expensed as incurred (HKFRS 3(R).59), not capitalised. Each entry balances: Dr 6,800,000 = Cr 6,800,000; Dr 80,000 = Cr 80,000. 解題思路（繁中）: 三步檢查：(1) investment 入賬金額 = total consideration（唔包 legal fees）；(2) 股份要拆 nominal → share capital、溢價 → share premium ；(3) contingent consideration 以 FV 確認為 liability。 A 錯：legal fees 資本化埋入 investment（6,880,000），而且 share capital 用咗 FV HK$2,500,000 全額入賬、冇拆 premium。 C 錯：漏咗 contingent consideration（investment 只有 6,500,000）。 D 錯：雖然 investment 金額同 expense 啱，但 share capital 成筆用 FV 入賬（2,500,000），冇分出 share premium——股本只可以按 nominal value 入賬。 考試伏位：CBE journal entry grid 最興考「Dr/Cr 戶口名 + 金額」配對——share capital 永遠係 nominal value！ Rule Check: HKFRS 3(R).37 (consideration at acquisition date FV, including equity interests issued); HKFRS 3(R).39 (contingent consideration); HKFRS 3(R).59 (acquisition related costs expensed); HKAS 32 (equity issued at nominal value; issue costs as equity deduction). Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大伏：(1) 將 acquisition related costs 加落 investment cost（HKFRS 3 明令禁止，連 separate FS 都唔准）；(2) share capital 按 fair value 入賬。記住： Share capital = nominal，Share premium = FV − nominal 。

title: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Heron Limite…
text: M6 Chapter 22: Business Combinations — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Heron Limited is considering four transactions. In accordance with HKFRS 3 (Revised) Business Combinations , which of the following transactions should be accounted for as a business combination ? A. Heron Limited purchases a single second hand delivery truck from a car dealer for use in its logistics operations. B. Heron Limited purchases 100% of the share capital of a company incorporated two weeks ago that has not yet commenced any activities and holds no assets other than the cash subscribed for its shares. C. Heron Limited purchases all of the net assets of an operating bakery business, including the ovens and premises, and takes over the employment contracts of the bakery's trained workforce whose production processes are critical to producing the bakery's output. D. Heron Limited purchases 25% of the ordinary share capital of an operating confectionery company, over which it gains significant influence but no ability to direct the relevant activities. Q2. On 1 March 20X5, Falcon Limited signed an agreement to acquire 100% of the share capital of Wren Limited. Control of Wren Limited passed to Falcon Limited on 31 March 20X5. The consideration comprised: Cash of HK$3,000,000 paid at settlement; 200,000 ordinary shares of Falcon Limited (quoted share price: HK$14 on 1 March 20X5; HK$16 on 31 March 20X5); A further cash payment of HK$500,000 if Wren Limited's revenue exceeds an agreed target within 12 months of acquisition; the fair value of this contingent consideration at the acquisition date is assessed as HK$350,000. Falcon Limited also paid legal fees of HK$90,000 in connection with the acquisition and share issue costs of HK$30,000. In accordance with HKFRS 3 (Revised), what is the consideration transferred ? A. HK$6,150,000 B. HK$6,550,000 C. HK$6,670,000 D. HK$6,700,000 Q3. Otter Limited acquired 80% of the share capital of Seal Limited on 30 June 20X5. Seal Limited is defending a lawsuit brought by a former supplier. The claim arises from a past breach of contract, but Seal Limited's lawyers consider an outflow of resources is not probable, so Seal Limited has disclosed (but not recognised) the claim as a contingent liability in its own financial statements. Otter Limited determines that the obligation is a present obligation arising from past events and that its fair value at the acquisition date can be reliably measured at HK$180,000. In accordance with HKFRS 3 (Revised), how should Otter Limited account for this contingent liability in accounting for the business combination? A. Do not recognise it, because HKAS 37 prohibits the recognition of contingent liabilities. B. Disclose it only, consistent with Seal Limited's own accounting treatment. C. Recognise it as an assumed liability at its acquisition date fair value of HK$180,000. D. Recognise it only if and when an outflow of resources becomes probable after the acquisition date. Q4. On 1 July 20X5, Panther Limited acquired 75% of the share capital of Leopard Limited for cash consideration of HK$9,000,000. At the acquisition date: The carrying amount of Leopard Limited's recognised net assets was HK$7,200,000; Leopard Limited owned an unrecognised trademark with a fair value of HK$600,000; The fair value of Leopard Limited's property, plant and equipment exceeded its carrying amount by HK$400,000; A contingent liability (a present obligation whose fair value is reliably measurable) of HK$200,000 existed but was not recognised by Leopard Limited; The fair values of all other recognised assets and liabilities equalled their carrying amounts. Panther Limited measures the non controlling interest in Leopard Limited at fair value . The fair value of the non controlling interest at the acquisition date is HK$2,600,000. In accordance with HKFRS 3 (Revised), calculate the goodwill arising on the acquisition. State your answer in HK$. Q5. On 1 September 20X5, Kestrel Limited acquired 80% of the share capital of Merlin Limited. The consideration comprised cash of HK$4,000,000, the issue of 100,000 ordinary shares of Kestrel Limited (nominal value HK$1 per share; fair value HK$25 per share at the acquisition date), and contingent consideration with an acquisition date fair value of HK$300,000. Kestrel Limited also paid legal fees of HK$80,000 relating to the acquisition. Which set of journal entries correctly records these transactions in Kestrel Limited's separate (unconsolidated) financial statements in accordance with HKFRS 3 (Revised) and HKAS 32? A. Dr Investment in subsidiary 6,880,000; Cr Cash 4,080,000; Cr Share capital 2,500,000; Cr Contingent consideration liability 300,000 B. Dr Investment in subsidiary 6,800,000; Cr Cash 4,000,000; Cr Share capital 100,000; Cr Share premium 2,400,000; Cr Contingent consideration liability 300,000; and Dr Administrative expenses 80,000; Cr Cash 80,000 C. Dr Investment in subsidiary 6,500,000; Cr Cash 4,000,000; Cr Share capital 100,000; Cr Share premium 2,400,000; and Dr Administrative expenses 80,000; Cr Cash 80,000 D. Dr Investment in subsidiary 6,800,000; Dr Administrative expenses 80,000; Cr Cash 4,080,000; Cr Share capital 2,500,000; Cr Contingent consideration liability 300,000

title: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Recognition — 邊個要 consolidate、由幾時開始
B. Measurement — consolidation procedures 與調整
C. Disclosure — presentation 與披露要求
excerpt: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain why a parent must present …
text: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain why a parent must present consolidated financial statements and apply the single economic entity concept under HKFRS 10. 2. Apply the consolidation procedures (HKFRS 10 Appendix B) to combine a parent and its subsidiary line by line on a consolidation worksheet. 3. Prepare pro forma consolidation adjustment journal entries for fair value adjustments, pre acquisition equity elimination, intra group balances/transactions and unrealised profits/losses. 4. Calculate goodwill, the NCI share of consolidated profit or loss, and the NCI share of consolidated equity, distinguishing upstream from downstream transactions. 5. Identify the presentation and disclosure requirements of HKAS 1, HKFRS 12, HKAS 24 and Schedule 4 of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) for consolidated financial statements. 必背考點 A. Recognition — 邊個要 consolidate、由幾時開始 HKFRS 10 paras 4, 4B : a parent that controls one or more subsidiaries must present consolidated financial statements — assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses and cash flows of parent + subsidiaries presented as those of a single economic entity . Limited exemptions (e.g. certain intermediate parents, investment entities); s.379(3) of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) also provides limited relief. 考點：考試鍾意考「持股 < 50% 係咪一定唔使 consolidate？」—— No 。Consolidation turns on control , not the percentage. Consolidation begins when control is gained and ceases only when control is lost (HKFRS 10 paras 25, B98–B99). Line by line consolidation : recognise 100% of the subsidiary's assets/liabilities even if the parent owns less than 100% — because control gives the parent power over all the assets and liabilities. NCI exists only to attribute the slice of equity/results not belonging to owners of the parent (HKFRS 10 paras 22, B94). Loss of control (HKFRS 10 paras 25, B98–B99) : derecognise the former subsidiary's assets, liabilities, goodwill and NCI; recycle related OCI; recognise the gain/loss in profit or loss ; consolidate income/expenses up to the date control is lost . Any retained interest is re measured at fair value and accounted for as an associate (HKAS 28), joint venture (HKFRS 11) or financial asset (HKFRS 9). Partial disposal WITHOUT loss of control (HKFRS 10 paras 23, B96) : no gain or loss in profit or loss ; treat as an equity transaction (transaction with owners as owners) — adjust NCI and recognise any difference directly in equity. Goodwill is NOT re measured. B. Measurement — consolidation procedures 與調整 統一基礎（開始 consolidate 前必做） Same reporting date (HKFRS 10 paras B92–B93): subsidiary's reporting date may differ by no more than three months ; Cap. 622 s.367(4) requires subsidiary's financial year to coincide with the parent's unless the parent's directors have good reasons against it. Uniform accounting policies (HKFRS 10 paras 19, B87): adjust the subsidiary's figures to group policies in the consolidation worksheet. Consolidation procedures (HKFRS 10 para. B86) — 三大步： 1. Combine (add across) like items of assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses and cash flows; 2. Eliminate the parent's investment in each subsidiary against the subsidiary's pre acquisition equity — difference = goodwill (Dr) or gain from bargain purchase (Cr); 3. Eliminate in full intra group assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses and cash flows (HKFRS 10 para. B86(c)). Consolidation worksheet / pro forma journal entries Adjustment JEs are recorded only in the consolidation worksheet ; they are never posted to any entity's ledger (the group has no ledger of its own) and therefore do not carry forward — must be re posted ("refreshed") every period . 考試伏位：舊年嘅調整今年要重新做，仲要分開 opening retained earnings 部分。 Fair value adjustments on acquisition (HKFRS 3 (Revised)) Write back accumulated depreciation/amortisation/impairment of the acquired assets, then restate to fair value ; recognise previously unrecognised identifiable assets (e.g. brand name). Credit side goes to a temporary equity account — Business combinations reserve . Subsequent periods : extra depreciation/amortisation on the FV uplift must be charged each period (current year to Depreciation expense; prior years to opening Retained earnings). If the remeasured asset is later sold, the group's gain/loss is computed on the group carrying amount (FV based), not the subsidiary's book gain. Pre acquisition equity elimination（每期都要重做） （Bargain purchase → CR Gain from bargain purchase instead of DR Goodwill.） Goodwill（HKFRS 3 (Revised) acquisition method） Acquisition related costs (e.g. due diligence fees) are expensed , NOT added to consideration. Intra group adjustments（全部 eliminate in full） Transaction Pro forma consolidation adjustment JE Cash in transit DR Cash / CR Receivables（當收款方已收） Intra group loan DR Loan payable / CR Loan receivable；DR Interest income / CR Interest expense（本期）；DR Interest payable / CR Interest receivable Intra group services DR Management fee revenue / CR Management fee expense；DR Payables / CR Receivables（ 淨利潤冇影響，但都要 eliminate ，否則 revenue/expense 各自 overstated，誤導使用者） Intra group inventory sale DR Sales revenue / CR Cost of sales（full intra group sale value）；再 DR Cost of sales / CR Inventory（ 只限 year end 未售出部分嘅 unrealised profit ） Unrealised profit in opening inventory（翌年重做） DR Retained earnings / CR Cost of sales Intra group sale of non current asset (1) DR PPE / CR Accumulated depreciation（還原售出前累計折舊）；(2) DR Retained earnings (gain on sale) / CR PPE（消除 unrealised gain）；(3) DR Accumulated depreciation / CR Depreciation expense（本期）+ CR Retained earnings（前期）— 把折舊還原到「冇賣過」嘅水平，gain 透過 excess depreciation 逐步 realised Intra group dividend DR Dividend income / CR Retained earnings — dividend（ 只限 parent 份額 ）；DR Dividend payable / CR Dividend receivable；NCI 份額：DR NCI — equity / CR Retained earnings — dividend NCI measurement（本章核心計算） NCI share of profit or loss = NCI% × subsidiary's reported profit for the period adjusted for consolidation adjustments that affect consolidated net assets （LP §23.3.1.3）: 額外折舊/攤銷（acquisition FV uplift）→ 扣 Upstream unrealised profit（subsidiary 係賣方）→ 扣 subsidiary profit（NCI 要分擔） Downstream unrealised profit（parent 係賣方）→ 唔郁 subsidiary profit（NCI 唔使分擔） Intra group loans/services（equal amounts）→ 唔影響 net assets → 唔使調整 NCI share of consolidated equity at reporting date = NCI at acquisition + NCI% × (subsidiary's post acquisition movements in equity, adjusted for net asset affecting consolidation adjustments, net of dividends) Attribution JEs: DR Retained earnings (opening, prior periods' share) / CR NCI — equity；DR Profit attributable to NCI (P/L) / CR NCI — equity；DR NCI — equity / CR Retained earnings — dividend（NCI dividend share）。 C. Disclosure — presentation 與披露要求 Complete set of consolidated FS (HKAS 1 para. 10): consolidated SFP, SPLOCI, SOCIE, statement of cash flows + notes, with comparatives. On the face : SFP: NCI presented within equity , separately from equity attributable to owners of the parent (HKAS 1 para. 54(q); HKFRS 10 para. 22) — single line item, no need to split into "share capital — NCI" etc. SPLOCI: profit or loss attributable to NCI vs owners of the parent presented separately (HKAS 1 para. 81B); same split for total comprehensive income. SOCIE: comprehensive income attributable to NCI shown separately (HKAS 1 para. 106(a)). HKFRS 12 Disclosure of Interests in Other Entities : disclose significant judgements in determining control (HKFRS 12 paras 7, 10); composition of the group; nature/extent of significant restrictions on accessing group assets/settling liabilities; consequences of changes in ownership interest and of losing control; summarised financial information for each material non wholly owned subsidiary (HKFRS 12 paras 12, B10(b)); unconsolidated structured entities (HKFRS 12 paras 19A–19G); profit/OCI attributable to NCI and dividends paid to NCI (HKFRS 12 paras 12(e), 12(f)). Schedule 4, Part 1, para. 2 of Cap. 622 : the notes to the consolidated FS must include the parent's company level statement of financial position (with a single "investment in subsidiaries" line) and movements in the parent's company level reserves . HKFRSs themselves do NOT require the parent to prepare separate company level FS. HKAS 24 para. 13 : disclose relationships between parent and subsidiaries (even if there were no transactions). 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Upstream vs Downstream intra group transactions Upstream (Subsidiary → Parent) Downstream (Parent → Subsidiary) Seller / profit earner Subsidiary records the profit Parent records the profit Elimination JE Same — eliminate in full either way (HKFRS 10 para. B86(c)) Same Effect on NCI share of profit Yes — subsidiary's reported profit must be reduced by unrealised profit (and increased by realisation via excess depreciation); NCI bears its % No — no profit earned by the subsidiary, so NCI calculation is unaffected 點樣分辨 問「邊個記低咗個 profit？」— profit 喺 subsidiary 簿度 → upstream profit 喺 parent 簿度 → downstream 考試伏位 Panel reports 連續幾年話考生將 downstream unrealised profit 錯誤分攤畀 NCI（Jun 2025 Q1 就係咁）；相反 upstream 又唔記得調。記住： NCI 只分擔 subsidiary 自己賺嗰啲 同左 Table 2: Loss of control vs Partial disposal without loss of control Loss of control (HKFRS 10 paras 25, B98–B99) Partial disposal, control retained (HKFRS 10 paras 23, B96) Consolidation Ceases from the date control is lost; consolidate results up to that date Continues unchanged Gain/loss Recognised in profit or loss No gain/loss in P&L — equity transaction NCI / equity Derecognise NCI of former subsidiary Adjust NCI carrying amount; difference between consideration and NCI adjustment goes directly to parent's equity Goodwill Derecognised in full Not re measured Remaining interest Re measured at fair value; becomes associate (HKAS 28) / JV (HKFRS 11) / financial asset (HKFRS 9) N/A (still consolidating) 點樣分辨 唯一問題係「仲有冇 control？」——唔係睇持股跌唔跌穿 50% 持股降但 control 仍在 → 全部入 equity 考試伏位 以為賣咗部分持股就一定入 P&L；或者 <50% 就自動當失去 control（可以 de facto control） 錯誤將差額入 P&L，或者重計 goodwill Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Why must intra group income and expense line items that fully offset each other (e.g. intra group interest income/expense, management fees) still be eliminated on consolidation? Back: Net profit is unaffected, BUT individual line items (e.g. revenue, expenses) would be overstated . Overstated line items give misleading information — revenue may be a key performance indicator for users. Consolidation presents the group as a single economic entity ; an entity cannot trade with itself (HKFRS 10 para. B86(c)). 💬 白話：雖然一加一減淨利潤冇變，但條 revenue 同 expense 線會各自谷大咗，報表使用者睇落集團生意額大過實際。所以就算「冇 net effect」都一樣要對銷——呢點係考生常見扣分位。 Card 2 Front: Why must consolidation adjustment journal entries be re posted ("refreshed") every reporting period, and where are they recorded? Back: They are pro forma entries recorded only in the consolidation worksheet . The group itself keeps no ledger ; entries are never posted to any entity's books. The worksheet starts afresh each period → prior period adjustments (e.g. FV uplift, unrealised profit in opening inventory) must be re entered, with the prior year portion taken to opening retained earnings . 💬 白話：集團本身冇自己嘅帳簿，啲調整分錄只係 worksheet 上面做，所以每年開新 worksheet 就要由頭做返晒，上年嗰啲要改用 opening retained earnings 落。 Card 3 Front: State the pro forma consolidation adjustment journal entry for the pre acquisition equity elimination of a partly owned subsidiary (with goodwill). Back: DR Share capital (subsidiary, 100% at acquisition date) DR Retained earnings (pre acquisition) DR Reserves (pre acquisition) DR Business combinations reserve (FV adjustments) DR Goodwill (balancing figure) CR Investment in subsidiary CR Non controlling interests — equity (Bargain purchase → CR Gain from bargain purchase instead of DR Goodwill) 💬 白話：母公司簿入面嘅「Investment in subsidiary」同子公司收購前嘅 equity 屬於「集團成立之前」嘅嘢，要成條對銷；差額就係 goodwill，NCI 嗰份就 credit 去 NCI — equity。呢條 entry 每期都要重做。 Card 4 Front: An intra group sale of inventory took place during the year and part of the inventory remains on hand at the reporting date. Give the consolidation adjustment entries and the follow up entry next year if the inventory is then sold externally. Back: Year of sale: DR Sales revenue / CR Cost of sales (full intra group sale value); DR Cost of sales / CR Inventory ( unrealised profit on unsold portion only ). Following year (if sold externally): DR Retained earnings / CR Cost of sales (unrealised profit in opening inventory). Only the portion relating to inventory still on hand is eliminated; the on sold portion is realised by the group. 💬 白話：存貨未賣出集團之外，利潤就係「unrealised」，要壓低返存貨值同利潤；下年賣出咗，就用 opening retained earnings 對 COGS，等利潤落返啱嘅年度。 Card 5 Front: How is the NCI's share of a partly owned subsidiary's profit or loss measured when intra group transactions exist? Back: NCI% × subsidiary's reported profit, adjusted only for consolidation adjustments that change consolidated net assets : less extra depreciation/amortisation on acquisition FV uplift; less unrealised profit on upstream sales (subsidiary is the seller); plus realisation of upstream unrealised gains via excess depreciation; no adjustment for downstream sales, intra group loans or services (equal amounts). Then attribute: DR Profit attributable to NCI (P/L) / CR NCI — equity. 💬 白話：口訣——「跟錢走」。只有影響集團淨資產嘅調整先會動到 NCI；同埋只有子公司自己賺嘅（upstream）利潤先關 NCI 事，母公司賺嘅（downstream）唔使分畀 NCI。 Card 6 Front: What alignment of reporting dates and accounting policies is required before combining the parent and subsidiary financial statements, and what are the limits? Back: Same reporting date : if impracticable, subsidiary's date may differ by no more than three months , consistently applied (HKFRS 10 paras B92–B93). Cap. 622 s.367(4) requires subsidiary's financial year to coincide with the parent's unless the parent's directors have good reasons otherwise. Uniform accounting policies : adjust subsidiary's figures to group policies via consolidation adjustments (HKFRS 10 paras 19, B87). 💬 白話：「Apples with apples」——同期、同 policy 先可以加埋一齊。考試見到唔同年結日，記住上限三個月。 Card 7 Front: A parent sells part of its interest in a subsidiary but retains control. How is the transaction accounted for under HKFRS 10? Back: Continue to consolidate; no gain or loss in profit or loss (HKFRS 10 paras 23, B96). Treated as an equity transaction (transaction with owners as owners): adjust the carrying amount of NCI; any difference between the consideration and the NCI adjustment is recognised directly in the parent's equity . Goodwill is not re measured; acquisition date accounting is unchanged. 💬 白話：一日仲 control 住，就一日當係「同自己股東做交易」，所有差額落 equity，唔准碰 P&L。一旦失去 control 先至計 gain/loss 入 P&L。 Card 8 Front: List the NCI related items that must appear on the face of the consolidated financial statements, and the parent level disclosure required by the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622). Back: SFP: NCI within equity, separate from owners of the parent (HKAS 1 para. 54(q); HKFRS 10 para. 22). SPLOCI: profit/loss and total comprehensive income split between owners of the parent and NCI (HKAS 1 para. 81B). SOCIE: comprehensive income attributable to NCI separately (HKAS 1 para. 106(a)). Cap. 622 Schedule 4, Part 1, para. 2: notes must include the parent's company level SFP (single "investment in subsidiaries" line) and movements in the parent's reserves . HKFRS 12: summarised financial information for each material non wholly owned subsidiary (paras 12, B10(b)). 💬 白話：NCI 係 equity 入面一條獨立線，P&L 要拆「歸母公司 / 歸 NCI」。另外香港公司法要求集團帳附註埋母公司自己嘅 SFP——呢啲 disclosure 題考生成日留白，係易攞分位。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Consolidation worksheet 合併工作底稿，將母子公司報表逐行加總再做調整嘅工具；唔係正式帳簿 Consolidation adjustment journal entries are recorded in the consolidation worksheet and are not posted to any entity's ledger. Pro forma journal entry 「模擬」調整分錄，只存在於 worksheet，每年要重做 The pro forma journal entry eliminates the parent's investment in the subsidiary against the subsidiary's pre acquisition equity. Pre acquisition equity 子公司喺被收購日之前累積嘅權益，唔屬於集團，要對銷 Pre acquisition profits relate to periods before the group came into existence and are eliminated on consolidation. Business combinations reserve Worksheet 上面暫記 FV 調整嘅臨時 equity 戶口 The fair value uplift on the subsidiary's plant was credited to the business combinations reserve. Unrealised profit 集團內部交易產生、但貨未賣畀外人嘅利潤，要消除 The unrealised profit on the intra group sale was eliminated against the carrying amount of inventory still on hand. Upstream / Downstream transaction Upstream = 子公司賣畀母公司；downstream = 母公司賣畀子公司；決定 NCI 使唔使分擔 unrealised profit Because the sale was downstream, the unrealised profit adjustment did not affect the NCI's share of profit. Non controlling interest (NCI) 子公司權益中唔屬於母公司嗰份，喺 consolidated SFP 嘅 equity 內獨立呈列 Non controlling interests are presented within equity, separately from the equity attributable to owners of the parent. Loss of control 母公司失去對子公司嘅控制，由嗰日起停止合併，盈虧入 P&L On loss of control, the parent derecognises the subsidiary's assets, liabilities and NCI and recognises the gain or loss in profit or loss.

title: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 3 Quiz (Model Answers)
headings: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 3 Quiz (Model Answers)
excerpt: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 3 Quiz (Model Answers) Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The NCI's share of profit is me…
text: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 3 Quiz (Model Answers) Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The NCI's share of profit is measured as NCI% × the subsidiary's reported profit, adjusted only for consolidation adjustments that change consolidated net assets. An unrealised profit adjustment is attributed to NCI only when the subsidiary is the selling entity (an upstream transaction), because that profit was earned and recorded by the subsidiary. In option B, Swift Limited (the subsidiary) sold inventory to the parent and 40% remains unsold, so the unrealised profit embedded in that inventory reduces Swift Limited's reported profit before computing the NCI share. 解題思路（繁中）: 核心口訣係「跟錢走」——NCI 只分擔子公司自己賺嘅利潤。Option B 係 upstream（子公司做賣方），子公司簿入面有 profit，年尾有 40% 未賣出，unrealised profit 要由子公司 reported profit 扣減，所以啱。Option A 係 downstream，profit 記喺母公司 Heron 簿度，同子公司 profit 無關，唔使調整 NCI 計算（呢個係 Jun 2025 panel report 點名嘅考生錯誤）。Option C 管理費同 Option D 利息，雙方記帳金額相等，income 同 expense 完全對銷，唔影響集團淨資產，所以唔使郁子公司嘅 reported profit。 Rule Check: HKFRS 10 paras 22, B94 (attribution of profit or loss between owners of the parent and NCI); HKFRS 10 para. B86(c) (intra group transactions eliminated in full); LP §23.3.1.3 (upstream/downstream attribution approach). Common Trap（繁中）: 以為所有 intra group 交易都要調整子公司 profit 先計 NCI——其實只有「影響集團淨資產」兼且「子公司係賣方」嘅調整先計。反向都係陷阱：見到 upstream 又唔記得扣。 Q2 — Answer: HK$191,250 Model Answer (EN): Working HK$ Cub Limited's reported profit for the year 800,000 Less: additional depreciation on FV uplift (HK$120,000 ÷ 8 years) (15,000) Less: unrealised profit on upstream sale ((HK$250,000 − HK$200,000) × 40% on hand) (20,000) Cub Limited's contribution to consolidated profit 765,000 NCI share (25% × HK$765,000) 191,250 The unrealised profit is based only on the 40% of inventory still on hand; the 60% on sold externally is realised by the group. 解題思路（繁中）: 三步：先計 FV uplift 每年額外折舊 15,000（收購日 uplift 120,000 ÷ 8 年）；再計 upstream 存貨嘅 unrealised profit——mark up 係 50,000，但只有 40% 存貨未賣出，所以只扣 20,000；最後 adjusted profit 765,000 × NCI 25% = 191,250。注意呢度 NCI 係 25%（母公司持 75%），唔好撈錯用 75%。 Rule Check: HKFRS 10 paras 22, B94; HKFRS 3 (Revised) (fair value measurement of identifiable net assets and consequential depreciation); LP §23.3.1.3 (NCI share = NCI% × subsidiary's reported profit adjusted for net asset affecting consolidation adjustments). Common Trap（繁中）: 三大失分位：(1) 成條 mark up 50,000 全扣（得 183,750），忘記只有未售出部分先係 unrealised；(2) 唔記得扣 FV uplift 嘅額外折舊（得 195,000）；(3) 完全唔調整，直接 800,000 × 25% = 200,000。Panel reports 年年話 NCI profit allocation 係考生最弱一環。 Q3 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Goodwill (HKFRS 3 (Revised) acquisition method) HK$ Consideration transferred 2,000,000 Add: NCI at proportionate share (20% × HK$2,250,000) 450,000 Less: fair value of identifiable net assets acquired (HK$1,000,000 + HK$1,100,000 + HK$150,000) (2,250,000) Goodwill 200,000 The due diligence costs of HK$80,000 are acquisition related costs and are expensed as incurred — they are not added to the consideration transferred. 解題思路（繁中）: Option B (280,000) 錯在將 80,000 due diligence costs 加埋入 consideration——HKFRS 3 規定 acquisition related costs 要費用化。Option C (320,000) 錯在完全唔理 150,000 FV uplift，直接用賬面淨資產 2,100,000 計 NCI 同 goodwill。Option D (350,000) 錯在 NCI 有跟比例計，但扣減嘅 net assets 冇計 FV uplift（2,000,000 + 450,000 − 2,100,000）。記住 goodwill 條式入面「net assets」同「NCI（proportionate basis）」要用 同一把 fair value 尺 。 Rule Check: HKFRS 3 (Revised) (acquisition method: consideration transferred + NCI − recognised amounts of identifiable net assets; acquisition related costs expensed); LP Ch 23 §23.3.1.1 and Exam Practice Q4 (due diligence costs excluded from consideration). Common Trap（繁中）: 混淆 goodwill 計算中兩個 NCI 計法：呢題用 proportionate share（partial goodwill），所以 NCI = 20% × FV net assets，唔好用 fair value（full goodwill）計。另外記得 goodwill 出現在 consolidated SFP，子公司自己嘅簿係唔會見到嘅。 Q4 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): The intra group sale must be eliminated in full, and the unrealised profit relating to inventory still on hand must be eliminated: Unrealised profit = (HK$120,000 − HK$90,000) × 30% on hand = HK$9,000 Eliminate the sale: DR Sales revenue HK$120,000 / CR Cost of sales HK$120,000 Eliminate the unrealised profit: DR Cost of sales HK$9,000 / CR Inventory HK$9,000 Combined (net) entry: DR Sales revenue HK$120,000 / CR Cost of sales HK$111,000 / CR Inventory HK$9,000 (Dr total = Cr total = HK$120,000 — balanced) 解題思路（繁中）: Option A 只對銷咗個 sale，冇處理年尾存貨入面嘅 9,000 unrealised profit，inventory 同 profit 都 overstated。Option B 將成個 mark up 30,000 當晒 unrealised——但其實 70% 存貨已賣畀外人，嗰部分 profit 集團已經 realised，錯在冇按 30% 比例計。Option C 本末倒置：只調整 unrealised profit 但冇對銷 intra group sales revenue 同 COGS，revenue 同 expenses 各自 overstated，誤導使用者。Option D 先係完整：sale 全額對銷 + 只扣 30% on hand 部分嘅 unrealised profit，COGS 淨額 111,000 即係「120,000 對銷後加返 9,000」。 Rule Check: HKFRS 10 para. B86(c) (intra group transactions eliminated in full); LP §23.2.4.4 (eliminate sale against purchases; eliminate unrealised profit only for inventory still on hand). Common Trap（繁中）: 考生最易犯「全數扣 mark up」（Option B）。記住：realised 與否係由集團角度睇——貨離開咗集團先算數。另外 downstream 交易（呢題母公司賣畀子公司）嘅 unrealised profit 唔影響 NCI，不過因為呢間係 wholly owned subsidiary，呢點唔影響答案。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): NCI in consolidated equity at 31 December 20X6 HK$ NCI at acquisition (20% × (HK$2,000,000 + HK$1,500,000 + HK$400,000)) 780,000 Mink's post acquisition movement in retained earnings (HK$2,100,000 − HK$1,500,000) 600,000 Less: accumulated additional depreciation on FV uplift (3 years × HK$400,000 ÷ 10) (120,000) Adjusted post acquisition movement 480,000 NCI share of post acquisition movement (20% × HK$480,000) 96,000 NCI in equity at 31 December 20X6 876,000 解題思路（繁中）: 兩層加埋：收購日 NCI（proportionate share，記得計埋 400,000 FV uplift = 780,000）+ NCI 分佔收購後權益變動。收購後 RE 升咗 600,000，但要扣返三年（20X4–20X6）累計額外折舊 120,000，adjusted 係 480,000，NCI 分 20% = 96,000，總數 876,000。Option D (900,000) 忘記扣 FV uplift 折舊。Option C (892,000) 只扣咗一年折舊——由 1 Jan 20X4 到 31 Dec 20X6 係三年。Option A (836,000) 將 NCI 股息份額（20% × 200,000 = 40,000）再扣多次——但 2,100,000 嘅 closing retained earnings 本身已經係除息後數字，再扣就係 double count。 Rule Check: HKFRS 10 paras 22, B94; HKAS 1 para. 54(q); LP §23.3.2 (NCI share of consolidated equity = NCI at acquisition + NCI share of post acquisition movements in equity, adjusted). Common Trap（繁中）: 用「closing RE − 收購日 RE」計 post acquisition movement 時，股息已經自動反映咗，千祈唔好再扣一次。同埋額外折舊要計 累計 （由收購日到報告日），唔係只計本年度。另一伏位：唔小心用 80% 去計 NCI——NCI 係 20%。
