text: M6 Chapter 23: Preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) In accordance with HKFRS 10, Heron Limited owns 75% of Swift Limited. When determining the non controlling interest's share of Swift Limited's profit for the year, which ONE of the following intra group transactions requires an adjustment to Swift Limited's reported profit? A. Heron Limited sold inventory to Swift Limited during the year, and 40% of that inventory remains unsold at the reporting date. B. Swift Limited sold inventory to Heron Limited during the year, and 40% of that inventory remains unsold at the reporting date. C. Heron Limited provided management services to Swift Limited for a fee of HK$100,000, fully settled in cash before the reporting date. D. Swift Limited lent HK$500,000 to Heron Limited, on which both entities recorded interest of HK$25,000 for the year. Question 2 (Calculation) Puma Limited acquired 75% of Cub Limited on 1 July 20X3. Cub Limited's reported profit for the year ended 30 June 20X5 is HK$800,000. The following matters are relevant: At acquisition, the fair value of a plant held by Cub Limited exceeded its carrying amount by HK$120,000. The plant had a remaining useful life of eight years from acquisition, nil residual value, and is depreciated straight line. No adjustment for this has yet been made to Cub Limited's reported profit. During the year ended 30 June 20X5, Cub Limited sold inventory costing HK$200,000 to Puma Limited for HK$250,000. At 30 June 20X5, 40% of that inventory remained on hand in Puma Limited's warehouse. Calculate the non controlling interest's share of Cub Limited's profit for the year ended 30 June 20X5. Question 3 (Calculation / MCQ) On 1 January 20X5, Falcon Limited acquired 80% of the share capital of Wren Limited for cash consideration of HK$2,000,000. Falcon Limited also incurred due diligence costs of HK$80,000 in connection with the acquisition. Wren Limited's equity at the acquisition date comprised share capital of HK$1,000,000 and retained earnings of HK$1,100,000. On that date, the fair value of Wren Limited's equipment exceeded its carrying amount by HK$150,000; the fair values of all other identifiable assets and liabilities equalled their carrying amounts and met the measurement requirements of HKFRS 3 (Revised). Falcon Limited measures the non controlling interest at its proportionate share of the recognised amounts of Wren Limited's identifiable net assets. In accordance with HKFRS 3 (Revised), what is the goodwill arising on the acquisition of Wren Limited? A. HK$200,000 B. HK$280,000 C. HK$320,000 D. HK$350,000 Question 4 (Journal entry / MCQ) During the year ended 31 December 20X6, Otter Limited sold inventory that cost it HK$90,000 to its wholly owned subsidiary, Beaver Limited, for HK$120,000. At 31 December 20X6, 30% of that inventory remained unsold by Beaver Limited. Which ONE of the following sets of consolidation adjustment journal entries correctly eliminates the effects of this intra group sale in the consolidated financial statements? A. DR Sales revenue HK$120,000 / CR Cost of sales HK$120,000 B. DR Sales revenue HK$120,000 / CR Cost of sales HK$90,000 / CR Inventory HK$30,000 C. DR Cost of sales HK$9,000 / CR Inventory HK$9,000 D. DR Sales revenue HK$120,000 / CR Cost of sales HK$111,000 / CR Inventory HK$9,000 Question 5 (Calculation / MCQ) On 1 January 20X4, Lutra Limited acquired 80% of the share capital of Mink Limited for HK$3,200,000. At the acquisition date, Mink Limited's share capital was HK$2,000,000 and its retained earnings were HK$1,500,000; the fair value of a building held by Mink Limited exceeded its carrying amount by HK$400,000 (remaining useful life 10 years, straight line, nil residual value). The fair values of all other identifiable net assets equalled their carrying amounts. Lutra Limited measures the non controlling interest at its proportionate share of the recognised amounts of Mink Limited's identifiable net assets. At 31 December 20X6, Mink Limited's retained earnings in its own financial statements are HK$2,100,000, after declaring a dividend of HK$200,000 during the year ended 31 December 20X6. There have been no movements in Mink Limited's other equity balances since acquisition and no intra group trading. In accordance with HKFRS 10, what is the balance of the non controlling interest in equity in Lutra Limited's consolidated statement of financial position at 31 December 20X6? A. HK$836,000 B. HK$876,000 C. HK$892,000 D. HK$900,000

title: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Recognition — What is an associate and when does the equity method apply?
對比表 1：Subsidiary vs Associate vs Financial asset（control vs significant influence）
對比表 2：Goodwill on acquisition — Business combination vs Associate
excerpt: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define an associate and explain the meaning of significan…
text: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define an associate and explain the meaning of significant influence in accordance with HKAS 28 (2011). 2. Apply the equity method of accounting to investments in associates, including adjustments for fair value uplifts, dividends and unrealised gains/losses on upstream and downstream transactions. 3. Calculate the equity accounted carrying amount of an investment in an associate and the investor's share of the associate's profit or loss. 4. Determine whether and how an investment in an associate is tested for impairment in accordance with HKAS 28 and HKAS 36. 5. Prepare the presentation and disclosure of investments in associates in accordance with HKAS 1, HKFRS 12, HKAS 24 and HKAS 27. 必背考點 A. Recognition — What is an associate and when does the equity method apply? Rule Detail Reference Definition of associate An entity over which the investor has significant influence . HKAS 28.3 Significant influence The power to participate in the financial and operating policy decisions of the investee, but that power is insufficient to give control or joint control over those policies. HKAS 28.3 Rebuttable presumptions Holding ≥ 20% of voting power → presumed significant influence; holding < 20% → presumed no significant influence. Presumptions are rebuttable by evidence (e.g. associate under administration; contractual rights despite < 20%). HKAS 28.5 Indicators of significant influence Board representation; participation in policy making processes (incl. dividend decisions); material transactions between the entities; interchange of managerial personnel; provision of essential technical information. HKAS 28.6 Ongoing assessment Significant influence is assessed throughout the duration of the investment, not just at inception; it can be lost without any change in shareholding. HKAS 28.9 Accounting method An associate is not consolidated ; with limited exceptions it is accounted for using the equity method . HKAS 28.11 B. Measurement — Equity method (initial + subsequent) B1. Initial recognition (HKAS 28.10) The investment is initially recognised at cost , and adjusted thereafter for the post acquisition change in the investor's share of the associate's net assets. Investor's profit or loss includes its share of the associate's profit or loss ; investor's OCI includes its share of the associate's OCI . B2. Implicit goodwill / discount on acquisition (HKAS 28.12, 28.32) Goodwill (or discount) = Cost of investment − (% ownership × net fair value of associate's identifiable assets and liabilities) Goodwill → included implicitly in the carrying amount of the investment; no separate goodwill asset is recognised and no further journal entry is made. Discount on acquisition → recognised in profit or loss as part of the share of the associate's profit or loss in the period of acquisition . B3. Subsequent measurement — the equity accounted carrying amount (Exhibit 24.2) Share of profit must be based on the associate's profit adjusted for (HKAS 28.32): 1. additional/reduced depreciation or amortisation arising from acquisition date fair value adjustments (e.g. unrecognised trademark amortised over its useful life); and 2. the investor's share of unrealised gains/losses on upstream/downstream transactions. Associate's financial statements must be adjusted to uniform accounting policies and be of the same reporting date as the investor unless impracticable (a difference of up to three months is acceptable, adjusted for significant transactions in the gap). HKAS 28.33–36 Loss floor: the investment (an asset) cannot go below nil — the investor ceases to equity account its share of losses once the net investment is written down to zero (but keeps tracking them off record, and recognises a liability for any legal/constructive obligations). HKAS 28.38–39 B4. Distributions from the associate (HKAS 28.10) A dividend from an associate is NOT dividend income — it is a reduction in the carrying amount of the investment (avoids double counting, since the share of profit is already in P&L). B5. Upstream and downstream transactions (HKAS 28.28) Gains/losses on transactions between the investor and its associate are recognised only to the extent of unrelated investors' interests in the associate — i.e. the investor's own share of any unrealised gain/loss is eliminated . Upstream = associate sells to investor; downstream = investor sells to associate. HKAS 28 is unclear on the mechanics; the LP uses Approach 2 (adjust the line item of the entity recording the gain and the entity holding the asset): Upstream: DR Share of associate's profit or loss / CR Inventory (or PPE) Downstream: DR Cost of Sales (or Gain on sale of PPE) / CR Investment in associate No elimination of intercompany balances is needed (the associate is not consolidated line by line). For non current assets, the unrealised gain is effectively realised through excess depreciation over the asset's remaining useful life. B6. Impairment (HKAS 28.40–42, HKAS 36.4) Test only when there is objective evidence of impairment (loss events, e.g. significant financial difficulty of the associate, breach of contract, probable bankruptcy, adverse technological/market/economic/legal changes, significant or prolonged decline in fair value below cost). HKAS 28.40, 36.4 The investment is tested as a single asset ; implicit goodwill is not separately identified or tested . HKAS 28.41A–C Write down to recoverable amount = higher of fair value less costs to sell and value in use. HKAS 28.42 Full reversal of an impairment loss is possible (subject to HKAS 36 constraints) — the prohibition on reversing goodwill impairment does not apply because the goodwill is not separately recognised. HKAS 28.42 B7. Separate financial statements (HKAS 27.10) In the investor's separate financial statements (if presented — HKFRSs do not require them), account for associates at: cost , or in accordance with HKFRS 9 , or by applying the equity method . Same policy must be applied to all associates. C. Key journal entries (all balance) Event Journal entry (HK$) 1 Acquisition DR Investment in associate x,xxx / CR Cash x,xxx 2 Share of associate's profit (incl. any discount on acquisition) DR Investment in associate x,xxx / CR Share of associate's profit or loss x,xxx 3 Share of associate's OCI DR Investment in associate x,xxx / CR Share of associate's OCI x,xxx 4 Dividend received/receivable DR Cash (or Dividend receivable) x,xxx / CR Investment in associate x,xxx 5 Upstream unrealised gain — LP Approach 2 DR Share of associate's profit or loss x,xxx / CR Inventory (or PPE) x,xxx 6 Downstream unrealised gain — LP Approach 2 DR Cost of Sales (or Gain on sale of PPE) x,xxx / CR Investment in associate x,xxx 7 Impairment DR Impairment loss x,xxx / CR Investment in associate x,xxx 8 (Consolidation worksheet only) Catch up to opening equity accounted position DR Investment in associate x,xxx / CR Retained earnings — share of associate's profit or loss x,xxx D. Disclosure requirements Requirement Reference On the face of the SFP: carrying amount of all investments accounted for using the equity method (one line); on the face of SPLOCI: share of profit or loss of equity accounted associates/JVs, and share of their OCI (split between items that will / will not be reclassified to P&L). Classified as non current unless held for sale under HKFRS 5. HKAS 1.54, 82, 82A; HKAS 28.15 Disclosure objective: information enabling users to evaluate the nature of, and risks associated with , interests in associates and their effects on financial position, performance and cash flows. HKFRS 12.1 Significant judgements and assumptions in determining significant influence (and changes); nature, extent and financial effects of interests in associates; nature of and changes in risks. HKFRS 12.5A, 6, 7, 20 Key disclosures: particulars of each associate (name, activity, place of business, ownership interest); summarised financial information for each material associate; reconciliation of summarised financial information to the carrying amount; significant restrictions on the associate's ability to transfer cash; unrecognised share of losses; contingent liabilities. HKFRS 12.21–23 Related party disclosures of transactions and balances with associates. HKAS 24.19 Particulars of associates in separate financial statements, where presented. HKAS 27.17 易混淆概念對比 對比表 1：Subsidiary vs Associate vs Financial asset（control vs significant influence） Subsidiary (HKFRS 10) Associate (HKAS 28) Financial asset (HKFRS 9) Level of influence Control — power to direct relevant activities Significant influence — power to participate in financial & operating policy decisions Neither control nor significant influence Typical voting power 50% (but HKFRS 10 emphasises control, not a presumption) 20%–49.9% (rebuttable presumption, HKAS 28.5) < 20% Accounting in group FS Full consolidation — line by line; NCI recognised Equity method — one line investment + share of profit Fair value (FVTPL or FVOCI) Investee's assets/liabilities Recognised separately in consolidated SFP Not recognised — only net investment Not recognised Intercompany transactions Fully eliminated Eliminated only to extent of investor's share (HKAS 28.28) No elimination 💬 點樣分辨：關鍵字係 "participate" vs "direct" — 能夠參與決策 ≠ 能夠主導決策。考試伏位：持股 ≥20% 只係 rebuttable presumption ，如果有 administrator 接管、或者有相反證據，25% 都可以唔係 associate；反過來 <20% 但有 board representation + material transactions + essential technical information 都可以係 associate。另一伏位：potential voting rights（presently exercisable options）要計埋落 voting power 度，可能令 "associate" 變咗 subsidiary。 對比表 2：Goodwill on acquisition — Business combination vs Associate Subsidiary (HKFRS 3 business combination) Associate (HKAS 28 equity method) Goodwill recognition Separately recognised as an asset in consolidated SFP Implicit — included within carrying amount of "Investment in associate"; no separate asset (HKAS 28.32) NCI in the calculation Yes — full or partial goodwill methods No NCI — only the investor's share of net fair value is compared with cost Discount (bargain purchase) Gain recognised in P&L (after reassessment) Included in share of associate's profit or loss in the period of acquisition Impairment testing Annual test (HKAS 36); cannot be reversed Tested only on objective evidence, as part of the single investment asset ; full reversal possible (HKAS 28.42) 💬 點樣分辨：見到 associate 題目問 goodwill，記住「 唔會出現一條獨立 goodwill 線 」— 佢匿埋喺 investment carrying amount 入面。考試伏位：(1) 同學成日將 discount on acquisition 當 goodwill 咁藏喺成本度，其實要即刻落 P&L；(2) 題目問 reversal，business combination goodwill 唔得 reverse，但 associate investment 減值可以全數 reverse。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Define "associate" and "significant influence" in accordance with HKAS 28 (2011). Back: An associate is an entity over which the investor has significant influence (HKAS 28.3). Significant influence = the power to participate in the financial and operating policy decisions of the investee, but that power is insufficient to give control or joint control over those policies (HKAS 28.3). 💬 白話解釋：associate 即係「有份出聲但話唔到事」嘅投資。你可以參與（participate）財務同營運政策嘅決策，但冇能力主導（direct）佢哋 — 一旦可以主導就變咗 subsidiary 要 full consolidation。 Card 2 Front: What are the rebuttable presumptions in HKAS 28 regarding the level of voting power, and list the indicators of significant influence. Back: ≥ 20% of voting power → presumed to have significant influence; < 20% → presumed not to (HKAS 28.5). Both presumptions are rebuttable . Indicators (HKAS 28.6): representation on the board of directors ; participation in policy making processes (incl. dividend decisions); material transactions between the entities; interchange of managerial personnel ; provision of essential technical information . 💬 白話解釋：20% 只係起點，唔係終點。考試會畀 facts（例如被 administrator 接管、或者有董事席位加技術支援）叫你推翻呢個 presumption，所以一定要睇晒所有事實先好下結論。 Card 3 Front: Describe the equity method of accounting under HKAS 28.10, including initial recognition and subsequent adjustment. Back: Investment is initially recognised at cost ; thereafter adjusted for the post acquisition change in the investor's share of the associate's net assets (HKAS 28.10). Investor's profit or loss includes its share of the associate's profit or loss ; investor's OCI includes its share of the associate's OCI . Carrying amount = Cost + share of profit + share of OCI − dividends received +/− other changes in net assets. Carrying amount cannot fall below nil — cease to equity account losses beyond that point (HKAS 28.38–39). 💬 白話解釋：equity method 即係每年將投資嘅賬面值「重估」一次 — 賺咗錢你份就上調，派息就扣返落嚟。記住佢唔係真正嘅 consolidation，而係借用 consolidation 原則嘅 measurement technique 。 Card 4 Front: How are implicit goodwill and a discount on acquisition of an associate accounted for under HKAS 28.32? Back: Goodwill/discount = Cost − (% ownership × net fair value of identifiable assets and liabilities) (HKAS 28.12). Goodwill → included implicitly in the carrying amount of the investment; not separately recognised , no journal entry. Discount on acquisition → recognised in profit or loss as part of the share of the associate's profit or loss in the period of acquisition . 💬 白話解釋：買貴咗（goodwill）就靜靜哋藏喺投資成本度；買平咗（discount）就當係即時賺咗，要計入收購年度嘅 share of profit。呢個對比經常考 — 同 HKFRS 3 嘅 goodwill 分開確認完全唔同。 Card 5 Front: Before computing the investor's share of an associate's profit, what adjustments must be made to the associate's reported profit? Back: 1. Adjust for the effect of different accounting policies and align reporting dates (same date unless impracticable; gap up to 3 months allowed with adjustment for significant transactions) (HKAS 28.33–36). 2. Adjust for additional/reduced depreciation or amortisation arising from acquisition date fair value adjustments (e.g. unrecognised trademark) (HKAS 28.32). 3. Eliminate the investor's share of unrealised gains/losses on upstream/downstream transactions (HKAS 28.28). 💬 白話解釋：associate 自己報表嘅 profit 唔等於你計 share 用嘅 profit。兩大調整： FV uplift 嘅額外折舊/攤銷 同 未實現利潤 。漏咗 FV 攤銷係歷屆考生最常犯嘅錯。 Card 6 Front: How does an investor account for a dividend received from an associate under the equity method, and why? Back: NOT recognised as dividend income; it is a reduction in the carrying amount of the investment (HKAS 28.10). Journal entry: DR Cash (or Dividend receivable) / CR Investment in associate . Reason: avoids double counting — the investor has already recognised its share of the associate's profits in P&L. 💬 白話解釋：派息唔係新收入，只係將你已經認咗嘅利潤「套現」。考試伏位：如果公司嘅 own books 已經 DR Cash / CR Dividend income，consolidation worksheet 要做返 DR Dividend income / CR Investment in associate 嚟更正 — 2025 年考官報告特別點名呢個錯誤。 Card 7 Front: How are unrealised gains on upstream and downstream transactions with an associate eliminated under HKAS 28.28 (Approach 2 used in the LP)? Back: Gains/losses are recognised only to the extent of unrelated investors' interests — eliminate the investor's share of the unrealised gain/loss (HKAS 28.28). Upstream (associate → investor): DR Share of associate's profit or loss / CR Inventory (or PPE) . Downstream (investor → associate): DR Cost of Sales (or Gain on sale of PPE) / CR Investment in associate . For non current assets, the gain is realised over time via the excess depreciation adjustment. No elimination of intercompany balances (associate is not consolidated line by line). 💬 白話解釋：upstream/downstream 只係分邊個賣畀邊個。消除金額永遠係 gain × 你嘅持股% ，唔係全數。記憶法：upstream 調 share of profit + 調資產；downstream 調你自己嘅 P&L 行（cost of sales）+ 調 investment。 Card 8 Front: When and how is an investment in an associate tested for impairment, and can an impairment loss be reversed? Back: Tested only when objective evidence of impairment exists (e.g. associate's significant financial difficulty, breach of contract, probable bankruptcy, adverse environment changes, significant/prolonged FV decline below cost) (HKAS 28.40, 36.4). Tested as a single asset — implicit goodwill is not separately tested (HKAS 28.41A–C). Written down to recoverable amount = higher of fair value less costs to sell and value in use; entry: DR Impairment loss / CR Investment in associate (HKAS 28.42). Full reversal is possible subject to HKAS 36 constraints — the goodwill no reversal rule does not apply (HKAS 28.42). 💬 白話解釋：同 business combination goodwill 最大分別：唔使年年測（有 objective evidence 先測），減值唔使「先攞 goodwill 開刀」（成個投資係一件資產），而且 reversal 可以全數撥回。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Associate 有重大影響力但冇控制權嘅被投資公司 Moorhen is an associate of Albatross because Albatross has significant influence over it. Significant influence 有權「參與」財務及營運政策決策，但未到控制程度 Significant influence is the power to participate in financial and operating policy decisions without control or joint control. Equity method 權益法：成本開始，按應佔淨資產變動調整賬面值 Under the equity method, the investment is initially recognised at cost and adjusted for the post acquisition change in the investor's share of net assets. Implicit goodwill 藏喺投資賬面值入面、唔單獨確認嘅商譽 Goodwill of HK$321,000 is included implicitly in the carrying amount of the investment in the associate. Discount on acquisition 折價收購：買平咗，即時計入收購期 P&L The discount on acquisition is recognised in profit or loss as part of the share of the associate's profit or loss in the period of acquisition. Upstream / downstream transaction 上游（associate 賣畀 investor）／下游（investor 賣畀 associate）交易 The investor's share of the unrealised gain on the upstream sale of inventory is eliminated against the share of the associate's profit or loss. Unrealised gain 未實現利潤：集團內交易賺咗但貨仲喺自己手上 The gain is unrealised from the investor's perspective because the inventory remained on hand at the reporting date. Recoverable amount 可收回金額：fair value less costs to sell 同 value in use 兩者取高 The investment is written down to its recoverable amount, being the higher of value in use and fair value less costs to sell.

title: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Statement C is correct. Although Kingfisher Limited holds less than…
text: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Statement C is correct. Although Kingfisher Limited holds less than 20% of the voting power of Tern Limited (which gives rise to a rebuttable presumption of no significant influence), its board representation and provision of essential technical information are indicators that it has the power to participate in Tern Limited's financial and operating policy decisions. The presumption is rebutted by this evidence. 解題思路（繁中）: A 錯 ：≥20% 只係 rebuttable presumption 。被投資公司由 administrator 接管後，參與財務及營運政策決策嘅權力已轉移到 administrator 手上，presumption 被推翻 — 持股不變都可以失去 significant influence。 B 錯 ：呢個係 control （HKFRS 10）嘅定義 — "direct relevant activities"。Significant influence 只係 participate ，唔係 direct。呢個 definition swap 係經典伏位。 C 啱 ：<20% presume 冇 significant influence，但 board representation + provision of essential technical information 係 HKAS 28.6 明列嘅 indicators，足以推翻 presumption。 D 錯 ：30% 持股 + 可任命 8 席中 6 席董事 = 有能力 主導 財務及營運政策，即係 control，Plover 係 subsidiary 唔係 associate。 Rule Check: HKAS 28.3 (definition of significant influence); HKAS 28.5 (rebuttable presumptions); HKAS 28.6 (indicators of significant influence) Common Trap（繁中）: 見到 " 20%" 就即刻答「一定係 associate」— 考官最鍾意用 administrator 接管或者相反證據嚟考你 presumption 係可以推翻嘅；反向（<20% 但有實質影響力證據）一樣考。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under the equity method, a dividend received from an associate is not recognised as dividend income. It is recognised as a reduction in the carrying amount of the investment: Particular Debit (HK$) Credit (HK$) Cash 70,000 Investment in associate 70,000 This avoids double counting: Avocet Limited has already recognised its 35% share of Stilt Limited's profits in its profit or loss; the dividend is simply a distribution of those profits. Only Avocet Limited's share of the dividend (35% × HK$200,000 = HK$70,000) is relevant. 解題思路（繁中）: A 錯 ：equity method 下 associate 嘅利潤已經以 share of profit 入咗 P&L；再認 dividend income 即係雙重計算。 B 啱 ：DR Cash / CR Investment in associate — 股息係投資賬面值嘅減少（套現已確認嘅利潤份額）。 C 錯 ：investor 永遠只係處理 自己嗰份 （HK$70,000），唔會認成個股息總額 HK$200,000 — associate 唔係 consolidate，唔會 line by line 併入。 D 錯 ：股息唔係沖減 share of profit — 咁做會令 associate 對本期 P&L 嘅貢獻被錯誤陳述。Share of profit 同 dividend 係兩條獨立嘅調整線（一個入 P&L，一個扣 investment）。 Rule Check: HKAS 28.10 (equity method — distributions reduce the carrying amount of the investment) Common Trap（繁中）: 如果公司自己本帳已經記咗 DR Cash / CR Dividend income，consolidation worksheet 要做 pro forma 更正： DR Dividend income / CR Investment in associate 。考官報告（Jun 2025）特別點名考生「failed to eliminate dividend income recorded by the parent」— 呢個係實戰伏位。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Workings: HK$ Coral Limited's reported net profit 500,000 Less: additional amortisation on fair value uplift of patent (HK$400,000 / 8 years) (50,000) Coral Limited's adjusted profit for the year 450,000 Marlin Limited's share (30% × HK$450,000) 135,000 Journal entry: Particular Debit (HK$) Credit (HK$) Investment in associate 135,000 Share of associate's profit or loss 135,000 解題思路（繁中）: 重點：equity accounting 用嘅 profit 唔係 associate 自己報表嘅 profit。收購日 fair value uplift（未確認專利 HK$400,000）會產生額外攤銷，要先調整 associate 嘅 profit 先至乘以持股比例。 A (HK$150,000) 錯 ：30% × HK$500,000 — 完全冇扣 FV uplift 攤銷，係最常见錯誤。 B (HK$100,000) 錯 ：150,000 − 50,000 — 將 全數 攤銷喺乘以 30% 之後 先扣。正確次序係「先調整、後分成」，因為攤銷係成間公司嘅開支調整，唔係只屬於投資者嗰份。 C (HK$135,000) 啱 ：(500,000 − 50,000) × 30%。 D (HK$30,000) 錯 ：(500,000 − 400,000) × 30% — 將成個 FV uplift 當一次性開支扣晒，而唔係按 8 年攤銷。 Rule Check: HKAS 28.32 (share of profit or loss adjusted for depreciation/amortisation arising from acquisition date fair value adjustments); HKAS 28.10 (equity method) Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個次序錯誤最致命：(1) 忘記 FV uplift 攤銷；(2) 次序倒轉（先 ×% 後扣全數調整）。記住口訣： 「調整先做，分成後行」 。如果 uplift 係土地或無限期資產就唔使攤銷 — 睇清楚題目 useful life。 Q4 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): This is an upstream transaction (associate Puffin Limited sold to investor Gull Limited). The unrealised gain is HK$200,000 − HK$140,000 = HK$60,000, all unrealised because Gull Limited still holds the goods. Only the investor's share is eliminated: 25% × HK$60,000 = HK$15,000. Under Approach 2 (the Learning Pack's approach — the entity recording the gain is the associate, and the entity holding the inflated asset is the investor), the pro forma journal entry is: Particular Debit (HK$) Credit (HK$) Share of associate's profit or loss (25% × HK$60,000) 15,000 Inventory 15,000 解題思路（繁中）: A 啱 ：upstream = associate 賺咗 gain、investor 揸住 inflated inventory，所以調整 Share of associate's profit or loss （借方，減少應佔利潤）同 Inventory （貸方，還原成本）。金額 = gain × 25% = HK$15,000。 B 錯 ：消除金額係 investor's share （HK$15,000），唔係全數 gain HK$60,000 — 同 subsidiary 嘅 full elimination 唔同，associate 只係 eliminate to the extent of the investor's interest，其餘 75% 屬於 unrelated investors，已實現。 C 錯 ：呢個係 downstream （investor 賣畀 associate）嘅 Approach 2 分錄 — DR Cost of sales / CR Investment in associate。方向調轉咗。 D 錯 ：借貸方向完全倒轉 — 咁做會 增加 投資賬面值同應佔利潤，即係將未實現利潤當成額外收益，邏輯相反。 Rule Check: HKAS 28.28 (gains and losses from upstream/downstream transactions recognised only to the extent of unrelated investors' interests in the associate) Common Trap（繁中）: 兩大伏位：(1) 將 subsidiary consolidation 嘅 full elimination 習慣搬過嚟（associate 只消除自己嗰份）；(2) upstream/downstream 方向搞亂 — 記住 upstream = associate 係賣方，所以扣 share of profit、扣 investor 手上嘅資產。如果題目話貨已經賣咗出去畀第三方，就唔使消除（已實現）。 Q5 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): Step 1 — Goodwill/(discount) on acquisition: HK$ Net fair value of Harrier Limited's identifiable net assets (3,800,000 + 200,000) 4,000,000 Kestrel Limited's share (40%) 1,600,000 Cost of investment 2,000,000 Implicit goodwill (included in carrying amount; no separate recognition, no P&L impact) 400,000 Step 2 — Share of adjusted profit: HK$ Harrier Limited's reported net profit 700,000 Less: amortisation of licence fair value uplift (HK$200,000 / 5 years) (40,000) Adjusted profit 660,000 Kestrel Limited's share (40%) 264,000 Step 3 — Equity accounted carrying amount at 31 December 20X4: HK$ Cost 2,000,000 Add: share of associate's net profit for the year 264,000 Less: dividends received (40% × HK$100,000) (40,000) Carrying amount 2,224,000 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係完整 equity method 流程： goodwill/discount 判斷 → FV uplift 攤銷調整 → 減股息。Implicit goodwill HK$400,000 只係藏在 carrying amount 度， 唔使再調整 （唔似 discount 要落 P&L）。 A (HK$2,240,000) 錯 ：2,000,000 + (40% × 700,000) − 40,000 — 忘記扣 licence uplift 攤銷。 B (HK$2,264,000) 錯 ：2,000,000 + 264,000 — 忘記股息要扣減 carrying amount（股息唔係 income！）。 C (HK$2,164,000) 錯 ：扣咗 成個 股息 HK$100,000 — investor 只係收到自己 40% 嗰份（HK$40,000）。 D (HK$2,224,000) 啱 。 Rule Check: HKAS 28.10 (equity method mechanics; distributions reduce carrying amount); HKAS 28.12, 28.32 (implicit goodwill not separately recognised; FV adjustment depreciation) Common Trap（繁中）: 三步缺一不可：FV 攤銷、股息扣減、用自己嗰份股息。如果 cost 低過 share of net FV（discount on acquisition），記住 discount 要 加入 收購期 share of profit，而 goodwill 就咩都唔使做。呢類 multi step carrying amount 題係 Jun 2023 / Jun 2025 Section B 嘅必考元素，OTQ 化之後一樣要識逐步計。

excerpt: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 (1 mark) …
text: M6 Chapter 24: Investments in Associates — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 (1 mark) In accordance with HKAS 28 (2011) Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures , which of the following statements is correct? A. Heron Limited holds 26% of the voting power of Wader Limited. Because its holding exceeds 20%, Wader Limited must be accounted for as an associate even though an administrator has been appointed to manage Wader Limited's affairs. B. Significant influence is the power to direct the activities of another entity that significantly affect the investor's returns. C. Kingfisher Limited holds 18% of the voting power of Tern Limited. Kingfisher Limited has the contractual right to appoint two of Tern Limited's seven directors and supplies the essential software platform on which Tern Limited's operations depend. Kingfisher Limited may have significant influence over Tern Limited. D. Sandpiper Limited holds 30% of the voting power of Plover Limited and has the right to appoint six of the eight directors on Plover Limited's board. Plover Limited is an associate of Sandpiper Limited. Q2 (1 mark) Avocet Limited holds 35% of the ordinary shares of Stilt Limited and accounts for Stilt Limited as an associate using the equity method in its consolidated financial statements. During the year, Stilt Limited declared and paid a total dividend of HK$200,000 to its shareholders out of post acquisition profits. Avocet Limited received HK$70,000. In accordance with HKAS 28, how should Avocet Limited account for the dividend received in the financial statements in which the investment is equity accounted? A. Recognise dividend income of HK$70,000 in profit or loss. B. Debit Cash HK$70,000 and credit Investment in associate HK$70,000. C. Recognise dividend income of HK$200,000 in profit or loss. D. Reduce the share of Stilt Limited's profit for the year by HK$70,000. Q3 (1 mark) On 1 January 20X5, Marlin Limited acquired 30% of the ordinary shares of Coral Limited and correctly accounted for Coral Limited as an associate. At the acquisition date, the carrying amount of Coral Limited's identifiable net assets was HK$2,600,000. Marlin Limited identified an unrecognised patent with a fair value of HK$400,000 and a remaining useful life of eight years (straight line, nil residual value). The carrying amounts of all other identifiable assets and liabilities were equal to their fair values. For the year ended 31 December 20X5, Coral Limited reported a net profit of HK$500,000. In accordance with HKAS 28, what is Marlin Limited's share of Coral Limited's profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X5? A. HK$150,000 B. HK$100,000 C. HK$135,000 D. HK$30,000 Q4 (1 mark) Gull Limited holds 25% of the ordinary shares of Puffin Limited, an associate accounted for using the equity method. During the year ended 31 December 20X4, Puffin Limited sold goods to Gull Limited for HK$200,000. The goods had cost Puffin Limited HK$140,000. All of the goods remained in Gull Limited's inventory at 31 December 20X4. Using the approach adopted in the Learning Pack under which the accounts to be adjusted are determined by reference to the entity that recorded the gain and the entity that holds the asset, which pro forma journal entry eliminates the unrealised gain in Gull Limited's consolidation worksheet? A. DR Share of associate's profit or loss HK$15,000 / CR Inventory HK$15,000 B. DR Share of associate's profit or loss HK$60,000 / CR Inventory HK$60,000 C. DR Cost of sales HK$15,000 / CR Investment in associate HK$15,000 D. DR Investment in associate HK$15,000 / CR Share of associate's profit or loss HK$15,000 Q5 (2 marks) On 1 January 20X4, Kestrel Limited acquired 40% of the ordinary shares of Harrier Limited for HK$2,000,000 cash, giving Kestrel Limited significant influence over Harrier Limited. At the acquisition date, the carrying amount of Harrier Limited's identifiable net assets was HK$3,800,000. Harrier Limited had an unrecognised licence with a fair value of HK$200,000 and a remaining useful life of five years (straight line, nil residual value). The carrying amounts of all other identifiable assets and liabilities were equal to their fair values. For the year ended 31 December 20X4, Harrier Limited reported a net profit of HK$700,000 and declared a dividend of HK$100,000 to its shareholders. In accordance with HKAS 28, what is the equity accounted carrying amount of Kestrel Limited's investment in Harrier Limited at 31 December 20X4? A. HK$2,240,000 B. HK$2,264,000 C. HK$2,164,000 D. HK$2,224,000 End of quiz. Do not look at the answers file until you have submitted all five answers.

title: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
1. Recognition — Is it a joint arrangement? (HKFRS 11)
2. Recognition — Classification: joint operation vs joint venture (HKFRS 11.14–16)
3. Measurement — Accounting by each party (consolidated / equity-accounted FS)
對比一：Joint Operation vs Joint Venture
對比二：Control vs Joint Control vs Significant Influence
excerpt: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define joint control and assess whether it exists using the two …
text: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Define joint control and assess whether it exists using the two step approach (collective control + unanimous consent). 2. Define a joint arrangement and identify its key characteristics (contractual arrangement binding two or more parties, shared control). 3. Classify a joint arrangement as a joint operation or a joint venture by assessing the parties' rights and obligations (structure, legal form, contractual terms, other facts and circumstances). 4. Account for an interest in a joint venture using the equity method, and account for an interest in a joint operation by recognising shares of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses. 5. Prepare the presentation and disclosure in respect of interests in joint ventures and joint operations (HKAS 1 / HKFRS 12 / HKAS 24). 必背考點 1. Recognition — Is it a joint arrangement? (HKFRS 11) Definition of a joint arrangement (HKFRS 11.4–6) An arrangement of which two or more parties have joint control ; the parties are bound by a contractual arrangement , and that contractual arrangement gives two or more of those parties joint control. HKFRS 11 applies to all parties to a joint arrangement — not just those with joint control (a mere participant must still consider HKFRS 11). Joint control (HKFRS 11.7) = the contractually agreed sharing of control , which exists only when decisions about the relevant activities require the unanimous consent of the parties sharing control . Two step assessment: 1. Collective control (HKFRS 11.8, B5): two or more parties must act together to direct the relevant activities; a party that can only block (but not direct) decisions does not control. 2. Unanimous consent (HKFRS 11.9, B6, B9, B10): each party sharing control can prevent any other party (or group) from making unilateral decisions about relevant activities. Key fine points: More than one combination of agreeing parties can reach the required voting threshold → the contract must specify which combination must agree unanimously , otherwise there is no joint arrangement (HKFRS 11.B8). Unanimous consent over protective rights only → that investor does not have joint control (HKFRS 11.9, B6, B9, B10). Unanimous consent is not needed on every decision (e.g. dispute resolution mechanisms do not prevent joint control) (HKFRS 11.9, B9–B10). Not all parties need joint control — some may be pure participants/investors (HKFRS 11.7, 11). Reassess when facts and circumstances change — a party may gain or cease to have joint control (HKFRS 11.12–13). 2. Recognition — Classification: joint operation vs joint venture (HKFRS 11.14–16) Classification Rights and obligations of the jointly controlling parties Parties are called Joint operation Rights to the assets , and obligations for the liabilities , relating to the arrangement Joint operators Joint venture Rights to the net assets of the arrangement Joint venturers Classification uses a substance over form approach — the detail of the arrangement drives classification (HKFRS 11.15–16). Assessment sequence (Exhibit 25.2 decision tree, HKFRS 11.17, B15–B16, B21, B24, B33): 1. Not structured through a separate vehicle → can only be a joint operation . ("Separate vehicle" = a separately identifiable financial structure, including separate legal entities or entities recognised by statute, regardless of legal personality — HKFRS 11 Appendix A.) 2. Separate vehicle → does the legal form give the parties rights to net assets (e.g. a limited company normally does)? If No → joint operation. 3. If Yes → do the terms of the contractual arrangement override the legal form, giving parties rights to assets/obligations for liabilities in specified proportions? If Yes → joint operation (HKFRS 11.B25–B26, Exhibit 25.3). 4. If No → other facts and circumstances : is the arrangement designed so that (a) its activities primarily aim to provide the parties with output , and (b) it depends on the parties on a continuous basis for settling its liabilities ? If both Yes → joint operation (HKFRS 11.B31–32). Otherwise → joint venture . 3. Measurement — Accounting by each party (consolidated / equity accounted FS) Joint operator (HKFRS 11.20, 23) — recognise, in relation to its interest in the joint operation: its assets , including its share of any assets held jointly ; its liabilities , including its share of any liabilities incurred jointly ; its revenue from the sale of its share of the output arising from the joint operation; its share of the revenue from the sale of the output by the joint operation ; and its expenses , including its share of any expenses incurred jointly . Each element is recognised/measured under the HKFRS applicable to that element (HKFRS 11.23). A joint operator has rights to an asset (or share thereof), not a "right to use" — e.g. machinery used in a joint operation is accounted for under HKAS 16 , not HKAS 38 (HKFRS 11.BC39). The share follows the contractual rights/obligations , which may differ from the ownership interest ; proportionate consolidation is not permitted . Participant in a joint operation without joint control (HKFRS 11.23): If it has rights to assets / obligations for liabilities → account for those shares the same way as a joint operator . If not → apply the HKFRS applicable to its interest (e.g. HKFRS 9 for a loan). Joint venturer (HKFRS 11.24; HKAS 28.3, 28.27) — apply the equity method : Interest initially recognised at cost , adjusted thereafter for the post acquisition change in the venturer's share of net assets (HKAS 28.3). P&L includes the venturer's share of profit or loss ; OCI includes its share of OCI of the JV (HKAS 28.3). The venturer's ownership interest (not its "share of" individual assets/liabilities) drives the accounting — opposite of a joint operation (HKFRS 11.24, BC41). Unrealised gains/losses on upstream transactions (JV → venturer) are eliminated in applying the equity method (e.g. Dr Share of profit of joint venture / Cr Inventory). JVs are often newly formed vehicles, so implicit goodwill/discount on acquisition and FV adjustments may be less common (but still possible). Participant in a joint venture without joint control (HKFRS 11.25): Financial asset → HKFRS 9 ; or Associate type interest (significant influence) → HKAS 28 (equity method may apply). 4. Measurement — Separate financial statements (HKFRS 11.26–27; HKAS 27.6, 27.10) Separate FS may be presented only where the investor has investments in subsidiaries and/or associates and joint venture entities , and only in addition to consolidated/equity accounted FS. HKFRSs do not require separate FS. Joint venturer in separate FS — accounting policy choice (HKAS 27.10): at cost , or per HKFRS 9 (fair value) , or equity method . The choice must be applied consistently to all joint ventures (not arrangement by arrangement), but may differ from the policy chosen for associates. Joint operator in separate FS → accounts for its share of assets/liabilities/revenue/expenses exactly as in consolidated FS (HKFRS 11.26–27) — the cost/HKFRS 9/equity method choice does not apply. A party to only a joint operation (no subsidiary/associate/JV) presents "individual" (company) financial statements , not "separate financial statements". 5. Disclosure requirements Presentation (HKAS 1.54, 82, 82A) — face of the FS must show: the carrying amount of all investments accounted for using the equity method (JVs may be grouped with associates in one line item); the share of profit or loss of equity accounted JVs (and associates); and the share of OCI of equity accounted JVs (and associates), split between items that will / will not be reclassified to P&L. Amounts relating to joint operations are NOT separately reported . Disclosure (HKFRS 12.1, 12.7, 12.20, 12.21–23; HKAS 24.17) — objective: enable users to evaluate the nature of, and risks associated with , the interests and their effects on financial position, performance and cash flows: Significant judgements and assumptions in determining whether an interest is a joint arrangement and its type (JO vs JV) when structured through a separate vehicle — disclose any changes in assessment (HKFRS 12.7); Nature, extent and financial effects of interests in joint arrangements, incl. particulars (name, activity, place of business, ownership interest) (HKFRS 12.20); Summarised financial information for each material JV (based on the JV's HKFRS compliant FS, adjusted for policy differences and equity method adjustments such as FV adjustments, but NOT adjusted for intercompany transactions with the venturer), plus a reconciliation to the carrying amount (HKFRS 12.21–23); Significant restrictions on the JV's ability to transfer funds; unrecognised share of losses ; commitments ; and contingent liabilities relating to JVs (HKFRS 12.21–23); HKAS 24.17 : nature of the related party relationship and transactions/balances (incl. commitments) with JV partners; No separate quantitative disclosure required for joint operations (qualitative general information suffices, subject to the HKFRS 12 objective). 6. Key journal entries (all balanced) (a) Joint operation — recognise share of jointly purchased machine (50% share of HK$10,000,000 machine): (b) Joint operation — depreciation on share of machine (HK$5,000,000 ÷ 10 years): (c) Joint operation — recognise share of revenue from output sold by the joint operation (50% × HK$220,000): (d) Joint venture — initial recognition at cost: (e) Joint venture — share of JV's adjusted net profit (50% × HK$190,000): (f) Joint venture — dividend received (50% × HK$60,000): (g) Joint venture — eliminate unrealised gain on upstream sale of inventory (JV → venturer), per LP Approach 2 (Dr share of profit / Cr inventory): 易混淆概念對比 對比一：Joint Operation vs Joint Venture Joint Operation Joint Venture Rights / obligations Rights to assets ; obligations for liabilities (HKFRS 11.14–15) Rights to net assets only (HKFRS 11.14, 16) Party's name Joint operator Joint venturer Accounting basis "Share of" each asset/liability/revenue/expense per contractual share (may differ from ownership %) — HKFRS 11.20 Ownership interest in net assets via equity method — HKFRS 11.24, HKAS 28 Balance sheet effect Gross up: own line by line shares of assets/liabilities One line: "Investment in joint venture" (equity accounted) P&L effect Share of revenue and expenses line by line One line: "Share of profit of joint venture" Separate vehicle? Not structured through a separate vehicle → must be JO; but a separate vehicle can still be a JO if legal form/contract/facts give rights to assets & liabilities Requires a separate vehicle whose legal form gives rights to net assets, not overridden by contract/facts Separate FS Same accounting as consolidated FS (share of A/L/R/E) Policy choice: cost / HKFRS 9 / equity method (HKAS 27.10) Presentation Amounts not separately reported Separate line items with associates (HKAS 1.54, 82, 82A) 💬 點樣分辨： 唔好睇個名（"joint venture company" 都未必係 JV），要問「我直接擁有資產/孭住負債，定只係擁有淨資產嘅權益？」 考試伏位： (1) 有 separate vehicle ≠ 一定係 JV——若 output 全部賣俾股東、靠股東持續找數，照樣係 JO（HKFRS 11.B31–32）；(2) JO 份額跟合約權利義務，唔係跟持股比例（60/40 權利 vs 50/50 持股 → 用 60/40）；(3) proportionate consolidation 已禁止，JO 唔係按比例合併條線咁簡單，係逐項認自己份額。 對比二：Control vs Joint Control vs Significant Influence Control (HKFRS 10) Joint control (HKFRS 11.7) Significant influence (HKAS 28) Definition Power over relevant activities + exposure to variable returns + ability to affect returns Contractually agreed sharing of control; decisions on relevant activities need unanimous consent of parties sharing control Power to participate in financial & operating policy decisions, but not control or joint control Unilateral power? One party can decide alone No single party can decide alone; each can block the others Cannot decide alone, cannot block; influence only Contractual arrangement required? No Yes — essential No Resulting accounting Consolidation (subsidiary) Joint operation (line by line shares) or joint venture (equity method) Associate → equity method Blocking rights only Not control Not joint control if rights are protective only May indicate influence 💬 點樣分辨： Control = 我一個人話事；Joint control = 冇人單獨話事，相關活動要 一致同意 ；Significant influence = 有份參與但話唔到事。 考試伏位： (1) voting threshold 可以由多於一個組合達成（如 D+E 或 D+F 都得）→ 合約必須指明邊個組合要一致同意，否則 唔係 joint arrangement （HKFRS 11.B8）；(2) 只能「否決/保護性權利」≠ joint control；(3) 唔需要所有投資者都有 joint control——可以有純 participant。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Define "joint control" under HKFRS 11 and state the two conditions that must both be present. Back: Joint control = the contractually agreed sharing of control of an arrangement (HKFRS 11.7). Exists only when decisions about the relevant activities require the unanimous consent of the parties sharing control. Two conditions: (1) collective control — parties must act together to direct relevant activities (HKFRS 11.8); (2) unanimous consent — each party can prevent unilateral decisions by the others (HKFRS 11.9). 💬 白話：joint control 即係「合約講明一齊話事」——首先大家夾埋先控制到（collective），其次決策要一致同意，任何一方都可以否決其他人單獨行事。 Card 2 Front: An arrangement's decisions require 75% of voting rights. The threshold can be met by more than one combination of parties. What extra term is needed for the arrangement to be a joint arrangement, and why? Back: The contractual arrangement must specify which parties (or combination of parties) must agree unanimously on decisions about the relevant activities (HKFRS 11.B8). Reason: if multiple combinations can reach the threshold, no single combination is required to act unanimously — so unanimous consent (and thus joint control) is not demonstrated. 💬 白話：如果「A+B 得、A+C 都得」，即係冇一個組合係必須嘅，咁就冇「一致同意」可言——合約要白紙黑字寫明邊幾方必須一齊同意，先算 joint arrangement。 Card 3 Front: State the classification rule when a joint arrangement is NOT structured through a separate vehicle, and define "separate vehicle". Back: Not structured through a separate vehicle → the arrangement is always a joint operation (HKFRS 11.16). "Separate vehicle" = a separately identifiable financial structure, including separate legal entities or entities recognised by statute, regardless of whether they have legal personality (e.g. a company, a branch) (HKFRS 11 Appendix A). 💬 白話：冇獨立載體 → 實係 joint operation，無得拗。有獨立公司都唔代表係 JV，仲要過埋 legal form、contract terms、facts & circumstances 三關。 Card 4 Front: Even where a separate vehicle's legal form confers rights to net assets, which "other facts and circumstances" can still lead to joint operation classification? Back: Both of the following must hold (HKFRS 11.B31–32): The arrangement's activities primarily aim to provide the parties with output (the parties are the vehicle's primary source of cash flows); and The arrangement depends on the parties on a continuous basis for settling its liabilities . 💬 白話：間車係為股東而設（output 全部俾股東、break even 定價、唔准賣俾第三者），兼要股東持續泵水找數 → 經濟實質係股東自己擁有資產孭住負債 → joint operation。 Card 5 Front: List the five elements a joint operator recognises in relation to its interest in a joint operation (HKFRS 11.20). Back: 1. Its assets , including its share of any assets held jointly; 2. Its liabilities , including its share of any liabilities incurred jointly; 3. Its revenue from the sale of its share of the output arising from the joint operation; 4. Its share of the revenue from the sale of the output by the joint operation ; and 5. Its expenses , including its share of any expenses incurred jointly. 💬 白話：記口訣「A L R R E」：自己嘅資產負債、賣自己 output 嘅收入、JO 賣 output 我嘅份額、自己嘅開支。每項用返相關 HKFRS 計量（機器用 HKAS 16，唔係 HKAS 38）。 Card 6 Front: How does a joint venturer account for its interest in a joint venture, and how does the equity accounted carrying amount roll forward? Back: Apply the equity method (HKFRS 11.24; HKAS 28.3). Carrying amount = Cost + share of JV's adjusted net profit + share of JV's OCI − dividends received ± other changes in net assets. Adjust JV profit for unrealised gains/losses on upstream/downstream transactions and FV adjustment depreciation before taking the ownership % share. 💬 白話：opening cost 起錶，加應佔利潤（記得調整 unrealised gain），減股息。股息係收回投資，唔係收入——Dr Cash / Cr Investment in JV。 Card 7 Front: A participant in a joint arrangement does NOT have joint control. How does it account for its interest (joint operation vs joint venture)? Back: Joint operation: if it has rights to assets / obligations for liabilities → recognise its share of assets, liabilities, revenues, expenses same as a joint operator (HKFRS 11.23); otherwise apply the HKFRS applicable to the interest (e.g. HKFRS 9). Joint venture: financial asset → HKFRS 9 ; if significant influence → HKAS 28 equity method (HKFRS 11.25). 💬 白話：冇 joint control 唔代表唔使理 HKFRS 11。JO 嘅 participant 有實質資產負債權利就照樣逐項認份額；JV 嘅 participant 就當普通投資（HKFRS 9）或聯營（HKAS 28）處理。 Card 8 Front: What are the accounting policy options for a joint venturer's investment in a JV in its separate financial statements, and what consistency rule applies? Back: Options (HKAS 27.10): at cost , in accordance with HKFRS 9 (fair value), or equity method . The same policy must be applied to all joint ventures (not an arrangement by arrangement choice), but it may differ from the policy used for associates . HKFRSs do not require separate FS; a joint operator in separate FS accounts for its share of A/L/R/E same as consolidated (HKFRS 11.26–27). 💬 白話：separate FS 入面 JV 有三個選擇（cost / HKFRS 9 / equity method），揀咗就要全部 JV 一致用，但可以同 associates 唔同 policy。記住：JO 冇呢個選擇。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Joint arrangement 兩方或以上擁有共同控制嘅安排，必須有合約約束 A joint arrangement is an arrangement of which two or more parties have joint control under a binding contractual arrangement. Joint control 合約協定共享控制權；相關活動決策須一致同意 Joint control exists only when decisions about the relevant activities require the unanimous consent of the parties sharing control. Relevant activities 對安排回報有重大影響嘅活動 Collective control means the parties must act together to direct the activities that significantly affect the returns of the arrangement. Joint operation 共同控制方對安排嘅資產有權利、對負債有義務 In a joint operation, each joint operator recognises its share of the assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses relating to the arrangement. Joint venture 共同控制方只對安排嘅淨資產有權利，用權益法入賬 A joint venturer accounts for its interest in the joint venture using the equity method in accordance with HKAS 28. Separate vehicle 可獨立識別嘅財務結構，有冇法人資格都計 A joint arrangement not structured through a separate vehicle is always classified as a joint operation. Equity method 投資按成本初始確認，其後按應佔淨資產變動調整 Under the equity method, the investment is initially recognised at cost and adjusted for the investor's share of the investee's post acquisition profit or loss, less dividends received. Unanimous consent 共享控制嘅各方可以阻止任何一方單獨決策 Unanimous consent means each party sharing control can prevent any of the other parties from making unilateral decisions about the relevant activities.

title: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKFRS 11, joint control exists only when decisions about the relevan…
text: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKFRS 11, joint control exists only when decisions about the relevant activities require the unanimous consent of the parties sharing control. Here the 60% threshold can be reached by more than one combination of agreeing parties (R + S = 75%; R + T = 65%; S + T = 60%). Where the required proportion can be achieved by more than one combination, the contractual arrangement must specify which parties (or combination of parties) must agree unanimously; since the contract is silent, unanimous consent cannot be demonstrated and the arrangement is not subject to joint control. It is therefore not a joint arrangement. 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵係「多於一個組合可以達到門檻」。三個組合 (R+S、R+T、S+T) 都過到 60%，即係冇任何一個組合係「必須」一致同意，unanimous consent 唔成立。選項 A 錯：三方能「集體」控制唔等於三方都有 joint control，participant 可以存在。選項 B 錯：R+S 只係其中一個可能組合，合約冇指明佢哋必須一致同意，唔能夠斷言佢哋有 joint control。選項 D 錯：40% 單獨過唔到 60% 門檻，R 冇單獨控制權。考試伏位：見到 voting threshold 題，第一步永遠係列晒所有達標組合，多過一個 + 合約冇指明 = 唔係 joint arrangement。 Rule Check: HKFRS 11.7–9; HKFRS 11.B8 Common Trap（繁中）: 考生見到兩方夾埋過門檻就即刻答「joint control」，忽略咗「unanimous consent 必須係唯一組合或合約指明」呢個條件。記住：collective control 只係第一步，仲要過 unanimous consent 嗰關。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Although the arrangement is structured through a separate vehicle whose legal form confers rights to net assets (which normally indicates a joint venture), other facts and circumstances override this: Seabird's activities primarily aim to provide the parties with output (all output is sold to Seagull and Otter at cost; third party sales are prohibited), and Seabird depends on the parties on a continuous basis for settling its liabilities (cash calls). Both conditions in HKFRS 11 are met, so the parties have rights to substantially all the economic benefits of Seabird's assets and obligations for its liabilities — the arrangement is a joint operation. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 decision tree 最後一關「other facts and circumstances」。選項 A 錯：有 separate vehicle 只係第一步，唔係自動 JV。選項 B 錯：legal form 畀 net assets 權利只係第二關，仲要睇合約條款同其他事實——呢度 output 全部賣俾股東（at cost/break even）+ 靠股東持續找數，兩個條件齊晒 → joint operation。選項 D 錯：兩位股東一致同意相關活動決策，正正係 unanimous consent + collective control，joint control 成立，所以一定係 joint arrangement（問題只係分類）。考試伏位：break even 定價 + 禁止賣第三者 + cash call 依賴 = 教科書式 JO 訊號。 Rule Check: HKFRS 11.14–17; HKFRS 11.B31–B32 Common Trap（繁中）: 見「limited company」「net assets」就停喺第二關答 JV。記住 decision tree 有四關：separate vehicle → legal form → contractual terms → output/dependence facts，任何一關指向資產負債權利都係 JO。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under the equity method, dividends received from a joint venture are a return of the investment, not income. They reduce the carrying amount of the equity accounted investment: (50% × HK$90,000 = HK$45,000) 解題思路（繁中）: 權益法下股息係「收回投資」，唔係收益——JV 嘅利潤已經透過「share of profit」入咗賬，再認 dividend income 會雙重計算。選項 A 錯：Dividend income 係成本法/HKFRS 9 金融資產嘅做法，唔係 equity method。選項 C 錯：Cr Share of profit 會高估當年應佔利潤。選項 D 錯：方向完全調轉（呢個係加注投資嘅分錄）。考試伏位：Jun 2025 panelist report 特別批評考生冇消除 parent 已記嘅 dividend income——CBE journal grid 題好易考呢點。 Rule Check: HKAS 28.3 (equity method: investment adjusted for post acquisition changes in share of net assets); HKFRS 11.24 Common Trap（繁中）: 混淆「收到股息 = 收入」嘅直覺。Equity method 口訣：利潤加投資、股息減投資。 Q4 — Answer: HK$3,625,000 Model Answer (EN): As a joint operator, Heron recognises its share of the jointly held asset (HKFRS 11.20) and measures it under HKAS 16: Item Workings HK$ Share of cost of machine 50% × HK$8,000,000 4,000,000 Less: depreciation (1 Apr – 31 Dec 20X4) HK$4,000,000 ÷ 8 years × 9/12 (375,000) Carrying amount at 31 December 20X4 3,625,000 解題思路（繁中）: 三步：(1) joint operator 認自己份額嘅資產（50% × 8m = 4m）；(2) 折舊按 HKAS 16 計，收購日 1 April 開始，到 31 Dec 係 9 個月，要 pro rate；(3) 4,000,000/8 = 500,000 全年，× 9/12 = 375,000。常見錯誤：忘記折舊（答 4,000,000）；用足全年折舊（答 3,500,000）；用 100% 成本再減折舊（答 7,250,000）。考試伏位：mid year acquisition + monthly depreciation 係 M6 指定動作，日期一定要數清楚月份。 Rule Check: HKFRS 11.20, 11.23 (each element measured per the applicable HKFRS); HKAS 16 Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 唔 pro rate 折舊；(2) 以為 joint operation 嘅機器係「使用權」——LP 明確講 joint operator 有 asset 嘅權利而非 right of use，所以用 HKAS 16 唔係其他準則。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Applying the equity method: HK$ Cost of investment (1 Jan 20X4) 800,000 Add: share of Peak's adjusted net profit — 50% × (HK$360,000 − HK$24,000 unrealised upstream gain) 168,000 Less: share of dividends declared — 50% × HK$80,000 (40,000) Carrying amount at 31 December 20X4 928,000 The sale from Peak to Victoria is an upstream transaction; the unrealised gain of HK$24,000 is eliminated from Peak's profit before applying the 50% share (per the LP's Approach 2, the adjustment is Dr Share of profit of joint venture / Cr Inventory). (Note: under the LP's alternative Approach 1, the investment would be further reduced by 50% × HK$24,000 = HK$12,000, giving HK$916,000; Approach 2 as presented in the LP's worked solution gives HK$928,000.) 解題思路（繁中）: 考三個調整：(1) upstream 交易嘅 unrealised gain 要喺計 share of profit 前喺 JV 利潤度扣（360,000 − 24,000 = 336,000，×50% = 168,000）；(2) 股息減投資賬面值（40,000）；(3) 起錶用 cost。選項 A (916,000)：將全數 24,000 由「應佔利潤」扣（180,000 − 24,000 = 156,000），即係扣多咗——只需扣應佔部分。選項 C (940,000)：完全冇調整 unrealised gain（800,000 + 180,000 − 40,000）。選項 D (968,000)：冇減股息（800,000 + 168,000）。考試伏位：upstream gain 係對方賣嘢俾我，存貨仲喺我度 → 利潤未實現，必須調整；記住 LP 用 Approach 2（影響 share of profit 同 investment 一致），Approach 1 會得出 916,000，考試時要跟題目指示或 LP 做法。 Rule Check: HKFRS 11.24; HKAS 28.3 (equity method); LP Ch 25 Apply & Analyse 2 (upstream unrealised gain adjustment) Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 忘記 upstream unrealised gain 調整；(2) 股息當收入而唔係減投資；(3) 將全數 gain 而唔係按比例扣。方向記法：JV 賣俾我 = upstream；調整永遠以 JV 嘅利潤做起點。

title: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 (MCQ) Entity R, …
text: M6 Chapter 25: Joint Arrangements — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1 (MCQ) Entity R, Entity S and Entity T establish an arrangement to operate a logistics hub. Their voting rights in the arrangement are Entity R 40%, Entity S 35% and Entity T 25%. The contractual arrangement requires 60% of the voting rights to make decisions about the relevant activities of the arrangement. The contractual arrangement is silent on which parties must agree to such decisions. In accordance with HKFRS 11 Joint Arrangements , which of the following statements is correct? A. Entity R, Entity S and Entity T collectively control the arrangement, so all three parties have joint control. B. Entity R and Entity S have joint control of the arrangement because together they hold 75% of the voting rights. C. The arrangement is not a joint arrangement because the required voting threshold can be achieved by more than one combination of agreeing parties. D. Entity R controls the arrangement because it is the single largest holder of voting rights. Q2 (MCQ) Seagull Limited (Seagull) and Otter Limited (Otter) incorporate Seabird Limited (Seabird), a limited company in which each holds 50% of the voting shares. All decisions about Seabird's relevant activities require the unanimous consent of Seagull and Otter. Seabird's legal form gives Seagull and Otter rights to Seabird's net assets, and the contractual arrangement does not change those rights. However, Seagull and Otter agree to purchase all of Seabird's output in a 50:50 ratio at a price equal to Seabird's cost of production, Seabird is prohibited from selling to third parties, and Seabird relies on cash calls from Seagull and Otter to settle its liabilities as they fall due. In accordance with HKFRS 11, how should Seagull classify its interest in Seabird? A. Joint venture, because the arrangement is structured through a separate vehicle incorporated as a limited company. B. Joint venture, because the legal form of the vehicle gives the parties rights to the net assets of the arrangement. C. Joint operation, because Seabird's activities primarily aim to provide the parties with output and Seabird depends on the parties on a continuous basis for settling its liabilities. D. Not a joint arrangement, because unanimous consent over relevant activities is not, by itself, sufficient to establish joint control. Q3 (MCQ — journal entry) Crane Limited (Crane) is a joint venturer holding 50% of Heron Bay Limited (Heron Bay), a joint venture accounted for using the equity method in Crane's consolidated financial statements. During the year, Heron Bay declares and pays a cash dividend of HK$90,000 in total to its shareholders. Which journal entry should Crane record in its consolidated financial statements upon receipt of its share of the dividend? A. Dr Cash HK$45,000 / Cr Dividend income HK$45,000 B. Dr Cash HK$45,000 / Cr Investment in joint venture HK$45,000 C. Dr Cash HK$45,000 / Cr Share of profit of joint venture HK$45,000 D. Dr Investment in joint venture HK$45,000 / Cr Cash HK$45,000 Q4 (Calculation — short answer) Heron Limited (Heron) and Kite Limited (Kite) are joint operators in a joint operation (not structured through a separate vehicle) in which each party has a 50% share of the assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses of the arrangement. On 1 April 20X4, the joint operation acquired a machine for HK$8,000,000. The machine has a useful life of 8 years and nil residual value; depreciation is charged on a straight line, monthly basis from the date of acquisition. Heron's reporting date is 31 December 20X4. In accordance with HKFRS 11 and HKAS 16, calculate the carrying amount of Heron's share of the machine to be recognised in Heron's financial statements at 31 December 20X4. Show your workings. Q5 (MCQ — calculation) On 1 January 20X4, Victoria Limited (Victoria) contributed HK$800,000 in cash to establish Peak Limited (Peak), a joint venture in which Victoria holds 50% of the voting rights. Victoria applies the equity method. For the year ended 31 December 20X4, Peak reported a net profit of HK$360,000, which includes a gain of HK$24,000 on the sale of inventory from Peak to Victoria; none of that inventory had been on sold by Victoria to third parties by the year end. During the year, Peak declared dividends of HK$80,000 in total. What is the carrying amount of Victoria's investment in Peak at 31 December 20X4? A. HK$916,000 B. HK$928,000 C. HK$940,000 D. HK$968,000
