excerpt: M8 Chapter 1: Introduction to Auditing — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the elements of an assurance engagement under the H…
text: M8 Chapter 1: Introduction to Auditing — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the elements of an assurance engagement under the Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended) and apply them to a financial statement audit. 2. Distinguish between reasonable and limited assurance engagements, and between attest and direct reporting engagements. 3. Describe the legal and regulatory framework governing statutory audits in Hong Kong under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) and the co regulation model. 4. Apply the HKICPA Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants (COE) conceptual framework to identify, evaluate and address threats to the fundamental principles and independence. 5. Differentiate the roles, responsibilities and reporting lines of external auditors and internal auditors. 必背考點 A. Assurance Concepts（Assurance Framework & Engagement Types） Definition of an assurance engagement （Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended), paras 10–11）：practitioner obtains sufficient appropriate evidence to express a conclusion designed to enhance the degree of confidence of intended users (other than the responsible party) about the outcome of measurement/evaluation of the underlying subject matter against criteria。注意：Framework 本身 不 mandate requirements ，佢只係發展準則嘅框架。 Five elements of an assurance engagement （Framework paras 22, 26）： 1. Three party relationship — practitioner / responsible party / intended users； 2. Appropriate underlying subject matter； 3. Suitable criteria（e.g. HKFRS under the CO）； 4. Sufficient appropriate evidence（需 professional scepticism + professional judgement + materiality）； 5. Written assurance report。 Attest vs Direct engagement （Framework paras 12, 13）：attest = responsible party 做出 written assertion，auditor 評論該 assertion（FS audit 多數係 attest）；direct = auditor 自己 measure/evaluate subject matter 並直接報告，responsible party 不作書面 assertion （e.g. reporting on compliance with regulations）。 Levels of assurance （Framework paras 15, 16）： Reasonable assurance = high but not absolute （HKSA 200.5; HKICPA Glossary）；audit → positive expression of opinion （e.g. "true and fair in accordance with the financial reporting framework" under the CO）。 Limited assurance = review engagement；fewer procedures（mainly enquiry and analytical procedures ），less evidence → negative expression （"nothing has come to the auditor's attention…"）。 Non assurance engagements ：agreed upon procedures engagements 受 HKSRS 4400 (Revised) Agreed Upon Procedures Engagements 規管 — 只報告 factual findings ， no assurance 提供。Compilation engagements 受 HKSRS 4410 (Revised) 規管。 Purpose of an audit （HKSA 200 para. 3）：enhance the degree of confidence of intended users by expressing an opinion on whether the FS are prepared, in all material respects, in accordance with the applicable financial reporting framework (HKFRS)。 Inherent limitations of an audit ：audit ≠ absolute assurance — sampling、professional judgement、internal control override、human error、fraud concealment 均令部分 misstatement 可能唔被發現（就算 audit 做得啱）。 B. Evidence & Basic Principles of a Financial Statement Audit（HKSA 200） ASOBAT (AAA, 1972) definition of auditing ："A systematic process of objectively obtaining and evaluating evidence regarding assertions about economic actions and events to ascertain the degree of correspondence between those assertions and established criteria and communicating the results to interested users." 六大元素：systematic process / objectivity / evidence / assertions / established criteria / communication。 HKSA 200 basic principles （HKSA 200.14–17）：(1) compliance with ethical requirements (incl. independence — para. 14)；(2) professional scepticism；(3) professional judgement；(4) sufficient appropriate audit evidence & audit risk reduced to acceptably low level；(5) conduct audit in accordance with all relevant HKSAs。 Reasonable assurance objective （HKSA 200.4, 5）：obtain reasonable assurance whether the FS as a whole are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error 。 Materiality （HKSA 200.6, 7）：misstatements are material if, individually or in aggregate, they could reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions of users — auditor 用 materiality 去 plan、perform audit 及評估 misstatements 影響。 Sufficient appropriate evidence ：sufficiency = quantity；appropriateness = quality（relevance + reliability）。 C. Ethics（HKICPA Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants, COE） 法源 ：COE 由 HKICPA Council 根據 Professional Accountants Ordinance s.18A 發出；Chapter A 採納 IESBA International Code。COE 結構：Part 1（conceptual framework）、Part 2（accountants in business）、Part 3（public practice）、Part 4A（independence — audit & review）、Part 4B（other assurance）。 Five fundamental principles （COE 110.1 A1, R110.2）： 1. Integrity — straightforward；不得明知而與 misleading 嘅信息有關聯； 2. Objectivity — 不受 bias、conflict of interest、undue influence 影響； 3. Professional competence and due care — 維持知識技能、act diligently； 4. Confidentiality — 未經授權不得披露，除非有 legal/professional right or duty；不得用作個人利益； 5. Professional behaviour — 遵守法律、public interest、避免 discredit the profession。 Conceptual framework approach （COE 120.1, 2; R120.5）： Identify → Evaluate → Address threats；用 safeguards 將 threat 消除或降至 acceptable level；無法處理就要 decline / resign。判斷標準 = reasonable and informed third party test （COE 120.5 A6）；需 inquiring mind + professional judgement（COE 120.5 A1）。 Five threats ： Self interest （financial interest in client、fee dependence）、 Self review （audit 自己 firm 做嘅工作，e.g. 代客設計會計系統後再做 audit）、 Advocacy （promoting client's position，e.g. 推銷客戶股份）、 Familiarity （long/close relationship）、 Intimidation （actual or perceived pressure，e.g. 威脅不續聘）。 Independence 兩層面 ： independence of mind （事實上：integrity、objectivity、professional scepticism 不受損）+ independence in appearance （睇落去：reasonable and informed third party 唔會認為受損）。Independence required during the engagement period AND the period covered by the financial statements 。 Key independence rules（Part 4A） ： No direct or material indirect financial interest in an audit client（firm / team member / immediate family）； Gifts & hospitality：只接受 trivial or inconsequential ； Contingent fee for an audit engagement 被禁止 ； Overdue fees 長期未付 = 形同 loan to client → 要考慮應否繼續； No partner/firm employee may serve as director or officer of an audit client（threat cannot be reduced to acceptable level）； Designing/implementing IT systems integral to accounting/financial reporting systems 被禁止（safeguards 都救唔返）；off the shelf systems 則可接受； Key audit partner of a public interest entity ：max 7 years on engagement，然後 5 years cooling off（COE Section 540）； Engagement quality reviewer 冷卻期：engagement partner 轉任 EQR 前建議 2 years cooling off （COE 325.8 A3），同 Section 540 rotation 係兩回事； PIE fee dependence（COE 15 Dec 2022 前版本）：同一客戶連續兩年 total fees 15% of firm's total fees → disclose to TCWG + pre or post issuance review。 HKSQM 1 ：firm 須 design, implement and operate a system of quality management （risk based approach），replaced HKSQC 1； HKSQM 2 處理 Engagement Quality Review（EQR 資格、執行、文件）。 D. Regulatory Framework（Statutory Audit — Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622)） Co regulation model ：政府立法（CO）+ 自我監管（HKICPA）。主要法定監管機構： SFC 及 HKEX ； HKICPA 係香港唯一法定會計師發牌機構 （professional training, development and regulation）。 PAO (Professional Accountants Ordinance) s.18A ：HKICPA Council 發出 standards of practice 及 statements of ethics 嘅權力來源。 AASC （Auditing and Assurance Standards Committee）負責制訂 HKSAs 等，並採 convergence policy 與 IAASB/IFAC 國際準則趨同（HK standards 可加本地要求或喺特殊情況下偏離，但 professional standards 唔會 override 本地法律）。 CO 關鍵條文 ： ss.373–378 ：公司須保存 accounting records（hard copy or electronic）， 保存 7 年 ，可供董事隨時查閱； ss.379–387 ：directors 須編製 give a true and fair view 嘅財務報表； s.380(4)(b) 規定採用 HKICPA 發出嘅 accounting standards (HKFRS)； s.383 規定 notes 披露董事 emoluments、retirement benefits、termination payments、loans；directors 須 approve and sign； ss.388–391 ：directors' report； ss.429–436 ：AGM 前向股東發送 FS 及 reports； s.393 ：只有 practice unit （CPA firm / practising individual CPA / corporate practice）有資格獲委任；公司 officer/employee 及其 partner 無資格（法定 independence 要求）； ss.395–400 ：auditor 每個財政年度由 shareholders 於 AGM 以 resolution 委任 ；casual vacancy 可由 directors 委任；委任 firm = 委任其 partners； s.404 ：remuneration 由股東 resolution 釐定（若由 directors 委任則可由 directors 釐定）； HKSA 210 Agreeing the Terms of Audit Engagements ：engagement letter 建立 contractual relationship，配合 statutory appointment； ss.405–406 ：auditor 於 AGM 向股東報告，意見包括 FS 是否 properly prepared in accordance with the CO + true and fair view；directors' report 若與 FS 不一致須在報告中表明； s.407 ：auditor 須另就 (i) adequate accounting records 及 (ii) FS agree with accounting records 形成意見；未能取得所有 necessary information and explanations 須在報告中聲明；knowingly or recklessly 遺漏上述報告事項屬 offence ； s.410 ：qualified privilege（無惡意下免於 defamation）； s.411 ：有權出席 general meeting 並就 audit matters 發言。 Standards suite（HKICPA pronouncements） ：HKSQM 1–99（quality management）、Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended)、HKSAs 100–999（mandatory for FS audits）、HKSREs 2000–2699（reviews）、HKSAEs 3000–3699（e.g. HKSAE 3000 (Revised)、HKSAE 3410 greenhouse gas）、HKSRSs 4000–4699（related services）、HKSIRs 100–999（investment circulars）；PNs/AGs 非強制但唔跟要解釋；HKAPGs 屬 non authoritative（e.g. HKAPG 1000）。HKSA 結構：Introduction / Objectives / Definitions / Requirements / Conformity & Compliance with ISAs / Application material。 Group audits （HKSA 600 (Revised) para. 11）：group engagement partner 對 group audit opinion 負全責，auditor's report 不得提及 component auditor（除非法律要求）。 E. Types of Audits（External vs Internal） External auditor ：independent of the entity，由 shareholders 委任（CO 下），向 shareholders 報告對 FS 嘅意見。 Internal audit （HKSA 610 (Revised 2013) para. 14）："A function of an entity that performs assurance and consulting activities designed to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the entity's governance, risk management and internal control processes." 屬於 entity 內部控制系統一部分，向 management 報告；公司 無法定義務 設立 internal audit function。 External auditor using internal audit work （HKSA 610 (Revised 2013) paras 8–9, 15, A1）：可以 (1) use the work of internal auditors 以 modify nature, timing, extent of procedures；或 (2) direct assistance（在 external auditor direction, supervision, review 下執行程序）。但 external auditor 必須自行評估 internal auditor 工作是否 adequate ，且 不能 delegate audit responsibility ；external audit scope 不會因設立 internal audit 而改變。 IIA definition of internal auditing ：independent, objective assurance and consulting activity designed to add value and improve operations — systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve risk management, control, and governance processes。Internal auditor 嘅 independence 係 organisational independence （charter 賦予 status、Audit Committee oversight、不審核自己負責嘅活動）。 其他 audit types ： Compliance audits （遵守 policies / laws / contracts）； Performance audits （value for money — Economy （以最低成本取得適當質量數量資源）/ Efficiency （最小投入最大產出）/ Effectiveness （達成目標），3 Es 要分清）； Comprehensive audits （FS + compliance + performance 混合，公共部門常見）； Corporate social responsibility (CSR) audits （ESG 風險，suitable criteria 可能難定）。 Audit Committee ：Board 轄下 sub committee（多為 independent directors），oversee financial reporting & auditing functions，擔任 Board 與 auditor 之間嘅 intermediary；可就 auditor appointment 及 audit fee 提出 recommendation （唔係委任！），review broad audit strategy and results（唔係 detailed procedures）。HKICPA 2002 年發出 A Guide for Effective Audit Committees 。 易混淆概念對比 對比 1：Reasonable Assurance (Audit) vs Limited Assurance (Review) 項目 Reasonable Assurance — Audit Limited Assurance — Review Risk of inappropriate conclusion Reduced to an acceptably low level Higher than reasonable assurance（可以接受） Procedures Full range of audit procedures（extensive evidence） Mainly enquiry and analytical procedures （less evidence） Form of conclusion Positive expression（"the FS give a true and fair view…"） Negative expression（"nothing has come to our attention…"） Assurance level High, but not absolute Moderate / lower than high 滿足 CO 法定要求？ Yes — statutory audit 必須係 reasonable assurance No — review 唔能代替 CO 下嘅 audit 💬 點樣分辨：考試最鍾意問「換個平啲嘅 review 得唔得」— 唔得，CO 要求 audit。伏位：review 唔係「無 assurance」，係 limited assurance；兩者都會出 report/opinion，分別在於 extent of procedures 同 form of expression 。 對比 2：External Auditor vs Internal Auditor 項目 External Auditor Internal Auditor 委任／存在依據 Statutory — shareholders 於 AGM 委任（CO ss.395–400） Voluntary — 由 management 決定是否設立（charter 規管） 向誰報告 Shareholders （及其他 intended users） Management / Audit Committee 地位 Independent of the entity（第三方） Integral part of the entity（內部控制系統一部分） 目標 對 FS 是否 true and fair 發表 opinion Evaluate and improve governance, risk management and internal control（HKSA 610 (Revised 2013) para. 14） Independence 來源 法定 + COE Part 4A Organisational independence（charter、AC oversight） 責任可否轉移 不可 delegate；用 internal audit work 都要自行評估（HKSA 610.15） 唔承擔 FS preparation 責任（嗰個係 management） 💬 點樣分辨：記住「誰請我、我向誰報告」— external 向 shareholders，internal 向 management。考試伏位：設立 internal audit function 唔會改變 external audit 嘅 scope ，external auditor 唔可以 delegate 責任 畀 internal audit（Jun 2023 Q2 考過呢個區域，但呢度係概念區分）。 Phase 2 閃卡（8 cards） Card 1 Front: What are the FIVE elements of an assurance engagement under the Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended)? Back: Three party relationship (practitioner / responsible party / intended users) An appropriate underlying subject matter Suitable criteria Sufficient appropriate evidence A written assurance report 💬 白話：記口訣「三方、主題、準則、證據、報告」。Framework paras 22, 26。考試常見伏位：將 engagement letter 或 management representation 誤當第六個元素。 Card 2 Front: Distinguish an attest engagement from a direct reporting engagement (Framework paras 12, 13). Back: Attest: responsible party measures/evaluates the subject matter and makes a written assertion ; auditor reports on that assertion (e.g. FS audit) Direct: auditor measures/evaluates the subject matter directly; no written assertion by the responsible party (e.g. report on compliance with regulations) Most FS audits are attest engagements 💬 白話：關鍵係「有冇 written assertion」— 有就 attest，冇就 direct。伏位：direct engagement 唔代表 management 無責任，佢哋仍然 retain responsibility for the subject matter。 Card 3 Front: State the level of assurance and form of conclusion for (a) an audit and (b) a review engagement. Back: Audit: reasonable assurance (high but not absolute); positive expression of opinion Review: limited assurance ; negative expression ("nothing has come to the auditor's attention that causes the auditor to believe the subject matter is materially misstated") 💬 白話：audit = 正面肯定式 + 高保證；review = 反面「冇發現問題」式 + 有限保證。記住 reasonable ≠ absolute — audit 有 inherent limitations（sampling、fraud concealment 等）。 Card 4 Front: What is the ASOBAT (AAA, 1972) definition of auditing and its key elements? Back: "A systematic process of objectively obtaining and evaluating evidence regarding assertions about economic actions and events to ascertain the degree of correspondence between those assertions and established criteria and communicating the results to interested users." Systematic process / Objectivity / Evidence / Assertions / Established criteria / Communication 💬 白話：呢個係 auditing 嘅經典定義，HKSA 200 嘅概念（evidence、assertions、criteria、report）都係由此延伸。背熟原句，exam 定義題直接用。 Card 5 Front: Under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), who appoints the auditor, and what must the auditor's report opine on (ss.395–407)? Back: Shareholders appoint by resolution at each AGM (ss.395–400); directors may fill a casual vacancy; only a practice unit is eligible (s.393) Report opinion: FS properly prepared per the CO + true and fair view (ss.405–406); adequate accounting records kept + FS agree with records (s.407); inconsistency of directors' report must be stated 💬 白話：委任權喺股東手（唔係董事、唔係 Audit Committee — AC 只可以 recommend）。s.407 嘅兩項額外意見係常見遺漏位。 Card 6 Front: List the FIVE fundamental principles of the HKICPA Code of Ethics and the FIVE categories of threats. Back: Principles: Integrity; Objectivity; Professional competence and due care; Confidentiality; Professional behaviour Threats: Self interest; Self review; Advocacy; Familiarity; Intimidation Conceptual framework: Identify → Evaluate → Address (safeguards / eliminate / decline) 💬 白話：兩組「五虎將」必背。Scenario 題搵 threat 時問自己：係錢（self interest）？審自己嘢（self review）？幫客撐腰（advocacy）？太熟（familiarity）？被施壓（intimidation）？ Card 7 Front: Explain the two components of independence and when independence is required (COE Part 4A). Back: Independence of mind : conclusion expressed without factors compromising professional judgement — acting with integrity, objectivity, professional scepticism Independence in appearance : avoiding circumstances where a reasonable and informed third party would conclude integrity/objectivity/professional scepticism is compromised Required during both the engagement period and the period covered by the financial statements 💬 白話：「事實上獨立」+「睇落獨立」缺一不可。時間上兩段都要 cover — 唔係淨係做 audit 嗰陣。 Card 8 Front: May an external auditor use the work of internal auditors? State the conditions under HKSA 610 (Revised 2013). Back: Yes — two ways: (1) using the work of the internal audit function to modify the nature, timing and extent of external audit procedures; (2) direct assistance by internal auditors under the external auditor's direction, supervision and review (paras 8–9) External auditor must evaluate whether the internal auditors' work is adequate for audit purposes (para. 15) External auditor cannot delegate responsibility ; the scope of the external audit is not altered by the existence of internal audit 💬 白話：可以用，但要自己 review 過先可以用；責任永遠喺 external auditor 度。考試伏位：「設咗 IA 可以縮細 audit scope」— 錯！ 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Assurance engagement 保證/鑑證業務：第三者幫你驗證資料可信度 An assurance engagement enhances the degree of confidence of intended users in the subject matter information. Reasonable assurance 合理保證：高但非絕對，audit 級數 An audit provides reasonable, but not absolute, assurance that the financial statements are free from material misstatement. Limited assurance 有限保證：review 級數，程序較少 A review engagement provides limited assurance expressed in a negative form. Attest engagement 客戶先出書面聲明，auditor 評論該聲明 A financial statement audit is an attest engagement because management asserts the statements in writing. Agreed upon procedures (AUP) 議定程序：只報告事實發現，零保證 An AUP engagement under HKSRS 4400 (Revised) reports factual findings and provides no assurance. Professional scepticism 專業懷疑態度：唔好照單全收 The auditor plans and performs the audit with an attitude of professional scepticism. Independence in appearance 表面獨立：旁人睇落都覺得你公正 Holding shares in an audit client impairs independence in appearance even if judgement is unaffected. Co regulation model 共同監管：政府立法 + 業界自律 Hong Kong's audit regulation follows a co regulation model of government legislation and HKICPA self regulation.

excerpt: M8 Chapter 1: Introduction to Auditing — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): A review engagement provides limited assurance . The practitioner per…
text: M8 Chapter 1: Introduction to Auditing — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): A review engagement provides limited assurance . The practitioner performs fewer procedures — primarily enquiry and analytical procedures — and therefore obtains less evidence than in an audit. The conclusion is expressed in a negative form : whether anything has come to the practitioner's attention that causes the practitioner to believe the subject matter information is materially misstated. 解題思路（繁中）: C 正確：review = limited assurance + negative form，程序以 enquiry 同 analytical procedures 為主。A 錯：positive form + full procedures 係 audit（reasonable assurance）嘅特徵。B 錯：「no assurance + factual findings」係 agreed upon procedures engagement （HKSRS 4400 (Revised)），唔係 review — review 仍然係 assurance engagement，只係 level 低啲。D 錯：review 嘅 conclusion 唔會用 positive form — 呢個係「有限保證 vs 正面表達」嘅混搭陷阱，考試最愛將兩個維度交叉錯配。 Rule Check: Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended) paras 15–16; HKSA 200 para. 5 (reasonable assurance = high but not absolute) Common Trap（繁中）: 學生經常將「review 都會出 opinion」誤解為「review = positive opinion」。記住：audit 同 review 都係 assurance engagement、 都會 出報告；分別在於 assurance level 同 form of expression。另外唔好將 review 同 AUP 撈亂 — AUP 先係零保證。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): This is an agreed upon procedures engagement under HKSRS 4400 (Revised) Agreed Upon Procedures Engagements . The procedures are agreed in advance between the engaging parties; the practitioner has no discretion to extend them to the extent needed to support a conclusion, and reports only factual findings . No assurance is expressed. 解題思路（繁中）: 題眼係三個事實：(1) 程序由客戶同銀行 預先議定 ；(2) 只報告 factual results ；(3) 唔會發表 opinion or conclusion 。呢三點齊齊指向 AUP — 無 assurance。A 錯：audit 要 practitioner 自行決定 scope 並發表意見，呢度程序係人哋定晒。B 錯：review 至少提供 limited assurance（negative form），題目講明唔發表任何結論。D 錯：HKSAE 3000 (Revised) 係 other assurance engagements，仍然要出 conclusion；而且 assurance level 唔係「at the practitioner's discretion」咁隨意。 Rule Check: HKSRS 4400 (Revised) Agreed Upon Procedures Engagements; Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended) paras 10–11（assurance engagement 定義 — AUP 唔符合，因為冇 conclusion 去 enhance confidence） Common Trap（繁中）: 「由 CPA 做 + 驗證數字」唔自動等於 audit。判斷流程：有冇 conclusion/opinion？冇 → AUP（no assurance）。有 → 睇 positive 定 negative form → reasonable 定 limited assurance。 Q3 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): This is a direct reporting engagement . Under paragraph 13 of the Framework, in a direct engagement the responsible party retains responsibility for the subject matter but does not make a written assertion; the practitioner measures or evaluates the underlying subject matter against the criteria and reports the outcome directly in the assurance report. 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵事實： management 冇出 written assertion ，auditor 自己直接 measure/evaluate compliance 然後報告 — 正正係 Framework para. 13 嘅 direct engagement 定義。A 錯：attest engagement（para. 12）要求 responsible party 先作 written assertion，auditor 再評論嗰個 assertion；題目講明冇 assertion。B 錯：assurance engagement 嘅 subject matter 可以係 non financial（LP 列出 compliance with legislation、greenhouse gas emissions 等七類）— 「非財務」唔等於「非保證」。C 錯：題目冇資料顯示 assurance level；「compliance 主題 = limited assurance」係無根據嘅聯想。 Rule Check: Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended) paras 12–13 Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好俾「attest」個字面意思（作證）誤導 — 佢嘅技術定義係「對 responsible party 嘅 written assertion 發表意見」。一個實用判斷法：搵「written assertion 有冇出現」— 有 = attest，冇 = direct。FS audit 多數係 attest（management 簽 FS = assertion）。 Q4 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Accepting the appointment creates a self review threat . Vertex & Co would be auditing accounting records and financial statements generated by a system that the firm itself designed and implemented — the auditor would be evaluating the output of its own firm's previous work. The LP notes that providing services to design or implement IT systems that are integral to the client's accounting, internal control and financial reporting systems is prohibited because the threat cannot be reduced to an acceptable level by safeguards. 解題思路（繁中）: 事實鏈：firm 設計+實施會計系統 → 系統產生賬目同 FS → 同一 firm 審核呢啲 FS = 審自己做嘅嘢 = self review。B 錯：self interest 係「財務或其他利益不當影響判斷」（e.g. 持股、fee dependence）— 呢度核心問題唔係錢。C 錯：advocacy 係「幫客戶站台推銷佢嘅立場」（e.g. 推銷客戶股份、訴訟中代表客戶）。D 錯：intimidation 係「被實際或感知壓力嚇到唔敢客觀」（e.g. 威脅撤換 auditor）— 題目冇施壓情節。 Rule Check: HKICPA Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants, Section 606 (information technology systems services); COE Section 120 conceptual framework (threat categories) Common Trap（繁中）: 揀 threat 類別時用「一句話測試」：錢 → self interest；審自己嘢 → self review；幫客撐腰 → advocacy；太熟 → familiarity；被施壓 → intimidation。仲要記住呢類 integral IT system 服務係 prohibited — safeguards 救唔返，唔係「做個 review 就得」。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Statement B is correct. Section 18A of the Professional Accountants Ordinance gives the HKICPA Council the power to issue standards of practice and statements of ethics to be applied by its members; the Council established the Auditing and Assurance Standards Committee (AASC) to develop Hong Kong pronouncements, and mandated the Ethics Committee to develop the COE. 解題思路（繁中）: A 錯：香港唯一法定會計師發牌機構係 HKICPA ；HKEX 同 SFC 係證券市場監管機構，唔發 CPA 牌。C 錯：LP 明確講 professional standards do not override local laws and regulations — 方向啱啱相反。D 錯：AASC 係採用 convergence policy ，以 IAASB（IFAC 轄下）嘅國際準則為基礎發展 HKSAs，唔係「獨立發展」；不過香港準則可以加入本地額外要求或喺特殊情況下偏離國際準則。 Rule Check: Professional Accountants Ordinance s.18A; LP Ch.1 §1.2.1–1.2.2 (co regulation model; HKICPA as the only statutory licensing body; convergence policy) Common Trap（繁中）: Legal/regulatory framework 係 Jun 2025 考官報告點名嘅弱項。三個機構分工要背： HKICPA = 發牌 + 準則 + 紀律； SFC / HKEX = 證券及上市監管； AASC = HKICPA 轄下制訂準則嘅委員會。仲有「convergence」同「harmonisation」— 前者係香港層面嘅政策名，後者係國際層面嘅講法。 Self study tip: 五題入面錯邊題，就返去 Phase 1 對應嘅必背考點重讀嗰段。

excerpt: M8 Chapter 1: Introduction to Auditing — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MC…
text: M8 Chapter 1: Introduction to Auditing — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) Which of the following correctly describes a review engagement? A. It provides reasonable assurance expressed in a positive form, because the practitioner performs the full range of audit procedures. B. It provides no assurance, because the practitioner only reports factual findings agreed with the client. C. It provides limited assurance expressed in a negative form, based primarily on enquiry and analytical procedures. D. It provides limited assurance expressed in a positive form, because the practitioner still expresses an opinion on the subject matter. Question 2 (Scenario MCQ) Harbour Logistics Limited is negotiating a HK$40 million bank loan. The bank asks for independent verification of the company's monthly inventory turnover figures. Harbour's management engages a CPA firm to perform a fixed list of procedures that management and the bank have agreed in advance (e.g. recompute turnover ratios, agree figures to the inventory ledger) and to report only the factual results of those procedures. The CPA firm will not express any opinion or conclusion. Which of the following best describes this engagement? A. An audit engagement conducted in accordance with HKSAs, providing reasonable assurance. B. A review engagement conducted in accordance with HKSREs, providing limited assurance. C. An agreed upon procedures engagement under HKSRS 4400 (Revised), providing no assurance. D. An assurance engagement under HKSAE 3000 (Revised), providing either reasonable or limited assurance at the practitioner's discretion. Question 3 (MCQ) A regulator requires Everline Limited, a licensed gas supplier, to engage an auditor to report on whether the company has complied with specific pipeline safety regulations during the year. Management does NOT make any written assertion about the company's compliance; the auditor measures and evaluates the company's compliance against the regulations directly, and reports the outcome together with the auditor's conclusion. Under the Hong Kong Framework for Assurance Engagements (Amended), this engagement is: A. An attest engagement, because the auditor is attesting to the company's compliance. B. A non assurance engagement, because the subject matter is non financial information. C. A limited assurance engagement, because the subject matter is compliance rather than financial statements. D. A direct reporting engagement, because the auditor measures the subject matter against the criteria without a written assertion from the responsible party. Question 4 (Scenario MCQ) Vertex & Co, a CPA firm, completed a major project last year for Larkspur Limited, designing and implementing a new accounting and internal control system that now generates all of the company's accounting records and financial statements. Larkspur has now invited Vertex & Co to accept appointment as its external auditor for the current year. Accepting the audit appointment would most directly create which category of threat to the fundamental ethical principles? A. Self review threat. B. Self interest threat. C. Advocacy threat. D. Intimidation threat. Question 5 (MCQ) Which of the following statements about the regulation of auditing in Hong Kong is CORRECT? A. The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong (HKEX) is the statutory licensing body responsible for registering certified public accountants and granting practising certificates. B. The HKICPA Council derives its power to issue standards of practice and statements of ethics from Section 18A of the Professional Accountants Ordinance. C. Hong Kong Standards on Auditing override local laws and regulations where a conflict arises between them. D. The Auditing and Assurance Standards Committee develops Hong Kong auditing standards independently of the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board to suit local circumstances. End of quiz. 答完先好去對答案。

B. Liability Under Contract Law & Common Law

excerpt: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Describe the auditor's legal liability to c…
text: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Describe the auditor's legal liability to clients under contract law, common law and the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), and the available defences. 2. Explain the auditor's liability to third parties, distinguishing the minimum basis of liability and burden of proof for each class of plaintiff. 3. Distinguish ordinary negligence, gross negligence and fraud, and apply the elements of each to audit failure scenarios. 4. Describe the Hong Kong corporate governance framework (CG Code, 'comply or explain', board committees) and the auditor's responsibility to communicate with those charged with governance under HKSA 260 (Revised). 5. Apply the client acceptance and continuance requirements of HKSQM 1 and the preconditions for an audit under HKSA 210. 備註：本章屬法律責任與公司治理，未直接覆蓋 Assertions / audit procedures for specific balances 類目，故必背考點按 Liability / Fraud & Ethics / Governance & Communication / Acceptance & Continuance 組織。 必背考點 A. Auditor's Objectives & Statutory Liability（CO Cap. 622） HKSA 200 para. 11(a)–(b) : 核數師目標係 (a) obtain reasonable assurance （非 absolute assurance）whether the FS as a whole are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error; (b) report on the FS and communicate as required by the HKSAs. CO (Cap. 622) ss.405–406 : auditor must report to shareholders at the AGM on whether the FS show a true and fair view and conform with the CO. CO (Cap. 622) s.407 : auditor also opines on whether adequate accounting records have been kept and whether the FS agree with those records. Failure to comply with ss.405–407 → legal liability to clients. CO Subdivision 5 'Auditor's Liability' (subsection 3) : any provision in the company's articles or contracts that exempts or indemnifies an auditor from liability for negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust is void 。但唔禁止公司幫核數師買保險（insurance against liability, including costs of defending civil/criminal proceedings），亦唔阻止喺核數師勝訴／獲 Court 按 ss.903 或 904 寬免時作出補償。 Criminal liability: auditors can be criminally liable (fine and imprisonment) for knowingly or recklessly omitting required statements from the auditor's report (e.g. adequate accounting records not kept; FS not in agreement with records; information/explanations not obtained) — 4th ed. LP 引用 Companies Bill Clause 398（即新 CO 相關條文）； COE Section R115.1 要求 professional accountants comply with all applicable laws, rules, regulations and standards. B. Liability Under Contract Law & Common Law Engagement letter（HKSA 210 para. 10） 內容必背： 1. Objective and scope of the audit; 2. Responsibilities of the auditor; 3. Responsibilities of management（CO 下 directors 負責編製 true and fair FS）; 4. Identification of the applicable financial reporting framework; 5. Reference to the expected form and content of reports; 6. A statement that the report may differ from its expected form and content. Privity of contract 只存在於 auditor 與 client 之間；breach of contract 例子：遲交 auditor's report、未按 HKSAs 執行審計。Contract law 下嘅抗辯：證明已履行 engagement letter 全部條款。 Ordinary negligence : failure to exercise the standard of care a reasonable person would exercise in like circumstances。Elements: (1) duty of care; (2) breach of that duty; (3) failure to comply with required standard of professional care (HKFRS/HKSA); (4) causation; (5) damages/actual losses. Gross negligence : lack of duty of care indicative of reckless behaviour （例：carrying out the audit without following the HKSAs）；elements 相同但 breach is more egregious 。 Fraud（HKSA 240.11(a)） : intentional act by management / TCWG / employees / third parties, involving deception to obtain an unjust or illegal advantage。Elements to prove fraud: misrepresentation of material facts + knowledge/belief it was false + intent to induce reliance + third party suffered damages. Defences to negligence claims : (1) no duty of care owed（難證明）; (2) performance was not negligent (due diligence); (3) contributory negligence by client/third parties; (4) absence of cause （loss 唔係因為 reliance on auditor's report）. Exhibit 2.1 — Plaintiff 類別（必背表）： Plaintiff Minimum Basis for Liability Burden of Proof Client Ordinary negligence Damage or loss Third party – Primary beneficiary Ordinary negligence Misstated FS or erroneous advice Foreseen beneficiary Gross negligence Reliance upon FS or advice Foreseeable third parties Gross negligence and fraud Deficient auditor conduct 香港法下 auditor 對 third parties 嘅法律責任範圍 limited ，只限於 auditors have an assumed responsibility to identified and particular third parties 。 C. Fraud Responsibility（Ethics 相關） HKSA 240 para. 4 : primary responsibility for the prevention and detection of fraud rests with those charged with governance AND management （TCWG oversight 包括考慮 management override of controls 嘅可能性）。 HKSA 240 para. 5 : inherent limitations of an audit → unavoidable risk that some material misstatements may not be detected even if the audit is properly planned and performed. HKSA 240 para. 33 : auditor must review accounting estimates for biases （包括 retrospective review of prior year significant estimates）and evaluate whether bias represents a risk of material misstatement due to fraud. HKSA 540 (Revised) : 'spectrum of inherent risk' — 複雜 estimates 可構成 fraud risk factor。 考試金句：auditor 唔負責防範／偵查 fraud，但必須 obtain reasonable assurance 並保持 professional scepticism ；audit failure = failing to discover material misstatements or failing to report discovered misstatements to management and TCWG. D. Corporate Governance（HK framework） 定義：process of managing the company for the benefit of its stakeholders , aligning management's interests with shareholders'（agency theory vs regulatory perspective）。 三大 primary functions: Oversight （board of directors）、 Managerial （management）、 Monitoring （shareholders）。 來源：Model Articles、 CO (Cap. 622, effective March 2014) 、 SFO (Cap. 571) 、Common Law、HK Listing Rules（ Appendix 14 CG Code）、Takeover Code。 Appendix 14 兩層建議 ： Code Provisions — listed companies 必須 comply or explain 任何 non compliance; Recommended Best Practices — 自願性 guidance。 CG Code sections: A Directors / B Board evaluation & remuneration / C Accountability and audit / D Delegation by the board / E Communication with shareholders / F Company secretary。 Board of directors : meet regularly（ at least 4 times a year , approx. quarterly）; 組成包括 executive + non executive + INEDs； Listing Rules 要求 INEDs 佔 board 至少 one third ；Chairman 與 Chief Executive 角色 should be separated （如合併須按 Appendix 14 解釋理由）。 必設 committees: nomination / remuneration / audit 。 Audit committee : 只可由 non executive directors 組成； at least 3 members ；其中 至少一名 INED 具備 appropriate professional qualifications or accounting/related financial management expertise。職責：oversee financial reporting、internal control、risk management、code of ethics/whistle blowing、appoint/remove/compensate external auditors and monitor their independence（每年 review auditor appointment）。 Nomination committee : majority INEDs，chairman 由 INED 或 board chairman 出任；duties 見 Appendix 14 para. A5.2 ：(a) review board structure/size/composition at least annually; (b) identify suitably qualified individuals; (c) assess independence of INEDs; (d) recommend appointment/re appointment and succession planning（尤其 chairman 與 chief executive）。 Remuneration committee : formal and transparent procedure for directors' remuneration；no director should decide his/her own remuneration；link pay to performance。 E. Auditor–TCWG Communication & Management Responsibilities HKSA 260 (Revised) Communication with Those Charged with Governance — 溝通目的/事項： auditor's responsibilities 與 engagement terms 的理解； 從 TCWG obtain audit relevant information； overview of planned scope, timing and strategy ； timely observations significant to financial reporting； effective two way communication （preserving independence & objectivity）； significant qualitative aspects of accounting policies, accounting estimates and FS disclosures。 HKSA 540 (Revised) para. 38 : communicate with management/TCWG about estimates giving rise to risk of material misstatement due to estimation uncertainty, complexity, subjectivity or other inherent risk factors. HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 19 （examinable，periods beginning on/after 15 Dec 2021）：risk assessment procedures to understand (a) entity & environment（organizational structure, ownership & governance, business model incl. IT; industry/regulatory factors; performance measures）; (b) applicable financial reporting framework & accounting policies; (c) how inherent risk factors affect susceptibility of assertions to misstatement. Management responsibilities：prepare FS per GAAP（首要責任）、design/implement/monitor internal control & risk management、確保 auditor 有 unrestricted access to records、explanations、attend general meetings。 F. Client Acceptance & Continuance Auditor appointment 次序（CO） : board of directors / audit committee → shareholders at AGM → the court（董事唔委任先輪到股東，股東都唔委任先由 court 委任）。 HKSQM 1 para. 30 （risk based quality objectives，取代 HKSQC 1）: (a) accept/continue judgments based on (i) information about the engagement and integrity and ethical values of the client , and (ii) the firm's ability to perform the engagement per professional standards and legal/regulatory requirements; (b) the firm's financial and operational priorities must not lead to inappropriate acceptance/continuance judgments. HKSA 210 para. 6 — Preconditions for an audit : (a) acceptable financial reporting framework; (b) management acknowledges responsibility for (i) FS preparation, (ii) necessary internal control, (iii) providing access to all information, additional information requested, and unrestricted access to persons within the entity. Client due diligence / AML ：Code Chapter F para. 600.1.4 — 'know your client' procedures，查業務及 ownership structure，防 money laundering。 Predecessor auditor communication ：必須先獲 client permission（否則 outgoing auditor 會違反 confidentiality）；商討事項包括 accounting/audit disagreements、fraud/illegal acts/internal control communications、 reasons for the change of auditors 。Client 拒絕 permission 且無 valid reasons → incoming auditor 應 decline。 Continuing engagements ：每年 revisit acceptance considerations + continued client due diligence（HKSQM 1）；如 management integrity 有疑問（例如發現重大 fraud）→ resign，除非法律強制繼續。 易混淆概念對比 表 1：Ordinary Negligence vs Gross Negligence vs Fraud Ordinary Negligence Gross Negligence Fraud Definition Failure to exercise the standard of care a reasonable person would exercise in like circumstances Lack of duty of care indicative of reckless behaviour (e.g. not following HKSAs at all) Intentional act involving deception to obtain unjust/illegal advantage (HKSA 240.11(a)) Mindset 疏忽、唔小心 魯莽、罔顧後果（程度更嚴重） 故意欺騙 Typical example 冇攞到 sufficient appropriate audit evidence 做 audit 完全唔跟 HKSAs 篡改 working papers、作假陳述 Liable to Client + primary beneficiary Foreseen/foreseeable third parties Foreseeable third parties 點樣分辨 問「有冇合理謹慎？」冇 = ordinary 問「係咪完全忽視專業準則？」= gross 問「係咪 intentional？」有 intent 先係 fraud 考試伏位 見「unintentional overstatement」係 error 唔係 fraud；gross negligence 唔需要 intent，但 fraud 必須有 intent to deceive 表 2：Code Provisions vs Recommended Best Practices（Appendix 14） Code Provisions Recommended Best Practices Status 'Comply or explain' — 上市公司必須遵守，否則解釋 non compliance 自願性 guidance，幫 issuer 設計自己嘅 CG measures Mandatory? 唔係 mandatory rules，但唔遵守就要 explain 完全自願，唔使解釋 適用對象 HKEX listed companies only（principles based, non statutory） 同上 例子 Chairman/CEO roles should be separated（如合併須給予理由） 每季度 45 日內公佈業績、audit committee 設 whistleblowing policy 點樣分辨 題目問「must comply or explain」→ Code Provision 問「encouraged / voluntary」→ RBP 考試伏位 CG Code 唔係法例 （non statutory），違反唔等於犯法；但 CO (Cap. 622) 先係 statutory framework — 兩者唔好撈亂 Phase 2 閃卡（8 cards） Card 1 Front: What are the auditor's two objectives under HKSA 200 para. 11(a)–(b)? Back: (a) Obtain reasonable assurance about whether the FS as a whole are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error, enabling expression of an opinion on whether the FS are prepared, in all material respects, in accordance with the applicable financial reporting framework; (b) Report on the FS, and communicate as required by the HKSAs, in accordance with the auditor's findings. 💬 記住係 reasonable （高但非絕對）assurance，因為 audit 有 inherent limitations（抽樣、依賴管理層陳述等）；如果題目講 absolute assurance 一定錯。 Card 2 Front: Who bears the primary responsibility for the prevention and detection of fraud, and what is the auditor's responsibility? (HKSA 240) Back: Primary responsibility: those charged with governance and management (HKSA 240 para. 4), including oversight of the potential for management override of controls. Auditor: obtain reasonable assurance that the FS are free from material misstatement whether caused by fraud or error. HKSA 240 para. 5: due to inherent limitations , some material misstatements may not be detected even in a properly planned and performed audit. 💬 考試必考陷阱：「auditor 負責防止同偵查 fraud」= 錯。Auditor 嘅責任係合理保證＋professional scepticism，唔係捉賊。 Card 3 Front: List the six items typically included in an engagement letter per HKSA 210 para. 10. Back: 1. Objective and scope of the audit; 2. Responsibilities of the auditor; 3. Responsibilities of management; 4. Identification of the applicable financial reporting framework; 5. Reference to the expected form and content of any reports; 6. A statement that a report may differ from its expected form and content. 💬 Engagement letter 係 auditor 同 client 嘅 書面合約 ，確立 privity of contract；contract law 下嘅抗辯就係證明已履行晒入面所有條款。 Card 4 Front: What are the five elements required to prove ordinary negligence against an auditor? Back: 1. Duty of care — the care others in the profession would exercise in similar circumstances; 2. Breach of that duty of care; 3. Failure to comply with the required standard of reasonable professional care (HKFRS/HKSA and other rules); 4. Causation — causal link between negligence and the plaintiff's losses; 5. Damages — actual losses incurred. 💬 記口訣 D B C C D（Duty, Breach, Compliance failure, Causation, Damages）。Gross negligence elements 一樣，分別在於 breach 程度更 egregious（reckless）。 Card 5 Front: State the four defences available to an auditor facing a negligence claim. Back: 1. No duty of care was owed (difficult to prove); 2. Performance was not negligent — due diligence was exercised; 3. Contributory negligence by the client and/or third parties; 4. Absence of cause — reliance on the auditor's report was not the reason for the financial loss. 💬 Contributory negligence 例子：client 收埋關鍵資料（如匿名告密信）唔話畀 auditor 知；absence of cause 例子：債權人無論 audit opinion 點都會照借錢。 Card 6 Front: Under CO (Cap. 622) Subdivision 5, what happens to provisions that exempt or indemnify an auditor from liability, and what is still permitted? Back: Any provision in articles/contracts exempting or indemnifying an auditor (of the company or an associated company) from liability for negligence, default, breach of duty or trust is void . Still permitted: (1) company taking out and maintaining insurance for the auditor against such liabilities (including defence costs in civil/criminal proceedings); (2) indemnifying the auditor where judgement is given in the auditor's favour, the auditor is acquitted, or relief is granted by the Court under ss.903 or 904 . 💬 考試伏位：「公司可以喺 articles 加條款豁免核數師疏忽責任」= 錯，條款 void；但「公司可以幫核數師買保險」= 啱。 Card 7 Front: What are the Listing Rules / CG Code composition requirements for the audit committee of a Hong Kong listed company? Back: Composed of non executive directors only ; At least three members ; At least one independent non executive director with appropriate professional qualifications or accounting/related financial management expertise; Oversees financial reporting, internal control, risk management, audit activities (appoint/remove/compensate external auditors, monitor independence), code of ethics and whistle blowing. 💬 記住「NEDs only + ≥3 + ≥1 INED 會計專才」。Executive director（如 CFO）坐入 audit committee = 即時違規，呢個係常見 scenario 陷阱。 Card 8 Front: What quality objectives does HKSQM 1 para. 30 require a firm to establish for client acceptance and continuance? Back: (a) Acceptance/continuance judgments are appropriate based on: (i) information about the nature and circumstances of the engagement and the integrity and ethical values of the client (management and, where appropriate, TCWG); and (ii) the firm's ability to perform the engagement in accordance with professional standards and applicable legal/regulatory requirements; (b) The firm's financial and operational priorities do not lead to inappropriate acceptance/continuance judgments. 💬 HKSQM 1 係 risk based，取代咗 HKSQC 1。常見 red flags：頻密換 auditor、director 被調查、異常豐厚 audit fee + 豪華招待（self interest threat）、client 拒絕畀 predecessor auditor 溝通權限。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Reasonable assurance 合理保證——高水平但非百分之百嘅保證 The auditor obtains reasonable, not absolute, assurance that the financial statements are free from material misstatement (HKSA 200.11(a)). Privity of contract 合約關係只存在於簽約雙方（auditor 同 client）之間 Because of privity of contract, a third party generally cannot sue the auditor under contract law. Ordinary negligence 普通过失——冇盡一般人喺同樣情況下應有嘅謹慎 Failing to gather sufficient appropriate audit evidence may constitute ordinary negligence. Gross negligence 嚴重過失——近乎罔顧後果嘅魯莽行為 Carrying out an audit without following the HKSAs is indicative of gross negligence. Contributory negligence 分擔過失——原告自己都有份造成損失 The auditor may defend a negligence claim by proving contributory negligence on the part of the client. 'Comply or explain' 「遵守或解釋」——唔遵守 Code Provision 就要解釋原因 Under Appendix 14, listed companies must comply with the Code Provisions or explain any non compliance. Those charged with governance (TCWG) 負責治理嘅人——通常係董事會同審計委員會 HKSA 260 (Revised) requires the auditor to communicate significant audit findings with those charged with governance. Client due diligence 客戶盡職審查——接客前查清楚客戶背景同洗錢風險 Client due diligence procedures help the firm assess the integrity of the prospective client before acceptance.

title: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), Part on 'Au…
text: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), Part on 'Auditor's Liability' (Subdivision 5, subsection 3), any provision — whether in the company's articles, a contract or otherwise — that exempts an auditor of the company (or of an associated company) from, or indemnifies the auditor against, any liability for negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust in relation to the performance of the auditor's duties is void . However, the same subsection does not prevent a company from taking out and maintaining insurance for an auditor against such liability, including liability incurred in defending civil or criminal proceedings. It also does not prevent indemnifying an auditor who successfully defends proceedings, is acquitted, or is granted relief by the Court under ss.903 or 904. Therefore the articles clause is void, but the insurance purchase is permitted. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 CO 對「豁免核數師責任條款」嘅處理。核心規則好清晰：豁免／彌償條款 void（無效） ，但 買保險係允許嘅 。A 錯因為 clause 唔可能 valid；C 錯因為保險係明文允許；D 錯因為就算股東特別決議通過，條款依然 void——法例直接令呢類條款無效，唔係程序問題。記住口訣：「 豁免 = void；保險 = OK 」。 Rule Check: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), 'Auditor's Liability' provisions (Subdivision 5, subsection 3); relief under ss.903–904 (as cited in LP Ch. 2, s.2.1.3) Common Trap（繁中）: 學生常誤以為「股東批准就可以豁免核數師責任」——錯，條款本身 void，任何批准都救唔返。亦有人反轉記成「保險都唔准買」，其實法例只係禁止 company 喺條款上免除/彌償責任，唔禁止投保。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Pearl Delta Bank is a third party primary beneficiary : it was specifically identified to the auditor before the report was issued, and the auditor knew the audited financial statements would be used by the bank for the particular purpose of the loan decision. Under common law (per the plaintiff/liability framework in Exhibit 2.1 of the LP), the minimum basis for an auditor's liability to a third party primary beneficiary is ordinary negligence , with the burden of proof on the plaintiff being misstated financial statements or erroneous advice. The misstatements here would have been detected by a reasonably careful audit, so ordinary negligence is established. 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵係辨認原告類別。Pearl Delta Bank 喺 audit report 簽發前已 書面表明身份同用途 （loan application），auditor 知情——呢啲係 identified / primary beneficiary 嘅特徵，所以最低責任基礎係 ordinary negligence 。A 錯：fraud 需要 auditor 有 intent to deceive，題目冇；C 錯：「foreseen beneficiary」嘅最低基礎係 gross negligence，但本案銀行唔止 foreseen——佢係明確 identified，屬 primary beneficiary；D 錯：雖然銀行同 auditor 無 privity of contract，但 common law 下 third party liability 唔需要 privity，auditor 對 identified third parties 有 assumed responsibility。香港法下 third party liability 範圍雖然 limited，但正正就係限於呢類 identified and particular third parties。 Rule Check: LP Ch. 2 Exhibit 2.1 (plaintiff classes: primary beneficiary → ordinary negligence, burden of proof = misstated financial statements or erroneous advice); auditor's assumed responsibility to identified third parties under Hong Kong common law (LP s.2.1.1/2.1.2.1) Common Trap（繁中）: 最大陷阱係將「foreseen」同「identified/primary beneficiary」撈亂——題目話「in writing before the report is signed」就係要話你知佢係 primary beneficiary。另外唔好以為「冇合約關係就一定唔使賠」。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Kwok & Co's conduct amounts to gross negligence : it arises from a lack of duty of care indicative of reckless behaviour , and the LP expressly gives the failure to follow the HKSAs when carrying out the audit as an example of gross negligence. Deliberately omitting all substantive procedures on the revenue cycle and disregarding mandatory HKSA requirements is more egregious than a mere failure to exercise reasonable care. It is not fraud because there was no intentional misrepresentation or intent to deceive; fraud requires an intentional act involving deception (HKSA 240). 解題思路（繁中）: 分辨三層責任：(1) Ordinary negligence = 冇盡合理謹慎（例如證據唔夠）；(2) Gross negligence = reckless，LP 明講「failure to follow the HKSAs when carrying out the audit」就係例子——本案 audit manager 刻意省略所有 substantive procedures 兼唔跟 HKSAs ，正中此例；(3) Fraud = 必須有 intentional deception ，題目講明「no intention to deceive」所以排除 A。B 錯在於程度：純粹慳時間而全面唔跟準則，已超越 ordinary negligence 嘅「唔小心」。D 錯：gross negligence 唔需要 intent。 Rule Check: LP Ch. 2 s.2.1.2.1 (ordinary negligence vs gross negligence elements; gross negligence = reckless behaviour, e.g. failure to follow the HKSAs); HKSA 240 para. 11(a) definition of fraud Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「deliberately not performing procedures」好多學生會揀 fraud——記住 fraud 嘅核心係 deception / intent to obtain unjust advantage ，唔係懶或 reckless。冇 intent to deceive → 頂多 gross negligence。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The proposed audit committee does not comply with the Listing Rules. An audit committee of a Hong Kong listed company must comprise non executive directors only , have at least three members , and include at least one independent non executive director with appropriate professional qualifications or accounting or related financial management expertise. Appointing the Chief Financial Officer — an executive director — as chair breaches the 'non executive directors only' requirement, regardless of the CFO's accounting qualification. 解題思路（繁中）: 三條規則逐個 check：① NEDs only — CFO 係 executive director， 違規 ；② ≥3 members — 符合；③ ≥1 INED with accounting expertise — 有一位 INED 會計專家，符合。所以唯一錯處係 CFO 坐入 committee，答案 B。A 錯：人數同專才達標唔可以抵消 NEDs only 要求；C 錯：Listing Rules 要求 at least three ，唔係 five；D 係精心陷阱：「comply or explain」適用於 CG Code 嘅 Code Provisions （例如 chairman/CEO 分設），但 audit committee 嘅組成係 Listing Rules 硬性要求 （must comprise NEDs only），唔可以靠披露理由就算合規。 Rule Check: Hong Kong Listing Rules / CG Code — audit committee composition (non executive directors only; minimum three members; at least one INED with professional/accounting qualifications), as stated in LP Ch. 2 s.2.2.5 Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個伏位：(1) 以為 CFO 係會計專才就可以做 audit committee 主席——身份（NED only）同資格（accounting expertise）係兩個獨立要求；(2) 亂用 'comply or explain' 當萬能擋箭牌——佢只適用於 Code Provisions 層面，Listing Rules 嘅硬性組成規定唔適用。 Q5 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under the Hong Kong Corporate Governance Code (Appendix 14 to the Listing Rules), the roles of chairman and chief executive should be separated . All listed companies are required to separate the roles; if they choose to combine them, they must give their reasons for doing so in accordance with Appendix 14 (the 'comply or explain' approach). The board should properly communicate its decision and rationale to shareholders. Separation is favoured because it strengthens board independence and reduces potential conflicts of interest and concentration of power. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 CG Code 嘅性質：佢係 principles based, non statutory 文件，行 'comply or explain'。Chairman/CEO 分設係 Code 要求，但唔係絕對禁令——合併可以， 必須解釋理由 。A 錯：呢個係 CG Code / Listing Rules 嘅事，唔係 CO (Cap. 622) 嘅刑事式禁令，兩個規管來源唔好撈亂；C 錯：chairman/CEO 分設屬 Code Provision 層級（comply or explain），唔係 Recommended Best Practice，所以唔可以「唔使披露」；D 錯：SFC 唔負責審批呢類公司治理安排。 Rule Check: Hong Kong Corporate Governance Code, Appendix 14 to the Listing Rules — separation of chairman and chief executive roles with reasons required if combined (LP Ch. 2 s.2.2.4, 'Chairman and Chief Executive') Common Trap（繁中）: 最常見錯誤係將 CG Code 當成法例（揀 A）。記住層級： CO (Cap. 622) = statutory ； Listing Rules = 硬性上市規定 ； CG Code = comply or explain 。題目問 CG Code 義務時，答案通常係「照做，否則解釋」而唔係「禁止」。
