excerpt: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申…
text: M8 Chapter 2: Legal Liability and Corporate Governance — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) The articles of association of Bright Harbour Limited, a Hong Kong incorporated company, contain a clause stating that the company's auditor shall not be liable to the company for any negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust in relation to the performance of the auditor's duties. The board is also considering whether the company may purchase insurance for the auditor against liabilities arising from the audit. Which of the following correctly states the position under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622)? A. The clause in the articles is valid, and the company may also purchase insurance for the auditor. B. The clause in the articles is void, but the company may purchase insurance for the auditor against liability arising from defending civil or criminal proceedings. C. The clause in the articles is void, and the company is prohibited from purchasing insurance for the auditor. D. The clause in the articles is valid, but only if approved by the shareholders by special resolution at a general meeting. Question 2 (Scenario MCQ) Cedar Textiles Limited is negotiating a HK$20 million loan from Pearl Delta Bank. Pearl Delta Bank informs Cedar's auditor, Lo & Co, in writing before the audit report is signed that it requires the audited financial statements specifically to assess this loan application. Lo & Co issues an unmodified auditor's report addressed to the shareholders, knowing the report will be given to Pearl Delta Bank for this purpose. The financial statements are subsequently found to contain material misstatements that a reasonably careful audit would have detected. Pearl Delta Bank relied on the audited financial statements, advanced the loan, and suffered a loss when Cedar Textiles Limited collapsed. Under common law, what is the minimum basis on which Lo & Co may be held liable to Pearl Delta Bank? A. Fraud, because Pearl Delta Bank is a foreseeable third party. B. Ordinary negligence, because Pearl Delta Bank is a third party primary beneficiary. C. Gross negligence, because Pearl Delta Bank is a foreseen beneficiary. D. No liability can arise, because Pearl Delta Bank has no privity of contract with Lo & Co. Question 3 (Scenario MCQ) During the audit of Marina Logistics Limited for the year ended 31 December 20X3, the audit manager of Kwok & Co decided, purely to save time, not to perform any substantive procedures on the revenue cycle and not to follow several mandatory requirements of the HKSAs. There is no evidence that any member of the audit team intended to deceive anyone. A material misstatement in revenue was not detected, and the client suffered losses as a result. Which of the following best describes Kwok & Co's potential liability to the client? A. Fraud, because a material misstatement was not detected. B. Ordinary negligence, because the audit manager failed to gather sufficient appropriate audit evidence. C. Gross negligence, because the failure to follow the HKSAs when carrying out the audit indicates reckless behaviour. D. No liability, because there was no intention to deceive the client. Question 4 (Scenario MCQ) Victoria Peak Holdings Limited, a company listed on the Main Board of the HKEX, proposes the following audit committee: Chair: the company's Chief Financial Officer (an executive director), who is a HKICPA member; Member: an independent non executive director with accounting expertise; Member: an independent non executive director with legal expertise. Which of the following statements is correct regarding this proposed audit committee? A. The composition complies with the Listing Rules because the committee has three members and includes an accounting expert. B. The composition does not comply with the Listing Rules because an audit committee must comprise non executive directors only. C. The composition does not comply with the Listing Rules because an audit committee must have at least five members. D. The composition complies with the Listing Rules because the 'comply or explain' approach allows the company to appoint an executive director as chair if reasons are disclosed. Question 5 (MCQ) Dragon Peak Properties Limited, a Hong Kong listed company, proposes that Mr. Chan should hold both the role of chairman of the board and the role of chief executive. Which of the following best describes the company's obligation under the Hong Kong Corporate Governance Code (Appendix 14)? A. Combining the two roles is strictly prohibited by the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622). B. The company may combine the two roles but must give its reasons for doing so, because the roles of chairman and chief executive should be separated under the Code. C. The company may freely combine the two roles with no disclosure, because this is only a Recommended Best Practice. D. The company must obtain prior approval from the Securities and Futures Commission before combining the two roles.

title: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Planning & Risk Assessment（核心框架）
B. Risk Model & Materiality 相關定義（本章範圍）
F. Report Modifications Overview（HKSA 700 (Revised)，詳見 Ch9）
excerpt: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the four stages of an audit and the objective of audit plan…
text: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the four stages of an audit and the objective of audit planning under HKSA 300 Planning an Audit of Financial Statements . 2. Identify and assess the risks of material misstatement at the financial statement level and the assertion level in accordance with HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) Identifying and Assessing the Risks of Material Misstatement . 3. Describe the five components of the system of internal control and evaluate control activities relevant to the audit. 4. Distinguish the seven audit methodologies (risk based, top down, system based, systems audit, balance sheet approach, transaction cycle approach, directional testing) and their advantages/disadvantages. 5. Apply the auditor's responsibilities relating to fraud under HKSA 240, including fraud risk factors and audit responses. 必背考點 A. Planning & Risk Assessment（核心框架） Four stages of an audit（LP §3.1） 1. Risk assessment stage — understand the client, its environment; identify risks that could cause material misstatement. 2. Risk response stage — devise responses: tests of control + substantive procedures. 3. Evidence gathering stage — 'detailed audit fieldwork'; gather sufficient appropriate audit evidence. 4. Reporting stage — review evidence, form opinion, issue auditor's report per HKSA 700 (Revised) . HKSA 300 — objective & benefits Objective: plan the audit so that it will be performed in an effective manner （LP 引述 HKSA 300）。 HKSA 300 para. 2 — benefits of adequate planning: (i) devote appropriate attention to important areas; (ii) identify and resolve potential problems on a timely basis; (iii) properly organize and manage the engagement effectively and efficiently; (iv) assist selection of engagement team members with appropriate capabilities/competence and assignment of work; (v) facilitate direction, supervision and review; (vi) assist coordination of work done by component auditors and experts. Audit planning is a continuous process — the plan may need revision (e.g. new fraud risk factors found during fieldwork); all changes must be documented with reasons. Audit strategy vs audit plan Audit strategy = high level plan of how the audit will be tackled; audit plan = detailed operational plan of how the strategy is achieved (nature, timing, extent of procedures). Risk assessment procedures（HKSA 315 (Revised 2019)） Performed through: inquiries of management; analytical procedures; observation and inspection . HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) requires the auditor to 'stand back' after risk assessment to evaluate whether all risks of material misstatement have been identified. Understanding required at three levels: entity level (operations, ownership/governance, investments, structure & financing — HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) App. 1 para. 5), industry level (market & competition, cyclical/seasonal activity, product technology, energy supply/cost — para. A68) and economy level (recession, interest rates, currency fluctuations — para. A70). B. Risk Model & Materiality 相關定義（本章範圍） Audit risk (Glossary of Terms / HKSA 200): the risk that the auditor expresses an inappropriate audit opinion when the financial statements are materially misstated. Audit risk = function of risks of material misstatement × detection risk . Risk of material misstatement (RoMM) = inherent risk × control risk (exists before the audit starts): Inherent risk — susceptibility of an assertion to a misstatement that could be material, before consideration of any related controls . Control risk — risk that a material misstatement will not be prevented, or detected and corrected, on a timely basis by the entity's internal control . Detection risk ( HKSA 200.13(e) ): the risk that the auditor's procedures will not detect a misstatement that exists and could be material. → 唯一受 auditor 控制嘅 risk ；detection risk 與 substantive procedures 嘅 extent 成反比。 Spectrum of inherent risk (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) / HKSA 540 (Revised)): the degree to which inherent risk varies; the higher on the spectrum, the more persuasive the audit evidence needed. Significant risk ( HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(l) ): an identified RoMM (i) for which inherent risk is assessed close to the upper end of the spectrum , or (ii) treated as significant per other HKSAs. Consider: fraud risk; recent significant economic/accounting developments; complexity; related party transactions; subjectivity/measurement uncertainty; unusual transactions outside normal course of business. Misstatement ( HKSA 450.4(a) ): a difference between the reported amount/classification/presentation/disclosure of an item and what is required under the applicable financial reporting framework. Can arise from error or fraud . Business risk ( HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(b) ): a risk resulting from significant conditions, events, circumstances, actions or inactions that could adversely affect the entity's ability to achieve its objectives and execute its strategies. Business risk is broader than RoMM but includes it → auditor uses a business risk approach (look at the business in its entirety; evaluate risks; consider impact on the FS). C. Assertions（HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. A190） Assertions about classes of transactions and events, and related disclosures (para. A190(a)): Occurrence — transactions/events recorded have occurred and pertain to the entity. Completeness — all transactions/events that should have been recorded have been recorded. Accuracy — amounts/data recorded appropriately. Cut off — recorded in the correct accounting period. Classification — recorded in the proper accounts. Presentation — appropriately aggregated/disaggregated and clearly described. Assertions about account balances, and related disclosures at period end (para. A190(b)): Existence — assets/liabilities/equity exist. Rights and obligations — entity holds/controls rights to assets; liabilities are obligations of the entity. Completeness — all assets/liabilities/equity that should have been recorded have been recorded. Accuracy, valuation and allocation — included at appropriate amounts; valuation/allocation adjustments appropriately recorded. Classification — recorded in the proper accounts. Presentation — appropriately aggregated/disaggregated; disclosures relevant and understandable. Directional testing（方向性測試） : assets & expenses tested for overstatement (vouch from records → source documents = existence/occurrence); liabilities & income tested for understatement (trace from source documents → records = completeness). D. Procedures & Evidence HKSA 500 Audit Evidence — auditor must obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence: Sufficiency = quantity of evidence; Appropriateness = quality (relevance and reliability). Types of audit procedures recognised by HKSA 500: inspection; observation; external confirmation; recalculation; reperformance; analytical procedures; inquiry . Tests of control vs substantive procedures Tests of control — test the operating effectiveness of the client's internal controls; not designed to detect material misstatement; do not focus on a monetary amount. Substantive procedures — designed to detect material misstatement in the FS (tests of detail + substantive analytical procedures). Key rule : the auditor can never eliminate substantive procedures entirely — inherent limitations of internal control (human error; ineffective controls; collusion; management override; management judgement on extent of controls). Five components of the system of internal control (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(m)): 1. Control environment — governance/management functions + attitudes, awareness, actions of TCWG and management; sets the 'tone at the top' (integrity & ethical values; effectiveness of controls cannot rise above the integrity of the people who create/administer/monitor them). 2. The entity's risk assessment process — how management identifies/manages business risks. 3. The entity's process to monitor the system of internal control — management assessing effectiveness of controls over time (ongoing or separate evaluations; e.g. timeliness/accuracy of bank reconciliations). 4. The information system and communication — procedures/records to initiate, record, process and report transactions. 5. Control activities — authorisation and approvals; reconciliations; verifications; physical or logical controls; segregation of duties (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 15 examples). Significant deficiency in internal control → must be communicated to TCWG per HKSA 265 Communicating Deficiencies in Internal Control to Those Charged with Governance and Management . Engagement letter (HKSA 210) Objective: accept/continue only when preconditions present + common understanding of terms. Preconditions (HKSA 210.6) : (1) acceptable financial reporting framework; (2) management acknowledges responsibility for (a) preparation of FS, (b) necessary internal control, (c) providing auditor access to all information + additional information + unrestricted access to persons. If preconditions absent → decline or resign (unless required by law/regulation). Contents: objective & scope; auditor's responsibilities; management's responsibilities (under Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) directors prepare FS showing true and fair view); applicable financial reporting framework; expected form/content of reports; statement that the report may differ from expected form/content. Legally binding contract; sent to new clients before work starts ; reviewed each year for existing clients (reissue only on change of circumstances). Audit documentation (HKSA 230) HKSA 230.2 : documentation provides evidence of (1) the basis for the auditor's conclusion on achieving the overall objectives; (2) that the audit was planned and performed per HKSAs and legal/regulatory requirements. HKSA 230.8 : sufficient to enable an experienced auditor with no previous connection to the audit to understand nature/timing/extent of procedures, results and evidence obtained, and significant matters/judgements. E. Ethics / Fraud（HKSA 240） Primary responsibility for prevention and detection of fraud rests with management and TCWG — NOT the auditor. Auditor's objectives ( HKSA 240.10 ): (1) identify and assess RoMM due to fraud; (2) obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence via designed responses; (3) respond appropriately to fraud/suspected fraud identified. Fraud = intentional act using deception for unjust/illegal advantage. Two types: fraudulent financial reporting (deliberately misstating FS, e.g. fictitious sales) and misappropriation of assets (theft, e.g. fictitious supplier/ghost employee). Fraud vs error distinction = intentional or unintentional . Fraud risk factors (HKSA 240.11(b)): events/conditions indicating incentive/pressure or opportunity — e.g. profit related bonus pressure; loan covenants; dominant manager; missing/doctored documents (fraudulent financial reporting); weak controls, high value inventory/cash, disgruntled employees, employees not taking leave (misappropriation). A fraud risk factor ≠ proof of fraud. Risk assessment procedures ( HKSA 240.17–18 ): inquiries of management / internal audit / TCWG about actual/suspected/alleged fraud; evaluate unusual analytical relationships; consider other information; evaluate fraud risk factors. Responses: written representations ( HKSA 580 ); test journal entries/adjustments near year end; test accounting estimates for bias; unpredictable procedures ; assign experienced staff. Professional scepticism must be maintained throughout, regardless of past experience of management's honesty/integrity. Fraud discovered → communicate on a timely basis to appropriate level of management; if fraud involves management → TCWG ; doubts over TCWG integrity → seek legal advice ; legal duty to report to third parties (e.g. ICAC, Police, SFC, HKMA) overrides confidentiality. F. Report Modifications Overview（HKSA 700 (Revised)，詳見 Ch9） Opinion type When used Unmodified opinion FS free from material misstatement; prepared per applicable framework (best opinion). Qualified 'except for' opinion Material but not pervasive misstatement, or material but not pervasive scope limitation. Adverse opinion Misstatement is material AND pervasive (FS do not give true and fair view). Disclaimer of opinion Unable to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence and possible effects could be pervasive (no opinion expressed). Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern (MURGC) paragraph (HKSA 570 (Revised)): used ONLY when the material uncertainty is adequately disclosed ; inadequate disclosure → modified opinion instead (MURGC inappropriate). Key Audit Matters (HKSA 701) : mandatory for listed entities ; matters of most significance in the auditor's professional judgement, selected from matters communicated to TCWG (HKSA 701.8, 701.9(a)–(c)). Non listed entities may include KAM voluntarily. 易混淆概念對比 表 1：Audit Risk / Business Risk / Audit Failure / Business Failure Term Meaning (EN) 點樣分辨／考試伏位 Audit risk Risk that the auditor expresses an inappropriate opinion when FS are materially misstated = RoMM × detection risk 係「auditor 講錯嘢」嘅風險；只有 detection risk 係 auditor 控制到。伏位：唔好寫成「FS 有 misstatement 嘅風險」（嗰個係 RoMM）。 Business risk Risk from conditions/events/circumstances/actions/inactions adversely affecting the entity's ability to achieve objectives and strategies (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(b)) 係「間公司」面對嘅風險， broader than RoMM （包含但唔等於）。external factors（利率、匯率、競爭）＝business risk；資本化錯誤、cut off 錯誤＝audit/FS risk。 Audit failure Auditor's report incorrectly states FS are correct when they contain errors/false statements 係 audit risk 真正發生咗 嘅結果；通常因 poor planning、無經驗員工、procedures 唔足、deadline 太趕。後果：罰款、HKICPA 紀律處分、禁做 audit。 Business failure Entity runs out of cash → liquidation/bankruptcy（包括 profitable 公司 over trading ） 公司倒閉 唔等於 auditor 有錯；考生常混淆——business failure 之後 users 先會話 auditor negligence（嗰啲先係 audit failure）。 表 2：Tests of Control vs Substantive Procedures Tests of control Substantive procedures Purpose (EN) Test the operating effectiveness of internal controls Detect material misstatements in the FS Focus The controls that generate the financial reports — no monetary amount Transactions, balances, disclosures (monetary amounts) When used When auditor plans to rely on internal controls Always required for material balances — can never be eliminated entirely Effect on the other Effective controls → reduce substantive procedures Weak/absent controls → extend substantive procedures 點樣分辨／考試伏位 見到「檢查 control 有冇運作」（如觀察授權步驟、reperform bank reconciliation）＝ToC 見到「搵錯數」（confirm receivables、recalculate depreciation、cut off testing）＝substantive。Jun 2023 考官報告：考生唔明 control risk 低 → substantive 少 呢個 inverse relationship。 Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: What are the four stages of an audit, and what happens in each? Back: Risk assessment stage — understand the client and its environment; identify risks that could cause material misstatement. Risk response stage — devise responses: tests of control and substantive procedures. Evidence gathering stage — 'detailed fieldwork': gather sufficient appropriate audit evidence. Reporting stage — review evidence, conclude, form opinion and issue the auditor's report (HKSA 700 (Revised)). 💬 記住順序：「 評 → 應 → 證 → 報 」。Planning 唔係做一次就算，係 continuous process，有新發現（例如 fraud risk factors）就要修訂 plan 兼 document 低原因。 Card 2 Front: Define audit risk and its components. Which component is controllable by the auditor? Back: Audit risk = risk the auditor expresses an inappropriate opinion when FS are materially misstated (Glossary of Terms; HKSA 200). Audit risk = risk of material misstatement × detection risk . RoMM = inherent risk × control risk (both exist before the audit; auditor cannot control them, only assess them). Detection risk (HKSA 200.13(e)) = risk the auditor's procedures fail to detect a material misstatement → the only risk under the auditor's control . 💬 考官伏位：RoMM 係「未 audit 之前已存在」，auditor 唔可以降低佢；auditor 只可以做多啲/好啲 procedures 去壓低 detection risk。Control risk 低 → substantive testing 可以少啲（inverse relationship）。 Card 3 Front: List the benefits of adequate audit planning per HKSA 300 para. 2. Back: Devote appropriate attention to important areas of the audit. Identify and resolve potential problems on a timely basis. Properly organize and manage the engagement effectively and efficiently. Assist selection of team members with appropriate capabilities/competence and assignment of work. Facilitate direction, supervision and review of the team's work. Assist coordination of work by component auditors and experts. 💬 六點全背，「List」題常客。注意：「save costs」同「reduce substantive testing」 唔係 HKSA 300.2 嘅 benefit（嗰啲係有效內控嘅效果）——MCQ 經常放呢兩個做 distractor。 Card 4 Front: What are the preconditions for an audit under HKSA 210, and what must the auditor do if they are not present? Back: 1. Determine the financial reporting framework is acceptable. 2. Obtain management's agreement that it acknowledges responsibility for: (a) preparation of the FS per the applicable framework; (b) internal control necessary to prepare FS free from material misstatement; (c) providing the auditor with all relevant information + additional information + unrestricted access to persons . If preconditions not present → decline or resign , unless required by law/regulation to continue. 💬 Engagement letter 係 legally binding contract；新客開工前必發，舊客 每年 review （唔係每年必發新信——有情況改變如換管理層、改 reporting framework 先需要更新）。呢個「每年發 vs 每年 review」係常見陷阱。 Card 5 Front: List the five components of the system of internal control (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(m)) and the five examples of control activities. Back: Five components: Control environment; Entity's risk assessment process; Process to monitor the system of internal control; Information system and communication; Control activities . Control activities examples: Authorisation and approvals; Reconciliations; Verifications; Physical or logical controls; Segregation of duties . 💬 分層記法：五大 components 係「層級」，control activities 係第五層入面嘅具體動作。常見混淆：「commitment to integrity」屬 control environment ；「segregation of duties」屬 control activities ；「management 定期 review controls」屬 monitoring 。仲有：內控再好都 唔可以唔做 substantive procedures （inherent limitations：human error、collusion、management override 等）。 Card 6 Front: State the assertions for (a) classes of transactions and events and (b) account balances per HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. A190. Back: (a) Transactions/events (para. A190(a)): Occurrence, Completeness, Accuracy, Cut off, Classification, Presentation . (b) Account balances (para. A190(b)): Existence, Rights and obligations, Completeness, Accuracy/valuation/allocation, Classification, Presentation . 💬 分辨口訣：transactions 用 OCCAC P （有 occurrence 同 cut off）；balances 用 ERCAP （有 existence 同 rights & obligations， 冇 occurrence/cut off）。Directional testing：由 ledger 查到 source documents（vouching）＝ existence/occurrence（overstatement）；由 source documents 追入 ledger（tracing）＝ completeness（understatement）。 Card 7 Front: What is a 'significant risk' and what factors indicate one? Back: Definition (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(l)): identified RoMM where inherent risk is assessed close to the upper end of the spectrum of inherent risk , or treated as significant per other HKSAs. Indicators: risk of fraud ; recent significant economic/accounting developments; complex transactions; significant related party transactions; high subjectivity / measurement uncertainty ; unusual transactions outside normal course of business. If significant risk identified → must obtain understanding of relevant controls over it; if management has no controls over it → significant deficiency → report to TCWG (HKSA 265). 💬 Spectrum of inherent risk 越高 → evidence 要越 persuasive 。考試鍾意問「邊樣係 significant risk」：新會計準則首年採用、重大 judgment/estimate（如 WIP 估值由無經驗員工做）都係典型答案。 Card 8 Front: Who is responsible for preventing and detecting fraud, and what are the auditor's objectives and responses under HKSA 240? Back: Prevention/detection of fraud = management + TCWG (primary responsibility). Auditor's objectives (HKSA 240.10): identify/assess RoMM due to fraud; obtain sufficient appropriate evidence via responses; respond appropriately to fraud identified. Responses: written representations (HKSA 580); test journal entries near year end; review accounting estimates for bias; unpredictable procedures; experienced staff. Fraud found → tell appropriate level of management; fraud involving management → TCWG ; doubts over TCWG integrity → legal advice ; statutory reporting (ICAC, Police, SFC etc.) overrides confidentiality. 💬 考生常錯：以為 auditor 負責 prevent/detect fraud——錯！Auditor 只負責 obtain reasonable assurance FS 無 material misstatement（whether due to fraud or error），並且無論過往經驗都要 keep professional scepticism 。Fraud vs error 嘅分別係 intentional vs unintentional 。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Audit risk 核數師出錯意見嘅風險 Audit risk is the risk that the auditor expresses an inappropriate opinion when the financial statements are materially misstated. Detection risk 查唔出錯嘅風險（唯一受核數師控制） Detection risk is the only component of audit risk that is under the auditor's control. Inherent risk 未計內控前嘅天生風險 Inherent risk is the susceptibility of an assertion to material misstatement before consideration of any related controls. Significant risk 接近 inherent risk 光譜上限嘅重大風險 A significant risk is an identified risk of material misstatement close to the upper end of the spectrum of inherent risk. Tests of control 測內控有冇有效運作（唔係搵錯數） Tests of control evaluate the operating effectiveness of the entity's internal controls. Substantive procedures 直接搵重大錯誤陳述嘅程序，唔可以完全唔做 Substantive procedures are designed to detect material misstatements and can never be eliminated entirely. Professional scepticism 保持質疑態度，唔好盲信管理層 The auditor must maintain professional scepticism throughout the audit, regardless of past experience of management's integrity. Engagement letter 具法律約束力嘅委聘信，釐清雙方責任 The engagement letter forms a legally binding contract setting out the terms and responsibilities of the audit engagement.

title: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Answers
Q5 — Answer: (i) Source documents — goods despatched notes (or customer orders); (ii) trace from the source documents FORWARD into the accounting records (sales day book/general ledger)
excerpt: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C. Detection risk is the only component of audit risk that is under the audit…
text: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C. Detection risk is the only component of audit risk that is under the auditor's control. Audit risk = risk of material misstatement (inherent risk × control risk) × detection risk. Inherent risk and control risk exist in the entity before the audit starts — the auditor can only assess them, not change them. The auditor controls detection risk by adjusting the nature, timing and extent of audit procedures: the higher the assessed risk of material misstatement, the lower the detection risk that can be accepted, hence more persuasive/more extensive substantive procedures. 解題思路（繁中）: 題目問「邊個 risk 係 auditor 直接控制到」——答案一定係 detection risk。Option A 錯：inherent risk 係客戶業務天生嘅風險（例如複雜 estimate），auditor 無權叫管理層簡化交易。Option B 錯：內控係管理層嘅責任，auditor 只能 assess 同測試，唔可以「direct」客戶點做。Option D 錯：business risk 係公司層面嘅風險（HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(b)），auditor 唔係管理顧問。記住 inverse relationship：control risk 低 → substantive procedures 可以少；RoMM 高 → detection risk 要壓低（做更多 testing）。 Rule Check: HKSA 200.13(e) (definition of detection risk); Glossary of Terms (audit risk definition); HKSA 300. Common Trap（繁中）: 考生常答 B（control risk），以為 auditor 測內控即係控制到佢——auditor 測試內控只係「評估」control risk，唔係改變佢。另一伏位：將 audit risk 定義成「FS 有 misstatement 嘅風險」——嗰個係 RoMM，唔係 audit risk。 Q2 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): A. The commission scheme tied to a revenue target and the bank's requirement for revenue growth create an incentive/pressure for fraudulent financial reporting — there is a risk that revenue is overstated (e.g. accelerating revenue recognition of next year's sales into the current year). The appropriate planned response is detailed cut off procedures over revenue recognition to ensure revenue is recorded in the correct accounting period. This is a fraud risk factor (pressure to meet targets), and the team must maintain professional scepticism over revenue. 解題思路（繁中）: 題眼係「bonus 掛鈎 revenue target」＋「銀行要睇業績先批貸款」——兩個都係 HKSA 240 嘅 fraud risk factors（incentive/pressure），直接指向 revenue overstatement ，對應 assertion 係 occurrence/cut off。Option B 錯：佣金制度係增加風險而唔係保證準確，絕對唔可以因此減少 substantive procedures。Option C 錯：rely on controls 必須先做 tests of control 證明 operating effectiveness，而且高 fraud risk 區域通常唔適合全靠內控。Option D 錯：fraud risk factor ≠ 已發生 fraud（LP 明講「the existence of fraud risk factors may not necessarily indicate the existence of fraud」），唔可以未審就斷定 fraud 兼即時 qualify。 Rule Check: HKSA 240 (fraud risk factors — incentive/pressure); HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) (risk assessment and responses); LP §3.5.2, Exhibit 3.3 (bonus structure → cut off procedures on revenue). Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「bonus / loan / 業績壓力」要即刻聯想到 revenue overstatement （唔係 understatement）同 cut off 。相反，經濟差嘅時候管理層反而可能 understate 利潤（maximise write offs）——方向由 pressure 嘅性質決定。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): C. The financial controller's ongoing review of whether bank reconciliations are being prepared on time and continue to operate effectively is the entity's process to monitor the system of internal control. Monitoring relates to the entity's process of assessing the effectiveness of controls over time and taking remedial action where necessary. (The preparation of the bank reconciliation itself is a control activity — a reconciliation; but reviewing whether the control continues to operate over time is monitoring.) 解題思路（繁中）: 分辨關鍵：「做 reconciliation」＝ control activity （HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 15 — reconciliations）；「check 啲 reconciliation 有冇持續做、有冇效」＝ monitoring 。題目問嘅係後者（review ... over time）。Option A 錯：control environment 係 tone at the top（integrity、ethical values、governance oversight），唔係具體 review 動作。Option B 錯：risk assessment process 係管理層識別同管理 business risks 嘅流程，唔係覆核內控運作。Option D 係最強 distractor——因為 bank reconciliation 本身確係 control activity，但題目問嘅係「監察個 control」嘅層次。讀題要睇主語同動詞。 Rule Check: HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. 12(m) (five components); para. 15 (control activities); LP §3.3.1.3 (monitoring — e.g. timeliness/accuracy of bank reconciliations). Common Trap（繁中）: 五大 components 嘅 classification 題係 panelist 報告中嘅常見失分位。口訣：integrity/ethics → control environment；「review controls over time / 跟進 deficiency」→ monitoring；authorisation / reconciliation / verification / physical & logical / segregation of duties → control activities。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B. Under HKSA 240, the primary responsibility for the prevention and detection of fraud rests with management and those charged with governance. The auditor is responsible for obtaining reasonable assurance that the financial statements are free from material misstatement, whether caused by fraud or error. Where fraud is identified, the auditor must communicate it on a timely basis to an appropriate level of management; where the fraud involves management (here, a senior finance manager), the matter must be communicated to those charged with governance. If the auditor has doubts about the integrity of those charged with governance, legal advice should be sought. Reporting to third parties (e.g. Police, ICAC) is required only where law or regulation imposes such a duty, and that duty takes precedence over confidentiality. 解題思路（繁中）: 三步判斷：(1) 責任歸屬——prevent/detect fraud 永遠係 management + TCWG，所以 A 錯；(2) 上報路線——fraud 涉及 management 就上 TCWG（B 啱）；涉及 TCWG 誠信有疑問就尋求法律意見；(3) 對外披露——只有法律/法規要求先會報第三方（ICAC、Police、SFC 等），唔係「所有情況都必報警」，所以 C 錯。Option D 錯得離譜：fraud 對 FS 有重大影響而管理層唔處理，auditor 要考慮 modify opinion，絕對唔可以「收埋」出 unmodified opinion；legal duty 亦 override confidentiality。 Rule Check: HKSA 240.10 (auditor's objectives); LP §3.5 (responsibility rests with management and TCWG; communication and third party reporting). Common Trap（繁中）: 最常見錯係 A——以為「auditor 提供 reasonable assurance」等於「auditor 負責捉 fraud」。記住：auditor 嘅責任係 identify and assess RoMM due to fraud 同 respond ，唔係 prevent/detect。另一陷阱：confidentiality 唔係絕對——法律責任優先，呢種情況 LP 建議 seek legal advice。 Q5 — Answer: (i) Source documents — goods despatched notes (or customer orders); (ii) trace from the source documents FORWARD into the accounting records (sales day book/general ledger) Model Answer (EN): To test completeness of revenue, the auditor selects a sample from source documents — goods despatched notes (or customer orders) — and traces them forward to sales invoices and their inclusion in the sales day book/general ledger (i.e. from outside the accounting system towards the accounting records). Vouching a sample of invoices from the sales day book back to goods despatched notes starts from what is already recorded ; it can confirm occurrence/accuracy of recorded sales, but can never reveal despatches that were never invoiced or recorded — hence it tests for overstatement, not understatement (completeness). Under directional testing, income and liabilities are tested for understatement by tracing from source documents to the records. 解題思路（繁中）: Directional testing 嘅核心邏輯：「 起點決定 assertion 」。 由 records → source documents （vouching，由帳查出去）＝ 證明「記低咗嘅嘢真係存在/發生」→ existence / occurrence （捉 overstatement ）。 由 source documents → records （tracing，由文件追入帳）＝ 證明「發生咗嘅嘢全部有記低」→ completeness （捉 understatement ）。 所以 completeness of revenue 一定要由 goods despatched notes / customer orders 出發追入 sales day book。由 sales day book 抽 invoice 向外 vouch，樣本本身就只包含「已記錄」嘅交易，邏輯上永遠搵唔到「漏咗冇記」嘅交易。Assets/expenses 測 overstatement；liabilities/income 測 understatement——呢句背熟就唔會錯。 Rule Check: HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para. A190(a) (completeness assertion); LP §3.1.4.7 (directional testing) and Exhibit 3.8 (Revenue — Completeness: agree customer orders with despatch notes and sales invoices through to inclusion in the sales day book). Common Trap（繁中）: 考官最愛嘅 direction of testing 陷阱（Jun 2023 報告特別提到考生混淆 existence vs completeness direction）。仲有 observation vs inspection 都係混淆高危：observation 係「睇人做嘢個過程」，inspection 係「睇文件/實物」——唔好亂用。 Self check reminder for students: 每題嘅 Rule Check 都對應 LP Chapter 3 內文引用嘅 HKSA 段落；温書時連埋 Phase 1 速查表一齊睇。

title: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) Durin…
text: M8 Chapter 3: Audit Planning I — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) During the planning of an audit, the engagement partner reminds the team that the auditor must reduce audit risk to an acceptably low level. Which of the following risks is the ONLY one directly controllable by the auditor through the design and performance of audit procedures? A. Inherent risk, because the auditor can require management to simplify complex transactions. B. Control risk, because the auditor can direct management to strengthen internal controls. C. Detection risk, because it is the risk that the auditor's procedures will not detect a misstatement that exists and could be material. D. Business risk, because the auditor can advise management on strategy to protect the entity's objectives. Question 2 (Scenario MCQ) Harbour Link Logistics Limited operates a freight forwarding business in Hong Kong. During the year, the company introduced a new commission scheme under which the sales team's annual bonus depends on achieving a revenue target. The company has also applied for a bank loan, and the bank requires audited financial statements showing revenue growth before approving the facility. As the audit senior planning this engagement, which of the following is the MOST appropriate response to the principal risk arising from these facts? A. Perform detailed cut off procedures over revenue to ensure revenue is recognised in the correct accounting period, given the risk that revenue is deliberately overstated. B. Reduce substantive procedures over revenue because the commission scheme motivates staff to record sales accurately. C. Place reliance on the internal controls over the sales cycle without performing tests of control, to save audit time. D. Issue a qualified opinion immediately because a fraud has been committed by the sales team. Question 3 (MCQ) The financial controller of an audit client personally reviews the monthly bank reconciliations each month, investigates any unusual reconciling items and checks that reconciliations are being prepared on time by the accounts clerk. Into which of the five components of the entity's system of internal control (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019)) does the financial controller's review of whether the reconciliations continue to be prepared and operate over time fall? A. Control environment. B. The entity's risk assessment process. C. The entity's process to monitor the system of internal control. D. Control activities. Question 4 (Scenario MCQ) During the audit of Bright Pearl Jewellery Limited, the audit team discovers that a senior finance manager has been diverting company funds into a personal bank account disguised as payments to a fictitious supplier. Which of the following statements correctly describes the responsibilities in this situation? A. The auditor is primarily responsible for the prevention and detection of the fraud, because the auditor provides reasonable assurance on the financial statements. B. The primary responsibility for the prevention and detection of fraud rests with management and those charged with governance; as the fraud involves management, the auditor should communicate the matter to those charged with governance. C. The auditor must report the fraud to the Hong Kong Police Force in all circumstances before informing the client, because confidentiality never applies to fraud. D. The auditor should conceal the matter in the auditor's report by issuing an unmodified opinion, as disclosing the fraud would breach client confidentiality. Question 5 (Short answer) An auditor wishes to test the completeness assertion for the client's revenue (i.e. whether all goods despatched have been invoiced and recorded). Using directional testing principles, state (i) the population from which the auditor should select the sample, and (ii) the direction of the test. Explain in one or two sentences why selecting invoices from the sales day book and vouching them to goods despatched notes would NOT satisfy the completeness assertion. End of quiz. No answers are provided in this file — attempt all questions closed book before checking the answer file.

title: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Audit Risk & Assertions（風險模型 + 斷言）
E. Using the Work of Others
excerpt: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the audit risk model (AR = IR × CR × DR) and analyse the r…
text: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the audit risk model (AR = IR × CR × DR) and analyse the relationship between business risk, inherent risk, control risk and detection risk in determining the audit approach. 2. Apply materiality and performance materiality (HKSA 320), using quantitative benchmarks and qualitative factors, to plan and evaluate audit work. 3. Distinguish between tests of controls and substantive procedures (tests of detail and substantive analytical procedures) and select an appropriate combined or substantive audit approach. 4. Apply analytical procedures (HKSA 520) at the planning, substantive and final review stages, including ratio, trend and common size analysis. 5. Evaluate the factors affecting the persuasiveness of audit evidence (HKSA 500/505/580) and the requirements for using the work of experts (HKSA 620) and internal auditors (HKSA 610 (Revised 2013)). 必背考點 A. Audit Risk & Assertions（風險模型 + 斷言） Audit Risk Model Audit risk = risk that the auditor expresses an incorrect opinion on the financial statements. HKSAs require a risk based approach ; auditors cannot check every transaction. AR = IR × CR × DR （量化時用乘數：如 AR 10%, IR 70%, CR 70% → DR = 10% ÷ 49% = 20.4% ） Inherent risk (HKSA 200.13(n)(i)): susceptibility of an assertion to a misstatement that could be material, before consideration of any related controls . 例：complex standards (HKFRS 9 forward contracts)、fast obsolescing inventory (HKAS 2 lower of cost and NRV)、estimates with high estimation uncertainty（可能是 significant risk，屬 inherent risk spectrum 高端）. Control risk (HKSA 200.13(n)(ii)): risk that a misstatement that could be material will not be prevented, or detected and corrected, on a timely basis by the entity's controls . 受管理層對內控嘅態度、control environment、員工能力影響。 Detection risk (HKSA 200.13(e)): risk that the auditor's procedures will not detect a material misstatement that exists. 唯一受 auditor 控制嘅風險 ；= sampling risk + non sampling risk。 Inverse relationship : RoMM（IR × CR）越高 → 可接受 DR 越低 → 越多 substantive testing ；反之亦然。 Business risk (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para 12(b)): risk resulting from significant conditions/events/circumstances that could adversely affect the entity's ability to achieve its objectives and execute its strategies. 分 operational / financial / compliance 三類。Business risk broader than RoMM — 不是所有 business risk 都影響財務報表（LP 明示：business risk identified by management, reviewed continuously；inherent risk identified by auditor, assessed at time of audit）。 RoMM 兩個層次 ：financial statement level（整體，如 fraud、incompetent management、going concern uncertainties）vs assertion level （再分 IR + CR，需 separate assessment ）。Presumed fraud risk： fraud in revenue recognition （HKSA 240 要求 professional scepticism，唔可以靠過往對 client integrity 嘅經驗排除 fraud）。 Cybersecurity risk ：auditor 要 evaluate automated controls 同 general IT controls；發現 material breach 要考慮對財務報告及 disclosures 嘅影響。 Assertions（HKSA 315 (Revised 2019)） 定義：representations by management, explicit or otherwise, inherent in preparing the financial statements per the applicable framework. Transactions and events (6) — HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para A190(a): Occurrence / Completeness / Accuracy / Cutoff / Classification / Presentation Account balances at period end (6) — HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para A190(b): Existence / Rights and obligations / Completeness / Accuracy, valuation and allocation / Classification / Presentation Disclosures：上述 assertions 經適當調整後適用；可用 disclosure checklist （要 up to date，符合 HKFRS 及 Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622)）。 Significant risk ：必須了解相關 controls；如打算 rely on controls over a significant risk，必須 current period 測試，且仍要做 substantive procedures。 HKSA 250 (Revised) laws & regulations：management 負責合規；auditor 要 obtain general understanding of legal/regulatory environment、inspect correspondence with regulators、enquire of management/TCWG、obtain written representations on known non compliance。Direct effect（HKFRS、Cap. 622、tax legislation）vs indirect effect（environmental、employment、health & safety）。 B. Materiality（HKSA 320） 定義 (HKSA 320.2): misstatements are material if they, individually or in aggregate, could reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions of users . Quantitative benchmarks （起點，非硬性規定，professional judgement）： 0.5%–1% of revenue；5%–10% of profit before tax；1%–2% of total assets 。 Material by nature （qualitative）：misstatement 令 profit 變 loss / net assets 變 net liabilities； directors' transactions / directors' remuneration ；going concern material uncertainties；potential legal claims 嘅 disclosures。例：平賣車俾 director — 金額 immaterial 但 material by nature ，屬 related party transaction (HKAS 24 (Revised))，唔披露 → modify opinion。 Materiality vs audit risk ：materiality 越高 → 越少 transactions 被測 → audit risk 越高 （inverse）。審計途中可上調/下調 materiality。 Performance materiality (HKSA 320.9): amount(s) set at less than materiality for the FS as a whole, to reduce to an appropriately low level the probability that the aggregate of uncorrected and undetected misstatements exceeds FS materiality. 可用百分比（如 75% × FS materiality）計算。 用啱 benchmark ：misstatement 要同受影響嘅項目比較（如 irrecoverable receivable → PBT + gross assets，唔係 revenue / net assets）。 C. Procedures（審計程序設計） Audit strategy vs audit plan Strategy 先於 plan，定 scope、timing、direction；考慮 characteristics of the engagement、reporting objectives、significant factors（materiality、assessed RoMM 等）、nature/timing/extent of resources。Plan 跟住 strategy，列明每個 audit area 點攞 evidence。 Audit programme = list of audit procedures per area； audit engagement partner review + authorise 後先可以開始 fieldwork。 Tests of controls 目的：測 operating effectiveness of controls； 唔測金額 （indirect evidence only）。有效 → 少啲 substantive；無效/唔存在 → 唔 rely，改做多啲 substantive。 理解內控係 mandatory （HKSA 315 (Revised 2019)），無論打唔打算 rely；五個 components：control environment / entity's risk assessment process / process to monitor the system of internal control / information system and communication / control activities。 Walk through test ：trace a sample of transactions through the accounting system，可作 tests of controls 一部分。 Service organisation（如外判 payroll）：可 attend/visit provider、arrange another firm、或攞 Type 1 report （description + design）/ Type 2 report （仲包 operating effectiveness）。 Significant deficiencies in internal control → report to TCWG/management per HKSA 265 。 HKSA 330 要求無論如何都做嘅 substantive procedures：agree FS to underlying accounting records；examine material journals；examine other adjustments。 Substantive procedures 定義：procedures designed to detect material misstatement at the assertion level ；= tests of detail + substantive analytical procedures。內控再好都 必須做一啲 （唔可以 100% rely on controls）。 Tests of detail ：verify individual transactions/balances（如 trace additions to purchase invoices → rights & obligations + valuation）。 Substantive analytical procedures — 4 steps 1. Develop an independent expectation （先於計算差異！） 2. Define a significant difference / threshold — threshold must not exceed performance materiality 3. Calculate the difference （expectation vs recorded amount） 4. Investigate the significant differences and draw conclusions — 要解釋 full difference ，唔係只係超過 threshold 嗰部分 適用性 4 factors：assertion being tested / reliability of the data / degree of precision possible / amount of variation acceptable。 Proof in total （reasonableness test，常用於 payroll）：Total wages last year × (1 + inflation) × No. of employees this year ÷ No. of employees last year。 Analytical procedures 唔可以單獨用 — 佢哋 identify possible sources of misstatement，唔直接 detect；要配 inquiry / recalculation / reperformance。 Analytical procedures 三個階段（HKSA 520） 1. Planning stage （risk assessment procedures，HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) required）— identify unusual transactions/ratios/trends、fraud risks 2. Substantive analytical procedures （HKSA 520.3(a): obtain relevant and reliable audit evidence） 3. Final review near end of audit （HKSA 520.3(b): assist in forming an overall conclusion whether FS are consistent with auditor's understanding — mandatory ） 定義 (HKSA 520.4): evaluations of financial information through analysis of plausible relationships among both financial and non financial data + investigation of fluctuations inconsistent or differing significantly from expected values。 技術： Comparisons （prior year、budgets/forecasts、auditor's expectations、industry）、 Trend analysis 、 Common size analysis （line item ÷ base × 100；SoFP base = total assets；P/L base = revenue）、 Ratio analysis 。 Ratio categories ：Profitability（GP margin = GP/Revenue×100；NP margin = PBT/Revenue×100）｜Efficiency（receivables days = receivables/revenue×365；inventory days = inventory/COS×365；payables days = payables/purchases×365）｜Liquidity（current、quick = (CA − inventory)/CL、gearing）｜Return（gearing、ROCE）。 影響 AP precision 嘅 4 factors： disaggregation / data reliability / predictability / type of analytical procedure 。 Data analytics ：操作完整 data set；用處包括 cost vs NRV comparison、inventory ageing、revenue trends by product/region、match orders to cash、segregation of duties user code analysis、GP margin analysis、AR/AP ageing。 D. Evidence（審計證據） HKSA 500 七大 procedures ： Inspection / Observation / External confirmation / Recalculation / Reperformance / Analytical procedures / Inquiry （"Review" 唔係 HKSA 500 procedure）。 Inspection ：文件（rights & obligations、cut off、控制運作痕跡）+ physical inspection of assets（existence、condition/impairment）— 但 physical inspection 未必 prove rights & obligations。 Observation ：只證明觀察當刻控制有運作（auditor presence 可能影響行為）— 局限要記。 External confirmation （HKSA 505.6(a) 定義：direct written response to the auditor from a third party）：auditor 要 maintain control — auditor prepares letters、selects sample、sends requests（HKSA 505.7）。Receivables confirmation → existence + rights & obligations ， 唔係 valuation 。Bank confirmation letter 包 balances + security pledged。Legal confirmation → HKAS 37 provision/contingent liability 判斷。 Recalculation （數學準確性，如 depreciation）vs Reperformance （auditor 獨立重做 client 嘅 control/procedure，如 bank reconciliation）— 唔好撈亂。 Inquiry ：alone is insufficient （low quality, inherent bias）；要 corroborate；可要求 confirm in written representation。 Evidence 質素 hierarchy（更可靠）：independent external source internally generated under effective controls auditor direct documentary form original documents（scanned/photocopied 可能被 tamper — fraud risk factor）。 Sufficiency （quantity）vs Appropriateness （quality = relevance + reliability）：unreliable evidence 攞幾多都冇用。 Factors affecting information as audit evidence： relevance / reliability / competence / sufficiency / timeliness （SoFP evidence 越近 reporting date 越可靠；P/L evidence 要 cover 全年）。 Written representations （HKSA 580）：internal evidence，只作 complement，唔可以單獨 rely；letter on client letterhead、signed by CEO/CFO、 date = date FS authorised for issue 、auditor's report 簽署 前 取得。Management 拒絕 → discuss reasons → re evaluate integrity of management → consider implications for auditor's report。Representation 與其他 evidence 不一致 → reconsider reliability、risk assessment、further procedures。 E. Using the Work of Others 兩類 expert： Management's expert （HKSA 500 — client 僱用，協助 prepare FS，如 valuer/actuary/lawyer）vs Auditor's expert （HKSA 620 — 審計師僱用，攞 sufficient appropriate audit evidence）。 需要 expert 嘅情況：property valuations、construction WIP、actuarial valuations for defined benefit plans、specialist inventory、legal provisions、complex financial instruments、complex accounting estimates（HKSA 540 (Revised) para A31 情況）。 HKSA 620 三步 ： 1. Agree scope in engagement letter：nature/scope/objectives、roles & responsibilities、communication、confidentiality 2. Assess competence, capability and objectivity （ before work starts）：qualifications、experience、professional body membership、published work；business/personal relationships with client → objectivity threat 3. Evaluate adequacy of work ：consistency with other audit evidence、relevance & reasonableness of assumptions/methods、relevance/completeness/accuracy of source data。Inadequate → agree further work 或換 expert。 HKSA 610 (Revised 2013) Using the Work of Internal Auditors ： 評估 IA function（610.15–610.17）： objectivity （organisational status + policies）、 competence 、 systematic and disciplined approach (incl. quality control) 用之前再評估：work properly planned/performed/supervised/reviewed/documented、sufficient appropriate evidence obtained、conclusions appropriate、reports consistent with work；external auditor 要 reperform 部分程序 Direct assistance = internal auditors perform audit procedures under direction, supervision and review of external auditor。 禁止 (HKSA 610.28(a)(b))：significant threats to objectivity 或 lacks sufficient competence。唔可以 assign：significant judgements / high RoMM areas / IA 曾參與嘅工作 / HKSA 610 下 external auditor 自己嘅決定 Direct assistance 條件：management written agreement 唔會干預 + IA written confirmation of confidentiality + external auditor direction/supervision/review；documentation per HKSA 610.36/37（包括 HKSA 230 下 review details） Responsibility for conclusion ：auditor's opinion 永遠係 engagement partner 負責； must not refer to the work of others in the auditor's report unless required by law or regulation（即使提咗都要講明唔 diminish responsibility）。 易混淆概念對比 Table 1: Tests of Controls vs Substantive Procedures Tests of Controls Substantive Procedures Objective Test operating effectiveness of internal controls Detect material misstatement at the assertion level Focus 控制有冇運作（唔理金額） 財務報表嘅金額／disclosures Evidence type Indirect evidence over FS Direct evidence over FS Sub types Walk through tests, observation, reperformance of controls, inspection of authorisation Tests of detail + substantive analytical procedures Mandatory? 了解內控 mandatory (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019))；tests of controls 只在打算 rely 時做 永遠要做一啲 — 內控再好都唔可以 100% rely；HKSA 330 指定三項必做 點樣分辨／考試伏位 見到 "authorisation"、"segregation of duties"、"credit check evidence" 字眼 = test of control 見到 "trace to invoice"、"recalculate"、"proof in total"、"confirm balance" = substantive。 伏位 ：觀察員工打卡（test of control）≠ trace capital item to invoice（substantive）；GP margin 按年比較係 analytical procedure 但未必係 substantive AP Table 2: Financial Statement Materiality vs Performance Materiality (HKSA 320) FS Materiality Performance Materiality Definition (HKSA 320.2 / 320.9) Misstatements that could influence economic decisions of users Amount(s) set at less than FS materiality so aggregate of uncorrected + undetected misstatements unlikely to exceed FS materiality Level Higher Lower （如 75% × FS materiality） Purpose 評估個別／合計 misstatement 對 FS 整體嘅影響；opinion 判斷基準 設計測試範圍嘅操作門檻；防止大量細 misstatement 加埋變 material Benchmarks 0.5–1% revenue / 5–10% PBT / 1–2% total assets FS materiality 嘅一個百分比（professional judgement） Qualitative? Yes — material by nature（directors' transactions、profit→loss） 主要係量化工具 點樣分辨／考試伏位 題目問「material or not」→ 用 FS materiality + nature 判斷 題目講「threshold for substantive AP must not exceed ___」→ 答案係 performance materiality ，唔係 FS materiality（常見伏位） Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: State the audit risk model and define each of its three components. Which component is under the auditor's control? Back: AR = IR × CR × DR Inherent risk (HKSA 200.13(n)(i)): susceptibility of an assertion to material misstatement before consideration of related controls Control risk (HKSA 200.13(n)(ii)): risk a material misstatement is not prevented, or detected and corrected, on a timely basis by the entity's controls Detection risk (HKSA 200.13(e)): risk the auditor's procedures fail to detect a material misstatement that exists Only detection risk is under the auditor's control (comprises sampling + non sampling risk) 💬 白話解：三件事乘埋就係審計風險。IR 係「件嘢本身易錯」（未計內控），CR 係「公司內控捉唔到錯」，DR 係「審計師自己都搵唔到」。審計師控制唔到間公司嘅 IR 同 CR，唯一可以做嘅係做多啲測試壓低 DR — 所以 IR/CR 高 → 要接受低 DR → 做多啲 substantive work。 Card 2 Front: Distinguish business risk from inherent risk, and explain why the auditor is not required to identify all business risks. Back: Business risk (HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para 12(b)): risks affecting the entity's ability to achieve objectives and execute strategies; categories: operational / financial / compliance; identified by management ; reviewed continuously Inherent risk: function of the audit risk model; identified by the auditor ; assessed at the time of the audit; always relates to potential material misstatement of the FS Business risk is broader than RoMM — not all business risks have financial statement consequences, hence outside the scope of the audit 💬 白話解：business risk 係公司嘅嘢（管理層日日要管），inherent risk 係審計嘅嘢（auditor 審計時先評）。公司執笠風險大把，但得嗰啲會搞錯財務報表嘅先關 auditor 事 — 考試鍾意問「邊個 identify 邊個」。 Card 3 Front: List the six assertions for classes of transactions and events, and the six assertions for account balances at period end, per HKSA 315 (Revised 2019). Back: Transactions & events (para A190(a)): Occurrence, Completeness, Accuracy, Cutoff, Classification, Presentation Account balances (para A190(b)): Existence, Rights and obligations, Completeness, Accuracy valuation and allocation, Classification, Presentation 💬 白話解：記口訣 — 交易用「OCCACC P」，結餘用「ERCCAP」。最大伏位： existence / rights & obligations / valuation & allocation 只屬於 balances ，transactions 冇呢啲；相反 occurrence / cutoff 只屬於 transactions 。考試最愛叫你在 combination MCQ 裏面分。 Card 4 Front: State the materiality benchmarks suggested by the LP, the definition of performance materiality, and give two examples of items material by nature. Back: Benchmarks (HKSA 320, starting points only): 0.5–1% of revenue; 5–10% of profit before tax; 1–2% of total assets Performance materiality (HKSA 320.9): amount(s) set at less than FS materiality to reduce to an appropriately low level the probability that the aggregate of uncorrected and undetected misstatements exceeds FS materiality Material by nature: misstatements turning a profit into a loss (or net assets into net liabilities); directors' transactions/remuneration ; going concern material uncertainties; disclosures of potential legal claims 💬 白話解：materiality 唔淨止睇數字大細，仲要睇性質 — 賤賣資產俾董事，金額再細都 material by nature（HKAS 24 related party 要披露）。Performance materiality 係「保險線」，拉低啲，等啲小錯加埋都唔會爆 FS materiality。 Card 5 Front: List the seven procedures for gathering audit evidence per HKSA 500, and state one limitation each of observation and inquiry. Back: Inspection, Observation, External confirmation, Recalculation, Reperformance, Analytical procedures, Inquiry Observation: only evidences the control operating at the time of observation ; auditor's presence may influence behaviour Inquiry: alone is insufficient — responses have inherent bias / low quality; must be corroborated by other procedures 💬 白話解：七式口訣「IOECRAI」。 Review 唔係其中一式 （LP 明講，考試考過呢個陷阱）。Observation 嘅致命傷係「你望住佢先做足」；inquiry 嘅致命傷係「佢講咩你唔可以就咁信」。 Card 6 Front: Describe the four steps of a substantive analytical procedure and the rule regarding the threshold. Back: 1. Develop an independent expectation 2. Define a significant difference / threshold — the threshold must not exceed performance materiality 3. Calculate the difference between expectation and recorded amount 4. Investigate significant differences and draw conclusions — obtain explanations for the full difference , not just the amount exceeding the threshold 💬 白話解：次序好重要 — 一定要 先有 expectation 先計差異 ，如果倒轉做（睇完實數先度 expectation）就係 anchoring，LP 明講唔得。Threshold 上限係 performance materiality，唔係 FS materiality — 考試 MCQ 陷阱位。 Card 7 Front: When is an external confirmation appropriate, what must the auditor control (HKSA 505), and which assertions does a trade receivables confirmation support (and not support)? Back: External confirmation (HKSA 505.6(a)): audit evidence as a direct written response to the auditor from a third party ; used for receivables, payables (no supplier statements), legal confirmations, inventory held by third parties, bank balances Auditor maintains control (HKSA 505.7): auditor prepares the letters, selects the sample, sends the requests; responses come directly to the auditor Receivables confirmation supports existence and rights & obligations — does NOT provide reliable evidence over valuation (customer may owe but never pay) 💬 白話解：confirmation 之所以可靠係因為第三方直接覆俾 auditor，唔經 client 手（唔會被做手腳）。但記住：客話「係呀我欠你錢」唔代表佢還得起 — 所以 existence ✓、valuation ✗，呢個係萬年伏位。 Card 8 Front: State the three criteria for evaluating the internal audit function (HKSA 610 (Revised 2013)), the two prohibitions on using internal auditors for direct assistance, and the rule on referring to others' work in the auditor's report. Back: Evaluate IA function: objectivity (organisational status + policies/procedures), competence , systematic and disciplined approach including quality control Direct assistance prohibited if: (a) significant threats to the internal auditor's objectivity , or (b) internal auditor lacks sufficient competence ; also cannot assign work involving significant judgements / high RoMM / work IA was involved in / HKSA 610 decisions Auditor's report: the auditor must not refer to the work of others unless required by law or regulation; responsibility for the opinion always rests with the audit engagement partner 💬 白話解：用內審之前要驗三樣：客觀、勝任、有系統。Direct assistance 兩個煞停制：唔客觀、唔夠料。最重要：專家做咗嘢都好，report 上面 唔准提佢個名 （除非法律要求），責任永遠係 partner 孭 — 呢個 MCQ 出到爛。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Audit risk 審計師出錯 opinion 嘅風險（= IR × CR × DR） Audit risk is the risk that the auditor expresses an incorrect opinion on the financial statements. Detection risk 審計程序搵唔到重大錯誤嘅風險；唯一 auditor 控制到嘅風險 Detection risk is reduced by increasing the nature, timing and extent of substantive procedures. Performance materiality 低過 FS materiality 嘅操作門檻，防小錯加埋變大錯 The threshold for substantive analytical procedures must not exceed performance materiality. Substantive procedures 專登設計嚟喺 assertion level 捉重大錯誤嘅程序（tests of detail + substantive AP） Substantive procedures are required on material items even when internal controls are effective. Walk through test 抽幾單交易由頭行到落尾，驗證對系統嘅理解（可作 test of controls） The auditor performed a walk through test by tracing a sales order through the accounting system. Proof in total 用獨立數據砌出整個餘額嘅合理期望值（常用於 payroll/depreciation） A proof in total of payroll was developed using last year's wages, pay rises and headcount changes. External confirmation 第三方直接書面回覆俾 auditor 嘅證據（HKSA 505） The auditor maintained control over external confirmations by preparing, selecting and sending the requests. Auditor's expert 審計師自己請嘅專家，幫手攞 sufficient appropriate audit evidence（HKSA 620） Before using an auditor's expert, the auditor must assess the expert's competence, capability and objectivity.

title: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 3 Quiz — Model Answers
headings: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 3 Quiz — Model Answers
excerpt: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 3 Quiz — Model Answers Q1 — Answer: Detection risk = 12.5% Model Answer (EN): Audit risk = Inherent risk × Control risk …
text: M8 Chapter 4: Audit Planning II — Phase 3 Quiz — Model Answers Q1 — Answer: Detection risk = 12.5% Model Answer (EN): Audit risk = Inherent risk × Control risk × Detection risk 5% = 80% × 50% × DR DR = 0.05 ÷ (0.80 × 0.50) = 0.05 ÷ 0.40 = 0.125 = 12.5% Because the acceptable detection risk is low (12.5%), the auditor must perform more extensive substantive procedures over the revenue cycle — i.e. modify the nature, timing and extent of planned substantive procedures (larger samples, more tests of detail, procedures closer to/after the year end) to reduce the risk that the auditor's procedures fail to detect a material misstatement. Placing little or no reliance on the entity's internal controls over revenue would be consistent with a control risk assessed at 50% or higher. 解題思路（繁中）: 審計風險模型係乘法：AR = IR × CR × DR。移項就係 DR = AR ÷ (IR × CR) = 5% ÷ 40% = 12.5%。背後邏輯：IR 同 CR 都唔受 auditor 控制，唯一可以郁嘅係 DR；而 DR 同 substantive testing 嘅 extent 係反比 — 可接受 DR 越低，就要做越多、越細緻嘅 substantive procedures 嚟壓低實際 DR。呢題同 LP 嘅 Apply and Analyse 4（AR 10%、IR/CR 各 70% → DR 20.4%）係同一條數式，換咗數字啫。 Rule Check: HKSA 200.13(n)(i), 200.13(n)(ii), 200.13(e) (definitions of inherent risk, control risk, detection risk); audit risk model per LP Section 4.1.2 (AR = IR × CR × DR) Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好將三個風險 相加 （模型係乘法，唔係加法）。 唔好答「12.5% 好低所以要減少 substantive testing」— 方向啱啱倒轉：DR 低 = 要 多 做 substantive work。呢個 inverse relationship 係 Jun 2023 panelist report 明確指出嘅考生弱點。 記住 detection risk = sampling risk + non sampling risk，係唯一 auditor 控制到嘅風險。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Selecting items from the physical inventory and tracing them to the inventory records tests the completeness assertion — it verifies that all inventory that physically exists has been recorded in the accounting records. The direction of testing is decisive: floor to records = completeness; records to floor = existence. 解題思路（繁中）: 測試方向係關鍵：由「實物」追到「紀錄」，係搵「有冇漏記」= completeness 。 A (Existence) 錯：existence 係由 inventory records 抽樣、追到 physical inventory（records → floor），方向相反。 C (Accuracy, valuation and allocation) 錯：valution 要測 cost vs NRV、recalculation，唔係 trace 方向。 D (Rights and obligations) 錯：要睇 supplier invoices / title documents，physical trace 唔能夠證明擁有權。 LP 原文（Section 4.6.3.1 Relevance）就用咗同一對例子：physical → records = completeness；records → physical = existence。 Rule Check: HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) para A190(b) (assertions about account balances); LP Section 4.6.3.1 (relevance — direction of testing at the inventory count) Common Trap（繁中）: 「Existence vs completeness 測試方向倒轉」係 Exam Lens 列明嘅 panelist 反覆投訴弱點（Jun 2023/Jun 2024）。考試見到 inventory count trace 題，第一件事問自己：起點係 floor 定 records？Floor → records = completeness；records → floor = existence。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The loan to a director is material by nature , even though it is quantitatively immaterial. Materiality has both quantitative and qualitative dimensions: transactions with directors (such as loans and directors' remuneration) are material by nature because of their impact on the financial statements and their sensitivity. The loan must be disclosed as a related party transaction in accordance with HKAS 24 (Revised) Related Party Disclosures. If management refuses to make the disclosure, the auditor would be required to modify the opinion due to a material disclosure being omitted from the financial statements. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考「material by nature」。LP 嘅 Apply and Analyse 5 幾乎同款：賤賣車俾 director，金額 immaterial 但係 related party transaction，必須披露。 A 錯：「金額細 + 記錄正確」唔代表可以唔理 — qualitative factors 可以令 immaterial amount 變 material。 C 錯：auditor 唔可以為咗令 misstatement 變 immaterial 而 調高 materiality — 調整 materiality 必須基於新發現嘅事實，唔係為遷就結果。 D 錯：auditor 冇權要求董事還錢；auditor 嘅角色係要求 披露 ／修正財務報表，否則考慮 modify opinion。 Rule Check: HKSA 320 Materiality in Planning and Performing an Audit (qualitative and quantitative factors); HKAS 24 (Revised) Related Party Disclosures; LP Section 4.2.2 (material by nature) Common Trap（繁中）: 考生成日以為 materiality 淨係數字遊戲。記住 LP 嘅 material by nature 清單：profit 變 loss、net assets 變 net liabilities、 directors' transactions 、going concern uncertainties、legal claims disclosures。見到「director」兩個字就要即刻諗 related party + material by nature。 Q4 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under HKSA 610 (Revised 2013), the external auditor must not assign to internal auditors work that involves making significant judgements in the audit , work relating to a high risk of material misstatement , or work with which the internal auditor has been involved. Assignment (2) — evaluating a highly subjective legal provision involving significant judgement and high RoMM — therefore must not be assigned. Routine reperformance such as bank reconciliations (assignment 1) may be assigned, subject to evaluating the internal auditors' objectivity and competence, obtaining management's written agreement and confidentiality confirmation, and the external auditor directing, supervising and reviewing their work. 解題思路（繁中）: B 啱：HKSA 610 (Revised 2013) 嘅禁區 — 唔可以 assign significant judgements、high RoMM、IA 曾參與嘅工作、或 HKSA 610 下嘅決定 — (2) 踩中兩個禁區，唔可以外派。 A 錯：supervision 唔可以洗白禁區工作 — 禁區係絕對嘅，唔係「supervise 就得」。 C 錯：bank reconciliation 係 routine reperformance，唔涉及 significant judgement，可以 assign（前提係評估咗 objectivity + competence）。 D 錯：direct assistance 唔係全面禁止 — 只係當法律/規例禁止、或 610.28(a)(b) 嘅情況（significant objectivity threats / lacks competence）先唔可以用。 Rule Check: HKSA 610 (Revised 2013) Using the Work of Internal Auditors — paras 610.28(a)–(b) (prohibitions on direct assistance: significant objectivity threats / lack of competence) and the "must not assign" requirements (significant judgements, high RoMM) as set out in LP Section 4.7.5 Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好以為「direct assistance = 乜都可以俾內審做」。考試伏位通常係：(i) 禁區工作類型（significant judgement / high RoMM）；(ii) direct assistance 嘅先決條件（management written agreement + IA written confidentiality confirmation + direction/supervision/review by external auditor）；(iii) 內審個名 永遠唔會 出現喺 auditor's report。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): The four steps of a substantive analytical procedure are: (1) develop an independent expectation; (2) define a significant difference or threshold; (3) calculate the difference; (4) investigate significant differences and draw conclusions. The threshold (maximum acceptable difference) must not exceed performance materiality and must be sufficiently small to enable the auditor to identify misstatements that could be material individually or when aggregated. 解題思路（繁中）: C 啱：LP 明確寫「the threshold does not exceed performance materiality」。 A 錯：threshold 嘅上限係 performance materiality （較低嗰個），唔係 FS materiality — 呢個係本章最經典嘅 MCQ 伏位。 B 錯：次序錯 — LP 明講「it would be inappropriate to first calculate the difference from prior year/period balances and then allow the results to influence the expected difference and acceptable threshold」。一定要先建立 independent expectation 。 D 錯：substantive analytical procedures 唔可以單獨用 — 佢哋 identify possible sources of misstatement，唔直接 detect misstatements，必須配合 inquiry / recalculation / reperformance 等 corroborative testing。 Rule Check: HKSA 520 Analytical Procedures; LP Section 4.6.1.2 (four elements/steps; threshold must not exceed performance materiality) Common Trap（繁中）: 兩個陷阱位：(1) threshold 上限揀 FS materiality（錯，係 performance materiality）；(2) 步驟次序倒轉 — 睇咗數先度 expectation 會產生 anchoring bias，LP 明文禁止。記住口訣：Expectation → Threshold → Difference → Investigate（ETDI），順序唔可以亂。
