text: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Apply tests of control and substantive procedures (tests of details and substantive analytical procedures) to each major business cycle — revenue, purchases, payroll, inventory, receivables, bank and cash, payables, non current assets, provisions, leases and related parties. 2. Map each audit procedure to the financial statement assertion(s) it verifies, and identify the direction of testing (existence vs completeness). 3. Evaluate the design of external confirmation requests (trade receivables, trade payables, bank) in accordance with HKSA 505 External Confirmations , including follow up procedures for non responses and doubts over reliability. 4. Explain the auditor's responsibilities when attending a physical inventory count under HKSA 501 Audit Evidence – Specific Considerations for Selected Items . 5. Determine the audit implications (including potential modification of the auditor's opinion) when accounting treatments contravene HKFRS 15, HKAS 2, HKFRS 9, HKAS 16, HKAS 38, HKAS 37, HKFRS 16 or HKAS 24 (Revised). 必背考點 A. Assertions — 每個 major balance 嘅 key assertions（背熟！考試年年考 mapping） Balance / Transaction Key Assertions 主要測試方向 Revenue (HKFRS 15) Cut off, Accuracy, Completeness, Occurrence 主要防 overstated revenue（fraud risk：bonus、covenants） Purchases / Expenses Completeness（最主要）、Accuracy、Cut off 防 understated purchases/expenses → cost of sales understated Payroll Accuracy, Completeness, Occurrence Fraud risk：'ghost' employees；年結 accrual（paid in arrears） Inventories (HKAS 2) Valuation, Existence, Completeness, Rights and obligations 主要防 overvalued → overstated current assets + gross profit Receivables (HKFRS 9 ECL) Valuation and Existence 防 overstatement（連帶 revenue overstatement — Dr Receivables Cr Revenue） Bank and Cash Existence and Valuation Window dressing 令 bank + payables understated Tangible non current assets (HKAS 16) Existence, Valuation, Completeness, Rights and obligations 防 incorrectly capitalised / under depreciation / revaluation 出錯 Intangible assets (HKAS 38) Existence, Valuation 防 contravene HKAS 38 而 capitalise（如 internally generated goodwill） Payables and Accruals Completeness （liabilities 嘅焦點永遠係 completeness） 防 understated liabilities → overstated profit Provisions (HKAS 37) Completeness, Valuation, Rights and obligations, Presentation 防 understated / incomplete；disclosure 唔足 Non current liabilities Completeness, Classification (current vs non current split per HKAS 1) Loan split 錯 → current 同 non current 齊齊 misstated Leases (HKFRS 16) Valuation, Completeness, Presentation and disclosure ROU asset / lease liability 計錯；interest rate implicit in the lease 用錯 Related parties (HKAS 24 (Revised) / HKSA 550) Presentation and disclosure, Completeness 防 non disclosure / concealment（fraud risk factor） 點樣記： Liabilities 永遠主攻 completeness （怕少記）；Assets 永遠主攻 existence + valuation （怕多記/值錯）；Revenue 主攻 occurrence + cut off （怕假數/跳期）。 B. Audit Procedures — assertion ↔ procedure mapping（核心考點） B1. Revenue（HKFRS 15） Inspect a sample of GDNs immediately before and after year end → recorded in correct accounting period（ cut off ）。 Recalculate sales discounts and sales tax on a sample of sales invoices（ accuracy ）。 Select a sample of GDNs → agree to sales invoices → follow through to inclusion in the sales day book（ completeness ）。 Inspect post year end credit notes , trace to GDN and invoice; if relates to pre year end sale, ensure reversed（ occurrence ）。 Recalculate contract liability （unearned service revenue）at year end and agree with the statement of financial position（ completeness and accuracy ）。Service revenue 只可以喺 contractual obligations 履行時先 recognise。 Analytical：compare revenue with prior year / budget / industry；calculate gross profit margin (gross profit/sales × 100) and investigate significant fluctuations； proof in total 。 Tests of control：credit limit checks、fictitious order rejection、GDN matched to invoice before invoicing、invoice approval、standing data amendment authorisation。 B2. Purchases / Expenses Inspect GRNs immediately pre and post year end → correct period（ cut off ）。 Sample of purchase orders → agree to GRNs and purchase invoices → through to inclusion in the purchases day book（ completeness ）。 Recalculate invoice values including discounts / sales tax（ accuracy ）。 Inspect unmatched GRNs not yet invoiced → agree to schedule of accruals（ completeness ）— goods received but not invoiced 要做 accrual。 Analytical：category by category comparison with prior year and budget；gross profit margin + operating margin cross check（margin 一升一跌可能代表 classification error：overheads 誤入 cost of sales 或 capital items 誤入 repairs）。 Gross profit margin 異常上升嘅原因：revenue overstated（cut off 錯）、purchases incomplete、closing inventory overvalued、opening inventory 錯。 B3. Payroll and Directors' Emoluments Agree total wages and salaries per payroll system with trial balance / general ledger / financial statements（ completeness and presentation ）。 Cast monthly payroll reports；recalculate gross and net pay for a sample（ accuracy ）。 Sample of joiners and leavers → agree start/leave dates with first/last payroll run（ accuracy ）。 Reperform employment tax calculations（ accuracy ）；agree year end tax accrual with payroll records and post year end payment（ occurrence ）。 Agree total net pay per payroll records with bank transfer listing and cash book（ occurrence ）。 Analytical： proof in total （prior year payroll + joiners/leavers + annual pay increase）vs actual。 Tests of control：authorisation of time sheets/overtime、log of amendments to standing data、Board minutes approval of bonuses、segregation of duties、supervised clocking in/out。 Directors' emoluments：schedule split into wages/bonuses/benefits/pension → agree with FS disclosures；inspect Board minutes；obtain written representation that all emoluments disclosed（ completeness ）。Disclosure 唔足 → opinion 可能要 modified。 B4. Inventories（HKAS 2 — lower of cost and NRV） Attend the year end inventory count（ HKSA 501 requires attendance where inventory is material, unless impracticable）。 Sample from count sheets → physical inventory （ existence ）；sample from physical inventory → count sheets （ completeness ）。 Agree sample of inventory items to purchase invoices for cost（ valuation ）。 Inspect post year end sales invoices to determine NRV; compare NRV with cost → lower of cost and NRV（ valuation ）。 Use CAATs to age inventory → identify slow moving items needing allowance（ valuation ）。 Trace goods received immediately pre year end to payables and inventory records；trace goods despatched pre year end OUT of inventory（ completeness and existence — cut off）。 Third party inventory：obtain external confirmation of quantity and condition（ rights and obligations ）；if material, attend the third party's count（ existence and completeness ）。 Analytical：inventory days / inventory turnover vs prior year；gross profit margin vs prior year。 Standard costs (HKAS 2 allows)：obtain breakdown, agree sample to invoices, discuss update frequency, inspect variance reports。 Consignment stock ：legal ownership stays with the principal ；agent's FS 唔可以 include；risk = client includes stock it does not own → overstated inventory。Auditor enquires how consignment stock is segregated。 Inventory count 三階段（HKSA 501）： Before ：obtain count instructions and assess effectiveness；review prior year working papers；establish locations and third party holdings；consider circularising third party warehouses；consider need for experts。 During — Tests of control ：non warehouse staff count（segregation of duties）；counted items flagged；no movements during count（24/7 client → segregate despatches/deliveries to a different location and count separately）；count sheets in numerical sequence；two people per team；damaged/obsolete items segregated；count sheets must NOT show expected quantities。 During — Substantive ：test counts both directions；inspect condition for damage/obsolescence（valuation）；record last deliveries pre year end。 Auditor's objectives： evaluate management's instructions and procedures; observe the count; inspect the condition of inventory; perform test counts 。注意：count 係 client 嘅責任，auditor 唔係去幫手數！ Perpetual inventory counts ：全年輪住數；auditor 要 attend at least one count、inspect exceptions、仍要做 cut off + NRV 測試。 B5. Receivables and Prepayments（HKFRS 9 ECL） Obtain aged receivables listing, cast, agree total with FS（ valuation and presentation ）；agree receivables ledger control account with list of balances（ completeness and existence ）。 Inspect post year end cash receipts → trace to pre year end balances（ rights and obligations and existence ）— 亦係 valuation 嘅 key evidence。 Assess reasonableness of expected credit loss allowance per HKFRS 9；discuss aged balances with credit control manager（ valuation ）。 Sample of year end balances → agree back to GDNs and sales orders（ existence ）。 Inspect customer correspondence for disputed items（ existence, valuation, rights and obligations ）。 Inspect listing for credit balances → reclassify to payables（ classification ）。 Analytical： trade receivables days vs prior year（ completeness and valuation ）。 Trade receivables confirmation （HKSA 505）： Client prepares letter on client's letterhead ； auditor sends it ；customer replies directly to the auditor 。 Positive request：reply whether agree or disagree。 Negative request：reply only if disagree — 只係 risk of material misstatement is low 先用得。 ⚠️ Confirmation does NOT test valuation — 只 verify existence and rights and obligations 。就算 customer 確認咗都唔代表佢找得起 → 要做 post year end cash receipts testing 補 valuation。 Follow up ：non response → second letter / phone call (with client's permission) / alternative procedures（post year end cash receipts testing）。 Doubts about reliability（HKSA 505.A11）：response not received directly / not from intended party → obtain further evidence（e.g. telephone the respondent to verify an email response）。 Oral responses are NOT external confirmations — request written response direct to auditor; if none, seek other evidence。 Prepayments：inspect cash book/bank statements that payment made；inspect invoices that goods/services not yet received；recalculate prepaid amount；compare with prior year。 B6. Bank and Cash Two key sources of evidence： bank confirmation letter + year end bank reconciliation 。 Obtain all bank reconciliations, cast, agree cash book balance with TB/FS（ accuracy, valuation and allocation ）。 Agree bank confirmation letter balance with year end reconciliation；agree bank statement balance with original statement（ accuracy, valuation and allocation ）。 Trace outstanding payments to post year end bank statement and note clearing date（ + completeness ）；trace outstanding lodgements to pre year end cash book and post year end statement（ + existence ）。 Examine old unpresented cheques — write back if no longer valid（ completeness ）。 Inspect bank confirmation letter for security pledged / legal right of set off （ presentation and rights and obligations ）；亦可以發現 unrecorded loans（ completeness of liabilities ）。 Window dressing ：payment made immediately AFTER year end 當作 year end 前已付 → bank balance 同 payables 齊齊 understated。Auditor 要求 client add back to payables and remove from the bank reconciliation；唔改 + material → modified opinion 。 Bank confirmation request contents：company name; details of current/deposit/loan accounts; account numbers; currency; collateral; contingent liabilities; year end (audit confirmation) date; authority to disclose date; contact name (engagement partner); audit firm contact details。Bank 要 client permission；auditor 喺 year end 前提早幾星期直接寄畀 bank。 Physical cash count（if cash material）：count petty cash, agree with FS（ accuracy, valuation, existence ）；check insurance cover for large cash balances。 B7. Financial Instruments and Investments Fair value exercise 高風險；auditor 唔可以幫 client 做 valuation，但要 evaluate 估值者嘅 qualifications, experience, competence, independence and objectivity ；assumptions/methodologies 同往年一致；controls over the valuation。 有疑慮 → use an auditor's expert per HKSA 620 Using the Work of an Auditor's Expert 。 Derivatives（e.g. forward foreign currency contracts）：remeasure to fair value through profit or loss；agree contracted rates with the contract；agree FV gain/loss with P&L；check no set off of financial assets/liabilities unless legal right of set off。 Financial liabilities：confirm material loans with lender；recalculate interest accruals；examine loan agreements for covenant compliance；inspect security。 B8. Tangible Non current Assets（HKAS 16） Cast non current assets register, agree totals with FS, agree opening balances b/f（ completeness, classification, presentation ）。 Sample from register → physically inspect assets（ existence ）；sample physical assets → register （ completeness ）。Inspect for damage/impairment indicators（ valuation ）。 Additions：agree cost to supplier invoice（ valuation ）；invoice in company's name（ rights and obligations ）；confirm capital in nature not repairs（ existence ）。 Properties：inspect title deeds in company's name（ rights and obligations ）。 Revaluation：inspect valuation report; agree to GL/FS; ensure all assets in the same asset class revalued — no cherry picking； HKAS 16.31 requires revaluations with sufficient regularity that carrying amount does not differ materially from fair value。Revaluation gain → revaluation reserve via OCI ，唔係 P&L。 Depreciation：recalculate charge for a sample； proof in total per asset category（analytical）；review profits/losses on disposal — large loss suggests under depreciation （policy too long）；assess useful lives vs asset replacement cycle。 Tests of control：Board authorisation of capital expenditure；approval of disposals；reconciliation of register reviewed；insurance cover adequate。 B9. Intangible Assets（HKAS 38） Recognition criteria（ HKAS 38.21(a), (b) ）：(a) probable that expected future economic benefits will flow to the entity；(b) cost can be measured reliably 。 Internally generated goodwill 永遠唔可以 recognise （no active market → cost cannot be reliably measured）。 Research costs must always be expensed ；只有 development costs 符合 criteria 先可以 capitalise。 Procedures：inspect purchase documentation / licence agreements（existence, rights and obligations, valuation）；inspect specialist valuer's reports；assess indicators of impairment；for development costs — discuss project with management, inspect project plans and budgets, inspect Board minutes；recalculate amortisation。 B10. Payables and Accruals Obtain trade payables listing, cast, agree with GL and FS；reconcile purchase ledger control account with listing（ completeness ）。 Supplier statement reconciliations — key completeness procedure; supplier statement 係 external evidence，可靠。 Inspect post year end payments relating to current year → agree to purchase ledger / accruals schedule（ completeness ）。 Review post year end invoices relating to current year → agree to accruals schedule（ completeness ）。 Sample of GRNs immediately pre and post year end → pre year end included in payables, post year end excluded（ completeness of payables and cut off of purchases ）。 Inquire of management re unrecorded liabilities（ completeness ）。 Inspect purchase ledger for debit balances → consider reclassification to receivables/prepayments（ classification ）。 Trade payables confirmation ：verifies completeness and existence ；less common than receivables confirmation（因為 supplier statements 已係好證據）；懷疑 unrecorded liabilities 時要 include regular suppliers with small or nil balances ；confirmation 唔可以單獨作為 sufficient appropriate evidence 。 Analytical：total payables vs prior year；trade payables days vs prior year。 B11. Provisions（HKAS 37） Recognition criteria（ HKAS 37.10 ）：(1) present obligation as a result of a past event ；(2) payment probable （more likely than not）；(3) amount can be estimated reliably 。全部符合先 recognise provision。 Payment 只係 possible → contingent liability ：disclose in notes（唔入帳）；remote → 唔使披露。 Reimbursement asset ：只有 receipt virtually certain 先可以 recognise（higher hurdle than probable）；probable → disclose contingent asset。 Rare exception（ HKAS 37.92 ）：disclosure would seriously prejudice the entity in a dispute → disclose general nature of dispute + fact and reason for non disclosure（extremely rare）。 Procedures：obtain breakdown of provisions, cast, agree to GL/FS；discuss with directors / inspect supporting docs for present obligation；inspect Board minutes for probability；recalculate provision components；review post year end cash book for payments； obtain confirmation from lawyers （with client's permission）or inspect legal correspondence；review legal expenses account in GL for unidentified claims；review FS disclosures for HKAS 37 compliance；obtain written representation that provision appropriately valued and complete。 應 recognise 而無 recognise / 應 disclose 而無 disclose，material → modified opinion（qualified 'except for' if material but not pervasive）。 B12. Non current Liabilities Split loan between current（≤1 year）and non current（ 1 year）per HKAS 1 ；split 錯 → current liabilities overstated、non current understated、distorts liquidity ratios（current ratio）。 Recalculate interest charge and accrual；inspect cash book for repayments；agree balances with original loan statement and bank confirmation letter （completeness — 可以發現 unrecorded loans）；inspect loan agreements for restrictive covenants — breach 可能令 loan immediately repayable → reclassify to current。 B13. Capital and Reserves 香港公司喺 Companies Ordinance 下 no longer have share premium （無面額制度）— shares issued above former par value → 全部入 share capital。 Revaluation gain：Dr Property, plant and equipment / Cr Revaluation reserve。 Dividends ：只在 legal obligation 存在時（declared at or before reporting date）先可以 recognise as liability；declared after year end → 唔可以認；dividends 永遠係 movement on reserves（statement of changes in equity）， 唔係 P&L expense 。 Procedures：agree share capital with statutory documents；agree share issue proceeds with cash book/bank statements；inspect Board minutes for share issues and dividend declarations；recalculate dividend based on dividend per share；agree dividend to post year end cash book。 B14. Leases（HKFRS 16） Lessee：recognise right of use (ROU) asset + lease liability at commencement；exemption（optional）for short term (<12 months) and low value leases（tablets, PCs, small office furniture, telephones）。 ROU asset = lease liability at initial measurement + payments at/before commencement − lease incentives received + initial direct costs + estimated dismantling costs。 Lease liability = PV of unpaid lease payments using interest rate implicit in the lease ；subsequent：b/f + interest − payments ± remeasurement。 ROU asset depreciated per HKAS 16 cost model over earlier of end of useful life and end of lease term。 Procedures：agree prior year lease liabilities b/f；cast lease schedule；obtain lease agreements and recalculate ROU asset and lease liability ；reperform closing liability roll forward（opening − payments + interest at implicit rate）；agree depreciation charge with P&L；review disclosures for HKFRS 16 and HKFRS 7 compliance。 B15. Related Parties（HKAS 24 (Revised) / HKSA 550） HKSA 550.2：related party relationships/transactions may give rise to higher risks of material misstatement than unrelated parties — complex structures；systems ineffective at identifying related party transactions；transactions may not be at market terms（甚至無 consideration）。 Risk assessment stage：engagement team discussion；inquire of management（identity of related parties, nature of relationships, transactions, controls）；professional scepticism throughout。 During audit：agree sample of transactions to supporting docs and check market rates ；review prior year working papers；review public register for directors' other interests；review accounting records for large/unusual transactions around year end；review loan confirmations for related party guarantors；review tax returns and lawyers' correspondence；inspect bank confirmation letter。 Previously unidentified related party discovered → inform the engagement team as soon as possible；request management identify all transactions with them；inquire why controls failed；perform substantive procedures；revisit risk assessment；if intentional non disclosure → fraud risk factor （HKSA 240）。 Written representation （must obtain）：management have disclosed the identity of all related parties and all related party relationships/transactions of which they are aware, and have appropriately accounted for and disclosed them per HKAS 24 (Revised)。 C. Evidence — 邊啲 evidence 最強 External confirmations （HKSA 505）：trade receivables / trade payables / bank confirmation letters — 由第三方直接回覆 auditor，可靠性高；auditor 必須 maintain control（見 Card 5）。 Supplier statements ：external evidence，比 client 內部記錄可靠。 Written representations （directors' emoluments、provisions、related parties）：internal evidence，只係補充，唔可以取代其他 procedures。 如果 procedures 攞唔到 sufficient appropriate evidence，alternative procedures 又唔得 → limitation of scope → 可能 modify opinion。 D. Ethics 相關要點（本章範圍） Payroll 係 sensitive area — auditor 必須保持 confidentiality 。 Auditor must not carry out the fair value valuation for the client （只能 evaluate 證據）— 避免 self review 威脅；需要時用 auditor's expert（HKSA 620）。 使用 client 嘅 investment manager / valuer 嘅工作前，必須評估其 independence and objectivity 、qualifications、competence。 Related party 非自願披露 / 管理層刻意隱瞞 → fraud risk factor → HKSA 240。 E. Report Modifications 觸發點（本章情境） 情境 結果 Material misstatement 唔肯改（e.g. 唔肯做 ECL allowance、window dressing 唔改、HKAS 37 應披露唔披露、related party 唔披露） Modified opinion — 通常 qualified 'except for' （material but not pervasive）+ Basis for Modified Opinion paragraph after Opinion paragraph Directors' emoluments disclosure 唔符合準則/法例 Auditor's opinion may be modified 攞唔到 sufficient appropriate evidence + 無 alternative procedures Limitation of scope → modified opinion 易混淆概念對比 對比 1：Existence vs Completeness — 測試方向倒轉就零分 Existence Completeness 問題 帳面記錄係咪真係存在？（防 overstatement） 存在嘅嘢係咪全部入咗帳？（防 understatement） 測試方向 Records → Physical/Source （由帳面揀 sample 追到實物/原始文件） Physical/Source → Records （由實物/原始文件追返入帳） Inventory count Sample from count sheets → physical inventory Sample from physical inventory → count sheets Non current assets Sample from register → physically inspect asset Sample physical assets → inspect register Receivables Year end balances → agree to GDNs/sales orders；confirmation Control account vs listing；receivables days analytical Payables Supplier statement reconciliation GRNs pre year end → included in payables；post year end payments/invoices testing 點樣分辨 問自己：「起點係帳面定實物？」帳面出發 = existence 實物/文件出發 = completeness 考試伏位 Panelist 年年鬧 mismatch：用 physical → records 答 existence 係錯；liabilities 主攻 completeness，唔好寫 existence procedures 落 payables Confirmation of receivables 唔 test valuation ；唔好以為確認咗餘額 = 收得返 對比 2：Provision vs Contingent Liability vs Contingent Asset / Reimbursement（HKAS 37） Provision Contingent Liability Contingent Asset / Reimbursement 門檻 Present obligation from past event + payment probable （more likely than not）+ reliable estimate （HKAS 37.10） Payment only possible ，或唔能夠 reliably measure Inflow probable → disclose；recognise reimbursement asset 只在 virtually certain 處理 Recognise in the statement of financial position Disclose in notes（remote 就唔使披露） Probable → disclose only；virtually certain → recognise asset 考試伏位 唔可以為未來支出設 provision（無 past event obligation）；35%/40% 勝算唔係 probable → 唔可以 recognise Material 而唔披露 → qualified 'except for' opinion；HKAS 37.92 嘅 non disclosure exception 係 extremely rare 「virtually certain」門檻高過「probable」；provision 同 reimbursement asset 唔可以 offset Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: What are the four key assertions for revenue, and which single procedure verifies cut off? Back: Assertions: cut off; accuracy; completeness; occurrence . Cut off procedure: inspect a sample of goods despatched notes (GDNs) immediately before and after year end and ensure they have been recorded in the correct accounting period . Related risk: overstated revenue via premature recognition or fictitious sales (fraud risk — bonuses, loan covenants). 💬 白話解釋：Revenue 嘅四大 assertion 要背到好似自己名咁。Cut off 測試一定係攞年結前後嘅 GDN 嚟睇，唔係睇 invoice date——因為 HKFRS 15 係睇 control 幾時轉移。記住「GDN 前後對」五個字。 Card 2 Front: When must the auditor attend the client's physical inventory count, and what are the auditor's four primary objectives at the count? Back: HKSA 501 requires attendance when inventory is material to the financial statements (unless impracticable). Objectives: (1) evaluate management's instructions and procedures for the count; (2) observe the client's staff performing the count; (3) inspect the condition of the inventory; (4) perform test counts . The count itself is the client's responsibility — the auditor never performs the count. 💬 白話解釋：考試常見伏位係「auditor 去盤點係為咗做盤點」——錯！Auditor 係去評估 client 嘅指示同程序、觀察、檢查存貨狀況、做 test counts。盤點永遠係管理層嘅責任。 Card 3 Front: During an inventory count, the auditor (i) selects items from the count sheets and traces them to the physical inventory, and (ii) selects physical items and traces them to the count sheets. Which assertion does each direction verify? Back: (i) Count sheets → physical inventory: existence （帳面有嘅嘢真係存在）。 (ii) Physical inventory → count sheets: completeness （實物有嘅嘢全部入咗帳）。 Same logic applies to non current assets (register → asset = existence; asset → register = completeness). 💬 白話解釋：口訣：「由紙到貨 = existence；由貨到紙 = completeness」。起點決定 assertion，呢個係 examiner 最鍾意玩嘅 direction trap。 Card 4 Front: Which assertions does a trade receivables confirmation verify, which assertion does it NOT verify, and what compensating procedure addresses that gap? Back: Verifies: existence and rights and obligations only. Does NOT verify: valuation — a customer agreeing the balance is owed does not mean the customer can pay. Compensating procedure: post year end cash receipts testing (inspect post year end cash receipts and trace to pre year end balances); also assess the expected credit loss allowance per HKFRS 9 and discuss aged balances with the credit controller. 💬 白話解釋：客人認數 ≠ 客人找得起數。所以 confirmation 永遠唔可以單獨依靠，一定要配搭期後收款測試同 ECL 評估。呢個係 LP 嘅 Key Learning Point，考試好鍾意考「NOT」題。 Card 5 Front: Per HKSA 505, how does the auditor maintain control over external confirmation requests? Back (HKSA 505.7 — four elements): 1. Determining the information to be confirmed or requested; 2. Selecting the appropriate confirming party ; 3. Designing the confirmation requests , including determining that requests are properly addressed and contain return information for responses to be sent directly to the auditor ; 4. Sending the requests , including follow up requests when applicable, to the confirming party. Extra points: the letter is prepared by the client on the client's letterhead but sent by the auditor; replies go direct to the auditor, never via the client (reduces risk of client interference). Doubts about reliability (HKSA 505.A11) → obtain further evidence, e.g. telephone the respondent to verify an emailed response; oral responses are NOT external confirmations. 💬 白話解釋：成個 confirmation 過程 auditor 要「揸 fit」：揀人、設計封信、親自寄、直接收回。Client 只負責出信紙。任何經 client 手嘅回覆都不可靠，要再攞證據。 Card 6 Front: What is 'window dressing' in the audit of bank and cash, and how should the auditor respond? Back: Definition: treating a payment made immediately after the reporting date as if it was made at or before year end (e.g. included as an unpresented payment in the year end bank reconciliation). Effect: understates a positive bank balance (or overstates an overdraft) and understates trade payables — the statement of financial position looks healthier than reality. Auditor's response: ask the client to add the payment back into trade payables and remove it from the bank reconciliation ; if refused and material → modified auditor's opinion (material misstatement). Detection: review the cash book for large or unusual items around year end; trace outstanding payments to post year end bank statements and note clearing dates. 💬 白話解釋：Window dressing 即係「扮靚個年結」——將 1 月先過數嘅 payment 當 12 月已付，銀行存款同應付賬齊齊縮水。記住調整方向：payables 加返上去，reconciliation 剔走。 Card 7 Front: State the HKAS 37 recognition criteria for a provision, and the different thresholds for a contingent liability and a reimbursement asset. Back: Provision (recognise): present obligation as a result of a past event + payment probable (more likely than not) + amount can be estimated reliably (HKAS 37.10). Contingent liability: payment only possible (or not reliably measurable) → disclose in notes ; remote → no disclosure. Reimbursement asset: recognise only if receipt is virtually certain (higher hurdle than probable); if probable → disclose as a contingent asset. Provision and reimbursement asset must not be offset . HKAS 37.92: disclosure may be withheld only in extremely rare cases where it would seriously prejudice the entity in a dispute — disclose general nature + fact/reason for non disclosure. 💬 白話解釋：三級門檻：probable → 入帳；possible → 披露；virtually certain → 先可以認資產。記住資產嘅門檻係最高嘅，因為會計上對收益/資產保守啲。35% 勝訴率 = possible，只可以披露 contingent liability。 Card 8 Front: What are the HKAS 38 recognition criteria for an intangible asset, and which common item is specifically prohibited from recognition? Back: Recognition criteria (HKAS 38.21(a), (b)): (a) it is probable that the expected future economic benefits attributable to the asset will flow to the entity; and (b) the cost of the asset can be measured reliably . Internally generated goodwill can never be recognised — no active market exists, so cost cannot be reliably measured. Research costs must always be expensed ; only development costs meeting the criteria may be capitalised. Audit procedures: inspect purchase documentation/licence agreements (existence, rights and obligations, valuation); assess impairment indicators; recalculate amortisation over useful economic life. 💬 白話解釋：HKAS 38 兩道閘：經濟利益 probable + 成本可靠計量。Internally generated goodwill 因為無 active market 計唔到可靠成本，所以永遠禁認。Research 一律費用化，development 達標先可以資本化——呢個對比係必考位。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Goods despatched note (GDN) 出貨單——證明貨已送出嘅文件，cut off 測試主角 The auditor inspected GDNs immediately before and after year end to verify the cut off assertion for revenue. Goods received note (GRN) 收貨單——採購/應付賬 completeness 測試嘅起點 Unmatched GRNs not yet invoiced were agreed to the schedule of accruals to verify completeness. External confirmation 外部確認函——第三方直接回覆 auditor 嘅證據 Under HKSA 505, the auditor must maintain control over external confirmation requests, including sending the requests. Cut off 截數分期——交易有冇記喺正確會計期間 Tracing GDNs around year end to sales invoices provides evidence that sales were recorded in the correct accounting period. Window dressing 粉飾年結——將期後付款假裝成年結前付款 Including a post year end payment run as an unpresented payment understates both the bank balance and trade payables. Net realisable value (NRV) 可變現淨值——存貨按 cost 同 NRV 孰低計量 The auditor compared post year end selling prices with cost to ensure inventory was held at the lower of cost and NRV per HKAS 2. Proof in total 整體合理性測算——用預期值同實際數比較嘅分析程序 The auditor performed a proof in total of the payroll expense, incorporating joiners, leavers and the annual pay increase. Supplier statement reconciliation 供應商對賬單調節——外部證據，驗證應付賬 completeness Supplier statement reconciliations were agreed with the purchase ledger balances and reconciling items were investigated.

title: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz Answers
headings: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz Answers
Q3 — Answer: (a) HK$150,000; (b) understated by HK$2,000; (c) investigate the difference with management / compare against materiality
Q5 — Model Answer (any FOUR of the following)
excerpt: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A trade receivables confirmation …
text: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A trade receivables confirmation — even a positive confirmation returned directly to the auditor — verifies only the existence and rights and obligations assertions. It does not verify valuation : a customer agreeing that a balance is owed gives no assurance that the customer is able to pay. The auditor must not place total reliance on the confirmation and must perform further procedures to test valuation, such as post year end cash receipts testing (inspecting post year end cash receipts and tracing them to the pre year end balance) and assessing the reasonableness of the expected credit loss allowance per HKFRS 9 , including discussing aged balances with the credit control manager. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 LP 嘅 Key Learning Point：confirmation 唔 test valuation。Distractor 分析： A 錯 ：高估咗 confirmation 嘅威力——就算正面確認直接寄返 auditor，都只覆蓋 existence 同 rights and obligations，valuation（收唔收得返）完全無掂到。呢個係考官最鍾意嘅「確認咗 = 搞掂晒」陷阱。 C 錯 ：letterhead 同 related party 同「使唔使做埋 valuation 測試」無關；letterhead 只係 confirmation 程序嘅行政安排（client 出信紙、auditor 寄、直接回覆 auditor）。 D 錯 ：兩重錯——confirmation 唔係 test completeness（receivables 主攻 overstatement，唔係 understatement），而且 negative confirmation 只喺 risk of material misstatement 低嘅情況先合用，material balance 唔會用 negative。 B 啱 ：準確指出 valuation gap 同補救程序（post year end cash receipts + ECL allowance）。 Rule Check: HKSA 505 External Confirmations （HKSA 505.7 維持控制；HKSA 505.A11 可靠性疑慮）；HKFRS 9 Financial Instruments （expected credit loss model）；LP Ch 7.6.3–7.6.4 Key Learning Point。 Common Trap（繁中）: 記住口訣「認數 ≠ 找數」。任何答「confirmation 提供 sufficient appropriate evidence 覆蓋晒所有 assertions」嘅選項都係伏。Valuation 永遠要靠期後收款同 ECL 評估補位。 Q2 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): The partner's concern is understatement of trade payables , i.e. the completeness assertion (the primary assertion for liabilities). Procedure B starts from an independent source document population (goods received notes dated immediately pre year end) and traces forward into the accounting records (payables balance and purchases). This direction of testing — from source to records — detects omitted liabilities and also verifies cut off of purchases . The other procedures test different assertions or are not substantive: A starts from the recorded population and traces back to source documents, which verifies existence (overstatement), not completeness; C verifies mathematical accuracy/completeness of the listing only within the recorded population — it cannot detect liabilities never recorded; D is a test of control , not a substantive procedure addressing completeness. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係典型嘅 direction trap（panelist 年年鬧嘅 mismatch 弱項）： 關鍵第一步：「payables understated」→ 目標 assertion 係 completeness 。 第二步：completeness 要「由源頭追到入帳」（GRN → payables）；existence 先係「由帳面追到源頭」（listing → invoice/GRN）。 A 錯 ：方向倒轉，test existence/overstatement。 C 錯 ：cast listing 只證明「已記錄嘅嘢加數無錯」，搵唔到「根本無記錄」嘅負債。 D 錯 ：審批授權係 test of control，唔係 substantive procedure，題目明確要求 substantive。 B 啱 ：GRN pre year end → 追入 year end payables = completeness + cut off，正中紅心。 Rule Check: LP Ch 7.11.2（payables procedures：GRNs pre and post year end → completeness of payables and cut off of purchases）；HKSA 500 Audit Evidence （substantive procedures vs tests of control）；liabilities completeness focus per LP Ch 7.11.1。 Common Trap（繁中）: 見到「supplier / payable / understated」即諗 completeness + 由源頭追起。仲有，記住 supplier statement reconciliations 都係 completeness 嘅強力程序（external evidence）——如果選項出現佢同 B 二選一，要睇題目場景（本題話 invoices recorded late，GRN tracing 更直接回應 cut off/omission 風險）。 Q3 — Answer: (a) HK$150,000; (b) understated by HK$2,000; (c) investigate the difference with management / compare against materiality Model Answer (EN): (a) Expected depreciation charge (proof in total) = HK$1,200,000 ÷ 8 years = HK$150,000 per annum (straight line, no residual value, no additions or disposals during the year). (b) Recorded charge = HK$148,000. Difference = HK$150,000 − HK$148,000 = HK$2,000 understated (depreciation expense understated; carrying amount of plant and machinery overstated by HK$2,000). The difference is 1.3% (HK$2,000 / HK$150,000) below expectation, which is clearly trivial and would not be material. (c) Audit response (any ONE): Discuss the difference with management and obtain an explanation (e.g. minor timing of assets entering service). Compare the difference with performance materiality/overall materiality and, if clearly trivial, record it on the summary of uncorrected misstatements without further work. Recalculate the depreciation charge for a sample of individual assets and agree with the non current assets register to identify the source of the difference. 解題思路（繁中）: Proof in total 係 LP 7.9.2 明確列出嘅 depreciation analytical procedure。步驟：(1) 用 policy 參數自己計一個 expectation（$1,200,000 / 8 = $150,000）；(2) 同 recorded figure 比較，$148,000 係低咗 → expense understated（記住 direction：depreciation 少計 = 資產帳面值多咗）；(3) 差異 $2,000 只佔 1.3%，屬 clearly trivial——照計入 uncorrected misstatements summary，唔使大費周章。考試伏位：有同學會答「 overstated」因為見到 recorded 數細過預期就淆亂——記住 expense 低咗，資產先至係 overstated，但題目問 depreciation charge 本身，所以係 understated。 Rule Check: HKAS 16 Property, Plant and Equipment （depreciation per cost model）；LP Ch 7.9.2（proof in total calculation for the depreciation charge — analytical procedure, verifies completeness and valuation）；HKSA 520 Analytical Procedures （investigating differences from expectations）。 Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 唔好加 residual value——題目話無。(2) 唔好 prorate——題目話無 additions/disposals。(3) Direction 要分清：charge 低咗 → depreciation understated → PPE carrying amount overstated。(4) 呢種 proof in total 係 substantive analytical procedure，唔好當佢係 test of details。 Q4 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 37 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets (HKAS 37.10), a provision is recognised only when ALL three criteria are met: (1) a present obligation as a result of a past event; (2) payment is probable (more likely than not); and (3) the amount can be estimated reliably . Here, the lawyers advise the likelihood of an outflow is only approximately 30% — possible but not probable — so the recognition criteria are NOT met and no provision can be recognised. However, because the claim is material , the company must disclose a contingent liability in the notes to the financial statements. If the finance director refuses to disclose a material contingent liability, the financial statements would not comply with HKAS 37 and the auditor would express a modified opinion — qualified 'except for' (material but not pervasive). 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 HKAS 37 三級門檻： A 錯 ：30% likelihood 唔係「probable」（more likely than not，即 50%），recognition criteria 唔齊，唔可以認 provision。 B 錯 ：trade payable 係畀「已知、確定」嘅負債；官司輸贏未知、金額未確定，唔可以用 payable。 D 錯 ：呢個係最危險嘅 distractor——「below 50% 所以乜都唔使做」。錯！Possible（唔係 remote）+ material = 必須 disclose contingent liability 。只有 remote 先可以唔披露。Finance director 嗰句「probably fail」係日常口語，唔係 HKAS 37 嘅 technical meaning，考試要分得好清楚。 C 啱 ：possible + material → disclose only，唔入帳。 Rule Check: HKAS 37.10（provision recognition criteria）；HKAS 37（contingent liabilities — disclose unless possibility of settlement is remote）；LP Ch 7.12.1–7.12.2（non disclosure of a material contingent liability → modified opinion, qualified 'except for'）。 Common Trap（繁中）: 三級門檻背到滾瓜爛熟：probable → recognise provision；possible → disclose contingent liability；remote → nothing。另外記住「probable」嘅口語同準則定義唔同——準則入面 probable = more likely than not。如果題目轉咗做 reimbursement/contingent asset，門檻係 virtually certain 先可以認資產。 Q5 — Model Answer (any FOUR of the following) Model Answer (EN): 1. Inspect post year end cash receipts in the post year end cash book/bank statements and trace them to pre year end trade receivable balances — verifies existence and rights and obligations (and provides strong evidence on valuation , since receipt of cash demonstrates recoverability). 2. Select a sample of year end trade receivable balances and agree them back to supporting documentation (goods despatched notes and sales orders) — verifies existence . 3. Obtain the aged receivables listing, cast it, and agree the total with the financial statements ; agree the receivables ledger control account with the list of balances — verifies valuation and presentation (and completeness and existence for the control account reconciliation). 4. Review the aged receivables listing for slow moving/overdue balances and discuss them with the credit control manager to assess whether the expected credit loss allowance under HKFRS 9 is adequate — verifies valuation . 5. Inspect customer correspondence for material disputed items that may require write off or an increased allowance — verifies existence, valuation and rights and obligations . 6. Calculate trade receivables days, compare with the prior year and investigate significant differences (substantive analytical procedure) — verifies completeness and valuation . 7. Inspect the receivables listing for credit balances and consider reclassification to payables — verifies existence, completeness (of payables) and classification . 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 Exam Practice 風格嘅「partner 話唔准做 confirmation，用 alternative procedures 頂上」情境，但場景係全新（Vertex Electronics）。得分關鍵： 每個 procedure 要 寫明 assertion ——題目有要求，唔寫就跌分（考官最鬧「唔跟 requirement」）。 必勝兩式： post year end cash receipts （existence + valuation 雙殺）同 agree balances to GDNs/sales orders （existence）一定要識。 唔好寫 confirmation 相關嘢（題目話明 other than confirmation）；唔好寫 tests of control（題目要 substantive procedures）。 Analytical（receivables days）都算分，但要註明佢主要 verify completeness 同 valuation。 Rule Check: LP Ch 7.6.2（receivables audit procedures and assertion mapping）；HKFRS 9 Financial Instruments （expected credit loss allowance）；HKSA 500 Audit Evidence （alternative procedures where external confirmation is not used）；HKSA 505 External Confirmations 。 Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 寫 procedure 唔寫 assertion = 唔跟題目要求。(2) 將「agree listing total to FS」當 existence——佢其實係 valuation/presentation（加 control account reconciliation 先有 completeness/existence）。(3) Post year end cash receipts 係呢類題嘅王牌：existence、rights and obligations、valuation 三個都掂。(4) 管理層拒絕畀做 confirmation 本身仲要 assess 係咪 scope limitation——呢度 partner 已判斷有足夠 alternative procedures，所以跟住题意答就得。 Citations are per the 4th edition LP Chapter 7 text. Where the LP cites a specific paragraph (e.g. HKSA 505.7, HKSA 505.A11, HKAS 37.10), that paragraph is used; otherwise the standard is cited at the level the LP supports.

title: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4.…
text: M8 Chapter 7: Audit Procedures for Specific Balances and Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) You are the audit senior of Harbour Trading Limited, a Hong Kong wholesaler of kitchen appliances. You have completed a positive trade receivables confirmation exercise for the year ended 31 December 20X4. A major customer, whose year end balance of HK$420,000 is material, has signed and returned the confirmation directly to your firm agreeing the balance in full. The audit junior concludes that no further audit work is needed on this balance. Which of the following correctly evaluates the audit junior's conclusion? A. The conclusion is appropriate, because a positive confirmation returned directly to the auditor provides sufficient appropriate audit evidence over existence, rights and obligations, and valuation. B. The conclusion is inappropriate, because the confirmation does not verify the valuation assertion; the auditor should perform additional procedures such as inspecting post year end cash receipts and assessing the expected credit loss allowance. C. The conclusion is appropriate, provided the confirmation was prepared on the client's letterhead and the customer is not a related party of Harbour Trading Limited. D. The conclusion is inappropriate, because a positive confirmation only verifies the completeness assertion; the auditor should have used a negative confirmation request to verify existence. Question 2 (MCQ) You are auditing Pacific Catering Supplies Limited for the year ended 31 March 20X5. Last year's letter of comment highlighted serious deficiencies in the purchases cycle, including purchase invoices being recorded late. The audit engagement partner is concerned that trade payables may be understated at the reporting date and asks you to design a substantive procedure that directly addresses this risk. Which of the following procedures is the MOST appropriate response to the partner's concern? A. Select a sample of trade payable balances from the year end purchase ledger listing and agree them to supplier invoices and goods received notes. B. Select a sample of goods received notes dated immediately before the year end and trace them to inclusion in the year end trade payables balance and purchases records. C. Cast the trade payables listing and agree the total with the general ledger and the financial statements. D. Inspect a sample of purchase orders for evidence of authorisation by a responsible official before the order was placed. Question 3 (Calculation / short answer) Summit Manufacturing Limited depreciates its plant and machinery on a straight line basis over eight years with no residual value. The total cost of plant and machinery per the non current assets register at 31 December 20X4 is HK$1,200,000. There were no additions or disposals during the year. The depreciation charge for plant and machinery recorded in the statement of profit or loss is HK$148,000. (a) Calculate the expected depreciation charge for the year using a proof in total approach. (b) State the difference between the expected charge and the recorded charge, and whether plant and machinery depreciation is overstated or understated. (c) State ONE appropriate audit response to the difference identified. Question 4 (MCQ) Golden Bowl Restaurants Limited is being sued by a customer who slipped in one of its branches in November 20X4, claiming HK$800,000 in damages. The amount is material to the financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X4. The company's lawyers have advised in writing that, based on the evidence available, it is possible but not probable (approximately 30% likelihood) that the court will find the company liable, and the claim is being actively defended. The finance director proposes to do nothing in the financial statements on the grounds that "the claim will probably fail". Which of the following is the correct treatment in the financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X4? A. Recognise a provision of HK$800,000 because a present obligation exists as a result of a past event. B. Recognise a trade payable of HK$800,000 because the claim has been quantified by the customer's lawyers. C. Disclose a contingent liability in the notes to the financial statements, because the claim is material and an outflow of economic benefits is possible but not probable. D. No recognition or disclosure is required because the likelihood of an outflow is below 50%. Question 5 (Short answer) The finance director of Vertex Electronics Limited refuses to allow your audit firm to send external confirmation requests to any of the company's customers, stating that the exercise "upsets customers". The audit engagement partner insists that, if confirmations cannot be sent, alternative procedures must be included in the audit programme to verify the existence and valuation of year end trade receivables. List FOUR substantive procedures, other than a trade receivables confirmation, that the auditor could perform to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence over the existence and/or valuation of trade receivables. For each procedure, state the assertion(s) it verifies. End of quiz. No answers are provided in this file.

title: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Evidence（完成階段嘅證據評估）
B. Ethics（完成階段嘅道德要求）
C. Procedures（完成階段嘅核心程序）
D. Assertions（本章程序對應嘅 assertions）
E. Report modifications（完成階段嘅報告影響；詳情見 Chapter 9）
excerpt: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Illustrate the major actions performed dur…
text: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Illustrate the major actions performed during the completion phase of an audit, including the final overall review of financial statements and final analytical procedures under HKSA 520. 2. Explain the going concern assumption, the auditor's objectives and requirements under HKSA 570 (Revised), and the implications for the auditor's report. 3. Illustrate the review of contingent liabilities, commitments and subsequent events, distinguishing adjusting from non adjusting events under HKSA 560 and HKAS 10. 4. Evaluate misstatements under HKSA 450, including the concept of "clearly trivial" and the effect of uncorrected misstatements on the auditor's opinion. 5. Describe the purpose, content and dating of the written representation letter under HKSA 580 and the matters communicated to those charged with governance under HKSA 260 (Revised). 必背考點 A. Evidence（完成階段嘅證據評估） Sufficient appropriate audit evidence （HKSA 500 Audit Evidence）： Audit evidence （para. 5(c)）：information used by the auditor in arriving at the conclusions on which the auditor's opinion is based — 包括 accounting records 同 other sources。 Sufficiency （para. 5(f)）：the measure of the quantity of audit evidence；受 risk of material misstatement 評估同 evidence quality 影響。 Appropriateness （para. 5(b)）：the measure of the quality of audit evidence — 即 relevance and reliability 。 證據來源： external evidence （confirmations、expert reports、analysts' reports、benchmarking data）一般比 internal evidence 更可靠；internal evidence 靠 data 之間嘅 corroboration。 完成階段評估證據時要確認：工作符合 HKSAs 同香港 legal/regulatory requirements；planning 階段識別嘅 risks 已被 address；procedures 結果能 support opinion；significant matters 已處理同 documented；consultations 已完成同落實。 HKSA 220 (Revised) Quality Management for an Audit of Financial Statements ：engagement partner 負責 direction、supervision 同 review engagement team 嘅工作，確保取得 sufficient appropriate audit evidence。（LP 指明 HKSA 220 (Revised) 於 April 2021 發出、15 December 2022 生效，屬 examinable document。） B. Ethics（完成階段嘅道德要求） Code of Ethics (COE) Section 300 — 五類 threats（對 engagement quality reviewer 同其他 appropriate reviewers 同樣適用）： 1. Self interest （直接財務利益、lowballing fee、利用 confidential information 圖利） 2. Self review （review 自己之前做嘅工作，例如曾做 engagement partner 再做 EQR） 3. Advocacy （代表 client 打官司、lobbying） 4. Familiarity （family member 係 client director、long association、兩位 partner 互相做對方嘅 EQR） 5. Intimidation （被威脅解僱、被逼同意 inappropriate accounting treatment、收禮後被要脅） Safeguards（COE para. 300.8 A2）：加派人手時間、由非團隊成員做 appropriate reviewer、用不同 partners/teams 處理 non assurance services、involve another firm、披露 referral fees/commissions。 Threat 唔可以 mitigate 到 acceptably low level → engagement quality review 必須由另一人執行。 完成階段 deadline 逼近時唔准走捷徑：professional competence、due care、professional behaviour（COE Section 110, subsections 113 and 115）。 Management/TCWG 施壓唔改 opinion = intimidation threat ；auditor 必須 stand its ground（integrity、objectivity — COE Section 110, subsections 111–115）。 C. Procedures（完成階段嘅核心程序） 1. Final overall review of financial statements 將 draft financial statements cross reference 返去 audit file（先 aggregated 再 disaggregated totals）。 檢查 disclosures 嘅 completeness 同 accuracy，確保符合 HKFRSs 同 Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) ；通常用 disclosure checklist。 Quantitative disclosures：segment reporting、related party transaction amounts、associates/JV summarised financial information；Qualitative disclosures：significant accounting policies、critical accounting estimates、going concern basis、contingent liability circumstances。 留意 management 提供 excessive disclosure 會模糊重點。 Final analytical procedures（HKSA 520 Analytical Procedures, para. 6） ：near the end of the audit，協助形成 overall conclusion — financial statements as a whole 是否與 auditor 嘅 understanding 一致。如發現之前未識別嘅 risks of material misstatement，必須 revise risk assessment 同 modify planned audit responses。 2. Going concern（HKSA 570 (Revised) Going Concern） Management 嘅責任： HKAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements （LP margin: HKAS 1.25–26）要求 management assess going concern；CO (Cap. 622) 喺若干情況下要求 directors 作 solvency statement。呢個 assessment 唔係 保證 entity 未來 12 個月存續。 Auditor 嘅三大 objectives（HKSA 570 (Revised)）：取得關於 going concern basis 是否 appropriate 嘅 sufficient appropriate evidence；conclude 是否存在 material uncertainty ；按 HKSA 570 (Revised) 形成 opinion。 四個 key requirements （HKSA 570.9–16）： 1. Risk assessment procedures（連結 HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) 同 HKSA 330） 2. Evaluating management's assessment（management 同 auditor 嘅 assessment 都要涵蓋 at least 12 months from the date of the financial statements ；budgets/forecasts、creditor 書面承諾 12 個月內唔追數、related parties support、進一步融資能力；auditor 要取 going concern written representation） 3. Period beyond management's assessment（HKSA 570.12–14 — inquire of management） 4. Additional audit procedures（如有 events/conditions cast significant doubt） Warning signs ：Financial（net current liabilities、total liabilities total assets、negative operating cash flows、operating losses、COD terms、unusual offshore financing、pending litigation、loan covenant breaches）；Operational（long lead times on asset sales、significant debt due and payable、creditor days 大幅變動、supply chain issues、loss of major customers）；Other（economic/environmental disasters、changes in laws/regulation、non insurable events）。 3. Contingent liabilities and commitments 適用 standards： HKSA 540 (Revised) （contingent liabilities 多數涉及 accounting estimate）、 HKAS 37 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets 、commitments 通常基於 contractual obligations。 主要 assertions：valuation（estimates reasonable per HKFRS）+ completeness （所有 material contingent liabilities 已識別、計量、披露）；commitments 程序目標係 completeness and accuracy 。 Contingent liabilities 程序： 按 HKSA 505 External Confirmations 向 legal counsel 同 banks 發 confirmations（pending litigation list + progress、warranties/guarantees claims、bank guarantees） Examine Board minutes（有冇批准 guarantees） Review environmental reviews 同 industry practices（如 mining 'make good' clauses） Review product warranty arrangements Commitments 程序：確認 leasing commitments 按 HKFRS 16 Leases 入賬；search 已簽約嘅 future capital expenditure 同 licensing commitments。 4. Subsequent events（HKSA 560 Subsequent Events；HKAS 10 Events After the Reporting Period） Adjusting events ：provide further evidence of conditions that existed at the end of the financial period → 要調整 financial statements。 Non adjusting events ：conditions that arose after period end → 唔調整，但 material 嘅話要 note disclosure。（香港上市公司最常見披露：post period end dividend declaration。） 三個時段嘅責任： 1. Date of FS → date of auditor's report ：主動責任（"active duty"）— 必須做 procedures，盡量接近 report date：understand management 點識別 events、enquiry of management/Board、read Board/management minutes、review post period end management accounts、跟進 legal counsel（regulators 期望 follow up 喺 opinion date 前最多 7 日內做）（HKSA 560.6–8）。 2. After auditor's report date → before FS issued ：被動責任（"passive duty"）— no obligation 做 procedures；但若得知會改變 opinion 嘅事實 → 討論是否 amend FS；management 修改 → 做 procedures + 出新 report + EoM or OM paragraph ；management 拒絕 → modify opinion per HKSA 705 (Revised) ；如已用 original report 發出 → take action to prevent reliance，必要時 seek legal advice（HKSA 560.10–13）。 3. After FS issued ：同上處理；視乎時間可能喺下年度 FS 或（listed）interim FS 修正（HKSA 560.14–17）。 5. Evaluation of misstatements（HKSA 450 Evaluation of Misstatements Identified during the Audit） Misstatement 定義 （para. 3）：reported amount / classification / presentation / disclosure 與 applicable financial reporting framework 要求之間嘅差異；可源自 error or fraud。 Accumulate 所有 misstatements，except those that are clearly trivial （para. 5）。 "Clearly trivial" ≠ "not material" （para. A2）— clearly trivial 係 wholly different (smaller) order of magnitude，個別或合計都 clearly of no consequence；有疑問就當唔係 clearly trivial。 三類 unrecorded misstatements： Factual — 無爭議，金額/披露明確錯誤。 Projected — 由 sample 發現嘅 misstatements 推算落成個 population。 Judgemental — auditor 唔同意 management 嘅 accounting estimates/policies judgements（例如 provisions、percentage of completion）。 Prior year uncorrected misstatements 要 carried forward ；如果累積效應 + 本年 misstatements 令本期 FS materially misstated → 要求調整。 Qualitative factors 可令低於 materiality 嘅 misstatements 變成 material（HKSA 450.10–11 相關討論）：影響 regulatory compliance、debt covenants、隱藏 earnings trends 轉變、影響已公佈 forecasts、影響 ratios、classification errors。 Uncorrected misstatements 個別或合計 material → 盡快通知 management/TCWG 並 request correction ；唔改 → 一般會 modified opinion（詳見 Chapter 9）。 6. Written representations（HKSA 580 Written Representations） 又名 management representation letter / rep. letter。 三大 objectives（HKSA 580.6）：取得 management（及適當時 TCWG）確認已履行 FS 編製責任同提供資料完整性嘅 written representations；用以 support 其他 audit evidence（或被其他 HKSAs 要求時）；對有冇提供 representations 作適當回應。 Written representations 係 necessary audit evidence，但 internally generated，單獨唔構成 sufficient appropriate audit evidence ，亦唔可以代替其他 procedures，唔影響 auditor 獲取其他 evidence 嘅 nature。 Dating： as close as possible to, but NOT after, the date of the auditor's report ；實務上通常與 auditor's report 同一日簽；要涵蓋 report 提及嘅所有 periods；auditor 唔應同意 management 改動 letter。 常見內容：management 承認按 HKFRS 編製 FS 嘅責任、books/records/minutes 完整提供、無 unrecorded transactions、internal control 設計責任、liens/encumbrances 已披露、estimates 假設合理、related parties 已披露、subsequent events 已調整/披露、uncorrected misstatements 個別及合計 immaterial（清單附於 letter）。 CO (Cap. 622) 公司額外 representations： s.380 （true and fair view）、妥善 accounting records、 s.383 + Cap. 622G （directors' emoluments notes）、 ss.390、543(2)、Schedule 5、s.452(3) （directors' report）。 其他 HKSAs 嘅 written representation 要求（HKSA 580 Appendix 1）： HKSA 240 para. 40（fraud：internal control 責任、fraud risk assessment 結果、已知/懷疑 fraud 已披露） HKSA 250 (Revised) para. 17（non compliance with laws and regulations 已披露） HKSA 450 para. 14（uncorrected misstatements immaterial + 附清單） HKSA 501 para. 12（litigation and claims 已披露及按 framework 處理） HKSA 540 (Revised) para. 37（estimates 嘅 methods、significant assumptions、data 係 appropriate） HKSA 550 para. 26（related parties 身份同交易已披露及入賬） HKSA 560 para. 9（所有需調整/披露嘅 subsequent events 已處理） HKSA 570 (Revised) para. 16(e)（management plans for future actions 及 feasibility） HKSA 710 para. 9（all periods + prior period restatement） HKSA 720 (Revised) para. 13(c)（final version of other information documents 會提供） 7. Communication with those charged with governance（HKSA 260 (Revised)；HKSA 265 para. 9） TCWG = persons entrusted with the supervision, control and direction of an entity；溝通對象係最高層（executive/non executive directors、Audit Committee），可在 engagement letter 釐清。 目的： effective two way communication — 交代 auditor 責任、planned scope/timing；從 TCWG 取得 audit 相關資料；及時提供 significant observations（包括 fraud）。 常見溝通事項（HKSA 260.14–17）：audit scope/approach 及 limitations、重大會計政策及變更、listed companies 嘅 key audit matters 、重大 audit adjustments、威脅 going concern 嘅事項、與 management 嘅 disagreements、預期嘅 report modifications、internal control material weaknesses、independence threats 及 safeguards、business risks、written representations 內容、改善 internal control 嘅 recommendations。 Documentation/timing（HKSA 260.23 一帶）：要 timely 、喺 management 批准 FS 前溝通； 即使冇事項都要發出 communication （聲明無 significant findings）；可以口頭，但必須喺 working papers 書面記錄；屬 two way dialogue，management 有權回應。 8. Related parties（HKSA 550 Related Parties；披露框架 HKAS 24 (Revised)） Related party 定義（HKSA 550.10）：(a) framework 定義嘅 related party；或 (b) 對 reporting entity 有 control/significant influence 嘅 person/entity、被 entity control/significantly influence 嘅 entity、common control 下嘅 entity（common controlling ownership、owners 係 close family、common key management）。State 共同控制嘅 entities 唔係 related parties，除非有重大交易/資源共享。 Related party transaction = transfer of resources, services or obligations between a reporting entity and a related party, regardless of whether a price is charged. Close family members：children、spouse/domestic partner、spouse 嘅 children、dependents。 考試重點：auditors 常犯錯誤係只當 related parties 做 disclosure issue，而冇回應 fraud/error 導致嘅 risk of material misstatement。 D. Assertions（本章程序對應嘅 assertions） Contingent liabilities： completeness （所有 material items 已識別）+ valuation（estimates reasonable per HKFRS）。 Commitments： completeness and accuracy 。 FS disclosures：completeness and accuracy（HKFRS + Cap. 622 compliance）。 E. Report modifications（完成階段嘅報告影響；詳情見 Chapter 9） Going concern（HKSA 570 (Revised)；LP margin: 570.17–18, 570.21–23）： 情況 報告結果 GC basis appropriate + material uncertainty exists + adequate disclosure Unmodified opinion + separate section " Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern "（opinion 唔因呢件事 modified） GC basis appropriate + material uncertainty exists + inadequate disclosure Qualified or adverse opinion per HKSA 705 (Revised) ；Basis for Qualified (Adverse) Opinion 要講明 material uncertainty 未充份披露 Management 用 GC basis 但 auditor 認為 inappropriate Adverse opinion Events/conditions 存在但 no material uncertainty 評估 disclosure 是否 adequate（按 framework） Management 唔願意 make/extend assessment Consider implications for the auditor's report Uncorrected misstatements material 且 management 唔更正 → generally a form of modified opinion 。 Report date 後、FS 發出前 FS 被修改 → 新 report + EoM/OM paragraph 提示用家。 易混淆概念對比 對比 1：Adjusting events vs Non adjusting events（HKAS 10 / HKSA 560） 項目 Adjusting events Non adjusting events Definition Provide further evidence of conditions that existed at the end of the financial period Evidence of conditions that arose after the end of the financial period Treatment Adjust the financial statements No adjustment ; disclose in notes if material 例子（LP 情境） Board 喺年結前已討論關廠並完成 impairment/provision 評估，年結後先正式拍板 → 要調整 年結後先有買家簽 deed of intent 買廠 → note disclosure；HK 上市公司最常見：post year end dividend declared 點樣分辨 問自己：「呢個 condition 喺 balance sheet date 存唔存在？」存在 → adjusting Condition 係年結後先出現 → non adjusting，但 material 就必須披露 考試伏位 唔好睇「decision 幾時做」，要睇「condition 幾時存在」——年結後先決定唔代表係 non adjusting Dividend declared after year end 係典型 non adjusting，唔好誤當 adjusting 入賬 對比 2：Contingent liability vs Commitment 項目 Contingent liability Commitment Definition An existing liability (actual or asserted) for which the recognition criteria cannot yet be met — confirmation depends on an uncertain future event An agreement equally and proportionately unperformed by both parties; relates to a future transaction (e.g. capex, JV infrastructure) 入賬/披露 Disclosed in notes until outflow becomes probable and amount can be reliably estimated（HKAS 37） Until one party performs, 唔符合 liability 定義；按披露要求（如 HKFRS 16 leases、capital commitments）處理 Audit 性質 多數涉及 accounting estimate → HKSA 540 (Revised) 適用；較難 conclude 基於 contractual obligations，較 straightforward 主要程序 HKSA 505 external confirmations to legal counsel/banks；Board minutes；environmental reviews；warranty arrangements 確認 HKFRS 16 處理；search contracted future capex 及 licensing commitments 考試伏位 「Straightforward / contractual」嘅描述其實係講 commitment，唔係 contingent liability；contingent liabilities 亦唔係「in all cases an accounting estimate」 唔好將兩者 disclosures 混為一談；commitments 目標 assertion 係 completeness and accuracy Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Under HKSA 500 Audit Evidence, define "sufficiency" and "appropriateness" of audit evidence (with paragraph references). Back: Sufficiency (para. 5(f)): the measure of the quantity of audit evidence; affected by the auditor's assessment of the risks of material misstatement and by the quality of the evidence. Appropriateness (para. 5(b)): the measure of the quality of audit evidence — its relevance and reliability in supporting the conclusions on which the opinion is based. 💬 記法：Sufficiency = 數量（要幾多「水」）；Appropriateness = 質素（水乾唔乾淨，即 relevance + reliability）。兩者互相影響：質素高，需要嘅數量可以少啲。考試好鍾意將兩個定義調轉做 distractor。 Card 2 Front: List the FOUR key requirements for the auditor in a going concern assessment under HKSA 570 (Revised). Back: 1. Risk assessment procedures and related activities (linked to HKSA 315 (Revised 2019)). 2. Evaluating management's assessment — must cover at least 12 months from the date of the financial statements ; auditor covers the same period. 3. Period beyond management's assessment — inquire of management about events/conditions beyond that period. 4. Additional audit procedures where events or conditions casting significant doubt are identified. 💬 記得「12 months 係由 date of the financial statements（reporting date）起計，唔係由 report date 起計」。Management 嘅 assessment 係佢哋嘅責任（HKAS 1），auditor 唔可以照單全收，一定要攞 sufficient appropriate evidence 去 evaluate。 Card 3 Front: Distinguish adjusting from non adjusting subsequent events and state the required treatment of each. Back: Adjusting events : provide further evidence of conditions that existed at the end of the financial period → adjust the financial statements. Non adjusting events : conditions that arose after the period end → no adjustment ; if material, disclose in the notes. Key test: did the condition exist at the reporting date? 💬 白話：問「件事嘅根源喺年結日存唔存在？」存在 → 調數；唔存在 → 淨披露。最常見陷阱：個 decision 年結後先落，但 condition 年結前已存在 —— 仍然係 adjusting。 Card 4 Front: Describe the auditor's responsibilities for subsequent events in each of the three time periods under HKSA 560. Back: 1. Date of FS → date of auditor's report ("active duty"): perform procedures (enquiry, read minutes, review post year end management accounts, follow up legal counsel) as close to the report date as possible (HKSA 560.6–8). 2. After report date → before FS issued ("passive duty"): no obligation to perform procedures; if a fact that would have amended the opinion becomes known → discuss amendment; if FS amended → new report + EoM/OM paragraph; if management refuses → modify opinion per HKSA 705 (Revised) (HKSA 560.10–13). 3. After FS issued : same approach; correction may fall into the following year's FS or interim FS for listed entities (HKSA 560.14–17). 💬 記住分界線：auditor's report 一簽，主動責任就完。之後係「冇責任搵，但知道咗就要郁」。Regulators 期望 legal counsel follow up 喺 opinion date 前最多 7 日做。 Card 5 Front: Under HKSA 450, what does "clearly trivial" mean, and what are the three types of unrecorded misstatements? Back: The auditor must accumulate all misstatements except those that are clearly trivial (para. 5). "Clearly trivial" is not the same as "not material" (para. A2): a wholly different (smaller) order of magnitude, clearly of no consequence individually or in aggregate. Any doubt → not clearly trivial. Three types: Factual (no doubt, amount/disclosure wrong); Projected (projection of sample misstatements to the population); Judgemental (auditor disagrees with management's estimates/policy judgements). 💬 「Clearly trivial < not material」係超高頻考點：低於 materiality 唔代表可以唔記錄，一定要達到 clearly trivial 先可以 skip。三類 misstatements 要識分 —— auditor 計返嚟嘅 impairment 差異通常係 judgemental；由 sample 推算嘅係 projected。 Card 6 Front: State the dating requirement of the written representation letter and explain its status as audit evidence under HKSA 580. Back: Dated as near as practicable to, but not after, the date of the auditor's report ; in practice signed on the same date as the auditor's report; must cover all periods referred to in the report. Written representations are necessary audit evidence but, being internally generated, do not on their own provide sufficient appropriate audit evidence ; they are not a substitute for other audit procedures, and do not change the nature of other evidence obtained. The auditor should not agree to management's proposed changes to the letter. 💬 三大考試伏位：(1) 日期唔可以遲過 report date；(2) rep letter 唔可以代替實質程序 —— 例如攞咗 impairment 嘅 representation 都仲要做 procedures；(3) management 想改 letter 內容 → 唔應同意。 Card 7 Front: Summarise the auditor's report implications when a material uncertainty related to going concern exists (HKSA 570 (Revised)). Back: GC basis appropriate + material uncertainty + adequate disclosure → Unmodified opinion + separate section " Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern " (opinion NOT modified on this matter). GC basis appropriate + material uncertainty + inadequate disclosure → Qualified or adverse opinion per HKSA 705 (Revised), with the matter stated in the Basis for Qualified (Adverse) Opinion section. Use of GC basis judged inappropriate → Adverse opinion . Management unwilling to make/extend its assessment → consider report implications. 💬 最容易考嘅決策樹：有冇 material uncertainty？Basis 啱唔啱？Disclosure 夠唔夠？記住 adequate disclosure 嘅情況 opinion 係 unmodified ，只係加一個獨立 section —— 唔係 qualified、唔係 EoM paragraph。 Card 8 Front: List the audit procedures normally performed to determine the completeness and accuracy of contingent liabilities, and name the standards engaged. Back: External confirmation to legal counsel and banks per HKSA 505 (pending litigation list/progress; claims such as warranties and guarantees with counsel's view on probability and HKD outcome; bank guarantees). Examine minutes of the Board of Directors (e.g. guarantees approved against loans). Examine environmental reviews and their likely outcomes. Consider industry practices (e.g. mining 'make good' restoration clauses). Review product warranty arrangements . Standards: HKSA 540 (Revised) (estimates), HKAS 37 (framework), HKSA 505 (confirmations). 💬 呢啲係「list type」長問答常客。答題時記得每個 procedure 都要講埋「搵緊乜」：例如 legal confirmation 係攞 pending litigation 清單同 counsel 對 probability/金額嘅意見。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Sufficient appropriate audit evidence 「夠數」兼「啱料」嘅審計證據 —— 量同質都要達標 The engagement partner must be satisfied that sufficient appropriate audit evidence supports the proposed auditor's opinion. Material uncertainty (related to going concern) 可能令人懷疑公司仲做唔做得落去嘅重大不確定性 A separate section headed "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" is included when adequate disclosure is made and the opinion is unmodified. Adjusting event 年結日已存在嘅狀況，期後有新證據 → 要調整賬目 The liquidation of a major customer whose financial difficulty existed at year end is an adjusting event. Non adjusting event 年結後先出現嘅新狀況 → 唔調賬，但可能要披露 A dividend declared after the reporting period is a non adjusting event disclosed in the notes if material. Clearly trivial 微到完全唔使理嘅錯誤，遠低於 materiality Misstatements that are clearly trivial are not accumulated under HKSA 450 paragraph 5. Uncorrected misstatements Auditor 搵到但 management 唔肯改嘅錯誤 Material uncorrected misstatements must be communicated to management and those charged with governance, with a request for correction. Written representation letter 管理層親筆簽嘅確認信，係必要但唔足夠嘅證據 The written representation letter is dated as near as practicable to, but not after, the date of the auditor's report. Those charged with governance (TCWG) 負責監督公司嘅人，通常係董事會同 audit committee The auditor communicates significant findings, including any expected modification to the auditor's report, with those charged with governance on a timely basis.
