excerpt: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKSA 500 Audit Evidence, appropriateness is th…
text: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKSA 500 Audit Evidence, appropriateness is the measure of the quality of audit evidence — that is, its relevance and its reliability in providing support for the conclusions on which the auditor's opinion is based (para. 5(b)). Sufficiency is the measure of the quantity of audit evidence, and the quantity needed is affected by both the auditor's assessment of the risks of material misstatement and the quality of the audit evidence (para. 5(f)). 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 LP 最愛考嘅「調轉定義」陷阱。C 係 HKSA 500 para. 5(b) 嘅原文意思。A 錯：佢將 appropriateness 嘅定義（quality = relevance + reliability）擺咗喺 sufficiency 度。B 錯：同 A 相反，將 sufficiency 嘅 quantity 定義擺咗喺 appropriateness 度。D 錯得比較微妙：sufficiency 嘅確受 risk assessment 影響，但 LP 明確講 quantity also affected by the quality of the audit evidence —— 個 "only" 令佢變錯。記住口訣：sufficiency = 量，appropriateness = 質（relevance + reliability），兩者有互動關係。 Rule Check: HKSA 500 Audit Evidence, paras. 5(b) and 5(f) Common Trap（繁中）: 考試 MCQ 經常將 sufficiency 同 appropriateness 嘅定義互相對調做 distractor；仲有留意 "only" 呢類絕對字眼 —— D 嘅錯正正係忽略咗 quality 都會影響所需嘅 quantity。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Reperforming the year end bank reconciliation is a procedure directed at the audit of cash/bank balances , not at identifying or verifying contingent liabilities. The procedures normally undertaken for the completeness and accuracy of contingent liabilities are: external confirmations to legal counsel and banks under HKSA 505 External Confirmations (covering pending/imminent litigation, claims such as warranties and guarantees with counsel's view on probability and outcome, and bank guarantees); examination of Board of Directors' minutes; examination of environmental reviews; consideration of industry practices (e.g. 'make good' restoration clauses); and review of product warranty arrangements. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 negation stem（"NOT"），考你分唔分到 procedures 嘅 目的/方向 。A、B、D 都係 LP 8.4.2 列出嘅 contingent liabilities 程序。C 聽落好合理（係真實審計程序），但佢係 bank balances 嘅 substantive procedure，同 contingent liabilities 嘅 completeness 完全冇邏輯關連 —— 呢個就係「logical connection between evidence and the assertions being audited」嘅概念。做 negation 題要逐個 option 問：「呢個 procedure 搵到嘅嘢，係咪關 contingent liabilities 事？」 Rule Check: HKSA 505 External Confirmations; HKSA 540 (Revised) Auditing Accounting Estimates and Related Disclosures; HKAS 37 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets（LP Ch. 8, section 8.4.2） Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好見到「聽落專業」嘅程序就揀 —— distractor 往往係真實存在但放錯地方的程序。答题时紧扣题干的 assertion（completeness of contingent liabilities）。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Under HKAS 10 Events After the Reporting Period and HKSA 560 Subsequent Events: (1) The customer's liquidation is an adjusting event — the severe liquidity problems existed since October 20X1, i.e. the condition existed at the end of the reporting period, and the post year end liquidation merely provides further evidence of that condition. The trade receivable (and any expected credit loss allowance) must be adjusted in the 31 December 20X1 financial statements. (2) The declaration of a special dividend is a non adjusting event — the condition arose after the period end; dividends declared after the reporting period are the most common subsequent event disclosure in Hong Kong and require note disclosure if material , not adjustment. 解題思路（繁中）: 判斷關鍵唔係「件事幾時發生」，而係「個 condition 喺 balance sheet date 存唔存在」。Customer 早喺 Oct 20X1 已有嚴重 liquidity problems → condition 存在於年結日 → adjusting，要調整 receivable/ECL。Dividend 係 Board 年結後先宣佈、唔依附任何年結前狀況 → non adjusting，material 就 note disclosure。A 錯：漏咗 dividend 嘅披露責任。C 錯：兩個 event 嘅處理完全倒轉。D 錯：「發生喺年結後」唔等於「唔使理」，adjusting event 一樣係年結後發生。 Rule Check: HKAS 10 Events After the Reporting Period; HKSA 560 Subsequent Events (procedures per paras. 6–8) Common Trap（繁中）: 最大陷阱係用「decision/event date」取代「condition date」做判斷。Debtor 年結後破产清算係典型 adjusting event（because evidence of impairment existed at year end）；dividend declared after year end 係典型 non adjusting event —— 兩個 pattern 都要背熟。 Q4 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): Where the auditor concludes that management's use of the going concern basis is appropriate but a material uncertainty exists, and the financial statements adequately disclose the principal events or conditions and management's plans, the auditor expresses an unmodified opinion and includes a separate section under the heading " Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern ", which draws attention to the disclosure note and states that these events or conditions indicate that a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the entity's ability to continue as a going concern, and that the auditor's opinion is not modified in respect of this matter . Only if disclosure is inadequate would a qualified or adverse opinion under HKSA 705 (Revised) be appropriate. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題係 going concern 決策樹嘅核心分支：(1) GC basis appropriate？(2) material uncertainty 存唔存在？(3) disclosure 夠唔夠？三條都「是」→ unmodified + MURGC section 。B 錯：qualified opinion 只喺 disclosure inadequate 時先用（per HKSA 705 (Revised)）。C 錯：adverse opinion 有兩種情況 —— 用 GC basis 本身 inappropriate，或者 inadequate disclosure 嚴重到 pervasive；淨係「material uncertainty 存在」唔會直接變 adverse。D 錯：adequate disclosure 唔代表可以唔提 —— MURGC section 係 mandatory。記住 MURGC section 唔係 EoM paragraph，而且 opinion 明確「not modified in respect of this matter」。 Rule Check: HKSA 570 (Revised) Going Concern (reporting conclusions; LP cites HKSA 570.17–18 and 570.21–23); HKSA 705 (Revised) for inadequate disclosure Common Trap（繁中）: 學生最常犯兩個錯：(1) 一見 going concern 問題就以為要 modify opinion —— 其實 adequate disclosure + appropriate basis = unmodified；(2) 將 MURGC section 當成 Emphasis of Matter paragraph —— 佢係一個 separate section with a prescribed heading ，唔係 EoM。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKSA 580 Written Representations, the written representation letter should be dated as near as practicable to, but not after, the date of the auditor's report , and must cover all financial statements and period(s) referred to in the auditor's report (in practice it is usually signed on the same date as the auditor's report). Written representations are necessary audit evidence , but because they are internally generated, they do not on their own provide sufficient appropriate audit evidence for the matters they cover and are not a substitute for other audit procedures. The auditor should not agree to changes management wishes to make to the letter. 解題思路（繁中）: C 一次過講啱兩個核心要求：日期 + 證據地位。A 錯：日期唔可以 after report date —— 呢個係硬性規則，唔係「越早越好」嘅彈性安排。B 錯：rep letter 係 internally generated，單獨唔構成 sufficient appropriate evidence；例如攞咗 impairment 嘅 written representation，auditor 仲係要做 procedures 驗證 impairment 夠唔夠。D 錯：LP 明確講 auditor should not agree to changes management may wish to make to the letter，否則佢唔可以當作 audit evidence 嘅一部分。呢三個伏位係 written representations 嘅「三大常考」。 Rule Check: HKSA 580 Written Representations (objectives per para. 6; list of HKSAs requiring representations per Appendix 1) Common Trap（繁中）: 「唔遲過 report date」同「唔係證據替代品」兩點經常分開考。留意 management 想改 letter 字眼係 red flag —— 考試會扮成「合理要求」做 distractor，但標準答案係拒絕。

title: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實…
text: M8 Chapter 8: Major Actions During the Audit Completion — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 (MCQ) Which of the following statements about audit evidence at the completion stage of an audit is correct ? A. Sufficiency is the measure of the quality of audit evidence, namely its relevance and reliability. B. Appropriateness is the measure of the quantity of audit evidence obtained during the audit. C. Appropriateness is the measure of the quality of audit evidence, namely its relevance and reliability in providing support for the conclusions on which the auditor's opinion is based. D. Sufficiency of audit evidence is affected only by the auditor's assessment of the risks of material misstatement, and not by the quality of the audit evidence obtained. Question 2 (MCQ) Lantau Marine Products Limited, a seafood importer, is subject to two pending lawsuits from former customers at its year end, and its bank has issued guarantees on its behalf to several suppliers. The audit manager wants to obtain evidence about the completeness of the contingent liabilities disclosed in the draft financial statements. Which of the following procedures would NOT be a procedure normally undertaken by the auditor to determine the completeness and accuracy of contingent liabilities? A. Issuing an external confirmation request, in line with HKSA 505 External Confirmations, to the company's legal counsel and banks. B. Examining the minutes of meetings of the Board of Directors to determine whether any guarantees have been approved against loans. C. Reperforming the year end bank reconciliation prepared by the client's accountant and agreeing the reconciling items to the subsequent month's bank statement. D. Reviewing the company's product warranty arrangements. Question 3 (Scenario MCQ) Cedar Trading Limited has a financial year end of 31 December 20X1. The auditor's report is due to be signed on 15 March 20X2. On 10 February 20X2, one of Cedar's largest trade receivables customers was placed into liquidation. The audit team notes that the customer had been experiencing severe liquidity problems since October 20X1, and the balance was material to the financial statements. Separately, on 25 February 20X2, the Board declared a special dividend, which was not conditional on any event existing at year end. How should Cedar Trading Limited treat these two events in its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X1? A. Adjust the financial statements for the customer's liquidation; make no adjustment and no disclosure for the special dividend. B. Adjust the financial statements for the customer's liquidation; disclose the special dividend in the notes if material. C. Disclose the customer's liquidation in the notes only; adjust the financial statements for the special dividend. D. Neither event requires adjustment or disclosure because both occurred after the reporting date. Question 4 (Scenario MCQ) Harbour Gate Logistics Limited has suffered recurring operating losses and negative operating cash flows, and its main bank facility falls due for repayment in five months' time with refinancing negotiations still in progress. The auditor concludes that the use of the going concern basis of accounting is appropriate , but that a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the company's ability to continue as a going concern. Management has included a note in the financial statements that adequately discloses the principal events and conditions and its plans to deal with them. What is the effect on the auditor's report? A. An unmodified opinion, with a separate section under the heading "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" drawing attention to the disclosure note. B. A qualified opinion, with the going concern uncertainty described in the "Basis for Qualified Opinion" section. C. An adverse opinion, because a material uncertainty exists in relation to going concern. D. An unmodified opinion with no reference to going concern, because adequate disclosure has been made in the financial statements. Question 5 (MCQ) Which of the following statements about the written representation letter under HKSA 580 Written Representations is correct ? A. It should be dated shortly after the date of the auditor's report so that it can cover events occurring up to the date the financial statements are issued. B. Because it is signed by management, it provides sufficient appropriate audit evidence on its own for the matters it covers, so no further procedures are needed for those matters. C. It should be dated as near as practicable to, but not after, the date of the auditor's report, and although it constitutes necessary audit evidence, it is not a substitute for other audit procedures. D. The auditor should agree to changes management wishes to make to the letter, provided management documents the reasons for the changes.

title: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Assertions & Materiality（影響 opinion 嘅根本概念）
B. Audit Procedures / Evidence relevant to reporting
C. Report modifications — 本章核心 ★
D. Additional communications in the auditor's report
E. Ethics（reporting 階段嘅道德壓力）
excerpt: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Analyse the basis of an auditor's report, including the importan…
text: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Analyse the basis of an auditor's report, including the importance of the report and how materiality drives reporting decisions. 2. Describe the elements of an auditor's report under HKSA 700 (Revised) and the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622). 3. Determine the appropriate form of auditor's opinion (unmodified / qualified / adverse / disclaimer) by applying the materiality and pervasiveness decision matrix in HKSA 705 (Revised). 4. Explain the format, content and placement of Emphasis of Matter, Other Matter, Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern paragraphs and the Key Audit Matters section (HKSA 706 (Revised), HKSA 701, HKSA 570 (Revised)). 5. Evaluate the ethical pressures (e.g. intimidation threat) arising when a modified opinion or KAM is proposed, per the HKICPA Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants. 必背考點 A. Assertions & Materiality（影響 opinion 嘅根本概念） Auditor's two objectives in forming an opinion : (1) form an opinion on the financial statements based on an evaluation of conclusions drawn from audit evidence obtained; (2) clearly express that opinion through a written report. Materiality & the opinion : to express an unmodified opinion , the auditor must conclude the financial statements as a whole are prepared "in all material respects, in accordance with the applicable financial reporting framework" (HKSA 700 (Revised); LP cites HKSA 700.11, 700.16). If not free from material misstatement → modify per HKSA 705 (Revised) . Misstatements arising from fraud are always qualitatively material , even if quantitatively immaterial. Never offset misstatements : a material revenue overstatement misstates the FS as a whole even if a cost of sales misstatement offsets the P&L effect. Individually immaterial misstatements within one balance/class may, in aggregate , be material → re evaluate risk of material misstatement for that balance/class. Materiality is re evaluated throughout the audit, with a final "stand back" reflection at the opinion stage (cf. HKSA 540 (Revised) stand back for accounting estimates; HKSA 320 for materiality). B. Audit Procedures / Evidence relevant to reporting Before finalising the opinion: stand back from working papers, confirm detection risk is sufficiently low across all assertions for material balances/disclosures, and evaluate the impact of accumulated unadjusted/uncorrected misstatements . Inability to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence arises from three sources (HKSA 705 (Revised) context): 1. Circumstances beyond the entity's control — e.g. accounting records destroyed; records seized by a government authority. 2. Nature or timing of the auditor's work — e.g. auditor appointed too late to attend the inventory count; substantive procedures alone cannot provide sufficient evidence; entity cannot obtain information from an equity accounted investee. 3. Limitation imposed by management — e.g. management prevents attendance at the inventory count, blocks third party confirmations, or refuses to provide supporting details for material balances. Going concern evidence chain (HKSA 570 (Revised), Exhibit 9.7 logic): risk assessment per HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) → can the auditor obtain sufficient appropriate evidence on whether a material uncertainty exists? → is the going concern basis appropriate? → is disclosure adequate? Each branch drives a different reporting outcome (see decision matrix below). C. Report modifications — 本章核心 ★ When to modify (HKSA 705 (Revised) para. 4): (a) the auditor concludes, based on evidence obtained, the FS as a whole are not free from material misstatement ; or (b) the auditor is unable to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence to conclude on possible effects of uncertainties. Decision matrix (HKSA 705 (Revised) para. A1 — Exhibit 9.4, 必背！) : Nature of matter Material but NOT pervasive Material AND pervasive FS are materially misstated Qualified Opinion Adverse Opinion Inability to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence Qualified Opinion Disclaimer of Opinion Qualified opinion (HKSA 705 (Revised) para. 7): two circumstances — (1) quantified material misstatement confined to a particular balance/class/disclosure; (2) scope limitation where possible undetected misstatements could be material but not pervasive. Wording: "except for the effects of the matter…" (misstatement) or "except for the possible effects of the matter…" (inability to obtain evidence). Basis for Qualified Opinion must, to the extent practicable, quantify the financial effects . Adverse opinion (HKSA 705 (Revised) para. 8): auditor HAS obtained sufficient appropriate evidence and concludes misstatements are both material and pervasive — e.g. failure to consolidate a subsidiary; going concern basis inappropriate but FS prepared on that basis. Wording: "because of the significance of the matter… the financial statements do not give a true and fair view…" . Basis for Adverse Opinion sits immediately after the Opinion paragraph . Disclaimer of opinion (HKSA 705 (Revised) paras. 9–10): unable to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence AND possible effects judged material and pervasive — essentially no opinion is expressed ("We were engaged to audit… We do not express an opinion…"). No Basis for Opinion in the normal form and the auditor's responsibilities section is abbreviated (HKSA 705 (Revised) Illustrations 4 and 5). Going concern outcomes map (HKSA 570 (Revised) + Exhibit 9.7): GC basis inappropriate but FS prepared on GC basis → Adverse Opinion (pervasive misstatement). GC basis appropriate + material uncertainty exists + adequate disclosure → Unmodified opinion with a "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" paragraph (NOT an EoM, NOT a modified opinion). GC basis appropriate + material uncertainty + inadequate disclosure → Qualified or Adverse (misstatement of disclosure). Cannot obtain evidence on whether a material uncertainty exists → Qualified or Disclaimer (inability to obtain evidence). D. Additional communications in the auditor's report Key Audit Matters — HKSA 701 (effective 15 December 2016): Definition: matters that, in the auditor's professional judgement, were of most significance in the audit of the current period FS (HKSA 701 paras. 9–10 — selection funnel: matters communicated to TCWG → matters requiring significant auditor attention / significant risks per HKSA 315 (Revised 2019) / high estimation uncertainty → KAMs). Mandatory for listed entities only ; voluntary for others. Each KAM description must include (HKSA 701 para. 11): (a) why the matter was considered most significant; (b) reference to related note disclosures; (c) how the matter was addressed in the audit (approach, procedures, key observations). Introductory language must state KAMs were addressed in the context of the audit as a whole and no separate opinion is provided on them. Matters giving rise to a modified opinion or MURGC are by nature KAMs but are NOT repeated in the KAM section — the KAM intro cross refers to the Basis for Qualified/Adverse Opinion or MURGC section instead. If there are no KAMs (rare), state so under the KAM heading. Emphasis of Matter paragraph — HKSA 706 (Revised) : refers to a matter appropriately presented or disclosed in the FS that is fundamental to users' understanding . Must state "Our opinion is not modified in respect of this matter." Common triggers: significant uncertainty around accounting estimates; special purpose framework; early adoption of a HKFRS with pervasive effect; prior period material error restated. A GC material uncertainty goes in the separate MURGC section, NOT an EoM. Other Matter paragraph — HKSA 706 (Revised) : refers to a matter OTHER than those presented or disclosed in the FS , relevant to users' understanding of the audit, the auditor's responsibilities or the auditor's report . Placed after the Opinion paragraph, and after EoM and KAM sections. Common triggers: prior period FS audited by another auditor; new/amended auditor's report after discovery of material subsequent events; certain law/regulation reporting. Other Information — HKSA 720 (Revised) (effective for periods ending on/after 15 December 2016): auditor reads other information (chairman's statement, MD&A, corporate governance report etc.) for material inconsistency with the FS or audit knowledge; no opinion or any form of assurance is given on it (HKSA 720 paras. 16, 21–22). Uncorrected material misstatement of other information → discuss with management; if unresolved, consider impact on the report. Directors are responsible for other information. Report components (HKSA 700 (Revised)) : Title (must say "Independent Auditor's Report"); Addressee (normally members/shareholders; state place of incorporation); Opinion presented FIRST (700.22, 700.23–27); Basis for Opinion — conducted per HKSAs, independence per the HKICPA Code of Ethics, evidence sufficient and appropriate (700.28); Other Information (700.32); Responsibilities of Directors/TCWG incl. going concern statement (700.33–36, 700.34(b), A49); Auditor's Responsibilities; Report on Other Legal and Regulatory Requirements (700.37–42); plus engagement partner's name (listed audits), auditor's name, CPA (Practising)/CPA designation, address, date. Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) overlay (PN 600.1 (Revised)): s.407(2) — auditor must investigate whether adequate accounting records kept and FS agree with records; s.407(3) — must state opinion in the report if adequate records NOT kept or FS NOT in agreement in any material respect. Applies to ALL reports including modified ones. Consolidation obligation: s.379(2). E. Ethics（reporting 階段嘅道德壓力） Client pressure NOT to issue a modified opinion / NOT to include a KAM = intimidation threat under the Code of Ethics. Auditor must stand ground to comply with HKSAs, HKFRSs and the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), upholding the fundamental principles — integrity, objectivity, professional competence and due care, confidentiality, professional behaviour (COE Section 110, subsections 111–115, Chapter A revised 2021). Threats of "second opinion" shopping or changing auditor do not justify softening the opinion. 易混淆概念對比 Table 1 — Modified opinion 決策：點樣分辨 Qualified / Adverse / Disclaimer Qualified Opinion Adverse Opinion Disclaimer of Opinion Root cause Material misstatement OR inability to obtain evidence — not pervasive Material misstatement (evidence obtained) — material AND pervasive Inability to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence — possible effects material AND pervasive Evidence position Misstatement quantifiable (or possible effects bounded) Auditor HAS the evidence and knows FS are wrong Auditor CANNOT conclude — "essentially not an opinion" Opinion wording "except for the effects / possible effects of the matter…" "…do not give a true and fair view…" "We do not express an opinion…" Basis section Basis for Qualified Opinion (quantify effects where practicable) Basis for Adverse Opinion Basis for Disclaimer of Opinion; no normal Basis for Opinion; abbreviated auditor's responsibilities (HKSA 705 Illustrations 4–5) 考試伏位 「except for」= qualified；分清 misstatement 定 scope limitation 有證據 + pervasive 先係 adverse；唔好同 disclaimer 調亂 Disclaimer 只係「無法取證」先用得；已知錯誤（HKFRS departure）唔可以出 disclaimer Table 2 — EoM vs OM vs MURGC vs KAM（考生最常調亂，Jun 2025 panelist 點名批評） Emphasis of Matter (HKSA 706) Other Matter (HKSA 706) Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern (HKSA 570) Key Audit Matters (HKSA 701) Matter located where? Already disclosed in the FS NOT presented/disclosed in the FS Going concern material uncertainty, adequately disclosed in FS Matters of most significance in the current audit Relevant to… Users' understanding of the financial statements Users' understanding of the audit / auditor's responsibilities / report Users' understanding of the going concern uncertainty Insight into the auditor's focus areas Modifies opinion? No — "Our opinion is not modified in respect of this matter" No No (opinion stays unmodified) No — no separate opinion on KAMs Mandatory? Judgement Judgement Required when GC basis appropriate + material uncertainty + adequate disclosure Listed entities only (voluntary otherwise) 考試伏位 GC uncertainty 用 MURGC，唔係 EoM；事項必須已喺 FS 披露 事項唔喺 FS 入面（如上年由另一核數師審核）；放喺 Opinion/EoM/KAM 之後 披露不足 → 唔係 MURGC，而係 qualified/adverse 引致 modified opinion/MURGC 嘅事項唔會重複列入 KAM section，只 cross refer Phase 2 閃卡 Card 1 Front: Under HKSA 705 (Revised), in which TWO circumstances must the auditor modify the opinion? Back: The auditor concludes, based on the audit evidence obtained, that the financial statements as a whole are not free from material misstatement ; or The auditor is unable to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence to conclude whether the possible effects of uncertainties could be material. 💬 記住兩個大閘：「已經知有錯」同「攞唔到證據」。之後先再問 pervasive 唔 pervasive 去揀 qualified/adverse/disclaimer。(HKSA 705 para. 4) Card 2 Front: State the HKSA 705 (Revised) opinion decision matrix (nature of matter × pervasiveness). Back: Material misstatement + material but not pervasive → Qualified Material misstatement + material and pervasive → Adverse Inability to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence + material but not pervasive → Qualified Inability to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence + material and pervasive → Disclaimer 💬 呢個 2×2 表係全章靈魂。口訣：「有證據 → Qualified/Adverse；無證據 → Qualified/Disclaimer；Pervasive 先會升級去 Adverse/Disclaimer。」 Card 3 Front: What are the key wording and content features of a qualified opinion and its Basis for Qualified Opinion paragraph? Back: Opinion wording: "except for the effects of the matter…" (misstatement) / "except for the possible effects of the matter…" (inability to obtain evidence). Basis for Qualified Opinion immediately follows the Opinion paragraph, explains the reasons, and quantifies the financial effects to the extent practicable . Ends with "…sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for our qualified opinion." 💬 考試見到 "except for" 就知係 qualified。仲要記住 basis paragraph 要講清楚件事同埋盡量量化影響。 Card 4 Front: How does a Disclaimer of Opinion differ from the other modified opinions? Back: Issued when the auditor cannot obtain sufficient appropriate evidence and possible effects are material and pervasive . It is essentially not an opinion — the auditor declines to express one ("We do not express an opinion…"). No normal Basis for Opinion paragraph; auditor's responsibilities section is abbreviated (HKSA 705 (Revised) Illustrations 4 and 5). Never appropriate where the auditor KNOWS the FS are misstated (a HKFRS departure → qualified/adverse instead). 💬 Disclaimer = 「我做唔到判斷」，唔係「份數有錯」。如果已經知道錯喺邊，就唔可以出 disclaimer — 呢個係 LP Knowledge Check 嘅經典伏位。 Card 5 Front: Going concern: the GC basis is appropriate, a material uncertainty exists, and management has made adequate disclosure. What is the reporting outcome? What if disclosure is inadequate? Back: Appropriate basis + material uncertainty + adequate disclosure → Unmodified opinion with a "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" paragraph (HKSA 570 (Revised)). Same facts but inadequate disclosure → Qualified or Adverse opinion (disclosure misstatement). GC basis inappropriate but used → Adverse opinion . Cannot obtain evidence → Qualified or Disclaimer . 💬 好多人以為 going concern 有問題就一定要 modify opinion — 錯！披露做足就只係加 MURGC paragraph，opinion 仍然 unmodified。 Card 6 Front: Define a Key Audit Matter and state the THREE required elements of each KAM description (HKSA 701). Back: KAM: matters that, in the auditor's professional judgement , were of most significance in the audit of the current period financial statements. Each KAM must describe: (a) why the matter was considered one of most significance; (b) reference to the related note disclosures ; (c) how the matter was addressed in the audit (approach, procedures, observations). KAMs are mandatory for listed entities ; no separate opinion is given on KAMs; matters behind a modified opinion/MURGC are cross referred, not repeated , as KAMs. 💬 三元素口訣「Why–Where–How」。KAM 係近年新增、panelist 話考生温唔夠 — 定義同 purpose 一定要背到。(HKSA 701 paras. 9–11) Card 7 Front: Distinguish an Emphasis of Matter paragraph from an Other Matter paragraph (HKSA 706 (Revised)). Back: EoM : matter appropriately presented or disclosed in the FS , fundamental to users' understanding of the financial statements . Must state the opinion is not modified for the matter. OM : matter NOT presented or disclosed in the FS , relevant to users' understanding of the audit, the auditor's responsibilities or the auditor's report . Placed after the Opinion paragraph and any EoM/KAM sections. Neither modifies the opinion. 💬 分辨關鍵：件事喺唔喺 FS 入面？喺 → EoM；唔喺 → OM。Jun 2025 考生將 OM 同 other information/KAM 調亂被批評，記實呢條分界線。 Card 8 Front: Which statements must appear in the Basis for Opinion section of an (unmodified) auditor's report under HKSA 700 (Revised)? Back: Audit conducted in accordance with HKSAs issued by the HKICPA , with reference to the Auditor's Responsibilities section. Auditor is independent per the HKICPA Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants and has fulfilled other ethical responsibilities. Auditor believes the audit evidence obtained is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for the opinion. 💬 Basis for Opinion 三件寶：HKSAs、independence/Code、sufficient appropriate evidence。Disclaimer 就冇正常嘅 Basis for Opinion — 呢個對比考試成日考。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Unmodified opinion 「無保留意見」— 最佳結果，FS 大致上跟足框架 An unmodified opinion states that the financial statements give a true and fair view in accordance with HKFRSs. Qualified opinion 「保留意見」— 得某一處有問題，其餘冇事 Except for the effects of the matter described in the Basis for Qualified Opinion section, the financial statements give a true and fair view. Adverse opinion 「否定意見」— 錯到成份 FS 唔可信 Because of the significance of the matter, the financial statements do not give a true and fair view. Disclaimer of opinion 「無法表示意見」— 攞唔到證據，索性唔出意見 We do not express an opinion on the consolidated financial statements of the Group. Pervasive 影響「遍及成份 FS」— 決定升級 adverse/disclaimer 嘅關鍵 The effects of the failure to consolidate the subsidiary are both material and pervasive. Emphasis of Matter paragraph 提醒段 — 指向 FS 已披露嘅重要事項，不改變意見 We draw attention to Note X of the financial statements; our opinion is not modified in respect of this matter. Key Audit Matters (KAM) 關鍵審計事項 — 上市先強制，講述核數師最關注嘅範疇 Key audit matters are those matters that, in our professional judgement, were of most significance in our audit of the current period. Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern 持續經營重大不確定性專段 — 披露足夠時用，唔算修改意見 A separate section draws attention to the material uncertainty related to going concern when disclosures are adequate.

title: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A qualified opinion is appropriate. The auditor has obtained sufficient ap…
text: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): A qualified opinion is appropriate. The auditor has obtained sufficient appropriate audit evidence and concluded that the financial statements are materially misstated (repairs of HK$3.8 million wrongly capitalised, a departure from HKFRSs), but the misstatement is confined to specific balances (PPE and repairs expense) and is therefore material but not pervasive . Under the HKSA 705 (Revised) decision matrix, a material but not pervasive misstatement results in a qualified ("except for") opinion. The Basis for Qualified Opinion paragraph would describe the matter and quantify its financial effects. 解題思路（繁中）: 兩步定位法：第一步問「有冇證據？」— 有，auditor 已經量化咗個錯誤，所以排除 disclaimer（D）。第二步問「pervasive 唔 pervasive？」— 題目講明 confined to PPE and related expense、唔影響 FS as a whole，所以唔係 adverse（C），只係 qualified。A 錯因為 EoM 係用嚟指向 FS 已披露嘅事項，而且 unmodified opinion 喺有 material misstatement 又拒絕調整嘅情況下根本唔可以出。考試伏位：見到管理層「refuses to adjust」加「confined to specific balances」就係標準 qualified 劇本。 Rule Check: HKSA 705 (Revised) paras. 4, 7 and A1 (decision matrix); HKSA 700 (Revised) for unmodified conditions. Common Trap（繁中）: 考生見金額「material」就衝動揀 adverse — 記住 adverse 要同時 material AND pervasive。另一伏位係以為「管理層拒絕調整」等於 scope limitation → 揀 disclaimer；其實 auditor 已攞到足夠證據，呢個係 misstatement 而唔係 inability to obtain evidence。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): A disclaimer of opinion is appropriate. The auditor is unable to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence over cash sales representing the majority of transactions, and concludes the possible effects of undetected misstatements could be both material and pervasive . Under HKSA 705 (Revised) paras. 9–10 and the para. A1 decision matrix, inability to obtain evidence with material and pervasive possible effects leads to a disclaimer — essentially no opinion is expressed ("We do not express an opinion…"). The fire is a circumstance beyond the entity's control, one of the three recognised sources of inability to obtain evidence. 解題思路（繁中）: 關鍵字係「unable to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence」+「material and pervasive」→ 直接對應矩陣右下角 = disclaimer。A 錯：scope limitation 唔係管理層造成唔代表可以降格做 qualified — pervasiveness 先係決定因素，70% 收入無憑無據已經係 pervasive。B 錯：adverse 係「有證據證明 FS 錯」先用得；而家係「唔知啲數啱唔啱」，性質完全不同。D 錯：unmodified opinion 要求 FS as a whole 無 material misstatement 且證據充分，明顯不成立；OM paragraph 亦唔係用嚟交代咁重大嘅取證失敗。 Rule Check: HKSA 705 (Revised) paras. 4, 9–10, A1; LP §9.5.3 (sources of inability: circumstances beyond entity's control). Common Trap（繁中）: 最常犯錯係將「records destroyed」當成 FS 一定錯 → 揀 adverse。記住口訣： 有證據先可以 adverse；無證據 + pervasive = disclaimer 。另外 disclaimer 唔係「soft option」— 佢代表 auditor 完全無法結論。 Q3 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): B . An Other Matter paragraph refers to a matter other than those presented or disclosed in the financial statements that, in the auditor's judgement, is relevant to users' understanding of the audit, the auditor's responsibilities or the auditor's report (HKSA 706 (Revised)). The fact that the prior year's financial statements were audited by another auditor is not a matter disclosed in the current year financial statements and is a classic OM trigger listed in the LP. Options A and D describe matters already disclosed in the financial statements → Emphasis of Matter. Option C belongs in the separate "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" section (HKSA 570 (Revised)). 解題思路（繁中）: 分辨口訣：「件事喺唔喺 FS 入面？」喺 → EoM（A、D）；唔喺 → OM（B，上年由另一間 firm 審係關於 the audit 嘅資訊，唔會寫喺 FS）。C 係最危險 distractor：going concern material uncertainty 披露足夠時有自己專屬嘅 MURGC section，唔係 EoM 亦唔係 OM。呢條直接打中 Jun 2025 panelist 批評嘅「OM 與 EoM/other information 調亂」弱點。 Rule Check: HKSA 706 (Revised) (definitions of EoM and OM paragraphs); HKSA 570 (Revised) (MURGC section). Common Trap（繁中）: 唔好以為「重要」嘅事項自動入 EoM — EoM 嘅前提係事項 已經喺 FS 披露 且 fundamental to users' understanding。OM 講嘅係關於審計本身/核數師責任/報告嘅事項，唔係 FS 內容。 Q4 — Answer: D Model Answer (EN): D . HKSA 701 defines KAMs as those matters that, in the auditor's professional judgement, were of most significance in the audit of the financial statements of the current period. The introductory language in the KAM section must state that the matters were addressed in the context of the audit of the financial statements as a whole and that the auditor does not provide a separate opinion on them. A is wrong: KAM communication is mandatory for listed entities only , voluntary otherwise. B is wrong: no separate opinion is given on individual KAMs. C is wrong: a matter giving rise to a modified opinion (or an MURGC) is by nature a KAM, but it is not repeated as a separate KAM — the KAM introductory paragraph cross refers to the Basis for Qualified/Adverse Opinion or MURGC section instead. 解題思路（繁中）: 四個選項分別測四個 KAM 核心點：適用範圍（listed only）、唔提供 separate opinion、同 modified opinion/MURGC 嘅 cross reference 規則、同埋定義本身。A 係「所有公司都要」嘅常見誇大；B 違反「no separate opinion」原則；C 係技術性最強嘅 distractor — 引致 qualified 嘅事項本質上係 KAM，但 HKSA 701 唔准重複描述，只可以 cross refer。答 D 要講到「professional judgement + most significance + current period」三個關鍵字。 Rule Check: HKSA 701 paras. 9–11 (definition, determining and communicating KAMs); LP Key Learning Point — KAMs required for listed entities only. Common Trap（繁中）: Panelist report 明確話考生「did not put enough effort into studying KAM」。最易錯係 C — 以為 modified opinion 嘅事項要照樣列入 KAM section；其實要避免重複，KAM intro 會寫 "In addition to the matter described in the Basis for Qualified Opinion… section, we have determined…"。 Q5 — Answer: A Model Answer (EN): A . Where (i) the going concern basis of accounting is appropriate, (ii) a material uncertainty exists, and (iii) that uncertainty is adequately disclosed in the financial statements, the auditor expresses an unmodified opinion and includes a separate "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" section drawing attention to the relevant note disclosures (HKSA 570 (Revised)). The opinion is not modified. B is wrong: an adequately disclosed going concern material uncertainty is reported in the dedicated MURGC section, not an Emphasis of Matter paragraph. C is wrong: the mere existence of a material uncertainty does not modify the opinion when disclosure is adequate. D is wrong: an adverse opinion applies only where the going concern basis itself is inappropriate but has been used. 解題思路（繁中）: 跟 Exhibit 9.7 決策樹行：GC basis appropriate? YES → adequate disclosure? YES → unmodified opinion + MURGC paragraph。四個選項對應四個可能 outcome，考你識唔識分：披露不足先會 qualified/adverse（C 嘅陷阱）；GC basis 本身唔適用先會 adverse（D 嘅陷阱）；MURGC 有專屬 section 唔係 EoM（B 嘅陷阱 — LP Knowledge Check Q18 同款概念，但場景全新）。記住「going concern 有 uncertainty ≠ opinion 要 modified」。 Rule Check: HKSA 570 (Revised) Going Concern; LP §9.6.3 and Exhibit 9.7; Apply and Analyse 4 (unmodified opinion + MURGC). Common Trap（繁中）: 考生見「連續虧損 + 巨額貸款到期」就條件反射揀 adverse 或 qualified。考試要逐個條件拆：basis 啱唔啱？disclosure 夠唔夠？evidence 攞唔攞到？三條問題嘅答案組合先決定 outcome，唔係單憑「公司財困」判斷。 Self check: all answers traceable to HKSA 700 (Revised), 705 (Revised), 706 (Revised), 701, 570 (Revised) as cited in the LP chapter text.

title: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Quiz
headings: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Quiz
excerpt: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Harbour …
text: M8 Chapter 9: Auditor's Reporting — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Question 1 Harbour View Engineering Limited is a non listed Hong Kong company. During the audit of its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X2, the auditor obtained sufficient appropriate audit evidence that the company had capitalised HK$3.8 million of routine repair and maintenance expenditure as property, plant and equipment, instead of charging it to profit or loss. The amount is material to the financial statements. Management refuses to adjust. The auditor is satisfied that the misstatement is confined to the property, plant and equipment balance and the related repairs expense, and does not affect the financial statements as a whole. Which type of auditor's opinion is most appropriate? A. Unmodified opinion with an Emphasis of Matter paragraph B. Qualified opinion C. Adverse opinion D. Disclaimer of opinion Question 2 Starlight Trading Limited is a Hong Kong wholesaler. Three months before the audit commenced, a fire destroyed the company's server room and all accounting records supporting its cash sales, which represent approximately 70% of total revenue and the majority of the company's transactions. No backups exist, and the auditor is unable to perform alternative procedures to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence over these transactions. Management has cooperated fully but simply cannot reconstruct the records. The auditor concludes that the possible effects of undetected misstatements could be both material and pervasive to the financial statements. Which type of auditor's opinion is most appropriate? A. Qualified opinion, because management did not impose the limitation B. Adverse opinion, because the financial statements are likely to be materially misstated C. Disclaimer of opinion D. Unmodified opinion with an Other Matter paragraph describing the fire Question 3 Which of the following matters would most appropriately be communicated in an Other Matter paragraph in the auditor's report? A. A significant uncertainty surrounding a material accounting estimate that has been adequately disclosed in the notes to the financial statements B. The prior year's financial statements were audited by another firm of auditors C. A material uncertainty related to going concern that has been adequately disclosed in the financial statements D. The early adoption of a new HKFRS, which has been fully disclosed in the financial statements and has a pervasive effect on them Question 4 Which of the following statements about Key Audit Matters (KAM) under HKSA 701 is correct ? A. KAMs must be communicated in the auditor's reports of all Hong Kong companies, whether listed or not B. The auditor provides a separate opinion on each KAM disclosed in the auditor's report C. A matter that gives rise to a qualified opinion must also be described in full as a separate KAM in the Key Audit Matters section D. KAMs are matters that, in the auditor's professional judgement, were of most significance in the audit of the current period financial statements, and no separate opinion is provided on them Question 5 Ocean Pearl Restaurant Group Limited has recorded operating losses for two consecutive years and its bank loans of HK$25 million fall due for repayment four months after the date of the auditor's report. Management has prepared the financial statements on the going concern basis, believing that a refinancing plan currently under negotiation will succeed. The auditor has obtained sufficient appropriate audit evidence and concludes that (i) the use of the going concern basis of accounting is appropriate, (ii) a material uncertainty exists about the group's ability to continue as a going concern, and (iii) the financial statements adequately disclose this material uncertainty. What is the appropriate reporting outcome? A. Unmodified opinion, with a separate "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern" section in the auditor's report B. Unmodified opinion, with an Emphasis of Matter paragraph referring to the going concern uncertainty C. Qualified opinion, because a material uncertainty exists D. Adverse opinion, because the going concern basis of accounting has been used End of quiz. No answers are provided in this file.

title: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
headings: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡
A. Objectives & Overall Responsibility（點解要有 group audit framework）
B. Significant vs Non-significant Components（分類 → 決定做咩工作）
C. Audit Procedures — Work Required per Component Category
D. Evidence — Understanding & Evaluating Component Auditors
E. Communication（group ↔ component 雙向溝通）
excerpt: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the concept of a group audit and the objectives of the auditor…
text: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 1 速查表 + Phase 2 閃卡 Phase 1 速查表 Learning Objectives 1. Explain the concept of a group audit and the objectives of the auditor under HKSA 600 (Revised), including the involvement of component auditors. 2. Distinguish significant components from non significant components and determine the type of audit work required for each. 3. Describe the characteristics and responsibilities of component auditors and how the group auditor evaluates and uses their work. 4. Explain the responsibilities of the group engagement partner and the required communications between the group engagement team and component auditors. 必背考點 A. Objectives & Overall Responsibility（點解要有 group audit framework） Reference standard: HKSA 600 (Revised) Special Considerations – Audits of Group Financial Statements (Including the Work of Component Auditors) . Auditor's objectives in a group audit: 1. Determine whether they can act as the auditor of the group financial statements ; and 2. If so: (a) communicate clearly with component auditors about the scope and timing of their work and their findings; (b) obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence regarding the financial information of the components and the consolidation process to express an opinion on the group financial statements. Ultimate responsibility for the opinion on the consolidated financial statements rests solely with the group engagement partner / group auditor — even for components audited by other firms. The group auditor cannot simply rely on the component auditor's opinion that the component's financial statements are free from material misstatement; an appropriate level of understanding of the component auditor's work is required. Per HKSA 220 (Revised) Quality Management for an Audit of Financial Statements , the group engagement partner is responsible for the direction, supervision, performance and review of the work, the adequacy of audit documentation, and being satisfied that sufficient appropriate audit evidence has been obtained. B. Significant vs Non significant Components（分類 → 決定做咩工作） Determination of significant components is the responsibility of the group auditor (HKSA 600.26–27). A component is significant if it is: 1. Of individual financial significance to the group (driver = SIZE ); or 2. Likely to include significant risks of material misstatement of the group financial statements due to its specific nature or circumstances (driver = RISK ) — HKSA 600.9(m). 15% benchmark : HKSA 600 (Revised) indicates 15% of a chosen benchmark (e.g. group assets, profit, revenue) might be chosen as indicative of financial significance — professional judgement still required; higher/lower percentages may be appropriate; document the appropriateness if 15% is applied (HKSA 600(A5), 600(A6)). LP also states financially significant components are prima facie those comprising more than 15% of sales, net income, assets, liabilities or cash flows. Risk indicators (non financial significance): estimates associated with impairments , inventory impairments , taxation provisions ; complex areas such as financial instruments , contingencies , subsequent events . C. Audit Procedures — Work Required per Component Category Component category Required work (HKSA 600 (Revised)) Financially significant (size) Full audit of the component's financial information using component materiality (performed by group engagement team or component auditor) (HKSA 600.26–27) Significant due to risk One or more of: (1) audit of the component's financial information using component materiality; (2) audit of one or more account balances, classes of transactions or disclosures relating to the likely significant risks; (3) specified audit procedures relating to the likely significant risks Non significant Analytical procedures at group level to corroborate the conclusion that there are no significant risks; document the belief if no additional risks identified; if analytical procedures indicate possible risk of material misstatement → document the nature, timing and extent of further procedures to address the identified risks (HKSA 600.28–29) D. Evidence — Understanding & Evaluating Component Auditors Before using the work of a component auditor, the group auditor must obtain an understanding of (HKSA 600.19–20): 1. Whether the component auditor will comply with ethical and independence standards (HKICPA Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants) — even if based outside Hong Kong; 2. The professional competence of the component auditor (incl. specialist skills, understanding of HKFRSs, and the auditing/quality management standards under which they operate); 3. Whether the group auditor will be able to be involved in the component auditor's work as necessary to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence; 4. Whether the component auditor operates in a regulatory environment that actively oversees auditors. The assessment must be formally documented ; if the group engagement partner has concerns over (1)–(3), the group engagement team should perform the audit of the components themselves . Component materiality: set by the group engagement team ; cannot exceed (must be lower than) group materiality ; communicated to the component auditor. Evaluating the component auditor's work (HKSA 600.42–45): obtain consent to be involved and to access information ; request confirmation on unrestricted access to / copies of working papers (or reasons if legally impossible); consider visits for significant components (triggers: working papers cannot leave jurisdiction, size/specific risks, doubt about diligence, change of auditors, recent acquisition/expected disposal, internal audit findings, prior period issues, audit adjustments noted, changes in local management/scope). Working paper review by group auditor covers: component audit planning memorandum, significant risks & fraud responses, detailed work programmes, specialists, materiality thresholds applied, tests of control (incl. group wide controls in group instructions), substantive procedures, judgements/estimates & management bias, related parties, litigation, contingencies, going concern, consolidation package, roll forward procedures, management representation letter, final analytical procedures, auditor's opinion consistency. E. Communication（group ↔ component 雙向溝通） Group engagement team → component auditor (group audit instructions): work to be performed; form and content of communications back; confirmation of cooperation; ethical/independence requirements (group and component); component materiality ; identified significant risks of material misstatement of the group financial statements (fraud or error); related parties; non compliance with laws and regulations; material weaknesses in internal control; relevant accounting, auditing and reporting requirements; communications with TCWG. Component auditor → group auditor (summary memorandum / group audit questionnaire, HKSA 600.41): confirmation of compliance with HKICPA Code of Ethics and with group requirements; scope of work and any variations from instructions (communicated prior to variation); fraud / non compliance with laws and regulations (fraud → communicate immediately ) and indicators of management bias ; significant risks and responses; KAMs (listed parent); corrected and uncorrected misstatements ; significant deficiencies in internal control (report at point of discovery); related party transactions; subsequent events procedures; items for the group letter of representation ; matters for group TCWG; contingencies and commitments; overall findings/conclusions/ opinion . Potential modification of the component auditor's opinion must be raised with the group auditor as soon as possible ; the group auditor determines whether it is reflected at the consolidated level. If the component auditor cannot meet its responsibilities, the group auditor may need to replace the component auditor. 易混淆概念對比 表 1 — Component 分類與所需工作（最常考伏位） Financially significant component Significant component (risk based) Non significant component Driver Size（e.g. 15% of a group benchmark） Specific nature/circumstances → significant risk of material misstatement Immaterial to group as a whole; low risk profile Who decides Group auditor（專業判斷＋文件記錄） Group auditor Group auditor Required work Full audit using component materiality Full audit / audit of specific balances / specified procedures（三選一或以上） Group level analytical procedures only；如有風險跡象先再做進一步程序 點樣分辨／考試伏位 見到 「X% of group assets/revenue」 諗 size driver — 必做 full audit，唔係淨做 review 金額細都可以係 significant（e.g. 有 complex financial instruments、impairment estimates）— 唔好以為細就唔使做嘢 伏位：「non significant = 唔使做任何程序」係錯 — LP 明確要求 analytical procedures at group level 並 document 結論 表 2 — Group Engagement Partner vs Component Auditor（責任邊界） Group engagement partner / team Component auditor Opinion responsibility Sole responsibility for the opinion on the group financial statements — 不可 divided responsibility Reports to group auditor in the form agreed in group audit instructions；may have separate local statutory reporting responsibilities Materiality Determines group materiality and component materiality（component ≤ group，實務上較低） Applies the materiality instructed；component materiality 唔係佢自己定 Engagement letter Issues group engagement letter to group management/TCWG Issues engagement letter to component management（如有 local engagement） Work evaluation Evaluates component auditor's competence, independence, work（review working papers / visits） Follows group instructions；maintains open communication；flags issues（fraud、opinion modification） immediately/as soon as possible 點樣分辨／考試伏位 伏位：以為可以喺 group auditor's report 度話「某啲子公司係其他核數師審嘅」嚟卸責 — LP 明言 group auditor has sole responsibility，唔可以 simply rely on component auditor's opinion 伏位：component auditor 發現 fraud 或者要 modify opinion，唔可以等到出 report 先講 — 要即時/盡快通知 group auditor Phase 2 閃卡（8 cards） Card 1 Front: What are the objectives of the auditor in a group audit under HKSA 600 (Revised)? Back: Determine whether they can act as the auditor of the group financial statements; If acting: communicate clearly with component auditors about the scope and timing of their work and their findings; Obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence regarding the financial information of the components and the consolidation process to express an opinion on the group financial statements. 💬 白話解：第一步問「我做得唔做得 group auditor」；做得就要同 component auditors 講清楚做咩、幾時做，同埋攞夠 evidence（包括 consolidation process），先可以出 group opinion。 Card 2 Front: How is a "significant component" defined under HKSA 600 (Revised), and what benchmark is commonly used? Back: A component is significant if it is (1) of individual financial significance to the group, OR (2) likely to include significant risks of material misstatement of the group financial statements due to its specific nature or circumstances (HKSA 600.9(m)); 15% of a chosen benchmark (e.g. group assets or profit) may be used as indicative of financial significance — but professional judgement is required and the appropriateness should be documented (HKSA 600(A6)). 💬 白話解：「大」或者「高危」其中一樣就係 significant component。15% 只係參考門檻，唔係硬性規定，用咗要寫低點解合理。 Card 3 Front: What audit work is required for (a) a financially significant component, (b) a component significant due to risk, and (c) a non significant component? Back: (a) Full audit of the component's financial information using component materiality; (b) One or more of: full audit using component materiality; audit of specific account balances/classes of transactions/disclosures relating to the significant risks; specified audit procedures relating to the significant risks; (c) Analytical procedures at group level; if these indicate possible risk of material misstatement, document the nature, timing and extent of further procedures. 💬 白話解：記口訣「Size → full audit；Risk → full/partial/specified 三揀；細粒 → group level analytical procedures」。Non significant ≠ 唔做嘢。 Card 4 Front: What four matters must the group auditor understand about a component auditor before using their work? Back: (HKSA 600.19–20) Compliance with ethical and independence requirements (HKICPA Code of Ethics), even if outside Hong Kong; Professional competence (incl. specialist skills and sufficient understanding of HKFRSs); Whether the group auditor can be involved in the component auditor's work as necessary; Whether the component auditor operates in a regulatory environment that actively oversees auditors. 💬 白話解：四樣嘢 — 操守、能力、俾唔俾我參與、佢嗰邊有冇人監管。Assessment 要正式 document；有疑慮就自己做返嗰個 component。 Card 5 Front: Who sets component materiality, and what is the rule about its level relative to group materiality? Back: Component materiality is determined by the group engagement team , not the component auditor; It must be lower than (cannot exceed) group materiality ; It must be communicated to the component auditor in the group audit instructions. 💬 白話解：Component materiality 係 group auditor 定嘅，而且一定要低過 group materiality — 咁先可以捕獲到喺 component 層面細、但加埋會影響 group 嘅 misstatements。 Card 6 Front: List at least five matters a component auditor normally reports to the group auditor in the summary memorandum / group audit questionnaire. Back: (HKSA 600.41 — any five) Compliance with the HKICPA Code of Ethics and with the group auditor's requirements; Scope of work performed, including variations from group instructions; Fraud or non compliance with laws and regulations (fraud communicated immediately); indicators of management bias; Significant risks affecting the consolidated financial statements and responses; Corrected and uncorrected misstatements; Significant deficiencies in internal control (reported at point of discovery); Related party transactions; subsequent events procedures; items for the group letter of representation; KAMs (listed parent); overall findings/conclusions/opinion. 💬 白話解：記得三個「即刻講」：fraud → immediately；internal control deficiencies → at point of discovery；可能 modify opinion → as soon as possible。其餘就喺 memorandum/questionnaire 度confirm。 Card 7 Front: Can the group engagement partner divide responsibility for the group audit opinion with component auditors? Back: No. Sole responsibility for the opinion on the group financial statements rests with the group engagement partner, including components audited by others; The group auditor must not simply rely on the component auditor's opinion — an appropriate level of understanding of the work undertaken is required; Per HKSA 220 (Revised), the partner is responsible for direction, supervision, performance and review, and for being satisfied that sufficient appropriate audit evidence has been obtained. 💬 白話解：考試常見伏位 — group auditor 唔可以喺 report 度寫「子公司係人哋審」嚟卸責。個 opinion 係你一個人孭，所以你要了解同評估 component auditor 做咗啲咩。 Card 8 Front: What factors should the group auditor consider in deciding whether to visit a component auditor? Back: Working papers cannot be moved out of the jurisdiction; Size or specific risks of the component; Doubt about the diligence/capability of the component auditor (face to face discussion needed); Change of group or component auditors; recent acquisition or expected disposal of the component; Work/conclusions of internal auditors; prior period issues; audit adjustments noted by the component auditor; Changes in local management or the size and scope of the component. Better practice: experienced team member (partner/manager) visits; clear purpose; visit before the component auditor's close out meeting with component management. 💬 白話解：Visit 嘅觸發點都係圍繞「風險高咗」或者「信任度低咗」。時間上記住：要喺 component close out meeting 之前去，先嚟得切將發現嘅問題放入去。 本章急救詞彙 EN Term 繁中白話 English Model Sentence Group engagement partner 對集團審計意見負全責嘅合夥人 The group engagement partner takes sole responsibility for the auditor's opinion on the group financial statements. Component auditor 幫手審集團旗下個別組成部分嘅核數師（可以係另一間 firm） The group auditor evaluated the professional competence and independence of the component auditor before using their work. Significant component 因規模或風險而對集團財務報表重要嘅組成部分 A component contributing 18% of group revenue is a significant component requiring a full audit. Component materiality 由 group auditor 設定、低過 group materiality 嘅 component 層面重要性水平 Component materiality, set by the group engagement team, must be lower than group materiality. Group audit instructions Group auditor 畀 component auditor 嘅工作指示（範圍、materiality、deadlines） The group audit instructions specified the work to be performed and the component materiality to be applied. Summary memorandum / group audit questionnaire Component auditor 向 group auditor 匯報工作結果嘅標準格式 The component auditor confirmed compliance with ethical requirements in the group audit questionnaire. Consolidation process 將各 component 財務資料合併做集團報表嘅過程，group auditor 都要攞 evidence The group auditor obtained sufficient appropriate audit evidence regarding the consolidation process. Analytical procedures (group level) 對 non significant components 喺集團層面做嘅分析性程序 For non significant components, the group auditor performed analytical procedures at group level to corroborate the conclusion that no significant risks existed.

title: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 3 Answers
headings: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 3 Answers
excerpt: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Pearl Delta Warehousing Limited is of individual financial significance to the g…
text: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 3 Answers Q1 — Answer: B Model Answer (EN): Pearl Delta Warehousing Limited is of individual financial significance to the group: at 22% of group total assets and 19% of group revenue, it exceeds the 15% benchmark adopted as indicative of financial significance. Under HKSA 600 (Revised), for a component that is financially significant, the group engagement team, or a component auditor on its behalf, is required to perform a full audit of the financial information of the component using component materiality (i.e. a materiality level lower than group materiality). 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考「size driven significant component → 必做 full audit」。Component 兩個指標（22% assets、19% revenue）都超過 15% benchmark，所以係 financially significant。Distractors：A（analytical procedures at group level）係 non significant components 嘅做法；C（specified procedures only）係 risk driven significant component 嘅其中一個選項，但呢度 driver 係 size 唔係 risk；D（review consolidation package）根本唔係 HKSA 600 (Revised) 下對 significant component 嘅足夠回應。考試伏位：見到 「no specific risks identified」 唔好被誤導以為唔使做嘢 — size 本身已經足以觸發 full audit。 Rule Check: HKSA 600 (Revised) paras. 26–27 (per LP); 15% benchmark per HKSA 600 (Revised) para. A6 (as cited in LP). Common Trap（繁中）: 學生常混淆三類 component 嘅所需工作。記口訣：Size → full audit（用 component materiality）；Risk → full audit / audit of specific balances / specified procedures；Non significant → group level analytical procedures。 Q2 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Component materiality is determined by the group engagement team for each component on which audit work is performed, and it must be lower than group materiality (it cannot exceed group materiality). The level of component materiality must be communicated to the component auditor, typically in the group audit instructions, so that the component auditor performs work and reports against that threshold. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考「邊個定 component materiality + 上限係幾多」。A 錯：component materiality 唔係 component auditor 自己定嘅 — LP 明確指出 materiality levels 由 group auditor 決定，component auditor 只係按指示應用。B 錯：component materiality 唔可以高過 group materiality（即使 component 有 local statutory audit，按較低嘅 local materiality 做都唔會造成問題，因為佢仍然要按 group 指示匯報）。D 錯：component materiality 係 group auditor → component auditor 溝通清單入面嘅明確項目，必須傳達。考試伏位：選項用「closest to operations」「unpredictability」等聽落合理嘅包裝嚟掩飾錯誤嘅責任歸屬。 Rule Check: HKSA 600 (Revised) — LP 10.3.1 (materiality levels determined by group engagement team; component materiality cannot be higher than group materiality; communicated to component auditor). Common Trap（繁中）: 以為「component auditor 最熟 component，所以佢定 materiality」。錯 — materiality 設定係 group engagement partner 責任鏈嘅一部分，因為 group opinion 係佢孭。 Q3 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): Under HKSA 600 (Revised), the group auditor must obtain an understanding of: (1) whether the component auditor will comply with ethical requirements, particularly independence (including Hong Kong requirements where the component auditor is based outside Hong Kong); (2) the component auditor's professional competence; (3) whether the group auditor will be able to be involved in the component auditor's work as necessary to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence; and (4) whether the component auditor operates in a regulatory environment that actively oversees auditors. The profitability or fee income of the component auditor's firm is not among these required matters. 解題思路（繁中）: Negation stem（NOT）題，考四項 required understanding 嘅背誦同辨認。A、B、D 都係 HKSA 600 (Revised) 明列嘅事項（ethics/independence、competence、regulatory environment），加埋「能否參與 component auditor 工作」就係四項。C 係唯一唔關事嘅 — 一間 component auditor firm 賺唔賺錢同佢能否勝任 group audit 無直接關係，HKSA 600 (Revised) 冇呢個要求。呢類 NOT 題一定要逐個選項對返個 list，唔好靠感覺。 Rule Check: HKSA 600 (Revised) paras. 19–20 (as cited in LP). Common Trap（繁中）: 學生容易因為「fee」「profitability」聽落似商業考慮而誤以為係 acceptance 考慮嘅一部分。留意：呢度問嘅係 using the work of a component auditor 嘅 understanding，唔係 client acceptance；兩者嘅考慮因素清單唔同，唔好撈亂。 Q4 — Answer: See model answer Model Answer (EN): A component is identified as a significant component if either of the following criteria is met: 1. It is of individual financial significance to the group (e.g. a 15% benchmark of group assets, profit or revenue may be applied as indicative of financial significance, subject to professional judgement and documentation of its appropriateness); or 2. Due to its specific nature or circumstances , it is likely to include significant risks of material misstatement of the group financial statements (e.g. components involving impairment estimates, complex financial instruments, taxation provisions or contingencies). For non significant components , the group auditor is required to perform analytical procedures at group level covering those components, to corroborate the conclusion that there are no significant risks in them. If no additional risks are identified, the group auditor documents the belief that no further procedures are needed; if the analytical procedures indicate a possible risk of material misstatement, the group auditor documents the nature, timing and extent of further procedures to address the identified risks. 解題思路（繁中）: 短答題，兩部分都要答齊先攞滿分。第一部分係 significant component 嘅定義 — 關鍵字係 「individual financial significance」 同 「likely to include significant risks of material misstatement due to specific nature or circumstances」 ，兩個 criteria 係「或」唔係「和」，答少一個會失分。第二部分伏位最大：好多學生答「non significant components 唔使做程序」— 呢個係零分答案；HKSA 600 (Revised) 明確要求 group level analytical procedures，而且要 document 結論同埋（如有需要）進一步程序嘅 nature, timing and extent。15% benchmark 可以提，但要記住佢只係 indicative，仲要 professional judgement。 Rule Check: HKSA 600 (Revised) para. 9(m) (definition of significant component); paras. A5–A6 (15% benchmark); paras. 28–29 (non significant components) — as cited in LP. Common Trap（繁中）: (1) 將兩個 criteria 寫成必須同時符合；(2) 以為 15% 係硬性法定門檻；(3) 以為 non significant = 唔使做任何嘢。三個都係典型失分位。 Q5 — Answer: C Model Answer (EN): The proposal is not acceptable. Sole responsibility for the auditor's opinion on the group financial statements rests with the group engagement partner (and the group auditor), including for components audited by other firms. The group auditor must not simply rely on the component auditors' opinions; the group engagement team must obtain an appropriate understanding of the work performed by component auditors and be satisfied that sufficient appropriate audit evidence has been obtained. Under HKSA 220 (Revised), the group engagement partner is responsible for the direction, supervision, performance and review of the work and for the adequacy of the audit documentation supporting the opinion on the consolidated financial statements. 解題思路（繁中）: 呢題考 group audit 嘅核心原則： 冇得 divided responsibility 。Group engagement partner 對成個 group opinion 負全責，包括嗰三間由無關連 component auditors 審嘅子公司。Distractors：A 錯 — 披露 component auditors 嘅名唔會轉移責任；B 錯 — 責任冇得因 component 細而豁免，insignificant components 都要做 group level analytical procedures；D 錯 — audit committee 同意都改變唔到 HKSA 600 (Revised) 嘅要求。考試伏位：「披露就冇事」係最常見嘅錯誤直覺 — 記住 group auditor 唔可以靠 disclose 嚟卸責。 Rule Check: HKSA 600 (Revised) (sole responsibility of group auditor; LP 10.2.3 and Summary); HKSA 220 (Revised) Quality Management for an Audit of Financial Statements (group engagement partner's responsibilities, LP 10.3.1). Common Trap（繁中）: 學生會將「referencing another auditor's report」當成可以接受嘅做法（某些司法管轄區歷史上容許 division of responsibility）。喺 HKSA 600 (Revised) 下：唔得 — sole responsibility 係絕對嘅，所以 group auditor 先要咁多工夫去評估同參與 component auditor 嘅工作。

excerpt: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Meridian Logistics Ho…
text: M8 Chapter 10: Group Audits — Phase 3 Quiz Rules: Closed book · 15 minutes · 5 questions · Submit as 1. … 2. … 3. … 4. … 5. … — 超時如實申報 Q1. Meridian Logistics Holdings Limited ("Meridian") is a Hong Kong listed group with a 31 December year end. Its group engagement team has adopted 15% of group total assets as the benchmark indicative of financial significance. One component, Pearl Delta Warehousing Limited, contributes 22% of the group's total assets and 19% of group revenue; its operations are routine and no specific risks of material misstatement have been identified. Under HKSA 600 (Revised), what type of work must be performed on Pearl Delta Warehousing Limited? A. Analytical procedures performed at group level only B. An audit of the component's financial information using component materiality (a full audit) C. Specified audit procedures relating to likely significant risks of material misstatement only D. A review of the component's consolidation package with no further audit work Q2. Which of the following statements about component materiality is correct under HKSA 600 (Revised)? A. Component materiality is determined by the component auditor, who is closest to the component's operations B. Component materiality may exceed group materiality where the component is audited to local statutory requirements C. Component materiality is determined by the group engagement team and must be lower than group materiality D. Component materiality need not be communicated to the component auditor, to preserve audit unpredictability Q3. Under HKSA 600 (Revised), which of the following is NOT a matter about which the group auditor is required to obtain an understanding before using the work of a component auditor? A. Whether the component auditor will comply with ethical requirements, particularly independence, relevant to the group audit B. The professional competence of the component auditor C. The profitability and fee income of the component auditor's firm D. Whether the component auditor operates in a regulatory environment that actively oversees auditors Q4. State the TWO criteria under which a component is identified as a significant component of a group under HKSA 600 (Revised), and state the audit work required for components that are non significant . Q5. Harbour Crane Group Limited has ten subsidiaries, three of which are audited by component auditors unrelated to the group auditor, Pine & Co. In drafting the auditor's report on the consolidated financial statements, the group engagement partner proposes to include a statement that Pine & Co's opinion is based in part on the reports of the other auditors, so that responsibility for those components is shared with the component auditors. Which of the following best describes the position under HKSA 600 (Revised)? A. The proposal is acceptable provided the component auditors' names are disclosed in the auditor's report B. The proposal is acceptable only for components that are not financially significant to the group C. The proposal is not acceptable — the group engagement partner takes sole responsibility for the opinion on the group financial statements and cannot divide that responsibility with component auditors D. The proposal is acceptable if the group's audit committee gives written consent to the division of responsibility End of quiz. 唔好睇答案先，做完先對！
